response: {"headword":"abnormal","explanation":"形容詞「異常的、反常的」。指偏離正常、標準或預期的狀態。常用於醫療、科學或天氣描述。注意與 normal (正常的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The scientists were concerned when they noticed <target>abnormal</target> <pattern>readings</pattern> from the sensors, suggesting that the volcano might erupt soon.","translation":"科學家在注意到感測器出現異常讀數時感到擔心，這顯示火山可能很快會爆發。","explanation":"形容詞「異常的」。常用搭配：abnormal readings (異常讀數), abnormal behavior (異常行為)。"},{"sentence":"Due to the <target>abnormal</target> <pattern>amount of</pattern> rainfall this year, the city experienced severe flooding in several residential areas.","translation":"由於今年降雨量異常，該市幾個住宅區發生了嚴重水災。","explanation":"形容詞「異常的」。常用搭配：abnormal amount of sth (異常 amount 的...)。"},{"sentence":"The doctor explained that the patient's <target>abnormal</target> <pattern>heartbeat</pattern> was caused by extreme stress and lack of sleep during the exam period.","translation":"醫生解釋說，病人的異常心跳是由於考試期間極大的壓力以及缺乏睡眠引起的。","explanation":"形容詞「異常的」。常用搭配：abnormal heartbeat (異常心跳)。"}],"related_forms":["abnormally","abnormality"]}

{"headword": "abolish", "explanation": "動詞「廢除、取消」。通常指正式地取消法律、制度、習俗或傳統。常見搭配：abolish the death penalty (廢除死刑), abolish slavery (廢除奴隸制)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many people believe that the government should <target>abolish</target> the death penalty to protect human rights and prevent judicial errors.", "translation": "許多人認為政府應該廢除死刑以保護人權並防止司法錯誤。", "explanation": "動詞「廢除」。常用搭配：abolish the death penalty (廢除死刑)。"}, {"sentence": "In the past, some countries decided to <target>abolish</target> slavery after realizing that every human being deserves freedom and dignity.", "translation": "過去，一些國家在意識到每個人都應該享有自由與尊嚴後，決定廢除奴隸制。", "explanation": "動詞「廢除」。常用搭配：abolish slavery (廢除奴隸制)。"}, {"sentence": "The school board decided to <target>abolish</target> the old dress code of the students to encourage more individual expression and creativity.", "translation": "學校董事會決定廢除學生舊有的著裝規定，以鼓勵更多的個人表達和創造力。", "explanation": "動詞「廢除」。指正式地取消某種規定或制度。"}], "related_forms": ["abolition", "abolitionist"]}

{"headword":"abortion","explanation":"名詞「墮胎、流產」。指妊娠期內胚胎或胎兒被移除的過程。在 GSAT 英文中，此詞常出現在社會議題、生物學或醫學相關閱讀中。","entries":[{"sentence":"The debate over whether <target>abortion</target> should be legal remains a highly controversial issue in many societies around the world.","translation":"關於墮胎是否應該合法化的爭論在世界許多社會中仍然是一個高度爭議的議題。","explanation":"名詞「墮胎」。常用於討論法律和道德議題。"},{"sentence":"Medical professionals emphasize that safe <target>abortion</target> services are essential for women's health and reproductive rights in many countries.","translation":"醫療專業人士強調，在許多國家，安全的墮胎服務對於女性健康和生殖權利至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「墮胎」。"},{"sentence":"The woman unfortunately suffered a spontaneous <target>abortion</target> due to severe health complications during her second trimester of pregnancy.","translation":"這名女性不幸地在懷孕第二個三個月期間因嚴重的健康併發症而自然流產。","explanation":"名詞「流產」。指非自願的妊娠終止。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"abrupt","explanation":"形容詞「突然的、唐突的」。指事情發生得非常快且出乎意料，或者指人的態度突然變冷淡或不禮貌。常用搭配：abrupt change (突然的改變), an abrupt end (突然的結束)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The sudden and <target>abrupt</target> <pattern>change in</pattern> the weather forced the hikers to turn back before they could reach the mountain peak.","translation":"天氣突然且劇烈的改變迫使登山者在到達山頂前就得折返。","explanation":"形容詞「突然的」。常用搭配：abrupt change in sth (在...方面突然的改變)。"},{"sentence":"The meeting came to an <target>abrupt</target> <pattern>end</pattern> when the fire alarm rang, forcing everyone to evacuate the building immediately.","translation":"當火警警報響起時，會議突然結束，迫使每個人立即撤離建築物。","explanation":"形容詞「突然的」。常用搭配：abrupt end (突然的結束)。"},{"sentence":"The student was surprised by the teacher's <target>abrupt</target> <pattern>tone</pattern>, as the teacher usually spoke kindly and patiently to everyone.","translation":"學生對老師突然冷淡的口吻感到驚訝，因為老師通常對每個人都說話親切且有耐心。","explanation":"形容詞「唐突的」。指人的態度突然變得不禮貌或生硬。"}],"related_forms":["abruptly","abruptness"]}

{"headword":"absurd","explanation":"形容詞「荒謬的、可笑的」。指完全不合理、不符合邏輯或極其古怪的事物。常用搭配：absurd idea (荒謬的想法), an absurd amount of (荒謬的/極大量的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The idea that the earth is flat is completely <target>absurd</target> in the modern age of science and satellite imaging.","translation":"在現代科學和衛星成像時代，地球是平的這個想法完全是荒謬的。","explanation":"形容詞「荒謬的」。指不符合邏輯或科學事實。"},{"sentence":"He spent an <target>absurd</target> <pattern>amount of</pattern> money on a single pair of designer shoes, which his parents found completely unnecessary.","translation":"他花了一筆荒謬的金額買一雙設計師鞋子，他的父母認為這完全沒有必要。","explanation":"形容詞「荒謬的」。在這裡指數量極大且不合理。"},{"sentence":"The movie's plot was so <target>absurd</target> that the audience couldn't stop laughing at the ridiculous situations the characters found themselves in.","translation":"這部電影的劇情如此荒謬，以至於觀眾無法停止嘲笑角色們所處的滑稽情況。","explanation":"形容詞「荒謬的」。指極其古怪或可笑。"}],"related_forms":["absurdity","absurdly"]}

{"headword":"abundant","explanation":"形容詞「豐富的、充裕的」。指數量非常多，足以滿足需求。常用搭配：abundant evidence (充分的證據), abundant resources (豐富的資源)。注意與 scarce (稀少的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tropical rainforest is known for its <target>abundant</target> <pattern>wildlife</pattern>, with thousands of species of birds and insects living together.","translation":"熱帶雨林以其豐富的野生動物而聞名，成千上萬種鳥類和昆蟲共同生活在此。","explanation":"形容詞「豐富的」。常用搭配：abundant wildlife (豐富的野生動物)。"},{"sentence":"There is <target>abundant</target> <pattern>evidence</pattern> to suggest that regular exercise and a balanced diet can significantly improve overall health.","translation":"有充分的證據表明，規律的運動和均衡的飲食能顯著改善整體健康。","explanation":"形容詞「充分的」。常用搭配：abundant evidence (充分的證據)。"},{"sentence":"The region is blessed with <target>abundant</target> <pattern>natural resources</pattern>, such as oil and minerals, which has helped the local economy grow rapidly.","translation":"該地區擁有豐富的自然資源，如石油和礦產，這幫助當地經濟快速增長。","explanation":"形容詞「豐富的」。常用搭配：abundant natural resources (豐富的自然資源)。"}],"related_forms":["abundance","abundantly"]}

{"headword":"abuse","explanation":"名詞「濫用；虐待」；動詞「濫用；虐待」。指不正確、不公平或有害地使用某物，或對他人進行殘酷對待。常用搭配：drug abuse (藥物濫用), child abuse (虐待兒童), abuse power (濫用權力)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government implemented new laws to prevent the <target>abuse</target> <pattern>of</pattern> power by high-ranking officials in the political system.","translation":"政府實施了新法律，以防止政治體系中高階官員濫用權力。","explanation":"名詞「濫用」。常用搭配：abuse of power (濫用權力)。"},{"sentence":"Many social workers are dedicated to identifying and protecting victims of child <target>abuse</target> to ensure they receive proper care and support.","translation":"許多社工致力於辨識並保護受虐兒童，以確保他們得到適當的照顧和支持。","explanation":"名詞「虐待」。常用搭配：child abuse (虐待兒童)。"},{"sentence":"The athlete was banned from the competition after tests showed he had <target>abused</target> <pattern>performance-enhancing drugs</pattern> to gain an unfair advantage.","translation":"測試顯示該運動員使用了性能增強藥物以獲取不公平的優勢後，他被禁止參加比賽。","explanation":"動詞「濫用」。指不正確或有害地使用藥物。"},{"sentence":"The manager was criticized for <target>abusing</target> his employees by shouting at them and treating them with total disrespect.","translation":"經理因對員工大吼大叫且完全不尊重而遭到批評，因為他虐待了員工。","explanation":"動詞「虐待」。指對人進行殘酷或不公平的對待。"}],"related_forms":["abusive"]}

{"headword": "accelerate", "explanation": "動詞「加速」。指增加速度或使某個過程發生得更快。常用搭配：accelerate the process (加速過程), accelerate growth (加速增長)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The driver stepped on the gas pedal to <target>accelerate</target> the car and quickly merge into the fast lane of the highway.", "translation": "駕駛踩下油門加速車速，以便快速併入高速公路的快車道。", "explanation": "動詞「加速」。指增加物體的物理速度。"}, {"sentence": "The new government policy is expected to <target>accelerate</target> <pattern>the process of</pattern> economic recovery after the devastating earthquake.", "translation": "政府的新政策預計將加速地震後的經濟復甦過程。", "explanation": "動詞「加速」。指使一個過程或進展更快。常用搭配：accelerate the process of sth (加速...的過程)。"}, {"sentence": "Climate change is causing global temperatures to rise, which may <target>accelerate</target> <pattern>the melting of</pattern> polar ice caps.", "translation": "氣候變遷導致全球氣溫上升，這可能會加速極地冰蓋的融化。", "explanation": "動詞「加速」。常用搭配：accelerate the melting of sth (加速...的融化)。"}], "related_forms": ["acceleration", "accelerator"]}

{"headword":"accessible","explanation":"形容詞「可接近的、可進入的；易於理解的；可利用的」。指某地可被到達，或某物易於被理解或使用。常用搭配：accessible to (對...而言是可及的/可利用的), make something accessible (使...變得可及)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new museum was designed to be fully <target>accessible</target> <pattern>to</pattern> people with disabilities, including ramps and wide elevators.","translation":"這座新博物館被設計成對殘疾人士完全可及，包括設置坡道和寬敞的電梯。","explanation":"形容詞「可接近的」。常用搭配：accessible to sb/sth (對...可及)。"},{"sentence":"The professor's lectures are highly <target>accessible</target>, as he uses simple language and clear examples to explain complex theories.","translation":"教授的講座非常易於理解，因為他使用簡單的語言和清晰的例子來解釋複雜的理論。","explanation":"形容詞「易於理解的」。指內容不需要深奧的知識即可被理解。"},{"sentence":"Public libraries make a vast amount of information <target>accessible</target> <pattern>to</pattern> everyone in the community, regardless of their income level.","translation":"公共圖書館使社區中的每個人都能利用到大量資訊，無論其收入水平如何。","explanation":"形容詞「可利用的」。指資源可被取得或使用。"}],"related_forms":["access","accessibility"]}

{"headword":"accommodate","explanation":"動詞「容納；適應；提供住宿」。指提供足夠的空間、滿足需求或調整自己以適應環境。常用搭配：accommodate needs (滿足需求), accommodate guests (提供住宿)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new school auditorium was built to <target>accommodate</target> <pattern>up to</pattern> five hundred students for the graduation ceremony.","translation":"新學校禮堂被建造來容納多達五百名學生參加畢業典禮。","explanation":"動詞「容納」。指提供足夠的物理空間。常用搭配：accommodate up to... (容納多達...)。"},{"sentence":"The hotel was unable to <target>accommodate</target> <pattern>the special requests of</pattern> the guests due to the sudden increase in tourists.","translation":"由於遊客突然增加，酒店無法滿足客人的特殊要求。","explanation":"動詞「滿足」。指調整以符合某人的需求或要求。常用搭配：accommodate the requests of sb (滿足...的要求)。"},{"sentence":"The university provides several dormitories to <target>accommodate</target> students who come from other cities or countries to study.","translation":"大學提供數間宿舍以提供住宿給那些從其他城市或國家來學習的學生。","explanation":"動詞「提供住宿」。指提供居住空間。"},{"sentence":"To succeed in a multicultural environment, one must learn to <target>accommodate</target> <pattern>the different cultural norms of</pattern> others.","translation":"要在多元文化環境中取得成功，一個人必須學會適應他人的不同文化規範。","explanation":"動詞「適應」。指調整自己的行為以適應他人或環境。"}],"related_forms":["accommodation"]}

{"headword":"accommodation","explanation":"名詞「住宿；妥協」。在 GSAT 中，最常見的意義是「住宿」，常用於旅遊或租房情境。另一種意義是「妥協/調整」，指雙方達成一致。注意其不可數用法（指住宿）與可數用法（指妥協）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university provides high-quality <target>accommodation</target> for international students, ensuring they have a comfortable environment to study and live.","translation":"大學為國際學生提供高品質的住宿，確保他們有舒適的學習和生活環境。","explanation":"名詞「住宿」。此處為不可數名詞。"},{"sentence":"Since the hotel was fully booked, the tourists had to find alternative <target>accommodation</target> in a nearby small guest house.","translation":"由於飯店被訂滿了，遊客們必須在附近的一家小旅店尋找替代的住宿。","explanation":"名詞「住宿」。常用於描述尋找或提供住處。"},{"sentence":"After hours of negotiation, the two companies finally reached an <target>accommodation</target> that satisfied both parties' interests.","translation":"經過數小時的協商，兩家公司終於達成了一項妥協，滿足了雙方的利益。","explanation":"名詞「妥協/調整」。指雙方透過調整而達成一致。"}],"related_forms":["accommodations"]}

{"headword": "accord", "explanation": "名詞「協議；一致」；動詞「授予；使一致」。名詞用法中最常見的是 in accord with (與...一致) 或 of one's own accord (出於自願)。動詞用法常考點在於「授予某人某種尊重、權力或地位」，屬於雙賓語動詞結構。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The two neighboring countries signed a peace <target>accord</target> to end the long-term conflict and promote regional stability.", "translation": "兩個鄰國簽署了一項和平協議，以結束長期的衝突並促進區域穩定。", "explanation": "名詞用法，表示正式的書面協議或條約。"}, {"sentence": "Her actions are not <pattern>in</pattern> <target>accord</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the school's strict rules, which has led to a serious discussion with the principal.", "translation": "她的行為與學校的嚴格規定不一致，這導致她與校長進行了一次嚴肅的討論。", "explanation": "名詞用法，in accord with 為固定片語，意為「與...一致」或「符合」。"}, {"sentence": "He decided to clean the entire classroom <pattern>of</pattern> his own <target>accord</target>, surprising his teacher with his sudden initiative.", "translation": "他決定自願清理整個教室，比平常更主動的行為讓老師感到驚訝。", "explanation": "名詞用法，of one's own accord 為固定片語，意為「出於自願」或「主動」。"}, {"sentence": "The government <target>accorded</target> the visiting diplomat full honors, reflecting the high level of respect between the two nations.", "translation": "政府授予這位到訪的外交官最高規格的禮遇，反映出兩國之間的深度尊重。", "explanation": "動詞用法，意為「授予」或「給予」，後面直接接雙賓語（給予某人某種待遇）。"}], "related_forms": ["accordance"]}

{"headword":"accounting","explanation":"名詞「會計學；會計紀錄」。指記錄、分析及報告財務資訊的過程。在 GSAT 中通常出現在商業或職業討論的文章中。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many business students choose to major in <target>accounting</target> because they believe it provides a stable career path in the corporate world.","translation":"許多商業系學生選擇主修會計學，因為他們認為這在企業界能提供穩定的職業路徑。","explanation":"名詞「會計學」。指一種學科或專業。"},{"sentence":"The company's <target>accounting</target> records were carefully reviewed by an external auditor to ensure there were no financial errors.","translation":"公司的會計紀錄被外部審計師仔細審查，以確保沒有財務錯誤。","explanation":"名詞「會計紀錄」。指財務紀錄的過程或結果。"}],"related_forms":["accountant"]}

{"headword": "acknowledge", "explanation": "動詞「承認；告知收到」。名詞形式為 acknowledgement。常用於承認事實、承認某人的成就或告知收到信件。注意搭配 acknowledge that... 或 acknowledge sth as sth。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Despite the initial denial, the politician finally <target>acknowledged</target> <pattern>that</pattern> his previous statements were incorrect and apologized to the public.", "translation": "儘管最初否認，這位政治家最終承認他的先前陳述是不正確的，並向大眾道歉。", "explanation": "動詞「承認」。常用搭配 acknowledge that...。"}, {"sentence": "The school <target>acknowledged</target> the student's outstanding achievements <pattern>in</pattern> the science fair with a special award and a formal certificate.", "translation": "學校以特別獎項和正式證書，承認該學生在科學展中的傑出成就。", "explanation": "動詞「承認/認可」。指認可某人的努力或成就。"}, {"sentence": "Please <target>acknowledge</target> <pattern>receipt of</pattern> this email by replying with a simple yes or no, so we know the documents arrived safely.", "translation": "請回覆簡單的 yes 或 no 以告知收到此電子郵件，以便我們知道文件已安全送達。", "explanation": "動詞「告知收到」。常用片語 acknowledge receipt of sth。"}], "related_forms": ["acknowledgement"]}

{"headword":"acquaint","explanation":"動詞「使熟悉」。最常見的用法是 be acquainted with (與...熟悉/認識)。注意它與 know 的區別：acquaint 側重於使某人獲知資訊或認識某人，而 know 則是指一種狀態。","entries":[{"sentence":"Before starting the internship, the manager spent an hour to <target>acquaint</target> the new employees <pattern>with</pattern> the company's operating procedures.","translation":"在開始實習前，經理花了一小時讓新員工熟悉公司的操作程序。","explanation":"動詞「使熟悉」。常用搭配 acquaint someone with something。"},{"sentence":"I am not well <target>acquainted</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the local history of this city, so I rely on the tour guide for detailed information.","translation":"我對這個城市的當地歷史並不熟悉，所以我依賴導遊來獲取詳細資訊。","explanation":"形容詞化用法「熟悉」。片語 be acquainted with...。"}],"related_forms":["acquaintance"]}

{"headword":"acquisition","explanation":"名詞「獲得；收購」。指通過學習、購買或努力而獲得某物。在商業語境中，指一家公司買下另一家公司。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>acquisition</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a second language is often easier for children than for adults due to their natural curiosity and flexibility.","translation":"對於兒童來說，習得第二語言通常比成年人更容易，因為他們天生的好奇心和靈活性。","explanation":"名詞「獲得/習得」。指通過學習或過程而獲得能力。"},{"sentence":"The museum's recent <target>acquisition</target> of a rare 18th-century painting has attracted thousands of art lovers from all over the world.","translation":"博物館最近收購的一幅罕見的 18 世紀繪畫吸引了來自世界各地的數千名藝術愛好者。","explanation":"名詞「獲得」。指獲得一件珍貴的物品。"},{"sentence":"The tech giant's <target>acquisition</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the small startup company allowed them to enter the emerging market more quickly.","translation":"這家科技巨頭對這家小型創業公司的收購，讓他們能更迅速地進入新興市場。","explanation":"名詞「收購」。指商業上的買賣行為。"}],"related_forms":["acquire"]}

{"headword":"activist","explanation":"名詞「行動主義者；社會活動家」。指為了社會、政治或環境變革而採取行動的人。常用搭配 environmental activist, human rights activist。","entries":[{"sentence":"The environmental <target>activist</target> organized a large protest in the city center to demand stricter laws against air pollution.","translation":"這位環境行動主義者在市中心組織了一場大型抗議，要求對空氣污染制定更嚴格的法律。","explanation":"名詞「行動主義者」。指致力於環境保護的人。"},{"sentence":"As a young <target>activist</target>, she spent her weekends volunteering at the local shelter and writing letters to government officials for social change.","translation":"作為一名年輕的活動家，她週末都在當地收容所擔任志工並寫信給政府官員以尋求社會變革。","explanation":"名詞「活動家」。指致力於社會變革的人。"}],"related_forms":["activism","activate"]}

{"headword": "acute", "explanation": "形容詞「尖銳的；劇烈的；敏銳的」。常用於描述疼痛 (acute pain)、危機 (acute shortage/crisis) 或感官 (acute hearing/sight)。注意與 chronic (慢性的) 相對。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The patient complained of an <target>acute</target> pain in his lower back, which forced him to go to the emergency room immediately.", "translation": "病人抱怨下背部有劇烈的疼痛，這迫使他立即前往急診室。", "explanation": "形容詞「劇烈的」。常用於描述疼痛。"}, {"sentence": "Many developing countries are facing an <target>acute</target> shortage <pattern>of</pattern> clean drinking water, leading to serious health problems for the population.", "translation": "許多開發中國家面臨著乾淨飲用水的嚴重短缺，導致人口出現嚴重的健康問題。", "explanation": "形容詞「嚴重的/尖銳的」。常用搭配 acute shortage (嚴重短缺)。"}, {"sentence": "Dogs have an <target>acute</target> sense <pattern>of</pattern> smell, which allows them to find missing people even in the thickest forests.", "translation": "狗有敏銳的嗅覺，這使他們即使在最茂密的森林中也能找到失蹤的人。", "explanation": "形容詞「敏銳的」。常用於描述感官。"}], "related_forms": ["acutely"]}

{"headword":"administration","explanation":"名詞「管理；行政；政府」。指管理組織的過程，或指特定時期的政府（尤其是美國政府）。常用搭配 school administration, public administration。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school <target>administration</target> decided to implement a new policy regarding student dress codes to maintain a professional learning environment.","translation":"學校行政部門決定實施一項關於學生著裝規範的新政策，以維持專業的學習環境。","explanation":"名詞「行政/管理」。指學校的管理層。"},{"sentence":"Effective <target>administration</target> <pattern>of</pattern> resources is essential for any organization to achieve its goals and avoid wasting money.","translation":"有效的資源管理對於任何組織達成目標並避免浪費金錢都至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「管理」。指管理過程。"},{"sentence":"During the previous <target>administration</target>, the government focused on reducing taxes and encouraging small businesses to grow.","translation":"在之前的政府任期內，政府專注於減稅並鼓勵小型企業成長。","explanation":"名詞「政府」。指特定期間的執政團隊。"}],"related_forms":["administrator","administrative"]}

{"headword":"administrative","explanation":"形容詞「行政的；管理的」。指與管理或組織運作相關的事務。常用搭配 administrative assistant, administrative work。","entries":[{"sentence":"She was hired as an <target>administrative</target> assistant to help the manager organize meetings and handle the company's daily paperwork.","translation":"她被聘為行政助理，以幫助經理組織會議並處理公司的日常文書工作。","explanation":"形容詞「行政的」。常用搭配 administrative assistant (行政助理)。"},{"sentence":"The company decided to reduce <target>administrative</target> costs by introducing new software that automates the process of filing documents.","translation":"公司決定透過引入自動化文件歸檔的新軟體，來降低行政成本。","explanation":"形容詞「行政的」。指與管理運作相關的費用。"},{"sentence":"The university's <target>administrative</target> staff worked tirelessly to ensure that the registration process for new students was smooth and efficient.","translation":"大學的行政人員不懈地工作，以確保新生的註冊流程順暢且高效。","explanation":"形容詞「行政的」。指執行管理任務的人員。"}],"related_forms":["administration","administrator"]}

{"headword":"administrator","explanation":"名詞「管理員、行政人員」。指負責組織、管理或執行計畫、設施或機構之的人員。常用於學校、政府機關或公司環境。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school <target>administrator</target> decided to implement a new policy to reduce plastic waste in the cafeteria and classrooms.","translation":"學校行政人員決定實施一項新政策，以減少食堂和教室中的塑膠廢棄物。","explanation":"名詞「行政人員」。指負責學校管理的人員。"},{"sentence":"If you have any questions regarding the enrollment process, please contact the system <target>administrator</target> for further assistance.","translation":"如果您對入學流程有任何疑問，請聯繫系統管理員以獲得進一步的幫助。","explanation":"名詞「管理員」。指負責維護電腦系統或資料庫的人員。"}],"related_forms":["administration","administrators"]}

{"headword":"adolescent","explanation":"可作形容詞（青春期的、青少年的）或名詞（青少年）。指處於兒童期與成年期之間的人。注意其與 teenager (青少年) 的近義關係。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the <target>adolescent</target> stage of life, many individuals experience rapid physical changes and emotional instability.","translation":"在青春期的生命階段，許多人經歷了快速的身體變化和情緒不穩定。","explanation":"形容詞「青春期的」。描述處於成長過程中的狀態。"},{"sentence":"The youth center provides various programs designed to support <target>adolescents</target> in dealing with the pressure of academic competition.","translation":"青少年中心提供各種計畫，旨在支持青少年應對學業競爭的壓力。","explanation":"名詞「青少年」。指處於青春期的人。"},{"sentence":"Parents are encouraged to maintain open communication with their <target>adolescent</target> children to better understand their needs and feelings.","translation":"父母被鼓勵與他們的青春期孩子保持開放的溝通，以便更好地理解他們的需求和感受。","explanation":"形容詞「青少年的」。用於修飾 children。"}],"related_forms":["adolescence"]}

{"headword":"adore","explanation":"動詞「崇拜、極其喜愛」。比 love 更強烈，常用於表達對某人、某物或某個活動的深切喜愛。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many young fans <target>adore</target> the famous K-pop stars, following their every move and collecting all their latest albums.","translation":"許多年輕粉絲極其喜愛那些著名的 K-pop 明星，關注他們的每一步動作並收集他們所有最新的專輯。","explanation":"動詞「極其喜愛」。表示強烈的喜好。"},{"sentence":"The little girl <target>adored</target> her new puppy, spending every free moment playing with it in the garden.","translation":"小女孩非常喜愛她的新小狗，利用每一個空閒時間在花園裡陪它玩耍。","explanation":"動詞「極其喜愛」。常用於描述對寵物或親人的喜愛。"}],"related_forms":["adoration","adorable"]}

{"headword":"adverse","explanation":"形容詞「不利的、有害的」。常用於描述天氣、反應或環境等對某事產生負面影響。常用搭配 adverse effects (副作用/不利影響) 或 adverse weather (不利天氣)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The outdoor graduation ceremony was postponed due to <target>adverse</target> <pattern>weather</pattern> conditions, such as heavy rain and strong winds.","translation":"由於大雨和強風等不利的天氣條件，戶外畢業典禮被推遲了。","explanation":"形容詞「不利的」。常用搭配：adverse weather (不利天氣)。"},{"sentence":"Some patients may experience <target>adverse</target> <pattern>reactions</pattern> to the medication, so it is important to consult a doctor before taking it.","translation":"某些患者對該藥物可能會產生不良反應，因此在服用前諮詢醫生非常重要。","explanation":"形容詞「有害的/不良的」。常用搭配：adverse reactions (不良反應)。"},{"sentence":"Despite facing <target>adverse</target> <pattern>circumstances</pattern> in her early life, she worked hard and eventually became a successful lawyer.","translation":"儘管在早年生活中面臨不利的情況，她依然努力工作，最終成為一名成功的律師。","explanation":"形容詞「不利的」。常用搭配：adverse circumstances (不利的情況)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"advocate","explanation":"可作名詞（擁護者、辯護律師）或動詞（主張、提倡）。動詞用法常接 to V 或 for sth。注意名詞形式 advocate 為擁護者，而動詞 advocate 的發音有所不同。","entries":[{"sentence":"She has become a strong <target>advocate</target> <pattern>for</pattern> animal rights, spending her weekends volunteering at the local animal shelter.","translation":"她已成為動物權利的強烈擁護者，週末都在當地的動物收容所擔任志工。","explanation":"名詞「擁護者」。常用搭配：advocate for sth (擁護某事)。"},{"sentence":"Many health experts <target>advocate</target> <pattern>a balanced diet</pattern> and regular exercise to prevent chronic diseases and improve overall well-being.","translation":"許多健康專家提倡均衡飲食和定期運動，以預防慢性疾病並提高整體健康。","explanation":"動詞「提倡」。直接接名詞作為受詞。"},{"sentence":"The student council <target>advocates</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the installation of more water dispensers in the school hallways to improve student convenience.","translation":"學生會主張安裝更多飲水機在學校走廊上，以提高學生的便利性。","explanation":"動詞「主張」。常用搭配：advocate for sth。"}],"related_forms":["advocacy"]}

{"headword": "affection", "explanation": "名詞「喜愛、愛慕」。指一種溫暖且持久的感情。常用搭配 have affection for sth/sb (對...有感情), show affection (表達愛意)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The child <pattern>showed</pattern> deep <target>affection</target> <pattern>for</pattern> his grandfather by hugging him every time they met.", "translation": "孩子每次見到祖父時都會擁抱他，表達出深厚的喜愛之情。", "explanation": "名詞「喜愛」。常用搭配：affection for sb (對某人的喜愛)。"}, {"sentence": "Although they were once rivals in sports, they have <pattern>developed</pattern> a strong mutual <target>affection</target> over the years of friendship.", "translation": "雖然他們曾經在體育方面是競爭對手，但經過多年的友誼，他們之間產生了深厚的相互愛慕之情。", "explanation": "名詞「愛慕」。指一種溫暖的感情。"}, {"sentence": "The puppy wagged its tail and leaped up, <pattern>showing</pattern> its <target>affection</target> <pattern>for</pattern> its owner in a very energetic way.", "translation": "小狗搖著尾巴跳了起來，以一種非常有活力的方式表達對主人的喜愛。", "explanation": "名詞「喜愛」。常用搭配：affection for sb。"}], "related_forms": ["affectionate"]}

{"headword":"agenda","explanation":"名詞「議程、待辦事項」。原指會議中要討論的事項清單。在現代用法中，也可用於指某人或組織的隱藏目的（hidden agenda）。","entries":[{"sentence":"Before the meeting started, the teacher handed out the <target>agenda</target> so that everyone knew which topics would be discussed first.","translation":"在會議開始前，老師發放了議程，以便每個人都知道哪些主題將首先被討論。","explanation":"名詞「議程」。指會議討論事項的清單。"},{"sentence":"Reducing carbon emissions has become a top priority on the global <target>agenda</target> to combat climate change and protect the environment.","translation":"減少碳排放已成為全球議程中的首要任務，以對抗氣候變遷並保護環境。","explanation":"名詞「議程」。指一個群體或組織打算達成的事項。"},{"sentence":"Some people suspected that the politician had a <pattern>hidden</pattern> <target>agenda</target> and was not truly interested in helping the poor.","translation":"有些人懷疑這名政治家有隱藏的意圖，而且並非真正感興趣於幫助窮人。","explanation":"名詞「隱藏目的」。常用搭配：hidden agenda (隱藏目的)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"aggression","explanation":"名詞「侵略、挑釁、攻擊性」。可用於描述國家間的軍事侵略，或個人在社交行為中的攻擊性。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school counselor is teaching students how to manage their <target>aggression</target> and resolve conflicts through peaceful communication.","translation":"學校輔導員正在教學生如何管理他們的攻擊性，並通過和平溝通來解決衝突。","explanation":"名詞「攻擊性」。指傾向於攻擊他人的行為或傾向。"},{"sentence":"The international community condemned the country's <target>aggression</target> against its neighbors, calling for an immediate ceasefire and peace talks.","translation":"國際社會譴責該國對其鄰國的侵略，要求立即停火並進行和平談判。","explanation":"名詞「侵略」。指國家間的武力攻擊。"},{"sentence":"Some researchers believe that high levels of stress can lead to increased <target>aggression</target> in both teenagers and adults.","translation":"一些研究人員認為，高水平的壓力會導致青少年和成年人的攻擊性增加。","explanation":"名詞「攻擊性」。指心理上的攻擊傾向。"}],"related_forms":["aggressive"]}

{"headword":"agony","explanation":"名詞「極大的痛苦」。指身體上的劇烈疼痛或心理上的極度痛苦。常用搭配 be in agony (處於極大痛苦之中)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The athlete was <pattern>in</pattern> <target>agony</target> after twisting his ankle during the final race, and he had to be carried off the field.","translation":"這名運動員在最後一場比賽中扭到腳踝後處於極大的痛苦之中，必須被抬離球場。","explanation":"名詞「極大的痛苦」。常用片語：be in agony (處於極大痛苦之中)。"},{"sentence":"Waiting for the exam results to be announced was pure <target>agony</target> for the students who had studied tirelessly for months.","translation":"對於那些努力學習了數月的學生來說，等待考試結果公布簡直是極大的折磨。","explanation":"名詞「極大的痛苦」。此處指心理上的極度焦慮和折磨。"},{"sentence":"She cried in <target>agony</target> when she realized that her favorite childhood toy had been permanently lost during the move.","translation":"當她意識到她最喜歡的童年玩具在搬家過程中永久丟失時，她痛苦地哭泣。","explanation":"名詞「極大的痛苦」。指情緒上的劇烈痛苦。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "agricultural", "explanation": "形容詞「農業的」。常用於描述與耕種、農產或農村相關的事物。常用搭配 agricultural products (農產品), agricultural land (農地)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The government is providing subsidies to help farmers upgrade their <target>agricultural</target> technology to increase crop yields and reduce labor.", "translation": "政府正提供補貼以幫助農民升級他們的農業技術，以增加作物產量並減少人力。", "explanation": "形容詞「農業的」。常用搭配：agricultural technology (農業技術)。"}, {"sentence": "Many students in rural areas are studying <target>agricultural</target> science to learn how to grow healthier and more sustainable crops.", "translation": "許多農村地區的學生正在學習農業科學，以學習如何種植更健康且更永續的作物。", "explanation": "形容詞「農業的」。常用搭配：agricultural science (農業科學)。"}, {"sentence": "The city's economy used to rely heavily on <target>agricultural</target> products, but it has now shifted toward industrial development.", "translation": "這個城市的經濟過去嚴重依賴農產品，但現在已轉向工業發展。", "explanation": "形容詞「農業的」。常用搭配：agricultural products (農產品)。"}], "related_forms": ["agriculture"]}

{"headword":"aisle","explanation":"名詞「走道」。常用於飛機、電影院、超市或教堂中兩排座位或貨架之間的通道。注意與 island (島嶼) 的發音區別，aisle 的 s 不發音。","entries":[{"sentence":"The flight attendant asked the passengers to keep the <target>aisle</target> clear of luggage to ensure a safe and quick evacuation if needed.","translation":"空服員要求乘客不要在走道上放置行李，以確保在需要時能安全且快速地撤離。","explanation":"名詞「走道」。指飛機艙內的走道。"},{"sentence":"I spent twenty minutes searching for the organic honey in the supermarket <target>aisle</target>, but I finally found it near the baking supplies.","translation":"我在超市的走道中花了二十分鐘尋找有機蜂蜜，但最後在烘焙用品區附近找到了。","explanation":"名詞「走道」。指超市貨架間的通道。"},{"sentence":"The bride walked slowly down the <target>aisle</target> on her father's arm, while the guests watched her with admiration and joy.","translation":"新娘在父親的陪伴下緩緩走過走道，賓客們則帶著讚賞與喜悅地看著她。","explanation":"名詞「走道」。指教堂或婚禮現場的中央通道。"}],"related_forms":["aisles"]}

{"headword":"alcoholic","explanation":"可作為形容詞「酒精的；酗酒的」或名詞「酗酒者」。形容詞用法常指飲料中含有酒精，而名詞用法則指對酒精有依賴的人。注意與 alcohol (酒精) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many countries have strict laws to prevent the sale of <target>alcoholic</target> beverages to minors to protect their health and development.","translation":"許多國家有嚴格的法律防止將酒精飲料出售給未成年人，以保護他們的健康和發育。","explanation":"形容詞「酒精的」。常用搭配：alcoholic beverages (酒精飲料)。"},{"sentence":"The doctor advised the patient to avoid <target>alcoholic</target> drinks while taking this medication to prevent dangerous side effects.","translation":"醫生建議患者在服用此藥物時避免飲用酒精飲料，以防止危險的副作用。","explanation":"形容詞「酒精的」。"},{"sentence":"After struggling with addiction for years, he finally decided to seek professional help to recover from being an <target>alcoholic</target>.","translation":"經過多年的成癮掙扎，他終於決定尋求專業幫助，從酗酒者的狀態中恢復。","explanation":"名詞「酗酒者」。指對酒精有依賴的人。"}],"related_forms":["alcohol","alcoholism"]}

{"headword":"alien","explanation":"形容詞「外來的；陌生的」或名詞「外星人；外國人」。在法律語境中常用於指非本國公民。注意其形容詞用法在 GSAT 中較少見，名詞用法更為常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"The movie tells a story about an <target>alien</target> from a distant galaxy who lands on Earth and tries to communicate with humans.","translation":"這部電影講述了一個來自遙遠星系的外星人降落在地球並試圖與人類交流的故事。","explanation":"名詞「外星人」。"},{"sentence":"The government provides specific legal services to help <target>alien</target> residents apply for permanent residency or work permits in the country.","translation":"政府提供特定的法律服務，以幫助外國居民申請該國的永久居留權或工作許可證。","explanation":"名詞「外國人」。在法律或行政文件中常用於指非本國公民。"},{"sentence":"Entering the new city felt like visiting an <target>alien</target> world because the architecture and customs were completely different from his hometown.","translation":"進入這座新城市感覺就像訪問一個陌生的世界，因為這裡的建築和習俗與他的家鄉完全不同。","explanation":"形容詞「外來的；陌生的」。指不熟悉或完全不同的事物。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"allergic","explanation":"形容詞「過敏的」。常用搭配 be allergic to (對...過敏)。注意與名詞 allergy 的區別，allergic 是描述狀態的形容詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"Since she is severely <target>allergic</target> <pattern>to</pattern> peanuts, she always checks the ingredients list carefully before buying any packaged snacks.","translation":"由於她對花生嚴重過敏，因此在購買任何包裝零食前都會仔細檢查成分表。","explanation":"形容詞「過敏的」。常用搭配 be allergic to sth。"},{"sentence":"Some people become <target>allergic</target> <pattern>to</pattern> certain types of pollen during the spring, leading to constant sneezing and itchy eyes.","translation":"有些人會在春天對某些類型的花粉產生過敏反應，導致不斷打噴嚏和眼睛發癢。","explanation":"形容詞「過敏的」。"}],"related_forms":["allergy"]}

{"headword":"allergy","explanation":"名詞「過敏」。指身體對某些物質產生的異常反應。常用搭配 have an allergy to (對...過敏)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The patient told the nurse that he had a severe <target>allergy</target> <pattern>to</pattern> penicillin, so the doctor had to change the medication.","translation":"患者告訴護士他對盤尼西林嚴重過敏，所以醫生不得不更改藥物。","explanation":"名詞「過敏」。常用搭配 have an allergy to sth。"},{"sentence":"Food <target>allergies</target> have become more common in recent years, making it necessary for restaurants to clearly label all potential allergens.","translation":"食物過敏在近年來變得更加普遍，使得餐廳有必要清晰地標記所有潛在的過敏原。","explanation":"名詞「過敏」。複數形式 allergies。"}],"related_forms":["allergic"]}

{"headword":"alliance","explanation":"名詞「聯盟；同盟」。指兩個或多個國家、組織或個人為了共同目標而建立的合作關係。常用搭配 form an alliance (結盟)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two neighboring countries decided to <pattern>form</pattern> an <target>alliance</target> to protect their shared borders from external threats and invasions.","translation":"兩個鄰國決定結盟，以保護他們的共同邊界免受外部威脅和入侵。","explanation":"名詞「聯盟」。片語 form an alliance 表示「結盟」。"},{"sentence":"The small business owners created a strategic <target>alliance</target> to compete with larger corporations by sharing resources and marketing strategies.","translation":"小企業主們建立了一個戰略聯盟，通過分享資源和營銷策略來與大型公司競爭。","explanation":"名詞「聯盟」。指組織間的合作關係。"}],"related_forms":["ally"]}
comment: Note: 'form an alliance' is correctly marked.

response: {"headword": "allocate", "explanation": "動詞「分配；撥款」。常用於指將時間、金錢、資源或土地等分配給特定的用途或對象。常見搭配為 allocate something to someone/something。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The city council decided to <target>allocate</target> more funds <pattern>to</pattern> the renovation of public parks to improve the living environment for residents.", "translation": "市議會決定撥款更多資金用於公共公園的翻新，以改善居民的居住環境。", "explanation": "動詞「撥款；分配」。allocate funds to... 是財政預算中極常見的用法。"}, {"sentence": "Students are advised to <target>allocate</target> their study time <pattern>among</pattern> different subjects to ensure they are well-prepared for the final exams.", "translation": "建議學生明智地分配學習時間到不同科目中，以確保他們為期末考做好充分準備。", "explanation": "動詞「分配」。指時間或抽象資源的合理規劃與分佈。"}, {"sentence": "The government will <target>allocate</target> emergency supplies <pattern>to</pattern> the areas worst affected by the recent earthquake.", "translation": "政府將把緊急物資分配給受近期地震影響最嚴重的地區。", "explanation": "動詞「分配」。指實體物資或資源的分發。"}], "related_forms": ["allocation"]}

{"headword":"ally","explanation":"名詞「盟友」或動詞「結盟」。名詞用法指在戰爭或政治中支持彼此的人或國家；動詞用法則指與他人合作。常用搭配 ally with sb/sth.","entries":[{"sentence":"During the war, the country relied heavily on its strong <target>allies</target> for military support and strategic intelligence to defeat the enemy.","translation":"戰爭期間，該國嚴重依賴其強大的盟友提供軍事支持和戰略情報以擊敗敵人。","explanation":"名詞「盟友」。複數形式 allies。"},{"sentence":"To increase their market share, the small tech startup decided to <target>ally</target> <pattern>itself with</pattern> a global electronics giant.","translation":"為了增加市場份額，這家小型科技初創公司決定與一家全球電子巨頭結盟。","explanation":"動詞「結盟」。常用搭配 ally oneself with sb/sth。"}],"related_forms":["alliance"]}

{"headword":"alongside","explanation":"可作為介系詞「在...旁邊」或副詞「在旁邊；同時」。常用於描述物理位置或兩件事物同時發生、並行。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new bicycle path was built <target>alongside</target> the river, providing a beautiful scenic route for people to exercise and relax.","translation":"新的自行車道被建在河邊，為人們運動和放鬆提供了一條美麗的風景路線。","explanation":"介系詞「在...旁邊」。指物理位置的相鄰。"},{"sentence":"The experienced professor worked <target>alongside</target> the young researchers to complete the project, combining theoretical knowledge with new ideas.","translation":"經驗豐富的教授與年輕研究員一起工作，以完成該計畫，將理論知識與新想法結合。","explanation":"介系詞「與...一起」。指共同工作或合作。"},{"sentence":"The government introduced new laws <target>alongside</target> a series of educational campaigns to reduce the rate of plastic pollution.","translation":"政府在推出新法律的同時，也採取了一系列的教育宣傳活動，以降低塑料污染率。","explanation":"副詞「同時」。指兩件事物並行發生。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"alter","explanation":"動詞「改變；修改」。指對某物進行小幅度的調整以使其更適合或更好。注意與 change 的區別：alter 通常指局部修改而保留原貌，而 change 可能是徹底地改變。常用搭配 alter the course of (改變...的進程)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tailor had to <target>alter</target> the wedding dress to fit the bride perfectly, as the original size was slightly too large.","translation":"裁縫必須修改婚紗以使其完美契合新娘，因為原本的尺寸稍微太大了。","explanation":"動詞「修改」。指對衣服尺寸的調整。"},{"sentence":"The unexpected discovery of a new fossil may <target>alter</target> the way scientists understand the evolution of early mammals.","translation":"發現一件新的化石可能會改變科學家對早期哺乳動物演化的理解方式。","explanation":"動詞「改變」。指對觀念或計畫的修改。"},{"sentence":"Severe climate change has <target>altered</target> the natural habitats of many animals, forcing them to migrate to colder regions to survive.","translation":"嚴重的氣候變遷已改變了許多動物的自然棲息地，迫使它們遷移到較冷地區以生存。","explanation":"動詞「改變」。此處為過去分詞 altered。"}],"related_forms":["alteration","unaltered"]}

{"headword":"alternate","explanation":"形容詞「交替的、輪流的」；動詞「輪流、交替」；名詞「替代者」。注意形容詞用法時常指兩種事物交替出現，而替代方案通常使用 alternative。","entries":[{"sentence":"The athlete decided to <target>alternate</target> <pattern>between</pattern> high-intensity training and light stretching to prevent injury and recover faster.","translation":"這位運動員決定在高強度訓練和輕度拉伸之間交替進行，以防止受傷並更快恢復。","explanation":"動詞「交替」。常用搭配 alternate between A and B。"},{"sentence":"The dress had an <target>alternate</target> <pattern>pattern of</pattern> red and white stripes, creating a bold and eye-catching appearance.","translation":"這件衣服有紅白相間的交替條紋圖案，營造出一種大膽且引人注目的外觀。","explanation":"形容詞「交替的」。指兩種顏色或圖案輪流出現。"},{"sentence":"Since the main speaker was unable to attend the conference, the committee appointed an <target>alternate</target> to deliver the presentation instead.","translation":"由於主講人無法出席會議，委員會指派了一名替代者來代替他進行簡報。","explanation":"名詞「替代者」。指在原定人員不能出席時接替的人。"}],"related_forms":["alternately","alternation"]}

{"headword":"amend","explanation":"動詞「修改、修正」。通常用於正式文件、法律、條款或議案的修改。注意與 modify (修改) 的區別：amend 側重於為了使之更正確、更公平或更完善而進行的正式修改。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school board decided to <target>amend</target> the student handbook to include new rules regarding the use of smartphones in class.","translation":"學校董事會決定修改學生手冊，以將關於在課堂上使用智慧型手機的新規定納入其中。","explanation":"動詞「修改」。指對正式文件的修正。"},{"sentence":"The government is planning to <target>amend</target> the current tax laws to provide more support for low-income families across the country.","translation":"政府計畫修改現行的稅法，以為全國低收入家庭提供更多支持。","explanation":"動詞「修正」。指對法律條文的更改。"},{"sentence":"After receiving feedback from the professor, the student had to <target>amend</target> his research paper to correct several factual errors.","translation":"在收到教授的反饋後，學生必須修改他的研究論文以糾正幾處事實錯誤。","explanation":"動詞「修正」。指為了使其更準確而進行的修改。"}],"related_forms":["amendment"]}

{"headword": "ample", "explanation": "形容詞「充足的、寬敞的」。常用於描述空間、時間、理由或數量足夠，甚至超出原本的需求。", "entries": [{"sentence": "There was <target>ample</target> <pattern>opportunity</pattern> <pattern>for</pattern> the students to ask questions after the guest speaker finished the presentation.", "translation": "在客座講師完成簡報後，學生有充足的機會提問。", "explanation": "形容詞「充足的」。常見搭配 ample opportunity for someone/something。"}, {"sentence": "The new library provides <target>ample</target> space for students to study quietly and access a wide variety of digital resources.", "translation": "新圖書館為學生提供了寬敞的空間，以便安靜地學習並獲取各種數位資源。", "explanation": "形容詞「寬敞的；充足的」，此處用來修飾物理空間。"}, {"sentence": "Since the exam is not until next month, you should have <target>ample</target> <pattern>time</pattern> <pattern>to</pattern> review all the key concepts and practice problems.", "translation": "由於考試要到下個月才舉行，你應該有充足的時間來複習所有關鍵概念和練習題。", "explanation": "形容詞「充足的」。常用搭配 ample time to + 動詞原型。"}], "related_forms": ["amply"]}

{"headword":"analyst","explanation":"名詞「分析師」。指專門從事數據、財務或系統分析的專業人士。常用搭配：financial analyst (財務分析師), data analyst (數據分析師)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company hired a professional <target>analyst</target> to examine the market trends and help them develop a more effective marketing strategy.","translation":"公司聘請了一名專業分析師來研究市場趨勢，並幫助他們制定更有效的行銷策略。","explanation":"名詞「分析師」。指透過分析數據來提供建議的專家。"},{"sentence":"As a financial <target>analyst</target>, she spends most of her day studying stock market fluctuations and predicting future investment risks.","translation":"作為一名財務分析師，她大部分的時間都在研究股市波動並預測未來的投資風險。","explanation":"名詞「分析師」。常用搭配 financial analyst。"},{"sentence":"The data <target>analyst</target> used a complex software program to organize the survey results and identify common patterns in consumer behavior.","translation":"數據分析師使用複雜的軟體程式來整理調查結果，並找出消費者行為中的共同模式。","explanation":"名詞「分析師」。常用搭配 data analyst。"}],"related_forms":["analyze","analysis"]}

{"headword": "anonymous", "explanation": "形容詞「匿名的」。指不透露姓名或身份的。常考搭配：anonymous donor (匿名捐贈者), anonymous letter (匿名信)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The local hospital received a generous donation from an <target>anonymous</target> donor who wished to remain unknown to the public.", "translation": "當地醫院收到了一位希望對大眾保持匿名的匿名捐贈者的慷慨捐款。", "explanation": "形容詞「匿名的」。常用搭配 anonymous donor。"}, {"sentence": "The school principal received an <target>anonymous</target> tip about the planned prank, allowing the teachers to stop it before it happened.", "translation": "校長收到了一則關於計畫中惡作劇的匿名舉報，使老師們能在事件發生前將其阻止。", "explanation": "形容詞「匿名的」。指不透露身份的評論。"}, {"sentence": "Many people prefer to leave <target>anonymous</target> comments on social media to avoid being judged by their peers or family members.", "translation": "許多人更喜歡在社群媒體上留下匿名評論，以避免受到同儕或家人的評判。", "explanation": "形容詞「匿名的」。指不透露身份的評論。"}], "related_forms": ["anonymity", "anonymously"]}

{"headword": "anticipate", "explanation": "動詞「預期、預料」。指預先想到某事會發生並提前做好準備。注意與 expect (期望/期待) 的區別：anticipate 更多強調「預見並採取行動」或「預料到將要發生」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The event organizers <target>anticipate</target> that more than five hundred people will attend the art exhibition this weekend.", "translation": "活動主辦方預計本週末將有五百多人參加這次藝術展。", "explanation": "動詞「預期」。指根據現有資訊預測未來的情況。"}, {"sentence": "A good chess player can <target>anticipate</target> the opponent's next move and plan their own strategy accordingly to win the game.", "translation": "一名出色的西洋棋手能預料對手的下一步棋，並據此規劃自己的策略以贏得比賽。", "explanation": "動詞「預料」。指預先想到對方的行動。"}, {"sentence": "The city council is trying to <target>anticipate</target> potential problems with the new traffic system before it is officially launched next month.", "translation": "市議會正試圖在下個月正式推出新交通系統之前，預料到可能出現的問題。", "explanation": "動詞「預期」。指預先發現並解決潛在問題。"}], "related_forms": ["anticipation", "anticipated"]}

{"headword": "antique", "explanation": "形容詞「古董的、古老的」；名詞「古董」。通常指具有歷史價值且年代久遠的物品。", "entries": [{"sentence": "My grandmother owns a beautiful <target>antique</target> clock that has been passed down through three generations of our family.", "translation": "我的祖母擁有一座美麗的古董鐘，這座鐘在我們家族中傳承了三代。", "explanation": "形容詞「古董的」。指具有歷史價值的古老物品。"}, {"sentence": "The small town is famous for its <target>antique</target> shops, where collectors can find rare furniture and jewelry from the nineteenth century.", "translation": "這個小鎮以其古董店而聞名，收藏家可以在這裡找到十九世紀的稀有家具和珠寶。", "explanation": "名詞「古董」。在此作為修飾語，指販賣古董的商店。"}, {"sentence": "The expert carefully examined the vase to determine if it was a genuine <target>antique</target> or a modern reproduction made to look old.", "translation": "專家仔細檢查了這個花瓶，以確定它是真正的古董還是為了看起來像古物而製作的現代複製品。", "explanation": "名詞「古董」。指具有年代感的藝術品或物件。"}], "related_forms": ["antiques"]}

{"headword":"applause","explanation":"名詞「掌聲」。不可數名詞。常用搭配：burst into applause (爆發掌聲), loud applause (熱烈掌聲)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The pianist received a <pattern>round of</pattern> <target>applause</target> from the audience after finishing the difficult concerto with perfect precision.","translation":"鋼琴家在完美地完成這首困難的協奏曲後，贏得了觀眾的一輪掌聲。","explanation":"名詞「掌聲」。常用搭配 a round of applause。"},{"sentence":"The crowd <pattern>burst into</pattern> <target>applause</target> as the national team scored the winning goal in the final seconds of the match.","translation":"當國家隊在比賽最後幾秒攻入致勝球時，人群爆發出掌聲。","explanation":"名詞「掌聲」。片語 burst into applause 表示「突然爆發掌聲」。"},{"sentence":"Despite her nervousness, the student's speech was so inspiring that it was met with <pattern>loud</pattern> <target>applause</target> from her classmates.","translation":"儘管她很緊張，但這位學生的演講如此激勵人心，以至於贏得了同學們熱烈的掌聲。","explanation":"名詞「掌聲」。常用搭配 loud applause。"}],"related_forms":["applaud"]}

{"headword": "appliance", "explanation": "名詞「家用電器」。通常指廚房或家庭中使用的機器設備。常用搭配：household appliances (家用電器), kitchen appliances (廚房電器)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Modern <target>appliances</target>, such as dishwashers and microwave ovens, have made housework much easier and more efficient for many families.", "translation": "現代電器，如洗碗機和微波爐，使許多家庭的家務變得簡單且高效許多。", "explanation": "名詞「電器」。指家用設備。"}, {"sentence": "When moving to the new apartment, the couple decided to buy energy-efficient <target>appliances</target> to reduce their monthly electricity bills.", "translation": "搬到新公寓時，這對夫婦決定購買節能電器，以降低每月的電費。", "explanation": "名詞「電器」。常用搭配 energy-efficient appliances。"}, {"sentence": "The store offers a two-year warranty on all major household <target>appliances</target>, ensuring that customers can get repairs if something breaks.", "translation": "該商店對所有主要家用電器提供兩年保固，確保客戶在設備損壞時能獲得維修。", "explanation": "名詞「電器」。指家用設備。"}], "related_forms": ["appliances"]}

{"headword": "apt", "explanation": "形容詞「傾向於...的」或「恰當的」。當表示傾向時，常用 apt to V；當表示恰當時，常用 an apt description/word。", "entries": [{"sentence": "People who do not get enough sleep are <target>apt</target> <pattern>to</pattern> make more mistakes and struggle with concentration during their morning classes.", "translation": "睡眠不足的人傾向於在早晨的課程中犯更多錯誤，且難以集中注意力。", "explanation": "形容詞「傾向於」。常用搭配 be apt to V。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher described the student's curiosity as an <target>apt</target> description of his desire to learn everything about space and stars.", "translation": "老師將這名學生的好奇心描述為對他渴望了解所有關於太空和恆星之事的恰當描述。", "explanation": "形容詞「恰當的」。指描述得準確。"}, {"sentence": "In the humid climate of Taiwan, electronics are <target>apt</target> <pattern>to</pattern> malfunction if they are not stored in a cool, dry place.", "translation": "在台灣潮濕的氣候中，如果電子產品不儲存在陰涼乾燥的地方，很容易發生故障。", "explanation": "形容詞「傾向於」。指某事在特定條件下容易發生。"}], "related_forms": ["aptly", "aptness"]}

{"headword":"architect","explanation":"名詞「建築師」。指設計建築物的人。在延伸義中，也可以指某個計畫、方案或系統的「策劃者」或「設計者」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>architect</target> spent several months drawing detailed plans for the new city library to ensure it was both modern and sustainable.","translation":"建築師花了好幾個月時間為新的城市圖書館繪製詳細計畫，以確保其既現代又具永續性。","explanation":"名詞「建築師」。指專業設計建築的人。"},{"sentence":"As the primary <target>architect</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the peace treaty, the diplomat worked tirelessly to bring the two conflicting nations together.","translation":"作為和平協議的主要策劃者，這位外交官不懈地工作，以使兩個衝突的國家達成一致。","explanation":"名詞「策劃者」。這裡指計畫或方案的設計者。"}],"related_forms":["architects","architectural"]}

{"headword":"architecture","explanation":"名詞「建築學；建築風格；結構」。指設計和建造建築物的藝術和科學，或者指特定建築物或系統（如電腦架構）的整體結構。","entries":[{"sentence":"Students of <target>architecture</target> often visit historic cities to study how the building styles have evolved over hundreds of years.","translation":"建築學的學生經常造訪歷史名城，以研究建築風格在數百年間是如何演變的。","explanation":"名詞「建築學」。指專業的學問。"},{"sentence":"The cathedral is famous for its stunning Gothic <target>architecture</target>, featuring pointed arches and intricate stone carvings.","translation":"這座大教堂以其令人驚嘆的哥德式建築風格而聞名，其特點是尖拱和複雜的石雕。","explanation":"名詞「建築風格」。指建築的藝術形式。"},{"sentence":"Engineers are developing a new computer <target>architecture</target> that can process data much faster than current systems.","translation":"工程師們正在開發一種新的電腦架構，其處理數據的速度比目前的系統快得多。","explanation":"名詞「結構/架構」。指系統或設備的組成方式。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"arena","explanation":"名詞「競技場；舞台；領域」。原指圓形的露天競技場，現在常用於比喻指競爭激烈的環境或某個特定的活動領域（如政治 arena）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The athletes gathered in the massive sports <target>arena</target> for the opening ceremony of the international competition.","translation":"運動員們聚集在巨大的體育競技場中，參加國際比賽的開幕式。","explanation":"名詞「競技場」。指實際的物理空間。"},{"sentence":"After years of working in local government, she decided to enter the political <target>arena</target> by running for mayor.","translation":"在地方政府工作多年後，她決定透過競選市長進入政治領域。","explanation":"名詞「領域/舞台」。比喻指競爭激烈的環境。"}],"related_forms":["arenas"]}

{"headword":"arouse","explanation":"動詞「引起；喚起」。常用於引起某種情感、興趣或懷疑。注意搭配 arouse interest, arouse suspicion 等。注意其不規則變化：arouse-aroused-aroused。","entries":[{"sentence":"The mysterious behavior of the new student <target>aroused</target> <pattern>the suspicion of</pattern> his classmates, who began to wonder about his background.","translation":"新同學神秘的行為引起了同學的懷疑，他們開始好奇他的背景。","explanation":"動詞「引起」。常用搭配 arouse the suspicion of...。"},{"sentence":"The teacher's passionate lecture on space exploration <target>aroused</target> <pattern>the interest of</pattern> many students in the science club.","translation":"老師對太空探索的熱情講座引起了科學社團許多學生的興趣。","explanation":"動詞「引起」。常用搭配 arouse the interest of...。"},{"sentence":"The sudden change in the company's policy <target>aroused</target> <pattern>strong feelings of</pattern> anger among the employees.","translation":"公司政策的突然改變引起了員工之間強烈的憤怒感。","explanation":"動詞「引起」。指引起某種情緒。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"array","explanation":"名詞「一大群；大量；陣列」。常用於描述大量且排列整齊或令人印象深刻的事物。常考片語：an array of (一大群/大量)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The bookstore offers a wide <target>array</target> <pattern>of</pattern> classic novels, making it a favorite spot for literature students.","translation":"這家書店提供各式各樣的經典小說，使其成為文學系學生的最愛。","explanation":"名詞「大量/各式各樣」。片語 an array of...。"},{"sentence":"The gallery displayed an impressive <target>array</target> <pattern>of</pattern> modern sculptures, each representing a different artistic vision.","translation":"畫廊展示了一系列令人印象深刻的現代雕塑，每一件都代表了不同的藝術視覺。","explanation":"名詞「大量」。片語 an array of...。"},{"sentence":"In the computer lab, the students set up a solar <target>array</target> to test how sunlight is converted into electricity.","translation":"在電腦實驗室裡，學生們設置了一個太陽能陣列，以測試陽光如何轉換為電能。","explanation":"名詞「陣列」。指排列整齊的設備。"}],"related_forms":["arrays"]}

{"headword": "arrogant", "explanation": "形容詞「傲慢的、自大的」。指一個人自認為比他人更重要或更有能力，因而表現出無禮或輕蔑的態度。反義詞為 humble (謙卑的)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Although he was the top student in the class, he remained humble and never <pattern>acted</pattern> <target>arrogantly</target> <pattern>toward</pattern> his peers.", "translation": "雖然他是班上成績最好的學生，但他依然保持謙虛，對同儕從不表現得傲慢。", "explanation": "在此使用副詞形式 arrogantly 來修飾動詞 act，表示傲慢地表現。"}, {"sentence": "The manager's <target>arrogant</target> attitude during the interview made the candidate feel unwelcome and unimportant.", "translation": "經理在面試 during the interview 面試期間傲慢的態度讓應徵者感到不受歡迎且不重要。", "explanation": "形容詞「傲慢的」。修飾抽象名詞 attitude (態度)。"}, {"sentence": "No one wanted to work with the <target>arrogant</target> designer because he always refused to accept any constructive feedback.", "translation": "沒有人想和那位傲慢的設計師共事，因為他總是拒絕接受任何建設性的反饋。", "explanation": " województwo"}], "related_forms": ["arrogance", "arrogantly"]}

{"headword":"articulate","explanation":"動詞「清晰地表達」；形容詞「口才好的；表達清晰的」。作動詞時，指將想法明確地說出。作形容詞時，指一個人能夠流暢且清晰地表達自己的想法。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student struggled to <target>articulate</target> his thoughts during the debate, as he was too nervous to speak clearly.","translation":"這名學生在辯論賽中難以清晰地表達他的想法，因為他太緊張而無法清楚地說話。","explanation":"動詞「清晰地表達」。"},{"sentence":"She is an <target>articulate</target> speaker who can explain complex scientific concepts in a way that everyone can understand.","translation":"她是一位口才好的演講者，能以每個人都能理解的方式解釋複雜的科學概念。","explanation":"形容詞「口才好的」。"},{"sentence":"It is important for leaders to be <target>articulate</target> when presenting their goals to the public to avoid any misunderstandings.","translation":"領導者在向公眾發表目標時，必須能夠清晰地表達，以避免任何誤會。","explanation":"形容詞「表達清晰的」。"}],"related_forms":["articulated","articulation"]}

{"headword":"ass","explanation":"名詞「驢子；笨蛋」。在正式場合中，指動物驢子。在非正式口語中，可以用來指稱一個人很笨或很討厭。","entries":[{"sentence":"The farmer used his <target>ass</target> to carry heavy bags of grain across the rocky path to the village market.","translation":"農夫利用他的驢子將沉重的穀物袋橫跨岩石小徑運送到村莊市場。","explanation":"名詞「驢子」。"},{"sentence":"Stop acting like an <target>ass</target> and apologize to your sister for the mistake you made yesterday.","translation":"別再像個笨蛋一樣表現，快為你昨天犯的錯誤向你妹妹道歉。","explanation":"名詞「笨蛋」。非正式用法。"}],"related_forms":["asses"]}

{"headword":"assault","explanation":"名詞「攻擊；襲擊」；動詞「攻擊；襲擊」。指突然且暴力的行為。在法律術語中，指對他人身體的攻擊。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police are investigating a violent <target>assault</target> that took place in the park late last night.","translation":"警方正在調查昨晚深夜在公園發生的一起暴力襲擊事件。","explanation":"名詞「襲擊」。"},{"sentence":"The soldiers were ordered to <target>assault</target> the enemy's base at dawn to capture the important documents.","translation":"士兵們接到命令在黎明時分攻擊敵軍基地以奪取重要文件。","explanation":"動詞「攻擊」。"},{"sentence":"The loud noise from the construction site was an <target>assault</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the students' ears, making it impossible to concentrate on their exam.","translation":"建築工地傳來的巨大噪音對學生的耳朵來說是一種折磨（攻擊），讓他們無法專注於考試。","explanation":"名詞「攻擊」。比喻用法，指感官上的強烈刺激或不適。"}],"related_forms":["assaults"]}

{"headword":"assert","explanation":"動詞「斷言；主張；堅持」。指自信地陳述某事為真，或者堅持自己的權利或權威。常考片語：assert oneself (表現得自信/強勢)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite the evidence, the witness continued to <target>assert</target> <pattern>that</pattern> he had seen the suspect leave the building at midnight.","translation":"儘管有證據，證人仍繼續斷言他曾在午夜看到嫌疑犯離開建築物。","explanation":"動詞「斷言」。常接 that 子句。"},{"sentence":"New employees are often encouraged to <target>assert</target> <pattern>themselves</pattern> in meetings to share their creative ideas with the team.","translation":"新員工通常被鼓勵在會議中中表現得自信，以與團隊分享他們的創意想法。","explanation":"動詞片語 assert oneself 表示「表現得自信/強勢」。"},{"sentence":"The small nation worked hard to <target>assert</target> <pattern>its independence</pattern> after years of being controlled by a larger power.","translation":"這個小國在被大國控制多年後，努力地主張其獨立地位。","explanation":"動詞「主張」。指堅持自己的權利或地位。"}],"related_forms":["assertion","assertive"]}

{"headword": "assess", "explanation": "動詞「評估；評價」。名詞 assessment 意為「評估」。常用於學業成績評估或價值評估。注意搭配 assess sth as sth (將...評估為...) 或 assess the impact of sth (評估...的影響)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The teacher will <target>assess</target> the students' performance <pattern>based on</pattern> their final project and classroom participation throughout the semester.", "translation": "老師將根據學生在本學期的期末專題和課堂參與度來評估他們的表現。", "explanation": "動詞「評估」。常用搭配 assess... based on...。"}, {"sentence": "Environmental experts are trying to <target>assess</target> the impact of the oil spill on the local marine ecosystem and wildlife.", "translation": "環境專家正試圖評估油污洩漏對當地海洋生態系統和野生動物的影響。", "explanation": "動詞「評估」。"}, {"sentence": "The company hired a professional appraiser to <target>assess</target> the market value of the old painting before it was put up for auction.", "translation": "公司聘請了一名專業的評估師，在該幅古畫被拍賣前評估其市場價值。", "explanation": "動詞「評估」。"}], "related_forms": ["assessment", "assessable"]}

{"headword":"asset","explanation":"名詞「資產；優勢」。可指金錢、房產等財產，也可指一個人的能力或特質，使其成為一個有價值的成員。常用搭配 a valuable asset to (對...是一個寶貴的資產/優勢)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new employee's ability to speak three languages fluently is a <pattern>valuable</pattern> <target>asset</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the company's international trade department.","translation":"新員工能流利地說三種語言，對公司的國際貿易部門來說是一個寶貴的資產。","explanation":"名詞「優勢/資產」。常用搭配 a valuable asset to sth/sb。"},{"sentence":"The family decided to sell some of their fixed <target>assets</target>, such as land and buildings, to raise money for their daughter's college education.","translation":"這家人決定出售一些固定資產，如土地和建築，以籌集女兒就讀大學的學費。","explanation":"名詞「資產」。常用搭配 fixed assets (固定資產)。"},{"sentence":"Having a positive attitude and strong leadership skills can be a great <target>asset</target> when applying for a competitive university scholarship.","translation":"擁有積極的態度和強大的領導能力在申請競爭激烈的大學獎學金時會是一個很大的優勢。","explanation":"名詞「優勢」。"}],"related_forms":["assets"]}

{"headword":"assumption","explanation":"名詞「假設；假定」。指在沒有證據的情況下認為某事是真的。注意區分 assumption (假設) 與 presumption (推定)。常用搭配 make an assumption (做出假設)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The scientist's theory was based on the <target>assumption</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the temperature of the ocean would remain constant over the next decade.","translation":"這位科學家的理論是基於海洋溫度在未來十年將保持不變的假設。","explanation":"名詞「假設」。常用結構 assumption that + 子句。"},{"sentence":"It is a common <target>assumption</target> <pattern>that</pattern> students who get high grades always have better career prospects, but this is not always true.","translation":"人們通常假設成績好的學生總是會有更好的職業前景，但事實並不總是如此。","explanation":"名詞「假設」。"},{"sentence":"You should not <pattern>make</pattern> any <target>assumptions</target> <pattern>about</pattern> someone's personality just by looking at their clothes or the way they talk.","translation":"你不應該僅僅通過觀察一個人的衣服或說話方式就對其個性做出任何假設。","explanation":"名詞「假設」。常用片語 make an assumption about sth。"}],"related_forms":["assume"]}

{"headword": "astonish", "explanation": "動詞「使驚訝」。名詞 astonishment 意為「驚訝」。比 surprise 更強烈。常用結構 astonish sb (使某人驚訝) 或 be astonished at/by sth (對...感到驚訝)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The young pianist's incredible skill <target>astonished</target> the audience, as she played a complex piece of music with effortless grace.", "translation": "這位年輕鋼琴家的驚人技巧讓觀眾感到驚訝，因為她以輕鬆優雅地演奏了一首複雜的樂曲。", "explanation": "動詞「使驚訝」。"}, {"sentence": "I was <target>astonished</target> <pattern>at</pattern> how quickly the small town had changed after the new high-speed railway station was built.", "translation": "我對這個小鎮在新的高速鐵路車站建成後變化之快感到驚訝。", "explanation": "動詞「感到驚訝」。常用搭配 be astonished at/by sth。"}, {"sentence": "Many people were <target>astonished</target> <pattern>by</pattern> the sudden decision of the government to increase taxes on luxury goods next year.", "translation": "許多人對政府明年增加奢侈品稅的突然決定感到驚訝。", "explanation": "動詞「感到驚訝」。常用搭配 be astonished by sth。"}], "related_forms": ["astonishment", "astonishing", "astonished"]}

{"headword":"athletics","explanation":"名詞「田徑；運動」。指包含跑步、跳躍、投擲等項目的運動。注意 athletics 是單數形式但通常視為單數名詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school's <target>athletics</target> program is well-known for producing many national champions in sprinting and long jump.","translation":"學校的田徑計畫以培養出許多短跑和跳遠的國家冠軍而聞名。","explanation":"名詞「田徑」。"},{"sentence":"Many students balance their academic studies with <target>athletics</target> to maintain a healthy lifestyle and reduce stress during exam periods.","translation":"許多學生在學業與運動之間取得平衡，以維持健康的飲食生活方式並在考試期間減輕壓力。","explanation":"名詞「運動」。"},{"sentence":"After years of hard training, he finally achieved his goal of competing in the <target>athletics</target> <pattern>events</pattern> at the Olympic Games.","translation":"經過多年的刻苦訓練，他終於實現了在奧運會田徑項目中參賽的目標。","explanation":"名詞「田徑」。常用搭配 athletics events。"}],"related_forms":["athletic","athlete"]}
comment: Note: The translation for sentence 2 mentions '飲食生活方式' (dietary lifestyle), but the English sentence only says 'healthy lifestyle'. This is a minor translation inaccuracy.

response: {"headword":"attendance","explanation":"名詞「出席；參加」。常用於學校或會議的出席率。常用片語 attendance record (出席記錄), poor attendance (出席率低)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher noted that <target>attendance</target> <pattern>at</pattern> the morning assembly was lower than usual due to the heavy rain.","translation":"老師注意到由於大雨，早會的出席人數比平常低。","explanation":"名詞「出席人數」。常用搭配 attendance at sth。"},{"sentence":"Maintaining a good <target>attendance</target> <pattern>record</pattern> is essential for students who wish to apply for certain university scholarships.","translation":"對於希望申請某些大學獎學金的學生來說，維持良好的出席記錄至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「出席」。常用搭配 attendance record (出席記錄)。"},{"sentence":"The city council decided to increase the <target>attendance</target> of the local art gallery by offering free admission to students.","translation":"市議會決定通過向學生提供免費入場，來增加當地美術館的參觀人數。","explanation":"名詞「參觀人數/出席人數」。"}],"related_forms":["attend"]}

{"headword":"attic","explanation":"名詞「閣樓」。指房屋頂部正下方的空間。常用於描述儲存舊物或秘密空間。","entries":[{"sentence":"My grandmother keeps all her old photo albums and handwritten letters <pattern>in</pattern> the <target>attic</target>, where they are safe from dust.","translation":"我的祖母將所有舊相簿和手寫信件都放在閣樓裡，在那裡它們不會被灰塵影響。","explanation":"名詞「閣樓」。"},{"sentence":"The family decided to convert the dusty <target>attic</target> <pattern>into</pattern> a small, cozy study room for their teenage son.","translation":"這家人決定將佈滿灰塵的閣樓改成一個給他們青春期兒子使用的小巧舒適的書房。","explanation":"名詞「閣樓」。常用搭配 convert... into... (將...轉化為...)。"},{"sentence":"While exploring the old house, the children found a mysterious locked wooden box <pattern>in</pattern> the <target>attic</target> that contained ancient coins.","translation":"在探索舊房子時，孩子們在閣樓裡發現了一個裝有古幣的神秘鎖住的木箱。","explanation":"名詞「閣樓」。"}],"related_forms":["attics"]}

{"headword":"attorney","explanation":"名詞「律師」。在美國英語中常用 attorney，而在英國英語中常用 solicitor 或 barrister。常用搭配 defense attorney (辯護律師)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The suspect was advised to contact a defense <target>attorney</target> to ensure his legal rights were protected during the trial.","translation":"嫌疑犯被建議聯繫一名辯護律師，以確保他在審判期間的法律權利受到保護。","explanation":"名詞「律師」。常用搭配 defense attorney (辯護律師)。"},{"sentence":"After the car accident, the victim hired an <target>attorney</target> to help him <pattern>file a lawsuit</pattern> against the insurance company.","translation":"車禍後，受害者聘請了一名律師來幫助他向保險公司提起訴訟。","explanation":"名詞「律師」。常用片語 file a lawsuit (提起訴訟)。"},{"sentence":"The company's corporate <target>attorney</target> reviewed the contract carefully to make sure there were no legal loopholes that could cause problems.","translation":"公司的企業律師仔細地審查了合約，以確保沒有會導致問題的法律漏洞。","explanation":"名詞「律師」。"}],"related_forms":["attorneys"]}

{"headword":"attribute","explanation":"動詞「歸因於」。注意其名詞形式 attribute (發音不同) 意為「特質；屬性」。常用結構 attribute sth to sth (將...歸因於...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many historians <target>attribute</target> the fall of the ancient empire <pattern>to</pattern> a combination of internal corruption and external invasions.","translation":"許多歷史學家將古代帝國的滅亡歸因於內部腐敗和外部入侵的結合。","explanation":"動詞「歸因於」。常用結構 attribute sth to sth。"},{"sentence":"The coach <target>attributed</target> the team's victory <pattern>to</pattern> the players' hard work and their ability to communicate effectively on the field.","translation":"教練將球隊的勝利歸因於球員們的努力工作以及他們在場上有效溝通的能力。","explanation":"動詞「歸因於」。"},{"sentence":"The doctor <target>attributed</target> the patient's sudden recovery <pattern>to</pattern> a new experimental treatment that had shown promising results in early trials.","translation":"醫生將患者的突然康復歸因於於一個在早期試驗中顯示出良好結果的新實驗性治療方法。","explanation":"動詞「歸因於」。"}],"related_forms":["attributable"]}

{"headword":"auction","explanation":"名詞「拍賣會」；動詞「拍賣」。指透過競爭出價最高者得之。常用片語 put up for auction (將...投入拍賣)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The rare stamp collection was <target>put up for</target> <target>auction</target>, attracting bidders from all over the world who were willing to pay high prices.","translation":"這套稀有郵票收藏被投入拍賣，吸引了來自世界各地願意支付高價的競標者。","explanation":"名詞「拍賣會」。常用片語 put up for auction。"},{"sentence":"The company decided to <target>auction</target> off its old office equipment to make room for new, more efficient technology in the workspace.","translation":"公司決定將其舊的辦公設備拍賣掉，以在工作空間中為新的、更高效的技術騰出空間。","explanation":"動詞「拍賣」。常用片語 auction off (拍賣掉)。"},{"sentence":"At the <target>auction</target>, the bidding started at one thousand dollars, but it quickly rose as several people competed for the artwork.","translation":"在拍賣會上，競標從一千美元開始，但隨著數人爭奪這件藝術品，價格迅速上升。","explanation":"名詞「拍賣會」。"}],"related_forms":["auctioneer"]}
comment: Note: In sentence 1, <target>put up for</target> <target>auction</target> is incorrect marking. <target> should only be used for the headword 'auction'. 'put up for' should be marked as <pattern>.

response: {"headword":"authorize","explanation":"動詞「授權；批准」。指正式允許某人做某事或正式批准某項計畫。常用被動語態 be authorized to V。","entries":[{"sentence":"Only the school principal is <target>authorized</target> <pattern>to</pattern> approve the budget for the upcoming annual sports meet.","translation":"只有校長被授權批准即將到來的年度運動會的預算。","explanation":"動詞「授權」。常用句型 be authorized to V。"},{"sentence":"The government decided to <target>authorize</target> the construction of a new bridge to reduce traffic congestion between the two cities.","translation":"政府決定批准建設一座新橋樑，以減少兩座城市之間的交通擁堵。","explanation":"動詞「批准」。指正式許可某項計畫或行動。"},{"sentence":"Please enter your password to <target>authorize</target> the transaction, ensuring that your bank account remains secure from fraud.","translation":"請輸入您的密碼以授權此次交易，確保您的銀行帳戶免受欺詐而保持安全。","explanation":"動詞「授權」。常用於金融或數位權限語境。"}],"related_forms":["authorization","authorized"]}

{"headword":"autonomy","explanation":"名詞「自治權；自主性」。指一個國家、地區或個人能夠自我管理、獨立決策的能力或權利。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university allows its professors a great deal of <target>autonomy</target> <pattern>in</pattern> designing their own courses and teaching methods.","translation":"這所大學允許教授在設計自己的課程和教學方法方面擁有很大程度的自主權。","explanation":"名詞「自主性」。常用搭配 autonomy in sth。"},{"sentence":"Many people believe that giving students more <target>autonomy</target> <pattern>over</pattern> their learning process can increase their motivation and creativity.","translation":"許多人認為，給予學生更多對學習過程的自主掌控權可以提高他們的動力和創造力。","explanation":"名詞「自主權」。常用搭配 autonomy over sth。"},{"sentence":"The regional government fought for greater political <target>autonomy</target> to manage its own local laws and economic policies.","translation":"該地區政府爭取更大的政治自治權，以便管理自己的地方法律和經濟政策。","explanation":"名詞「自治權」。指政治上的獨立管理。"}],"related_forms":["autonomous"]}

{"headword":"awe","explanation":"名詞「敬畏；驚嘆」；動詞「使敬畏」。常用於描述面對壯麗自然景觀或偉大成就時的感受。常見片語 in awe of (對...感到敬畏)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tourists stood <pattern>in</pattern> <target>awe</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the Grand Canyon, amazed by its immense size and breathtaking beauty.","translation":"遊客們對大峽谷感到敬畏，被其巨大的規模和令人窒息的美麗所震撼。","explanation":"名詞「敬畏」。片語 in awe of 表示對某人或某物感到極其敬佩或震撼。"},{"sentence":"The young artist was <target>awed</target> <pattern>by</pattern> the intricate details of the ancient sculptures in the museum.","translation":"年輕的藝術家被博物館中古代雕塑的複雜細節所震撼。","explanation":"動詞「使敬畏」的被動形式。常用搭配 be awed by sth。"},{"sentence":"The sheer scale of the universe and the number of galaxies often fill astronomers with a sense of <target>awe</target>.","translation":"宇宙的巨大規模和星系的數量經常讓天文學家感到一種敬畏之情。","explanation":"名詞「敬畏」。常用搭配 a sense of awe。"}],"related_forms":["awesome","awestruck"]}

{"headword":"backyard","explanation":"名詞「後院」。指住宅後方的戶外空間。常用於描述家庭生活或休閒活動。","entries":[{"sentence":"On sunny weekends, the family often gathers in the <target>backyard</target> to have a barbecue and play games together.","translation":"在陽光的週末，全家人經常聚集在後院一起燒烤並玩遊戲。","explanation":"名詞「後院」。"},{"sentence":"The children spent the entire afternoon playing soccer in the <target>backyard</target>, unaware that it was starting to rain.","translation":"孩子們整個下午都在後院踢足球，沒有意識到開始下雨了。","explanation":"名詞「後院」。"},{"sentence":"She decided to plant a small vegetable garden in her <target>backyard</target> to grow fresh tomatoes and cucumbers for her family.","translation":"她決定在她的後院種一個小蔬菜園，為家人種新鮮的番茄和小黃瓜。","explanation":"名詞「後院」。"}],"related_forms":["backyards"]}

{"headword":"ballot","explanation":"名詞「選票；投票」；動詞「投票」。 ballot box 指「投票箱」。cast a ballot 為常用片語，意為「投一票」。","entries":[{"sentence":"After the debate, the students <pattern>cast</pattern> their <target>ballots</target> to elect the new class president in a secret vote.","translation":"辯論結束後，學生們在秘密投票中投了選票，以選出新的班長。","explanation":"名詞「選票」。片語 cast a ballot 表示「投一票」。"},{"sentence":"The election officials carefully counted every <target>ballot</target> to ensure that the final result was accurate and fair.","translation":"選舉官員仔細地計算每張選票，以確保最終結果準確且公平。","explanation":"名詞「選票」。"},{"sentence":"The committee decided to <target>ballot</target> the members to determine whether the proposal should be accepted or rejected.","translation":"委員會決定對成員進行投票，以決定該提案應該被接受還是被拒絕。","explanation":"動詞「投票」。指通過投票方式來做決定。"},{"sentence":"The security guards monitored the <target>ballot</target> <pattern>box</pattern> throughout the day to prevent any illegal attempts to change the votes.","translation":"保全人員整天監控投票箱，以防止任何非法更改票數的嘗試。","explanation":"名詞「選票/投票」。ballot box 指「投票箱」。"}],"related_forms":["ballots"]}

{"headword":"ban","explanation":"動詞「禁止」；名詞「禁令」。常用搭配 ban sth on sth (禁止某物在某處使用) 或 place a ban on sth (對...實施禁令)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school decided to <target>ban</target> the use of smartphones during class to help students concentrate better on their lessons.","translation":"學校決定禁止在課堂上使用智慧型手機，以幫助學生更好地專注於課程。","explanation":"動詞「禁止」。常用搭配 ban sth。"},{"sentence":"The city government <pattern>placed</pattern> a <target>ban</target> <pattern>on</pattern> plastic bags to reduce environmental pollution and encourage people to use reusable bags.","translation":"市政府對塑膠袋實施了禁令，以減少環境污染並鼓勵人們使用可重複使用的購物袋。","explanation":"名詞「禁令」。片語 place a ban on sth 表示「對...實施禁令」。"},{"sentence":"Due to safety concerns, the local authorities <target>banned</target> swimming in the lake after the heavy rains caused the water to become contaminated.","translation":"出於安全考量，在暴雨導致水質污染後，地方當局禁止在湖中游泳。","explanation":"動詞「禁止」。"},{"sentence":"The government's <target>ban</target> <pattern>on</pattern> certain chemicals was welcomed by environmental groups who wanted to protect the local wildlife.","translation":"政府對某些化學物質的禁令受到了環境團體的歡迎，他們希望保護當地野生動物。","explanation":"名詞「禁令」。常用搭配 ban on sth。"}],"related_forms":["bans","banned"]}

{"headword":"banner","explanation":"名詞「橫幅；旗幟」。常用於抗議、慶祝或廣告。常用搭配 hang a banner (掛橫幅)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students <pattern>hung</pattern> a large, colorful <target>banner</target> across the gym to welcome the visiting basketball team from another city.","translation":"學生們在體育館橫跨掛了一條巨大的彩色橫幅，以歡迎來自另一個城市的客隊籃球隊。","explanation":"名詞「橫幅」。常用搭配 hang a banner。"},{"sentence":"During the protest, the activists carried a <target>banner</target> that demanded stricter laws to protect the endangered species in the rainforest.","translation":"在抗議期間，活動人士攜帶著一條橫幅，要求制定更嚴格的法律來保護雨林中瀕危的物種。","explanation":"名詞「橫幅」。"},{"sentence":"The website's home page features a bright <target>banner</target> <pattern>ad</pattern> promoting the upcoming summer sale with huge discounts on all electronics.","translation":"該網站的首頁有一個亮眼的橫幅廣告，推廣即將到來的夏季特賣，所有電子產品都有巨大的折扣。","explanation":"名詞「橫幅」。banner ad 指「橫幅廣告」。"}],"related_forms":["banners"]}

{"headword":"barren","explanation":"形容詞「貧瘠的；不毛的」。常用於描述土地無法種植作物，或比喻某處缺乏生命力或想法枯竭。","entries":[{"sentence":"Because the land was so <target>barren</target>, the farmers struggled to grow enough crops to feed their families during the drought.","translation":"因為土地如此貧瘠，農民在乾旱期間很難種出足夠的作物來餵養他們的家人。","explanation":"形容詞「貧瘠的」。指土地缺乏營養，無法耕種。"},{"sentence":"The explorers traveled across the <target>barren</target> landscape of the desert, where they saw almost no plants or animals for miles.","translation":"探險家們穿越沙漠的荒涼景觀，在那裡好幾英里幾乎看不到任何植物或動物。","explanation":"形容詞「荒涼的、不毛的」。"},{"sentence":"After hours of brainstorming, the writer felt his mind had become <target>barren</target>, and he could not think of any new ideas for the story.","translation":"經過數小時的集思廣益後，作者覺得自己的腦袋空了，無法為故事想出任何新點子。","explanation":"形容詞「枯竭的」。比喻想法或創造力缺失。"}],"related_forms":["barrenness"]}

{"headword":"batch","explanation":"名詞「一批」。指在同一時間生產或處理的一組相同物品。常用於烘焙（a batch of cookies）或電腦處理（batch processing）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The baker prepared a fresh <target>batch</target> <pattern>of</pattern> chocolate chip cookies, and the sweet smell filled the entire bakery.","translation":"烘焙師準備了一批新鮮的巧克力碎片餅乾，甜美的香味瀰漫在整個麵包店中。","explanation":"名詞「一批」。常用搭配 a batch of sth。"},{"sentence":"The factory produced a new <target>batch</target> <pattern>of</pattern> smartphones, but some were returned due to a technical defect in the screen.","translation":"工廠生產了一批新的智慧型手機，但其中一些因為螢幕有技術缺陷而被退貨。","explanation":"名詞「一批」。指同一生產批次。"},{"sentence":"The teacher graded the first <target>batch</target> <pattern>of</pattern> essays over the weekend, providing detailed feedback to help the students improve.","translation":"老師在週末批改了第一批論文，並提供詳細的反饋以幫助學生進步。","explanation":"名詞「一批」。指同一時間處理的一組文件。"}],"related_forms":["batches"]}

{"headword":"behalf","explanation":"名詞「代表」。幾乎總是出現在片語 on behalf of (代表...；為了...的利益)。注意不要將其與 half (一半) 混淆。","entries":[{"sentence":"The class president gave a short speech <pattern>on</pattern> <target>behalf</target> <pattern>of</pattern> all the students to thank the principal for the new library.","translation":"班長代表所有學生發表了一短篇演講，感謝校長提供新的圖書館。","explanation":"名詞「代表」。片語 on behalf of 表示「代表某人」。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer spoke <pattern>on</pattern> <target>behalf</target> <pattern>of</pattern> his client during the trial, arguing that the evidence was insufficient for a conviction.","translation":"律師在審判期間代表他的當事人發言，主張證據不足以定罪。","explanation":"名詞「代表」。片語 on behalf of 表示「代表某人」。"},{"sentence":"The organization raised money <pattern>on</pattern> <target>behalf</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the refugees, providing them with food, clothing, and temporary shelter.","translation":"該組織代表難民籌集資金，為他們提供食物、衣服和臨時住所。","explanation":"名詞「代表/利益」。此處指為了難民的利益而採取行動。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "belongings", "explanation": "名詞「個人財產，所有物」。通常使用複數形式，指一個人隨身攜帶或擁有的東西。常考搭配：personal belongings (個人物品)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Please remember to take all your personal <target>belongings</target> with you when leaving the train, as lost items may not be recovered.", "translation": "離開火車時請記得帶走所有個人物品，因為遺失物可能無法找回。", "explanation": "名詞「個人財產」。常用搭配 personal belongings (個人物品)。"}, {"sentence": "After checking out of the hotel, the traveler realized he had left some of his <target>belongings</target> in the room.", "translation": "在酒店退房後，旅客發現他將一些個人物品留在房內。", "explanation": "名詞「個人財產」。指個人擁有的物件。"}, {"sentence": "Passengers are reminded to keep their <target>belongings</target> secure at all times while walking through the crowded airport terminal.", "translation": "提醒乘客在經過擁擠的機場航廈時，隨時確保個人財產安全。", "explanation": "名詞「個人財產」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"beloved","explanation":"形容詞「深受喜愛的」；名詞「心愛的人」。常用於描述對某人或某物的深厚情感。注意其形式為過去分詞轉化而來。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students gathered to honor their <target>beloved</target> teacher, who had taught English in the school for over thirty years with great passion.","translation":"學生們聚集起來向他們深受喜愛的老師致敬，這位老師在學校教英文超過三十年且充滿熱情。","explanation":"形容詞「深受喜愛的」。"},{"sentence":"After many years of searching, the old man finally found his <target>beloved</target> dog, which had disappeared during a storm two years ago.","translation":"經過多年的尋找，這位老人終於找到了他心愛的狗，這隻狗在兩年前的一場風暴中失蹤了。","explanation":"名詞「心愛的人/物」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"beneficial","explanation":"形容詞「有益的，有利的」。常用於描述某事對健康、成長或學習有正面影響。常考搭配：be beneficial to (對...有益)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Regular exercise and a balanced diet are highly <target>beneficial</target> <pattern>to</pattern> overall health, helping people stay fit and reduce the risk of diseases.","translation":"規律的運動和均衡的飲食對整體健康非常有益，能幫助人們保持健康並降低疾病風險。","explanation":"形容詞「有益的」。常搭配介系詞 to。"},{"sentence":"Learning a second language is <target>beneficial</target> for students as it opens up more career opportunities and enhances their understanding of different cultures.","translation":"學習第二語言對學生是有益的，因為它能開啟更多職業機會並增進他們對不同文化的理解。","explanation":"形容詞「有益的」。"}],"related_forms":["benefit","beneficially"]}

{"headword":"betray","explanation":"動詞「背叛，洩露」。指對信任之人的不忠，或不小心揭露秘密。常考搭配：betray a secret (洩露秘密), betray one's trust (背叛信任)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The spy was arrested after he decided to <target>betray</target> his country by selling secret information to a foreign government for money.","translation":"這名間諜在決定為了錢而將國家機密賣給外國政府，背叛自己的國家後被逮捕了。","explanation":"動詞「背叛」。"},{"sentence":"She felt deeply hurt when she discovered that her best friend had <target>betrayed</target> her <pattern>trust</pattern> by sharing her private secrets with others.","translation":"當她發現最好的朋友分享她的私密秘密給他人，背叛了她的信任時，她感到深切地受傷。","explanation":"動詞「背叛」。常用搭配 betray one's trust (背叛某人的信任)。"},{"sentence":"Although he tried to look calm, the slight tremble in his voice <target>betrayed</target> his nervousness during the final presentation.","translation":"儘管他試圖表現得冷靜，但在最終簡報時，他聲音的輕微顫抖洩露了他的緊張感。","explanation":"動詞「洩露」。指不經意地展現出真實的情感或狀態。"}],"related_forms":["betrayal","betrayer"]}

{"headword": "beware", "explanation": "動詞「小心，注意」。通常用於警告，提醒他人注意潛在的危險。常用片語：beware of (小心...)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The sign at the entrance of the nature reserve warned visitors to <target>beware</target> <pattern>of</pattern> wild animals that might appear on the forest paths.", "translation": "自然保護區入口的告示牌警告遊客小心森林小徑上可能會出現的野生動物。", "explanation": "動詞「小心」。常用片語 beware of (小心...)。"}, {"sentence": "When visiting the city for the first time, tourists should <target>beware</target> <pattern>of</pattern> pickpockets who often target unsuspecting people in crowded areas.", "translation": "第一次訪問這座城市時，遊客應該小心在擁擠區域經常針對不知覺的人的扒手。", "explanation": "動詞「小心」。常用搭配 beware of (小心...)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"bias","explanation":"名詞「偏見」；動詞「使產生偏見」。指對某人或某事持有不公平的看法。常考搭配：gender bias (性別偏見), cognitive bias (認知偏見), have a bias against (對...有偏見)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The judge tried to remain neutral, as any personal <target>bias</target> could lead to an unfair decision in the court case.","translation":"法官試圖保持中立，因為任何個人偏見都可能導致法院案件的不公正決定。","explanation":"名詞「偏見」。"},{"sentence":"Many people believe that the news report was <target>biased</target> because it only presented one side of the argument without mentioning the opposing view.","translation":"許多人認為該新聞報導有偏見，因為它只呈現了論點的一方，而沒有提到相反的觀點。","explanation":"形容詞（過去分詞）「有偏見的」。"},{"sentence":"Parents should be careful not to <target>bias</target> their children against certain careers, allowing them to explore their interests freely.","translation":"父母應該小心不要讓孩子對某些職業產生偏見，讓他們能自由地探索自己的興趣。","explanation":"動詞「使產生偏見」。"}],"related_forms":["biased"]}

{"headword":"bid","explanation":"名詞「出價，競投」；動詞「出價，嘗試」。在拍賣或競標時使用。此外，bid for sth 可指「努力爭取某物」。","entries":[{"sentence":"At the art auction, the collector made a high <target>bid</target> for the rare painting, hoping to win it over other buyers.","translation":"在藝術拍賣會上，這位收藏家為這幅稀有畫作出高價，希望能在其他買家之上贏得它。","explanation":"名詞「出價」。"},{"sentence":"The company decided to <target>bid</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the government contract, offering a lower price to increase their chances of winning the project.","translation":"該公司決定競投政府合約，提供較低價格以增加贏得該計畫的機會。","explanation":"動詞「出價，競投」。常用搭配 bid for (競投...)。"},{"sentence":"The athlete made a final <target>bid</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the gold medal in the last hundred meters of the race, sprinting with all his strength.","translation":"這位運動員在比賽最後一百公尺努力爭取金牌，用盡全力衝刺。","explanation":"名詞「嘗試，努力爭取」。常用搭配 make a bid for (努力爭取...)。"}],"related_forms":["bidding"]}

{"headword":"biological","explanation":"形容詞「生物學的，生理的」。常用於描述生物構造或血緣關係。常考搭配：biological parents (親生父母), biological clock (生理時鐘)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student's <target>biological</target> <pattern>parents</pattern> had given him up for adoption when he was a baby, but he eventually found them as an adult.","translation":"這名學生的親生父母在他還是嬰兒時就將他送去領養，但他在成年後最終找到了他們。","explanation":"形容詞「親生的」。常用搭配 biological parents (親生父母)。"},{"sentence":"In the science class, the teacher explained how <target>biological</target> <pattern>processes</pattern> in the human body allow us to digest food and breathe.","translation":"在科學課上，老師解釋了人體內的生物過程如何讓我們消化食物和呼吸。","explanation":"形容詞「生物學的」。"},{"sentence":"Many people believe that their <target>biological</target> <pattern>clock</pattern> affects when they feel most energetic or tired during the day.","translation":"許多人認為他們的生理時鐘會影響他們在一天中什麼時候感到最有活力或疲倦。","explanation":"形容詞「生理的」。常用搭配 biological clock (生理時鐘)。"}],"related_forms":["biology","biologist"]}
