{"headword":"bizarre","explanation":"形容詞「古怪的，怪異的」。用來描述極不尋常或令人驚訝的事物。比 strange 更強烈。","entries":[{"sentence":"The witness described a <target>bizarre</target> series of events that led to the accident, which the police found difficult to believe.","translation":"證人描述了一連串導致事故的古怪事件，警察發現這很難令人相信。","explanation":"形容詞「古怪的」。"},{"sentence":"During the festival, some people wore <target>bizarre</target> costumes made of recycled materials, creating a very unique and colorful sight.","translation":"在節日期間，有些人穿著由回收材料製成的古怪服裝，創造出非常獨特且色彩繽紛的景象。","explanation":"形容詞「怪異的」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"blast","explanation":"名詞「爆炸，強風」；動詞「炸毀，大聲播放」。常考片語：a blast of (一陣...)，以及 blast away (炸毀/清除)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The workers used a powerful <target>blast</target> to clear the rocks from the mountain road, making it safer for cars to pass.","translation":"工人使用強力的爆炸來清除山路上的岩石，使車輛通過更加安全。","explanation":"名詞「爆炸」。"},{"sentence":"A sudden <target>blast</target> <pattern>of</pattern> cold air hit the students as they opened the door to the classroom, making them shiver.","translation":"一陣突然的冷空氣襲擊了學生，當他們打開教室門時，讓他們打了冷顫。","explanation":"名詞「一陣強風」。常用片語 a blast of (一陣...)。"},{"sentence":"The DJ started to <target>blast</target> loud music throughout the party, which annoyed the neighbors who were trying to sleep.","translation":"DJ開始在整個派對中大聲播放音樂，這讓試圖睡覺的鄰居感到厭煩。","explanation":"動詞「大聲播放」。"}],"related_forms":["blasts"]}

{"headword":"blur","explanation":"名詞「模糊的影像；模糊不清」；動詞「使模糊；模糊化」。常考用法：a blur of... (模糊的一片)。注意與 vague (模糊的/不清晰的) 的區別：blur 側重於視覺上的模糊或界限不清，如 a blur of colors (色彩模糊的一片)；而 vague 側重於記憶、表達或想法的不清晰，如 a vague memory (模糊的記憶) 或 a vague answer (含糊的回答)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Because she was crying, her vision became a <target>blur</target>, and she could hardly see the road ahead of her.","translation":"因為她在哭，她的視線變得模糊，幾乎看不清前面的路。","explanation":"名詞「模糊的影像」。指視覺上不清晰的狀態。"},{"sentence":"The car drove past so quickly that it was just a <target>blur</target> <pattern>of</pattern> red as it disappeared around the corner.","translation":"那輛車開得太快，在轉彎消失時只是一片模糊的紅色。","explanation":"名詞「模糊的一片」。片語 a blur of... 用於描述快速移動或光線導致的視覺模糊。"},{"sentence":"The long hours of studying and lack of sleep began to <target>blur</target> the <pattern>line between</pattern> his professional life and personal time.","translation":"長時間的學習和缺乏睡眠開始使他的職業生活與個人時間之間的界限變得模糊。","explanation":"動詞「使模糊」。指抽象的界限、區分或定義變得不明確。"},{"sentence":"The artist used a special technique to <target>blur</target> the edges of the shapes, creating a softer and more natural look.","translation":"藝術家使用一種特殊技巧來使形狀的邊緣模糊化，營造出更柔和、更自然的視覺效果。","explanation":"動詞「使模糊」。指物理上的視覺效果。"}],"related_forms":["blurred","blurring"]}

{"headword":"blush","explanation":"名詞「臉紅」；動詞「臉紅」。通常由尷尬、羞愧或興奮引起。常見搭配：blush with shame/embarrassment (因羞愧/尷尬而臉紅)。","entries":[{"sentence":"When the teacher praised her in front of the whole class, she felt a warm <target>blush</target> spread across her cheeks.","translation":"當老師在全班面前稱讚她時，她感覺臉頰上泛起了一陣紅暈。","explanation":"名詞「臉紅」。指臉部皮膚因血液流向臉頰而變紅的現象。"},{"sentence":"He couldn't help but <target>blush</target> <pattern>with</pattern> embarrassment when he realized he had been wearing his shirt inside out all day.","translation":"當他意識到自己整天把襯衫穿反了時，他禁不住臉紅。","explanation":"動詞「臉紅」。常用搭配 blush with + 情感 (如 embarrassment 或 shame)。"},{"sentence":"The shy girl <target>blushed</target> <pattern>deeply</pattern> after the boy she liked asked her to go to the school dance together.","translation":"那個害羞的女孩在心儀的男孩邀請她一起參加學校舞會後，臉紅得很厲害。","explanation":"動詞「臉紅」。副詞 deeply 常與 blush 搭配以強調程度。"}],"related_forms":["blushing"]}

{"headword":"bodyguard","explanation":"名詞「保鏢」。指受雇於保護重要人物（如名人、政治家）免受威脅或傷害的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The famous singer was accompanied by a professional <target>bodyguard</target> to ensure her safety while walking through the crowd of fans.","translation":"這位知名歌手由一名專業保鏢陪同，以確保她在穿過粉絲人群時的安全。","explanation":"名詞「保鏢」。"},{"sentence":"Because the president is a high-profile figure, he requires a team of highly trained <target>bodyguards</target> to protect him at all times.","translation":"因為總統是一位高知名度的人物，他需要一支由受過高度訓練的保鏢組成的團隊來時刻保護他。","explanation":"名詞「保鏢」。複數形式 bodyguards。"}],"related_forms":["bodyguards"]}

{"headword":"bolt","explanation":"名詞「螺栓；門栓；閃電」；動詞「突然衝出；鎖上」。注意搭配 bolt the door (鎖門) 和 a bolt of lightning (一道閃電)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The mechanic tightened every <target>bolt</target> on the engine to make sure the machine would operate safely and without vibration.","translation":"機械師擰緊了引擎上的每個螺栓，以確保機器能安全且無振動地運行。","explanation":"名詞「螺栓」。指金屬製的固定件。"},{"sentence":"He quickly <target>bolted</target> <pattern>the door</pattern> from the inside to prevent anyone from entering the room while he was studying.","translation":"他迅速從內部鎖上了門，以防止他在學習時有人進入房間。","explanation":"動詞「鎖上」。指使用門栓鎖門。"},{"sentence":"A sudden <target>bolt</target> <pattern>of</pattern> lightning struck the old oak tree in the backyard, splitting it in half instantly.","translation":"一道突然的閃電擊中了後院的那棵老橡樹，瞬間將其劈成兩半。","explanation":"名詞「閃電」。常用片語 a bolt of lightning。"},{"sentence":"As soon as the alarm went off, the frightened cat <target>bolted</target> <pattern>out of</pattern> the house and ran into the woods.","translation":"警報一響，受驚的貓就突然衝出房子，跑進了森林裡。","explanation":"動詞「突然衝出」。指快速且突然地離開。"}],"related_forms":["bolted","bolting"]}

{"headword":"bonus","explanation":"名詞「獎金；額外的好處」。除了金錢上的獎金，也可以指意外獲得的便利或好處。常用搭配：annual bonus (年終獎金), performance bonus (績效獎金)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company gave all its employees a generous year-end <target>bonus</target> because the business had achieved record-breaking profits this year.","translation":"由於公司今年取得了創紀錄的利潤，公司給所有員工發放了豐厚的年終獎金。","explanation":"名詞「獎金」。指額外支付的金錢。"},{"sentence":"Since the hotel room included a free breakfast, it was a welcome <target>bonus</target> for the travelers who wanted to save money.","translation":"由於飯店房間包含免費早餐，這對想要省錢的旅行者來說是一個令人高興的額外好處。","explanation":"名詞「額外的好處」。指意外或額外獲得的優點。"}],"related_forms":["bonuses"]}

{"headword":"boom","explanation":"名詞「繁榮；激增；轟鳴聲」；動詞「繁榮；激增」。常考用法：economic boom (經濟繁榮), baby boom (嬰兒潮)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city experienced a significant economic <target>boom</target> after the government decided to build a new high-tech industrial park nearby.","translation":"在政府決定在附近建立一個新的高科技工業園區後，這座城市經歷了顯著的經濟繁榮。","explanation":"名詞「繁榮」。指經濟或產業的快速增長。"},{"sentence":"The <target>boom</target> <pattern>in</pattern> online shopping has forced many traditional brick-and-mortar stores to change their business models to survive.","translation":"網購的激增迫使許多傳統的實體店改變其經營模式以求生存。","explanation":"名詞「激增」。指某種趨勢或現象的快速增加。"},{"sentence":"A loud <target>boom</target> echoed through the valley after the explosives were detonated, shaking the windows of the nearby houses.","translation":"爆炸物被引爆後，一聲巨大的轟鳴聲在山谷中迴盪，震動了附近房屋的窗戶。","explanation":"名詞「轟鳴聲」。指低沉且巨大的聲音。"},{"sentence":"The tech industry began to <target>boom</target> in the late 1990s, creating thousands of new jobs for software engineers and designers.","translation":"科技產業在 1990 年代後期開始繁榮，為軟體工程師和設計師創造了數千個新工作崗位。","explanation":"動詞「繁榮」。指產業或經濟的快速增長。"}],"related_forms":["booming","boomed"]}

{"headword":"boost","explanation":"動詞「提升；增加；促進」；名詞「提升；助力」。常用搭配：boost confidence (提升信心), boost productivity (提高生產力), give a boost to (給予助力)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The positive feedback from her teacher gave her a huge <target>boost</target> <pattern>in</pattern> confidence, encouraging her to participate more in class.","translation":"老師的正面回饋大大提升了她的信心，鼓勵她在課堂上更積極地參與。","explanation":"名詞「提升」。指信心或能量的增加。"},{"sentence":"The government implemented a new policy to <target>boost</target> <pattern>local tourism</pattern> by offering discounts on entrance fees to museums.","translation":"政府實施了一項新政策，通過提供博物館入場費折扣來促進當地旅遊業。","explanation":"動詞「促進」。指增加或提高某種數值或活動。"},{"sentence":"Taking a short nap during the afternoon can often <target>boost</target> <pattern>your energy levels</pattern> and help you focus better on your studies.","translation":"下午小睡片刻通常能提升你的能量水平，幫助你更好地專注於學習。","explanation":"動詞「提升」。指提高體力或精神狀態。"},{"sentence":"The new marketing campaign was designed to <target>boost</target> <pattern>sales</pattern> of the new smartphone before the holiday season began.","translation":"新的行銷活動旨在在假期季節開始前提高新款智慧型手機的銷量。","explanation":"動詞「增加」。指提高銷售額或數量。"}],"related_forms":["booster","boosted","boosting"]}

{"headword":"booth","explanation":"名詞「攤位；小亭子；隔間」。常用於描述展覽會的攤位、電話亭或投票隔間。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student council set up an information <target>booth</target> in the school courtyard to provide details about the upcoming cultural festival.","translation":"學生會在學校中庭設置了一個資訊攤位，以提供關於即將到來的文化節的詳細資訊。","explanation":"名詞「攤位」。指展覽或活動中的小型臨時設施。"},{"sentence":"Before the election, each voter entered a private <target>booth</target> to mark their choice in secret, ensuring a fair voting process.","translation":"在選舉之前，每位選民進入一個私人隔間在秘密地標記他們的選擇，以確保投票過程公平。 ","explanation":"名詞「隔間」。指為了私密性而設置的小空間。"},{"sentence":"In the old days, people had to find a public telephone <target>booth</target> on the street to make a call when they were away from home.","translation":"在以前，人們在離開家時必須在街上找公共電話亭來撥打電話。","explanation":"名詞「小亭子」。指公共電話亭。"}],"related_forms":["booths"]}

{"headword":"boredom","explanation":"名詞「無聊；倦怠」。由形容詞 bored (感到無聊的) 衍生而來。常用搭配：out of boredom (出於無聊)。","entries":[{"sentence":"To escape the <target>boredom</target> of their long commute, many students listen to podcasts or read books on the bus every day.","translation":"為了擺脫漫長通勤的無聊，許多學生每天在公車上聽播客或閱讀書籍。","explanation":"名詞「無聊」。指感到沒有趣或缺乏刺激的狀態。"},{"sentence":"He began to draw random shapes in his notebook <pattern>out of</pattern> <target>boredom</target> while the teacher was explaining a very simple concept.","translation":"當老師在解釋一個非常簡單的概念時，他出於無聊而在筆記本上畫了一些隨機的形狀。","explanation":"名詞「無聊」。片語 out of boredom 意為「出於無聊」。"}],"related_forms":["bore","boring","bored"]}

{"headword":"bound","explanation":"形容詞「注定的；必須的；受限的」；動詞「跳躍；跳躍前進」；名詞「邊界」。注意搭配 be bound to V (注定會...) 和 off-limits/out-of-bounds (禁止進入的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you continue to study this hard every day, you are <target>bound</target> <pattern>to</pattern> succeed in the upcoming entrance examination.","translation":"如果你每天繼續如此努力地學習，你注定會在即將到來的入學考試中取得成功。","explanation":"形容詞「注定的」。片語 be bound to V 表示「注定會...」。"},{"sentence":"The deer <target>bounded</target> across the meadow with great energy, disappearing quickly into the thick forest near the river.","translation":"鹿在草地上充滿活力地跳躍前進，迅速消失在河邊茂密的森林中。","explanation":"動詞「跳躍前進」。指以大跨步跳躍移動。"},{"sentence":"Students are reminded that the construction site behind the school is <pattern>out of</pattern> <target>bounds</target> for safety reasons.","translation":"學生被提醒，出於安全考慮，學校後方的施工現場是禁止進入的。","explanation":"名詞「邊界」。片語 out of bounds 表示「禁止進入的」。"},{"sentence":"The legal agreement <target>bounds</target> the two companies to share their research findings for the next five years.","translation":"這份法律協議將這兩家公司限制在接下來五年內必須共享其研究結果。","explanation":"動詞「限制」。指由法律或協議所規定。"}],"related_forms":["boundary","bounding","bounds"]}

{"headword":"boundary","explanation":"名詞「邊界，界限」。可指地理上的國境或分界線，也可指抽象的心理、社交或權限界限。常用搭配：cross the boundary (越界), push the boundaries (挑戰極限/突破界限)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The farmers used a long fence to mark the <target>boundary</target> <pattern>between</pattern> their land and the neighbor's property to avoid any future disputes.","translation":"農民們用一道長圍欄來標記他們的土地與鄰居財產之間的邊界，以避免未來的爭議。","explanation":"名詞「邊界」。指物理上的分界線。"},{"sentence":"In a healthy friendship, it is important to establish clear <target>boundaries</target> to ensure that both people feel respected and comfortable.","translation":"在健康的友誼中，建立明確的界限很重要，以確保雙方都感到被尊重且舒適。","explanation":"名詞「界限」。指抽象的社交或心理限制。"},{"sentence":"The young scientist hoped to <pattern>push</pattern> the <target>boundaries</target> <pattern>of</pattern> modern medicine by discovering a new way to treat the rare disease.","translation":"這位年輕的科學家希望透過發現一種治療罕見病的新方法，來突破現代醫學的界限。","explanation":"名詞「界限」。片語 push the boundaries 表示挑戰現有的極限或突破傳統。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"boxer","explanation":"名詞「拳擊手」或「拳擊犬」。在 GSAT 中通常指運動員。注意其與 box (盒子/裝箱) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The professional <target>boxer</target> trained for months in the gym, focusing on his speed and strength before the championship match.","translation":"這位職業拳擊手在健身房訓練了數月，在冠軍賽前專注於他的速度和力量。","explanation":"名詞「拳擊手」。"},{"sentence":"The crowd cheered loudly when the <target>boxer</target> landed a powerful punch, knocking his opponent down to the canvas.","translation":"當拳擊手擊出一記強力重拳將對手擊倒在拳擊台墊上時，人群大聲歡呼。","explanation":"名詞「拳擊手」。"}],"related_forms":["boxing"]}

{"headword":"breakthrough","explanation":"名詞「突破，重大進展」。常用於科學研究、醫療或技術領域。常用搭配：make a breakthrough (取得突破)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After years of failure, the research team finally <pattern>made</pattern> a major <target>breakthrough</target> in the development of the new vaccine.","translation":"經過多年的失敗，研究團隊終於在研發新疫苗方面取得了重大突破。","explanation":"名詞「突破」。片語 make a breakthrough 表示取得重大進展。"},{"sentence":"The discovery of electricity was a significant <target>breakthrough</target> that changed how people lived and worked around the world.","translation":"電的發現是一次重大突破，改變了全世界人們生活和工作的方式。","explanation":"名詞「突破」。"},{"sentence":"Diplomats from both countries are hoping for a <target>breakthrough</target> in the peace talks to end the long conflict.","translation":"兩國的外交官希望在和平談判中取得突破，以結束長期的衝突。","explanation":"名詞「突破」。指在僵局中取得進展。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"briefcase","explanation":"名詞「公事包」。通常指商務人士攜帶文件或筆電的硬殼手提包。","entries":[{"sentence":"The lawyer carried a leather <target>briefcase</target> filled with important legal documents as he walked into the courtroom for the trial.","translation":"律師走進法庭準備審理時，攜帶著一個裝滿重要法律文件的皮革公事包。","explanation":"名詞「公事包」。"},{"sentence":"He realized he had forgotten his <target>briefcase</target> at home, which contained the presentation slides he needed for the morning meeting.","translation":"他意識到他把公事包忘在家裡了，裡面有他早晨會議需要的簡報投影片。","explanation":"名詞「公事包」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"bronze","explanation":"名詞「青銅」；形容詞「青銅色的」。在體育賽事中，bronze medal 指「銅牌」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The athlete was proud to win a <target>bronze</target> <pattern>medal</pattern> in the 100-meter sprint at the International Olympic Games.","translation":"這位運動員很自豪能在國際奧運會的100公尺短跑中贏得一枚銅牌。","explanation":"形容詞用法，修飾 medal。bronze medal 即「銅牌」。"},{"sentence":"Many ancient civilizations used <target>bronze</target> to make tools and weapons because it was stronger than pure copper.","translation":"許多古代文明使用青銅來製造工具和武器，因為它比純銅更堅硬。","explanation":"名詞「青銅」。"},{"sentence":"The museum displayed a large <target>bronze</target> statue of a famous leader from the Roman Empire, which had survived for centuries.","translation":"博物館展出了一尊來自羅馬帝國著名領袖的巨大青銅像，它已保存了數個世紀。","explanation":"形容詞「青銅色的/青銅製的」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"browse","explanation":"動詞「瀏覽（網頁、書籍）」；名詞「瀏覽」。在現代英語中，最常用於 describe surfing the internet (瀏覽網路) 或 looking through a shop (隨意逛店)。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the break, many students like to <target>browse</target> <pattern>through</pattern> social media on their phones to see what their friends are doing.","translation":"在休息時間，許多學生喜歡用手機瀏覽社群媒體，看看他們的朋友在做什麼。","explanation":"動詞「瀏覽」。常用片語 browse through (瀏覽...)。"},{"sentence":"I spent an hour <target>browsing</target> the bookshelves in the local library, looking for a novel that would interest me.","translation":"我在當地圖書館的書架前瀏覽了一個小時，尋找一本能引起我興趣的小說。","explanation":"動詞「瀏覽、翻閱」。"},{"sentence":"The customer told the shop assistant that she was just <target>browsing</target> and did not need any help finding a specific item.","translation":"顧客告訴店員她只是在隨便逛逛，不需要幫忙尋找特定商品。","explanation":"動詞「隨意逛逛」。"},{"sentence":"A quick <target>browse</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the news headlines revealed that the weather would be stormy throughout the coming weekend.","translation":"快速瀏覽新聞標題後發現，接下來的整個週末天氣將會陰雨綿綿。","explanation":"名詞「瀏覽」。"}],"related_forms":["browser"]}

{"headword":"bruise","explanation":"名詞「瘀青」；動詞「使瘀青」。常與 skin 或 body parts 搭配。注意與 wound (傷口) 的區別：bruise 通常指皮下出血而沒有破皮。","entries":[{"sentence":"After falling off his bicycle, the boy had a large purple <target>bruise</target> on his knee, although the skin was not broken.","translation":"從自行車上摔下來後，男孩的膝蓋上有一塊巨大的紫色瘀青，雖然皮膚沒有破裂。","explanation":"名詞「瘀青」。"},{"sentence":"The fruit was <target>bruised</target> during transport, making it look less appealing to customers in the supermarket.","translation":"水果在運輸過程中被撞傷了（產生瘀傷），使得超級市場的顧客覺得它不那麼吸引人。","explanation":"動詞（被動態）「使瘀青/撞傷」。可用於描述水果受損。"},{"sentence":"She didn't feel much pain, but the impact of the door <target>bruised</target> her arm, leaving a dark mark for a week.","translation":"她沒感到太多疼痛，但門的撞擊使她的手臂瘀青，留下了一個深色印記長達一週。","explanation":"動詞「使瘀青」。"}],"related_forms":["bruised"]}

{"headword":"bulk","explanation":"名詞「大部分，主體」或「體積，大量」。常用片語 the bulk of (大部分的...)，in bulk (大量地)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>bulk</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the students spent their summer vacation studying for the entrance exams instead of traveling.","translation":"大多數學生利用暑假準備入學考試，而不是去旅行。","explanation":"名詞「大部分」。片語 the bulk of... 表示絕大多數。"},{"sentence":"To save money and reduce packaging waste, many families prefer to buy their basic groceries <pattern>in</pattern> <target>bulk</target> from wholesale stores.","translation":"為了省錢並減少包裝浪費，許多家庭更喜歡從批發店大量購買基本雜貨。","explanation":"名詞「大量」。片語 in bulk 表示大量地。"},{"sentence":"Because of the <target>bulk</target> of the package, it was too large to fit through the narrow doorway of the apartment.","translation":"由於包裹的體積太大，它無法通過公寓狹窄的門口。","explanation":"名詞「體積」。"}],"related_forms":["bulky"]}

{"headword":"bully","explanation":"名詞「欺凌者，霸凌者」；動詞「欺凌，威脅」。在 GSAT 中常出現於關於 school violence (校園暴力) 的文章。常用搭配：bully someone into doing something (脅迫某人做某事)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school implemented a strict anti-bullying policy to protect students from being targeted by a <target>bully</target> in the playground.","translation":"學校實施了嚴格的反霸凌政策，以保護學生免受操場上霸凌者的針對。","explanation":"名詞「霸凌者」。"},{"sentence":"It is never acceptable to <target>bully</target> classmates, as this behavior can cause long-term psychological damage to the victims.","translation":"欺凌同學絕對是不被允許的，因為這種行為會對受害者造成長期的心理傷害。","explanation":"動詞「欺凌」。"},{"sentence":"The older students tried to <target>bully</target> the freshmen <pattern>into</pattern> doing their homework, but the teacher stopped them immediately.","translation":"高年級學生試圖脅迫新生幫他們做作業，但老師立即制止了他們。","explanation":"動詞「脅迫」。片語 bully someone into doing something。"}],"related_forms":["bullying"]}

{"headword":"bureau","explanation":"名詞「局，署」或「辦公桌」。常用於政府機構，如 Federal Bureau of Investigation (聯邦調查局)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The Federal <target>Bureau</target> of Investigation is responsible for investigating federal crimes and protecting the national security of the United States.","translation":"聯邦調查局負責調查聯邦犯罪並保護美國的國家安全。","explanation":"名詞「局/署」。指政府行政機關。"},{"sentence":"She works for the travel <target>bureau</target>, helping tourists plan their itineraries and book hotel rooms for their trips abroad.","translation":"她在旅遊局工作，幫助遊客規劃行程並預訂出國旅行的酒店房間。","explanation":"名詞「局/署」。"},{"sentence":"He kept all his important documents and stationery organized in the top drawer of his old wooden <target>bureau</target>.","translation":"他把所有重要文件和文具整齊地放在他舊木製辦公桌的頂層抽屜裡。","explanation":"名詞「辦公桌/抽屜櫃」。"}],"related_forms":["bureaucracy","bureaucrat"]}

{"headword":"bureaucracy","explanation":"名詞「官僚制度；官僚體系」。指由許多行政職員組成的管理系統，常用於描述程序繁瑣、效率低下的行政過程。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many young entrepreneurs complain that the excessive <target>bureaucracy</target> in the city government makes it difficult to start a new business quickly.","translation":"許多年輕創業家抱怨市政府過多的官僚制度使得快速創業變得困難。","explanation":"名詞「官僚制度」。指繁瑣的行政程序。"},{"sentence":"To improve efficiency, the school administration is trying to <pattern>reduce</pattern> <target>bureaucracy</target> by simplifying the application process for student clubs.","translation":"為了提高效率，學校行政部門正試圖透過簡化學生社團的申請流程來減少官僚體系。","explanation":"名詞「官僚體系」。常用動詞搭配：reduce bureaucracy (減少官僚體系)。"}],"related_forms":["bureaucratic","bureaucrat"]}

{"headword":"burial","explanation":"名詞「埋葬；葬禮」。指將死者埋入地下的行為或儀式。","entries":[{"sentence":"Archaeologists discovered an ancient <target>burial</target> <pattern>site</pattern> in the valley, providing valuable clues about the customs of the people who lived there.","translation":"考古學家在山谷中發現了一個古代埋葬地點，提供了關於居住在那裡的人們習俗的寶貴線索。","explanation":"名詞「埋葬」。常用搭配：burial site (埋葬地點)。"},{"sentence":"The family gathered for the <target>burial</target> ceremony to say their final goodbyes and honor the memory of their beloved grandfather.","translation":"家人們聚集在葬禮儀式上，向他們心愛的祖父做最後的告別並紀念他的回憶。","explanation":"名詞「葬禮」。指埋葬死者的儀式。"}],"related_forms":["bury"]}

{"headword":"butcher","explanation":"名詞「屠夫；肉販」；動詞「屠宰；殘忍殺害」。作為動詞時，常用於描述極其殘忍的或極不專業地處理某事（如發音）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The local <target>butcher</target> is known for providing the highest quality meat and giving helpful advice on how to cook different cuts.","translation":"當地的肉販以提供最高品質的肉類以及提供關於如何烹調不同部位肉類的有益建議而聞名。","explanation":"名詞「肉販」。指在肉店工作的人。"},{"sentence":"The farmer had to hire a professional <target>butcher</target> to process the livestock after the harvest season ended.","translation":"農民在收穫季節結束後，必須聘請專業的屠夫來處理牲畜。","explanation":"名詞「屠夫」。指從事屠宰工作的人。"},{"sentence":"During the debate, the candidate <target>butchered</target> the pronunciation of the opponent's name, which caused a lot of laughter in the crowd.","translation":"在辯論過程中，該候選人把對手的名字發音發得慘不忍睹，引起了人群中許多笑聲。","explanation":"動詞「殘忍殺害/糟蹋」。在此處指極其糟糕地發音或處理。"}],"related_forms":["butchery"]}

{"headword":"calcium","explanation":"名詞「鈣」。一種化學元素，對骨骼和牙齒的健康至關重要。常出現在生物或健康類文章中。","entries":[{"sentence":"Drinking milk and eating yogurt are great ways to <pattern>increase</pattern> your <target>calcium</target> intake to keep your bones strong and healthy.","translation":"喝牛奶和吃優格是增加鈣質攝取以保持骨骼強健健康的好方法。","explanation":"名詞「鈣」。常用搭配：calcium intake (鈣質攝取)。"},{"sentence":"The doctor recommended that the elderly patient take <target>calcium</target> supplements to prevent osteoporosis and reduce the risk of fractures.","translation":"醫生建議這位年長的患者服用鈣片補充劑，以預防骨質疏鬆症並降低骨折風險。","explanation":"名詞「鈣」。常用搭配：calcium supplements (鈣補充劑)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"canal","explanation":"名詞「運河；水渠」。指人工挖掘的通道，用於運輸或灌溉。","entries":[{"sentence":"The Panama <target>canal</target> is one of the most important engineering feats in history, allowing ships to travel between two oceans more quickly.","translation":"巴拿馬運河是歷史上最重要的工程成就之一，讓船隻能在兩個海洋之間更快速地穿行。","explanation":"名詞「運河」。指人工挖掘的大型水路。"},{"sentence":"In the rural village, farmers built a small <target>canal</target> to carry water from the river to their dry fields during the summer.","translation":"在鄉村村莊裡，農民們建造了一條小水渠，在夏天將河水引向他們乾燥的田地。","explanation":"名詞「水渠」。指用於灌溉的較小人工水路。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "canvas", "explanation": "名詞「帆布；畫布」。指一種強韌的粗布材質，常用於油畫或製作帳篷和帆布鞋。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The artist carefully stretched the <target>canvas</target> over the wooden frame before applying the first layer of oil paint to the surface.", "translation": "藝術家在將第一層油畫顏料塗在表面之前，小心地將畫布撐在木框上。", "explanation": "名名詞「畫布」。指用於油畫的粗布。"}, {"sentence": "Because it was raining, we decided to cover the equipment with a heavy <target>canvas</target> sheet to keep everything dry and protected.", "translation": "因為在下雨，我們決定用一張厚帆布單覆蓋設備，以保持所有東西乾燥且受保護。", "explanation": "名詞「帆布」。指一種強韌的粗布材質。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"capability","explanation":"名詞「能力；功能」。指一個人或系統能夠完成某項任務的潛在能力或技術能力。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new software has the <target>capability</target> to process huge amounts of data in seconds, which significantly increases the team's productivity.","translation":"這款新軟體具有在幾秒鐘內處理海量數據的能力，這顯著提高了團隊的生產力。","explanation":"名詞「功能/能力」。指系統或技術上的能力。"},{"sentence":"Through hard work and practice, the student demonstrated a remarkable <target>capability</target> for learning new languages quickly and accurately.","translation":"透過努力工作和練習，這名學生展現了快速且準確地學習新語言的卓越能力。","explanation":"名詞「能力」。指個人潛在的心智或技術能力。"},{"sentence":"The manager believes that the employee's current <target>capabilities</target> are well-suited for the leadership role in the upcoming project.","translation":"經理認為該員工目前的能能力非常適合即將到來的專案中的領導角色。","explanation":"名詞「能力」。常用複數形式描述多方面的能力。"}],"related_forms":["capable"]}

{"headword":"carbon","explanation":"名詞「碳」。一種化學元素，是所有有機生命的基礎。常出現在環境、氣候變遷類文章中。","entries":[{"sentence":"To fight climate change, many countries are trying to <pattern>reduce</pattern> their <target>carbon</target> <pattern>footprint</pattern> by using renewable energy sources like wind and solar power.","translation":"為了對抗氣候變遷，許多國家正試圖透過使用風能和太陽能等可再生能源來減少其碳足跡。","explanation":"名詞「碳」。常用搭配：carbon footprint (碳足跡)。"},{"sentence":"Scientists found that the <target>carbon</target> levels in the atmosphere have increased significantly over the last century due to industrial activities.","translation":"科學家發現，由於工業活動，大氣中的碳水平在過去一個世紀中顯著增加。","explanation":"名詞「碳」。指化學元素碳。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"carnival","explanation":"名詞「嘉年華；狂歡節」。指一種充滿音樂、舞蹈和色彩的盛大公開慶祝活動。","entries":[{"sentence":"Every year, the city hosts a grand <target>carnival</target> with colorful parades and loud music, attracting thousands of tourists from around the world.","translation":"每年，這座城市都會舉辦一場盛大的嘉年華，有色彩繽紛的遊行和響亮的音樂，吸引了來自世界各地的數千名遊客。","explanation":"名詞「嘉年華」。指大型公開慶祝活動。"},{"sentence":"The children were excited to play games and eat cotton candy at the school <target>carnival</target> held on the last day of the semester.","translation":"孩子們很興奮能在學期最後一天舉辦的學校嘉年華中玩遊戲、吃棉花糖。","explanation":"名詞「嘉年華」。指校園內的小型慶祝活動。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"casino","explanation":"名詞「賭場」。指一個提供賭博遊戲的場所。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city's economy grew rapidly after the government allowed the construction of a large <target>casino</target> and several luxury hotels.","translation":"在政府允許建造一座大型賭場和幾個豪華飯店後，這座城市的經濟迅速增長。","explanation":"名詞「賭場」。"},{"sentence":"Entering a <target>casino</target> usually requires a valid ID to prove that the visitor is of legal gambling age.","translation":"進入賭場通常需要有效的身分證件，以證明訪客已達到法定賭博年齡。","explanation":"名詞「賭場」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"cathedral","explanation":"名詞「大教堂」。通常指規模宏大、具有重要宗教地位的教堂，尤其是主教座堂。與一般的 church 不同，cathedral 具有更高的行政地位。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city's ancient <target>cathedral</target> is famous for its stunning gothic architecture and colorful stained-glass windows that attract thousands of tourists.","translation":"這座城市的古老大教堂以其令人驚嘆的哥德式建築和色彩繽紛的彩色玻璃窗而聞名，吸引了數以千計的遊客。","explanation":"名詞「大教堂」。強調其規模和建築風格。"},{"sentence":"During the festival, the <target>cathedral</target> hosted a grand choral performance, filling the massive space with beautiful, echoing music.","translation":"在節日期間，大教堂舉辦了一場宏大的合唱表演，使巨大的空間充滿了美麗且迴盪的音樂。","explanation":"名詞「大教堂」。描述其在宗教和文化活動中的用途。"}],"related_forms":["cathedrals"]}

{"headword":"caution","explanation":"名詞「小心，謹慎」；動詞「警告」。名詞時常用片語 exercise caution (保持謹慎) 或 use caution (小心)。動詞時常用搭配 caution someone against sth (警告某人不要做某事)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government advised all citizens to <pattern>exercise</pattern> <target>caution</target> when traveling to regions that are currently experiencing severe weather conditions.","translation":"政府建議所有公民在前往目前正經歷嚴重天氣狀況的地區時要保持謹慎。","explanation":"名詞「小心，謹慎」。常用片語 exercise caution 表示「保持謹慎」。"},{"sentence":"The teacher <target>cautioned</target> the students <pattern>against</pattern> leaving their personal belongings unattended in the crowded school cafeteria.","translation":"老師警告學生不要將個人物品在擁擠的學校食堂中無人看管。","explanation":"動詞「警告」。常用搭配 caution someone against V-ing 表「警告某人不要...」。"},{"sentence":"Parents should <pattern>use</pattern> <target>caution</target> when allowing their young children to access the internet without supervision.","translation":"父母在允許幼兒在沒有監督的情況下使用網路時應保持小心。","explanation":"名詞「小心」。常用片語 use caution 表示「小心」。"}],"related_forms":["cautious","cautiously"]}

{"headword":"cautious","explanation":"形容詞「謹慎的」。指在行動前仔細考慮可能的風險，以避免危險或錯誤。常用搭配 cautious about sth (對...感到謹慎)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The investor was very <target>cautious</target> <pattern>about</pattern> putting all his money into a single stock, fearing a sudden market crash.","translation":"這位投資者在將所有錢投入一支股票時非常謹慎，擔心市場突然崩盤。","explanation":"形容詞「謹慎的」。常用搭配 cautious about sth。"},{"sentence":"Because the road was slippery after the rain, the driver became more <target>cautious</target>, slowing down to avoid any potential accidents.","translation":"因為雨後道路濕滑，駕駛員變得更加謹慎，減速以避免任何潛在的事故。","explanation":"形容詞「謹慎的」。描述行動上的小心翼翼。"}],"related_forms":["caution","cautiously"]}

{"headword": "celebrity", "explanation": "名詞「名人」。指在公眾面前享有盛名的人。常用片語 A-list celebrity (頂級名人)。注意與 fame (名聲) 的區別：celebrity 指的是人，而 fame 是指狀態。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The young singer became an overnight <target>celebrity</target> after her song went viral on social media, attracting millions of fans.", "translation": "這位年輕歌手在她的歌曲在社交媒體上瘋傳後一夜之間成為名人，吸引了數百萬名粉絲。", "explanation": "名詞「名人」。指享有名聲的人。"}, {"sentence": "Being a <target>celebrity</target> often comes with a lack of privacy, as paparazzi constantly follow them to capture every moment of their lives.", "translation": "成為名人通常伴隨著缺乏隱私，因為狗仔隊不斷跟隨他們，捕捉他們生活的每一個瞬間。", "explanation": "名詞「名人」。描述名人的生活狀態。"}], "related_forms": ["celebrate"]}

{"headword":"cemetery","explanation":"名詞「墓地」。指專門用於埋葬死者的場所。注意與 graveyard (墓地) 的區別：cemetery 通常指較大規模的公共墓地，而 graveyard 通常指教堂旁的墓地。","entries":[{"sentence":"The old <target>cemetery</target> on the edge of town is filled with ancient tombstones and tall trees, creating a quiet and peaceful atmosphere.","translation":"城邊的舊墓地充滿了古老的墓碑和高大的樹木，營造出一種安靜和平靜的氛圍。","explanation":"名詞「墓地」。描述其環境。"},{"sentence":"Family members gathered at the <target>cemetery</target> to pay their respects to their ancestors during the traditional holiday.","translation":"家人們在傳統節日期間聚集在墓地，向他們的祖先表達敬意。","explanation":"名詞「墓地」。描述其用途。"}],"related_forms":["cemeteries"]}

{"headword": "ceremony", "explanation": "名詞「典禮」。指為了紀念或慶祝某事而舉行的正式活動。常用片語 graduation ceremony (畢業典禮), wedding ceremony (婚禮), opening ceremony (開幕式)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The students were filled with excitement and nervousness as they waited for their names to be called during the graduation <target>ceremony</target>.", "translation": "學生們在畢業典禮上等待被叫到名字時，心中充滿了興奮與緊張。", "explanation": "名詞「典禮」。常用搭配 graduation ceremony。"}, {"sentence": "The Olympic <pattern>opening</pattern> <target>ceremony</target> was a grand spectacle, combining traditional culture with modern technology to impress the world.", "translation": "奧運會的開幕典禮是一場盛大的奇觀，將傳統文化與現代科技結合，令世界印象深刻。", "explanation": "名詞「典禮」。常用搭配 opening ceremony。"}, {"sentence": "The wedding <target>ceremony</target> was held in a small garden, with the couple exchanging vows in front of their closest friends and family.", "translation": "婚禮典禮在一個小花園中舉行，新婚夫婦在他們最親近的朋友和家人面前交換誓言。", "explanation": "名詞「典禮」。常用搭配 wedding ceremony。"}], "related_forms": ["ceremonial", "ceremonious"]}

{"headword":"certainty","explanation":"名詞「確定性；必然性」。指某事肯定會發生或毫無疑問的事實。常用片語 with certainty (確定地)。注意與 uncertainty (不確定性) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"In a world full of surprises, there is no absolute <target>certainty</target> that a hard-working student will always get the highest grade.","translation":"在一個充滿驚喜的世界裡，並沒有絕對的確定性，證明勤奮的學生總是能拿到最高分。","explanation":"名詞「確定性」。指某事肯定會發生。"},{"sentence":"The witness spoke with absolute <target>certainty</target>, claiming that he had seen the suspect leave the building exactly at midnight.","translation":"證人以絕對肯定的口吻說話，聲稱他在午夜時分正好看到嫌疑犯離開建築物。","explanation":"名詞「確定性」。常用片語 with certainty。"}],"related_forms":["certain","certainly"]}

{"headword":"certificate","explanation":"名詞「證書」。指證明某事（如學位、資格、死亡、出生）的正式文件。動詞用法較少見，指「發給證書」。","entries":[{"sentence":"After completing the advanced English course, each student received a <target>certificate</target> <pattern>of</pattern> completion to prove their language proficiency.","translation":"在完成進階英語課程後，每個學生都收到了一張結業證書，以證明他們的語言能力。","explanation":"名詞「證書」。常用搭配 certificate of completion。"},{"sentence":"The company requires all new employees to provide a birth <target>certificate</target> and a copy of their diploma for the hiring process.","translation":"公司要求所有新員工在招聘過程中提供出生證明和畢業證書副本。","explanation":"名詞「證書」。常用搭配 birth certificate (出生證明)。"},{"sentence":"To participate in the international competition, the athlete had to be <target>certified</target> by a professional medical organization.","translation":"為了參加國際比賽，運動員必須由專業醫療機構認證。","explanation":"動詞用法（被動態）。certified 為 certificate 的分詞形式，表示「認證」。"}],"related_forms":["certify","certification"]}

{"headword":"chaos","explanation":"名詞「混亂」。指完全缺乏秩序或組織的狀態。常用搭配 in chaos (處於混亂中)。注意與 confused (感到困惑的) 區別：chaos 是名詞，描述整個局面。","entries":[{"sentence":"The sudden power outage caused absolute <target>chaos</target> in the airport, with passengers shouting and running in all directions.","translation":"突然的停電在機場造成了絕對的混亂，乘客們大聲喊叫並向四面八方奔跑。","explanation":"名詞「混亂」。描述一種完全缺乏秩序的局面。"},{"sentence":"When the teacher left the classroom for a few minutes, the students fell into <target>chaos</target>, talking loudly and throwing paper airplanes.","translation":"當老師離開教室幾分鐘後，學生們陷入了混亂，大聲聊天並扔紙飛機。","explanation":"名詞「混亂」。常用片語 fall into chaos。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"chapel","explanation":"名詞「小教堂」。通常指較小規模的教堂，或是位於大教堂、醫院、機場或學校等機構內的小型祈禱室。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university has a small <target>chapel</target> where students can go to find peace and reflect on their lives during stressful exam weeks.","translation":"大學裡有一座小教堂，學生在壓力巨大的考試週可以去那裡尋找平靜並反思生活。","explanation":"名詞「小教堂」。強調其規模較小且位於校園內。"},{"sentence":"The wedding was held in a cozy <target>chapel</target> by the lake, providing a romantic and intimate setting for the couple.","translation":"婚禮在湖邊一座舒適的小教堂舉行，為新婚夫婦提供了浪漫且親密的氛圍。","explanation":"名詞「小教堂」。描述其作為小型宗教場所的用途。"}],"related_forms":["chapels"]}

{"headword":"characterize","explanation":"動詞「描述；定義；以...為特徵」。常用於學術寫作中描述某物的主要特徵。注意其被動語態用法，例如 be characterized by (以...為特徵)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The author tends to <target>characterize</target> the main protagonist as a brave and determined person who never gives up on his dreams.","translation":"作者傾向於將主角描述為一個勇敢且堅定的人，永遠不會放棄他的夢想。","explanation":"動詞「描述；定義」。指給予某人或某物特定的特徵描述。"},{"sentence":"Modern architecture in this city is often <target>characterized</target> <pattern>by</pattern> its sleek lines and the extensive use of glass and steel.","translation":"這座城市的現代建築通常以其流暢的線條以及玻璃和鋼材的大量使用為特徵。","explanation":"被動語態 be characterized by 表「以...為特徵」。這是 GSAT 常考的學術用法。"},{"sentence":"Scientists <target>characterize</target> the new virus by analyzing its genetic structure to understand how it spreads among the population.","translation":"科學家透過分析新病毒的基因結構來定義其特徵，以了解它是如何在人群中傳播的。","explanation":"動詞「定義特徵」。在科學語境中指明確地指出某物的屬性。"}],"related_forms":["characterization","characteristic"]}

{"headword":"chef","explanation":"名詞「主廚；廚師」。注意與 cook 的區別：chef 通常指在專業餐廳工作且經過訓練的專業廚師，而 cook 則是泛指任何會煮飯的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The head <target>chef</target> carefully selected the freshest ingredients from the local market to ensure the dinner was high quality.","translation":"主廚仔細地從當地市場挑選最新鮮的食材，以確保晚餐的高品質。","explanation":"名詞「主廚」。指餐廳裡的最高負責人。"},{"sentence":"After years of training in France, he became a professional <target>chef</target> and opened his own restaurant specializing in Italian cuisine.","translation":"在法國訓練多年後，他成為了一名專業廚師並開了一家專攻義大利料理的餐廳。","explanation":"名詞「專業廚師」。"},{"sentence":"The <target>chef</target> <pattern>prepared</pattern> a special dish for the guests, combining traditional flavors with modern cooking techniques.","translation":"廚師為客人準備了一道特別的菜餚，將傳統風味與現代烹飪技巧相結合。","explanation":"名詞「廚師」。常用動詞搭配：prepare a dish。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"choir","explanation":"名詞「合唱團」。常用動詞搭配 include, join, sing in。注意其發音為 /'kwaɪər/。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many students decided to <pattern>join</pattern> the school <target>choir</target> because they wanted to perform in the annual winter concert.","translation":"許多學生決定加入學校合唱團，因為他們想在年度冬季音樂會上演出。","explanation":"名詞「合唱團」。常用動詞搭配 join the choir。"},{"sentence":"The church <target>choir</target> sang a beautiful song that moved everyone in the audience to tears during the wedding ceremony.","translation":"教堂合唱團唱了一首美麗的歌曲，在婚禮儀式上讓在場的所有人都流淚了。","explanation":"名詞「合唱團」。"},{"sentence":"The <target>choir</target> <pattern>practiced</pattern> <pattern>for</pattern> several hours every day to ensure their harmony was perfect for the competition.","translation":"合唱團每天練習好幾個小時，以確保他們的和聲在比賽中是完美的。","explanation":"名詞「合唱團」。常用動詞搭配 practice for。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"chord","explanation":"名詞「和弦」或「弦」。在音樂語境中指三個或更多音符同時發出的聲音。注意不要與 cord (繩索) 混淆。","entries":[{"sentence":"The music student spent hours learning how to <pattern>play</pattern> a <target>chord</target> on the guitar, focusing on the correct finger placement.","translation":"這名音樂系學生花了好幾個小時學習如何在吉他上彈奏一個和弦，專注於正確的手指擺放位置。","explanation":"名詞「和弦」。常用動詞搭配 play a chord。"},{"sentence":"The pianist played a soft <target>chord</target> at the end of the piece, creating a peaceful and emotional atmosphere in the room.","translation":"鋼琴家在曲末彈奏了一個輕柔的和弦，在房間裡營造出一種寧靜且感性的氛圍。","explanation":"名詞「和弦」。"},{"sentence":"In geometry class, the teacher explained that a <target>chord</target> is a straight line segment whose endpoints both lie on a circle.","translation":"在幾何課上，老師解釋說弦是一條端點都在圓上的直線線段。","explanation":"名詞「弦」。在數學/幾何學中的定義。"}],"related_forms":["chords"]}

{"headword":"chore","explanation":"名詞「雜務；瑣事」。通常指日常生活中枯燥且必須完成的工作，如家事。常用片語 daily chores (日常雜務)。","entries":[{"sentence":"My mother always reminds me to <pattern>do</pattern> my <target>chores</target> before I can go out and play with my friends.","translation":"我母親總是提醒我在出門和朋友玩之前要先完成我的雜務。","explanation":"名詞「雜務」。常用動詞搭配 do chores。"},{"sentence":"Cleaning the bathroom is the <target>chore</target> I dislike the most, but it is necessary to keep the house clean.","translation":"清理浴室是我最討厭的雜務，但為了保持房子乾淨，這是必要的。","explanation":"名詞「雜務」。"},{"sentence":"For many office workers, filing papers and answering emails are just <pattern>daily</pattern> <target>chores</target> that they must complete every morning.","translation":"對於許多上班族來說，整理文件和回覆電子郵件只是他們每天早晨必須完成的日常雜務。","explanation":"名詞「日常雜務」。常用形容詞搭配 daily chores。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"chronic","explanation":"形容詞「慢性的；長期的」。常用於醫學語境描述疾病，或用於描述長期存在的社會問題。注意與 acute (急性的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The elderly man suffered from <target>chronic</target> <pattern>back pain</pattern>, which made it difficult for him to walk long distances.","translation":"這位老人患有慢性背痛，這使得他很難行走長距離。","explanation":"形容詞「慢性的」。常用搭配 chronic back pain / chronic illness。"},{"sentence":"Many cities around the world are facing <target>chronic</target> <pattern>shortages of</pattern> affordable housing, leading to higher rents for young people.","translation":"全球許多城市面臨著長期缺乏可負擔住房的問題，導致年輕人的租金更高。","explanation":"形容詞「長期的」。指長期存在且難以解決的問題。"},{"sentence":"The doctor warned him that <target>chronic</target> <pattern>stress</pattern> could lead to serious health problems if he did not find a way to relax.","translation":"醫生警告他，如果他找不到放鬆的方法，長期的壓力可能會導致嚴重的健康問題。","explanation":"形容詞「長期的」。常用搭配 chronic stress。"}],"related_forms":["chronically"]}

{"headword":"chubby","explanation":"形容詞「圓滾滾的；豐滿的」。通常用於描述小孩或嬰兒的臉頰，帶有一定的親切感，而非貶義。","entries":[{"sentence":"The baby had <target>chubby</target> <pattern>cheeks</pattern> that everyone in the family wanted to pinch, making him look very cute.","translation":"這個嬰兒有圓滾滾的臉頰，家人中每個人都想捏他的臉頰，讓他看起來非常可愛。","explanation":"形容詞「圓滾滾的」。常用搭配 chubby cheeks。"},{"sentence":"As a small child, he was quite <target>chubby</target>, but he became lean and athletic after joining the school basketball team.","translation":"在他幼年時，他相當圓滾滾的，但在加入學校籃球隊後，他變得精瘦且具有運動能力。","explanation":"形容詞「圓滾滾的」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"chunk","explanation":"名詞「大塊；厚塊」。指較大且形狀不規則的塊狀物。在非正式語境中也可指「一大塊時間」或「一大塊資訊」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The chef cut the beef into large <target>chunks</target> and added them to the pot to make a hearty beef stew.","translation":"廚師將牛肉切成大塊，並將其加入鍋中製作一份豐盛的牛肉燉菜。","explanation":"名詞「大塊」。指實體塊狀物。"},{"sentence":"She spent a large <target>chunk</target> <pattern>of</pattern> her monthly salary on rent, leaving her with very little money for other expenses.","translation":"她每月薪水的大部分都花在租金上，導致她幾乎沒有錢支付其他開支。","explanation":"名詞「一大塊/大部分」。常用片語 a chunk of sth。"},{"sentence":"The teacher advised the students to break the complex information into smaller <target>chunks</target> to make it easier to study and remember.","translation":"老師建議學生將複雜的資訊分成較小的塊狀，以便於學習和記憶。","explanation":"名詞「塊」。在此指資訊的片段。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"circuit","explanation":"名詞「電路；巡迴；迴路」。常用於電學、運動賽事或法律巡迴法院。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the physics lab, the students learned how to <pattern>complete</pattern> a <target>circuit</target> using a battery, wires, and a small light bulb.","translation":"在物理實驗室中，學生學習如何使用電池、電線和小燈泡來完成一個電路。","explanation":"名詞「電路」。常用動詞搭配 complete a circuit。"},{"sentence":"The race car driver drove around the <target>circuit</target> at an incredible speed, completing one full lap in under two minutes.","translation":"賽車手以極快的速度在賽道上駕駛，在兩分鐘內完成了一圈。","explanation":"名詞「賽道/巡迴路徑」。指圓形的跑道或賽道。"},{"sentence":"The judge traveled on a <target>circuit</target> to hear cases in different small towns, ensuring that justice was accessible to all citizens.","translation":"Judge 先生在巡迴中審理案件，以確保所有公民都能獲得公正的裁判。","explanation":"名詞「巡迴」。指定期在不同地點之間移動的路徑。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"cite","explanation":"動詞「引用；舉例」。常用於學術寫作中，指引用他人地文章或研究來支持自己的論點。注意不要與 site (地點) 或 sight (視覺) 混淆。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student was warned that he must <target>cite</target> all the sources he used in his essay to avoid <pattern>plagiarism</pattern>.","translation":"學生被警告他必須在論文中引用所有使用的來源，以避免剽竊。","explanation":"動詞「引用」。常用搭配 cite the sources。"},{"sentence":"During the debate, the speaker <target>cited</target> <pattern>several examples of</pattern> the new policy's failure to convince the audience that a change was needed.","translation":"在辯論中，演講者舉了幾個新政策失敗的例子，以說服聽眾需要做出改變。","explanation":"動詞「舉例」。常用搭配 cite examples of sth。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer <target>cited</target> <pattern>a previous case</pattern> to support his argument that the defendant was not guilty of the crime.","translation":"律師引用了一個先前的案例來支持他的論點，即被告並不對該罪行負責。","explanation":"動詞「引用」。指引用法律案例、權威資料來支持論點。"}],"related_forms":["citation"]}

{"headword":"citizenship","explanation":"名詞「公民權；公民身分」。指一個人被法律承認為某國公民的狀態。常用搭配 citizenship test (公民權考試)、gain/acquire citizenship (獲得公民權)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After living in the country for several years, she finally <pattern>applied for</pattern> <target>citizenship</target> to gain full legal rights and voting power.","translation":"在那個國家生活了幾年後，她終於申請了公民權，以獲得完整的法律權利和投票權。","explanation":"名詞「公民權」。常用搭配 apply for citizenship (申請公民權)。"},{"sentence":"The government requires all applicants to pass a <target>citizenship</target> <pattern>test</pattern> to prove their knowledge of the country's history and laws.","translation":"政府要求所有申請者通過公民權考試，以證明他們對該國歷史和法律的了解。","explanation":"名詞「公民權」。常用搭配 citizenship test (公民權考試)。"},{"sentence":"Many immigrants strive to <pattern>acquire</pattern> <target>citizenship</target> because it provides them with a sense of belonging and long-term stability.","translation":"許多移民努力獲得公民權，因為這能給他們一種歸屬感和長期穩定性。","explanation":"名詞「公民權」。常用搭配 acquire citizenship (獲得公民權)。"}],"related_forms":["citizen"]}

{"headword":"civic","explanation":"形容詞「公民的；城市的」。通常指與公民義務、權利或城市管理相關的事物。常用搭配 civic duty (公民義務)、civic center (市民中心/市政中心)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Voting in the national election is considered a fundamental <target>civic</target> <pattern>duty</pattern> for every adult citizen in a democratic society.","translation":"在民主社會中，參與國家選舉被認為是每位成年公民的基本公民義務。","explanation":"形容詞「公民的」。常用搭配 civic duty (公民義務)。"},{"sentence":"The city council decided to build a new <target>civic</target> <pattern>center</pattern> to provide a space for public meetings and community events.","translation":"市議會決定建造一座新的市政中心，為大眾會議和社區活動提供空間。","explanation":"形容詞「城市的/市政的」。常用搭配 civic center (市政中心)。"},{"sentence":"The students organized a <target>civic</target> <pattern>engagement</pattern> project to clean up the local park and improve the neighborhood environment.","translation":"學生們組織了一個公民參與計畫，旨在清理當地公園並改善鄰里環境。","explanation":"形容詞「公民的」。常用搭配 civic engagement (公民參與)。"}],"related_forms":["civics"]}

{"headword":"clarity","explanation":"名詞「清晰；清楚」。可用於描述聲音、影像、文字的清晰度，或想法、邏輯的明確性。常用搭配 lack of clarity (缺乏清晰度)、gain clarity (獲得明確理解)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The professor's explanation was so precise that it provided great <target>clarity</target> on the complex scientific theories discussed in class.","translation":"教授的解釋如此精準，以至於對課堂上討論的複雜科學理論提供了極大的清晰度。","explanation":"名詞「清晰」。指想法或解釋的明確性。"},{"sentence":"To improve the <target>clarity</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the presentation, the speaker used simple diagrams and bullet points instead of long paragraphs.","translation":"為了提高簡報的清晰度，演講者使用了簡單的圖表和列點，而非長篇大論。","explanation":"名詞「清晰度」。指訊息傳達的清楚程度。"},{"sentence":"After discussing the problem with her mentor, she finally <pattern>gained</pattern> <target>clarity</target> regarding her future career choices and academic goals.","translation":"在與導師討論問題後，她終於對未來的職業選擇和學業目標有了明確的理解。","explanation":"名詞「明確」。常用搭配 gain clarity (獲得明確理解)。"}],"related_forms":["clear"]}

{"headword":"clause","explanation":"名詞「子句」或「條款」。在語言學中指包含主詞和動詞的句子組成部分；在法律文件中指合約或法律中的特定條款。","entries":[{"sentence":"In English grammar, a main <target>clause</target> can stand alone as a complete sentence, whereas a subordinate <target>clause</target> cannot.","translation":"在英文文法中，主句可以獨立成句，而從句則不能。","explanation":"名詞「子句」。語言學用法。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer carefully reviewed the <target>clause</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the contract to ensure that his client's interests were fully protected.","translation":"律師仔細審閱了合約中的條款，以確保其客戶的利益得到充分保護。","explanation":"名詞「條款」。法律文件用法。"},{"sentence":"The employment agreement includes a non-disclosure <target>clause</target> that prevents employees from sharing company secrets with outside competitors.","translation":"雇傭協議中包含一項保密條款，防止員工將公司秘密分享給外部競爭對手。","explanation":"名詞「條款」。常用搭配 non-disclosure clause (保密條款)。"}],"related_forms":["clauses"]}

{"headword":"cling","explanation":"動詞「緊緊抓住；依附；堅持」。常用搭配 cling to sth (緊抓...；堅持...)。注意其不規則變化：cling, clung, clung。","entries":[{"sentence":"The frightened child <target>clung</target> <pattern>to</pattern> his mother's hand as they walked through the crowded streets of the city.","translation":"當他們走在城市擁擠的街道上時，受驚的孩子緊緊抓著母親的手。","explanation":"動詞「緊緊抓住」。常用搭配 cling to sth。"},{"sentence":"Despite the evidence showing his theory was wrong, the scientist <target>clung</target> <pattern>to</pattern> his old beliefs and refused to change.","translation":"儘管證據顯示他的理論是錯誤的，這位科學家仍然堅持他的舊信念並拒絕改變。","explanation":"動詞「堅持」。指對想法、信仰的執著。"},{"sentence":"Wet clothes tend to <target>cling</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the skin, which can make a person feel very uncomfortable during a humid summer.","translation":"濕衣服傾向於貼在皮膚上，這在潮濕的夏季會讓人感到非常不舒服。","explanation":"動詞「貼著」。指物理上的依附。"}],"related_forms":["clinging"]}

{"headword":"clinical","explanation":"形容詞「臨床的；冷漠的」。主要指在醫院對病人進行實務觀察而非實驗室研究；也可以指一種缺乏情感、過於客觀的態度。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new drug underwent rigorous <target>clinical</target> <pattern>trials</pattern> to ensure its safety and effectiveness before being released to the public.","translation":"這種新藥在對大眾發布前，經過了嚴格的臨床試驗，以確保其安全性和有效性。","explanation":"形容詞「臨床的」。常用搭配 clinical trials (臨床試驗)。"},{"sentence":"The doctor provided a <target>clinical</target> <pattern>assessment</pattern> of the patient's condition based on physical examinations and medical history.","translation":"醫生根據身體檢查和病史，對患者的病情進行了臨床評估。","explanation":"形容詞「臨床的」。常用搭配 clinical assessment (臨床評估)。"},{"sentence":"She described the accident in a <target>clinical</target> <pattern>tone</pattern>, without showing any emotion or sympathy for the victims.","translation":"她用一種冷漠的口吻描述這起事故，沒有對受害者表現出任何情感或同情。","explanation":"形容詞「冷漠的」。指過於客觀、缺乏人情味的態度。"}],"related_forms":["clinician","clinically"]}

{"headword":"cluster","explanation":"名詞「群；簇」；動詞「聚集」。名詞指一群聚集在一起的人或物；動詞指將人或物聚集在一起。","entries":[{"sentence":"A small <target>cluster</target> <pattern>of</pattern> stars was visible in the clear night sky, appearing as a bright group of lights.","translation":"在晴朗的夜空中可以看到一小簇恆星，看起來像是一組明亮的光點。","explanation":"名詞「群；簇」。常用搭配 a cluster of sth。"},{"sentence":"The students tended to <target>cluster</target> <pattern>around</pattern> the teacher after class to ask questions about the upcoming final exam.","translation":"課後學生們傾向於聚集在老師周圍，詢問關於即將到來的期末考的問題。","explanation":"動詞「聚集」。常用搭配 cluster around sth/sb。"},{"sentence":"Health officials are monitoring a <target>cluster</target> <pattern>of</pattern> infections in the local community to prevent a wider outbreak of the disease.","translation":"衛生官員正在監控當地社區的一群感染病例，以防止疾病的大規模爆發。","explanation":"名詞「群」。常用於流行病學，指在特定時間/地點集中出現的病例。"}],"related_forms":["clustered"]}

{"headword":"cocaine","explanation":"名詞「可卡因」。一種強烈且具成癮性的非法刺激性藥物。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police seized a large amount of <target>cocaine</target> during the raid on the warehouse, stopping a major drug trafficking operation.","translation":"警方在搜查倉庫期間沒收了大量可卡因，阻止了一次重大的毒品走私行動。","explanation":"名詞「可卡因」。"},{"sentence":"Drug abuse, including the use of <target>cocaine</target>, can lead to severe heart problems and permanent damage to the nervous system.","translation":"藥物濫用，包括使用可卡因，會導致嚴重的心臟問題以及對神經系統的永久性損害。","explanation":"名詞「可卡因」。"},{"sentence":"The government launched a public awareness campaign to warn teenagers about the dangers of <target>cocaine</target> and other illegal substances.","translation":"政府發起了一場公眾意識活動，以警告青少年關於可卡因和其他非法物質的危險。","explanation":"名詞「可卡因」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"coffin","explanation":"名詞「棺材」。用於將死者安葬的容器。","entries":[{"sentence":"The family gathered around the open <target>coffin</target> to say their final goodbyes to the grandfather before the burial ceremony.","translation":"家人們聚集在敞開的棺材旁，在葬禮之前與祖父做最後的告別。","explanation":"名詞「棺材」。"},{"sentence":"In some cultures, the <target>coffin</target> is decorated with bright colors and flowers to celebrate the life of the deceased person.","translation":"在某些文化中，棺材會用鮮豔的顏色和花朵裝飾，以慶祝死者的生前生活。","explanation":"名詞「棺材」。"},{"sentence":"The heavy wooden <target>coffin</target> was slowly lowered into the ground as the mourners wept and prayed in silence.","translation":"當哀悼者在沉默中哭泣和祈禱時，沉重的木製棺材被緩緩地放入地下。","explanation":"名詞「棺材」。"}],"related_forms":["coffins"]}

{"headword":"cognitive","explanation":"形容詞「認知的」。指與心智過程相關的事物，如思考、記憶、感知和學習。常用搭配 cognitive skills (認知能力)、cognitive development (認知發展)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Playing strategy games and reading complex books can help improve a child's <target>cognitive</target> <pattern>abilities</pattern> and problem-solving skills.","translation":"玩策略遊戲和閱讀複雜的書籍可以幫助提高孩子的認知能力和解決問題的技能。","explanation":"形容詞「認知的」。常用搭配 cognitive abilities (認知能力)。"},{"sentence":"Psychologists study <target>cognitive</target> <pattern>development</pattern> to understand how children's thinking patterns change as they grow older.","translation":"心理學家研究認知發展，以了解孩子們的思考模式如何隨著年齡增長而改變。","explanation":"形容詞「認知的」。常用搭配 cognitive development (認知發展)。"},{"sentence":"Certain types of dementia can lead to a decline in <target>cognitive</target> <pattern>function</pattern>, making it difficult for patients to remember simple things.","translation":"某些類型的失智症會導致認知功能的下降，使得患者難以記住簡單的事情。","explanation":"形容詞「認知的」。常用搭配 cognitive function (認知功能)。"}],"related_forms":["cognition","cognitively"]}

{"headword": "coherent", "explanation": "形容詞「連貫的、條理分明的」。常用於描述論點、計畫或發言邏輯清晰。常用搭配：a coherent argument (一個連貫的論點), coherent thoughts (清晰的思緒)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The student's essay was well-organized, presenting a <target>coherent</target> argument that convinced the teacher of his point of view.", "translation": "這名學生的論文組織良好，提出了一個連貫的論點，使老師相信了他的觀點。", "explanation": "形容詞「連貫的」。用於描述論點邏輯清晰。"}, {"sentence": "After the accident, the witness was too shocked to give a <target>coherent</target> account of what had happened to the police.", "translation": "事故發生後，證人太震驚了，無法向警方提供關於發生之事的條理分明的描述。", "explanation": "形容詞「條理分明的」。描述發言或敘述清晰。"}, {"sentence": "To succeed in the debate, you must ensure that your points are <target>coherent</target> and supported by strong evidence.", "translation": "要在辯論中獲勝，你必須確保你的論點是連貫的，且有強而有力的證據支持。", "explanation": "形容詞「連貫的」。"}], "related_forms": ["coherence", "coherently"]}

{"headword":"coincidence","explanation":"名詞「巧合」。常考片語：by coincidence (巧合地), what a coincidence (真是巧合)。注意與 accident (意外) 的區別：coincidence 強調兩個獨立事件在時間或空間上意外地一致。","entries":[{"sentence":"It was a complete <target>coincidence</target> that I met my old primary school friend at the airport in a different country.","translation":"我在另一個國家的機場遇到小學時的老朋友，完全是一個巧合。","explanation":"名詞「巧合」。指意外且不相關的事件同時發生。"},{"sentence":"By pure <target>coincidence</target>, both students chose the same topic for their history project, even though they had not discussed it.","translation":"純屬巧合，兩名學生為他們的歷史專題選擇了相同的主題，儘管他們並沒有討論過。","explanation":"名詞「巧合」。常用搭配 by coincidence。"},{"sentence":"When she realized we were wearing the exact same dress to the party, she exclaimed, \"What a <target>coincidence</target>!\"","translation":"當她意識到我們穿著完全一樣的洋裝參加派對時，她驚呼：「真是太巧了！」","explanation":"名詞「巧合」。常用口語表達 What a coincidence!"}],"related_forms":["coincidental","coincidentally"]}

{"headword": "collaboration", "explanation": "名詞「合作」。常用於學術、藝術或商業領域。常用搭配：in collaboration with (與...合作), close collaboration (密切合作)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The new scientific discovery was the result of close <target>collaboration</target> <pattern>between</pattern> researchers from three different universities across the globe.", "translation": "這項新的科學發現是全球三所不同大學的研究人員密切合作的結果。", "explanation": "名詞「合作」。強調共同努力以達成目標。"}, {"sentence": "The art exhibit was created <pattern>in</pattern> <target>collaboration</target> <pattern>with</pattern> a local community center to promote cultural diversity in the city.", "translation": "這次藝術展覽是與當地社區中心合作創建的，旨在促進城市中的文化多樣性。", "explanation": "名詞「合作」。常用搭配 in collaboration with。"}, {"sentence": "Teachers encourage students to work in <target>collaboration</target> during group projects to develop their teamwork and communication skills through shared goals.", "translation": "老師鼓勵學生在小組專題中合作，以透過共同目標培養他們的團隊合作和溝通能力。", "explanation": "名詞「合作」。"}], "related_forms": ["collaborate", "collaborator", "collaborative"]}

{"headword": "collective", "explanation": "可作形容詞「共同的、集體的」或名詞「集體」。常用搭配：collective effort (共同努力), collective memory (集體記憶), collective responsibility (集體責任)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Cleaning up the beach after the storm required a <target>collective</target> effort from all the volunteers in the town.", "translation": "風暴後清理海灘需要鎮上所有志工的共同努力。", "explanation": "形容詞「共同的、集體的」。常用搭配 collective effort。"}, {"sentence": "The students felt a sense of <target>collective</target> responsibility to keep their classroom clean and organized throughout the semester.", "translation": "學生們感到有一種集體責任感，要在整個學期中保持教室的整潔有序。", "explanation": "形容詞「集體的」。常用搭配 collective responsibility。"}, {"sentence": "The national anthem and the flag are symbols that contribute to the <target>collective</target> identity of the people in the country.", "translation": "國歌和國旗是促成該國人民集體認同感的象徵。", "explanation": "形容詞「集體的」。常用搭配 collective identity。"}, {"sentence": "The farmers formed a <target>collective</target> to share expensive machinery and negotiate better prices for their crops in the market.", "translation": "農民們組成了一個集體，以共享昂貴的機器並在市場上為他們的作物協商更好的價格。", "explanation": "名詞「集體」。指一群人為了共同利益而組織起來的團體。"}], "related_forms": ["collectively", "collectivism"]}

{"headword": "collector", "explanation": "名詞「收藏家、收集者」。常用搭配：art collector (藝術收藏家), stamp collector (集郵者), tax collector (稅務徵收員)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "As an avid stamp <target>collector</target>, he spent years searching for rare stamps from countries that no longer exist.", "translation": "作為一名熱衷的集郵者，他花了很多年尋找那些已不存在國家的稀有郵票。", "explanation": "名詞「收藏家」。指對特定物品有愛好並收集的人。"}, {"sentence": "The wealthy businessman was a famous <pattern>art</pattern> <target>collector</target> who owned many original paintings by world-renowned artists.", "translation": "這位富有的商人是一位著名的藝術收藏家，擁有許多世界知名藝術家的原作畫作。", "explanation": "名詞「收藏家」。"}, {"sentence": "In ancient times, the <pattern>tax</pattern> <target>collector</target> was often feared by the villagers because he demanded strict payment of all duties.", "translation": "在古代，稅務徵收員常被村民恐懼，因為他要求嚴格繳納所有稅金。", "explanation": "名詞「收集者」。此處指執行徵收職責的人。"}], "related_forms": ["collect", "collection"]}

{"headword": "colonial", "explanation": "形容詞「殖民的」；名詞「殖民地居民」。常用搭配：colonial period (殖民時期), colonial architecture (殖民風格建築), colonial rule (殖民統治)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The city's downtown area still features many <target>colonial</target> buildings with large balconies and white walls from the 18th century.", "translation": "這座城市的市中心仍有許多 18 世紀的殖民風格建築，擁有大型陽台和白牆。", "explanation": "形容詞「殖民的」。常用於描述建築或時期的風格。"}, {"sentence": "Students learned about the struggles of people living under <target>colonial</target> rule during their history class last week.", "translation": "學生們在上週的歷史課上學習了生活在殖民統治下的人們的掙扎。", "explanation": "形容詞「殖民的」。常用搭配 colonial rule。"}, {"sentence": "The museum exhibits various artifacts from the <target>colonial</target> era, showing how trade and culture shifted during that time.", "translation": "博物館展出了殖民時期的各種文物，展示了當時貿易和文化是如何轉移的。", "explanation": "形容詞「殖民的」。常用搭配 colonial era/period。"}], "related_forms": ["colonize", "colony", "colonialism", "colonist"]}

{"headword":"columnist","explanation":"名詞「專欄作家」。指在報紙或雜誌中定期撰寫特定主題文章的人。常用搭配：newspaper columnist (報紙專欄作家)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The famous political <target>columnist</target> writes a weekly piece in the national newspaper, analyzing current events with a sharp perspective.","translation":"這位著名的政治專欄作家在國家報紙上撰寫週刊文章，以銳利的視角分析時事。","explanation":"名詞「專欄作家」。"},{"sentence":"Many readers enjoy the humor and wit of the local food <target>columnist</target> who reviews the best restaurants in the city.","translation":"許多讀者喜歡當地美食專欄作家的幽默與機智，他評論城市中最好的餐廳。","explanation":"名詞「專欄作家」。"},{"sentence":"After years of reporting as a journalist, she was finally invited to become a regular <target>columnist</target> for a fashion magazine.","translation":"在擔任記者報導多年後，她終於受邀成為一家時尚雜誌的定期專欄作家。","explanation":"名詞「專欄作家」。"}],"related_forms":["column"]}

{"headword": "combat", "explanation": "動詞「對抗、打擊」；名詞「戰鬥、格鬥」。動詞用法常接抽象的負面事物如 inflation (通膨)、disease (疾病) 或 crime (犯罪)。名詞用法常考於 hand-to-hand combat (徒手格鬥) 或 armed combat (武裝戰鬥)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The government implemented new policies to <target>combat</target> <pattern>inflation</pattern> and lower the cost of living for ordinary citizens.", "translation": "政府實施了新政策以打擊通貨膨脹，並降低普通公民的生活成本。", "explanation": "動詞「對抗、打擊」。用於描述採取行動遏制抽象的社會或經濟問題。"}, {"sentence": "Doctors are working hard to develop a new vaccine to <target>combat</target> <pattern>the spreading virus</pattern> and save more lives.", "translation": "醫生們正努力研發一種新疫苗以對抗傳播中的病毒並挽救更多生命。", "explanation": "動詞「對抗」。常用於醫療或科學背景，指與疾病作鬥爭。"}, {"sentence": "The soldiers were trained in hand-to-hand <target>combat</target> to ensure they could protect themselves in extreme emergency situations.", "translation": "士兵們接受了徒手戰鬥訓練，以確保他們在極端緊急情況下能保護 themselves in extreme emergency situations 確保他們在極端緊急情況下能保護自己。", "explanation": "名詞「戰鬥、格鬥」。手動格鬥（hand-to-hand combat）為固定軍事用語。"}, {"sentence": "The two armies engaged in fierce <target>combat</target> for several days before a peace treaty was finally signed.", "translation": "兩軍在和平條約最終簽署之前，進行了數日的激烈戰鬥。", "explanation": "名詞「戰鬥」。指軍隊或群體之間的武裝衝突。"}], "related_forms": ["combative", "combatant"]}

{"headword":"comedian","explanation":"名詞「喜劇演員」。常用搭配：stand-up comedian (單口喜劇演員)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The stand-up <target>comedian</target> made the entire audience laugh with his funny stories about his awkward experiences in high school.","translation":"這位單口喜劇演員用他高中時尷尬經歷的有趣故事讓全場觀眾大笑。","explanation":"名詞「喜劇演員」。常用搭配 stand-up comedian。"},{"sentence":"To be a successful <target>comedian</target>, one must have a great sense of timing and the ability to read the audience's mood.","translation":"要成為一名成功的喜劇演員，必須有很好的時機掌控感以及閱讀觀眾情緒的能力。","explanation":"名詞「喜劇演員」。"},{"sentence":"The movie features a talented <target>comedian</target> whose facial expressions are just as funny as the jokes he tells.","translation":"這部電影由一位天才喜劇演員主演，他的面部表情和他講的笑話一樣有趣。","explanation":"名詞「喜劇演員」。"}],"related_forms":["comedy","comedic"]}

{"headword":"commentary","explanation":"名詞「評論、解說」。常用於 sports commentary (體育解說) 或 social commentary (社會評論)。指對某事提供解釋、分析或意見的詳細論述。","entries":[{"sentence":"While watching the World Cup, I found the expert <target>commentary</target> very helpful for understanding the complex rules of the game.","translation":"在看世界盃時，我發現專家的解說對理解比賽複雜的規則非常有幫助。","explanation":"名詞「解說」。指對體育比賽等活動的即時分析。"},{"sentence":"The novelist used his latest book as a form of social <target>commentary</target> to criticize the inequality in modern society.","translation":"這位小說家將他的最新著作作為一種社會評論，以批評現代社會的不平等。","explanation":"名詞「評論」。指對社會現象的分析與批判。"},{"sentence":"The DVD includes a director's <target>commentary</target> track, where he explains the creative choices he made during the filming process.","translation":"這張 DVD 包含一段導演解說軌道，他在其中解釋了拍攝過程中做出的創意選擇。","explanation":"名詞「解說」。指對作品創作過程的詳細說明。"}],"related_forms":["comment","commentator"]}

{"headword":"commentator","explanation":"名詞，指「評論員」或「解說員」。常用於體育賽事或政治分析。常用搭配：sports commentator (體育評論員), political commentator (政治評論員)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The sports <target>commentator</target> provided a detailed analysis of the game, explaining the players' strategies to the audience.","translation":"體育評論員對比賽進行了詳細分析，向觀眾解釋球員的策略。","explanation":"名詞「評論員」。常用搭配：sports commentator。"},{"sentence":"As a well-known political <target>commentator</target>, he often writes articles for major newspapers to share his views on current global events.","translation":"作為一名知名的政治評論員，他經常在主流報紙上發表文章，分享他對當前全球事件的看法。","explanation":"名詞「評論員」。常用搭配：political commentator。"}],"related_forms":["commentators","commentate","commentary"]}

{"headword":"commission","explanation":"名詞用法包括「佣金」、「委員會」和「委任」。動詞則指「委任」或「委託」。注意 commission as a fee (佣金) 和 commission as a group (委員會) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The real estate agent earns a small <target>commission</target> <pattern>on</pattern> every house he sells, which allows him to make a living.","translation":"房地產經紀人每賣出一間房子都能賺到一小筆佣金，這讓他能維持生計。","explanation":"名詞「佣金」。常用搭配：earn a commission on sth。"},{"sentence":"The government established a special <target>commission</target> to investigate the causes of the environmental pollution in the river.","translation":"政府成立了一個特別委員會來調查河流中環境污染的原因。","explanation":"名詞「委員會」。指被委派執行特定任務的團體。"},{"sentence":"The city council decided to <target>commission</target> a local artist to create a large sculpture for the new public park.","translation":"市議會決定委託一名當地藝術家為新的公共公園創作一座大型雕塑。","explanation":"動詞「委託」。指為金錢而請人創作或製造某物。"}],"related_forms":["commissioned","commissioning"]}

{"headword": "commitment", "explanation": "名詞「承諾、投入、奉獻、責任」。常考搭配包括 make a commitment to (做出承諾), show commitment to (展現對...的投入)。注意後接的 to 為介係詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Graduating from university requires a strong <target>commitment</target> <pattern>to</pattern> studying every day, even when the subjects become difficult.", "translation": "從大學畢業需要對每天學習有強烈的投入，即使在科目變得困難時也是如此。", "explanation": "名詞「投入、奉獻」。此處的 to 為介係詞，後接動名詞。"}, {"sentence": "The couple <pattern>made</pattern> a lifelong <target>commitment</target> <pattern>to</pattern> each other during their wedding ceremony, promising to support one another through thick and thin.", "translation": "這對夫妻在婚禮上對彼此做出了終身的承諾，答應在患難與共時互相支持。", "explanation": "名詞「承諾」。常用搭配為 make a commitment to someone。"}, {"sentence": "Because of his professional <target>commitment</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the project, he often stayed late at the office to ensure every detail was perfect.", "translation": "由於他對該項目的專業投入，他經常在辦公室加班以確保每個細節都完美。", "explanation": "名詞「投入」。指對工作、任務或目標的專注與責任感。"}, {"sentence": "She has many family <target>commitments</target> that prevent her from traveling abroad for a long period of time during the summer break.", "translation": "她有許多家庭責任，使她無法在暑假期間長時間地在國外旅行。", "explanation": "名詞「責任、義務」。此時多用複數形式，指必須履行的約定或照顧責任。"}], "related_forms": ["commit", "committed"]}

{"headword":"commodity","explanation":"名詞，指「商品」或「有用之物」。在經濟學中，commodity 通常指原物料（如原油、黃金、穀物）等大宗商品，而非單個零售產品。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the modern economy, data has become a valuable <target>commodity</target> that companies use to target their advertisements more effectively.","translation":"在現代經濟中，數據已成為一種寶貴的商品，公司利用數據更有效地投放廣告。","explanation":"名詞「商品」。指具有交易價值的物品。"},{"sentence":"During the drought, water became a scarce <target>commodity</target> in the region, leading to high prices and strict rationing.","translation":"乾旱期間，水在該地區成為一種稀缺商品，導致價格高漲和嚴格的配給。","explanation":"名詞「有用之物」。指非常需要但數量有限的東西。"}],"related_forms":["commodities"]}

{"headword": "communism", "explanation": "名詞「共產主義」。指一種社會政治與經濟體制，主張財產公有、取消私有制，並由國家統一控制所有生產資料與資源。相關詞彙為 communist (共產主義者；共產主義的)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The political scientist explained that <target>communism</target> is a system where the government controls all production and resources to ensure equal distribution among citizens.", "translation": "這位政治學家解釋說，共產主義是一種政府控制所有生產和資源以確保公民之間平等分配的體制。", "explanation": "名詞「共產主義」。句中完整交代了其核心經濟特徵以利閱讀理解。"}, {"sentence": "During the twentieth century, the ideological conflict between capitalism and <target>communism</target> shaped the global political landscape.", "translation": "在二十世紀，資本主義與共產主義之間的意識形態衝突塑造了全球的政治格局。", "explanation": "名詞「共產主義」。常與 capitalism (資本主義) 放在一起進行歷史或政治考題的對比。"}, {"sentence": "After the revolution, the nation <pattern>adopted</pattern> <target>communism</target> and nationalized all private factories and lands.", "translation": "革命之後，該國採用了共產主義，並將所有私營工廠和土地收歸國有。", "explanation": "名詞「共產主義」。與國家體制的建立和政策轉變相關。"}], "related_forms": ["communist"]}

{"headword":"communist","explanation":"形容詞指「共產主義的」；名詞指「共產主義者」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The scholar spent years studying the <target>communist</target> <pattern>ideology</pattern> to understand how it shaped the governments of several countries.","translation":"這位學者花了很多年研究共產主義意識形態，以了解它是如何塑造幾個國家的政府的。","explanation":"形容詞「共產主義的」。常用搭配：communist ideology。"},{"sentence":"During the Cold War, many governments were concerned that <target>communists</target> had infiltrated their political systems to influence policy.","translation":"在冷戰期間，許多政府擔心共產主義者已經滲透進他們的政治體系以影響政策。","explanation":"名詞「共產主義者」。"}],"related_forms":["communism"]}

{"headword": "commute", "explanation": "動詞，指「通勤」，即定期在住所與工作/學校地點之間往返。常用搭配：commute to work/school (通勤去上班/上學)。名詞則指「通勤路程/時間」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Because she lives far from the office, she has to <target>commute</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the city center by train every morning.", "translation": "因為她住得很遠，每天早上必須搭火車通勤到市中心上班。", "explanation": "動詞「通勤」。常用搭配：commute to sth。"}, {"sentence": "Many people prefer to work from home to avoid the long <target>commute</target> and the stress of heavy traffic during rush hour.", "translation": "許多人偏好在家工作，以避免長途通勤和尖峰時段交通擁堵的壓力。", "explanation": "名詞「通勤路程」。"}, {"sentence": "The daily <target>commute</target> can be quite exhausting, especially when the trains are crowded and delayed during the rainy season.", "translation": "每日的通勤路程可能相當累人，特別是在雨季火車擁擠且延誤的時候。", "explanation": "名詞「通勤路程」。"}, {"sentence": "Most of the employees <target>commute</target> <pattern>by</pattern> bus or subway to save money on parking fees in the expensive downtown area.", "translation": "大多數員工搭乘巴士或地鐵通勤，以節省市中心昂貴的停車費。", "explanation": "動詞「通勤」。"}], "related_forms": ["commuter", "commuting"]}

{"headword":"commuter","explanation":"名詞，指「通勤者」。指定期在住所與工作/學校地點之間往返的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new subway line has significantly reduced travel time for thousands of <target>commuters</target> who travel between the suburbs and downtown.","translation":"新的地鐵線顯著縮短了數千名在郊區和市中心之間往返的通勤者的旅行時間。","explanation":"名詞「通勤者」。"}],"related_forms":["commute","commuting"]}

{"headword":"compact","explanation":"形容詞「緊湊的、小巧的」；名詞「協議、契約」；動詞「壓縮」。注意 compact (形容詞) 與 compact (名詞) 用法的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student bought a <target>compact</target> laptop that fits easily into her backpack, allowing her to study anywhere on campus.","translation":"這名學生買了一台小巧的筆記型電腦，能輕鬆放入背包，讓她在校園任何地方都能學習。","explanation":"形容詞「小巧的、緊湊的」。"},{"sentence":"The two nations signed a <target>compact</target> to cooperate on environmental protection and reduce carbon emissions together.","translation":"兩國簽署了一項協議，共同合作保護環境並減少碳排放。","explanation":"名詞「協議」。指正式的協議或契約。"},{"sentence":"The factory uses a powerful machine to <target>compact</target> the waste paper into small blocks for easier recycling and transport.","translation":"工廠使用一台強大的機器將廢紙壓縮成小塊，以便於回收和運輸。","explanation":"動詞「壓縮」。"}],"related_forms":["compaction","compacted"]}

{"headword":"comparable","explanation":"形容詞，意為「可比擬的、相當的」。常用搭配：comparable to (與...相當/可比)。注意與 comparative (比較的) 的區別：comparable 強調的是兩者在程度、大小或品質上相似，而 comparative 指的是比較兩個或多個事物的過程。","entries":[{"sentence":"The quality of the new smartphone is <target>comparable</target> <pattern>to</pattern> that of the most expensive brands on the market.","translation":"這款新智慧型手機的品質與市場上最昂貴的品牌相當。","explanation":"形容詞「相當的、可比擬的」。常用搭配：comparable to sth。"},{"sentence":"Although the two cities are different in size, their cultural diversity is <target>comparable</target>, with both offering many museums and galleries.","translation":"儘管這兩座城市的大小不同，但它們的文化多樣性相當，兩者都提供許多博物館和畫廊。","explanation":"形容詞「相當的」。指兩者在某方面程度相似。"}],"related_forms":["compare","comparatively","comparison"]}

{"headword":"compassion","explanation":"名詞「同情心、憐憫」。指對他人痛苦的深刻理解並希望緩解其苦難的情感。常用搭配 compassion for someone (對某人的同情)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The nurse showed great <target>compassion</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the elderly patients, always listening patiently to their stories and offering comfort.","translation":"護理師對年長的病人表現出極大的同情心，總是耐心地傾聽他們的故事並提供安慰。","explanation":"名詞「同情心」。常用搭配 compassion for someone。"}],"related_forms":["compassionate"]}

{"headword":"compassionate","explanation":"形容詞「有同情心的、憐憫的」。描述一個人能感受到他人的痛苦並願意提供幫助。常用於描述醫療人員或社會工作者。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>compassionate</target> teacher spent her free time helping struggling students improve their grades through extra tutoring sessions.","translation":"這位有同情心的老師利用空閒時間透過額外補習，幫助成績落後的學生提高分數。","explanation":"形容詞「有同情心的」。描述人的性格特質。"}],"related_forms":["compassion"]}

{"headword":"compatible","explanation":"形容詞「兼容的、相容的」。可用於科技（如軟體、硬體）或人際關係（指價值觀、性格相容）。常用搭配 be compatible with (與...相容)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new software is not <target>compatible</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the older operating system, so the company must upgrade all their computers.","translation":"這款新軟體與較舊的作業系統不相容，因此公司必須升級所有電腦。","explanation":"形容詞「兼容的」。用於描述科技產品的相容性。"},{"sentence":"After dating for several months, they realized they were not <target>compatible</target> in terms of their life goals and values.","translation":"交往幾個月後，他們發現彼此在生活目標和價值觀方面並不相容。","explanation":"形容詞「相容的」。用於描述人與人之間性格或價值觀的契合度。"}],"related_forms":["compatibility"]}

{"headword": "compel", "explanation": "動詞「強迫、迫使」。指透過權力、法律或強烈的壓力使某人採取行動。常用搭配 compel someone to do something (強迫某人做某事)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The sudden increase in tuition fees may <target>compel</target> some students <pattern>to</pattern> take part-time jobs to support their studies.", "translation": "學費的突然增加可能會迫使一些學生從事兼職工作以維持學業。", "explanation": "動詞「強迫」。搭配 compel someone to do something。"}, {"sentence": "Severe weather conditions <target>compelled</target> the airline <pattern>to</pattern> cancel all departing flights to ensure the safety of passengers.", "translation": "嚴重的天氣狀況迫使航空公司取消所有起飛航班，以確保乘客的安全。", "explanation": "動詞「迫使」。"}, {"sentence": "The judge's order may <target>compel</target> the witness <pattern>to</pattern> testify in court despite their fear of retaliation.", "translation": "法官的命令可能會強迫證人儘管害怕遭到報復仍必須在法庭上作證。", "explanation": "動詞「強迫」。"}, {"sentence": "Hunger and poverty often <target>compel</target> people <pattern>to</pattern> leave their hometowns in search of better opportunities in the city.", "translation": "飢餓和貧困經常迫使人們離開家鄉，在城市中尋找更好的機會。", "explanation": "動詞「迫使」。"}], "related_forms": ["compelling", "compulsion"]}

{"headword":"compensate","explanation":"動詞「補償、彌補」。可指金錢上的補償，也可指用另一種優點來彌補缺點。常用搭配 compensate for something (彌補/補償某事)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The airline decided to <target>compensate</target> the passengers <pattern>for</pattern> the long delay by providing free hotel rooms and meal vouchers.","translation":"航空公司決定透過提供免費飯店房間和餐券，來補償乘客因長時間延誤而受到的損失。","explanation":"動詞「補償」。常用搭配 compensate for sth (金錢或物質補償)。"},{"sentence":"Although he lacks natural talent for music, his hard work and persistence <target>compensate</target> <pattern>for</pattern> his lack of skill.","translation":"雖然他缺乏音樂天賦，但他的努力與堅持彌補了他的技巧不足。","explanation":"動詞「彌補」。指用一種特質來抵消另一種不足。"}],"related_forms":["compensation"]}

{"headword": "compensation", "explanation": "名詞「補償、賠償金」。指為了彌補損失或傷害而支付的金額，或是對辛勤工作的報酬。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The injured worker received a large sum of <target>compensation</target> from the company after the accident occurred in the factory.", "translation": "這名受傷的工人在此次工廠事故發生後，從公司獲得了一大筆賠償金。", "explanation": "名詞「賠償金」。指金錢上的補償。"}, {"sentence": "The company offers a competitive <target>compensation</target> <pattern>package</pattern>, including a high salary and comprehensive health insurance for all employees.", "translation": "公司提供具競爭力的薪酬待遇，包括高薪和為所有員工提供的全面健康保險。", "explanation": "名詞「報酬」。常用搭配 compensation package (薪酬待遇)。"}, {"sentence": "The government provided financial <target>compensation</target> <pattern>to</pattern> families whose homes were destroyed by the massive earthquake last year.", "translation": "政府為去年強震摧毀房屋的家庭提供了財務補償。", "explanation": "名詞「補償金」。"}, {"sentence": "In exchange for the extra hours they worked during the peak season, employees were given <target>compensation</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the form of extra vacation days.", "translation": "作為在旺季加班的額外小時的交換，員工得到了以額外假期形式提供的補償。", "explanation": "名詞「補償」。指非金錢上的補償。"}, {"sentence": "The airline was forced to pay <target>compensation</target> <pattern>to</pattern> passengers whose flights were delayed for more than twelve hours due to technical issues.", "translation": "由於技術問題導致航班延誤超過十二小時，航空公司被強迫向乘客支付補償金。", "explanation": "名詞「賠償金」。"}], "related_forms": ["compensate"]}

{"headword": "competence", "explanation": "名詞「能力、勝任」。指完成某項工作或任務所需的技能、知識或能力。常用搭配 professional competence (專業能力)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The hiring manager evaluated the candidate's technical <target>competence</target> through a series of practical tests and a detailed interview.", "translation": "招聘經理透過一系列實作測試和詳細的面試，評估了應徵者的技術能力。", "explanation": "名詞「能力」。指完成任務所需的技能。"}, {"sentence": "To ensure the safety of patients, the hospital requires all doctors to demonstrate their professional <target>competence</target> through regular certification exams.", "translation": "為了確保病患的安全，醫院要求所有醫生透過定期認證考試來證明他們的專業能力。", "explanation": "名詞「專業能力」。"}, {"sentence": "The student's linguistic <target>competence</target> improved significantly after she spent a whole summer attending an intensive English language camp in Canada.", "translation": "這名學生在加拿大參加一個整個夏天的密集英文語言營後，語言能力顯著提升。", "explanation": "名詞「能力」。指具備某項技能的水平。"}, {"sentence": "Regardless of the candidate's academic degrees, the committee focused on whether he possessed the necessary managerial <target>competence</target> to lead the team.", "translation": "無論候選人的學位如何，委員會專注於他是否具備領導團隊所需的管理能力。", "explanation": "名詞「能力」。"}], "related_forms": ["competent"]}

{"headword": "competent", "explanation": "形容詞「有能力的、勝任的」。描述一個人具備足夠的技能或知識來做好某件事。注意與 capable 的區別：competent 強調的是達到標準的合格程度，而 capable 強調的是潛力或可能性。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The school is looking for a <target>competent</target> English teacher who can effectively manage the classroom and inspire students to learn.", "translation": "學校正在尋找一位有能力的英文老師，能有效地管理教室並激勵學生學習。", "explanation": "形容詞「有能力的」。指達到合格標準的技能水平。"}, {"sentence": "Although he is a <target>competent</target> driver, he still prefers to take the subway to avoid the stress of heavy city traffic.", "translation": "儘管他是一位合格的駕駛員，他仍然偏好搭乘地鐵，以避免市中心繁忙交通的壓力。", "explanation": "形容詞「合格的」。"}, {"sentence": "The company needs a <target>competent</target> assistant who can handle multiple tasks simultaneously and organize the office schedule efficiently.", "translation": "公司需要一位有能力的助理，能同時處理多項任務並高效地組織辦公室的行程。", "explanation": "形容詞「勝任的」。"}, {"sentence": "After years of training, she became a <target>competent</target> swimmer, capable of competing in the school's annual swimming competition.", "translation": "經過多年的訓練，她變成了一位合格的游泳者，能夠在學校的年度游泳競賽中參賽。", "explanation": "形容詞「有能力的」。"}], "related_forms": ["competence"]}

{"headword": "complexity", "explanation": "名詞「複雜性」。指事物由許多相互關聯的部分組成，因此難以理解或處理。常用形容詞搭配 high complexity (高複雜度)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <target>complexity</target> of the new tax law made it difficult for small business owners to understand their financial obligations.", "translation": "新稅法的複雜性使得小企業主很難理解他們的財務義務。", "explanation": "名詞「複雜性」。指事物結構複雜而難以處理。"}, {"sentence": "The high <target>complexity</target> of the modern computer chip design requires engineers to use advanced software to simulate the hardware's performance.", "translation": "現代電腦晶片設計的高複雜度，要求工程師使用先進的軟體來模擬硬體的性能。", "explanation": "名詞「複雜性」。搭配 high complexity。"}, {"sentence": "Due to the <target>complexity</target> of the biological processes involved, the researchers had to spend several years conducting detailed experiments.", "translation": "由於涉及的生物過程的複雜性，研究人員不得不花費數年時間進行詳細的實驗。", "explanation": "名詞「複雜性」。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher explained the <target>complexity</target> of the historical event by breaking it down into several simple points for the students to understand.", "translation": "老師透過將歷史事件的複雜性分解為幾個簡單的要點，讓學生能夠理解。", "explanation": "名詞「複雜性」。"}], "related_forms": ["complex"]}

{"headword": "compliance", "explanation": "名詞「遵守、服從」。指按照法律、規則或指令行事。常用搭配 in compliance with (遵守...)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The factory was shut down for a week because its waste disposal system was not <pattern>in</pattern> <target>compliance</target> <pattern>with</pattern> environmental regulations.", "translation": "這間工廠被關閉了一週，因為其廢棄物處理系統不符合環境法規。", "explanation": "名詞「遵守」。常用片語 in compliance with (遵守/符合)。"}, {"sentence": "To ensure the safety of the building, all residents must act <pattern>in</pattern> <target>compliance</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the fire safety guidelines provided by the city.", "translation": "為了確保建築物的安全，所有住戶必須遵守城市提供的消防安全指南。", "explanation": "名詞「遵守」。"}, {"sentence": "The company's failure to maintain <target>compliance</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the labor laws led to a huge fine from the government.", "translation": "該公司未能維持對勞工法的遵守，導致政府開出巨額罰單。", "explanation": "名詞「遵守」。"}, {"sentence": "Medical professionals emphasize the importance of patient <target>compliance</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the prescribed medication schedule to ensure a full recovery.", "translation": "醫療專業人士強調病患對處方藥物服用計劃的遵守之重要性，以確保完全康復。", "explanation": "名詞「遵守」。"}], "related_forms": ["comply"]}
