{"headword":"complication","explanation":"名詞，意為「複雜化」或「併發症」。在醫療語境中，常用於描述手術或疾病後出現的額外問題；在一般語境中，則指使情況變得更複雜的因素。注意與 complex (形容詞) 的區別：complex 描述事物的結構複雜，而 complication 側重於「產生了複雜的局面」或「額外的困難」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctor explained that while the surgery was successful, some <target>complications</target> might arise during the recovery process.","translation":"醫生解釋說，雖然手術成功了，但在康復過程中可能會出現一些併發症。","explanation":"名詞「併發症」。指疾病或治療過程中出現的新問題。"},{"sentence":"Adding a new set of rules to the project created an unexpected <target>complication</target>, delaying the final deadline by two weeks.","translation":"為計畫增加一套新規則造成了意想不到的複雜情況，使最終截止日期延後了兩週。","explanation":"名詞「複雜化、困難」。指使事情變得困難的因素。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer warned his client that any <target>complications</target> in the contract could lead to expensive legal battles in the future.","translation":"律師警告他的客戶，合約中的任何複雜之處都可能導致未來昂貴的法律爭端。","explanation":"名詞「複雜之處」。"}],"related_forms":["complicate","complicated"]}

{"headword":"compliment","explanation":"名詞「稱讚」；動詞「稱讚」。注意與 complement (補足/互補) 的拼法區分：compliment 是關於讚美 (praise)，而 complement 是關於使完整 (complete)。常見搭配：pay someone a compliment (稱讚某人)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher <target>complimented</target> the student <pattern>on</pattern> her excellent presentation, which gave her more confidence for the next project.","translation":"老師稱讚這位學生出色的簡報，這讓她在下一個計畫中更有信心。","explanation":"動詞「稱讚」。常用搭配：compliment someone on something。"},{"sentence":"It is always a good idea to <pattern>pay</pattern> someone a <target>compliment</target> when they have put a lot of effort into their work.","translation":"當他人對工作投入大量心血時，稱讚他們總是一個好主意。","explanation":"名詞「稱讚」。常用片語 pay someone a compliment。"},{"sentence":"She received several <target>compliments</target> on her new dress during the graduation party, making her feel very special.","translation":"在畢業派對上，她的新洋裝得到了許多稱讚，讓她覺得自己很特別。","explanation":"名詞「稱讚」。"},{"sentence":"The chef was happy to see that the guests <target>complimented</target> the taste of the dessert throughout the evening.","translation":"主廚很高興地看到客人在整個晚上都稱讚甜點的味道。","explanation":"動詞「稱讚」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"comply","explanation":"動詞「遵守；服從」。核心搭配為 comply with。注意與 obey 的區別：obey 較常用於服從權威或指令 (如 obey parents)；comply 則更常用於遵守法律、規則或標準 (如 comply with regulations)。","entries":[{"sentence":"All students must <target>comply</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the school's dress code to maintain a professional atmosphere on campus.","translation":"所有學生必須遵守學校的著裝規定，以維持校園內的專業氛圍。","explanation":"動詞「遵守」。常用搭配：comply with rules/regulations。"},{"sentence":"The company was fined heavily because it failed to <target>comply</target> <pattern>with</pattern> safety standards in the factory.","translation":"該公司因未能遵守工廠的安全標準而被處以巨額罰款。","explanation":"動詞「遵守」。指符合法律或規定的要求。"},{"sentence":"If you do not <target>comply</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the terms of the agreement, the contract will be canceled immediately.","translation":"如果你不遵守協議條款，合約將立即被取消。","explanation":"動詞「遵守」。常用於法律合約語境。"}],"related_forms":["compliance","compliant"]}

{"headword":"component","explanation":"名詞「元件；成分；構成部分」；形容詞「組成部分的」。常指一個大系統中不可或缺的小部分。常見搭配：key component (關鍵組成部分), essential component (必要成分)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The engine is made of many small <target>components</target>, and if one fails, the entire machine might stop working.","translation":"引擎由許多小零件組成，如果其中一個失效，整個機器可能會停止運作。","explanation":"名詞「元件、零件」。指機械或電子設備的組成部分。"},{"sentence":"Trust is a <pattern>key</pattern> <target>component</target> of any healthy relationship, allowing partners to feel safe and supported.","translation":"信任是任何健康關係的關鍵組成部分，讓伴侶感到安全且受到支持。","explanation":"名詞「組成部分」。指抽象概念的構成要素。"},{"sentence":"The scientist analyzed every <target>component</target> of the chemical mixture to identify which substance caused the reaction.","translation":"科學家分析了化學混合物的每個成分，以確定哪種物質引起了反應。","explanation":"名詞「成分」。指物質的組成。"},{"sentence":"The <target>component</target> parts of the computer must be compatible with each other for the system to run smoothly.","translation":"電腦的組成零件必須彼此相容，系統才能順暢運行。","explanation":"形容詞「組成部分的」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"compound","explanation":"名詞「化合物；複合物；圍牆區域」；動詞「使惡化；混合」；形容詞「複合的」。注意其在不同語境下的巨大差異：化學中指 compound (化合物)，在社會問題中，compound the problem 指「使問題更嚴重」。","entries":[{"sentence":"In chemistry class, students learned how to create a <target>compound</target> by combining two different elements under high heat.","translation":"在化學課上，學生學習了如何在高溫下將兩種不同元素結合來製造化合物。","explanation":"名詞「化合物」。指由兩種或多種化學元素組成的物質。"},{"sentence":"The governor's refusal to apologize only <target>compounded</target> the anger of the public, leading to more protests.","translation":"州長拒絕道歉只會加劇公眾的憤怒，導致更多的抗議活動。","explanation":"動詞「使惡化」。常用於描述問題、危機或痛苦的加劇。"},{"sentence":"The military officers lived within a secure <target>compound</target> that was surrounded by high walls and guarded 24 hours a day.","translation":"軍官們住在一個安全的圍牆區域內，周圍有高牆並全天候有警衛看守。","explanation":"名詞「圍牆區域」。指被圍起來的建築群。"},{"sentence":"English learners often study <target>compound</target> adjectives, such as well-known or old-fashioned, to describe people and things more precisely.","translation":"英語學習者經常學習複合形容詞，例如 well-known 或 old-fashioned，以便更精確地描述人或物。","explanation":"形容詞「複合的」。指由兩個或多個詞組成的。"},{"sentence":"To make the drink taste better, the chef decided to <target>compound</target> several different spices into a single sauce.","translation":"為了讓飲料味道更好，廚師決定將幾種不同的香料混合成一種醬汁。","explanation":"動詞「混合」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"comprehend","explanation":"動詞「理解；領悟」。比 understand 更正式，且通常指對複雜概念、深奧理論或他人情感的全面理解。常用於否定句中，表示「無法想像」或「無法理解」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The quantum physics lecture was so complex that many students struggled to <target>comprehend</target> the core theories.","translation":"這場量子物理講座太複雜了，許多學生很難理解其核心理論。","explanation":"動詞「理解」。指對複雜知識的領悟。"},{"sentence":"I simply cannot <target>comprehend</target> why some people would treat animals so cruelly despite knowing the pain they cause.","translation":"我實在無法理解為什麼有些人明知會造成痛苦卻仍如此殘忍地對待動物。","explanation":"動詞「理解/想像」。常用於對某種行為感到不可理喻時。"},{"sentence":"To fully <target>comprehend</target> the history of the war, one must read accounts from both the winners and the losers.","translation":"為了充分理解戰爭的歷史，一個人必須閱讀勝利者和失敗者的記錄。","explanation":"動詞「全面理解」。"}],"related_forms":["comprehension","comprehensible"]}

{"headword":"comprehension","explanation":"名詞「理解力；領悟」。在學術語境中，最常見於 reading comprehension (閱讀理解) 或 listening comprehension (聽力理解)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The English exam includes a section on reading <target>comprehension</target> to test if students can identify the main idea of a text.","translation":"英文考試包含一個閱讀理解部分，以測試學生是否能識別文本的主旨。","explanation":"名詞「閱讀理解」。指對文章內容的理解能力。"},{"sentence":"Due to the loud noise in the classroom, the student's <target>comprehension</target> of the teacher's instructions was very poor.","translation":"由於教室裡的噪音很大，該學生對老師指令的理解力很差。","explanation":"名詞「理解力」。"},{"sentence":"The child's language <target>comprehension</target> is usually more advanced than his ability to speak clearly in full sentences.","translation":"孩子的語言理解能力通常比他用完整句子清晰表達的能力更強。","explanation":"名詞「理解力」。"}],"related_forms":["comprehend","comprehensible"]}

{"headword":"comprise","explanation":"動詞「包含；由...組成」。注意其用法：A comprises B (A 包含 B)，或是 B comprise A (B 組成了 A)。在被動用法 be comprised of 時，意思與 be composed of 相同，意為「由...組成」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new apartment <target>comprises</target> three bedrooms, a spacious living room, and a modern kitchen for the family.","translation":"這間新公寓包含三間臥室、一個寬敞的客廳和一個為家庭設計的現代化廚房。","explanation":"動詞「包含」。指整體包含哪些部分。"},{"sentence":"The committee is <target>comprised</target> <pattern>of</pattern> ten experts from different fields, including biology, chemistry, and environmental science.","translation":"該委員會由來自生物學、化學和環境科學等不同領域的十位專家組成。","explanation":"動詞片語 be comprised of (由...組成)。"},{"sentence":"These five small islands <target>comprise</target> the entire archipelago, attracting thousands of tourists every summer.","translation":"這五個小島組成了整個群島，每年夏天吸引數千名遊客。","explanation":"動詞「組成」。指部分構成整體。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"compromise","explanation":"名詞「妥協；讓步」；動詞「妥協；損害/危險」。動詞用法中，「損害」 (endanger) 是 GSAT 常考的高階用法，例如 compromise national security (損害國家安全) 或 compromise one's principles (違背原則)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After hours of arguing, the two companies finally reached a <target>compromise</target> that satisfied both parties involved.","translation":"經過數小時的爭論，兩家公司最終達成了一項令參與雙方都滿意的妥協方案。","explanation":"名詞「妥協」。指雙方各讓一步而達成的協議。"},{"sentence":"The politician refused to <target>compromise</target> his values, even when he was under pressure to win more votes.","translation":"這位政治家拒絕在價值觀上妥協，即使他在贏得更多選票的壓力之下。","explanation":"動詞「妥協；讓步」。"},{"sentence":"Leaking the secret password could <target>compromise</target> the entire network's security, allowing hackers to steal private data.","translation":"洩漏秘密密碼可能會損害整個網路的安全，讓駭客能夠盜取私人數據。","explanation":"動詞「損害、危及」。指使某物處於危險或易受攻擊的狀態。"},{"sentence":"The captain realized that if he stayed to save the cargo, he might <target>compromise</target> the safety of his crew.","translation":"船長意識到如果他留在原地救貨物，可能會危及船員的安全。","explanation":"動詞「危及」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"compulsory","explanation":"形容詞「強制性的；義務的」。常考搭配：compulsory education (義務教育)。注意與 optional (可選擇的) 形成反義關係。","entries":[{"sentence":"In many countries, primary education is <target>compulsory</target>, meaning every child must attend school until a certain age.","translation":"在許多國家，初等教育是強制性的，這意味著每個孩子在達到一定年齡前都必須就學。","explanation":"形容詞「強制性的」。常用於教育或法律規定。"},{"sentence":"While the history class is <target>compulsory</target>, students can choose optional courses like photography or drama for fun.","translation":"雖然歷史課是必修的，但學生可以選擇攝影或戲劇等選修課程來增加樂趣。","explanation":"形容詞「必修的」。指必須參加的課程。"},{"sentence":"Wearing a helmet is <target>compulsory</target> for all cyclists in this city to reduce the risk of head injuries.","translation":"在這座城市，所有騎自行車的人都必須強制配戴頭盔，以降低頭部受傷的風險。","explanation":"形容詞「強制性的」。"}],"related_forms":["compulsion","compulsorily"]}

{"headword": "conceal", "explanation": "動詞「隱瞞、隱藏」。常指刻意不讓他人知道真相，或物理上遮掩某物使其不被看見。比 hide 更正式，常出現在法律、犯罪或嚴肅文學語境中，如 conceal weapons (攜帶暗器/隱藏武器)、conceal the truth (隱瞞真相)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The suspect tried to <target>conceal</target> <pattern>the truth</pattern> about where he had been on the night of the crime to avoid being arrested.", "translation": "嫌疑犯試圖隱瞞他在犯罪之夜身在何處的真相，以避免被逮捕。", "explanation": "動詞「隱瞞」。常用搭配 conceal the truth，指刻意不讓他人知道事實。"}, {"sentence": "The spy wore a heavy coat to <target>conceal</target> a small camera hidden in his pocket, allowing him to take photos secretly.", "translation": "間諜穿著一件厚外套來隱藏他口袋裡的小相機，讓他能秘密地拍照。", "explanation": "動詞「隱藏」。指物理上的遮掩、掩蓋，不讓物品外露。"}, {"sentence": "Despite her professional appearance, the young lawyer tried to <target>conceal</target> her nervousness during the first high-profile case she handled.", "translation": "儘管她外表專業，這位年輕律師在處理她的第一個高知名度案件時，試圖掩飾她的緊張感。", "explanation": "動詞「掩飾；隱瞞」。指控制面部表情或行為以隱藏心理狀態、情感。"}, {"sentence": "The dense forest and thick fog <target>concealed</target> the small village from view, making it difficult for the rescue team to locate the residents.", "translation": "茂密的森林和濃霧隱藏了這個小村莊，使其難以被看見，導致救援隊難以定位住戶。", "explanation": "動詞「遮蔽；隱藏」。指自然自然景觀或環境造成的物理阻隔。"}], "related_forms": ["concealment"]}

{"headword": "concede", "explanation": "動詞「承認、讓步」。常用於在爭論或競爭中，儘管不情願，但不得不承認某事為真。常考片語 concede defeat (承認失敗)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After the final vote count was completed, the candidate finally <target>conceded</target> <pattern>defeat</pattern> and congratulated his opponent on winning the election.", "translation": "在最終計票完成後，候選人終於承認失敗，並祝賀對手贏得選舉。", "explanation": "動詞片語 concede defeat 表示「承認失敗」。"}, {"sentence": "Although she didn't want to admit it, she had to <target>concede</target> <pattern>that</pattern> her opponent's argument was more logical and better supported by evidence.", "translation": "儘管她不想承認，但她不得不承認對手的論點更具邏輯性且有更多證據支持。", "explanation": "動詞「承認」。常用於指不得不承認某個事實或觀點。"}, {"sentence": "The team captain <target>conceded</target> <pattern>a goal</pattern> and then immediately began to organize the team's defense to prevent further losses.", "translation": "隊長承認（讓步）了一個進球，然後立即開始組織團隊的防禦，以防止進一步的損失。", "explanation": "動詞「讓步」。在體育比賽中指失分。"}, {"sentence": "During the debate, the politician <target>conceded</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the new policy was not as effective as he had initially promised, admitting a mistake.", "translation": "在辯論中，這位政治家承認了新政策並不像他最初承諾的那樣有效，且承認了一個錯誤。", "explanation": "動詞「承認」。"}], "related_forms": ["concession"]}

{"headword":"conceive","explanation":"動詞「構思、想像；懷孕」。在 GSAT 中，常考「構思」或「想像」之意。常用片語 conceive of (想像/構思)。注意與 perceive (感知) 的區別：conceive 強調的是在心中創造或形成一個想法，而 perceive 側重於透過感官或理解來接收資訊。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is difficult for some people to <target>conceive</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a world without the internet, as it has become an essential part of daily life.","translation":"對某些人來說，很難想像一個沒有網路的世界，因為網路已成為日常生活的一部分。","explanation":"動詞片語 conceive of sth 表示「想像某事」。"},{"sentence":"The architect spent several months trying to <target>conceive</target> <pattern>a new design</pattern> for the city's library that combined modern style with traditional elements.","translation":"建築師花了好幾個月試圖為城市的圖書館構思一個新設計，將現代風格與傳統元素結合。","explanation":"動詞「構思」。指在心中形成一個計畫或想法。"},{"sentence":"The couple had been trying to <target>conceive</target> <pattern>a child</pattern> for years before they finally succeeded with the help of medical treatment.","translation":"這對夫婦多年來一直嘗試懷孕，最後在醫療治療的幫助下終於成功了。","explanation":"動詞「懷孕」。"}],"related_forms":["concept","conception","conceivable"]}

{"headword":"conception","explanation":"名詞「觀念、概念；懷孕」。常考「觀念/概念」之意。常用片語 a general conception of (對...的概括觀念)。注意與 concept (概念) 的區別：concept 通常指一個抽象的理論、原則或通用定義，而 conception 指的是個人或群體對某事物的理解或看法。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher's explanation helped students develop a clearer <target>conception</target> <pattern>of</pattern> how the economic system works in a globalized world.","translation":"老師的解釋幫助學生們對全球化世界中經濟系統如何運作建立了更清晰的觀念。","explanation":"名詞「觀念」。指對某事物的理解或看法。"},{"sentence":"The doctor explained that the baby's development begins immediately after <target>conception</target>, as cells divide and grow rapidly.","translation":"醫生解釋說，胎兒的發展始於受孕後立即開始，因為細胞會迅速分裂並生長。","explanation":"名詞「受孕」。指生物學上的受孕過程。"}],"related_forms":["conceive","conceptual"]}

{"headword":"condemn","explanation":"動詞「譴責、強烈批評；判定...不可用」。常用於正式場合，如政府對另一國家的行為進行譴責。常考搭配：condemn someone for something (因某事而譴責某人)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The United Nations issued a statement to <target>condemn</target> the violent attacks on innocent civilians during the recent conflict in the region.","translation":"聯合國發表聲明，譴責近期該地區衝突期間對無辜平民的暴力攻擊。","explanation":"動詞「譴責」。指強烈批評某人的行為是不道德或錯誤的。"},{"sentence":"Many people <target>condemned</target> the company <pattern>for</pattern> its lack of environmental protection, leading to a boycott of its products worldwide.","translation":"許多人譴責該公司缺乏環境保護，導致其產品在全世界被抵制。","explanation":"動詞「譴責」。常用片語 condemn someone for sth。"},{"sentence":"The building was <target>condemned</target> <pattern>by</pattern> the city council after the earthquake, as it was no longer safe for people to live in.","translation":"這棟建築在地震後被市議會判定為不可用，因為它已不再安全，不能讓人居住。","explanation":"動詞「判定不可用」。指官方判定某物（通常是房屋）因危險而不能使用。"}],"related_forms":["condemnation"]}

{"headword":"conduct","explanation":"動詞「執行、進行；領導、指揮」。名詞「行為、操守」。注意：作為動詞時，重音在第二個音節 (con-DUCT)；作為名詞時，重音在第一個音節 (CON-duct)。常用片語 conduct a survey/study (進行調查/研究)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The research team decided to <target>conduct</target> <pattern>a survey</pattern> to collect data on how many students use social media for studying.","translation":"研究團隊決定進行一項調查，以收集關於有多少學生使用社群媒體學習的數據。","explanation":"動詞「進行」。常用搭配 conduct a survey/study/experiment。"},{"sentence":"The famous conductor spent hours teaching the orchestra how to <target>conduct</target> the symphony with precision and emotion.","translation":"著名的指揮家花了好幾個小時教管弦樂團如何精確且有感情地指揮這首交響曲。","explanation":"動詞「指揮」。指音樂上的指揮。"},{"sentence":"The school board criticized the student's <target>conduct</target> during the class trip, as he had repeatedly ignored the teacher's instructions.","translation":"學校董事會批評該學生在班級旅行期間的行為，因為他多次無視老師的指令。","explanation":"名詞「行為、操守」。指個人在特定情況下的行為方式。"}],"related_forms":["conductor"]}

{"headword": "confession", "explanation": "名詞「供認、坦白、交代」。指承認自己的錯誤、罪行或隱瞞的事實。常見動詞搭配為 make a confession (做出交代/坦白) 或 sign a confession (簽署供詞)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After hours of questioning by the police, the suspect finally <pattern>made</pattern> a <target>confession</target>, admitting that he had stolen the money from the bank.", "translation": "經過警方數小時的詢問後，嫌疑犯終於坦白，承認他從銀行偷了錢。", "explanation": "名詞「供認；坦白」。make a confession 為常用片語，表示做出招供或坦白。"}, {"sentence": "The girl felt a sense of relief after her <target>confession</target>, admitting to her parents about the broken vase, even though she knew she would be punished.", "translation": "在向父母坦白弄碎花瓶後，女孩感到一種解脫感，儘僅她知道自己會被處罰。", "explanation": "名詞「坦白」。指在日常生活中向親友承認錯誤。"}, {"sentence": "The lawyer argued that the <target>confession</target> <pattern>of the suspect</pattern> was coerced by the police and should therefore be considered invalid in court.", "translation": "律師辯稱嫌疑犯的供詞是受到警方強迫而得出的，因此在法庭上應被視為無效。", "explanation": "名詞「供認」。指法律上有法律效力的正式供詞（confession of the suspect）。"}, {"sentence": "In a moment of guilt, the student <pattern>made</pattern> a <target>confession</target> <pattern>to</pattern> his teacher about the answers he had secretly copied from the internet.", "translation": "在內疚的一刻，這個學生向老師坦白了他在考試期間秘密從網路上複製的答案。", "explanation": "名詞「坦白」。make a confession to someone 表示向某人坦承某事。"}], "related_forms": ["confess"]}

{"headword": "confidential", "explanation": "形容詞「機密的、保密的」。常用於指正式文件或資訊，不應被公開。常考搭配：confidential information (機密資訊), in confidence (秘密地)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The lawyer told his client that all the information provided during the meeting would be kept <target>confidential</target> and not shared with anyone.", "translation": "律師告訴他的客戶，會議期間提供的所有資訊將被保密，不會與任何人分享。", "explanation": "形容詞「保密的」。指資訊不應被公開。"}, {"sentence": "Employees are required to sign a <target>confidential</target> <pattern>agreement</pattern> to ensure they do not leak company secrets to their competitors.", "translation": "員工被要求簽署一份保密協議，以確保他們不會將公司秘密洩漏給競爭對手。", "explanation": "形容詞「機密的」。常用搭配 confidential agreement (保密協議)。"}, {"sentence": "The government official handled the <target>confidential</target> <pattern>documents</pattern> with extreme care to prevent sensitive national security secrets from leaking to the press.", "translation": "政府官員極其小心地處理機密文件，以防止敏感的國家安全機密洩漏給媒體。", "explanation": "形容詞「機密的」。搭配 confidential documents。"}, {"sentence": "The manager spoke to the employee <pattern>in</pattern> <target>confidence</target>, promising that the personal details of the matter would not be revealed to other staff.", "translation": "經理秘密地與員工交談，承諾此事之個人細節不會被透露給其他職員。", "explanation": "使用名詞形式作為片語 in confidence，表示「秘密地」。"}], "related_forms": ["confidentiality", "confident"]}

{"headword": "confine", "explanation": "動詞「限制、禁閉」。常用於指將某人或某物限制在一個特定的空間或範圍內。常用片語 confine someone to (將某人禁閉在.../將某人限制在...)", "entries": [{"sentence": "Due to the heavy rain and strong winds, the students were <target>confined</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the classroom for their lunch break, unable to go outside.", "translation": "由於大雨和強風，學生們在午休時間被限制在教室內，無法外出。", "explanation": "動詞「限制」。指將人或物限制在特定空間。"}, {"sentence": "Please <target>confine</target> your comments <pattern>to</pattern> the topic of the discussion, so that we can finish the meeting on time.", "translation": "請將您的評論限制在討論的主題範圍內，以便我們能準時結束會議。", "explanation": "動詞「限制」。指將討論範圍限制在特定主題。"}, {"sentence": "The patient was <target>confined</target> <pattern>to</pattern> a wheelchair for several months after the serious car accident, but he gradually regained some mobility.", "translation": "在嚴重車禍後，該患者被限制在輪椅上數月，但隨後逐漸恢復了一些行動能力。", "explanation": "動詞「限制」。指將人限制在特定醫療設備或狀態中。"}, {"sentence": "Wild animals should not be <target>confined</target> in small cages for long periods, as it can cause them significant psychological stress.", "translation": "野生動物不應長時間被限制在小籠子裡，因為這會給他們帶來巨大的心理壓力。", "explanation": "動詞「禁閉/限制」。指將動物限制在狹小空間。"}], "related_forms": ["confinement"]}

{"headword": "conform", "explanation": "動詞「遵守、符合、一致」。常用於指行為符合社會規範或法律。常用片語 conform to (遵守/符合)。注意與 comply 與 abide by 的區別：conform to 側重於指行為符合某種標準或產品產品規格，而 comply with 或 abide by 則更側重於指遵守法律、規則或校規。", "entries": [{"sentence": "New students often feel pressure to <target>conform</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the social norms of the school, as they want to be accepted by their classmates.", "translation": "新生往往感到壓力，想要遵守學校的社交規範，由於他們想被同學接受。", "explanation": "動詞片語 conform to sth 表示「遵守/符合」社會規範或標準。"}, {"sentence": "The company's new products must <target>conform</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the safety standards of the international market to be sold globally.", "translation": "該公司的新產品必須符合國際市場的安全標準才能在全球銷售。", "explanation": "動詞「符合」。指產品符合特定的技術或產品規格。"}, {"sentence": "Some teenagers try to <target>conform</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the latest fashion trends to fit in with their peer group and avoid being mocked.", "translation": "一些青少年試圖遵循最新的時尚趨勢，以融入其同儕群體並避免被嘲笑。", "explanation": "動詞「遵守」。指行為符合主流趨勢。"}, {"sentence": "The building's architectural design does not <target>conform</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the local zoning laws, which may lead to serious legal issues for the owner.", "translation": "該建築的建築設計不符合當地分區法，這可能會給業主帶來嚴重的法律問題。", "explanation": "動詞「符合」。指設計符合法律規範。"}], "related_forms": ["conformity", "conformist"]}

{"headword":"confront","explanation":"動詞「面對、對質」。常用於面對困難、問題或與人對質。常考搭配：confront a problem (面對問題), confront someone with something (拿...與某人對質)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student decided to <target>confront</target> the teacher <pattern>with</pattern> the evidence of the mistake in the textbook, hoping for a correction.","translation":"這名學生決定拿著課本中錯誤的證據與老師對質，希望能得到修正。","explanation":"動詞「對質」。搭配 confront someone with something。"},{"sentence":"When you <target>confront</target> a difficult challenge in life, it is important to stay calm and think logically to find a solution.","translation":"當你在生活中面對困難的挑戰時，保持冷靜並邏輯清晰地思考以尋找解決方案是很重要的。","explanation":"動詞「面對」。指面對不愉快或困難的情況。"},{"sentence":"The city council must <target>confront</target> the growing issue of air pollution to protect the health of all citizens living in the area.","translation":"市議會必須面對日益嚴重的空氣污染問題，以保護該地區所有市民的健康。","explanation":"動詞「面對」。常用搭配：confront an issue/problem。"}],"related_forms":["confronts","confronted","confronting"]}

{"headword":"confrontation","explanation":"名詞「對峙、衝突」。通常指兩方之間激烈的爭論或對立。常用搭配：avoid a confrontation (避免衝突), violent confrontation (暴力衝突)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two athletes had a heated <target>confrontation</target> on the field after a disputed call by the referee, but they soon shook hands.","translation":"在裁判做出爭議判決後，兩名運動員在場上發生了激烈的對峙，但他們很快就握手言和。","explanation":"名詞「對峙」。指兩者之間激烈的爭論。"},{"sentence":"The diplomat worked hard to <pattern>avoid</pattern> a direct <target>confrontation</target> between the two countries to maintain global peace and stability.","translation":"外交官努力地避免兩國之間直接的衝突，以維持全球和平與穩定。","explanation":"名詞「衝突」。搭配 avoid a confrontation。"},{"sentence":"After weeks of tension, the final <target>confrontation</target> between the hero and the villain took place in the middle of the dark forest.","translation":"經過數週的緊張局勢，英雄與反派之間的最終對決在黑暗森林的中間發生了。","explanation":"名詞「對決」。指兩方勢力之間的最終對抗。"}],"related_forms":["confront"]}

{"headword":"consecutive","explanation":"形容詞「連續的」。指事情接連發生，中間沒有間斷。常用搭配：consecutive days/years/wins (連續的天數/年份/勝場)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The basketball team won five <target>consecutive</target> <pattern>games</pattern>, making them the strongest contender for the championship this year.","translation":"這支籃球隊連續贏了五場比賽，使他們成為今年奪冠的最強競爭者。","explanation":"形容詞「連續的」。搭配 consecutive games。"},{"sentence":"It rained for three <target>consecutive</target> <pattern>days</pattern>, causing the local river to overflow and flood the nearby farmland.","translation":"連續三天都在下雨，導致當地河流氾濫並淹沒了附近的農田。","explanation":"形容詞「連續的」。搭配 consecutive days。"},{"sentence":"The company has reported an increase in profits for four <target>consecutive</target> <pattern>years</pattern>, attracting many new investors from around the world.","translation":"這間公司連續四年獲利增加，吸引了許多來自世界各地的投資者。","explanation":"形容詞「連續的」。搭配 consecutive years。"}],"related_forms":["consecutively"]}

{"headword":"consensus","explanation":"名詞「共識」。指群體中大多數人達成的一致意見。常用片語：reach a consensus (達成共識), general consensus (普遍共識)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After hours of intense debate, the committee finally <pattern>reached</pattern> a <target>consensus</target> on the new school uniform policy.","translation":"經過數小時的激烈辯論，委員會終於就新校服政策達成了共識。","explanation":"名詞「共識」。搭配 reach a consensus。"},{"sentence":"There is a <pattern>general</pattern> <target>consensus</target> among scientists that global warming is caused by human activities and carbon emissions.","translation":"科學家之間存在一個普遍共識，即全球暖化是由人類活動和碳排放引起的。","explanation":"名詞「共識」。搭配 general consensus。"},{"sentence":"The team spent the entire afternoon trying to find a <target>consensus</target> regarding which project topic they should choose for the science fair.","translation":"團隊花了一整個下午試圖就他們應該為科學展選擇哪個專題題目達成共識。","explanation":"名詞「共識」。指一致的意見。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"consent","explanation":"名詞「同意」；動詞「同意」。常用搭配：with the consent of (在...的同意下), give consent (給予同意), by mutual consent (經由雙方同意)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teenager was not allowed to go on the school trip unless she <target>consented</target> to follow all the safety rules.","translation":"除非這名青少年同意遵守所有安全規則，否則她不被允許參加學校旅行。","explanation":"動詞「同意」。"},{"sentence":"The medical procedure could only be performed <pattern>with</pattern> the <target>consent</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the patient's parents, as he was still a minor.","translation":"由於該患者仍是未成年人，這項醫療程序只能在父母同意的情況下才能進行。","explanation":"名詞「同意」。搭配 with the consent of..."},{"sentence":"The two neighbors finally <target>consented</target> to divide the land between their properties, ending a long-term dispute over the boundary.","translation":"這兩個鄰居終於同意將他們之間的土地分開，結束了關於邊界的長期爭端。","explanation":"動詞「同意」。"},{"sentence":"The agreement was signed <pattern>by</pattern> <target>mutual</target> <pattern>consent</pattern>, meaning both sides were happy with the terms of the contract.","translation":"該協議是經由雙方同意而簽署的，意味著雙方對合約條款都感到滿意。","explanation":"名詞「同意」。搭配 by mutual consent。"}],"related_forms":["consenting"]}

{"headword":"conservation","explanation":"名詞「保育、保存」。常用於自然資源、環境或歷史建築的保護。常用搭配：wildlife conservation (野生動物保育), conservation area (保育區)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government established a new <target>conservation</target> <pattern>area</pattern> to protect endangered species from losing their natural habitats.","translation":"政府建立了一個新的保育區，以保護瀕危物種免於失去其自然棲息地。","explanation":"名詞「保育區」。搭配 conservation area。"},{"sentence":"Many volunteers joined the <target>conservation</target> <pattern>project</pattern> to plant trees and clean the beaches, aiming to restore the local ecosystem.","translation":"許多志工加入了保育計畫，種樹並清理海灘，旨在恢復當地的生態系統。","explanation":"名詞「保育」。搭配 conservation project。"},{"sentence":"Water <target>conservation</target> is essential in regions where droughts are common, as it ensures that enough water is available for everyone.","translation":"在乾旱頻繁的地區，節水（水資源保育）至關重要，因為它確保了每個人都有足夠的水可用。","explanation":"名詞「保育」。指資源的節約與保護。"}],"related_forms":["conserve","conservationist"]}

{"headword":"considerate","explanation":"形容詞「體貼的、周到的」。指對他人的需求或感受考慮周到。注意與 considerable (相當多的) 區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"It was very <target>considerate</target> of him to bring an umbrella for his friend, knowing that the weather forecast predicted heavy rain.","translation":"知道天氣預報預測有大雨，他給朋友帶一把傘，真是非常體貼。","explanation":"形容詞「體貼的」。"},{"sentence":"The <target>considerate</target> students always remember to lower their voices when they are studying in the library to avoid disturbing others.","translation":"體貼的學生在圖書館學習時總是記得降低聲音，以避免打擾他人。","explanation":"形容詞「體貼的」。"},{"sentence":"She is known for being <target>considerate</target> and kind, always putting the needs of others before her own in every situation.","translation":"她以體貼和善良著稱，在任何情況下總是將他人的需求置於自己之上。","explanation":"形容詞「體貼的」。"}],"related_forms":["considerately","consideration"]}

{"headword":"constitutional","explanation":"形容詞「憲法的、體質的」。名詞則指「憲法」。常用搭配：constitutional right (憲法權利), constitutional amendment (憲法修正案)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The lawyers argued that the new law was <target>constitutional</target>, meaning it did not violate any of the country's basic laws.","translation":"律師們主張這項新法律是符合憲法的，意味著它沒有違反該國的任何基本法律。","explanation":"形容詞「符合憲法的」。"},{"sentence":"Freedom of speech is considered a fundamental <target>constitutional</target> <pattern>right</pattern> in many democratic countries around the world.","translation":"言論自由在世界上許多民主國家被認為是一項基本的憲法權利。","explanation":"形容詞「憲法的」。搭配 constitutional right。"},{"sentence":"The government proposed a <target>constitutional</target> <pattern>amendment</pattern> to change the way the president is elected every four years.","translation":"政府提出了憲法修正案，以改變每四年一次總統選舉的方式。","explanation":"形容詞「憲法的」。搭配 constitutional amendment。"}],"related_forms":["constitution"]}

{"headword": "constraint", "explanation": "名詞「限制、約束」。指限制行動或選擇的條件。常用搭配：financial constraints (財務限制), time constraints (時間限制), under constraint (在強迫下)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Due to severe <pattern>financial</pattern> <target>constraints</target>, the school had to cancel the annual art exhibition and the music festival.", "translation": "由於嚴重的財務限制，學校不得不取消年度藝術展和音樂節。", "explanation": "名詞「限制」。搭配 financial constraints。"}, {"sentence": "The architect had to work within strict <pattern>time</pattern> <target>constraints</target> to finish the building before the grand opening ceremony.", "translation": "建築師必須在嚴格的時間限制下工作，以在盛大的開幕式之前完成建築物。", "explanation": "名詞「限制」。搭配 time constraints。"}, {"sentence": "The artist felt a sense of <target>constraint</target> when he was forced to use only a limited number of colors in his painting.", "translation": "藝術家在被強迫僅使用有限數量的顏色繪畫時，感到一種限制感。", "explanation": "名詞「限制、約束」。"}, {"sentence": "Many small businesses face significant <pattern>budgetary</pattern> <target>constraints</target> that prevent them from investing in the latest technology to improve efficiency.", "translation": "許多小型企業面臨著巨大的預算限制，使他們無法投資於最新的技術以提高效率。", "explanation": "名詞「限制」。搭配 budgetary constraints。"}], "related_forms": ["constrain"]}

{"headword":"consultation","explanation":"名詞「諮詢、商議」。指為了獲取建議或專業意見而進行的討論。常用搭配：in consultation with (與...商議), professional consultation (專業諮詢)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The principal decided the new school rules <pattern>in</pattern> <target>consultation</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the student council and the teachers.","translation":"校長與學生會和老師們商議後，決定了新的學校規則。","explanation":"名詞「商議」。搭配 in consultation with..."},{"sentence":"If you are feeling stressed about your future career, it is a good idea to seek a professional <target>consultation</target> from a counselor.","translation":"如果你對未來的職業感到壓力，尋求諮詢師的專業諮詢是一個好主意。","explanation":"名詞「諮詢」。指獲取專業建議。"},{"sentence":"The city council held a public <target>consultation</target> to hear the opinions of citizens regarding the construction of a new park.","translation":"市議會舉行了公眾諮詢會，以聽取市民關於建設新公園的意見。","explanation":"名詞「諮詢、商議」。指公開討論。"}],"related_forms":["consult"]}

{"headword":"consumption","explanation":"名詞，意為「消費」或「消耗」。常用於描述資源、能源或食物的量。常見搭配：mass consumption (大量消費), energy consumption (能源消耗), consumption of... (對...的消費/消耗)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government is encouraging people to reduce their energy <target>consumption</target> by using energy-efficient appliances to protect the environment.","translation":"政府正鼓勵人們使用節能電器來減少能源消耗，以保護環境。","explanation":"名詞「消耗」。指資源或能源的使用量。"},{"sentence":"Doctors warn that the excessive <target>consumption</target> <pattern>of</pattern> sugar can lead to various health problems, such as obesity and diabetes.","translation":"醫生警告說，過量攝取糖分會導致各種健康問題，例如肥胖和糖尿病。","explanation":"名詞「攝取/消費」。在此指對食物或飲品的攝取。"},{"sentence":"The rise of online shopping has significantly changed the patterns of mass <target>consumption</target> in modern society.","translation":"網路購物的興起顯著改變了現代社會的大量消費模式。","explanation":"名詞「消費」。指購買商品的行為或習慣。"}],"related_forms":["consume","consumer"]}

{"headword":"contagious","explanation":"形容詞，意為「傳染性的」或「具有感染力的」。可用於描述疾病，也可比喻地描述情緒（如笑聲、恐慌）。常用搭配：contagious disease (傳染病), contagious laughter (具感染力的笑聲)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Flu is a highly <target>contagious</target> virus, so students are advised to stay home and rest when they have a fever.","translation":"流感是一種高度傳染性的病毒，因此建議學生在發燒時留在家中休息。","explanation":"形容詞「傳染性的」。指疾病可從一人傳到另一人。"},{"sentence":"Her <target>contagious</target> laughter filled the room, making everyone feel happy and relaxed during the stressful exam period.","translation":"她那具有感染力的笑聲充滿了房間，讓每個人在壓力巨大的考試期間都感到快樂和放鬆。","explanation":"形容詞「具感染力的」。比喻用法，指情緒或行為容易影響他人。"}],"related_forms":["contagion"]}

{"headword":"contaminate","explanation":"動詞，意為「污染」。指將有害或不潔的東西加入其中，使之不純或危險。常用搭配：contaminate the environment (污染環境), contaminated water (被污染的水)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Chemical leaks from the factory have <target>contaminated</target> the local river, making the water unsafe for fish and humans.","translation":"工廠的化學洩漏污染了當地河流，使水對魚類和人類來說是不安全的。","explanation":"動詞「污染」。指使環境或物質變得不潔。"},{"sentence":"To ensure food safety, you should keep raw meat separate from vegetables to avoid <target>contaminating</target> the fresh produce.","translation":"為了確保食品安全，您應該將生肉與蔬菜分開存放，以避免污染新鮮農產品。","explanation":"動詞「污染」。在此指將細菌或有害物質傳播至其他食物。"}],"related_forms":["contamination","contaminant"]}

{"headword":"contemplate","explanation":"動詞，意為「沉思」或「考慮」。指長時間地思考某件事，或在做決定前深思熟慮。常用搭配：contemplate doing something (考慮做某事)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After graduating from high school, many students <target>contemplate</target> <pattern>whether</pattern> to study abroad or attend a local university.","translation":"高中畢業後，許多學生在沉思是否要出國留學或就讀當地大學。","explanation":"動詞「沉思/考慮」。指對未來選擇的深思熟慮。"},{"sentence":"The artist spent hours <target>contemplating</target> the blank canvas, trying to decide which colors would best express his emotions.","translation":"藝術家花了好幾個小時凝視著空白的畫布，試圖決定用哪些顏色最能表達他的情感。","explanation":"動詞「沉思/凝視」。指專注地思考或觀察。"}],"related_forms":["contemplation","contemplative"]}

{"headword":"contemporary","explanation":"形容詞「當代的、同時代的」；名詞「同時代的人」。作為形容詞時，常指現代的風格或議題。注意與 modern 的區別：contemporary 強調的是「現在這個時間點」，而 modern 則可指一個較寬的時代區間（如 modern history）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The museum features a wide collection of <target>contemporary</target> art, showcasing the creative styles of artists living today.","translation":"這家博物館展出了大量當代藝術收藏，展示了現今生活著的藝術家的創意風格。","explanation":"形容詞「當代的」。指現今時代的。"},{"sentence":"Although they lived in different countries, the two philosophers were <target>contemporaries</target>, sharing similar ideas about human nature.","translation":"儘管他們住在不同的國家，這兩位哲學家是同時代的人，對人性有著相似的看法。","explanation":"名詞「同時代的人」。指在同一時間段生活的人。"},{"sentence":"The teacher compared the traditional poems with <target>contemporary</target> literature to show how writing styles have changed over time.","translation":"老師將傳統詩歌與當代文學進行比較，以展示寫作風格隨時間如何改變。","explanation":"形容詞「同時代的/當代的」。"}],"related_forms":["contemporaneous"]}

{"headword":"contempt","explanation":"名詞，意為「輕視、蔑視」。指對某人或某事認為其不值得尊重或低劣的感覺。常用搭配：show contempt for (對...表示輕視), treat with contempt (以輕視對待)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The arrogant student spoke with <target>contempt</target> <pattern>for</pattern> those who struggled with the subject, making him unpopular among his peers.","translation":"那個傲慢的學生對那些在該科目上遇到困難的人表示輕視，這使他在同儕中不受歡迎。","explanation":"名詞「輕視」。指對他人缺乏尊重的態度。"},{"sentence":"The judge warned the lawyer that showing <target>contempt</target> <pattern>of</pattern> court would result in severe legal penalties.","translation":"法官警告律師，對法院表示輕視（藐視法庭）將導致嚴厲的法律處罰。","explanation":"名詞「輕視/藐視」。contempt of court 是法律術語，指藐視法庭。"}],"related_forms":["contemptuous","contemptible"]}

{"headword":"contend","explanation":"動詞，意為「競爭」或「主張」。當指競爭時，常用 contend with (對付/競爭)；當指主張時，常用 contend that (主張...)。注意其名詞形式 contention (爭論/主張)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two top athletes had to <target>contend</target> <pattern>with</pattern> each other for the gold medal in the final race of the Olympics.","translation":"這兩位頂尖運動員必須在奧運會的最後一場比賽中競爭金牌。","explanation":"動詞「競爭」。指兩者之間為了爭奪某物而競爭。"},{"sentence":"Some historians <target>contend</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the ancient civilization collapsed due to climate change rather than war.","translation":"一些歷史學家主張，這個古文明的崩潰是由於氣候變遷而非戰爭。","explanation":"動詞「主張」。指在爭論中提出自己的觀點。"},{"sentence":"During the hiking trip, the group had to <target>contend</target> <pattern>with</pattern> heavy rain and strong winds, making their journey difficult.","translation":"在徒步旅行期間，該團體必須面對暴雨和強風，這讓他們的旅程變得困難。","explanation":"動詞「對付/面對」。contend with 指處理困難的情況。"}],"related_forms":["contender","contention"]}

{"headword":"continental","explanation":"形容詞，意為「大陸的」或「歐洲大陸的」。常用於描述地理區域或氣候（如 continental climate 大陸性氣候）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The travel agency offers a <target>continental</target> tour package that visits several major cities across the European continent.","translation":"旅行社提供一個歐洲大陸旅遊套裝行程，將參訪歐洲大陸上的幾個主要城市。","explanation":"形容詞「大陸的」。指與歐洲大陸相關的。"},{"sentence":"Regions far from the ocean usually have a <target>continental</target> climate, with very hot summers and very cold winters.","translation":"遠離海洋的地區通常具有大陸性氣候，特徵是夏天非常炎熱且冬天非常寒冷。","explanation":"形容詞「大陸的」。指大陸內部氣候。"}],"related_forms":["continent"]}

{"headword":"contractor","explanation":"名詞，意為「承包商」。指與另一方簽約提供服務或工程的個人或公司。常用搭配：independent contractor (獨立承包商), general contractor (總承包商)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school hired a professional <target>contractor</target> to renovate the old science laboratory and install new equipment.","translation":"學校聘請了一位專業承包商來翻新舊的科學實驗室並安裝新設備。","explanation":"名詞「承包商」。指負責執行工程的人。"},{"sentence":"The homeowner complained that the <target>contractor</target> had not finished the kitchen renovation on time as promised in the contract.","translation":"屋主抱怨承包商沒有按照合約約定在時間內完成廚房的翻新。","explanation":"名詞「承包商」。指簽約提供服務的人。"}],"related_forms":["contract"]}

{"headword":"contradiction","explanation":"名詞，意為「矛盾」。指兩個陳述或事實之間不一致或相反的情況。常用搭配：a contradiction in terms (矛盾修辭), contradict oneself (自相矛盾)。","entries":[{"sentence":"There is a clear <target>contradiction</target> <pattern>between</pattern> the politician's promises and his actual actions after he was elected.","translation":"這位政治家在當選後的承諾與實際行動之間存在明顯的矛盾。","explanation":"名詞「矛盾」。指兩者之間的不一致。"},{"sentence":"The witness's second statement was a complete <target>contradiction</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the first one, leading the jury to doubt his honesty.","translation":"證人的第二次陳述與第一次完全矛盾，導致陪審團懷疑他的誠實。","explanation":"名詞「矛盾」。指後者否認或相反於前者。"},{"sentence":"Calling this luxury hotel a 'budget-friendly' option is a <target>contradiction</target> <pattern>in</pattern> terms, as the prices are extremely high.","translation":"將這家豪華酒店稱為「經濟實惠」的選擇是一種矛盾修辭，因為價格極高。","explanation":"名詞「矛盾」。contradiction in terms 指詞彙組合本身就矛盾。"}],"related_forms":["contradict"]}

{"headword":"controversial","explanation":"形容詞「有爭議的」。常用於描述觀點、議題或決定引起人們強烈且對立的意見。常見搭配：controversial issue/topic/decision。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government's <target>controversial</target> <pattern>decision</pattern> to build a new dam caused widespread protests from local residents and environmentalists.","translation":"政府建造新水壩的爭議性決定引起了當地居民和環保主義者的廣泛抗議。","explanation":"形容詞「有爭議的」。描述決定引起對立意見。"},{"sentence":"The professor led a lively debate on a <target>controversial</target> <pattern>topic</pattern> regarding climate change, encouraging students to analyze different perspectives.","translation":"教授針對氣候變遷這一爭議性話題引導了一場熱烈的辯論，鼓勵學生分析不同的觀點。","explanation":"形容詞「有爭議的」。常用搭配 controversial topic。"},{"sentence":"Whether students should be allowed to use AI tools for their essays is a <target>controversial</target> <pattern>issue</pattern> in many modern classrooms.","translation":"學生是否應該被允許在論文中使用 AI 工具，在許多現代教室中是一個有爭議的議題。","explanation":"形容詞「有爭議的」。常用搭配 controversial issue。"}],"related_forms":["controversially"]}

{"headword":"controversy","explanation":"名詞「爭議」。指對某事產生強烈且對立的意見的狀態。常用片語：spark/cause a controversy (引起爭議), be at the center of controversy (處於爭議中心)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The artist's latest painting <pattern>sparked</pattern> a huge <target>controversy</target> because it challenged traditional views of beauty and art.","translation":"這位藝術家的最新畫作引起了巨大的爭議，因為它挑戰了傳統的審美觀和藝術觀。","explanation":"名詞「爭議」。片語 spark a controversy 表示「引起爭議」。"},{"sentence":"The new school policy regarding smartphone use <pattern>caused</pattern> a <target>controversy</target> among students and parents, leading to several heated meetings.","translation":"學校關於手機使用的新規定引起了學生和家長的爭議，導致了幾次激烈的會議。","explanation":"名詞「爭議」。片語 cause a controversy 表示「造成爭議」。"},{"sentence":"The famous athlete was <pattern>at the center of</pattern> <target>controversy</target> after he was accused of using banned substances to improve his performance.","translation":"這位著名運動員在被指控使用禁藥提高表現後，處於爭議的中心。","explanation":"名詞「爭議」。片語 be at the center of controversy 表示「處於爭議中心」。"}],"related_forms":["controversial"]}

{"headword":"conversion","explanation":"名詞「轉換、轉變」。可指從一種形式、功能、信仰或單位到另一種的轉變。常見搭配：currency conversion (貨幣轉換), conversion rate (轉換率)。","entries":[{"sentence":"When traveling to Japan, the tourist spent some time studying <pattern>currency</pattern> <target>conversion</target> to understand how much his money was worth in yen.","translation":"去日本旅遊時，這位遊客花了一些時間研究貨幣轉換，以了解他的錢換算成日圓是多少。","explanation":"名詞「轉換」。指貨幣單位的變更。"},{"sentence":"The old warehouse was redesigned for its <target>conversion</target> <pattern>into</pattern> a modern art gallery, attracting many visitors from the city.","translation":"這座舊倉庫為了轉換成現代藝術畫廊而重新設計，吸引了許多來自城市的遊客。","explanation":"名詞「轉換」。指空間功能的轉變。常用搭配 conversion into sth。"},{"sentence":"The teacher explained the <target>conversion</target> <pattern>of</pattern> Celsius to Fahrenheit, helping students calculate the temperature change more accurately.","translation":"老師解釋了攝氏度轉華氏度的轉換方式，幫助學生更準確地計算溫度變化。","explanation":"名詞「轉換」。指測量單位的轉換。"}],"related_forms":["convert"]}

{"headword":"convert","explanation":"動詞「轉換、轉變」。指將某物從一種形式、目的或信仰變更為另一種。名詞則指「改宗者、轉向者」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school decided to <target>convert</target> the unused storage room <pattern>into</pattern> a small library to provide students with more reading space.","translation":"學校決定將不使用的儲藏室轉換成一座小圖書館，以提供學生更多閱讀空間。","explanation":"動詞「轉換」。常用搭配 convert A into B。"},{"sentence":"Many homeowners <target>convert</target> their old garages <pattern>into</pattern> home offices to create a quiet environment for working from home.","translation":"許多房主將他們的舊車庫轉換成家庭辦公室，以創造一個適合在家工作的安靜環境。","explanation":"動詞「轉換」。常用搭配 convert A into B。"},{"sentence":"After reading several books on philosophy, the young man decided to <target>convert</target> his beliefs and join a different religious group.","translation":"在閱讀了幾本關於哲學的書後，這個年輕人決定轉變他的信仰，加入另一個宗教團體。","explanation":"動詞「轉變」。指信仰的改變。"},{"sentence":"The <target>convert</target> spoke passionately about how his new faith had changed his life and given him a new sense of purpose.","translation":"這位改宗者熱情地談論他的新信仰如何改變了他的生活並給予他新的目標感。","explanation":"名詞「改宗者」。指改變信仰的人。"}],"related_forms":["conversion"]}

{"headword":"convict","explanation":"動詞「定罪、宣判有罪」。名詞「囚犯、被定罪者」。注意動詞與名詞的發音不同（動詞重音在第二音節，名詞重音在第一音節）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The jury took three days to discuss the evidence before they finally <target>convicted</target> the suspect <pattern>of</pattern> theft and fraud.","translation":"陪審團討論證據三天後，最終將該嫌疑人定為盜竊和詐騙罪。","explanation":"動詞「定罪」。常用搭配 convict someone of a crime。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer tried to present new evidence to prove that the man had been <target>convicted</target> <pattern>wrongly</pattern>, but the court rejected it.","translation":"律師試圖提供新證據證明該男子被錯誤定罪，但法院拒絕了。","explanation":"動詞「定罪」。常用搭配 be convicted of sth。"},{"sentence":"The <target>convict</target> was ordered to perform community service as part of his sentence after being found guilty of a minor offense.","translation":"這名囚犯在被判定犯有輕微罪行後，被命令執行社區服務作為其刑期的部分。","explanation":"名詞「囚犯」。指被法律定罪的人。"}],"related_forms":["conviction"]}

{"headword":"conviction","explanation":"名詞「定罪」或「堅定的信念」。指被法院判決有罪的行為或一種深植於心的強烈信念。注意區分這兩種截然不同的意義。","entries":[{"sentence":"The man had no previous <target>convictions</target> for any crimes, which led the judge to give him a lighter sentence for his first offense.","translation":"該男子此前沒有任何犯罪紀錄（定罪紀錄），這使得法官對其第一宗罪行給予較輕的刑期。","explanation":"名詞「定罪」。指法律上的定罪紀錄。"},{"sentence":"She spoke with deep <target>conviction</target>, making the audience believe that her plan to protect the environment was the only way to save the planet.","translation":"她帶著深厚的信念地說話，使聽眾相信她保護環境的計畫是拯救地球的唯一方法。","explanation":"名詞「信念」。指強烈且堅定的信念。"},{"sentence":"It is her <pattern>firm</pattern> <target>conviction</target> that every child in the world should have access to quality education regardless of their background.","translation":"她的堅定信念是，世界上每個孩子無論背景如何，都應該能夠獲得高品質的教育。","explanation":"名詞「信念」。常用搭配 firm conviction。"}],"related_forms":["convict"]}

{"headword":"coordinate","explanation":"動詞「協調、統籌」；名詞「座標」；形容詞「對等的、協調的」。在 GSAT 中，動詞用法最為常見，指安排多人或多個部分共同工作以達成目標。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student council president had to <target>coordinate</target> with the teachers and the school administration to organize the annual sports meet.","translation":"學生會會長必須與老師和學校行政部門協調，以籌備年度運動會。","explanation":"動詞「協調」。指安排多人共同工作。"},{"sentence":"To ensure the event ran smoothly, the volunteers <target>coordinated</target> their efforts to manage the crowd and guide visitors to the rest rooms.","translation":"為了確保活動順利進行，志工們協調他們的努力，以管理人群並引導遊客前往休息室。","explanation":"動詞「協調」。指同步行動。"},{"sentence":"The geography teacher asked the students to mark the exact <target>coordinates</target> of the ancient city on the map using their GPS devices.","translation":"地理老師要求學生使用 GPS 設備在地圖上標記出古城的精確座標。","explanation":"名詞「座標」。指地圖或數學上的位置。"},{"sentence":"She wore a <target>coordinated</target> outfit of a white blouse and a grey skirt, which made her look professional and elegant for the interview.","translation":"她穿了一套協調的白色上衣和灰色裙子，讓她在面試時看起來專業且優雅。","explanation":"形容詞「協調的」。指色彩或風格一致。"}],"related_forms":["coordination","coordinator"]}

{"headword":"copyright","explanation":"名詞「版權、著作權」；動詞「為...取得版權」。指法律保護的創作物所有權。常用搭配：copyright law (版權法), violate copyright (侵犯版權)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The author was shocked to find that his latest novel had been printed and sold without his permission, <pattern>violating</pattern> the <target>copyright</target> <pattern>law</pattern>.","translation":"作者驚訝地發現他的最新小說在未經他許可的情況下被印刷並銷售，侵犯了版權法。","explanation":"名詞「版權」。常用搭配 violate copyright law。"},{"sentence":"Many artists now use digital watermarks to protect their <target>copyright</target> and prevent other people from stealing their original drawings.","translation":"許多藝術家現在使用數位水印來保護他們的版權，防止他人盜用他們的原創繪畫。","explanation":"名詞「版權」。"},{"sentence":"The software company decided to <target>copyright</target> their new program to ensure that no other company could copy the source code without payment.","translation":"該軟體公司決定為其新程式取得版權，以確保沒有其他公司可以在不付費的情況下複製原始碼。","explanation":"動詞「為...取得版權」。"}],"related_forms":["copyrighted"]}

{"headword": "core", "explanation": "名詞「核心、中心」。可指物體的中心部分（如水果的果核）或事情的最重要、最基礎的部分（如核心價值）。常用搭配：core value (核心價值), core subject (核心科目)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The scientist explained that the <target>core</target> of the Earth consists mainly of iron and nickel, creating a powerful magnetic field.", "translation": "科學家解釋說，地球的核心主要由鐵和鎳組成，創造了一個強大的磁場。", "explanation": "名詞「核心」。指物理上的中心。"}, {"sentence": "English and Mathematics are considered <target>core</target> <pattern>subjects</pattern> in high school, as they provide the fundamental knowledge needed for almost every career.", "translation": "英文和數學被認為是高中的核心科目，因為它們提供了幾乎所有職業所需的基礎知識。", "explanation": "名詞（作形容詞用法）「核心」。常用搭配 core subject。"}, {"sentence": "The company's <target>core</target> <pattern>values</pattern> emphasize honesty and teamwork, which helps them build trust with their customers over the long term.", "translation": "公司的核心價值觀強調誠實和團隊合作，這幫助他們與客戶建立長期的信任。", "explanation": "名詞（作形容詞用法）「核心」。常用搭配 core value。"}, {"sentence": "After eating the apple, the boy threw the <target>core</target> into the compost bin to help the garden's soil become more fertile.", "translation": "吃完蘋果後，男孩將果核丟進堆肥桶，以幫助花園的土壤變得更肥沃。", "explanation": "名詞「果核」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "corporate", "explanation": "形容詞「公司的、企業的、法人的」。用於描述與大型公司、企業運作或整體組織相關的事物。常見搭配：corporate culture (企業文化), corporate image (企業形象), corporate social responsibility (企業社會責任)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The new employee spent the first week learning about the <target>corporate</target> <pattern>culture</pattern>, including how colleagues interact and how meetings are conducted.", "translation": "新員工在第一週學習企業文化，包括同事之間如何互動以及會議如何進行。", "explanation": "形容詞「企業的」。corporate culture 指公司的核心價值與工作氛圍。"}, {"sentence": "Many large companies now focus on <target>corporate</target> <pattern>social responsibility</pattern>, such as donating money to local charities to improve their public image.", "translation": "許多大公司現在專注於企業社會責任，例如捐款給當地慈善機構以改善其公眾形象。", "explanation": "形容詞「企業的」。corporate social responsibility (CSR) 意為企業社會責任。"}, {"sentence": "The marketing team worked hard to create a professional <target>corporate</target> <pattern>image</pattern> that would attract more investors and high-quality talent.", "translation": "translation", "explanation": "形容詞「企業的」。corporate image 指公眾對大企業的整體印象。"}, {"sentence": "The <target>corporate</target> <pattern>headquarters</pattern> are located in the center of the city, providing easy access to all the major financial districts.", "translation": "公司總部位於市中心，方便前往所有主要金融區。", "explanation": "形容詞「公司的」。corporate headquarters 意為總公司或公司總部。"}], "related_forms": ["corporation"]}

{"headword":"corporation","explanation":"名詞，意為「公司、法人、企業體」。通常指規模較大的公司，尤其是那些法律上被視為單一實體的組織。常用搭配：multinational corporation (跨國公司), government corporation (政府法人)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The multinational <target>corporation</target> expanded its business to several Asian countries to reach more customers and increase its global profits.","translation":"這家跨國公司將其業務擴展到幾個亞洲國家，以接觸更多客戶並增加其全球利潤。","explanation":"名詞「公司」。指規模巨大的企業體。"},{"sentence":"Many young graduates hope to find a stable job in a large <target>corporation</target> because of the better benefits and career growth opportunities.","translation":"許多年輕畢業生希望在大型公司中找到一份穩定的工作，因為那裡有更好的福利和職涯成長機會。","explanation":"名詞「公司」。常用於描述大型企業。"}],"related_forms":["corporate"]}

{"headword":"correlation","explanation":"名詞，意為「相關性、相互關係」。常用於學術、統計或科學語境，描述兩個變數之間是否存在聯繫。注意：correlation 不代表 causation (因果關係)，這是常見的邏輯謬誤。","entries":[{"sentence":"Researchers found a strong <target>correlation</target> <pattern>between</pattern> the amount of time students spend studying and their final exam scores.","translation":"研究人員發現學生花在學習上的時間與其期末考分數之間存在強烈的相關性。","explanation":"名詞「相關性」。常用搭配：correlation between A and B。"},{"sentence":"Although there is a <target>correlation</target> <pattern>between</pattern> ice cream sales and summer temperatures, it does not mean that ice cream causes the heat.","translation":"雖然冰淇淋的銷售額與夏季溫度之間存在相關性，但這並不意味著冰淇淋導致了高溫。","explanation":"名詞「相關性」。此處強調相關性不等於因果關係。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"correspondent","explanation":"名詞，意為「通訊員、記者」。通常指被派駐在特定地點或專門報導特定領域的記者。常用搭配：foreign correspondent (駐外記者), war correspondent (戰地記者)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The network's foreign <target>correspondent</target> reported live from the capital city to provide updates on the political crisis in the region.","translation":"該電視台的駐外記者從首都進行現場報導，以提供該地區政治危機的最新進展。","explanation":"名詞「駐外記者」。指派駐在國外的記者。"},{"sentence":"As a war <target>correspondent</target>, he traveled to dangerous conflict zones to document the reality of the war and share the stories of the victims.","translation":"作為一名戰地記者，他前往危險的衝突地區記錄戰爭的現實並分享受害者的故事。","explanation":"名詞「戰地記者」。指專門報導戰爭地區的記者。"}],"related_forms":["correspondence","correspondent"]}

{"headword":"corridor","explanation":"名詞，意為「走廊、通道」。指建築物內連接不同房間的狹長空間。常用於學校、醫院或飯店等場景。","entries":[{"sentence":"Students were told to walk quietly in the <target>corridor</target> during the class change to avoid disturbing other students who were still studying.","translation":"學生們被告知在換課期間在走廊上安靜行走，以避免打擾到仍在學習的其他學生。","explanation":"名詞「走廊」。指建築物內部的通道。"},{"sentence":"The nurse hurried down the hospital <target>corridor</target> to deliver the medicine to the patient in room 302 as quickly as possible.","translation":"護理師快步走在醫院走廊上，為了盡快將藥品送到 302 室的病人手中。","explanation":"名詞「走廊」。指醫院內部的通道。"}],"related_forms":["corridors"]}

{"headword":"corrupt","explanation":"形容詞「腐敗的、墮落的」；動詞「使腐敗、使墮落」。形容詞時常指官員收賄或不誠實；動詞時指使人失去道德或使數據損壞。常用搭配：corrupt official (腐敗官員), corrupt a file (損壞文件)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The citizens protested against the <target>corrupt</target> government, demanding transparency and honesty in the management of public funds.","translation":"公民們抗議腐敗的政府，要求在管理公共資金方面保持透明和誠實。","explanation":"形容詞「腐敗的」。指官員不誠實、收賄。"},{"sentence":"He was accused of taking bribes to <target>corrupt</target> the judicial process and ensure a favorable outcome for the wealthy businessman.","translation":"他被指控收賄以使司法程序腐敗，並確保該富商獲得有利的結果。","explanation":"動詞「使腐敗」。指使法律或制度失去公正性。"},{"sentence":"I tried to open the document, but the computer warned me that the file was <target>corrupted</target>, making it impossible to recover the data.","translation":"我想打開這份文件，但電腦警告我文件已損壞，導致無法恢復數據。","explanation":"形容詞/分詞「損壞的」。用於描述電腦文件損壞。"}],"related_forms":["corruption","corruptly"]}

{"headword":"corruption","explanation":"名詞，意為「腐敗、貪汙」。指一種不誠實或不道德的行為，特別是人們在權力位置上利用權力獲利。常用搭配：political corruption (政治腐敗), fight against corruption (打擊貪汙)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The organization works tirelessly to fight against <target>corruption</target> in the government, promoting fairness and equality for all citizens.","translation":"該組織不懈地努力打擊政府中的腐敗，促進所有公民的公平與平等。","explanation":"名詞「腐敗、貪汙」。指利用權力獲利的非法行為。"},{"sentence":"Many people believe that widespread <target>corruption</target> within the police force can lead to a loss of public trust in the legal system.","translation":"許多人認為警力內部的廣泛腐敗會導致公眾對法律系統的信任喪失。","explanation":"名詞「腐敗」。指組織內部的不誠實行為。"}],"related_forms":["corrupt"]}

{"headword":"counsel","explanation":"名詞「建議、法律顧問」；動詞「建議、勸導」。注意與 counselor (顧問/諮詢師) 的區別：counsel 作為名詞時可指建議本身，或指在法庭上的律師。動詞則是指提供建議的過程。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student sought the <target>counsel</target> <pattern>of</pattern> her school counselor to decide which elective courses would best suit her future goals.","translation":"這名學生尋求學校輔導員的建議，以決定哪些選修課程最適合她未來的目標。","explanation":"名詞「建議」。指提供給他人的指導或意見。"},{"sentence":"The judge asked the defense <target>counsel</target> to present their evidence before making a final decision on the case.","translation":"法官要求辯護律師在做出案件最終決定前提交其證據。","explanation":"名詞「法律顧問/律師」。在法律語境中，counsel 指律師。"},{"sentence":"The experienced teacher tried to <target>counsel</target> the struggling student on how to manage his time and reduce stress during the exam period.","translation":"經驗豐富的老師試圖勸導一名學習困難的學生，教他如何管理時間並在考試期間減輕壓力。","explanation":"動詞「建議、勸導」。指提供專業的指導。"}],"related_forms":["counselor","counseling"]}

{"headword":"counselor","explanation":"名詞，意為「顧問、諮詢師、輔導員」。指提供專業建議或指導的人。常用搭配：school counselor (學校輔導員), guidance counselor (指導顧問)。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you are feeling overwhelmed by the pressure of the entrance exam, you should talk to the school <target>counselor</target> for support.","translation":"如果你覺得入學考試的壓力太大，你應該找學校輔導員尋求支持。","explanation":"名詞「輔導員」。指在學校提供心理或學業指導的人。"},{"sentence":"The guidance <target>counselor</target> helped the student choose a college major that matched his interests and personal strengths.","translation":"指導顧問幫助這名學生選擇了一個符合他興趣和個人強項的大學專業。","explanation":"名詞「指導顧問」。指幫助學生規劃未來的專業人員。"}],"related_forms":["counsel"]}

{"headword":"courteous","explanation":"形容詞，意為「有禮貌的、客氣的」。比 polite 更正式，強調一種教養良好、體貼他人的態度。常用搭配：courteous behavior (有禮貌的行為), courteous treatment (禮貌的對待)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The hotel staff were extremely <target>courteous</target> and helpful, making the guests feel welcome and comfortable during their entire stay.","translation":"飯店員工非常有禮貌且樂於助人，讓客人整個入住期間感到受歡迎且舒適。","explanation":"形容詞「有禮貌的」。指態度客氣且教養良好。"},{"sentence":"It is important for sales employees to be <target>courteous</target> <pattern>to</pattern> all customers, regardless of whether they decide to buy anything.","translation":"銷售員對所有客戶保持禮貌是非常重要的，無論他們是否決定購買任何東西。","explanation":"形容詞「有禮貌的」。常用搭配：courteous to someone。"}],"related_forms":["courteously","courtesy"]}

{"headword":"coverage","explanation":"名詞，意為「報導、範圍」。在媒體語境中，指對某事件的報導；在保險語境中，指保險的承保範圍。常用搭配：media coverage (媒體報導), insurance coverage (保險承保範圍)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The presidential election received extensive media <target>coverage</target>, with news channels broadcasting the results every hour.","translation":"總統大選獲得了廣泛的媒體報導，新聞頻道每小時播報一次結果。","explanation":"名詞「報導」。指媒體對事件的描述和報導。"},{"sentence":"Before signing the contract, the traveler checked if his travel insurance provided enough <target>coverage</target> <pattern>for</pattern> medical emergencies abroad.","translation":"在簽署合約前，旅行者檢查了他的旅遊保險是否為海外醫療緊急情況提供了足夠的承保範圍。","explanation":"名詞「承保範圍」。指保險公司承保的項目和金額。"},{"sentence":"The remote mountain village suffered from a lack of mobile network <target>coverage</target>, making it difficult for residents to contact the outside world.","translation":"這個偏遠的山村缺乏行動網路訊號覆蓋範圍，導致居民很難與外界聯繫。","explanation":"名詞「覆蓋範圍」。指訊號或服務的到達範圍。"}],"related_forms":["cover"]}

{"headword":"credibility","explanation":"名詞「可信度、可信性」。常用於描述一個人、一家公司或一份報告的可靠程度。常考搭配：gain/lose credibility (獲得/失去可信度), establish credibility (建立可信度)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The politician's <target>credibility</target> <pattern>was</pattern> <target>damaged</target> after the media revealed that he had lied about his educational background.","translation":"在媒體揭露該政治家謊報其教育背景後，他的可信度受損了。","explanation":"名詞「可信度」。常用搭配 damage credibility (損害可信度)。"},{"sentence":"To <pattern>establish</pattern> <target>credibility</target> with the audience, the speaker cited several peer-reviewed studies from reputable universities.","translation":"為了在聽眾面前建立可信度，演講者引用了幾篇來自知名大學的同行評審研究。","explanation":"名詞「可信度」。片語 establish credibility 表示「建立可信度」。"},{"sentence":"The witness's testimony lacked <target>credibility</target> because his story changed multiple times during the police interrogation.","translation":"證人的證詞缺乏可信度，因為他在警方審問期間的故事多次變動。","explanation":"名詞「可信度」。常用搭配 lack credibility (缺乏可信度)。"}],"related_forms":["credible","credibly"]}

{"headword":"creek","explanation":"名詞「小溪」。通常指比 river 小的河流，常用於自然景觀描述。","entries":[{"sentence":"While hiking in the mountains, we found a peaceful <target>creek</target> <pattern>with</pattern> clear water flowing over smooth, grey stones.","translation":"在山中健行時，我們發現了一條寧靜的小溪，清澈的水流過光滑的灰色石頭。","explanation":"名詞「小溪」。"},{"sentence":"The children spent the whole afternoon playing by the <target>creek</target>, catching small fish and looking for colorful pebbles.","translation":"孩子們整個下午都在小溪邊玩，捉小魚並尋找彩色的鵝卵石。","explanation":"名詞「小溪」。"}],"related_forms":["creeks"]}

{"headword":"cripple","explanation":"動詞「使殘廢；使癱瘓」；名詞「殘疾人」。注意：在現代英語中，將此詞作為名詞使用來指代殘疾人被認為是不禮貌的，建議使用 person with a disability。動詞用法在 GSAT 中更為常見，常用於描述系統或經濟受損。","entries":[{"sentence":"The severe earthquake <target>crippled</target> the city's transportation system, making it nearly impossible for emergency services to reach the injured.","translation":"嚴重地震使城市的交通系統癱瘓，使得緊急救援服務幾乎不可能到達傷者身邊。","explanation":"動詞「使癱瘓」。常用於描述基礎設施或系統失效。"},{"sentence":"A sudden increase in fuel prices <target>crippled</target> the local shipping industry, forcing many small companies to go out of business.","translation":"突然的燃料價格上漲使當地航運業癱瘓，迫使許多小公司倒閉。","explanation":"動詞「使癱瘓」。指導致某事物無法正常運作。"},{"sentence":"The athlete's career was <target>crippled</target> <pattern>by</pattern> a serious knee injury during the final match of the national championship.","translation":"這位運動員的職業生涯因在全國錦標賽決賽中受重傷而受挫。","explanation":"動詞「使殘廢/受挫」。常用搭配 be crippled by sth。"}],"related_forms":["crippled"]}

{"headword":"criterion","explanation":"名詞「標準、準則」。注意其單複數形式：單數為 criterion，複數為 criteria。這是 GSAT 常考的文法陷阱，注意主詞與動詞的一致性。","entries":[{"sentence":"The most important <target>criterion</target> <pattern>for</pattern> selecting the new manager was their ability to lead a diverse team effectively.","translation":"選擇新經理最重要的標準是他們能有效地領導一支多元化團隊的能力。","explanation":"名詞「標準」（單數）。常用搭配 criterion for sth。"},{"sentence":"The university has established strict <target>criteria</target> <pattern>for</pattern> admission, requiring students to have both high grades and strong leadership skills.","translation":"這所大學制定了嚴格的入學標準，要求學生同時具備高分和強大的領導能力。","explanation":"名詞「標準」（複數）。常用搭配 criteria for sth。"},{"sentence":"When evaluating the research paper, the professor used several <target>criteria</target> to judge the accuracy of the data and the clarity of the arguments.","translation":"在評估研究論文時，教授使用多項標準來評判數據的準確性和論點的清晰度。","explanation":"名詞「標準」（複數）。"}],"related_forms":["criteria"]}

{"headword":"crucial","explanation":"形容詞「至關重要的」。常用於強調某事物對結果有決定性影響。常考搭配：play a crucial role in (在...中扮演至關重要的角色), it is crucial that... (至關重要地是...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Getting enough sleep is <target>crucial</target> <pattern>for</pattern> students to maintain their focus and perform well during the final exams.","translation":"充足的睡眠對於學生在期末考期間保持專注並發揮良好至關重要。","explanation":"形容詞「至關重要的」。常用搭配 crucial for sb/sth。"},{"sentence":"The teacher's encouragement <pattern>played</pattern> a <target>crucial</target> <pattern>role</pattern> <pattern>in</pattern> helping the shy student regain his confidence and participate in class.","translation":"老師的鼓勵在幫助這位害羞的學生重新獲得自信並參與課堂上扮演了至關重要的角色。","explanation":"形容詞「至關重要的」。片語 play a crucial role in... 表示「在...中扮演至關重要的角色」。"},{"sentence":"It is <target>crucial</target> <pattern>that</pattern> all participants sign the consent form before the experiment begins to ensure legal and ethical compliance.","translation":"所有參與者必須在實驗開始前簽署同意書，以確保符合法律和倫理規範，這一點至關重要。","explanation":"形容詞「至關重要的」。句型 It is crucial that... (後接應接原形動詞或 should + 原形動詞)。"}],"related_forms":["crucially"]}

{"headword":"crude","explanation":"形容詞「天然的、未經加工的」；「粗糙的、簡陋的」；「粗魯的」。在 GSAT 中，crude oil (原油) 是最常見的搭配，此外也常用於描述簡易的工具或設備。","entries":[{"sentence":"The country's economy relies heavily on the export of <target>crude</target> <pattern>oil</pattern>, making it vulnerable to changes in global market prices.","translation":"該國經濟嚴重依賴原油出口，使其容易受到全球市場價格變動的影響。","explanation":"形容詞「天然的、未經加工的」。常用搭配 crude oil (原油)。"},{"sentence":"During the survival training, the students built a <target>crude</target> shelter using only branches and leaves to protect themselves from the rain.","translation":"在生存訓練期間，學生們僅使用樹枝和葉子搭建了一個簡陋的避難所，以保護自己免受雨淋。","explanation":"形容詞「簡陋的」。指設備簡單且未經精細加工。"},{"sentence":"He made a <target>crude</target> joke during the formal dinner, which made many of the guests feel uncomfortable and offended.","translation":"他在正式晚餐中開了一個粗魯的玩笑，這讓許多客人感到不適且被冒犯。","explanation":"形容詞「粗魯的」。指言行缺乏禮貌或教養。"}],"related_forms":["crudely"]}

{"headword":"cruise","explanation":"名詞「巡航、航遊」；動詞「巡航、航遊」。常用於度假旅遊（cruise ship）或速度恆定的移動。","entries":[{"sentence":"After working hard all year, the couple decided to <target>cruise</target> <pattern>around</pattern> the Mediterranean, visiting several historic cities along the way.","translation":"辛苦工作一年後，這對夫婦決定在地中海航遊，沿途訪問幾個歷史名城。","explanation":"動詞「航遊」。常用搭配 cruise around sth。"},{"sentence":"The luxury <target>cruise</target> <pattern>ship</pattern> offers a wide variety of activities, including swimming pools, theaters, and fine dining restaurants for the passengers.","translation":"這艘豪華郵輪提供多種活動，包括游泳池、劇院和高級餐廳，供乘客享用。","explanation":"名詞「航遊/郵輪」。常用搭配 cruise ship (郵輪)。"},{"sentence":"The pilot maintained a steady <target>cruising</target> <pattern>speed</pattern> to ensure the flight was smooth and the passengers remained comfortable throughout the journey.","translation":"飛行員保持穩定的巡航速度，以確保飛行平穩且乘客在整個旅程中感到舒適。","explanation":"名詞/形容詞「巡航的」。常用搭配 cruising speed (巡航速度)。"}],"related_forms":["cruises","cruising"]}

{"headword":"crystal","explanation":"名詞「水晶、晶體」；形容詞「透明的、清晰的」。常考片語：crystal clear (極其清晰的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The scientist examined the <target>crystal</target> structure of the mineral under a microscope to understand its chemical properties and growth patterns.","translation":"科學家在顯微鏡下檢查礦物的晶體結構，以了解其化學性質和生長模式。","explanation":"名詞「晶體」。"},{"sentence":"The mountain lake was so <target>crystal</target> <pattern>clear</pattern> that we could see the colorful fish swimming deep below the surface.","translation":"山上的湖泊如此清澈，以至於我們可以看到五彩繽紛的魚在水面深處游動。","explanation":"形容詞「透明的」。片語 crystal clear 表示「極其清晰的」。"},{"sentence":"She wore a beautiful necklace made of <target>crystal</target> beads, which sparkled brightly under the lights of the ballroom.","translation":"她戴著一條由水晶珠子製成的美麗項鍊，在舞廳的燈光下閃閃發光。","explanation":"名詞「水晶」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"cuisine","explanation":"名詞「烹飪、料理」。通常指特定地區或國家的烹飪風格。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city is famous for its diverse <target>cuisine</target>, allowing visitors to enjoy authentic dishes from all over the world in one place.","translation":"這座城市以其多元的料理聞名，讓遊客能在同一地點享用來自世界各地的正宗菜餚。","explanation":"名詞「料理」。"},{"sentence":"Many people prefer Italian <target>cuisine</target> because of its focus on fresh ingredients and the perfect combination of pasta and tomato sauce.","translation":"許多人偏好義大利料理，因為它注重新鮮食材以及義大利麵與番茄醬的完美結合。","explanation":"名詞「料理」。通常搭配國家名稱，如 Italian cuisine。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"currency","explanation":"名詞「貨幣、流通」。除了指金錢，有時也可用於描述目前流行的想法或趨勢。常考搭配：foreign currency (外幣), local currency (當地貨幣)。","entries":[{"sentence":"When traveling to a foreign country, it is essential to exchange your money into the local <target>currency</target> to pay for daily expenses.","translation":"前往外國旅行時，將錢換成當地貨幣以支付日常開支是非常必要的。","explanation":"名詞「貨幣」。"},{"sentence":"The government implemented new policies to stabilize the value of the national <target>currency</target> and prevent a sudden economic crisis.","translation":"政府實施了新政策以穩定國家貨幣的價值，防止突然的經濟危機。","explanation":"名詞「貨幣」。"},{"sentence":"Many international businesses now accept digital <target>currencies</target>, such as Bitcoin, as a modern alternative to traditional paper money.","translation":"許多國際企業現在接受數位貨幣（如比特幣）作為傳統紙幣的現代替代方案。","explanation":"名詞「貨幣」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"curriculum","explanation":"名詞「課程」。指學校、大學或教育計畫中所有課程的總體計畫。注意與 course (單門課程) 的區別：curriculum 側重於整個教育體系的課程安排，而 course 側重於單一的科目學習。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school board decided to update the <target>curriculum</target> to include more digital literacy skills, preparing students for the modern workforce.","translation":"學校董事會決定更新課程，以納入更多數位素養技能，讓學生為現代職場做好準備。","explanation":"名詞「課程」。指整個教育計畫的安排。"},{"sentence":"Teachers often work together to develop a <target>curriculum</target> that balances academic knowledge with practical experience and social development.","translation":"教師們經常一起制定一個能平衡學術知識、實作經驗與社交發展的課程。","explanation":"名詞「課程」。"},{"sentence":"Some parents believe that the national <target>curriculum</target> is too focused on testing, leaving little room for creative arts and physical education.","translation":"有些家長認為國家課程過於注重測試，導致創意藝術和體育課空間太少。","explanation":"名詞「課程」。"}],"related_forms":["curricula"]}

{"headword":"custody","explanation":"名詞「監護權；拘留」。在法律語境中，常用於指父母對孩子的照顧權 (child custody) 或警察對嫌疑人的拘留 (police custody)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After the difficult divorce, the parents eventually agreed to share joint <target>custody</target> <pattern>of</pattern> their children to ensure their stability.","translation":"在經歷艱難的離婚後，父母最終同意共同擁有孩子的監護權，以確保孩子的穩定。","explanation":"名詞「監護權」。常用搭配 custody of someone。"},{"sentence":"The suspect was taken into police <target>custody</target> last night and is expected to be questioned further about the robbery.","translation":"嫌疑人昨晚被警方拘留，預計將針對搶劫案接受進一步審訊。","explanation":"名詞「拘留」。片語 take into custody 表示「拘留」。"},{"sentence":"The museum's most valuable painting was kept in safe <target>custody</target>, protected by high-tech security systems and armed guards.","translation":"博物館最珍貴的畫作被妥善保管，由高科技安全系統和武裝警衛保護。","explanation":"名詞「保管」。指對某物持有並負責其安全。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"customs","explanation":"名詞「海關」。注意此詞恆為複數形式且不可數（在指海關時），指負責檢查貨物和徵收關稅的政府部門。區分於 custom (單數，意為「習俗」)。","entries":[{"sentence":"When arriving at the international airport, all passengers must pass through <target>customs</target> and declare any restricted items they are carrying.","translation":"抵達國際機場時，所有乘客必須通過海關並申報他們攜帶的任何受限物品。","explanation":"名詞「海關」。指進入國家時的檢查站。"},{"sentence":"The traveler was delayed at <target>customs</target> because he had too many expensive electronics and failed to pay the necessary duties.","translation":"這名旅客在海關被耽擱，因為他攜帶了太多昂貴的電子產品且未支付必要關稅。","explanation":"名詞「海關」。"},{"sentence":"The <target>customs</target> officer asked the woman to open her suitcase for a detailed inspection of the souvenirs she bought abroad.","translation":"海關人員要求該女子打開手提箱，詳細檢查她在國外購買的紀念品。","explanation":"名詞「海關」。常用搭配 customs officer (海關人員)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "deadly", "explanation": "形容詞「致命的」；副詞「極其地」。形容詞用法最常見，指會導致死亡的事物。副詞用法較不正式，常用於強調程度。注意與 deathly (死一般的) 的區別：deadly 強調結果導致死亡，而 deathly (如 deathly pale) 強調像死人一樣的狀態。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The scientists discovered a <target>deadly</target> virus that could spread quickly through the air, prompting the government to issue an emergency warning.", "translation": "科學家發現了一種能快速透過空氣傳播的致命病毒，促使政府發布緊急警告。", "explanation": "形容詞「致命的」。常用於描述疾病、病毒或武器。"}, {"sentence": "The forest fire became <target>deadly</target> when the strong wind pushed the flames toward the small village, forcing residents to evacuate quickly.", "translation": "森林大火在強風將火焰推向小村莊時變得致命，迫使居民迅速撤離。", "explanation": "形容詞「致命的」。"}, {"sentence": "The snake's <target>deadly</target> <pattern>venom</pattern> can cause respiratory failure in humans within a few minutes, making it one of the most dangerous predators.", "translation": "這種蛇的致命毒液能在幾分鐘內導致人類呼吸衰竭，使其成為最危險的捕食者之一。", "explanation": "形容詞「致命的」。搭配 deadly venom。"}, {"sentence": "The student was <target>deadly</target> <pattern>serious</pattern> about his goal to study abroad, waking up at five every morning to practice English without fail.", "translation": "這位學生對他出國留學的目標極其認真，每天早上五點準時起床練習英文，絕不間斷。", "explanation": "副詞用法，搭配 deadly serious 表示「極其認真」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"debris","explanation":"名詞「碎片、殘骸」。指毀壞後留下的碎片或廢棄物。注意發音，末尾的 s 不發音 /dəˈbriː/。常用於描述自然災害或事故後的現場。","entries":[{"sentence":"After the powerful earthquake, rescue teams spent days searching through the <target>debris</target> to find survivors trapped under the collapsed buildings.","translation":"強震之後，救援隊花了好幾天在殘骸中搜尋被困在坍塌建築物下的倖存者。","explanation":"名詞「碎片、殘骸」。常用於描述建築物坍塌後的碎片。"},{"sentence":"The beach was covered in <target>debris</target> after the storm, so volunteers gathered to clean up the plastic and broken wood.","translation":"風暴後海灘上佈滿了碎片，因此志工們聚集在一起清理塑料和碎木頭。","explanation":"名詞「碎片、殘骸」。指自然災害後留下的廢棄物。"},{"sentence":"Astronauts are concerned about space <target>debris</target>, as small pieces of old satellites can damage the international space station at high speeds.","translation":"太空人擔心太空碎片，因為舊衛星的小碎片在高速移動時可能會損壞國際太空站。","explanation":"名詞「碎片、殘骸」。常用搭配 space debris (太空碎片)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"debut","explanation":"名詞/動詞「初次登場、出道」。指表演者、運動員或新產品第一次公開亮相。名詞常用搭配 make one's debut (初次登場)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young pianist <pattern>made</pattern> her <target>debut</target> at the National Concert Hall, receiving a standing ovation from the audience for her skill.","translation":"這位年輕的鋼琴家在國家音樂廳初次登場，因其精湛的技巧而贏得觀眾的起立鼓掌。","explanation":"名詞「初次登場」。片語 make one's debut 表示「初次亮相」。"},{"sentence":"The tech company is planning to <target>debut</target> its new foldable smartphone next month during a global press conference in Tokyo.","translation":"這家科技公司計劃下個月在東京的一次全球新聞發布會上首次推出其新款摺疊手機。","explanation":"動詞「初次登場」。指產品首次公開。"},{"sentence":"After years of training in secret, the pop idol finally <target>debuted</target> with a catchy song that quickly topped the music charts.","translation":"經過多年的秘密訓練，這位流行偶像終於以一首朗朗上口的歌曲出道，迅速登頂音樂排行榜。","explanation":"動詞「出道」。指表演者正式開始職業生涯。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"decay","explanation":"名詞「腐爛、衰敗」；動詞「腐爛、衰退」。指有機物分解或社會、制度的逐漸惡化。在牙科中常用於指蛀牙 (tooth decay)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The smell of organic matter <target>decaying</target> in the compost bin helps create rich soil for the garden's vegetables.","translation":"堆肥箱中有機物質腐爛的味道有助於創造肥沃的土壤來種植花園裡的蔬菜。","explanation":"動詞「腐爛」。指有機物分解過程。"},{"sentence":"Doctors warned the boy that too many sugary snacks would lead to tooth <target>decay</target>, causing pain and expensive dental bills.","translation":"醫生警告男孩，吃太多含糖零食會導致蛀牙，造成疼痛和昂貴的牙科費用。","explanation":"名詞「腐爛」。常用搭配 tooth decay (蛀牙)。"},{"sentence":"The abandoned mansion had fallen into a state of <target>decay</target> over the decades, with peeling paint and broken windows everywhere.","translation":"這座廢棄的大宅在數十年間陷入了衰敗狀態，到處是剝落的油漆和破碎的窗戶。","explanation":"名詞「衰敗」。指建築物或環境的逐漸損壞。"},{"sentence":"Some historians argue that the empire's moral <target>decay</target> was more damaging than the external attacks from neighboring countries.","translation":"一些歷史學家認為，該帝國的道德衰敗比來自鄰國的外部攻擊更具破壞性。","explanation":"名詞「衰敗」。指抽象概念如道德或制度的惡化。"}],"related_forms":["decayed"]}

{"headword":"deceive","explanation":"動詞「欺騙」。指刻意使他人相信不真實的事物。注意與 cheat 的區別：deceive 側重於使人產生錯誤的認知或相信謊言；cheat 側重於在比賽、考試或金錢交易中違反規則以獲利。","entries":[{"sentence":"The clever criminal tried to <target>deceive</target> the police by wearing a disguise and using a fake name during the investigation.","translation":"狡猾的罪犯試圖透過偽裝和在調查中使用假名來欺騙警察。","explanation":"動詞「欺騙」。指使人相信錯誤的事實。"},{"sentence":"Companies that <target>deceive</target> customers with false advertising can be fined heavily by the government to protect consumer rights.","translation":"以虛假廣告欺騙消費者的公司可能會被政府處以重罰，以保護消費者權益。","explanation":"動詞「欺騙」。"},{"sentence":"He felt betrayed when he discovered that his business partner had <target>deceived</target> him for months regarding the company's actual profits.","translation":"當他發現他的商業夥伴在公司實際利潤方面欺騙了他好幾個月後，他感到被背叛了。","explanation":"動詞「欺騙」。"}],"related_forms":["deception","deceptive"]}

{"headword":"decent","explanation":"形容詞「像樣的、體面的、適度的」。常用於描述行為、品質或薪水符合社會標準且可接受的。例如 a decent salary (像樣的薪水), decent behavior (體面的行為)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After working hard for several years, she finally found a <target>decent</target> job with a fair salary and good health benefits.","translation":"努力工作幾年後，她終於找到了一份薪水公正且有良好醫療福利的像樣工作。","explanation":"形容詞「像樣的」。指符合基本期待且可接受的品質。"},{"sentence":"It is important for students to provide a <target>decent</target> explanation for their absences, rather than just making up random excuses.","translation":"學生提供一個體面的缺席理由，而不是隨便編造藉口，是很重要的。","explanation":"形容詞「體面的」。指合理且被社會接受的。"},{"sentence":"The hotel room was not luxurious, but it was <target>decent</target> and clean enough for a short stay during the business trip.","translation":"酒店房間雖然不豪華，但對於出差期間的短期停留來說，它是像樣且足夠乾淨的。","explanation":"形容詞「像樣的」。指達到基本標準。"}],"related_forms":["decency","decently"]}

{"headword":"declaration","explanation":"名詞「宣言、申報」。指正式地宣布某事，或在海關申報物品。常見搭配：declaration of independence (獨立宣言), customs declaration (海關申報)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The signing of the <target>declaration</target> of independence marked the beginning of a new era for the country and its people.","translation":"獨立宣言的簽署標誌著該國及其人民新時代的開始。","explanation":"名詞「宣言」。指正式且公開的宣布。"},{"sentence":"Passengers are required to fill out a customs <target>declaration</target> form before landing to list all the goods they are bringing into the country.","translation":"乘客在降落前被要求填寫海關申報單，列出他們攜帶進入該國的所有貨物。","explanation":"名詞「申報」。指在法律或行政程序中告知政府的行為。"},{"sentence":"The government's formal <target>declaration</target> <pattern>of</pattern> war against the enemy nation shocked the world and led to immediate military action.","translation":"政府對敵國發出的正式宣戰宣言震驚了世界，並導致了立即的軍事行動。","explanation":"名詞「宣言」。常用搭配 declaration of war (宣戰)。"}],"related_forms":["declare"]}

{"headword":"decline","explanation":"動詞可用於「下降、減少」或「婉拒」。名詞則指「衰退、下降」。注意 decline in (在...方面下降) 和 decline to V (婉拒做某事) 的用法。","entries":[{"sentence":"Environmentalists are concerned about the steady <target>decline</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the population of honeybees, which could affect global food production.","translation":"環境保護主義者對蜜蜂數量持續下降感到擔憂，這可能會影響全球糧食生產。","explanation":"名詞「衰退、下降」。常用搭配：decline in sth。"},{"sentence":"Due to the economic crisis, there has been a sharp <target>decline</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the number of international tourists visiting the city.","translation":"由於經濟危機，造訪該市的國際遊客數量急劇下降。","explanation":"名詞「下降」。常用搭配：decline in sth。"},{"sentence":"The sales of the old model <target>declined</target> <pattern>significantly</pattern> after the company released a more advanced and cheaper version.","translation":"在公司發布更先進且更便宜的版本後，舊型號的銷售量顯著下降。","explanation":"動詞「下降、減少」。"},{"sentence":"She politely <target>declined</target> the invitation <pattern>to</pattern> attend the party because she had to study for her final exams.","translation":"她禮貌地婉拒了參加派對的邀請，因為她必須準備期末考。","explanation":"動詞「婉拒」。常用搭配：decline to V 或 decline the invitation。"}],"related_forms":["declined","declining"]}

{"headword": "dedicate", "explanation": "動詞「奉獻、致力於」。常用搭配 dedicate sth to sth/sb 或 be dedicated to V-ing/N。注意 to 是介係詞，後接動名詞或名詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The young scientist decided to <target>dedicate</target> her entire life <pattern>to</pattern> finding a cure for the rare disease.", "translation": "這位年輕的科學家決定將她的整個生命奉獻給尋找這種罕見疾病的治療方法。", "explanation": "動詞「奉獻」。常用搭配：dedicate sth to sth。"}, {"sentence": "Our teacher is <target>dedicated</target> <pattern>to</pattern> helping students achieve their academic goals, often staying late to provide extra support.", "translation": "我們的老師致力於幫助學生達成他們的學業目標，經常加班提供額外支持。", "explanation": "形容詞化用法，be dedicated to V-ing 表示「致力於」。"}, {"sentence": "The local government decided to <target>dedicate</target> a large part of the city park <pattern>to</pattern> a community garden where residents can grow their own vegetables.", "translation": "當地政府決定將城市公園的一大部分奉獻給社區花園，讓居民可以種植自己的蔬菜。", "explanation": "動詞「奉獻/撥出」。常用搭配 dedicate sth to sth。"}, {"sentence": "The writer spent several years <target>dedicating</target> his time <pattern>to</pattern> writing a detailed biography of the famous historical figure.", "translation": "這個作者花了好幾年時間致力於撰寫一位著名歷史人物的詳細傳記。", "explanation": "動詞「致力於」。搭配 dedicate time to V-ing。"}], "related_forms": ["dedication", "dedicated"]}

{"headword":"defendant","explanation":"名詞「被告」。法律術語，指在法庭上被指控犯罪或被起訴的人。注意與 plaintiff (原告) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>defendant</target> stood silently in the courtroom while the lawyer presented evidence to prove his innocence.","translation":"當律師出示證據證明其清白時，被告在法庭上保持沉默。","explanation":"名詞「被告」。"},{"sentence":"After hours of deliberation, the jury finally decided that the <target>defendant</target> was not guilty of the crime.","translation":"經過數小時的商議，陪審團最終判定被告不構成犯罪。","explanation":"名詞「被告」。"}],"related_forms":["defense","defend"]}

{"headword":"deficit","explanation":"名詞「赤字、虧損」。常用於財務或預算，指支出大於收入的情況。常考搭配 budget deficit (預算赤字), trade deficit (貿易赤字)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government is trying to reduce the national budget <target>deficit</target> by cutting unnecessary spending and increasing taxes.","translation":"政府正試圖透過削減不必要的支出並增加稅收來減少國家預算赤字。","explanation":"名詞「赤字」。常用搭配：budget deficit。"},{"sentence":"The company reported a significant financial <target>deficit</target> this year due to the unexpected increase in raw material costs.","translation":"由於原物料成本意外增加，公司今年報告了顯著的財務虧損。","explanation":"名詞「虧損」。"}],"related_forms":[]}
