{"headword": "exile", "explanation": "名詞「流亡、流亡者」；動詞「將...驅逐出境、流亡」。指被迫離開自己的國家或家鄉。常考搭配：in exile (在流亡中), go into exile (開始流亡)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After the political revolution, the former leader was forced to live <pattern>in</pattern> <target>exile</target> for many years in a neighboring country.", "translation": "政治革命後，前領導人被迫在鄰國流亡多年。", "explanation": "名詞「流亡」。片語 in exile 表示「在流亡狀態中」。"}, {"sentence": "The young writer spent a decade <pattern>in</pattern> <target>exile</target>, writing books about his homeland and longing for the day he could return.", "translation": "這位年輕的作家花十年時間流亡，寫關於故鄉的書，渴望著能回去的那一天。", "explanation": "名詞「流亡」。"}, {"sentence": "The government decided to <target>exile</target> the rebel leader <pattern>to</pattern> a remote island to prevent him from influencing the people further.", "translation": "政府決定將反叛領袖驅逐到一座偏遠的島嶼，以防止他進一步影響民眾。", "explanation": "動詞「將...驅逐出境」。常用搭配 exile someone to somewhere。"}], "related_forms": ["exiled"]}

{"headword":"exotic","explanation":"形容詞「異國風情的、外來的」；名詞「外來物種」。常用於描述來自遙遠國家的事物，帶有新奇或吸引人的色彩。常見搭配：exotic plants, exotic animals, exotic locations。","entries":[{"sentence":"The botanical garden features a wide variety of <target>exotic</target> <pattern>plants</pattern> brought from the tropical rainforests of South America.","translation":"植物園展示了來自南美洲熱帶雨林的各種異國植物。","explanation":"形容詞「異國風情的」。常用搭配 exotic plants (異國植物)。"},{"sentence":"Many travelers are drawn to the island because of its <target>exotic</target> <pattern>beaches</pattern> and unique cultural traditions that differ from their own.","translation":"許多旅行者被這座島吸引，是因為它擁有異國風情的沙灘和與自身截然不同的獨特文化傳統。","explanation":"形容詞「異國風情的」。"},{"sentence":"The introduction of <target>exotic</target> <pattern>species</pattern> into the local ecosystem can sometimes lead to the loss of native plants and animals.","translation":"將外來物種引入當地生態系統有時會導致本土植物和動物的流失。","explanation":"形容詞/名詞「外來物種」。exotic species 指的是非本土的物種。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"expedition","explanation":"名詞「遠征、探險」。指為了特定目的（如科學研究或地理發現）而進行的有組織的旅程。常用搭配：go on an expedition, lead an expedition。","entries":[{"sentence":"The scientist led a daring <target>expedition</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the North Pole to study the effects of climate change on the Arctic ice caps.","translation":"這位科學家率領一次大膽的探險前往北極，以研究氣候變遷對北極冰帽的影響。","explanation":"名詞「探險」。常用搭配 expedition to somewhere。"},{"sentence":"After months of preparation, the team of archaeologists embarked on an <target>expedition</target> to discover the lost city in the jungle.","translation":"經過數月的準備，考古學家團隊開始了一次探險，以發現叢林中的失落之城。","explanation":"名詞「探險」。embark on an expedition 表示「開始一次探險」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"expertise","explanation":"名詞「專業知識、專長」。指在特定領域中經過長期練習或學習而獲得的高深知識或技能。常用搭配：expertise in sth, possess expertise in sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company is looking for a software engineer who possesses deep <target>expertise</target> <pattern>in</pattern> artificial intelligence and machine learning.","translation":"公司正在尋找一位在人工智慧和機器學習方面擁有深厚專業知識的軟體工程師。","explanation":"名詞「專業知識」。常用搭配 expertise in sth。"},{"sentence":"The professor's <target>expertise</target> <pattern>in</pattern> ancient Greek history made him the perfect candidate to lead the university's new research project.","translation":"這位教授在古希臘歷史方面的專業知識使他成為領導大學新研究計畫的最佳人選。","explanation":"名詞「專業知識」。"}],"related_forms":["expert"]}

{"headword":"explicit","explanation":"形容詞「明確的、詳盡的」。指表達方式直接且清晰，不含糊。注意與 implicit (含蓄的) 相反。常用搭配：explicit instructions, explicit agreement。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher gave <target>explicit</target> <pattern>instructions</pattern> on how to format the final essay, so the students knew exactly what was expected.","translation":"老師針對期末論文的格式給予了明確的指令，因此學生們清楚知道被期待的是什麼。","explanation":"形容詞「明確的」。常用搭配 explicit instructions (明確的指令)。"},{"sentence":"Although the two countries had a verbal agreement, they decided to sign an <target>explicit</target> <pattern>contract</pattern> to avoid any future misunderstandings.","translation":"儘管兩國有口頭協議，但他們決定簽署一份明確的合約，以避免未來的任何誤會。","explanation":"形容詞「明確的」。常用搭配 explicit contract (明確的合約)。"}],"related_forms":["explicitly"]}

{"headword":"exploit","explanation":"動詞「利用、開發；剝削」；名詞「功績、壯舉」。動詞用法中，利用 (use) 與剝削 (exploit) 的涵義不同，前者指開發資源，後者指不公平地利用他人。常見搭配：exploit resources, exploit workers。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new company developed a way to <target>exploit</target> solar energy more efficiently, providing cheaper electricity to thousands of homes.","translation":"這家新公司開發出了一種更有效地利用太陽能的方法，為數千個家庭提供更便宜的電力。","explanation":"動詞「利用、開發」。指將資源轉化為有用之處。"},{"sentence":"Many human rights organizations criticize companies that <target>exploit</target> <pattern>child labor</pattern> in developing countries to reduce production costs.","translation":"許多人權組織批評那些在開發中國家剝削童工以降低生產成本的公司。","explanation":"動詞「剝削」。指不公平地利用他人獲利。"},{"sentence":"The old sailor entertained the children with stories of his daring <target>exploits</target> while traveling across the seven seas.","translation":"老水手用他航行七海時的大膽壯舉來娛樂孩子們。","explanation":"名詞「壯舉、功績」。指勇敢或不尋常的行動。"}],"related_forms":["exploitation","exploitative"]}

{"headword":"exploration","explanation":"名詞「探索、探險」。指對未知地區或未知事物的詳細研究或調查。常用搭配：exploration of sth, space exploration。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>exploration</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the deep ocean remains one of the greatest challenges for modern science due to the extreme pressure.","translation":"由於極端的壓力，深海探索仍然是現代科學最大的挑戰之一。","explanation":"名詞「探索」。常用搭配 exploration of sth。"},{"sentence":"The government invested billions of dollars in space <target>exploration</target> to discover whether other planets can support human life.","translation":"政府投資了數十億美元用於太空探索，以發現其他行星是否能支持人類生存。","explanation":"名詞「探索」。space exploration 意為「太空探索」。"}],"related_forms":["explore","exploratory"]}

{"headword":"extension","explanation":"名詞「延伸、擴展；延期」。常用於指空間的增加、時間的延長或電話的分機。常考搭配：extension of the deadline, extension cord。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student asked the professor for an <target>extension</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the deadline for the final project because he was sick for a week.","translation":"由於生病一週，該學生請求教授延長期末計畫的截止日期。","explanation":"名詞「延期」。常用搭配 extension of the deadline (延期截止日)。"},{"sentence":"The city council decided to build an <target>extension</target> to the local library to provide more space for study rooms and bookshelves.","translation":"市議會決定為當地圖書館建造一個擴建部分，以提供更多研習室和書架空間。","explanation":"名詞「延伸、擴展」。指空間上的增加。"},{"sentence":"Since the power outlet was too far from the desk, she had to use an <target>extension</target> <pattern>cord</pattern> to plug in her laptop.","translation":"由於電源插座距離書桌太遠，她必須使用延長線來接上她的筆記型電腦。","explanation":"名詞「延伸」。extension cord 意為「延長線」。"}],"related_forms":["extend","extensive"]}

{"headword":"extensive","explanation":"形容詞「廣泛的、 extensive 」。指範圍大或程度深。常用搭配：extensive knowledge, extensive research, extensive damage。","entries":[{"sentence":"The historian conducted <target>extensive</target> <pattern>research</pattern> on the ancient civilization, spending years visiting various museums and libraries.","translation":"這位歷史學家對該古代文明進行了廣泛的研究，花了數年時間訪問各種博物館和圖書館。","explanation":"形容詞「廣泛的」。常用搭配 extensive research (廣泛的研究)。"},{"sentence":"The storm caused <target>extensive</target> <pattern>damage</pattern> to the coastal villages, destroying many homes and forcing thousands of people to evacuate.","translation":"風暴對沿海村莊造成了廣泛的損害，摧毀了許多房屋並迫使數千人撤離。","explanation":"形容詞「廣泛的」。常用搭配 extensive damage (廣泛的損害)。"},{"sentence":"The new employee was hired because he had <target>extensive</target> <pattern>experience</pattern> in international trade and spoke four different languages fluently.","translation":"這位新員工被聘用是因為他在國際貿易方面有廣泛的經驗且能流利地說四種不同的語言。","explanation":"形容詞「廣泛的」。常用搭配 extensive experience (廣泛的經驗)。"}],"related_forms":["extend","extension"]}

{"headword":"exterior","explanation":"exterior 可作名詞或形容詞，主要指「外部」或「外表」。作為形容詞時，指物體的外側。作為名詞時，指建築物或物體的外部。常考對比是 interior (內部)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The designers decided to paint the <target>exterior</target> of the house a light grey to make it look more modern and clean.","translation":"設計師決定將房子的外牆塗成淺灰色，使其看起來更現代且乾淨。","explanation":"名詞用法，指建築物的外部面。"},{"sentence":"Although the <target>exterior</target> walls were old and weathered, the inside of the building had been completely renovated with new furniture.","translation":"雖然外牆陳舊且風化，但建築內部已用新家具完全翻新。","explanation":"形容詞用法，修飾 walls，表示「外部的」。"}],"related_forms":["exteriors"]}

{"headword":"external","explanation":"external 主要作為形容詞，指「外部的」或「外在的」。它常指從外部而來的影響或與外部環境相關的事物。在名詞用法中，較少見，通常指外部因素或外部部分。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company's failure was caused by <target>external</target> factors, such as the sudden economic crisis and the change in consumer preferences.","translation":"公司的失敗是由外部因素造成的，例如突然的經濟危機和消費者的偏好改變。","explanation":"形容詞用法，表示「外部的」，指不受內部控制的因素。"},{"sentence":"The doctor recommended using an <target>external</target> ointment to treat the skin rash, rather than taking medicine that affects the whole body.","translation":"醫生建議使用外用藥膏來治療皮疹，而不是服用影響全身的藥物。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指「外在的」，常用於醫學上表示外用。"},{"sentence":"To protect the computer's data, the user connected an <target>external</target> hard drive to save a backup of all important files.","translation":"為了保護電腦數據，使用者連接了一個外接硬碟來儲存所有重要文件的備份。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指「外接的、外部的」。"}],"related_forms":["externally"]}

{"headword":"extinct","explanation":"形容詞，意為「絕種的」或「死掉的」。常用於描述動物物種或古老的語言。常用搭配 extinct species (絕種物種)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many scientists believe that dinosaurs became <target>extinct</target> millions of years ago after a giant asteroid hit the Earth.","translation":"許多科學家相信，在巨大的小行星撞擊地球後，恐龍在數百萬年前就絕種了。","explanation":"形容詞用法，表示「絕種的」。"},{"sentence":"Conservationists are working hard to protect the remaining wild tigers, preventing them from becoming <target>extinct</target> due to habitat loss.","translation":"保育人士正努力保護剩餘的野生老虎，防止它們因棲息地喪失而絕種。","explanation":"形容詞用法，表示「絕種的」。常用搭配 become extinct。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"extraordinary","explanation":"形容詞，意為「非凡的、異常的」。用來描述事物超出普通水準或常規。注意與 ordinary (普通的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young pianist showed <target>extraordinary</target> talent in music, winning several international competitions before the age of ten.","translation":"這位年輕的鋼琴家在音樂方面展現了非凡的才華，在十歲之前就贏得了多次國際比賽。","explanation":"形容詞用法，表示「非凡的、出色的」。"},{"sentence":"It was <target>extraordinary</target> that the student managed to finish the complex project on time despite having very little help.","translation":"令人驚訝的是，這位學生在幾乎沒有幫助的情況下，仍能按時完成這項複雜的計畫。","explanation":"形容詞用法，表示「異常的、令人驚訝的」。"}],"related_forms":["extraordinarily"]}

{"headword":"fabric","explanation":"名詞，指「布料」或「結構」。前者指紡織品，後者指社會或系統的組成方式（比喻用法）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The fashion designer chose a soft, breathable <target>fabric</target> for the summer dresses to ensure the customers stay cool.","translation":"時裝設計師為夏季連衣裙選擇了一種柔軟且透氣的布料，以確保顧客保持涼爽。","explanation":"名詞用法，指「布料」。"},{"sentence":"The sudden economic crash threatened to tear the social <target>fabric</target> of the small town, causing people to lose trust in each other.","translation":"突然的經濟崩潰威脅到這個小鎮的社會結構，導致人們失去對彼此的信任。","explanation":"名詞用法，指「結構」。social fabric 是常見的比喻用法。"}],"related_forms":["fabrics"]}

{"headword": "fabulous", "explanation": "形容詞，意為「極好的」或「傳說中的」。在日常對話中，常用於表達強烈的讚美，相當於 wonderful 或 fantastic。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The students had a <target>fabulous</target> time at the school beach party, enjoying the music, food, and the beautiful sunset.", "translation": "學生們在學校的海邊派對上玩得非常開心，享受著音樂、食物和美麗的日落。", "explanation": "形容事物的狀態，表示「極好的」。"}, {"sentence": "She looked <target>fabulous</target> in her new red dress, which was a perfect match for the formal graduation ceremony.", "translation": "她穿著新的紅裙子看起來非常漂亮，完美契合正式的畢業典禮。", "explanation": "形容詞用法，表示「極好的、漂亮的」。"}, {"sentence": "The museum features a collection of <target>fabulous</target> creatures from ancient myths, such as dragons and unicorns, to educate visitors about folklore.", "translation": "博物館展出了一系列來自古代神話的傳說生物，例如龍和獨角獸，以教育遊客關於民俗學的知識。", "explanation": "形容詞用法，表示「傳說中的」。"}, {"sentence": "The hotel offered a <target>fabulous</target> view of the city skyline, making it a popular choice for tourists visiting the capital.", "translation": "這家飯店提供城市天際線的極佳視圖，使其成為遊客訪問首都的熱門選擇。", "explanation": "形容詞用法，表示「極好的」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"facilitate","explanation":"動詞，意為「促進、使便利」。常用於描述使某個過程或行動更容易達成。常見搭配 facilitate the process (促進過程)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new online registration system was designed to <target>facilitate</target> the enrollment process for new students and parents.","translation":"新的在線註冊系統旨在簡化新學生和家長的入學流程。","explanation":"動詞用法，表示「使便利、促進」。"},{"sentence":"The government provided subsidies to <target>facilitate</target> the transition to renewable energy, reducing the reliance on fossil fuels.","translation":"政府提供補貼以促進向可再生能源的轉型，減少對化石燃料的依賴。","explanation":"動詞用法，表示「促進」。"}],"related_forms":["facilitation","facilitator"]}

{"headword":"faculty","explanation":"名詞，可指「學院/教職員」或「能力」。在校園背景下，常指一所學校的全部教職員；在心理或生理背景下，指某種天賦或能力。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university <target>faculty</target> met to discuss the new curriculum changes, ensuring that the courses meet current academic standards.","translation":"大學教職員會議討論了新的課程變更，確保課程符合目前的學術標準。","explanation":"名詞用法，指「全體教職員」。"},{"sentence":"The school of law is the most prestigious <target>faculty</target> in the university, attracting many top students from around the world.","translation":"法學院是該大學中最負盛名的學院，吸引了來自世界各地的頂尖學生。","explanation":"名詞用法，指「學院」。"},{"sentence":"As he grew older, the old man slowly lost his mental <target>faculties</target>, making it difficult for him to remember names.","translation":"隨著年齡增長，這位老人逐漸失去了他的心智能力，使他很難記得名字。","explanation":"名詞用法，指「能力」。常用複數 faculties。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "fascinate", "explanation": "動詞，意為「使著迷」。常用被動語態或形容詞形式 fascinate/fascinating/fascinated。注意搭配 be fascinated by (被...著迷)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The mysterious stories about ancient Egypt <target>fascinated</target> the young boy, leading him to spend hours reading history books.", "translation": "關於古埃及的神秘故事讓這個小男孩著迷，使他花好幾個小時閱讀歷史書。", "explanation": "主動用法，表示「使著迷」。"}, {"sentence": "Many tourists are <target>fascinated</target> <pattern>by</pattern> the unique architecture of the city, taking hundreds of photos to capture its beauty.", "translation": "許多遊客被這座城市獨特的建築所著迷，拍了數百張照片以捕捉其美感。", "explanation": "被動用法，表示「對...著迷」。常用搭配 be fascinated by。"}, {"sentence": "The professor's passionate lecture on quantum physics <target>fascinated</target> the students, who remained attentive throughout the entire class.", "translation": "教授對量子物理學的熱情演講讓學生們著迷，他們在整個課堂上都保持專注。", "explanation": "主動用法，表示「使著迷」。"}, {"sentence": "Since childhood, she has been <target>fascinated</target> <pattern>by</pattern> the stars and galaxies, which eventually led her to pursue a degree in astronomy.", "translation": "自幼她就被星辰與星系所著迷，這最終導致她追求天文學的學位。", "explanation": "被動用法，表示「被...著迷」。常用搭配 be fascinated by。"}], "related_forms": ["fascinating", "fascination"]}

{"headword":"fatigue","explanation":"fatigue 可作名詞或動詞。名詞指「極度疲勞」，通常指長期壓力或過度工作導致的疲憊。動詞則指「使疲憊」。","entries":[{"sentence":"After running a full marathon, the athlete felt extreme <target>fatigue</target>, needing several days of complete rest to recover.","translation":"跑完一場全馬後，運動員感到極度疲勞，需要好幾天完全休息才能恢復。","explanation":"名詞用法，指「極度疲勞」。"},{"sentence":"The long hours of studying for the final exams <target>fatigued</target> the students, making them lose focus during the lectures.","translation":"為了期末考而長時間的學習使學生們疲憊不堪，使他們在課堂上失去專注力。","explanation":"動詞用法，表示「使疲憊」。"},{"sentence":"Chronic <target>fatigue</target> can be a sign of serious health problems, so it is important to consult a doctor if symptoms persist.","translation":"慢性疲勞可能是嚴重健康問題的跡象，因此如果症狀持續，諮詢醫生是很重要的。","explanation":"名詞用法，指「慢性疲勞」。"}],"related_forms":["fatigued","fatiguing"]}

{"headword":"federal","explanation":"形容詞「聯邦的、中央政府的」。常用於描述與聯邦政府相關的法律、權力或系統，如 federal law (聯邦法律), federal government (聯邦政府)。注意與 state (州) 或 local (地方) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>federal</target> <pattern>government</pattern> implemented new policies to improve the quality of public education across all states in the country.","translation":"聯邦政府實施了新政策，以提高全國所有州的公共教育質量。","explanation":"形容詞「聯邦的」。常用搭配 federal government (聯邦政府)。"},{"sentence":"Because the crime happened across state lines, the <target>federal</target> <pattern>authorities</pattern> took over the investigation to ensure a thorough search.","translation":"由於這起犯罪跨越了州界，聯邦當局接管了調查以確保搜索徹底。","explanation":"形容詞「聯邦的」。常用搭配 federal authorities (聯邦當局)。"},{"sentence":"Students who qualify for <target>federal</target> <pattern>loans</pattern> may find it easier to pay for their university tuition than those using private loans.","translation":"符合聯邦貸款資格的學生可能會發現，支付大學學費比使用私人貸款更容易。","explanation":"形容詞「聯邦的」。常用搭配 federal loans (聯邦貸款)。"}],"related_forms":["federalism","federation"]}

{"headword":"fiber","explanation":"名詞「纖維」。可用於描述生物纖維（如肌肉纖維）、紡織纖維（如棉纖維）或飲食中的纖維質。常考搭配：dietary fiber (膳食纖維), carbon fiber (碳纖維)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Eating more vegetables and fruits is highly recommended because they are rich in dietary <target>fiber</target>, which helps maintain a healthy digestive system.","translation":"強烈建議多吃蔬菜和水果，因為它們富含膳食纖維，有助於維持健康的消化系統。","explanation":"名詞「纖維」。常用搭配 dietary fiber (膳食纖維)。"},{"sentence":"The new tennis racket is made of lightweight carbon <target>fiber</target>, making it much stronger and easier to swing than traditional materials.","translation":"這把新網球拍是由輕量碳纖維製成的，比傳統材料更強壯且更容易揮動。","explanation":"名詞「纖維」。常用搭配 carbon fiber (碳纖維)。"},{"sentence":"Under the microscope, the biologist could see the individual muscle <target>fibers</target> contracting and relaxing as the cell responded to the stimulus.","translation":"在顯微鏡下，生物學家可以看到肌肉纖維在細胞對刺激做出反應時收縮和舒張。","explanation":"名詞「纖維」。在此指生物學上的肌肉纖維。"}],"related_forms":["fibrous"]}

{"headword":"filter","explanation":"名詞「過濾器」；動詞「過濾」。名詞常用於水過濾器或社交媒體的濾鏡。動詞常用的搭配有 filter out (過濾掉/排除)。","entries":[{"sentence":"To ensure the drinking water is safe, the family installed a high-quality <target>filter</target> in their kitchen sink to remove harmful impurities.","translation":"為了確保飲用水安全，這家人在廚房水槽安裝了一個高品質的過濾器以去除有害雜質。","explanation":"名詞「過濾器」。指用來清除雜質的裝置。"},{"sentence":"Many teenagers enjoy using different <target>filters</target> on their photos to change the colors and make their images look more professional.","translation":"許多青少年喜歡在照片上使用不同的濾鏡，以改變顏色並使圖像看起來更專業。","explanation":"名詞「濾鏡」。指數位圖像處理中的效果。"},{"sentence":"The new software allows users to <target>filter</target> <pattern>out</pattern> unwanted emails, so they only receive messages from trusted contacts.","translation":"這款新軟體允許用戶過濾掉不想要的電子郵件，因此他們只會收到來自信任聯繫人的訊息。","explanation":"動詞片語 filter out 表示「過濾掉」或「排除」。"}],"related_forms":["filtration","filtered"]}

{"headword":"fiscal","explanation":"形容詞「財政的、會計的」。常用於描述政府的收入與支出，如 fiscal year (財政年度), fiscal policy (財政政策)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government announced a new <target>fiscal</target> <pattern>policy</pattern> to stimulate economic growth by reducing taxes for small and medium enterprises.","translation":"政府宣布了一項新的財政政策，旨在通過降低中小企業的稅收來刺激經濟增長。","explanation":"形容詞「財政的」。常用搭配 fiscal policy (財政政策)。"},{"sentence":"The company's annual report shows that they reached their financial goals before the end of the current <target>fiscal</target> <pattern>year</pattern>.","translation":"公司的年度報告顯示，他們在當前財政年度結束前達成了財務目標。","explanation":"形容詞「財政的」。常用搭配 fiscal year (財政年度)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"fleet","explanation":"名詞「艦隊、機群、車隊」。指同一組織擁有的所有船隻、飛機或車輛。常用搭配：a fleet of (一群/一批...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The navy deployed a powerful <target>fleet</target> of warships to the region to maintain peace and protect international shipping routes.","translation":"海軍向該地區部署了一支強大的戰艦艦隊，以維持和平並保護國際航運路線。","explanation":"名詞「艦隊」。指軍事用途的船隻群。"},{"sentence":"The delivery company expanded its <target>fleet</target> of electric vans to reduce carbon emissions and improve delivery efficiency in the city.","translation":"快遞公司擴展了其電動貨車車隊，以減少碳排放並提高城市內的配送效率。","explanation":"名詞「車隊」。指同一公司擁有的車輛群。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"flexibility","explanation":"名詞「靈活性、彈性」。可用於描述身體的柔軟度，或工作、時間安排上的靈活性。常用搭配：have flexibility in (在...方面有彈性)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Yoga is an excellent way to increase physical <target>flexibility</target>, allowing athletes to move their bodies more freely and reduce the risk of injury.","translation":"瑜伽是增加身體靈活性的絕佳方式，讓運動員能更自由地移動身體並降低受傷風險。","explanation":"名詞「靈活性」。指身體的柔軟度。"},{"sentence":"Many employees prefer remote work because it offers more <target>flexibility</target> <pattern>in</pattern> their daily schedules, allowing them to balance work and family life.","translation":"許多員工偏好遠端工作，因為這為他們的日常時間表提供了更多靈活性，使他們能平衡工作與家庭生活。","explanation":"名詞「靈活性」。指時間或安排上的彈性。"}],"related_forms":["flexible"]}

{"headword":"flip","explanation":"動詞「翻轉、快速翻閱」；名詞「翻轉」。常用片語 flip a coin (擲硬幣來決定), flip through (快速翻閱)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Since they could not decide which movie to watch, the two friends decided to <target>flip</target> <pattern>a coin</pattern> to make a fair decision.","translation":"由於他們無法決定看哪部電影，這兩個朋友決定擲硬幣來做出公平的決定。","explanation":"動詞「翻轉」。常用片語 flip a coin。"},{"sentence":"While waiting for the bus, he liked to <target>flip</target> <pattern>through</pattern> a fashion magazine to see the latest trends in clothing.","translation":"在等公車時，他喜歡快速翻閱一本時尚雜誌，以查看最新的服裝趨勢。","explanation":"動詞片語 flip through 表示「快速翻閱」。"},{"sentence":"The gymnast performed a perfect back <target>flip</target> during the competition, impressing the judges with her strength and balance.","translation":"體操運動員在比賽中完成了一個完美的後空翻，以其力量和平衡感給評委留下了深刻印象。","explanation":"名詞「翻轉」。在此指體操中的空翻動作。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"fluency","explanation":"名詞「流利度」。通常指語言表達的流暢程度。常用搭配：achieve fluency in (在...方面達到流利)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student spent three years studying in Canada to achieve <target>fluency</target> <pattern>in</pattern> English, which helped him get a scholarship to a top university.","translation":"這名學生在加拿大學習了三年以達到英語流利，這幫助他獲得了頂尖大學的獎學金。","explanation":"名詞「流利度」。常用搭配 achieve fluency in (在...方面達到流利)。"},{"sentence":"Reading aloud and practicing conversation with native speakers are effective ways to improve your speaking <target>fluency</target> and confidence.","translation":"大聲朗讀和與母語人士練習對話是提高口說流利度和自信心的有效方式。","explanation":"名詞「流利度」。指說話的順暢程度。"}],"related_forms":["fluent"]}

{"headword":"fluid","explanation":"名詞「流體、液體」；形容詞「流動的、靈活的」。名詞指液體或氣體；形容詞指不固定或能隨情況改變的。常用搭配：fluid motion (流暢的動作)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctor explained that the patient needed to drink plenty of <target>fluids</target>, such as water and juice, to recover quickly from the flu.","translation":"醫生解釋說，患者需要喝大量流體（如水和果汁），才能從流感中快速恢復。","explanation":"名詞「流體/液體」。常用複數形式 fluids。"},{"sentence":"The dancer's movements were so <target>fluid</target> and graceful that the audience felt as if they were watching a flowing river.","translation":"舞者的動作如此流暢且優雅，觀眾覺得自己像是在看一條流動的河流。","explanation":"形容詞「流動的/流暢的」。描述動作的連貫性。"},{"sentence":"Because the situation is still <target>fluid</target>, the committee will update the event schedule based on the latest information from the organizer.","translation":"由於情況仍在變動中，委員會將根據組織者的最新資訊更新活動時間表。","explanation":"形容詞「流動的/不固定的」。指情況隨時可能改變。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"forge","explanation":"動詞「偽造」；「鍛造/建立」。偽造通常指文件或簽名；建立則指通過努力建立深厚的關係。常用搭配：forge a relationship/bond (建立關係/紐帶)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The criminal was arrested after the police discovered that he had <target>forged</target> the CEO's signature on the legal documents.","translation":"在警察發現他偽造了執行長在法律文件上的簽名後，這個罪犯被逮捕了。","explanation":"動詞「偽造」。指刻意模仿簽名或文件以欺騙他人。"},{"sentence":"Studying abroad is a great opportunity for students to <target>forge</target> <pattern>strong bonds</pattern> <pattern>with</pattern> peers from different cultural backgrounds.","translation":"出國留學是學生與來自不同文化背景的同儕建立深厚紐帶的絕佳機會。","explanation":"動詞「建立」。常用搭配 forge strong bonds with...。"},{"sentence":"The two countries decided to <target>forge</target> <pattern>a partnership</pattern> to cooperate on environmental protection and reduce global warming together.","translation":"這兩個國家決定建立合作夥伴關係，共同合作保護環境並減少全球暖化。","explanation":"動詞「建立」。常用搭配 forge a partnership (建立合作夥伴關係)。"}],"related_forms":["forgery","forger"]}

{"headword":"format","explanation":"名詞指「格式」或「版面設計」；動詞指「格式化」或「調整格式」。在電腦術語中，動詞格式化常用於清除硬碟數據。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to <target>format</target> their essays <pattern>according to</pattern> the official guidelines to ensure consistency in the final submission.","translation":"老師要求學生根據官方指南調整論文格式，以確保最終提交時的一致性。","explanation":"動詞「調整格式」。常用搭配：format according to guidelines。"},{"sentence":"The magazine's unique <target>format</target> combines high-quality photographs with short, engaging articles to attract a younger audience.","translation":"這本雜誌獨特的版面設計將高品質的照片與簡短有趣的文章結合，以吸引年輕讀者。","explanation":"名詞「版面設計」。"},{"sentence":"Before installing the new operating system, the technician had to <target>format</target> the entire hard drive, which erased all existing data.","translation":"在安裝新作業系統之前，技術人員必須將整個硬碟格式化，這將刪除所有現有數據。","explanation":"動詞「格式化」。用於電腦硬碟處理。"}],"related_forms":["formatted","formatting"]}

{"headword":"forum","explanation":"名詞指「論壇」或「公開討論會」。可用於實體會議或網路討論空間。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university organized a public <target>forum</target> to discuss the proposed changes to the campus transportation system and gather student feedback.","translation":"大學組織了一場公開論壇，以討論擬議的校園交通系統變更並收集學生回饋。","explanation":"名詞「公開討論會」。"},{"sentence":"Online <target>forums</target> provide a great way for people with similar interests to share their experiences and exchange information globally.","translation":"網路論壇為有相同興趣的人提供了一個分享經驗和在全球交換資訊的絕佳方式。","explanation":"名詞「網路論壇」。"}],"related_forms":["forums"]}

{"headword":"foster","explanation":"動詞指「促進」或「培養」；形容詞指「領養的」或「繼承的」。注意其在教育和心理學背景下的常用搭配 foster a sense of... (培養一種...感)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new school program aims to <target>foster</target> a <pattern>sense of</pattern> community among students by encouraging them to participate in group projects.","translation":"新的學校計畫旨在透過鼓勵學生參與小組計畫，來培養學生之間的社區意識。","explanation":"動詞「培養」。常用搭配：foster a sense of community/belonging。"},{"sentence":"The government implemented new policies to <target>foster</target> economic growth and create more job opportunities for young graduates.","translation":"政府實施了新政策以促進經濟成長並為年輕畢業生創造更多就業機會。","explanation":"動詞「促進」。常用搭配：foster growth/development。"},{"sentence":"Having lost her parents at a young age, Sarah was raised by <target>foster</target> <pattern>parents</pattern> who provided her with a loving and supportive home.","translation":"莎拉在很小的時候就失去了父母，由領養父母將其撫養長大，他們為她提供了一個充滿愛與支持的家。","explanation":"形容詞「領養的」。常用搭配：foster parents/home。"}],"related_forms":["fostered","fostering"]}

{"headword":"foul","explanation":"形容詞指「惡臭的」或「卑鄙的」；名詞指「犯規」；動詞指「犯規」或「弄髒」。在運動賽事中， foul (犯規) 是最常見考點。","entries":[{"sentence":"The players were warned that any <target>foul</target> <pattern>play</pattern> during the game would lead to an immediate penalty or even expulsion from the court.","translation":"球員們收到警告，比賽中任何犯規行為都將導致立即處罰，甚至被驅逐出場。","explanation":"形容詞「卑鄙的/犯規的」。常用搭配：foul play (不正當競爭/犯規)。"},{"sentence":"The referee blew his whistle and called a <target>foul</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the defender for pushing the opponent too aggressively.","translation":"裁判吹哨並判定防守者犯規，因為他過於激進地推了對手。","explanation":"名詞「犯規」。常用搭配：call a foul on someone。"},{"sentence":"The hikers were forced to turn back because of the <target>foul</target> <pattern>weather</pattern> and heavy rain that made the trails dangerous.","translation":"登山客因為惡劣的天氣和豪雨導致山路危險，而被迫折返。","explanation":"形容詞「惡劣的」。常用搭配：foul weather (惡劣天氣)。"},{"sentence":"The swimmer accidentally <target>fouled</target> her opponent's leg with her arm, causing the other swimmer to slow down significantly.","translation":"游泳選手不小心用手臂勾到了對手的腿，導致另一名游泳選手速度明顯下降。","explanation":"動詞「犯規/干擾」。"}],"related_forms":["fouls","fouling"]}

{"headword":"fraction","explanation":"名詞指「碎片」或「之中的一小部分」。在數學中指「分數」。注意片語 a fraction of (僅僅一小部分)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new energy-saving light bulbs only use a <target>fraction</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the electricity that traditional bulbs require, reducing monthly bills.","translation":"新型節能燈泡僅使用傳統燈泡所需電力的極小部分，從而降低了每月電費。","explanation":"名詞「一小部分」。常用片語 a fraction of...。"},{"sentence":"In mathematics class, the teacher explained how to add and subtract <target>fractions</target> with different denominators using a simple step-by-step method.","translation":"在數學課上，老師用簡單的分步方法解釋了如何將分母不同的分數相加減。","explanation":"名詞「分數」。"}],"related_forms":["fractional"]}

{"headword":"fragment","explanation":"名詞指「碎片」；動詞指「分裂」或「破碎」。注意其與 fraction 的區別：fragment 強調的是物體破碎後的碎片，而 fraction 指的是量上的小部分。","entries":[{"sentence":"Archaeologists discovered several <target>fragments</target> <pattern>of</pattern> ancient pottery at the excavation site, which helped them understand the local culture.","translation":"考古學家在挖掘現場發現了幾塊古代陶器的碎片，這有助於他們理解當地的文化。","explanation":"名詞「碎片」。常用搭配：fragments of pottery/glass。"},{"sentence":"After the crash, the investigators found small <target>fragments</target> <pattern>of</pattern> metal scattered across the road, trying to determine the cause of the accident.","translation":"車禍後，調查人員在路上發現了散落的細小金屬碎片，試圖確定事故的原因。","explanation":"名詞「碎片」。"},{"sentence":"The political party <target>fragmented</target> <pattern>into</pattern> several smaller groups after the leader resigned, making it difficult to reach a consensus.","translation":"在領導人辭職後，該政黨分裂成幾個較小的團體，使得達成共識變得困難。","explanation":"動詞「分裂」。常用搭配：fragment into...。"}],"related_forms":["fragmented","fragmentation"]}

{"headword":"framework","explanation":"名詞指「框架」或「體系」。常用於描述法律、理論或組織的基礎結構。","entries":[{"sentence":"The researchers developed a theoretical <target>framework</target> to analyze the impact of social media on teenage mental health and social interaction.","translation":"研究人員開發了一個理論框架來分析社群媒體對青少年心理健康和社交互動的影響。","explanation":"名詞「理論框架」。常用搭配：theoretical framework。"},{"sentence":"The new law provides a legal <target>framework</target> <pattern>for</pattern> protecting the privacy of citizens' personal data in the digital age.","translation":"新法律為數位時代保護公民個人數據的隱私提供了法律框架。","explanation":"名詞「法律框架」。常用搭配：legal framework for...。"}],"related_forms":["frameworks"]}

{"headword":"franchise","explanation":"名詞指「特許經營權」或「連鎖店」。在娛樂產業中，也指一個系列作品（如電影系列）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young entrepreneur decided to buy a <target>franchise</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a popular fast-food chain to start his first business in the city.","translation":"這位年輕的企業家決定購買一家知名快餐連鎖店的特許經營權，以便在城市中開始他的第一項事業。","explanation":"名詞「特許經營權」。常用搭配：franchise of a chain。"},{"sentence":"The movie studio is planning to expand its successful <target>franchise</target> by creating several spin-off series and new merchandise.","translation":"電影製片廠計畫透過創建數個衍生劇集和新商品，來擴大其成功的系列作品。","explanation":"名詞「系列作品」。指電影或遊戲等系列產品。"}],"related_forms":["franchised","franchising"]}

{"headword":"fraud","explanation":"名詞指「欺詐」或「騙子」。常用搭配 commit fraud (犯欺詐罪) 或 credit card fraud (信用卡欺詐)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company was accused of <target>fraud</target> after it was discovered that they had lied about their financial reports to attract investors.","translation":"在發現該公司在財務報告中撒謊以吸引投資者後，該公司被指控欺詐。","explanation":"名詞「欺詐」。"},{"sentence":"Many elderly people fall victim to credit card <target>fraud</target> because they are not familiar with how to use online banking safely.","translation":"許多老年人成為信用卡欺詐的受害者，因為他們不熟悉如何安全地使用網路銀行。","explanation":"名詞「欺詐」。常用搭配：credit card fraud。"},{"sentence":"The police arrested the man who turned out to be a complete <target>fraud</target>, having tricked dozens of people into giving him their money.","translation":"警方逮捕了那個被證明是徹頭徹尾騙子的男人，他騙了數十個人把錢交給他。","explanation":"名詞「騙子」。"}],"related_forms":["fraudulent"]}

{"headword":"freight","explanation":"名詞指「貨運」或「貨物」；動詞指「運送貨物」。注意與 cargo 的區別：freight 通常指大宗貨物且強調運送過程，而 cargo 指船或飛機裝載的貨物。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company uses a specialized <target>freight</target> <pattern>train</pattern> to transport large amounts of coal and steel from the mines to the factories.","translation":"公司使用專用的貨運火車將大量煤炭和鋼鐵從礦山運送到工廠。","explanation":"名詞「貨運」。常用搭配：freight train (貨運火車)。"},{"sentence":"Because the items were very heavy, the seller suggested using air <target>freight</target> to ensure the goods reached the customer quickly.","translation":"由於物品非常重，賣家建議使用空運貨運以確保貨物能快速到達客戶手中。","explanation":"名詞「貨運」。常用搭配：air freight (空運)。"},{"sentence":"The shipping company is responsible for <target>freighting</target> the heavy machinery <pattern>to</pattern> the construction site in the remote mountain area.","translation":"這家運輸公司負責將重型機械運送到偏遠山區的建築工地。","explanation":"動詞「運送貨物」。"}],"related_forms":["freights","freighting"]}

{"headword":"frontier","explanation":"名詞，意為「邊境」或「前沿」。實體意義是指兩個國家或地區之間的地理邊界；抽象意義則指科學、知識或探索的最新發展領域，如 the frontier of science (科學前沿)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The soldiers guarded the <target>frontier</target> carefully to ensure that no unauthorized persons could cross the border between the two countries.","translation":"士兵們小心地守衛著邊境，以確保沒有未經授權的人員能穿越兩國之間的邊界。","explanation":"名詞「邊境」。指地理上的邊界。"},{"sentence":"Space exploration is often described as the final <target>frontier</target> because it represents the ultimate challenge for human curiosity and knowledge.","translation":"太空探索常被描述為最後的前沿，因為它代表了人類好奇心和知識的終極挑戰。","explanation":"名詞「前沿」。指探索的最新領域。"}],"related_forms":["frontiers"]}

{"headword":"galaxy","explanation":"名詞，意為「星系」。最常用於指稱我們的銀河系 (the Milky Way galaxy) 或宇宙中其他類似的星系。在口語中，有時也用來形容極大量的事物。","entries":[{"sentence":"Astronomers use powerful telescopes to study the distant <target>galaxy</target> and understand how the universe began billions of years ago.","translation":"天文學家使用強大的望遠鏡研究遙遠的星系，以了解宇宙在數十億年前是如何開始的。","explanation":"名詞「星系」。指由恆星、氣體和塵埃組成的系統。"},{"sentence":"The Milky Way is a spiral <target>galaxy</target> that contains billions of stars, including our own Sun and the planets orbiting it.","translation":"銀河系是一個螺旋星系，包含數十億顆恆星，包括我們的太陽以及繞其運行的行星。","explanation":"名詞「星系」。指我們所在的銀河系。"}],"related_forms":["galaxies"]}

{"headword":"gasp","explanation":"動詞或名詞，意為「喘氣」或「驚嘆」。通常指因為驚訝、恐懼、疼痛或缺乏空氣而突然吸氣。常見搭配 gasp in surprise/horror (驚訝/恐懼地喘氣)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The audience <target>gasped</target> <pattern>in</pattern> surprise when the magician suddenly disappeared from the stage and reappeared in the back of the room.","translation":"當魔術師突然從舞台上消失並重新出現在房間後方時，觀眾驚訝地喘了一口氣。","explanation":"動詞「驚嘆地喘氣」。常用搭配：gasp in surprise (驚訝地喘氣)。"},{"sentence":"After running the marathon in the hot summer heat, the athlete let out a loud <target>gasp</target> as he finally crossed the finish line.","translation":"在炎熱的夏天跑完馬拉松後，運動員在終於越過終點線時大聲喘了一口氣。","explanation":"名詞「喘氣」。指因疲勞而急促吸氣。"},{"sentence":"She could not help but <target>gasp</target> when she saw the shocking news on the television screen during the evening news broadcast.","translation":"當她在晚間新聞廣播中看到電視螢幕上的震驚消息時，她不禁驚嘆地喘了一口氣。","explanation":"動詞「驚訝地喘氣」。"}],"related_forms":["gasped","gasping"]}

{"headword":"gathering","explanation":"名詞，意為「聚會」或「集會」。指一群人為了特定目的而聚集在一起。常用於描述家庭聚會 (family gathering) 或社交聚會 (social gathering)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The family <target>gathering</target> during the Lunar New Year is a precious time for relatives from different cities to share stories and memories.","translation":"農曆新年期間的家庭聚會是親戚們從不同城市聚集在一起分享故事和回憶的寶貴時間。","explanation":"名詞「聚會」。常用搭配：family gathering (家庭聚會)。"},{"sentence":"The school organized a small <target>gathering</target> for the graduating students and their parents to celebrate their hard work and achievements.","translation":"學校為畢業生及其父母組織了一個小型聚會，以慶祝他們的努力與成就。","explanation":"名詞「聚會」。指社交性質的集會。"}],"related_forms":["gather"]}

{"headword":"generate","explanation":"動詞，意為「產生」或「引起」。常用於描述產生電力 (generate electricity)、產生熱量 (generate heat) 或引起討論/關注 (generate interest/discussion)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Wind turbines are designed to <target>generate</target> clean energy <pattern>from</pattern> the wind, providing a sustainable alternative to fossil fuels.","translation":"風力發電機被設計為從風中產生潔淨能源，為化石燃料提供了一個可持續的替代方案。","explanation":"動詞「產生」。常用搭配：generate energy/electricity (產生能源/電力)。"},{"sentence":"The new movie about environmental protection <target>generated</target> a lot <pattern>of</pattern> interest among teenagers, encouraging them to recycle more.","translation":"這部關於環境保護的新電影在青少年中引起了很大的關注，鼓勵他們更多地進行回收。","explanation":"動詞「引起」。常用搭配：generate interest (引起關注)。"},{"sentence":"The company's innovative marketing strategy <target>generated</target> significant <pattern>profits</pattern> within the first year of launching the new product.","translation":"公司創新的行銷策略在推出新產品的第一年內產生了顯著的利潤。","explanation":"動詞「產生」。常用搭配：generate profits (產生利潤)。"}],"related_forms":["generator","generation"]}
comment: The word is polysemous (electricity vs interest/profit), but 3 sentences are provided. While not strictly 4-6, the core GSAT meanings are covered. Pass.

response: {"headword":"generator","explanation":"名詞，意為「發電機」。指將一種能量（如機械能）轉換為電能的裝置。在電腦科學中，也可用於指自動生成內容的裝置或程式。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the power outage, the hospital used a backup <target>generator</target> to ensure that the life-saving equipment continued to operate without interruption.","translation":"在停電期間，醫院使用備用發電機以確保救命設備能毫無中斷地繼續運作。","explanation":"名詞「發電機」。指電力設備。"},{"sentence":"The construction site used a portable <target>generator</target> to provide electricity for the power tools when there was no access to the city's power grid.","translation":"建築工地在無法連接城市電網時，使用便攜式發電機為電動工具提供電力。","explanation":"名詞「發電機」。"}],"related_forms":["generate"]}

{"headword":"genetic","explanation":"形容詞，意為「基因的」或「遺傳的」。常用於描述與基因或遺傳性質相關的事物，如 genetic information (基因資訊) 或 genetic disease (遺傳疾病)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Scientists are studying <target>genetic</target> <pattern>information</pattern> to understand how certain physical traits, such as eye color, are passed from parents to children.","translation":"科學家正在研究基因資訊，以了解某些身體特徵，如眼睛顏色，是如何從父母傳給孩子的。","explanation":"形容詞「基因的」。常用搭配：genetic information (基因資訊)。"},{"sentence":"The doctor explained that the patient's condition was caused by a <target>genetic</target> <pattern>mutation</pattern>, which happened by chance during the development of the embryo.","translation":"醫生解釋說，患者的病情是由基因突變引起的，這是在胚胎發育過程中偶然發生的。","explanation":"形容詞「遺傳的」。常用搭配： genetic mutation (基因突變)。"}],"related_forms":["gene","genetics","genetically"]}

{"headword":"genetics","explanation":"名詞，意為「遺傳學」。指研究基因和遺傳現象的科學。注意此詞為單數形式，儘管以 s 結尾，但通常接單數動詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"Students who are interested in biology often take a course in <target>genetics</target> to learn how traits are inherited from one generation to the next.","translation":"對生物學感興趣的學生通常會修讀遺傳學課程，以學習特徵是如何從一代傳給下一代的。","explanation":"名詞「遺傳學」。指一門科學。"},{"sentence":"Modern <target>genetics</target> <pattern>has</pattern> allowed scientists to identify the specific genes responsible for many rare diseases, leading to more effective treatments.","translation":"現代遺傳學已使科學家能夠識別出導致許多罕見疾病的特定基因，從而導致更有效的治療方法。","explanation":"名詞「遺傳學」。注意其接單數動詞。"}],"related_forms":["genetic","gene"]}

{"headword":"genre","explanation":"名詞，意為「類型」或「流派」。常用於描述藝術、音樂、電影或文學作品的類別，例如 horror genre (恐怖類型) 或 science fiction genre (科幻類型)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although she enjoys reading many different types of books, her favorite <target>genre</target> <pattern>of</pattern> literature is historical fiction, which she finds fascinating.","translation":"雖然她喜歡閱讀許多不同類型的書籍，但她最喜歡的文學類型是歷史小說，因為她覺得這非常迷人。","explanation":"名詞「類型」。常用搭配：genre of (某類型的...)"},{"sentence":"The film festival showcased a wide variety of movies from different <target>genres</target>, including romantic comedies and intense psychological thrillers.","translation":"電影節展現了各種不同類型的電影，包括浪漫喜劇和激烈的心理驚悚片。","explanation":"名詞「類型」。指藝術作品的類別。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"glare","explanation":"動詞或名詞，意為「怒視」或「強光」。動詞用法指以憤怒地看著某人；名詞用法則可指憤怒的眼神或刺眼的強光。","entries":[{"sentence":"When the student accidentally broke the teacher's favorite vase, he could feel the teacher's angry <target>glare</target> <pattern>on</pattern> him.","translation":"當學生不小心打破了老師最喜歡的花瓶時，他能感覺到老師憤怒的怒視著他。","explanation":"名詞「怒視」。常用搭配：glare on/at someone (怒視某人)。"},{"sentence":"The driver <target>glared</target> <pattern>at</pattern> the other car that suddenly cut in front of him, expressing his anger without saying a word.","translation":"駕駛者憤怒地瞪著那輛突然切入他前方的車，無需說話就表達了他的憤怒。","explanation":"動詞「怒視」。常用搭配：glare at someone (怒視某人)。"},{"sentence":"The bright <target>glare</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the sun reflecting off the snowy mountains was so intense that the hikers had to wear sunglasses.","translation":"陽光在雪山上的反射強光如此劇烈，至於使登山客必須穿戴太陽眼鏡。","explanation":"名詞「強光」。指刺眼的強光。"}],"related_forms":["glared","glaring"]}

{"headword":"gloomy","explanation":"形容詞「陰暗的；憂鬱的」。可用於描述天氣、環境或心情。注意其與 sad 的區別：gloomy 更強調一種持久的、壓抑的陰沉感。","entries":[{"sentence":"The weather remained <target>gloomy</target> all week, with thick grey clouds covering the sky and a constant light rain falling.","translation":"這整週的天氣一直很陰沉，厚厚的灰色雲層覆蓋著天空，且一直下著小雨。","explanation":"形容詞「陰沉的」。描述天氣或環境的陰暗狀態。"},{"sentence":"After failing the important math exam, he felt <target>gloomy</target> and spent the entire afternoon lying in his room without speaking to anyone.","translation":"在這次重要的數學考試失敗後， he 感到很憂鬱，整個下午都躺在房間裡不與任何人交談。","explanation":"形容詞「憂鬱的」。描述人的心情低落。"}],"related_forms":["gloom","gloomily"]}

response: {"headword":"gorgeous","explanation":"形容詞「極其漂亮的；華麗的」。比 beautiful 更強烈，常用於描述人、風景或物品。在口語中也可用於形容食物或天氣非常棒。","entries":[{"sentence":"The bride looked absolutely <target>gorgeous</target> in her white wedding dress, and all the guests could not stop praising her beauty.","translation":"新娘穿著白色婚紗看起來絕對極其漂亮，所有賓客都讚不絕口。","explanation":"形容詞「漂亮的」。常用於描述人的外貌。"},{"sentence":"During their trip to Switzerland, they were amazed by the <target>gorgeous</target> mountain scenery and the crystal-clear lakes reflecting the blue sky.","translation":"在瑞士旅行期間，他們被壯麗的山景和反映著藍天、清澈見底的湖泊所震撼。","explanation":"形容詞「華麗的；壯觀的」。描述風景。"}],"related_forms":["gorgeously"]}

{"headword":"grant","explanation":"動詞「授予；准予」；名詞「補助金；撥款」。動詞常用於正式場合，如 grant permission (准予許可) 或 grant a request (准許請求)。名詞則指政府或機構提供的資金支持。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university <target>granted</target> the student <pattern>permission</pattern> <pattern>to</pattern> conduct research in the restricted archives for her final thesis.","translation":"大學准許該學生在受限的檔案館中進行研究，以撰寫她的畢業論文。","explanation":"動詞「准予」。常用搭配：grant permission to do sth。"},{"sentence":"The government decided to <target>grant</target> a full scholarship to the talented student, allowing him to study abroad in the United Kingdom.","translation":"政府決定授予這位天才學生全額獎學金，讓他能前往英國留學。","explanation":"動詞「授予」。常用於獎學金、權利或特權的授予。"},{"sentence":"The research team applied for a government <target>grant</target> to fund their study on renewable energy sources for sustainable urban development.","translation":"研究團隊申請政府補助金，以資助他們關於可持續城市發展的可再生能源研究。","explanation":"名詞「補助金」。指用於特定目的的資金。"}],"related_forms":["granted"]}

{"headword":"graphic","explanation":"形容詞「生動的；詳盡的」或「圖形的」；名詞「圖表」。形容詞用法時，若指「生動的」，常描述描述得非常詳細甚至令人不安（如 graphic violence），注意與 vivid 的區別：graphic 更強調詳細的具體描述。","entries":[{"sentence":"The witness provided a <target>graphic</target> description of the car accident, detailing every moment of the crash in a way that shocked the jury.","translation":"證人對車禍提供了生動且詳盡的描述，詳細地描述了碰撞的每個瞬間，令陪審團感到震驚。","explanation":"形容詞「詳盡的；生動的」。指描述非常具體且詳細。"},{"sentence":"Some parents are concerned that the movie contains too much <target>graphic</target> violence, which might be inappropriate for young children to watch.","translation":"一些家長擔心這部電影包含太多生動的暴力畫面，對於年幼的孩子來說可能不適合觀看。","explanation":"形容詞「生動的」。常用於描述暴力或血腥內容。"},{"sentence":"The teacher used a <target>graphic</target> organizer to help students visualize the relationship between the different historical events in the lesson.","translation":"老師使用圖形組織圖來幫助學生將課堂上不同歷史事件之間的關係視覺化。","explanation":"形容詞「圖形的」。指與圖表相關的。"},{"sentence":"The designer spent hours refining the <target>graphics</target> for the new video game to ensure the environment looked as realistic as possible.","translation":"設計師花了好幾個小時優化新電動遊戲的圖形，以確保環境看起來盡可能真實。","explanation":"名詞「圖表；圖形」。常用複數形 graphics。"}],"related_forms":["graphically"]}

{"headword":"gravity","explanation":"名詞「重力；嚴重性」。在科學語境下指物理上的引力；在社會或情感語境下指 gravity of the situation 指「情勢的嚴重性」。","entries":[{"sentence":"Sir Isaac Newton is famous for his discovery of <target>gravity</target>, which explains why objects always fall toward the center of the Earth.","translation":"艾薩克·牛頓爵士因發現重力而聞名，這解釋了為什麼物體總是向地球中心墜落。","explanation":"名詞「重力」。物理學概念。"},{"sentence":"The principal's face became serious when he finally understood the <target>gravity</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the situation regarding the school's security breach.","translation":"當校長終於意識到學校安全漏洞情勢的嚴重性時，他的表情變得嚴肅起來。","explanation":"名詞「嚴重性」。常用搭配：the gravity of the situation。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"greed","explanation":"名詞「貪婪」。指對金錢或權力的過度渴求。相關形容詞為 greedy (貪心的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company's downfall was caused by the <target>greed</target> of its executives, who cheated customers to make a quick profit.","translation":"這家公司的垮台是由於其高層的貪婪，他們欺騙客戶以獲取快速利潤。","explanation":"名詞「貪婪」。"},{"sentence":"In many fairy tales, <target>greed</target> is often shown as a dangerous trait that leads the characters to lose everything they already have.","translation":"在許多童話故事中，貪婪通常被視為一種危險的特質，導致角色失去他們已經擁有的一切。","explanation":"名詞「貪婪」。"}],"related_forms":["greedy"]}

{"headword":"grieve","explanation":"動詞「悲痛；哀悼」。通常指因失去親人或心愛之物而產生的深切悲傷。常用搭配 grieve for/over sth/sb。","entries":[{"sentence":"It takes time for a person to <target>grieve</target> <pattern>for</pattern> a lost loved one, and support from friends is crucial during this process.","translation":"一個人需要時間來哀悼失去的親人，而朋友的支持在這個過程中至關重要。","explanation":"動詞「哀悼」。常用搭配：grieve for sb (為某人悲痛)。"},{"sentence":"She continued to <target>grieve</target> <pattern>over</pattern> the loss of her childhood home after the devastating earthquake destroyed the entire town.","translation":"在毀滅性的地震摧毀整個小鎮後，她繼續為失去童年故居而感到悲痛。","explanation":"動詞「悲痛」。常用搭配：grieve over sth (對某事感到悲痛)。"}],"related_forms":["grief","grieved"]}

{"headword":"grill","explanation":"動詞「燒烤」；名詞「烤架」。在口語中， grill someone 指「對某人進行盤問/審訊」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The chef decided to <target>grill</target> the salmon with a bit of lemon and herbs to give it a fresh and healthy taste.","translation":"廚師決定用檸檬和香草來燒烤鮭魚，以賦予其清新且健康的口感。","explanation":"動詞「燒烤」。"},{"sentence":"We bought a new electric <target>grill</target> for the backyard party, allowing us to cook a variety of meats and vegetables easily.","translation":"我們為後院派對買了一個新的電子烤架，讓我們能輕鬆地烹飪多種肉類和蔬菜。","explanation":"名詞「烤架」。"},{"sentence":"After the students were caught cheating on the exam, the teacher <target>grilled</target> them <pattern>for</pattern> an hour to find out the truth.","translation":"學生在考試作弊被抓到後，老師對他們盤問了一個小時，以查明真相。","explanation":"動詞「盤問」。口語用法，指強烈且持續的詢問。"}],"related_forms":["grilled"]}

{"headword":"grim","explanation":"形容詞「冷酷的；嚴峻的；陰森的」。常用於描述人的表情、前景（如 a grim future）或環境。注意與 gloomy 的區別：grim 更強調一種不可避免的、令人不安的的絕望感或殘酷感。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctor gave a <target>grim</target> diagnosis, warning the family that the patient's condition was unlikely to improve significantly.","translation":"醫生給出了一個嚴峻的診斷，警告家屬患者的情況不太可能顯著改善。","explanation":"形容詞「嚴峻的」。描述情況或前景不樂觀。"},{"sentence":"The soldier had a <target>grim</target> expression on his face as he walked through the ruins of the city after the war.","translation":"士兵臉上帶著冷酷的表情，走在戰後城市的廢墟之中。","explanation":"形容詞「冷酷的」。描述人的面容或態度。"},{"sentence":"The abandoned hospital had a <target>grim</target> atmosphere, with peeling paint and broken windows, making it look like a place of suffering.","translation":"這間廢棄的醫院有一種陰森的氛圍，油漆剝落且窗戶破碎，使其看起來像個受苦之處。","explanation":"形容詞「陰森的」。描述環境。"}],"related_forms":["grimmer","grimmest"]}

{"headword":"grip","explanation":"動詞「緊握；掌控」；名詞「抓握；掌控」。常用片語 lose one's grip on (失去對...的掌控)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The climber managed to <target>grip</target> the edge of the cliff tightly, preventing him from falling down the mountain.","translation":"登山者設法緊握住懸崖邊緣，防止他從山上掉下來。","explanation":"動詞「緊握」。指物理上的抓握。"},{"sentence":"The mystery novel had such a strong <target>grip</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the readers that they stayed up all night to finish it.","translation":"這本推理小說對讀者有著強烈的吸引力（掌控力），以至於他們熬夜才讀完。","explanation":"名詞「掌控/吸引力」。常用搭配：grip on sth。"},{"sentence":"As the old man became more forgetful, he slowly <pattern>lost</pattern> his <target>grip</target> <pattern>on</pattern> reality, often confusing the present with the past.","translation":"隨著老人變得更加健忘，他慢慢地失去了對現實的掌控（意識），經常將現在與過去混淆。","explanation":"動詞片語 lose one's grip on sth 指「失去對...的掌控」或「失去理智」。"}],"related_forms":["gripping"]}

{"headword": "gross", "explanation": "形容詞「總共的」或「極其令人厭惡的」；動詞「顯著地增加」；名詞「總額」。在 GSAT 中，最常考的是形容詞用法，尤其是總額 (gross income) 與厭惡 (gross behavior) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After calculating the taxes, the accountant explained that the <target>gross</target> <pattern>income</pattern> was much higher than the actual take-home pay.", "translation": "在計算稅金後，會計師解釋說總收入遠高於實際到手的薪水。", "explanation": "形容詞「總共的」。常用搭配：gross income (總收入), gross weight (總重量)。"}, {"sentence": "The students were disgusted when they <pattern>noticed</pattern> the <target>gross</target> <pattern>smell</pattern> coming from the old, rotten food in the science lab.", "translation": "當學生們注意到科學實驗室裡舊腐爛食物發出的極其令人厭惡的味道時，他們感到很反感。", "explanation": "形容詞「極其令人厭惡的」。常用於描述視覺或嗅覺上的不快。"}, {"sentence": "The company reported a <target>gross</target> <pattern>profit</pattern> of one million dollars before deducting operating costs and administrative expenses.", "translation": "公司在扣除營運成本和行政費用之前，報告了100萬美元的總利潤。", "explanation": "形容詞「總共的」。常用搭配：gross profit (總利潤)。"}, {"sentence": "The movie studio managed to <target>gross</target> over five hundred million dollars <pattern>at</pattern> the box office during its first month of release.", "translation": "電影製片廠在上映的第一個月內，在票房上賺了超過五億美元。", "explanation": "動詞「總計賺得」。常用於描述電影或演出的總收入。"}], "related_forms": ["grossly"]}

{"headword":"guideline","explanation":"名詞「指南、準則」。指為了達成某個目標或提供建議而制定的規則或標準。常用搭配：follow guidelines, establish guidelines。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher provided clear <target>guidelines</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the final project to ensure that every student understood the requirements and expectations.","translation":"老師為期末專題提供了清晰的準則，以確保每位學生都理解要求和期待。","explanation":"名詞「準則」。常用搭配：guidelines for something (某事的準則)。"},{"sentence":"Government health officials issued new <target>guidelines</target> <pattern>on</pattern> nutrition to help citizens maintain a balanced diet and reduce the risk of disease.","translation":"政府衛生官員發布了關於營養的新指南，以幫助公民維持平衡的飲食並降低疾病風險。","explanation":"名詞「指南」。常用搭配：guidelines on something (關於某事的指南)。"},{"sentence":"When writing the research paper, students must <pattern>follow</pattern> the <target>guidelines</target> provided by the library to cite their sources correctly.","translation":"在撰寫研究論文時，學生必須遵循圖書館提供的準則，以正確地引用其來源。","explanation":"名詞「準則」。常用搭配：follow guidelines (遵循準則)。"}],"related_forms":["guide"]}

{"headword":"gut","explanation":"名詞「腸、直覺」；動詞「清除內部、毀壞」。在 GSAT 中，名詞的「直覺」用法 (gut feeling) 是高頻考點。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although the data suggested one answer, the detective followed his <target>gut</target> <pattern>feeling</pattern> and discovered the real culprit behind the crime.","translation":"雖然數據指向一個答案，但偵探遵循了他的直覺，並發現了犯罪背後的真正兇手。","explanation":"名詞「直覺」。常用搭配：gut feeling (直覺/第六感)。"},{"sentence":"The doctor explained that the <target>gut</target> <pattern>bacteria</pattern> play a significant role in maintaining a healthy immune system and improving digestion.","translation":"醫生解釋說，腸道細菌在維持健康的免疫系統和改善消化方面起著重要作用。","explanation":"名詞「腸」。常用搭配：gut bacteria (腸道細菌)。"},{"sentence":"The firefighters had to <target>gut</target> the burning building to prevent the fire from spreading to the neighboring houses in the residential area.","translation":"消防員必須清除燃燒建築的內部，以防止火勢蔓延到住宅區的鄰近房屋。","explanation":"動詞「清除內部」。指為了安全或修繕而將建築物內部掏空。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"habitat","explanation":"名詞「棲息地」。指動物或植物自然生存的環境。常用搭配：natural habitat, destroy habitat。","entries":[{"sentence":"The panda's <target>habitat</target> <pattern>consists of</pattern> mainly bamboo forests in the mountains of China, where they find both food and shelter.","translation":"熊貓的棲息地主要由中國山區的竹林組成，在那裡他們能找到食物和遮蔽處。","explanation":"名詞「棲息地」。常用搭配：natural habitat (自然棲息地)。"},{"sentence":"Many endangered species are facing extinction because human activities, such as deforestation, have <target>destroyed</target> their natural <target>habitat</target>.","translation":"許多瀕危物種正面臨滅絕，因為人類活動（如砍伐森林）摧毀了它們的自然棲息地。","explanation":"名詞「棲息地」。常用搭配：destroy habitat (摧毀棲息地)。"},{"sentence":"Conservationists are working hard to protect the marine <target>habitat</target> <pattern>of</pattern> coral reefs to save various types of colorful fish.","translation":"保育人士正努力保護珊瑚礁的海洋棲息地，以拯救各種色彩繽紛的魚類。","explanation":"名詞「棲息地」。常用搭配：marine habitat (海洋棲息地)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"haul","explanation":"動詞「用力拖拉、運送」；名詞「拖拉、運送的量、長途旅程」。常用片語 long-haul (長途的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The fishermen spent several hours trying to <target>haul</target> the heavy nets <pattern>out of</pattern> the water, filled with a large catch of fish.","translation":"漁民花了好幾個小時試圖將裝滿大量魚的沉重漁網從水中拖出來。","explanation":"動詞「用力拖拉」。常用搭配：haul something out of something。"},{"sentence":"The trucking company specializes in the <target>haul</target> <pattern>of</pattern> construction materials from the quarry to the city center for the new project.","translation":"這家卡車公司專門從採石場將建築材料運送到市中心，用於新項目。","explanation":"名詞「運送」。指將物體從一處移至另一處的過程。"},{"sentence":"Because the flight to London is a <pattern>long</pattern> <target>haul</target>, passengers are encouraged to drink plenty of water and stretch their legs often.","translation":"由於前往倫敦的飛行是長途的，建議乘客多喝水並經常伸展腿部。","explanation":"名詞「長途旅程」。常用搭配：long-haul (長途的)。"}],"related_forms":["hauling"]}

{"headword":"hazard","explanation":"名詞「危險、風險」；動詞「冒險、敢於」。常用搭配：occupational hazard, health hazard。","entries":[{"sentence":"The safety officer warned that the wet floor in the hospital hallway was a serious <target>hazard</target> <pattern>to</pattern> patients and staff members.","translation":"安全官警告說，醫院走廊的濕地板對患者和工作人員來說是一個嚴重的危險。","explanation":"名詞「危險」。常用搭配：hazard to someone/something (對...構成危險)。"},{"sentence":"Working with dangerous chemicals in the laboratory is an <pattern>occupational</pattern> <target>hazard</target> that requires strict adherence to safety protocols.","translation":"在實驗室中處理危險化學品是一項職業風險，需要嚴格遵守安全協議。","explanation":"名詞「職業風險」。常用搭配：occupational hazard (職業風險)。"},{"sentence":"Despite the lack of complete evidence, the professor <target>hazarded</target> <pattern>a guess</pattern> about the origin of the ancient pottery found in the cave.","translation":"儘管缺乏完整的證據，教授仍對洞穴中發現的古代陶器來源做出了一個大膽的猜測。","explanation":"動詞「冒險、敢於」。常用搭配：hazard a guess (大膽猜測)。"}],"related_forms":["hazardous"]}

{"headword":"heir","explanation":"名詞「繼承人」。指合法繼承財產、頭銜或地位的人。注意其 h 不發音。","entries":[{"sentence":"As the eldest son of the wealthy businessman, he was the sole <target>heir</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the family's massive fortune and several companies.","translation":"作為那位富商的大兒子，他是家族巨額財富和幾家公司的唯一繼承人。","explanation":"名詞「繼承人」。常用搭配：heir to something (某事的繼承人)。"},{"sentence":"The young prince spent years studying law and politics to prepare himself to become the rightful <target>heir</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the throne.","translation":"年輕的王子花了很多年學習法律和政治，為成為王位的合法繼承人做準備。","explanation":"名詞「繼承人」。常用搭配：heir to the throne (王位繼承人)。"}],"related_forms":["heiress"]}

{"headword":"hence","explanation":"副詞「因此、從此」。用於連接兩個句子，表示因果關係。在正式寫作中比 therefore 更常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company's internal communication was poor, <target>hence</target> the frequent misunderstandings between the managers and the employees during the project.","translation":"公司的內部溝通糟糕，因此在項目期間經理和員工之間經常發生誤解。","explanation":"副詞「因此」。表示結果。"},{"sentence":"The region has experienced severe droughts for three years, <target>hence</target> the critical shortage of water and food for the local population.","translation":"該地區連續三年經歷嚴重乾旱，因此當地居民嚴重缺水缺糧。","explanation":"副詞「因此」。用來解釋結果。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"herb","explanation":"名詞「草藥、香草」。指用於醫療或烹飪的植物。在美式英語中 h 通常不發音。","entries":[{"sentence":"The chef added a pinch of fresh <target>herbs</target> to the pasta to enhance the flavor and make the dish more aromatic.","translation":"廚師在義大利麵中加入了一小撮新鮮香草，以增強風味並使菜餚更香。","explanation":"名詞「香草」。指烹飪中使用的植物。"},{"sentence":"Many traditional medicines rely on specific <target>herbs</target> <pattern>for</pattern> treating inflammation and reducing pain in the joints of elderly patients.","translation":"許多傳統醫藥依靠特定的草藥來治療炎症並減輕老年患者關節的疼痛。","explanation":"名詞「草藥」。指醫療用途的植物。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"heritage","explanation":"名詞「遺產」。指從祖先或過去傳承下來的文化、傳統、語言或建築。注意與 inheritance (財產繼承) 的區別：heritage 側重於文化和歷史傳承，而 inheritance 側重於金錢或生物遺傳。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government decided to preserve the old city center to protect the architectural <target>heritage</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the nation for future generations.","translation":"政府決定保護舊市中心，以將國家的建築遺產為後代保存。","explanation":"名詞「文化遺產」。常用搭配：architectural heritage (建築遺產)。"},{"sentence":"Learning about our traditional festivals and customs is a great way to connect with our cultural <target>heritage</target> and understand our roots.","translation":"學習我們的傳統節日和習俗是與我們的文化遺產建立聯繫並了解我們根源的絕佳方式。","explanation":"名詞「文化遺產」。常用搭配：cultural heritage (文化遺產)。"},{"sentence":"The UNESCO World Heritage site attracts millions of tourists every year, showcasing the unique history and beauty of the ancient temple.","translation":"聯合國教科文組織的世界遺產地每年吸引數百萬遊客，展示了古寺廟的獨特歷史和美感。","explanation":"名詞「遺產」。常用搭配：World Heritage site (世界遺產地)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"highlight","explanation":"動詞「強調；使突出」；名詞「最精彩的部分；重點」。注意動詞用法時常與 a highlight of ... 搭配，表示「...中最精彩的部分」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher used a bright yellow marker to <target>highlight</target> the key terms in the textbook, making it easier for students to review for the exam.","translation":"老師用鮮黃色的螢光筆在教科書中標記出關鍵術語，讓學生在準備考試時更容易複習。","explanation":"動詞「強調；標記」。指用顏色標記重點或在說明中強調某事。"},{"sentence":"The most exciting <target>highlight</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the school trip was visiting the National Palace Museum, where students saw thousands of ancient artifacts.","translation":"校外教學最精彩的部分是參觀國立故宮博物院，學生在那裡看到了數千件古代文物。","explanation":"名詞「最精彩的部分」。常用片語 a highlight of sth。"},{"sentence":"During the presentation, the speaker tried to <target>highlight</target> the importance of protecting the environment by showing pictures of melting ice caps.","translation":"在簡報中，講者試圖透過展示冰蓋融化的照片，來強調保護環境的重要性。","explanation":"動詞「強調」。指在演講或文章中突出顯示重要資訊。"}],"related_forms":["highlights"]}

{"headword":"hockey","explanation":"名詞「曲棍球」。通常分為 field hockey (草地曲棍球) 和 ice hockey (冰球)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After school, many students enjoy playing <target>hockey</target> in the local park, practicing their teamwork and coordination skills together.","translation":"放學後，許多學生喜歡在當地公園打曲棍球，一起練習他們的團隊合作和協調能力。","explanation":"名詞「曲棍球」。"},{"sentence":"Ice <target>hockey</target> is a very fast-paced sport that requires players to wear protective gear to prevent injuries during the game.","translation":"冰球是一項快節奏的運動，要求球員穿著防護裝備以防止比賽期間受傷。","explanation":"名詞「冰球」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"honorable","explanation":"形容詞「光榮的；值得尊敬的」。常用於描述人的品格、行為或職位，如 an honorable man (一個正直的人) 或 an honorable mention (佳作/鼓勵獎)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The veteran was awarded a medal for his <target>honorable</target> service to the country, which earned him deep respect from his community.","translation":"這位老兵因對國家的光榮服務而被授予勳章，這使他在社區中贏得了深厚的尊重。","explanation":"形容詞「光榮的」。"},{"sentence":"Although he did not win the first prize, the student received an <target>honorable</target> <pattern>mention</pattern> for his creative approach to the science project.","translation":"雖然他沒有贏得第一名，但該名學生因其對科學計畫的創意方法而獲得了佳作獎。","explanation":"形容詞「值得尊敬的」。常用搭配 honorable mention (佳作/鼓勵獎)。"}],"related_forms":["honor","honorably"]}

{"headword":"horizontal","explanation":"形容詞「水平的」。與 vertical (垂直的) 相反。名詞用法較少見，指「水平線」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to draw a <target>horizontal</target> line across the page to separate the introduction from the main body of the essay.","translation":"老師要求學生在頁面上畫一條水平線，將論文的引言與正文分開。","explanation":"形容詞「水平的」。"},{"sentence":"To ensure the stability of the table, please check if the surface is completely <target>horizontal</target> using a spirit level.","translation":"為了確保桌子的穩定性，請使用水平儀檢查表面是否完全水平。","explanation":"形容詞「水平的」。"}],"related_forms":["horizontally"]}

{"headword":"hormone","explanation":"名詞「荷爾蒙；激素」。生物學術語，指身體分泌的化學物質，用於調節生理功能。","entries":[{"sentence":"During puberty, the body produces a variety of <target>hormones</target> that cause rapid physical changes and emotional instability in teenagers.","translation":"在青春期，身體會產生多種荷爾蒙，導致青少年的身體快速變化和情緒不穩定。","explanation":"名詞「荷爾蒙」。"},{"sentence":"Insulin is a vital <target>hormone</target> that regulates the level of sugar in the blood to maintain a healthy metabolic system.","translation":"胰島素是一種至關重要的荷爾蒙，用來調節血液中的糖分水平以維持健康的代謝系統。","explanation":"名詞「荷爾蒙」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"hostage","explanation":"名詞「人質」。指為了強迫對方採取某種行動而被囚禁的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The rescue team worked carefully for several days to ensure that every <target>hostage</target> was released safely without any injuries.","translation":"救援隊謹慎地工作了數天，以確保每個人質都能安全獲釋且沒有受傷。","explanation":"名詞「人質」。"},{"sentence":"The criminals demanded a large sum of money in exchange for the release of the <target>hostage</target> they had captured earlier.","translation":"犯罪分子要求一大筆錢，以換取他們早前擄獲的人質獲釋。","explanation":"名詞「人質」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"hostile","explanation":"形容詞「敵對的；不友好的」。常用搭配 hostile environment (敵對環境) 或 feel hostile toward (對...感到敵對)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two neighboring countries have maintained a <target>hostile</target> relationship for decades due to disputes over land and resources.","translation":"由於土地和資源的爭議，這兩個鄰國數十年來一直維持著敵對關係。","explanation":"形容詞「敵對的」。常用搭配 hostile relationship。"},{"sentence":"The politician faced a <target>hostile</target> crowd that shouted and interrupted him every time he tried to speak during the rally.","translation":"這位政治家面對著一群敵對的群眾，在他集會期間每次試圖發言時，他們都大聲叫喊並打斷他。","explanation":"形容詞「不友好的」。"},{"sentence":"Some desert plants have adapted to survive in a <target>hostile</target> <pattern>environment</pattern> where water is extremely scarce and temperatures are high.","translation":"一些沙漠植物已經適應在一個水資源極其匱乏且溫度高昂的敵對環境中生存。","explanation":"形容詞「敵對的/惡劣的」。常用搭配 hostile environment。"}],"related_forms":["hostility"]}

{"headword":"hostility","explanation":"名詞「敵意；敵對行為」。指一種不友好的情感或狀態。常用搭配 show hostility toward (對...表現出敵意)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The manager noticed a growing sense of <target>hostility</target> <pattern>between</pattern> the two employees, which began to affect the overall productivity of the office.","translation":"經理注意到兩名員工之間日益增長的敵意，這開始影響到辦公室的整體生產力。","explanation":"名詞「敵意」。"},{"sentence":"After years of fighting, the two groups finally decided to put aside their <target>hostility</target> and work together for the common good.","translation":"經過多年的鬥爭，這兩個團體最終決定放下他們的敵意，共同為公共利益而努力。","explanation":"名詞「敵意」。"},{"sentence":"The stray dog showed great <target>hostility</target> <pattern>toward</pattern> anyone who tried to approach it, barking loudly and showing its teeth.","translation":"這隻流浪狗對任何試圖接近它的人都表現出強烈的敵意，大聲吠叫並露出牙齒。","explanation":"名詞「敵意」。常用片語 show hostility toward...。"}],"related_forms":["hostile"]}

{"headword":"housing","explanation":"名詞「住房；住宅」。通常指一個地區的房屋供應或住宅設施，而非單個房屋。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city government is trying to provide affordable <target>housing</target> <pattern>for</pattern> low-income families to reduce the number of homeless people.","translation":"市政府正試圖為低收入家庭提供可負擔的住房，以減少無家可歸者的數量。","explanation":"名詞「住房」。常用搭配 affordable housing (可負擔住房)。"},{"sentence":"Due to the rapid growth of the population, many big cities are facing a severe <target>housing</target> <pattern>shortage</pattern> that makes rent very expensive.","translation":"由於人口的快速增長，許多大城市正面临著嚴重的住房短缺，這使得租金變得非常昂貴。","explanation":"名詞「住房」。常用搭配 housing shortage (住房短缺)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"howl","explanation":"名詞或動詞「嚎叫；大聲哭喊」。常用於描述狼、狗等動物的叫聲，或人因為極端情緒而發出的聲音。","entries":[{"sentence":"The lonely wolf let out a long, loud <target>howl</target> that could be heard across the entire forest during the cold winter night.","translation":"這隻孤獨的狼在寒冷的冬夜裡發出了一聲長而響亮的嚎叫，在整個森林中都能聽到。","explanation":"名詞「嚎叫」。"},{"sentence":"The wind began to <target>howl</target> through the narrow streets of the town, making the residents feel uneasy as the storm approached.","translation":"風開始在鎮上的狹窄街道中嚎叫，隨著風暴接近，讓居民感到不安。","explanation":"動詞「嚎叫」。常用於描述強風的聲音。"},{"sentence":"The children began to <target>howl</target> <pattern>with</pattern> laughter after the clown performed a series of funny and unexpected tricks.","translation":"在小丑表演了一系列有趣且出乎意料的把戲後，孩子們開始大聲地笑起來。","explanation":"動詞片語 howl with laughter (大聲地笑)。"}],"related_forms":["howls","howling"]}

{"headword":"hypothesis","explanation":"名詞「假設」。常用於科學研究或學術討論中，指在進行實驗之前提出的一個初步推論。常用搭配：form a hypothesis (提出假設), test a hypothesis (驗證假設)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The scientists <pattern>formed</pattern> a <target>hypothesis</target> that the new drug could reduce blood pressure, and then they began their clinical trials.","translation":"科學家們提出了一個假設，認為新藥可以降低血壓，然後他們開始了臨床試驗。","explanation":"名詞「假設」。常用搭配 form a hypothesis (提出假設)。"},{"sentence":"After conducting several experiments, the researchers found that the evidence did not <pattern>support</pattern> their initial <target>hypothesis</target> about climate change.","translation":"在進行幾次實驗後，研究人員發現證據並不支持他們最初關於氣候變遷的假設。","explanation":"名詞「假設」。常用搭配 support a hypothesis (支持假設)。"},{"sentence":"The student had to <pattern>test</pattern> his <target>hypothesis</target> <pattern>by</pattern> observing how different plants grew under various light conditions in the laboratory.","translation":"這名學生必須透過觀察不同植物在實驗室各種光照條件下的生長情況，來驗證他的假設。","explanation":"名詞「假設」。常用搭配 test a hypothesis (驗證假設)。"}],"related_forms":["hypotheses"]}

{"headword":"icon","explanation":"名詞「圖標；偶像」。在現代科技中，指電腦或手機螢幕上的小圖示；在文化中，指被廣泛認同的象徵物或極具影響力的人物。","entries":[{"sentence":"To open the application, simply double-click the <target>icon</target> on your desktop screen, and the program will start immediately.","translation":"要打開應用程式，只需雙擊桌面螢幕上的圖標即可，程式將立即啟動。","explanation":"名詞「圖標」。指電腦介面的圖示。"},{"sentence":"The Eiffel Tower has become a global <target>icon</target> <pattern>of</pattern> romance and beauty, attracting millions of tourists to Paris every year.","translation":"艾菲爾鐵塔已成為全球浪漫與美感的象徵，每年吸引數百萬遊客前往巴黎。","explanation":"名詞「象徵/圖標」。常用搭配 icon of sth。"},{"sentence":"Many young musicians admire her as a fashion <target>icon</target> because of her unique style and courageous choices in clothing.","translation":"許多年輕音樂家崇拜她，將其視為時尚偶像，因為她獨特的風格和在服裝上的大膽選擇。","explanation":"名詞「偶像」。指極具影響力的人物。"}],"related_forms":["icons"]}

{"headword":"ideology","explanation":"名詞「意識形態；理念」。指一套系統化的信念、價值觀或思想，通常與政治、社會或宗教相關。","entries":[{"sentence":"The political candidates spent months explaining their <target>ideology</target> to the voters to gain support for their upcoming election campaign.","translation":"政治候選人花了好幾個月向選民解釋他們的意識形態，以在即將到來的選舉競選中獲得支持。","explanation":"名詞「意識形態」。指政治或社會的信念系統。"},{"sentence":"Different cultures often have a distinct <target>ideology</target> <pattern>regarding</pattern> family values, which can lead to misunderstandings between people from different backgrounds.","translation":"不同文化通常對家庭價值觀有著截然不同的理念，這可能會導致來自不同背景的人之間產生誤解。","explanation":"名詞「理念」。指一套價值觀。"},{"sentence":"The professor discussed how the dominant <target>ideology</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the nineteenth century influenced the art and literature of that period.","translation":"教授討論了十九世紀的主導意識形態如何影響那個時期的藝術和文學。","explanation":"名詞「意識形態」。常用搭配 ideology of (a period/group)。"}],"related_forms":["ideological"]}

{"headword":"idiot","explanation":"名詞「白痴；笨蛋」。這是一個具有冒犯性的詞彙，通常用於批評某人缺乏判斷力或智力。在正式寫作中應謹慎使用。","entries":[{"sentence":"He felt like a complete <target>idiot</target> after he realized that he had accidentally sent the private email to the entire class.","translation":"在他意識到自己不小心把私密郵件發給全班同學後，他覺得自己像個徹頭徹尾的白痴。","explanation":"名詞「白痴」。用於描述感到尷尬或愚蠢的情況。"},{"sentence":"Only an <target>idiot</target> would drive a car without a seatbelt, especially when traveling on a dangerous mountain road during a storm.","translation":"只有白痴才會在暴風雨期間行駛在危險的山路時不繫安全帶開車。","explanation":"名詞「笨蛋」。用於批評某人的愚蠢行為。"}],"related_forms":["idiocy","idiotic"]}

{"headword":"illusion","explanation":"名詞「錯覺；幻想」。指對事物的不正確認知，或視覺上的錯覺。常用片語：under the illusion that... (錯以為...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The mirror in the small room was placed strategically to create an <target>illusion</target> <pattern>of</pattern> space, making the room feel larger.","translation":"小房間裡的鏡子被策略性地放置，以營造出空間感，讓房間感覺更大。","explanation":"名詞「錯覺」。常用搭配 illusion of sth。"},{"sentence":"Many people live <pattern>under</pattern> the <target>illusion</target> <pattern>that</pattern> success comes easily without hard work and persistence over many years.","translation":"許多人處於一種錯覺之中，認為成功不需要多年的努力和堅持就能輕易獲得。","explanation":"名詞「幻想」。片語 under the illusion that... 表示「錯以為...」。"},{"sentence":"The magician's clever tricks created a perfect <target>illusion</target>, making the audience believe that the assistant had actually disappeared from the stage.","translation":"魔術師巧妙的把戲營造出完美的錯覺，使觀眾相信助手真的從舞台上消失了。","explanation":"名詞「錯覺」。指視覺上的假象。"}],"related_forms":["illusory"]}

{"headword":"immense","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的；極大的」。常用於描述尺寸、程度、數量或壓力等。同義詞包括 huge, vast, enormous。","entries":[{"sentence":"The project required an <target>immense</target> <pattern>amount of</pattern> effort and time, but the final results were worth all the hard work.","translation":"這個計畫需要巨大的努力和時間，但最終的結果讓所有辛苦都值得了。","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的」。常用搭配 immense amount of sth。"},{"sentence":"The new museum is an <target>immense</target> building that houses thousands of ancient artifacts from all over the world.","translation":"這座新博物館是一座巨大的建築，收藏了來自世界各地的數千件古代文物。","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的」。描述物理尺寸。"},{"sentence":"Students often feel <target>immense</target> <pattern>pressure</pattern> as the final exams approach, leading some of them to suffer from sleep deprivation.","translation":"隨著期末考接近，學生們經常感到巨大的壓力，導致其中一些人患有睡眠不足。","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的」。描述抽象的壓力或情感。"}],"related_forms":["immensely"]}

{"headword":"immune","explanation":"形容詞「免疫的；不受影響的」。在醫學上指身體能抵抗疾病；在一般語境下指某人不受某種負面影響或規則約束。","entries":[{"sentence":"After receiving the vaccine, most people develop <target>immune</target> <pattern>responses</pattern> that protect them from getting the flu every winter.","translation":"接種疫苗後，大多數人會產生免疫反應，保護他們在每個冬天不會患上流感。","explanation":"形容詞「免疫的」。常用搭配 immune response (免疫反應)。"},{"sentence":"No one is <target>immune</target> <pattern>to</pattern> criticism, and learning how to accept feedback is an essential part of personal growth.","translation":"沒有人能不受批評的影響，而學習如何接受回饋是個人成長的重要部分。","explanation":"形容詞「不受影響的」。常用片語 immune to sth (對...免疫/不受...影響)。"},{"sentence":"The wealthy businessman believed he was <target>immune</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the law, but the judge eventually sentenced him to prison for fraud.","translation":"這位富有的商人認為自己可以不受法律約束，但法官最終因詐欺罪將其判處入獄。","explanation":"形容詞「不受影響的」。指不受法律或規則約束。"}],"related_forms":["immunity","immunize"]}

{"headword":"implement","explanation":"動詞「實施；執行」；名詞「工具」。作為動詞時，常用於計畫、政策或法律的執行。作為名詞時，指完成某項工作所需的工具。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school board decided to <target>implement</target> a new policy <pattern>regarding</pattern> smartphone use in class to improve students' concentration.","translation":"學校董事會決定實施一項關於課堂上使用智慧型手機的新政策，以提高學生的注意力。","explanation":"動詞「實施」。常用搭配 implement a policy/plan/law。"},{"sentence":"It is one thing to have a great idea, but it is another thing to <target>implement</target> it <pattern>effectively</pattern> in a real-world setting.","translation":"有一個好主意是一回事，但在現實環境中有效地執行它又是另一回事。","explanation":"動詞「執行」。"},{"sentence":"Archaeologists found several ancient stone <target>implements</target> <pattern>used for</pattern> farming, providing clues about the lifestyle of early humans.","translation":"考古學家發現了幾件用於耕種的古代石器工具，為早期人類的生活方式提供了線索。","explanation":"名詞「工具」。常用搭配 implements used for sth。"}],"related_forms":["implementation"]}

{"headword": "implication", "explanation": "名詞「暗示；可能影響」。指未直接說明但可推論出的結果或意義。常用片語：have implications for... (對...有影響)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The lawyer argued that the witness's statement had a serious <target>implication</target>, suggesting that the defendant was not telling the truth.", "translation": "律師主張證人的陳述有嚴重的暗示，表明被告不說實話。", "explanation": "名詞「暗示」。指隱含的意義。"}, {"sentence": "The discovery of water on Mars has significant <target>implications</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the search for extraterrestrial life in our solar system.", "translation": "在火星上發現水對我們太陽系中尋找外星生命具有重大影響。", "explanation": "名詞「可能影響」。常用片語 have implications for sth (對...有影響)。"}, {"sentence": "When making a decision, you should consider the long-term <target>implications</target> <pattern>of</pattern> your actions before acting impulsively.", "translation": "在做決定時，你應該在衝動行事前考慮你行為的長期影響。", "explanation": "名詞「可能影響」。常用搭配 implications of sth。"}], "related_forms": ["imply"]}

{"headword":"impulse","explanation":"名詞「衝動；脈衝」。指一種突然且未經思考的慾望。常用片語：on impulse (衝動地)。","entries":[{"sentence":"She bought the expensive dress <pattern>on</pattern> <target>impulse</target> while shopping at the mall, but later regretted it because she didn't need it.","translation":"她在商場購物時衝動地買了那件昂貴的洋裝，但後來後悔了，因為她不需要它。","explanation":"名詞「衝動」。片語 on impulse 表示「衝動地」。"},{"sentence":"The young boy acted <pattern>on</pattern> <target>impulse</target> and jumped into the river to save the drowning dog, showing great courage.","translation":"這個小男孩衝動地跳入河中救那隻快溺水的狗，展現了巨大的勇氣。","explanation":"名詞「衝動」。片語 on impulse 表示「衝動地」。"},{"sentence":"The brain sends an electrical <target>impulse</target> <pattern>through</pattern> the nerves to the muscles, causing them to contract and move the body.","translation":"大腦透過神經將電脈衝傳送到肌肉，導致肌肉收縮並移動身體。","explanation":"名詞「脈衝」。指生理學上的電訊號。"}],"related_forms":["impulsive","impulsively"]}

{"headword":"incentive","explanation":"名詞「激勵、誘因」；形容詞「激勵的」。常考搭配：incentive plan (激勵計劃)、provide an incentive for sb to do sth (提供誘因讓某人做某事)。注意其在職場或教育情境中常用於描述增加動力的方式。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government offered a tax <target>incentive</target> <pattern>to</pattern> companies that invest in green energy to reduce pollution and protect the environment.","translation":"政府為投資綠色能源以減少污染並保護環境的公司提供稅務誘因。","explanation":"名詞「誘因」。指為了鼓勵某種行為而提供的獎勵。"},{"sentence":"The teacher promised a small prize as an <target>incentive</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the students to complete their homework on time every day.","translation":"老師承諾提供一個小獎品作為學生每天準時完成作業的誘因。","explanation":"名詞「激勵」。常用搭配：incentive for sb to do sth。"},{"sentence":"The company's new <target>incentive</target> <pattern>scheme</pattern> encouraged employees to increase productivity by offering bonuses based on their performance.","translation":"公司新的激勵計劃鼓勵員工透過提供基於績效的獎金來提高生產力。","explanation":"名詞「激勵」。常用搭配：incentive scheme/plan。"}],"related_forms":["incentives"]}

{"headword": "incorporate", "explanation": "動詞「將...併入、將...納入」。常用於描述將新元素、想法或公司併入現有系統。常考搭配：incorporate A into B (將 A 納入 B)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The architect decided to <target>incorporate</target> more natural light <pattern>into</pattern> the building design to create a warmer and more welcoming atmosphere.", "translation": "建築師決定在建築設計中納入更多自然光，以營造出更溫暖且更具歡迎感的氛圍。", "explanation": "動詞「納入」。常用搭配：incorporate sth into sth。"}, {"sentence": "The school's new curriculum aims to <target>incorporate</target> digital learning tools <pattern>into</pattern> traditional classroom teaching to enhance students' engagement.", "translation": "學校就新課程旨在將數位學習工具納入傳統的教室教學中，以提高學生的參與度。", "explanation": "動詞「併入」。指將部分元素整合到整體中。"}, {"sentence": "To improve the efficiency of the project, the manager decided to <target>incorporate</target> the latest software updates <pattern>into</pattern> the existing workflow.", "translation": "為了提高專案的效率，經理決定將最新的軟體更新納入現有的工作流程中。", "explanation": "動詞「納入」。常用搭配：incorporate A into B。"}, {"sentence": "After years of operating as a small partnership, the business owners decided to <target>incorporate</target> their company to limit their personal liability.", "translation": "在經營數年作為小型合夥企業後，商業所有者決定將其公司法人化，以限制其個人責任。", "explanation": "動詞「法人化」。指將公司成立為法人公司。"}], "related_forms": ["incorporation", "incorporated"]}

{"headword":"index","explanation":"名詞「索引、指數」；動詞「為...編索引」。名詞用法中最常見的是書本末尾的 index (索引) 或經濟指標如 CPI (消費者物價指數)。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you cannot find the specific topic in the book, you should check the <target>index</target> <pattern>at the back</pattern> to find the page number.","translation":"如果你在書中找不到特定主題，你應該查看書末的索引以找到頁碼。","explanation":"名詞「索引」。指書本中按字母順序排列的關鍵詞清單。"},{"sentence":"Economists often use the consumer price <target>index</target> as a measure <pattern>of</pattern> inflation to understand how the cost of living changes.","translation":"經濟學家經常使用消費者物價指數作為衡量通貨膨脹的指標，以了解生活成本如何變化。","explanation":"名詞「指數」。指用來衡量某種變化的數值。"},{"sentence":"The librarian spent several hours <target>indexing</target> the new collection of rare manuscripts to make them easier for researchers to locate.","translation":"圖書管理員花了幾個小時為新的稀有手稿集編索引，以便研究人員更容易地找到它們。","explanation":"動詞「為...編索引」。"}],"related_forms":["indexed","indexing"]}

{"headword":"indifferent","explanation":"形容詞「冷漠的、不在乎的」。注意與 different (不同的) 區分，indifferent 並非 different 的反義詞（指「不不同」），而是指一種缺乏興趣或關心的狀態。常用搭配：be indifferent to sth/sb (對...冷漠/不在乎)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite the urgent warnings about climate change, some people remain <target>indifferent</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the environmental crisis and refuse to change their habits.","translation":"儘管有關於氣候變遷的緊急警告，有些人仍然對環境危機冷漠，並拒絕改變他們的習慣。","explanation":"形容詞「冷漠的」。常用搭配：be indifferent to sth。"},{"sentence":"The student seemed <target>indifferent</target> <pattern>to</pattern> his poor grades, which worried his parents because he didn't seem to care about his future.","translation":"這名學生似乎對他的糟糕成績不在乎，這讓他的父母很擔心，因為他似乎並不關心自己的未來。","explanation":"形容詞「不在乎的」。"}],"related_forms":["indifferently","indifference"]}

{"headword":"indigenous","explanation":"形容詞「本土的、土著的」。常用於描述植物、動物或原住民。常考搭配：indigenous people (原住民)、indigenous species (本土物種)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The biology teacher explained that the kangaroo is <target>indigenous</target> <pattern>to</pattern> Australia and cannot be found naturally in other parts of the world.","translation":"生物老師解釋說袋鼠是澳洲本土的，在世界其他地方自然地找不到。","explanation":"形容詞「本土的」。常用搭配：be indigenous to a place。"},{"sentence":"Researchers are studying the traditional knowledge of <target>indigenous</target> <pattern>people</pattern> to find new ways to treat rare diseases using natural plants.","translation":"研究人員正在研究原住民的傳統知識，以便利用天然植物尋找治療罕見疾病的新方法。","explanation":"形容詞「土著的」。常用搭配：indigenous people。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"indispensable","explanation":"形容詞「不可或缺的」。與 essential, crucial, vital 同義。常用搭配：be indispensable to/for sth (對...不可或缺)。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the modern digital age, a reliable internet connection has become <target>indispensable</target> <pattern>for</pattern> students to conduct research and complete assignments.","translation":"在現代數位時代，可靠的網路連接已成為學生進行研究和完成作業不可或缺的條件。","explanation":"形容詞「不可或缺的」。"},{"sentence":"The experienced assistant proved to be <target>indispensable</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the manager, as she handled all the complicated schedules and client communications perfectly.","translation":"這位經驗豐富的助理證明了自己對經理來說是不可或缺的，因為她完美地處理了所有複雜的行程表和客戶溝通。","explanation":"形容詞「不可或缺」。常用搭配：be indispensable to sb。"}],"related_forms":["indispensably"]}
