{"headword":"indulge","explanation":"動詞「縱容、沉溺於」。常用於描述滿足欲望或享受快感。常考搭配：indulge in sth (沉溺於/享受...)。注意其名詞形式 indulgence (縱容/享受)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After a week of hard studying for the final exams, the students decided to <target>indulge</target> <pattern>in</pattern> a large chocolate cake to reward themselves.","translation":"在為期一週的期末考苦讀後，學生們決定享用一個大巧克力蛋糕來獎勵自己。","explanation":"動詞「享受」。常用搭配：indulge in sth。"},{"sentence":"Parents should be careful not to <target>indulge</target> their children <pattern>too much</pattern>, or the kids might grow up without learning how to be disciplined.","translation":"父母應該小心不要過度縱容孩子，否則孩子長大後可能學不會如何自律。","explanation":"動詞「縱容」。指允許某人做他們想做但可能不健康或不正確的事。"},{"sentence":"During his vacation in Italy, he loved to <target>indulge</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the local street food, trying every single dish he found interesting.","translation":"在他義大利的假期中，他熱愛沉溺於當地街頭小吃，嘗試每一道他覺得有趣的菜餚。","explanation":"動詞「沉溺於」。"}],"related_forms":["indulgent","indulgence"]}

{"headword":"inevitable","explanation":"形容詞「不可避免的」。常考搭配：it is inevitable that... (不可避免的是...)。注意其名詞形式 inevitability (不可避免性)。","entries":[{"sentence":"With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, it is <target>inevitable</target> <pattern>that</pattern> some traditional jobs will be replaced by machines in the future.","translation":"隨著人工智慧的快速發展，未來某些傳統工作被機器取代是不可避免的。","explanation":"形容詞「不可避免的」。常用句型：It is inevitable that..."},{"sentence":"After weeks of dark clouds and heavy rain, the flood was <target>inevitable</target>, as the river banks could no longer hold the water.","translation":"經過數週的雲層昏暗和暴雨，洪水是不可避免的，因為河岸已無法再承受水流量。","explanation":"形容詞「不可避免的」。指必然會發生的事。"}],"related_forms":["inevitably"]}

{"headword":"infect","explanation":"動詞「感染」。常用於描述病原體使某人染病。常考搭配：be infected with sth (被...感染)。注意區分 infect (使感染) 與 be infected (被感染) 的主動與被動用法。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctor warned the patients that they could easily be <target>infected</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the virus if they did not wear masks in crowded places.","translation":"醫生警告患者，如果他們在擁擠的地方不戴口罩，很容易被病毒感染。","explanation":"動詞「感染」。常用被動語態：be infected with sth。"},{"sentence":"Poor sanitation in the old city center made it easier for bacteria to <target>infect</target> the local residents, leading to a sudden outbreak of illness.","translation":"舊市中心糟糕的衛生條件使得細菌更容易感染當地居民，導致疾病突然爆發。","explanation":"動詞「感染」。指病原體主動使人染病。"}],"related_forms":["infection","infectious"]}

{"headword": "infinite", "explanation": "形容詞「無限的、無邊的」。常用於描述數量、空間或可能性。常用搭配：infinite patience (無限的耐心)、infinite possibilities (無限的可能性)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The astronomer explained that the universe is <target>infinite</target> <pattern>in</pattern> size, containing billions of galaxies and stars that we cannot even imagine.", "translation": "天文學家解釋說宇宙在尺寸上是無限的，包含數十億個星系和恆星，我們甚至無法想像。", "explanation": "形容詞「無限的」。常用搭配：infinite in size。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher had <target>infinite</target> <pattern>patience</pattern> with the students, always explaining the difficult concepts again and again until everyone understood.", "translation": "老師對學生有著無限的耐心，總是反覆解釋困難了概念，直到每個人都理解為止。", "explanation": "形容詞「無限的」。常用搭配：infinite patience。"}, {"sentence": "With the help of the internet, students now have <target>infinite</target> <pattern>possibilities</pattern> for learning, as they can access information from all over the world.", "translation": "借助網路的幫助，學生現在擁有無限的學習可能性，因為他們可以獲取來自全世界的資訊。", "explanation": "形容詞「無限的」。常用搭配：infinite possibilities。"}], "related_forms": ["infinitely"]}

{"headword":"infrastructure","explanation":"名詞「基礎建設」。指一個社會、城市或組織運作所需的基本物理或組織結構，如道路、橋樑、電力系統或通訊網路。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government decided to invest more money in the city's <target>infrastructure</target>, including new bridges and better public transportation systems.","translation":"政府決定投資更多資金於城市的基礎建設，包括新橋樑和更好的公共交通系統。","explanation":"名詞「基礎建設」。指物理上的硬體設備。"},{"sentence":"The sudden increase in tourists put a great strain on the island's <target>infrastructure</target>, leading to traffic jams and water shortages.","translation":"遊客的突然增加給島上的基礎建設帶來了巨大壓力，導致交通堵塞和用水短缺。","explanation":"名詞「基礎建設」。描述基礎設施在面對高需求時的壓力。"}],"related_forms":["infrastructures"]}

{"headword":"inherent","explanation":"形容詞「內在的、固有的」。指某種特質、風險或能力是事物本身的一部分，無法分開。常用搭配 inherent in sth (某事中固有的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many investors realize that there is an <target>inherent</target> <pattern>risk</pattern> <pattern>in</pattern> investing in the stock market, regardless of how stable the company seems.","translation":"許多投資者意識到，無論公司看起來多麼穩定，投資股票市場都有內在的風險。","explanation":"形容詞「內在的」。常用搭配 inherent risk (內在風險)。"},{"sentence":"The teacher explained that the <target>inherent</target> <pattern>beauty</pattern> of the poem lies in its simple language and deep emotional expression.","translation":"老師解釋說，這首詩的內在美在於其簡單的語言和深沉的情感表達。","explanation":"形容詞「內在的」。描述事物本身固有的美感。"}],"related_forms":["inherently"]}

{"headword":"inherit","explanation":"動詞「繼承」。可指繼承財產、地位，或繼承生物遺傳特徵。常用搭配 inherit from sth/sb (從...繼承)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After his grandfather passed away, the young man <target>inherited</target> a large house and several pieces of valuable art <pattern>from</pattern> his family.","translation":"祖父去世後，這名年輕人從家人那裡繼承了一棟大房子和幾件昂貴的藝術品。","explanation":"動詞「繼承」。指繼承物質財產。"},{"sentence":"The scientist discovered that the children <target>inherited</target> certain physical traits, such as blue eyes and curly hair, <pattern>from</pattern> their parents.","translation":"科學家發現孩子們從父母那裡繼承了某些身體特徵，例如藍色眼睛和捲髮。","explanation":"動詞「繼承」。指遺傳生物特徵。"}],"related_forms":["inheritance","inheritability"]}

{"headword":"initiate","explanation":"動詞「開始、發起」；形容詞「入會的、啟蒙的」；名詞「新入會者」。在 GSAT 中最常見為動詞用法，指啟動一個計劃、過程或程序。常用搭配 initiate a plan/process (發起計劃/過程)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school board decided to <target>initiate</target> a new program to help students improve their speaking skills through weekly debate competitions.","translation":"學校董事會決定發起一個新計畫，透過每週的辯論比賽來幫助學生提高口說能力。","explanation":"動詞「發起」。指啟動一個正式的計劃。"},{"sentence":"The government plans to <target>initiate</target> a series of reforms to reduce pollution and protect the local environment for future generations.","translation":"政府計劃啟動一系列改革，以減少污染並保護當地環境以造福後代。","explanation":"動詞「啟動」。指開始一個正式的過程。"},{"sentence":"The secret society used a special ceremony to <target>initiate</target> new members into the group, ensuring they understood the rules.","translation":"秘密社團使用一種特殊的儀式將新成員納入其中，確保他們理解相關規則。","explanation":"動詞「使入會」。指通過儀式讓某人加入某組織。"}],"related_forms":["initiation","initiator"]}

{"headword": "initiative", "explanation": "名詞「主動權、倡議、新計畫」；形容詞「主動的」。名詞用法中，take the initiative (採取主動) 是極其重要的片語。形容詞用法常描述人的工作態度。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Instead of waiting for the teacher to give instructions, the student <pattern>took</pattern> the <target>initiative</target> to start the research project early.", "translation": "這名學生沒有等待老師給指令，而是採取主動，提前開始研究計畫。", "explanation": "名詞「主動權」。常用片語 take the initiative (採取主動)。"}, {"sentence": "The local community launched a new <target>initiative</target> to clean up the city's parks and plant more trees along the streets.", "translation": "當地社區發起了一項新倡議，旨在清理城市公園並在街道兩旁種更多樹。", "explanation": "名詞「倡議/新計畫」。指為了改善情況而採取的一系列行動。"}, {"sentence": "Employers value staff who <pattern>show</pattern> <target>initiative</target> and can solve problems independently without needing constant supervision from their managers.", "translation": "雇主非常看重那些具有主動性且能獨立解決問題，而不需要經理不斷監督的員工。", "explanation": "名詞「主動權/主動性」。常用搭配 show initiative。"}], "related_forms": ["initiate"]}

{"headword":"inject","explanation":"動詞「注射、注入」。可指醫學上的注射，也可比喻指注入資金、能量或新想法以改善情況。","entries":[{"sentence":"The nurse carefully <target>injected</target> the vaccine <pattern>into</pattern> the patient's arm to protect him from the flu during the winter season.","translation":"護理師小心地將疫苗注射到患者的手臂中，以保護他在冬季免受流感的影響。","explanation":"動詞「注射」。常用搭配 inject sth into sth。"},{"sentence":"The government decided to <target>inject</target> more capital <pattern>into</pattern> the struggling economy to create more jobs and stimulate growth.","translation":"政府決定向掙扎中的經濟注入更多資金，以創造更多就業機會並刺激增長。","explanation":"動詞「注入」。比喻用法，指注入資金以改善經濟。"},{"sentence":"The director tried to <target>inject</target> some humor <pattern>into</pattern> the boring speech to make the audience feel more relaxed and interested.","translation":"導演試圖在枯燥的演講中注入一些幽默感，讓聽眾感到更輕鬆且感興趣。","explanation":"動詞「注入」。比喻用法，指將某種特質注入到某事中。"}],"related_forms":["injection"]}

{"headword":"injection","explanation":"名詞「注射、注劑」。通常指醫學上的注射行為或注射的藥物。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctor gave the patient a quick <target>injection</target> of pain medication to reduce the inflammation and speed up the recovery process.","translation":"醫生給患者快速注射了一劑止痛藥，以減輕炎症並加速康復過程。","explanation":"名詞「注射」。指醫學上的注射行為。"},{"sentence":"Many children are afraid of needles, so the nurse used a small distraction to make the <target>injection</target> less frightening for them.","translation":"許多孩子害怕針頭，所以護理師使用了一種小小的分心法，讓他們覺得注射沒那麼可怕。","explanation":"名詞「注射」。"}],"related_forms":["inject"]}

{"headword":"inning","explanation":"名詞「局（棒球等）」。在運動賽事中指一個比賽單元。在比喻用法中， lapped an inning (過時了一局) 或 have another inning (再次獲得機會) 可能出現。","entries":[{"sentence":"The pitcher threw a great game, but the opposing team managed to score three runs in the fifth <target>inning</target> of the match.","translation":"投手表現出色，但對手在比賽的第五局成功地得分三分。","explanation":"名詞「局」。指棒球比賽中的一個時間單元。"},{"sentence":"After a difficult start to the season, the athlete hoped to have another <target>inning</target> at the professional level to prove his skill.","translation":"在賽季開端面臨困難後，這名運動員希望在專業水準能再次獲得機會，以證明他的技能。","explanation":"名詞「局」。比喻用法，指再次獲得機會或嘗試。"}],"related_forms":["innings"]}

{"headword":"innovation","explanation":"名詞「創新」。指引入新方法、新想法或新產品。常用搭配 drive innovation (推動創新), technological innovation (科技創新)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company's success is mainly due to its constant <target>innovation</target> in the field of renewable energy and sustainable materials.","translation":"這家公司的成功主要歸功於其在可再生能源和永續材料領域的持續創新。","explanation":"名詞「創新」。描述公司競爭力的來源。"},{"sentence":"Educational <target>innovation</target> is necessary to prepare students for the future, as traditional teaching methods may not be enough for the digital age.","translation":"教育創新對於準備學生迎接未來是必要的，因為傳統的教學方法對於數位時代可能不足夠。","explanation":"名詞「創新」。指在教育方法上的更新。"}],"related_forms":["innovate","innovative"]}

{"headword":"innovative","explanation":"形容詞「創新的、新穎的」。描述一種新方法或想法，通常帶有正面的評價。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young engineer proposed an <target>innovative</target> <pattern>design</pattern> for a new bridge that could withstand strong earthquakes and heavy winds.","translation":"這名年輕工程師為一座新橋樑提出了一個創新的設計，能夠承受強烈的地震和強風。","explanation":"形容詞「創新的」。常用搭配 innovative design (創新設計)。"},{"sentence":"Using virtual reality in the classroom is an <target>innovative</target> <pattern>approach</pattern> to learning history, making the lessons more engaging for students.","translation":"在教室中使用虛擬實境是一種創新的學習歷史方法，使課程對學生來說更有吸引力。","explanation":"形容詞「創新的」。常用搭配 innovative approach (創新方法)。"}],"related_forms":["innovation","innovate"]}

{"headword":"inquiry","explanation":"名詞「詢問；調查」。常用於正式場合，指對某事進行詳細的詢問或官方調查。注意搭配 in response to an inquiry (回應詢問) 或 make an inquiry into (對...進行調查)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The customer sent a formal <target>inquiry</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the company regarding the delivery status of his order, hoping for a quick reply.","translation":"顧客向公司發送了一封正式詢問，關於其訂單的遞送狀態，希望得到快速回覆。","explanation":"名詞「詢問」。常用搭配：make an inquiry to sb/sth。"},{"sentence":"The government launched a thorough <target>inquiry</target> <pattern>into</pattern> the cause of the train accident to prevent similar tragedies from happening again.","translation":"政府對火車事故的原因啟動了徹底調查，以防止類似的悲劇再次發生。","explanation":"名詞「調查」。常用搭配：an inquiry into sth。"}],"related_forms":["inquire"]}

{"headword":"insane","explanation":"形容詞「瘋狂的；精神失常的」。可以用於描述精神疾病，也可以在非正式語境中描述極其不理智的行為。常用搭配 drive someone insane (使某人發瘋)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The constant noise from the construction site next door was starting to drive the students <target>insane</target>, making it impossible to study.","translation":"隔壁建築工地不斷傳來的噪音開始讓學生們發瘋，使他們根本無法讀書。","explanation":"形容詞「瘋狂的」。常用搭配：drive someone insane (使某人發瘋)。"},{"sentence":"The judge had to decide if the defendant was legally <target>insane</target> at the time of the crime, which would affect the final verdict.","translation":"法官必須決定被告在犯罪時是否在法律上精神失常，這將影響最終的判決。","explanation":"形容詞「精神失常的」。"}],"related_forms":["insanity"]}

{"headword":"insight","explanation":"名詞「洞察力；深刻的見解」。指對某事物的本質或真實情況有深刻的理解。常用搭配 gain insight into (洞察/獲取對...的深刻見解)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Reading books from different cultures allows students to gain a deeper <target>insight</target> <pattern>into</pattern> how people live and think around the world.","translation":"閱讀不同文化的書籍讓學生能對世界各地人們的生活和思考方式獲得更深刻的見解。","explanation":"名詞「洞察力；見解」。常用搭配：gain insight into sth。"},{"sentence":"The professor's lecture provided a valuable <target>insight</target> <pattern>into</pattern> the complex psychological factors that influence human behavior in social situations.","translation":"教授的講座提供了關於影響社交情況下人類行為之複雜心理因素的寶貴見解。","explanation":"名詞「深刻的見解」。常用搭配：provide insight into sth。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"installation","explanation":"名詞「安裝；設施」。可用於描述安裝設備（如軟體、家電）或指已安裝的設備/軍事設施。常用搭配 install sth in/on (安裝...於)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The IT department spent the entire afternoon on the <target>installation</target> of the new computer software, ensuring every student had access to it.","translation":"資訊部門花了一整個下午安裝新的電腦軟體，確保每位學生都能使用它。","explanation":"名詞「安裝」。指將設備或軟體放置在正確位置以供使用的過程。"},{"sentence":"The city government decided to build a new art <target>installation</target> in the central park to promote local artists and attract more tourists.","translation":"市政府決定在中央公園建造一個新的藝術裝置，以推廣當地藝術家並吸引更多遊客。","explanation":"名詞「設施；裝置」。指特製的藝術品或設備。"}],"related_forms":["install"]}

{"headword":"institute","explanation":"名詞「學院；協會」；動詞「制定；開始」。名詞指專業研究或教育機構；動詞常用於正式地開始某項程序、法律或制度。常用搭配 institute a policy (制定政策)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The research <target>institute</target> is famous for its groundbreaking work in cancer treatment, attracting scientists from all over the world.","translation":"這家研究學院以其在癌症治療方面的突破性工作而聞名，吸引了世界各地的科學家。","explanation":"名詞「學院；研究所」。"},{"sentence":"To improve campus safety, the school decided to <target>institute</target> a new set of rules <pattern>regarding</pattern> visitor access to the classrooms.","translation":"為了提高校園安全，學校決定制定一套關於訪客進入教室的新規則。","explanation":"動詞「制定；開始」。常用搭配：institute a policy/rule/law。"}],"related_forms":["institutional"]}

{"headword": "institution", "explanation": "名詞「制度；機構」。指長期存在的社會習慣或法律系統，或指大型的公共機構（如大學、醫院）。常用搭配 social institution (社會制度)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Marriage is often viewed as a fundamental social <target>institution</target> that provides stability and support for families and children in many cultures.", "translation": "婚姻通常被視為一種基本的社會制度，在許多文化中為家庭和孩子提供穩定與支持。", "explanation": "名詞「制度」。指被社會認可的習慣或體系。"}, {"sentence": "The university is a prestigious educational <target>institution</target> known for its high academic standards and exceptional research opportunities for students.", "translation": "這所大學是一所著名的教育機構，以其高學術標準和為學生提供卓越研究機會而聞名。", "explanation": "名詞「機構」。指大型的公共組織。"}, {"sentence": "The government established a new financial <target>institution</target> to provide low-interest loans to young entrepreneurs starting their own small businesses.", "translation": "政府建立了一家新的金融機構，為開始創業的年輕企業家提供低利貸款。", "explanation": "名詞「機構」。指專業的組織或體系。"}, {"sentence": "The tradition of elder care is a deeply rooted social <target>institution</target> in many Asian cultures, reflecting a strong sense of filial piety.", "translation": "照顧長輩的傳統在許多亞洲文化中是一種根深蒂固的社會制度，反映了強烈的孝心。", "explanation": "名詞「制度」。指社會習慣。"}, {"sentence": "Many patients believe that the medical <target>institution</target> they visited was more efficient than the smaller clinics in their hometowns.", "translation": "許多患者認為他們就診的醫療機構比他們家鄉的小診所更有效率。", "explanation": "名詞「機構」。指醫療服務組織。"}], "related_forms": ["institutional", "institutionalize"]}

{"headword":"intact","explanation":"形容詞「完整無缺的」。指某物在經歷過損害、攻擊或變化後依然保持原樣。常用搭配 remain intact (保持完整)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite the severe earthquake that hit the city, the old library building remained <target>intact</target>, surprisingly saving all the rare books inside.","translation":"儘管城市遭受了劇烈地震，舊圖書館建築依然保持完整，令人驚訝地保存了所有內部的稀有書籍。","explanation":"形容詞「完整無缺的」。常用搭配：remain intact。"},{"sentence":"The archaeologists were thrilled to find that the ancient pottery was still <target>intact</target> after being buried underground for thousands of years.","translation":"考古學家很高興地發現，這些古代陶器在地下埋藏數千年後依然完整無缺。","explanation":"形容詞「完整無缺的」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"integrate","explanation":"動詞「整合；使融合」。指將不同部分結合在一起形成一個整體，或指將某人融入一個群體中。常用搭配 integrate A into B (將A整合進B)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new curriculum aims to <target>integrate</target> technology <pattern>into</pattern> the classroom to help students learn more effectively and creatively.","translation":"新課程旨在將科技整合進教室，以幫助學生更有效率且更有創意地學習。","explanation":"動詞「整合」。常用搭配：integrate sth into sth。"},{"sentence":"It can be challenging for international students to <target>integrate</target> <pattern>into</pattern> the local community and adapt to the different cultural norms.","translation":"對國際學生來說，融入當地社區並適應不同的文化規範可能是具有挑戰性的。","explanation":"動詞「融合；融入」。常用搭配：integrate into a group/community。"}],"related_forms":["integration","integrative"]}

{"headword":"integration","explanation":"名詞「整合；融合」。指將不同部分結合在一起的過程。常用搭配 social integration (社會融合), cultural integration (文化融合)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The successful <target>integration</target> <pattern>of</pattern> new employees <pattern>into</pattern> the company culture is essential for maintaining a productive and happy workplace.","translation":"將新員工成功融合進公司文化中，對於維持一個高效且快樂的工作環境至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「整合；融合」。常用搭配：the integration of A into B。"},{"sentence":"Many cities are working on the <target>integration</target> <pattern>of</pattern> renewable energy sources into the city's power grid to reduce carbon emissions.","translation":"許多城市正致力於將再生能源整合進城市電網中，以減少碳排放。","explanation":"名詞「整合」。常用搭配：the integration of sth into sth。"}],"related_forms":["integrate"]}

{"headword":"integrity","explanation":"名詞「誠實；正直；完整性」。指一個人堅持道德原則的誠實，或指一個系統/物體的完整性。常用搭配 a man of integrity (一個正直的人)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher praised the student for his <target>integrity</target> when he admitted his mistake and refused to cheat on the final exam.","translation":"老師稱讚這名學生在承認錯誤且拒絕在期末考作弊時表現出的誠實。","explanation":"名詞「誠實；正直」。指堅持道德準則。"},{"sentence":"Engineers must check the structural <target>integrity</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the bridge after the storm to ensure it is safe for cars to cross.","translation":"風暴後，工程師必須檢查橋樑的結構完整性，以確保汽車通過是安全的。","explanation":"名詞「完整性」。常用搭配：the integrity of sth。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"intensify","explanation":"動詞，意為「加強」或「強化」。常用於描述程度、強度、壓力或衝突的增加。常見搭配：intensify the effort (加強努力), intensify the search (強化搜尋)。","entries":[{"sentence":"As the deadline approached, the pressure on the students to complete their final projects began to <target>intensify</target>, causing many to feel stressed.","translation":"隨著截稿日期的臨近，學生完成期末專題的壓力開始增加，導致許多人感到壓力很大。","explanation":"動詞「加強、增加」。指壓力或程度的提升。"},{"sentence":"The government decided to <target>intensify</target> its <pattern>efforts</pattern> <pattern>to</pattern> combat climate change by implementing stricter environmental regulations.","translation":"政府決定透過實施更嚴格的環境法規，來加強對抗氣候變遷的努力。","explanation":"動詞「加強」。常用搭配：intensify efforts to V (加強努力做某事)。"},{"sentence":"The rain continued to <target>intensify</target> throughout the evening, making it nearly impossible for the drivers to see the road clearly.","translation":"雨勢在整個晚上持續加強，使得駕駛員幾乎無法清楚地看到道路。","explanation":"動詞「強化」。指自然現象（如雨、風）強度的增加。"}],"related_forms":["intensified","intensification","intense"]}

{"headword": "intent", "explanation": "名詞「意圖、目的」；形容詞「專注的」。名詞常用於法律或正式語境，搭配介係詞 on。形容詞常用於搭配 be intent on (專注於.../一心想...)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The lawyer argued that the suspect had no criminal <target>intent</target> when the accident happened, making the crime less severe.", "translation": "律師辯稱，事故發生時嫌疑人並沒有犯罪意圖，使這項罪行較輕。", "explanation": "名詞「意圖」。指做某事的目的或計畫。"}, {"sentence": "The young pianist was so <target>intent</target> <pattern>on</pattern> practicing her most difficult piece that she didn't notice her teacher enter the room.", "translation": "這位年輕的鋼琴家如此專注於練習她最困難的曲目，以至於沒有注意到老師進入房間。", "explanation": "形容詞「專注的」。片語 be intent on (doing) sth 表「專注於...」。"}, {"sentence": "The suspect's <target>intentions</target> were questioned by the police after they found several suspicious documents in his briefcase.", "translation": "在警方於其公事包中發現幾份可疑文件後，嫌疑人的意圖受到了質疑。", "explanation": "名詞「意圖、目的」。intentions 是 intent 的常見複數形式。"}], "related_forms": ["intention", "intentionally"]}

{"headword":"interference","explanation":"名詞，意為「干涉」或「干擾」。常用於描述第三方介入某事或電子訊號的干擾。常用搭配：interference in (干涉...), interference from (來自...的干擾)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher requested that parents avoid unnecessary <target>interference</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the classroom's grading process to maintain fairness for all students.","translation":"老師要求家長避免對教室的評分過程進行不必要的干涉，以維持對所有學生的公平。","explanation":"名詞「干涉」。指介入他人事務。搭配介系詞 in。"},{"sentence":"The hikers experienced significant radio <target>interference</target> due to the mountain's magnetic field, making it hard to contact the rescue team.","translation":"由於山脈的磁場，登山客遇到了嚴重的無線電干擾，使得很難與救援隊取得聯繫。","explanation":"名詞「干擾」。指物理或電訊號的干擾。"},{"sentence":"Without constant <target>interference</target> <pattern>from</pattern> her younger brother, she could finally focus on her homework and finish it more quickly.","translation":"如果沒有弟弟不斷的干擾，她終於可以專注於功課並更快地完成。","explanation":"名詞「干擾」。指被他人打擾。搭配介系詞 from。"}],"related_forms":["interfere"]}

{"headword":"interior","explanation":"形容詞「內部的」；名詞「內部」。形容詞常用於描述建築、車輛或身體內部。名詞則可指一個空間的內部或一個國家的內陸地帶。","entries":[{"sentence":"The designer focused on the <target>interior</target> decorations of the house, choosing soft colors and modern furniture to create a relaxing atmosphere.","translation":"設計師專注於房子的內部裝飾，選擇柔和的顏色和現代家具以營造放鬆的氛圍。","explanation":"形容詞「內部的」。"},{"sentence":"The car's <target>interior</target> was made of high-quality leather, which made the vehicle feel much more luxurious and comfortable for the passengers.","translation":"這輛車的內部是由高品質皮革製成的，這使得乘客感到車輛更加豪華舒適。","explanation":"名詞「內部」。指車輛或建築的內部空間。"},{"sentence":"Early explorers faced many dangers when they traveled into the <target>interior</target> of the continent, as there were no maps for those regions.","translation":"早期的探險家在進入大陸內部（內陸）旅行時面臨許多危險，因為那些地區沒有地圖。","explanation":"名詞「內部/內陸」。指一個地理區域的中心地帶。"}],"related_forms":["interiorly"]}

{"headword":"interpretation","explanation":"名詞，意為「解釋」或「口譯」。指對某種意義的理解或對外語的即時翻譯。常用搭配：interpretation of (對...的解釋/理解)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two historians had a different <target>interpretation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the ancient text, leading to a long debate about its true meaning.","translation":"兩位歷史學家對這篇古文有不同的解釋，導致關於其真正含義的長期爭論。","explanation":"名詞「解釋、理解」。指對資訊的解讀方式。"},{"sentence":"Since the diplomat did not speak the local language, he relied on the <target>interpretation</target> provided by his assistant during the meeting.","translation":"由於外交官不會說當地語言，他在會議期間依賴助手提供的口譯。","explanation":"名詞「口譯」。指將一種語言即時翻譯成另一種語言。"},{"sentence":"The actor's unique <target>interpretation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the character made the play more interesting and gave the audience a new perspective.","translation":"這位演員對角色的獨特詮釋，使這齣戲變得更有趣，並給觀眾帶來了新的視角。","explanation":"名詞「詮釋」。指在藝術或表演中對角色的理解。"}],"related_forms":["interpret"]}

{"headword":"interval","explanation":"名詞，意為「間隔」或「間歇」。指時間或空間上的距離。常見搭配：at regular intervals (定期地/等距地), time interval (時間間隔)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The security guard walked around the building <pattern>at</pattern> <target>regular</target> <target>intervals</target> to ensure that all the doors were locked.","translation":"保全人員定期地在建築物周圍巡邏，以確保所有的門都鎖上了。","explanation":"名詞「間隔」。片語 at regular intervals 表示「定期地」或「等距地」。"},{"sentence":"During the long play, there was a fifteen-minute <target>interval</target> for the audience to stretch their legs and buy some drinks.","translation":"在長篇劇目中，有十五分鐘的間歇，讓觀眾伸展腿部並買些飲料。","explanation":"名詞「間歇」。指在活動中暫停的一段時間。"},{"sentence":"The scientist measured the <target>interval</target> <pattern>between</pattern> the two chemical reactions to determine how fast the process was happening.","translation":"科學家測量了兩次化學反應之間的時間間隔，以確定過程進行的速度有多快。","explanation":"名詞「間隔」。指兩個事件或物體之間的距離。"}],"related_forms":["intervals"]}

{"headword":"intervention","explanation":"名詞，意為「干預」或「介入」。通常指為了改善情況或防止惡化而採取行動。常用搭配：intervention in (干預...), humanitarian intervention (人道干預)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government's early <target>intervention</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the economic crisis helped prevent the country from falling into a deeper depression.","translation":"政府在經濟危機早期的干預幫助該國免於陷入更深層的蕭條。","explanation":"名詞「干預」。指政府或權威機構採取行動以控制情況。"},{"sentence":"The school counselor's <target>intervention</target> was necessary to resolve the conflict between the two students before it turned into a physical fight.","translation":"學校輔導員的介入是必要的，以在衝突演變成肢體衝突之前解決兩名學生之間的矛盾。","explanation":"名詞「介入」。指第三方介入以解決問題。"},{"sentence":"International organizations often call for humanitarian <target>intervention</target> when a country's citizens are facing severe human rights abuses.","translation":"當一個國家的公民面臨嚴重的人權侵害時，國際組織經常呼籲進行人道干預。","explanation":"名詞「干預」。humanitarian intervention 指「人道干預」。"}],"related_forms":["intervene"]}

{"headword":"investigator","explanation":"名詞，意為「調查員」或「偵探」。指負責調查事件、犯罪或事故的人。常用搭配：private investigator (私人偵探), lead investigator (首席調查員)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The lead <target>investigator</target> spent several weeks analyzing the evidence found at the crime scene to identify the suspect.","translation":"首席調查員花了幾個星期分析在犯罪現場發現的證據，以識別嫌疑人。","explanation":"名詞「調查員」。指負責案件調查的專業人員。"},{"sentence":"After the plane crash, an independent <target>investigator</target> was hired to determine the exact cause of the accident and prevent future occurrences.","translation":"飛機失事後，一名獨立調查員被聘請來確定事故的確切原因並防止未來再次發生。","explanation":"名詞「調查員」。指對特定事故進行技術調查的人。"},{"sentence":"The company hired a private <target>investigator</target> to find out if any of its employees were leaking confidential information to competitors.","translation":"公司聘請了一名私人偵探來查明是否有任何員工將機密資訊洩漏給競爭對手。","explanation":"名詞「私人偵探」。private investigator 常指私人偵探。"}],"related_forms":["investigate","investigation"]}

{"headword":"irony","explanation":"名詞，意為「諷刺」。指實際情況與預期或表達的含義完全相反，導致一種幽默或悲劇性的效果。常用搭配：the irony of (...的諷刺之處)。","entries":[{"sentence":"It was a great <target>irony</target> that the man who spent his whole life studying safety rules eventually died in a simple accident.","translation":"這個花了一輩子研究安全規則的人最終死於一場簡單的意外，這真是極大的諷刺。","explanation":"名詞「諷刺」。指實際結果與預期完全相反。"},{"sentence":"The <target>irony</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the situation was that the fire station burned down while the firefighters were away on a training course.","translation":"這情況的諷刺之處在於，消防局在消防員們外出參加培訓課程時被燒毀了。","explanation":"名詞「諷刺」。片語 the irony of...。"},{"sentence":"He spoke with a touch of <target>irony</target> when he mentioned that his brand new expensive car had broken down on the first day.","translation":"當他提到他那輛嶄新且昂貴的汽車在第一天就故障時，說話帶著一絲諷刺。","explanation":"名詞「諷刺」。指說話語氣中的諷刺感。"}],"related_forms":["ironic","ironically"]}

{"headword":"journalism","explanation":"名詞，意為「新聞業」或「新聞學」。指收集、撰寫和報導新聞的專業活動。常用搭配：investigative journalism (調查報導), citizen journalism (公民新聞)。","entries":[{"sentence":"She decided to major in <target>journalism</target> because she wanted to hold powerful people accountable by reporting the truth to the public.","translation":"她決定主修新聞學，因為她想透過向大眾報導真相來讓權力者承擔責任。","explanation":"名詞「新聞學」。指大學的學科。"},{"sentence":"Investigative <target>journalism</target> plays a crucial role in a democratic society by exposing corruption and hidden scandals in the government.","translation":"調查報導在民主社會中扮演關鍵角色，透過揭露政府的腐敗和隱藏的醜聞。","explanation":"名詞「新聞業」。investigative journalism 指「調查報導」。"},{"sentence":"The rise of social media has changed the nature of <target>journalism</target>, allowing ordinary citizens to report news in real-time from anywhere.","translation":"社群媒體的興起改變了新聞業的性質，使得普通公民能夠從任何地方即時報導新聞。","explanation":"名詞「新聞業」。指整個行業。"}],"related_forms":["journalist","journalistic"]}

{"headword":"journalist","explanation":"名詞「記者」。指從事新聞採集、撰寫與報導的人。常用搭配 include investigative journalist (調查記者) 或 freelance journalist (自由記者)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>journalist</target> spent months researching the corruption case, interviewing dozens of witnesses to uncover the truth for the public.","translation":"這名記者花了好幾個月研究這起腐敗案，訪談了數十名證人以揭露真相給大眾。","explanation":"名詞「記者」。指從事專業新聞報導的人。"},{"sentence":"As a freelance <target>journalist</target>, she has the flexibility to travel the world and write about diverse cultural experiences for different magazines.","translation":"作為一名自由記者，她能靈活地在世界各地旅行，並為不同的雜誌撰寫關於多元文化體驗的文章。","explanation":"名詞「記者」。搭配 freelance journalist 表示自由記者。"}],"related_forms":["journalism"]}

{"headword":"judicial","explanation":"形容詞「司法的；法庭的」。通常與法律體系中的司法部門相關，例如 judicial system (司法體系) 或 judicial review (司法審查)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>judicial</target> <pattern>system</pattern> is designed to ensure that every citizen receives a fair trial regardless of their social status or wealth.","translation":"司法體系旨在確保每位公民無論其社會地位或財富，都能獲得公平的審判。","explanation":"形容詞「司法的」。常用搭配 judicial system。"},{"sentence":"The high court exercised its <target>judicial</target> <pattern>review</pattern> to determine if the new government law was consistent with the constitution.","translation":"高等法院行使其司法審查權，以判定這項新政府法律是否與憲法一致。","explanation":"形容詞「司法的」。常用搭配 judicial review (司法審查)。"}],"related_forms":["judiciary","judicially"]}

{"headword": "jug", "explanation": "名詞「水罐；大口瓶」。名詞最常用於描述盛裝液體的容器，如 a jug of water (一罐水)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She poured fresh orange juice from a large glass <target>jug</target> into the glasses for all her guests at the brunch.", "translation": "她在早午餐會上將一大玻璃水罐中的新鮮橙汁倒入所有客人的杯子裡。", "explanation": "名詞「水罐」。指一種帶把手和口的大容器。"}, {"sentence": "The farmer used a heavy plastic <target>jug</target> to carry water from the well to the garden for his thirsty plants.", "translation": "農夫使用一個沉重的塑料水罐，將水從井中運到花園裡給口渴的植物。", "explanation": "名詞「水罐」。指用於攜帶液體的容器。"}], "related_forms": ["jugs"]}

{"headword":"jury","explanation":"名詞「陪審團」。指在法庭上聽取證據並決定被告是否有罪的一組普通公民。常用搭配 serve on a jury (擔任陪審員)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After hours of deliberation, the <target>jury</target> finally <pattern>reached</pattern> a <pattern>verdict</pattern> of not guilty for the defendant in the murder trial.","translation":"經過數小時的商議，陪審團最終在謀殺案審判中對被告做出了無罪的裁決。","explanation":"名詞「陪審團」。常用搭配 reach a verdict (達成裁決)。"},{"sentence":"Many citizens feel it is a civic duty to <pattern>serve</pattern> <pattern>on</pattern> a <target>jury</target> to help maintain the fairness of the legal process.","translation":"許多公民認為擔任陪審員是其公民義務，以幫助維護法律程序的公平性。","explanation":"名詞「陪審團」。常用片語 serve on a jury。"}],"related_forms":["juror"]}

{"headword":"justify","explanation":"動詞「證明...有理；為...辯護」。常用搭配 justify the cost (證明成本合理) 或 justify one's actions (為自己的行為辯護)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The manager tried to <target>justify</target> the budget increase by showing a detailed report on how the new equipment would improve productivity.","translation":"經理試圖透過展示一份關於新設備如何提高生產力的詳細報告，來證明增加預算的合理性。","explanation":"動詞「證明...有理」。指證明某事是正確的、合理的或必要的。"},{"sentence":"Although he apologized for the mistake, he still tried to <target>justify</target> <pattern>his actions</pattern> by claiming he was only trying to help.","translation":"儘管他為錯誤道歉，他仍試圖聲稱自己只是想幫忙，以此為自己的行為辯護。","explanation":"動詞「為...辯護」。指為不被認同的行為提供理由。"}],"related_forms":["justification","justifiable"]}

{"headword":"juvenile","explanation":"形容詞「青少年的；年幼的」；名詞「青少年」。常用搭配 juvenile delinquency (青少年犯罪) 或 juvenile court (青少年法庭)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city council decided to build more sports centers to prevent <target>juvenile</target> <pattern>delinquency</pattern> by giving young people more healthy activities.","translation":"市議會決定建造更多體育中心，透過給予年輕人更多健康的活動來防止青少年犯罪。","explanation":"形容詞「青少年的」。常用搭配 juvenile delinquency。"},{"sentence":"Because the suspect was only fifteen years old, the case was handled by the <target>juvenile</target> <pattern>court</pattern> rather than an adult court.","translation":"由於嫌疑人僅十五歲，此案由青少年法庭處理，而非成人法庭。","explanation":"形容詞「青少年的」。常用搭配 juvenile court。"},{"sentence":"The social worker spent years helping <target>juveniles</target> who had fallen into bad company and struggled to return to school.","translation":"社工花了好幾年時間幫助那些誤入歧途且努力重返學校的青少年。","explanation":"名詞「青少年」。指尚未成年的人。"}],"related_forms":["juvenilia"]}

{"headword":"kidnap","explanation":"動詞「綁架」。常用搭配 kidnap someone for ransom (為了贖金而綁架某人)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The criminal gang planned to <target>kidnap</target> the wealthy businessman's daughter to demand a huge <pattern>ransom</pattern> from her father.","translation":"該犯罪集團計劃綁架這位富有商人的女兒，向其父親要求巨額贖金。","explanation":"動詞「綁架」。指非法強行帶走某人以獲利。"},{"sentence":"Police officers used advanced tracking technology to rescue the victim after the kidnappers had <target>kidnapped</target> him and hidden him in a remote cabin.","translation":"在綁匪將受害者綁架並藏在偏遠小屋後，警察利用先進的追蹤技術將其救出。","explanation":"動詞「綁架」。"}],"related_forms":["kidnapper","kidnapping"]}

{"headword":"landlord","explanation":"名詞「房東」。指出租房屋或土地的人。常用搭配 pay rent to the landlord (向房東支付租金)。","entries":[{"sentence":"When the water pipe in the bathroom burst, the tenant immediately called the <target>landlord</target> to ask for urgent repairs.","translation":"當浴室的水管破裂時，房客立即打電話給房東要求緊急維修。","explanation":"名詞「房東」。指房屋的擁有者且出租給他人的人。"},{"sentence":"The student decided to move to a different apartment because his <target>landlord</target> was too strict about the rules regarding guests.","translation":"這名學生決定搬到另一間公寓，因為他的房東對於訪客的規定太過嚴格。","explanation":"名詞「房東」。"}],"related_forms":["landlady"]}

{"headword":"laser","explanation":"名詞「雷射」。指一種高能強光。常用於醫學 (laser surgery)、工業 (laser cutting) 或日常生活中 (laser pointer)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The eye surgeon used a precise <target>laser</target> to reshape the cornea, allowing the patient to see clearly without glasses.","translation":"眼科醫生使用精準的雷射來重塑角膜，使患者在不需要眼鏡的情況下能看得清楚。","explanation":"名詞「雷射」。常用搭配 laser surgery。"},{"sentence":"In the chemistry lab, the students used a <target>laser</target> <pattern>pointer</pattern> to show the exact location of the reaction on the screen.","translation":"在化學實驗室中，學生使用雷射指示筆來向螢幕上顯示反應的確切位置。","explanation":"名詞「雷射」。常用搭配 laser pointer (雷射指示筆)。"}],"related_forms":["lasers"]}

{"headword":"lawmaker","explanation":"名詞「立法者；國會議員」。指負責制定法律的人。常用搭配 pass a law (通過法律)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>lawmakers</target> are currently debating whether to increase the minimum wage to help low-income families cope with rising prices.","translation":"立法者們目前正在辯論是否要提高最低工資，以幫助低收入家庭應對物價上漲。","explanation":"名詞「立法者」。指在議會中制定法律的代表。"},{"sentence":"Environmental groups urged the <target>lawmakers</target> to <pattern>pass</pattern> a stricter law <pattern>against</pattern> plastic pollution to protect the ocean's ecosystem.","translation":"環保團體敦促立法者通過一項更嚴格的禁塑法律，以保護海洋生態系統。","explanation":"名詞「立法者」。搭配 pass a law (通過法律)。"}],"related_forms":["lawmaking"]}

{"headword":"lawsuit","explanation":"名詞，意為「訴訟」。通常指民事訴訟，而非刑事案件。常用搭配包括 file a lawsuit (提起訴訟) 或 settle a lawsuit (達成訴訟和解)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The former employee decided to <pattern>file</pattern> a <target>lawsuit</target> <pattern>against</pattern> the company for unfair dismissal and loss of income.","translation":"前員工決定對公司提起訴訟，理由是不公平地解僱以及收入損失。","explanation":"名詞「訴訟」。常用搭配：file a lawsuit against someone (對某人提起訴訟)。"},{"sentence":"After months of negotiation, both parties finally agreed to <pattern>settle</pattern> the <target>lawsuit</target> <pattern>out of</pattern> court to avoid further legal costs.","translation":"經過數月的協商，雙方最終同意在法庭外就該訴訟達成和解，以避免進一步的法律費用。","explanation":"名詞「訴訟」。常用搭配：settle a lawsuit out of court (在法庭外達成訴訟和解)。"}],"related_forms":["lawsuits"]}

{"headword":"layer","explanation":"名詞意為「層」，動詞意為「分層」或「覆蓋一層」。在學術或日常描述中，常指物體表面的覆蓋物，如 a layer of dust (一層灰塵) 或 a layer of cake (一層蛋糕)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The geologist explained that the Earth's crust consists of several <target>layers</target> <pattern>of</pattern> rock, each with different mineral compositions.","translation":"地質學家解釋說，地殼由幾層岩石組成，每層的礦物組成都不同。","explanation":"名詞「層」。常用搭配：a layer of something (一層...)。"},{"sentence":"To stay warm during the winter trip to Japan, she wore several <target>layers</target> <pattern>of</pattern> clothing under her heavy coat.","translation":"為了在日本的冬季旅行中保持溫暖，她在厚大衣下穿了幾層衣服。","explanation":"名詞「層」。指衣服的層疊。"},{"sentence":"The baker carefully <target>layered</target> the chocolate cream between the sponges to create a beautiful and delicious dessert.","translation":"烘焙師小心地將巧克力奶油分層疊加在海綿蛋糕之間，以製作出一道美麗且美味的甜點。","explanation":"動詞「分層」。指將東西疊加成層。"}],"related_forms":["layered"]}

{"headword":"league","explanation":"名詞，主要指「聯盟」或「聯賽」。常用於體育競賽（如 the Major League Baseball）或政治/商業合作組織。注意與連詞 league 的區別，在 GSAT 範圍內主要考其組織形式。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school's basketball team worked hard to win the championship in the regional <target>league</target> this year.","translation":"學校的籃球隊今年努力爭取在區域聯賽中奪冠。","explanation":"名詞「聯賽」。指體育競賽的組織。"},{"sentence":"Several small businesses formed a <target>league</target> to share resources and compete more effectively against larger corporations.","translation":"幾家小企業組成了一個聯盟，以共享資源並更有效地與大公司競爭。","explanation":"名詞「聯盟」。指為了共同目的而組成的組織。"},{"sentence":"The new player is so skilled that he is in a <target>league</target> <pattern>of</pattern> his own, far surpassing all other competitors.","translation":"這名新球員的技術如此高超，以至於他處於一個獨立的等級，遠遠超過所有其他競爭對手。","explanation":"名詞「等級/水準」。常用片語 in a league of one's own (處於獨立的等級/無出其右)。"}],"related_forms":["leagues"]}

{"headword":"legacy","explanation":"名詞，意為「遺產」或「留下的影響」。不僅指金錢或財產的遺產，更常用於描述一個人、時代或文化留下的深遠影響（例如 a cultural legacy）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The museum was established to preserve the artistic <target>legacy</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the famous painter for future generations to admire.","translation":"這座博物館的成立是為了保存這位著名畫家的藝術遺產，供後代欣賞。","explanation":"名詞「遺產」。指文化或藝術上的留下來的東西。"},{"sentence":"The former president's <target>legacy</target> is still debated by historians, as his policies had both positive and negative effects on the country.","translation":"前總統的遺產（留下的影響）仍被歷史學家討論，因為他的政策對國家產生了正面和負面的影響。","explanation":"名詞「遺產/影響」。指一個人留下的政治或社會影響。"},{"sentence":"He received a large financial <target>legacy</target> <pattern>from</pattern> his grandfather, which allowed him to study abroad at a prestigious university.","translation":"他從祖父那裡繼承了一筆巨大的財產遺產，這使他能夠在一家著名的大學留學。","explanation":"名詞「遺產」。指金錢或財產。"}],"related_forms":["legacies"]}

{"headword": "legendary", "explanation": "形容詞，意為「傳奇的」或「著名的」。指事物或人物因其卓越成就或故事而聞名於世。常搭配 legendary status (傳奇地位) 或 legendary stories (傳奇故事)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <target>legendary</target> basketball player was honored at the ceremony for his incredible achievements and contribution to the sport.", "translation": "這位傳奇的籃球運動員在典禮上獲表彰，以表彰其令人驚嘆的成就以及對這項運動的貢獻。", "explanation": "形容詞「傳奇的」。指極其著名且有成就的人。"}, {"sentence": "Many tourists visit the ancient castle to hear <target>legendary</target> <pattern>tales</pattern> about the brave knights who once lived there.", "translation": "許多遊客參觀這座古堡，以聆聽關於曾經居住在那裡的勇敢騎士的傳奇故事。", "explanation": "形容詞「傳奇的」。常用搭配：legendary tales/stories (傳奇故事)。"}, {"sentence": "According to <target>legendary</target> accounts from the ancient era, the city was founded by a hero who could communicate with animals.", "translation": "根據古代時代的傳奇記載，這座城市是由一位能與動物溝通的英雄創立的。", "explanation": "形容詞「傳奇的」。指基於傳說或傳奇故事而非事實。"}], "related_forms": ["legend"]}

{"headword":"legislation","explanation":"名詞，意為「立法」或「法律」。指通過法律的過程或已經通過的法律條文。常用搭配 include pass legislation (通過立法) 或 new legislation (新法)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government is expected to <pattern>pass</pattern> new <target>legislation</target> to protect the environment and reduce plastic waste in the ocean.","translation":"政府預計將通過新立法以保護環境並減少海洋中的塑料垃圾。","explanation":"名詞「立法/法律」。常用搭配：pass legislation (通過立法)。"},{"sentence":"Strict <target>legislation</target> <pattern>against</pattern> smoking in public areas has significantly decreased the number of health problems related to lung disease.","translation":"在公共區域禁煙的嚴格立法顯著地減少了與肺病相關的健康問題數量。","explanation":"名詞「立法/法律」。常用搭配：legislation against something (禁止...的法律)。"}],"related_forms":["legislate","legislator"]}

{"headword":"legislative","explanation":"形容詞，意為「立法的」。指與法律制定或立法機關（如國會）相關的事務。常見搭配 legislative body (立法機關) 或 legislative power (立法權)。","entries":[{"sentence":"In many democratic countries, the <target>legislative</target> <pattern>branch</pattern> is responsible for creating and voting on new laws for the society.","translation":"在許多民主國家，立法部門負責為社會制定並投票通過新法律。","explanation":"形容詞「立法的」。常用搭配：legislative branch (立法部門)。"},{"sentence":"The committee discussed whether the government had exceeded its <target>legislative</target> <pattern>authority</pattern> when implementing the new tax regulations.","translation":"委員會討論了政府在實施新稅收規定時是否超過了其立法權限。","explanation":"形容詞「立法的」。常用搭配：legislative authority (立法權限)。"}],"related_forms":["legislation","legislator"]}

{"headword": "legitimate", "explanation": "形容詞意為「合法的」或「合理的」。注意其形容詞用法時，常指事物符合法律、規則或理據，如 a legitimate reason (合理的理由) 或 a legitimate business (合法生意)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The company had a <target>legitimate</target> <pattern>reason</pattern> for delaying the shipment because of the severe storm that blocked the main port.", "translation": "由於嚴重風暴封鎖了主港口，公司有合理的理由延遲發貨。", "explanation": "形容詞「合理的」。常用搭配：legitimate reason (合理的理由)。"}, {"sentence": "The police are investigating whether the online store is a <target>legitimate</target> <pattern>business</pattern> or just a scam to steal people's money.", "translation": "警方正在調查這家在線商店是否是一家合法企業，或者僅僅是一個偷錢的騙局。", "explanation": "形容詞「合法的」。常用搭配：legitimate business (合法生意)。"}, {"sentence": "The candidate's concerns about the new policy were considered <target>legitimate</target> by the committee after they reviewed all the evidence.", "translation": "在委員會審查所有證據後，認為該候選人對新政策的擔憂是合理的。", "explanation": "形容詞「合理的」。指符合邏輯或理據。"}], "related_forms": ["legitimacy", "legitimately"]}

{"headword":"lest","explanation":"連接詞，意為「以免、唯恐」。後接的子句通常使用 should + 動詞原形或省略 should 的原形動詞（虛擬語氣）。注意它比 than or because 具有更正式的文法結構。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student carefully double-checked his essay <target>lest</target> he <pattern>should</pattern> make any silly mistakes before submitting it to the teacher.","translation":"學生仔細地複查了他的論文，以免在提交給老師之前犯下任何愚蠢的錯誤。","explanation":"連接詞「以免」。後接 should + 動詞原形。"},{"sentence":"She spoke in a low whisper <target>lest</target> she <target>wake</target> the baby who had just fallen asleep in the next room.","translation":"她用低聲耳語說話，以免喚醒剛剛在隔壁房間睡著的嬰兒。","explanation":"連接詞「以免」。此處省略了 should，直接使用原形動詞 wake。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"liability","explanation":"名詞，意為「責任」或「累贅/負債」。在法律或財務上指「法律責任」或「債務」。在日常描述中，指一個人或事物成為了負擔或阻礙。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company's insurance policy covers all <target>liability</target> <pattern>for</pattern> accidents that happen during the school field trip to the factory.","translation":"公司的保險政策涵蓋了在學校校外教學前往工廠期間發生事故的所有法律責任。","explanation":"名詞「法律責任」。常用搭配：liability for something (對...的責任)。"},{"sentence":"The team manager realized that the player's bad attitude was becoming a <target>liability</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the entire team's performance.","translation":"球隊經理意識到，這名球員的糟糕態度正成為整個球隊表現的累贅。","explanation":"名詞「累贅/負擔」。常用搭配：a liability to someone/something (對...的累贅)。"},{"sentence":"In the financial report, the accountant listed all the company's long-term <target>liabilities</target> to show the total amount of debt they owed.","translation":"在財務報告中，會計師列出了公司所有的長期負債，以顯示他們欠下的債務總額。","explanation":"名詞「負債」。指財務上的債務。"}],"related_forms":["liable"]}

{"headword":"likelihood","explanation":"名詞「可能性」。常用片語 the likelihood of (發生...的可能性) 或 in all likelihood (極有可能)。注意與 probability 的區別，likelihood 較常在口語或非正式書面語中使用，而 probability 較常在數學或科學統計語境中出現。","entries":[{"sentence":"Given the dark clouds and strong wind, there is a high <target>likelihood</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a severe thunderstorm occurring this afternoon.","translation":"考慮到烏雲和強風，今天下午發生嚴重雷雨的可能性很高。","explanation":"名詞「可能性」。常用片語 the likelihood of + N/V-ing。"},{"sentence":"In all <target>likelihood</target>, the new policy will be implemented next month, providing more resources for students with special needs.","translation":"極有可能，這項新政策將於下個月實施，為有特殊需求的學生提供更多資源。","explanation":"片語 in all likelihood 表示「極有可能」。"}],"related_forms":["likely"]}

{"headword":"likewise","explanation":"副詞「同樣地」。用於連接兩個相似的情況或動作。在作文中常用作轉折詞，以增加文章的邏輯連貫性。","entries":[{"sentence":"My sister loves to read classic novels to expand her knowledge; <target>likewise</target>, I spend my free time visiting art museums.","translation":"我姊姊喜歡讀古典小說來擴展她的知識；同樣地，我也在空閒時間參觀美術館。","explanation":"副詞「同樣地」。用於連接兩個相似的習慣或喜好。"},{"sentence":"The first experiment showed a significant increase in temperature; <target>likewise</target>, the second test produced similar results.","translation":"第一次實驗顯示溫度顯著增加；同樣地，第二次測試也產生了相似的結果。","explanation":"副詞「同樣地」。用於描述科學實驗中一致的結果。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"loop","explanation":"名詞「環、圈」。指將線類物體彎曲成圈的形狀。在電腦科學中指「迴圈」。動詞用法為「循環播放」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The magician tied a complex <target>loop</target> in the rope, making it look as if the string had disappeared into thin air.","translation":"魔術師在繩子上打了一個複雜的環，使得繩子看起來像是憑空消失了。","explanation":"名詞「環、圈」。指實體線條形成的圈狀。"},{"sentence":"The song was playing on a <target>loop</target> in the mall, which eventually made the shoppers feel bored and annoyed.","translation":"這首歌在商場裡循環播放，最終讓購物者感到厭煩。","explanation":"名詞「迴圈」。片語 on a loop 表示「循環播放」。"},{"sentence":"The computer program entered an infinite <target>loop</target>, causing the software to crash and lose all the unsaved data.","translation":"電腦程式進入了一個無限迴圈，導致軟體崩潰並遺失所有未儲存的資料。","explanation":"名詞「迴圈」。指電腦程式中的重複執行過程。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"lounge","explanation":"名詞「休息室」；動詞「懶散地坐著/躺著」。名詞常用於機場或酒店的 lounge；動詞常用於描述放鬆或無所事事地度過時間。","entries":[{"sentence":"After waiting for three hours, the tired travelers decided to relax in the airport <target>lounge</target> before their flight departed.","translation":"等待三小時後，疲憊的旅客決定在飛機起飛前在機場休息室放鬆。","explanation":"名詞「休息室」。指舒適的公共休息區域。"},{"sentence":"On lazy Sunday afternoons, he likes to <target>lounge</target> <pattern>around</pattern> in his pajamas and read comic books all day.","translation":"在懶散的週日下午，他喜歡穿著睡衣在屋子裡懶散地閒逛，整天讀漫畫書。","explanation":"動詞片語 lounge around 表示「懶散地閒逛/休息」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"lump","explanation":"名詞「塊、腫塊」；動詞「將...視為一類」。名詞常用於描述不規則形狀的固體塊 (a lump of sugar) 或身體上的腫塊。動詞常用片語 lump together (將...混為一談)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The baker added a small <target>lump</target> <pattern>of</pattern> sugar to the coffee to make it taste sweeter and more pleasant.","translation":"烘焙師在咖啡中加入了一小塊方糖，使其味道更甜且更令人愉悅。","explanation":"名詞「塊」。常用搭配 a lump of sth。"},{"sentence":"The doctor felt a strange <target>lump</target> in the patient's neck and recommended a biopsy to check if it was cancerous.","translation":"醫生在病人的脖子上感覺到一個奇怪的腫塊，並建議進行切片檢查以確認是否為癌症。","explanation":"名詞「腫塊」。指身體上異常的凸起。"},{"sentence":"It is unfair to <target>lump</target> all teenagers <pattern>together</pattern> as rebellious, because every individual has a different personality.","translation":"將所有青少年混為一談視為叛逆是不公平的，因為每個個體都有不同的性格。","explanation":"動詞片語 lump together 表示「將...混為一談/視為同一類」。"}],"related_forms":["lumpy"]}

{"headword":"mainstream","explanation":"名詞或形容詞「主流的」。指被大多數人接受的思維、風格或趨勢。常用搭配 mainstream media (主流媒體) 或 enter the mainstream (進入主流)。","entries":[{"sentence":"While some people prefer independent films, the blockbuster movie quickly entered the <target>mainstream</target> and became a global hit.","translation":"雖然有些人偏好獨立電影，但這部大片很快進入了主流並成為全球熱門作品。","explanation":"名詞「主流」。指被廣泛接受的趨勢。"},{"sentence":"The <target>mainstream</target> <pattern>media</pattern> often focus on celebrity gossip rather than reporting on the critical environmental issues affecting the planet.","translation":"主流媒體經常關注名人八卦，而不是報導影響地球的關鍵環境問題。","explanation":"形容詞「主流的」。常用搭配 mainstream media。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"maintenance","explanation":"名詞「維護、保養」。指保持某物處於良好狀態的過程。常用搭配 maintenance cost (維護成本) 或 routine maintenance (例行維護)。注意其動詞形式為 maintain。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school decided to close the gymnasium for a week to perform routine <target>maintenance</target> on the sports equipment and flooring.","translation":"學校決定將體育館關閉一週，以對體育設備和地板進行例行維護。","explanation":"名詞「維護」。指對設施的定期檢查與修理。"},{"sentence":"Owning a luxury car may seem exciting, but the high <target>maintenance</target> <pattern>costs</pattern> can be a significant financial burden for many owners.","translation":"擁有一輛豪華車可能看起來很令人興奮，但高昂的維護成本對許多車主來說可能是一個沉重的財務負擔。","explanation":"名詞「維護」。常用搭配 maintenance costs。"}],"related_forms":["maintain"]}

{"headword":"mammal","explanation":"名詞「哺乳動物」。生物學術語，指具有乳腺並哺育後代的動物。常用於自然科學類文章中。","entries":[{"sentence":"Whales are large marine <target>mammals</target> that breathe air through blowholes, which distinguishes them from fish that use gills.","translation":"鯨魚是大型海洋哺乳動物，透過噴氣孔呼吸空氣，這使它們與使用鰓的魚類有所區別。","explanation":"名詞「哺乳動物」。"},{"sentence":"Bats are the only <target>mammals</target> capable of true flight, allowing them to hunt insects efficiently during the night.","translation":"蝙蝠是唯一能夠真正飛行的哺乳動物，這使它們能在夜間高效地獵捕昆蟲。","explanation":"名詞「哺乳動物」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"mandate","explanation":"名詞「授權、指令」；動詞「強制執行、授權」。在政治語境中，指選民授予當選者的權力；在法律語境中指指政府強制要求的規定。","entries":[{"sentence":"The newly elected president claimed he had a clear <target>mandate</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the voters to implement his proposed economic reforms.","translation":"新當選的總統聲稱他得到了選民的明確授權來實施他提出的經濟改革。","explanation":"名詞「授權」。常用搭配 a mandate from someone。"},{"sentence":"During the health crisis, the government decided to <target>mandate</target> the wearing of face masks in all public indoor spaces to reduce the spread of the virus.","translation":"在健康危機期間，政府決定強制要求在所有公共室內空間佩戴口罩，以減少病毒的傳播。","explanation":"動詞「強制執行」。指法律或官方要求必須做某事。"},{"sentence":"The school board issued a <target>mandate</target> requiring all teachers to attend the professional development workshop every semester.","translation":"學校委員會發布了一項指令，要求所有教師每學期必須參加專業發展研討會。","explanation":"名詞「指令」。指官方的行政命令。"}],"related_forms":["mandatory"]}

{"headword":"manifest","explanation":"動詞「顯現、表明」；形容詞「顯而易見的」。動詞常用於描述情感、症狀或特徵的顯現。形容詞用法較少見，但多用於正式書面語。","entries":[{"sentence":"The patient's anxiety began to <target>manifest</target> <pattern>itself in</pattern> a series of nervous habits, such as biting nails and shaking legs.","translation":"病人的焦慮開始透過一系列緊張的習慣顯現出來，例如咬指甲和抖腿。","explanation":"動詞「顯現」。常用片語 manifest itself in (在...中顯現)。"},{"sentence":"Although she tried to hide her anger, it <target>manifested</target> <pattern>in</pattern> her sharp tone of voice when she spoke to the clerk.","translation":"儘管她試圖隱藏憤怒，但當她對店員說話時，她的尖銳語調表明了她的憤怒。","explanation":"動詞「表明」。指情感或特徵的顯現。"},{"sentence":"The failure of the project was a <target>manifest</target> <pattern>error</pattern> of judgment by the manager, who ignored all the warnings from his staff.","translation":"該項目的失敗是經理判斷失誤的顯而易見的錯誤，他無視了員工的所有警告。","explanation":"形容詞「顯而易見的」。常用於描述錯誤或不公正的情況。"}],"related_forms":["manifestation","manifestly"]}

{"headword":"manipulate","explanation":"動詞「操縱、控制」或「熟練地操作」。可指物理上的操作，也可指心理上的控制或數據的篡改。注意其負面含義，常用於描述不誠實的手段。","entries":[{"sentence":"The clever politician tried to <target>manipulate</target> the public's opinion by using emotional language and misleading information in his speeches.","translation":"這位聰明的政治家試圖在演講中使用情感化語言和誤導性信息來操縱公眾輿論。","explanation":"動詞「操縱」。指透過不正當手段控制他人或情況。"},{"sentence":"The surgeon must <target>manipulate</target> the delicate instruments <pattern>with</pattern> great precision to ensure the operation is successful and safe.","translation":"外科醫生必須極其精確地操作精細的器械，以確保手術成功且安全。","explanation":"動詞「熟練地操作」。指物理上的靈巧控制。"},{"sentence":"The accountant was fired after the company discovered he had <target>manipulated</target> the financial data to hide the losses.","translation":"會計師在公司發現他篡改財務數據以隱瞞損失後被解僱了。","explanation":"動詞「篡改」。指為了私利而改變數據或事實。"}],"related_forms":["manipulation","manipulative"]}

{"headword":"mansion","explanation":"名詞「大宅、豪宅」。指規模宏大且豪華的住宅。常用搭配 a grand mansion (一座宏偉的大宅)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The wealthy businessman built a grand <target>mansion</target> on the hill, which featured a private swimming pool and a large garden.","translation":"這位富有的商人在山丘上建了一座宏偉的豪宅，設有私人游泳池和一個大花園。","explanation":"名詞「大宅」。指豪華的私人住宅。"},{"sentence":"The historic <target>mansion</target> was converted into a luxury hotel to attract tourists and preserve its architectural beauty.","translation":"這座歷史悠久的大宅被改造成一家豪華酒店，以吸引遊客並保留其建築美感。","explanation":"名詞「大宅」。"}],"related_forms":["mansions"]}

{"headword":"marine","explanation":"形容詞「海洋的」或名詞「海軍陸戰隊員」。形容詞用法常考搭配 marine biology (海洋生物學), marine life (海洋生物)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Students interested in <target>marine</target> biology often spend their summers volunteering at the aquarium to study various sea creatures.","translation":"對海洋生物學感興趣的學生經常在夏天到水族館擔任志工，研究各種海洋生物。","explanation":"形容詞「海洋的」。常用搭配 marine biology。"},{"sentence":"The government is implementing new laws to protect <target>marine</target> life <pattern>from</pattern> pollution and overfishing in the Pacific Ocean.","translation":"政府正在實施新法律，以保護太平洋中的海洋生物免受污染和過度捕撈的影響。","explanation":"形容詞「海洋的」。常用搭配 marine life。"},{"sentence":"After years of training, he finally joined the U.S. <target>marine</target> corps and served in several international peacekeeping missions.","translation":"經過多年的訓練，他終於加入了美國海軍陸戰隊，並在多次國際維和任務中服役。","explanation":"名詞「海軍陸戰隊員」。"}],"related_forms":["mariner"]}

{"headword":"masculine","explanation":"形容詞「男性的、陽剛的」或名詞「陽性名詞」。常用於描述特質或語言學中的性別分類。","entries":[{"sentence":"In many languages, nouns are divided into <target>masculine</target> and feminine categories, which can be challenging for language learners to memorize.","translation":"在許多語言中，名詞被分為陽性和陰性類別，這對語言學習者來說記憶起來可能很有挑戰性。","explanation":"形容詞「陽性的」。指語言學中的性別分類。"},{"sentence":"The character in the novel is described as having <target>masculine</target> features, such as a strong jawline and a deep voice.","translation":"小說中的角色被描述為具有陽剛的特徵，例如強壯的下顎線和低沉的聲音。","explanation":"形容詞「陽剛的」。指典型的男性特徵。"}],"related_forms":["masculinity"]}

{"headword":"massage","explanation":"名詞或動詞「按摩」。指透過揉捏肌肉來放鬆身體或減輕疼痛。常用搭配 get a massage (做按摩)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After a stressful week of studying for final exams, she decided to get a professional <target>massage</target> to relieve muscle tension.","translation":"在經歷了一週壓力巨大的期末考準備後，她決定去做專業按摩以緩解肌肉緊張。","explanation":"名詞「按摩」。常用搭配 get a massage。"},{"sentence":"The athlete spent thirty minutes <target>massaging</target> his sore calves <pattern>with</pattern> an oil-based cream to speed up his recovery after the race.","translation":"這位運動員花三十分鐘用油基乳霜按摩他痠痛的小腿，以加速賽後恢復。","explanation":"動詞「按摩」。常用搭配 massage sth with sth。"}],"related_forms":["massages","massaged","massaging"]}

{"headword":"massive","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的、大規模的」。指體積、重量或程度極大。常用搭配 a massive amount of (大量的...), a massive heart attack (嚴重心臟病發作)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The construction of the new stadium required a <target>massive</target> <pattern>amount of</pattern> concrete and steel to support its unique design.","translation":"新體育場的建設需要大量的混凝土和鋼鐵來支撐其獨特的設計。","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的」。常用搭配 massive amount of。"},{"sentence":"The earthquake caused <target>massive</target> destruction in the city, leaving thousands of people homeless and destroying many historic buildings.","translation":"這場地震在城市中造成了巨大的破壞，使數千人無家可歸並摧毀了許多歷史建築。","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的」。指規模或程度極大。"},{"sentence":"The company suffered a <target>massive</target> loss of data after a cyber attack hit their main servers last Monday.","translation":"公司在上週一遭受網路攻擊擊中其主伺服器後，遭受了巨大的數據損失。","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的」。指程度極深。"}],"related_forms":["massively"]}

{"headword":"masterpiece","explanation":"名詞「傑作、名作」。指藝術、文學或音樂作品中最高水準的成就。常用搭配 a timeless masterpiece (永恆的傑作)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The museum's most famous exhibit is a <target>masterpiece</target> painted by Leonardo da Vinci, attracting visitors from all over the world.","translation":"博物館最著名的展品是李奧納多·達文西創作的傑作，吸引了來自世界各地的遊客。","explanation":"名詞「傑作」。指藝術作品的最高水準。"},{"sentence":"After years of hard work and dedication, the author finally published her first novel, which critics hailed as a literary <target>masterpiece</target>.","translation":"經過多年的努力和奉獻，這位作者終於出版了她的第一本小說，這被評論家譽為文學傑作。","explanation":"名詞「傑作」。指文學作品。"}],"related_forms":["masterpieces"]}

{"headword":"mattress","explanation":"名詞「床墊」。指放在床架上的厚墊子。","entries":[{"sentence":"Because he suffered from back pain, the doctor recommended that he buy a firmer <target>mattress</target> to provide better support for his spine.","translation":"因為他患有背痛，醫生建議他買一張較硬的床墊，以便為他的脊椎提供更好的支撐。","explanation":"名詞「床墊」。"},{"sentence":"The hotel room was so comfortable that she fell asleep instantly on the soft <target>mattress</target> after a long day of sightseeing.","translation":"酒店房間非常舒適，以至於她在漫長的一天觀光後，立即在柔軟的床墊上睡著了。","explanation":"名詞「床墊」。"}],"related_forms":["mattresses"]}

{"headword": "meantime", "explanation": "名詞或副詞「在此期間」。常用片語 in the meantime (在此期間，同時)。注意與 while (連接詞) 的區別，meantime 通常作為副詞短語使用。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The flight was delayed by two hours; <pattern>in the</pattern> <target>meantime</target>, the passengers waited in the airport lounge and read magazines.", "translation": "航班延誤了兩小時；在此期間，乘客們在機場休息室等待並閱讀雜誌。", "explanation": "副詞短語 in the meantime 表示「在此期間」。"}, {"sentence": "The technician is repairing the computer, and <pattern>in the</pattern> <target>meantime</target>, we can use the tablets to finish our group project.", "translation": "技術人員正在修理電腦，在此期間，我們可以使用平板電腦來完成我們的小組計畫。", "explanation": "副詞短語 in the meantime 表示「在此期間」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"mechanism","explanation":"名詞「機制、結構、機械裝置」。可指物理上的機械構造，也可指社會、心理或生物上的運作方式。常用搭配 a defense mechanism (防禦機制)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The locking <target>mechanism</target> of the old safe was so complex that it took the expert an hour to open it without a key.","translation":"這台舊保險箱的鎖定機制如此複雜，以至於專家花了一小時才在沒有鑰匙的情況下將其打開。","explanation":"名詞「機械裝置」。指物理上的構造。"},{"sentence":"Psychologists explain that denial is a common defense <target>mechanism</target> people use to protect themselves from emotional pain after a trauma.","translation":"心理學家解釋說，否認是一種人們在創傷後用來保護自己免受情感痛苦的常見防禦機制。","explanation":"名詞「機制」。常用搭配 defense mechanism (防禦機制)。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are still studying the biological <target>mechanism</target> <pattern>by which</pattern> plants convert sunlight into energy through photosynthesis.","translation":"科學家仍在研究植物透過光合作用將陽光轉化為能量的生物機制。","explanation":"名詞「機制」。指運作方式。常用搭配 mechanism by which... (透過...的機制)。"}],"related_forms":["mechanisms","mechanical","mechanically"]}

{"headword":"medication","explanation":"名詞「藥物、藥劑」。指用於治療疾病或緩解症狀的藥品。注意與 medicine 的區別：medicine 既指藥物也指醫學，而 medication 更強調藥物治療的過程或特定的藥品。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctor advised the patient to take his <target>medication</target> <pattern>regularly</pattern> to ensure the infection was treated effectively and quickly.","translation":"醫生建議病人定期服用藥物，以確保感染得到有效且快速的治療。","explanation":"名詞「藥物」。常用搭配：take medication regularly (定期服用藥物)。"},{"sentence":"Some people may experience side effects from their <target>medication</target>, so it is important to consult a healthcare professional before changing the dose.","translation":"有些人可能會對他們的藥物產生副作用，因此在更改劑量前諮詢醫療專業人員非常重要。","explanation":"名詞「藥物」。常用搭配：side effects from medication (藥物的副作用)。"}],"related_forms":["medications"]}

{"headword":"mentor","explanation":"名詞「導師、指導者」。指在學業、職業或人生方向上提供建議與指導的人。動詞形式同樣為 mentor，意為「指導、導師」。","entries":[{"sentence":"During her first year at the university, she was lucky to have a <target>mentor</target> who provided valuable guidance on her academic goals.","translation":"在大學第一年，她很幸運地有一位導師，為她的學業目標提供了寶貴的指導。","explanation":"名詞「導師」。指提供指導的人。"},{"sentence":"He decided to <target>mentor</target> the new employees to help them adapt to the company culture and improve their professional skills.","translation":"他決定指導新員工，幫助他們適應公司文化並提高專業技能。","explanation":"動詞「指導」。指對他人提供建議和支持。"}],"related_forms":["mentorship","mentors"]}

{"headword":"merge","explanation":"動詞「合併、融合」。常用於公司合併、道路匯合或想法的結合。常搭配介系詞 with 或 into。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two small tech companies decided to <target>merge</target> <pattern>with</pattern> each other to create a larger and more competitive business in the global market.","translation":"這兩家小型科技公司決定相互合併，以便在全球市場中創建一家規模更大且更具競爭力的企業。","explanation":"動詞「合併」。常用搭配：merge with sth (與...合併)。"},{"sentence":"As the highway ends, the local road will <target>merge</target> <pattern>into</pattern> the main expressway, so drivers should be careful when changing lanes.","translation":"當公路結束時，地方道路將匯入主幹線道，因此駕駛者在變換車道時應小心。","explanation":"動詞「匯合」。常用搭配：merge into sth (匯入...之中)。"},{"sentence":"The artist's new style <target>merges</target> traditional painting techniques <pattern>with</pattern> modern digital art to create a unique visual experience.","translation":"這位藝術家的全新風格將傳統繪畫技巧與現代數位藝術融合在一起，創造出獨特的視覺體驗。","explanation":"動詞「融合」。常用搭配：merge A with B (將A與B融合)。"}],"related_forms":["merger","merged","merging"]}

{"headword":"metaphor","explanation":"名詞「隱喻、比喻」。一種修辭手法，將一件事物直接比作另一件事物，用以增加表達的生動性。注意與 simile (明喻) 的區別：metaphor 不使用 like 或 as。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher explained that the phrase \"life is a journey\" is a common <target>metaphor</target> used to describe the process of growing and learning.","translation":"老師解釋說，「人生是一場旅程」是一個常用的隱喻，用來描述成長和學習的過程。","explanation":"名詞「隱喻」。指將一件事物比作另一件事物的修辭法。"},{"sentence":"In the poem, the author uses the <target>metaphor</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a storm to represent the internal conflict and emotional turmoil the character is feeling.","translation":"在詩中，作者使用了風暴的隱喻來代表角色內心的衝突與情感上的動盪。","explanation":"名詞「隱喻」。常用搭配：the metaphor of sth (某事的隱喻)。"}],"related_forms":["metaphorical","metaphors"]}

{"headword": "metropolitan", "explanation": "形容詞「大都市的、都會區的」。名詞則指「大都市居民」。常用於描述城市規模、人口密度或行政區劃。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Living in a <target>metropolitan</target> area provides people with more job opportunities and and better access to public transportation and healthcare services.", "translation": "居住在大都市地區能為人們提供更多的工作機會，以及更好的公共交通和醫療服務。", "explanation": "形容詞「大都市的」。常用搭配：metropolitan area (都會區)。"}, {"sentence": "The city council is planning to improve the <target>metropolitan</target> transit system to reduce traffic congestion and lower pollution levels in the downtown area.", "translation": "市議會計畫改善大都市的交通系統，以減少市中心的交通擁堵並降低污染程度。", "explanation": "形容詞「大都市的」。常用搭配：metropolitan transit system (都會交通系統)。"}, {"sentence": "People living in <target>metropolitan</target> regions often face higher living costs compared to those living in small rural towns.", "translation": "居住在大都市地區的人們通常面臨著比住在小鄉村鎮的人更高的生活成本。", "explanation": "形容詞「大都市的」。指都會區的人口。"}], "related_forms": ["metropolis"]}

{"headword":"midst","explanation":"名詞，意為「中間、之中」。常作介系詞用法出現在 in the midst of sth 片語中，表示「在...之中」或「在...最盛之時」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The small village was located <pattern>in</pattern> the <target>midst</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a dense forest, making it a peaceful place for those seeking quietude.","translation":"這個小村莊位於一片茂密森林之中，對於那些尋求寧靜的人來說是一個平和的地方。","explanation":"名詞「中間」。in the midst of sth 表示在某個空間的中間。"},{"sentence":"The company had to make urgent changes <pattern>in</pattern> the <target>midst</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a financial crisis to avoid going bankrupt.","translation":"公司在金融危機之中不得不做出緊急調整，以避免破產。","explanation":"名詞「之中」。in the midst of sth 表在某種狀態或事件發生之時。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"migration","explanation":"名詞「遷移、移居」。可用於指動物的季節性遷徙或人類為了生活、工作而搬遷到其他地區。注意搭配介系詞 to 或 from。","entries":[{"sentence":"The annual <target>migration</target> <pattern>of</pattern> birds to warmer regions in winter is a fascinating natural phenomenon that scientists study closely.","translation":"候鳥在冬季向溫暖地區的年度遷徙是一個令人著迷的自然現象，科學家對此進行了密切研究。","explanation":"名詞「遷徙」。指動物的季節性移動。常用搭配：migration of birds (候鳥遷徙)。"},{"sentence":"Economic instability often leads to the <target>migration</target> <pattern>of</pattern> young people from rural areas to big cities in search of better jobs.","translation":"經濟不穩定通常導致年輕人從農村地區移居到大城市以尋找更好的工作。","explanation":"名詞「移居」。指人類的搬遷。常用搭配：migration from A to B (從A移居到B)。"}],"related_forms":["migrate","migratory","migrations"]}

{"headword":"milestone","explanation":"名詞「里程碑」。原指路邊標記距離的里程碑，現常用於比喻指重大事件或關鍵進展，標誌著一個重要階段的完成。","entries":[{"sentence":"Graduating from high school is a significant <target>milestone</target> <pattern>in</pattern> a student's life, marking the transition from childhood to adulthood.","translation":"高中畢業是學生生活中一個重要的里程碑，標誌著從童年到成年期的過渡。","explanation":"名詞「里程碑」。常用搭配：a milestone in one's life (人生中的里程碑)。"},{"sentence":"The development of the new vaccine was a major <target>milestone</target> <pattern>for</pattern> medical science, saving countless lives around the world.","translation":"新疫苗的開發是醫學科學的一個重大里程碑，拯救了全球無數的生命。","explanation":"名詞「里程碑」。常用搭配：a milestone for sth (對...而言的里程碑)。"}],"related_forms":["milestones"]}

{"headword":"miniature","explanation":"形容詞「微小的、縮小的」。名詞則指「微縮模型」。常用於描述模型、藝術品或自然界中極小的事物。","entries":[{"sentence":"The museum displayed a <target>miniature</target> version <pattern>of</pattern> the entire city, allowing visitors to see the layout from above.","translation":"博物館展示了一個整個城市的縮小版本，讓遊客能從上方看到佈局。","explanation":"形容詞「縮小的」。常用搭配：miniature version (縮小版本)。"},{"sentence":"He collects <target>miniatures</target> of famous historical battles, spending hours painting the tiny soldiers with great detail.","translation":"他收集著名歷史戰役的微縮模型，花很多小時精細地繪製那些微小的士兵。","explanation":"名詞「微縮模型」。"},{"sentence":"The garden was filled with <target>miniature</target> roses that only grew a few centimeters tall, making the space look charming.","translation":"花園裡種滿了微小的玫瑰，每朵只有幾公分高，讓空間看起來很有魅力。","explanation":"形容詞「微小的」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "minimal", "explanation": "形容詞「極小的、最低限度的」。指數量、程度或努力程度達到最低限度。注意與 minimum (名詞/形容詞) 的出現：minimal 常指程度低，而 minimum 是指法律或規定上的最低限度。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The company decided to keep the decorations <target>minimal</target> to maintain a professional atmosphere and avoid unnecessary spending.", "translation": "公司決定將裝飾保持在最低限度，以維持專業的氛圍並避免不必要的開支。", "explanation": "形容詞「最低限度的」。指程度低。"}, {"sentence": "Because the speaker spoke so clearly and slowly, there was <target>minimal</target> confusion among the audience regarding the main topic.", "translation": "因為演講者說得非常清楚且緩慢，聽眾對主題的理解幾乎沒有混淆。", "explanation": "形容詞「極小的」。minimal confusion 指極少量的混淆。"}, {"sentence": "With <target>minimal</target> effort, she was able to complete the assignment on time, thanks to her excellent time management skills.", "translation": "憑藉最低限度的努力，她能夠準時完成作業，這得益於她的出色的時間管理能力。", "explanation": "形容詞「最低限度的」。片語 minimal effort 表「最低限度地努力」。"}], "related_forms": ["minimally", "minimum"]}

{"headword":"minimize","explanation":"動詞「使減到最低」，常用於描述減少風險、成本或損失。常見搭配：minimize the risk (降低風險), minimize the cost (降低成本)。","entries":[{"sentence":"To ensure the safety of the passengers, the airline implemented new protocols to <target>minimize</target> the <pattern>risk</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> accidents during takeoff.","translation":"為了確保乘客的安全，航空公司實施了新協定以降低起飛時發生事故的風險。","explanation":"動詞「使減到最低」。常用搭配 minimize the risk of...。"},{"sentence":"The company is looking for ways to <target>minimize</target> the <pattern>cost</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> production without sacrificing the quality of their products.","translation":"公司正在尋找在不犧牲產品品質的情況下，降低生產成本的方法。","explanation":"動詞「使減到最低」。常用搭配 minimize the cost of...。"},{"sentence":"When presenting your research, try to <target>minimize</target> the use of complex jargon to make your findings easier for a general audience to understand.","translation":"在呈現你的研究時，試著減少使用複雜的專業術語，使一般大眾更容易理解你的發現。","explanation":"動詞「使減到最低」，此處指減少使用量。"}],"related_forms":["minimized","minimizing","minimum","minimal"]}

{"headword":"mint","explanation":"名詞「薄荷」或「鑄幣廠」。在 GSAT 中，薄荷作為口味或植物較常見，而鑄幣廠則出現在歷史或經濟相關的文章中。","entries":[{"sentence":"She added a few fresh <target>mint</target> leaves to her iced tea, giving the drink a refreshing and cool taste during the hot summer.","translation":"她在冰茶中加入了一些新鮮的薄荷葉，讓這杯飲料在炎熱的夏天中具有清爽且涼爽的口感。","explanation":"名詞「薄荷」。指植物或其味道。"},{"sentence":"The government established a national <target>mint</target> to produce official coins and manage the country's currency system effectively.","translation":"政府成立了國家鑄幣廠以生產官方貨幣並有效管理國家的貨幣體系。","explanation":"名詞「鑄幣廠」。指製造硬幣的工廠。"},{"sentence":"He was lucky to find a coin in <target>mint</target> <pattern>condition</pattern>, which made it extremely valuable to coin collectors around the world.","translation":"他很幸運地找到一枚狀態極佳（如新）的硬幣，這使得它對全球的硬幣收藏家來說極其昂貴。","explanation":"名詞用法，in mint condition 是固定片語，意為「狀態如新」。"}],"related_forms":["mints"]}

{"headword":"missionary","explanation":"名詞「傳教士」；形容詞「傳教的」。通常與宗教擴展或文化交流相關。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>missionary</target> traveled to a remote village in Africa to provide medical care and teach the local people about their faith.","translation":"這位傳教士前往非洲的一個偏遠村莊，提供醫療照顧並向當地人傳授他們的信仰。","explanation":"名詞「傳教士」。"},{"sentence":"Many <target>missionary</target> <pattern>schools</pattern> were established in Asia during the 19th century to provide education and spread religious beliefs.","translation":"19世紀時，許多傳教學校在亞洲建立，以提供教育並傳播宗教信仰。","explanation":"形容詞「傳教的」。常用搭配 missionary school (傳教學校)。"}],"related_forms":["missionaries"]}

{"headword":"moan","explanation":"動詞或名詞「呻吟、抱怨」。動詞可用於描述身體疼痛或不滿地發聲。常見搭配：moan about (抱怨...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The injured athlete let out a low <target>moan</target> <pattern>of</pattern> pain after the accident, signaling that he was slowly waking up.","translation":"事故發生後，受傷的運動員發出了低沉的痛苦呻吟，表明他正緩緩醒來。","explanation":"名詞「呻吟」。指因疼痛而發出的聲音。"},{"sentence":"Students often <target>moan</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the amount of homework their teachers assign, even though they know it helps them improve.","translation":"學生們經常抱怨老師布置的作業量，儘管他們知道這對他們有幫助。","explanation":"動詞「抱怨」。常用片語 moan about...。"},{"sentence":"He continued to <target>moan</target> <pattern>about</pattern> his bad luck, instead of taking action to solve the problems he was facing.","translation":"他繼續抱怨他的不幸，而不是採取行動來解決他所面臨的問題。","explanation":"動詞「抱怨」。"}],"related_forms":["moans","moaning"]}

{"headword":"mock","explanation":"形容詞「模擬的、嘲諷的」；動詞「嘲笑」；名詞「模擬考」。注意 mock exam (模擬考) 是學生生活中最常見的搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"To prepare for the final exam, the school organized a <target>mock</target> <pattern>exam</pattern> to help students practice their time management skills.","translation":"為了準備期末考，學校組織了一次模擬考，以幫助學生練習時間管理技巧。","explanation":"形容詞「模擬的」。常用搭配 mock exam (模擬考)。"},{"sentence":"The cruel students began to <target>mock</target> the new boy for his old clothes, making him feel lonely and unwelcome in class.","translation":"殘忍的學生開始嘲笑那個新來的男孩，因為他的衣服很舊，讓他覺得在班上很孤單且不受歡迎。","explanation":"動詞「嘲笑」。"},{"sentence":"The actor used a <target>mock</target> <pattern>surprise</pattern> to make the audience laugh, pretending to be shocked by the unexpected news.","translation":"演員使用一種嘲諷的驚訝表情來讓觀眾發笑，假裝被這則意外的消息所震驚。","explanation":"形容詞「嘲諷的、假裝的」。"},{"sentence":"The teacher gave us a <target>mock</target> <pattern>interview</pattern> to simulate a real job application process and give us feedback on our performance.","translation":"老師為我們進行了一次模擬面試，以模擬真實的求職過程並對我們的表現提供回饋。","explanation":"形容詞「模擬的」。常用搭配 mock interview (模擬面試)。"}],"related_forms":["mocked","mocking"]}

{"headword": "mode", "explanation": "名詞「模式、方式」。常用於描述機器設定、行為方式或數學中的眾數。", "entries": [{"sentence": "To save battery life on his smartphone, he switched the device to power-saving <target>mode</target>, which limits background apps.", "translation": "為了節省智慧型手機的電量，他將裝置切換到省電模式，這會限制背景應用程式。", "explanation": "名詞「模式」。常用搭配 power-saving mode。"}, {"sentence": "The students were asked to work in collaboration <target>mode</target>, sharing ideas and solving problems together as a team.", "translation": "學生們被要求以協作模式工作，分享想法並共同解決問題。", "explanation": "名詞「方式」。collaboration mode (協作模式)。"}, {"sentence": "The camera has a special night <target>mode</target> for photography, allowing users to capture clear images in low-light conditions.", "translation": "這台相機有特殊的夜拍模式，讓使用者能在低光源環境下拍出清晰的照片。", "explanation": "名詞「模式」。常用搭配 night mode。"}], "related_forms": ["modes"]}

{"headword":"modify","explanation":"動詞「修改、調整」。指對某物進行小幅度的變動以使其更適合或更有效。常用搭配：modify the plan (修改計畫)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The engineer had to <target>modify</target> the original design of the bridge to ensure it could withstand strong winds and earthquakes.","translation":"工程師必須修改橋樑的原始設計，以確保它能承受強風和地震。","explanation":"動詞「修改」。指調整設計以符合需求。"},{"sentence":"Depending on the students' level of understanding, the teacher may <target>modify</target> her lesson plan to make the material more accessible.","translation":"根據學生理解程度的不同，老師可能會修改她的教案，使教材更容易理解。","explanation":"動詞「修改」。指調整教學計畫。"},{"sentence":"You can <target>modify</target> the settings on your laptop to improve the screen brightness and contrast based on your personal preference.","translation":"你可以修改筆記型電腦的設定，以根據個人偏好改善螢幕亮度與對比。","explanation":"動詞「修改、調整」。"}],"related_forms":["modification","modified","modifying"]}

{"headword":"molecule","explanation":"名詞「分子」。科學術語，常用於化學或生物相關的閱讀文章中。","entries":[{"sentence":"A water <target>molecule</target> consists of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom, which are bonded together by chemical reactions.","translation":"一個水分子由兩個氫原子和一個氧原子組成，它們透過化學反應結合在一起。","explanation":"名詞「分子」。指化學上的最小單位。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are studying how a single <target>molecule</target> can affect the way a protein functions in the human body.","translation":"科學家正在研究單個分子如何影響蛋白質在人體內運作的方式。","explanation":"名詞「分子」。"}],"related_forms":["molecular","molecules"]}

{"headword":"monopoly","explanation":"名詞「壟斷、獨佔」。指單一公司或個人控制整個市場或資源。常用搭配：have a monopoly on/over (壟斷...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company has a <target>monopoly</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the production of this rare medicine, allowing them to set high prices without competition.","translation":"這家公司壟斷了這種罕見藥物的生產，使他們能在沒有競爭的情況下設定高價。","explanation":"名詞「壟斷」。常用搭配 have a monopoly on...。"},{"sentence":"Government regulations were introduced to prevent any single corporation from having a <target>monopoly</target> <pattern>over</pattern> the national electricity grid.","translation":"政府引入了監管條例，以防止任何單一公司壟斷國家電網。","explanation":"名詞「壟斷」。常用搭配 have a monopoly over...。"},{"sentence":"In the board game <target>monopoly</target>, players try to buy properties and build houses to bankrupt their opponents through rent.","translation":"在大富翁（Monopoly）這款桌遊中，玩家試圖購買房產並蓋房子，透過租金讓對手破產。","explanation":"名詞「壟斷/大富翁遊戲」。"}],"related_forms":["monopolize","monopolist"]}

{"headword":"morality","explanation":"名詞「道德、道德觀」。指區分對錯的標準。常用搭配：standards of morality (道德標準)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The philosopher spent years discussing the <target>morality</target> <pattern>of</pattern> artificial intelligence, questioning whether machines can make ethical decisions.","translation":"這位哲學家花了好幾年討論人工智慧的道德問題，質疑機器是否能做出倫理決定。","explanation":"名詞「道德」。常用搭配 morality of...。"},{"sentence":"Different cultures have different <pattern>standards</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> <target>morality</target>, which can lead to misunderstandings when people from different backgrounds communicate.","translation":"不同的文化有不同的道德標準，這可能會在不同背景的人交流時導致誤解。","explanation":"名詞「道德」。常用搭配 standards of morality (道德標準)。"},{"sentence":"The students debated the <target>morality</target> <pattern>of</pattern> animal testing in the classroom, arguing whether it is acceptable to use animals for science.","translation":"學生們在教室裡辯論動物實驗的道德問題，爭論使用動物進行科學研究是否可以接受。","explanation":"名詞「道德」。"}],"related_forms":["moral","morals"]}

{"headword":"mortality","explanation":"名詞，意為「死亡率」或「終將死亡的性質」。在 GSAT 中，常出現在科學、生物或社會議題的文章中，常用搭配 mortality rate (死亡率)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Medical advancements in the last century have significantly lowered the infant <target>mortality</target> <pattern>rate</pattern> in many developing countries.","translation":"上個世紀的醫學進步顯著降低了許多開發中國家的嬰兒死亡率。","explanation":"名詞「死亡率」。常用搭配：mortality rate。"},{"sentence":"The sudden increase in the <target>mortality</target> <pattern>rate of</pattern> the local bird population worried the environmentalists who studied the forest.","translation":"當地鳥類族群死亡率的突然增加，讓研究該森林的環境保護論者感到擔心。","explanation":"名詞「死亡率」。"},{"sentence":"The poet wrote a moving piece about human <target>mortality</target>, reminding readers that life is short and every moment is precious.","translation":"詩人寫了一篇關於人類終將死亡的感人作品，提醒讀者生命短暫，每一刻都彌足珍貴。","explanation":"名詞「終將死亡的性質」。"}],"related_forms":["mortal"]}

{"headword": "mortgage", "explanation": "名詞或動詞，意為「房貸」或「抵押」。名詞用法最為常見，指借錢買房並以房產作為擔保。常用搭配 take out a mortgage (申請房貸)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After saving money for several years, the young couple finally <pattern>took</pattern> <pattern>out</pattern> a <target>mortgage</target> to buy their first home in the suburbs.", "translation": "在儲蓄了幾年之後，這對年輕夫婦終於申請了房貸，在郊區買了他們的第一個家。", "explanation": "名詞「房貸」。常用搭配：take out a mortgage。"}, {"sentence": "Because the interest rates rose unexpectedly, the family struggled to pay off their monthly <target>mortgage</target> payments on time.", "translation": "由於利率意外上升，這家人掙扎著要按時支付每月的房貸款項。", "explanation": "名詞「房貸」。"}, {"sentence": "Many people find it difficult to <target>mortgage</target> their property to start a new business because of the high risk involved.", "translation": "由於風險較高，許多人發現將其財產抵押以創業非常困難。", "explanation": "動詞「抵押」。指以財產作為擔保借款。"}, {"sentence": "The bank agreed to <target>mortgage</target> the house for a large sum of money, allowing the owner to cover his urgent medical expenses.", "translation": "銀行同意將這棟房子抵押出巨額款項，讓屋主能支付緊急的醫療費用。", "explanation": "動詞「抵押」。"}, {"sentence": "The couple decided to refinance their <target>mortgage</target> to take advantage of lower interest rates and reduce their monthly costs.", "translation": "這對夫婦決定重新對其房貸進行融資，以利用較低的利率來減少每月支出。", "explanation": "名詞「房貸」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"motive","explanation":"名詞，意為「動機」。指促使某人採取特定行動的原因。常用搭配 have a motive for (有...的動機)。注意與 motivation (動力/激勵) 的區別：motive 側重於行為背後的理由，而 motivation 側重於執行任務的積極性。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police are still trying to determine the <target>motive</target> <pattern>behind</pattern> the crime, as there was no clear evidence of theft.","translation":"警方仍在試圖確定這起犯罪背後的動機，因為沒有明顯的盜竊證據。","explanation":"名詞「動機」。常用搭配：motive behind sth。"},{"sentence":"She had no apparent <target>motive</target> <pattern>for</pattern> helping the stranger, other than a simple desire to be kind to others.","translation":"除了簡單地想對他人友善之外，她並沒有明顯的幫助陌生人的動機。","explanation":"名詞「動機」。常用搭配：have a motive for sth。"}],"related_forms":["motivation","motivate"]}
