{"headword": "mount", "explanation": "動詞「增加、上升」或「攀登」；名詞「山」。動詞用法中，mount up (累積) 是常見考點。注意其在描述壓力、債務或情緒時的用法。", "entries": [{"sentence": "As the deadline for the final project approached, the students felt the pressure <target>mounting</target> and began to study late into the night.", "translation": "隨著期末專題的截止日期臨近，學生們感到壓力增加，開始熬夜讀書。", "explanation": "動詞「增加、上升」。指壓力、情緒等逐漸增強。"}, {"sentence": "The family's debts continued to <target>mount</target> <pattern>up</pattern> after they lost their primary source of income during the economic crisis.", "translation": "在經濟危機期間失去主要收入來源後，這家人的債務繼續累積。", "explanation": "動詞片語 mount up 意為「累積」。常用於債務、費用等。"}, {"sentence": "The experienced climbers spent three days trying to <target>mount</target> the steep peak of the mountain, facing extreme cold and strong winds.", "translation": "經驗豐富的登山者花了三天時間試圖攀登陡峭的山峰，面對極端寒冷和強風。", "explanation": "動詞「攀登」。"}, {"sentence": "The small village is located at the foot of a majestic <target>mount</target> that is often covered in snow throughout the winter.", "translation": "這個小村莊位於一座雄偉的山峰腳下，冬天通常被白雪覆蓋。", "explanation": "名詞「山」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"mumble","explanation":"動詞或名詞，意為「含糊不清地說」。指說話時嘴巴沒有完全張開，導致他人難以聽清楚。常用搭配 mumble to oneself (自言自語地含糊地說)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The shy student tended to <target>mumble</target> his answers during the oral exam, making it difficult for the teacher to understand him.","translation":"那個害羞的學生在口試期間傾向於含糊地回答問題，讓老師很難聽懂他的話。","explanation":"動詞「含糊不清地說」。"},{"sentence":"He was so nervous that he started to <target>mumble</target> <pattern>to</pattern> himself while waiting for his turn to speak on stage.","translation":"他太緊張了，以至於在等待輪到他在台上發言時，開始自言自語地含糊地說話。","explanation":"動詞片語 mumble to oneself 意為「自言自語地含糊地說」。"},{"sentence":"I could barely hear his <target>mumble</target> because of the loud noise coming from the construction site across the street.","translation":"因為街對面建築工地傳來的巨大噪音，我幾乎聽不到他的含糊之言。","explanation":"名詞「含糊不清的言語」。"}],"related_forms":["mumbling"]}

{"headword":"municipal","explanation":"形容詞，意為「市政的、城市的」。指由市政府管理或與城市行政相關的事務。常用搭配 municipal government (市政府), municipal library (市立圖書館)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>municipal</target> <pattern>government</pattern> has decided to build a new park to provide more green spaces for the city's residents.","translation":"市政府決定建造一座新公園，為城市居民提供更多綠地。","explanation":"形容詞「市政的」。常用搭配：municipal government。"},{"sentence":"Students can borrow books from the <target>municipal</target> <pattern>library</pattern> using their student ID, which is a great resource for their research.","translation":"學生可以使用學生證從市立圖書館借書，這對他們的研究來說是一個很棒的資源。","explanation":"形容詞「市政的」。常用搭配：municipal library。"},{"sentence":"The city's <target>municipal</target> <pattern>waste</pattern> system has been upgraded to improve the efficiency of recycling and trash collection.","translation":"該市的市政廢物處理系統已經升級，以提高回收和垃圾收集的效率。","explanation":"形容詞「市政的」。常用搭配：municipal waste。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"muscular","explanation":"形容詞，意為「肌肉發達的」。常用於描述人的體格或某些身體部位。注意與 muscle (肌肉) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"After months of strict training and a high-protein diet, the athlete developed a <target>muscular</target> <pattern>build</pattern> that helped him win the race.","translation":"經過數月嚴格的訓練和高蛋白飲食，這位運動員練就了肌肉發達的體格，幫助他贏得了比賽。","explanation":"形容詞「肌肉發達的」。常用搭配：muscular build。"},{"sentence":"The <target>muscular</target> <pattern>structure</pattern> of the heart allows it to pump blood efficiently to all parts of the body.","translation":"心臟的肌肉結構使其能夠高效地將血液泵送到身體的所有部位。","explanation":"形容詞「肌肉發達的」。"}],"related_forms":["muscle"]}

{"headword":"mustard","explanation":"名詞，意為「芥末」。指一種調味料或一種植物。在 GSAT 中，通常出現在食物描述或文化文章中。","entries":[{"sentence":"The diner ordered a hot dog with <target>mustard</target> and ketchup, which is a classic combination of toppings in the United States.","translation":"食客點了一份加芥末和番茄醬的熱狗，這是美國最經典的配料組合。","explanation":"名詞「芥末」。"},{"sentence":"Some people find the taste of <target>mustard</target> too strong and pungent, so they prefer to use mayonnaise instead.","translation":"有些人覺得芥末的味道太強且刺鼻，，所以他們更喜歡用美乃滋代替。","explanation":"名詞「芥末」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "myth", "explanation": "名詞，意為「神話」或「誤區」。指古老的傳說或被廣泛接受但實際上是錯誤的信念。常用搭配 debunk a myth (揭穿一個誤區)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "In my history class, we studied ancient Greek <target>myths</target> about the gods and heroes who shaped the early world.", "translation": "在我的歷史課上，我們學習了古希臘神話中關於塑造早期世界的神和英雄的故事。", "explanation": "名詞「神話」。指古老的傳說。"}, {"sentence": "The scientist spent years of research to <pattern>debunk</pattern> the <target>myth</target> that some people believe that eating chocolate causes acne.", "translation": "這位科學家花了多年的研究來揭穿那個關於「吃巧克力會導致痤瘡」的誤區。", "explanation": "名詞「誤區」。常用搭配：debunk a myth。"}, {"sentence": "It is a common <target>myth</target> that you must drink eight glasses of water a day, but the actual amount depends on your body's needs.", "translation": "一個常見的誤區是認為你每天必須喝八杯水，但實際數量取決於你身體的需求。", "explanation": "名詞「詞義二：誤區」。"}], "related_forms": ["mythology", "mythical"]}

{"headword":"naive","explanation":"形容詞，意為「天真的、單純的」。指缺乏經驗或判斷力，因此容易被欺騙。注意其發音和拼寫，常與 innocent (清純的/無辜的) 相關，但 naive 帶有一定的負面意味。","entries":[{"sentence":"It was <target>naive</target> <pattern>of</pattern> him to believe that everything on the internet is true, especially without checking any reliable sources.","translation":"他相信網路上的所有內容都是真實的，尤其是沒有檢查任何可靠來源的情況下，這真是太天真了。","explanation":"形容詞「天真的」。常用搭配：It is naive of someone to do sth。"},{"sentence":"The young student was too <target>naive</target> to realize that the salesperson was trying to trick him into buying an overpriced product.","translation":"這個年輕學生太天真了，以至於沒有意識到銷售員正試圖騙他購買一件價格過高的產品。","explanation":"形容詞「天真的」。"},{"sentence":"Although she is highly educated, she can be quite <target>naive</target> regarding the complex political situations in different countries.","translation":"儘管她受過高等教育，但對於不同國家的複雜政治局勢，她可能相當天真。","explanation":"形容詞「天真的」。"}],"related_forms":["naivety","naively"]}

{"headword":"narrative","explanation":"名詞「敘事、故事」；形容詞「敘事性的」。名詞時指一種講述事件的方式或故事線。注意 narrative 與 story 的區別：narrative 通常更正式，強調講述的結構和過程。","entries":[{"sentence":"The novel's complex <target>narrative</target> follows three different characters, weaving their separate lives into a single, compelling story.","translation":"這部小說複雜的敘事方式追蹤了三個不同的角色，將他們各自的生活編織成一個引人入勝的故事。","explanation":"名詞「敘事、故事」。指講述故事的結構。"},{"sentence":"The history teacher encouraged students to write a personal <target>narrative</target> <pattern>about</pattern> their most memorable childhood experience to practice their descriptive writing.","translation":"歷史老師鼓勵學生寫一篇關於他們最難忘童年經驗的個人敘事文章，以練習他們的描述性寫作。","explanation":"名詞「敘事」。指一種文學體裁。"},{"sentence":"The author used a first-person <target>narrative</target> <pattern>style</pattern> to make the reader feel more connected to the protagonist's internal thoughts.","translation":"作者使用第一人稱的敘事風格，讓讀者感到與主角的內心想法更緊密地連結。","explanation":"形容詞「敘事性的」。描述講述方式。"}],"related_forms":["narrator","narrate"]}

{"headword":"nasty","explanation":"形容詞「令人厭惡的、下流的、糟糕的」。可用於描述氣味、味道、性格或情況（如天氣或受傷程度）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The old garbage cans in the alley emitted a <target>nasty</target> <pattern>smell</pattern> that made everyone who walked past cover their noses.","translation":"小巷子裡的舊垃圾桶散發出一種令人厭惡的味道，讓每個經過的人都捂住鼻子。","explanation":"形容詞「令人厭惡的」。常用搭配 nasty smell (厭惡的味道)。"},{"sentence":"She was shocked by the <target>nasty</target> <pattern>comments</pattern> left on her social media post, realizing that some people can be very unkind online.","translation":"她被社交媒體貼文上的下流評論震驚了，意識到有些人在網路上可能非常不友善。","explanation":"形容詞「下流的、惡劣的」。常用搭配 nasty comments (惡劣的評論)。"},{"sentence":"Be careful with that knife, because a <target>nasty</target> <pattern>cut</pattern> on your finger could lead to a serious infection if not treated properly.","translation":"小心用那把刀，因為手指上的一個嚴重割傷如果處理不當，可能會導致嚴重的感染。","explanation":"形容詞「糟糕的、嚴重的」。常用搭配 nasty cut (嚴重的割傷)。"},{"sentence":"The outdoor concert was canceled due to the <target>nasty</target> <pattern>weather</pattern>, with heavy rain and strong winds making it unsafe for the audience.","translation":"由於天氣糟糕，戶外音樂會被取消了，大雨和強風使得觀眾處於不安全狀態。","explanation":"形容詞「糟糕的」。常用搭配 nasty weather (糟糕的天氣)。"}],"related_forms":["nastily"]}

{"headword":"negotiation","explanation":"名詞「協商、談判」。指為了達成協議而進行的討論過程。常用片語 under negotiation (在協商中), reach a negotiation (達成協商)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After hours of intense <target>negotiation</target>, the two companies finally reached an agreement on the price of the new merger.","translation":"經過數小時激烈的協商，兩家公司終於在這次新合併的價格上達成了一致。","explanation":"名詞「協商」。指達成協議的過程。"},{"sentence":"The terms of the new employment contract are still <pattern>under</target> <target>negotiation</target>, as both parties are trying to find a fair compromise.","translation":"新僱傭合約的條款仍在協商中，因為雙方都在試圖尋找一個公平的妥協方案。","explanation":"名詞「協商」。常用片語 under negotiation (在協商中)。"},{"sentence":"Effective communication skills are essential for successful <target>negotiation</target> <pattern>between</pattern> different groups with conflicting interests.","translation":"有效的溝通技巧對於在具有衝突利益的不同群體之間進行成功的協商至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「協商」。常用搭配 negotiation between A and B。"}],"related_forms":["negotiate","negotiable"]}

{"headword":"neutral","explanation":"形容詞「中立的、中性的」；名詞「中立者」。指不偏袒任何一方，或在化學/物理中不帶電。注意 neutral 與 indifferent (冷漠的) 的區別：neutral 是指立場中立，而 indifferent 是指不在乎。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher acted as a <target>neutral</target> mediator during the argument between the two students to help them resolve the conflict fairly.","translation":"在兩名學生爭吵時，老師充當了中立的調解人，以幫助他們公平地解決衝突。","explanation":"形容詞「中立的」。指不偏袒任何一方。"},{"sentence":"When discussing sensitive political topics in class, it is often better to maintain a <target>neutral</target> <pattern>tone</pattern> to avoid unnecessary arguments.","translation":"在課堂上討論敏感的政治話題時，通常最好保持中立的語氣，以避免不必要的爭論。","explanation":"形容詞「中立的」。常用搭配 neutral tone (中立的語氣)。"},{"sentence":"In chemistry class, we learned that a <target>neutral</target> <pattern>solution</pattern> has a pH value of 7, meaning it is neither acidic nor alkaline.","translation":"在化學課上，我們學到中性溶液的 pH 值為 7，這意味著它既不是酸性的也不是鹼性的。","explanation":"形容詞「中性的」。指化學上的中性。"},{"sentence":"Since he did not want to offend either of his friends, he decided to remain a <target>neutral</target> during the debate about which movie to watch.","translation":"因為他不想得罪任何一個朋友，所以他決定在關於看哪部電影的辯論中保持中立。","explanation":"名詞「中立者」。"}],"related_forms":["neutrality","neutralize"]}

{"headword":"nominate","explanation":"動詞「提名」。指正式地建議某人擔任某個職位或獲獎。常用搭配 nominate someone for something (提名某人獲獎/任職)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students were asked to <target>nominate</target> a classmate <pattern>for</pattern> the position of class president during the first meeting of the semester.","translation":"在學期的第一次會議上，學生們被要求提名一名同學擔任班長職位。","explanation":"動詞「提名」。常用搭配 nominate someone for sth。"},{"sentence":"The famous director was <target>nominated</target> <pattern>for</pattern> an Academy Award because of his unique vision and stunning cinematography in the new film.","translation":"這位著名的導演因為在新電影中展現的獨特視覺和驚人的電影攝影而獲得了奧斯卡金像獎的提名。","explanation":"動詞「提名」。常用被動語態 nominate be nominated for sth。"},{"sentence":"The committee will <target>nominate</target> three candidates <pattern>to</pattern> lead the project, and the final choice will be made by the board of directors.","translation":"委員會將提名三位候選人來領導這個專案，而最終選擇將由董事會決定。","explanation":"動詞「提名」。常用搭配 nominate someone to do sth。"}],"related_forms":["nomination","nominee"]}

{"headword":"nomination","explanation":"名詞「提名」。指提名某人的行為或過程。","entries":[{"sentence":"After receiving the <target>nomination</target> <pattern>for</pattern> Best Actor, the young artist felt honored and thanked his team for their hard work.","translation":"在獲得最佳男主角的提名後，這位年輕的藝術家感到很榮幸，並感謝他的團隊的辛勤工作。","explanation":"名詞「提名」。常用搭配 nomination for sth。"},{"sentence":"The process of <target>nomination</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the new chairman was handled carefully to ensure that everyone's voice was heard.","translation":"新任主席的提名過程被小心地處理，以確保每個人的聲音都被聽到。","explanation":"名詞「提名」。常用搭配 nomination of someone。"}],"related_forms":["nominate","nominee"]}

{"headword":"nominee","explanation":"名詞「被提名者」。指被提名獲獎或任職的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"Each <target>nominee</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the scholarship was given ten minutes to present their academic achievements and future goals to the committee.","translation":"每位獎學金的被提名者都有十分鐘的時間向委員會展示他們的學業成就和未來目標。","explanation":"名詞「被提名者」。常用搭配 nominee for sth。"},{"sentence":"Although she was a <target>nominee</target> in several categories, she did not win the final award, but she still felt proud of her work.","translation":"儘管她在多個類別中被提名，但她最終沒有獲獎，但她仍然對自己的作品感到自豪。","explanation":"名詞「被提名者」。"}],"related_forms":["nominate","nomination"]}

{"headword":"nonprofit","explanation":"形容詞「非營利性的」。指不以獲利為目的的組織或機構。常搭配 nonprofit organization (非營利組織)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many students volunteer their time at a <target>nonprofit</target> <pattern>organization</pattern> to help homeless people and gain real-world experience.","translation":"許多學生在非營利組織擔任志工，以幫助無家可歸的人並獲得現實世界的經驗。","explanation":"形容詞「非營利性的」。常用搭配 nonprofit organization。"},{"sentence":"The <target>nonprofit</target> <pattern>group</pattern> focuses on protecting endangered species and restoring the natural habitats of wild animals in the rainforest.","translation":"這個非營利團體專注於保護瀕危物種和恢復雨林中野生動物的自然棲息地。","explanation":"形容詞「非營利性的」。常用搭配 nonprofit group。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "norm", "explanation": "名詞「規範、常態」。指社會中被普遍接受的標準或行為模式。常用片語 social norm (社會規範), the norm (常態)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "In some cultures, it is a <target>norm</target> <pattern>to</pattern> take off your shoes before entering a house, showing respect for the homeowner.", "translation": "在某些文化中，進入房屋前脫鞋是一個規範，以表示對屋主的尊重。", "explanation": "名詞「規範」。指社會行為的標準。"}, {"sentence": "Working from home has become <pattern>the</pattern> <target>norm</target> <pattern>for</pattern> many employees in the tech industry after the global pandemic.", "translation": "在全球疫情後，在家工作對許多科技產業的員工來說已成為常態。", "explanation": "名詞「常態」。常用片語 the norm (常態)。"}, {"sentence": "Students who do not follow the <target>norms</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the school, such as wearing the uniform correctly, may be asked to meet with the counselor.", "translation": "不遵守學校規範的學生，例如正確穿著校服，可能會被要求與輔導員面談。", "explanation": "名詞「規範」。常用搭配 norms of sth。"}], "related_forms": ["normalize", "normalization"]}

{"headword": "noticeable", "explanation": "形容詞「顯著的、明顯的」。指容易被察覺或注意到。注意 noticeable 與 obvious (顯而易見的) 區別：noticeable 側重於被察覺到的過程，而 obvious 顯然地不需要思考就可得知。", "entries": [{"sentence": "There has been a <target>noticeable</target> <pattern>improvement</pattern> in the student's test scores after he started attending extra tutoring sessions every weekend.", "translation": "在該學生開始每個週末參加額外補習後，他的考試分數有顯著的進步。", "explanation": "形容詞「顯著的」。常用搭配 noticeable improvement (顯著的進步)。"}, {"sentence": "The sudden change in her expression was <target>noticeable</target> <pattern>to</pattern> everyone in the room, indicating that she was unhappy with the decision.", "translation": "她表情的突然變化對房間裡的每個人來說都很明顯，顯示出她對這個決定不滿意。", "explanation": "形容詞「明顯的」。常用搭配 noticeable to someone。"}, {"sentence": "Because of the heavy fog, there was a <target>noticeable</target> <pattern>difference</pattern> in visibility between the two roads, making them both dangerous to drive on.", "translation": "由於濃霧，這兩條道路在能見度上存在顯著差異，使得兩者在駕駛時都十分危險。", "explanation": "形容詞「顯著的」。修正句子邏輯，確保 noticeable 與危險程度相符。"}], "related_forms": ["noticeably", "notice"]}

{"headword":"notify","explanation":"動詞「通知、告知」。常用搭配 notify someone of something (通知某人某事) 或 notify someone that... (通知某人...)。注意與 inform 的區別：notify 較為正式，常用於官方或法律通知。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school administration will <target>notify</target> all parents <pattern>of</pattern> the changes in the exam schedule through an official email.","translation":"學校行政部門將透過官方電子郵件通知所有家長考試時間表的變動。","explanation":"動詞「通知」。常用搭配：notify someone of something。"},{"sentence":"Please <target>notify</target> the manager <pattern>that</pattern> you will be absent from the meeting tomorrow due to a family emergency.","translation":"如果您明天因為家庭緊急情況不能參加會議，請通知經理。","explanation":"動詞「通知」。常用搭配：notify someone that..."},{"sentence":"The airline decided to <target>notify</target> the passengers <pattern>of</pattern> the flight delay as soon as the weather conditions worsened.","translation":"航空公司決定在天氣狀況惡化時立即通知乘客航班延誤。","explanation":"動詞「通知」。常用搭配：notify someone of something。"}],"related_forms":["notification","notified"]}

{"headword":"notion","explanation":"名詞「觀念、想法」。通常指一個大致的想法或一種普遍的看法，較 notion than idea 較為抽象或不確定。常用搭配 have a notion that... (有個想法/觀念)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students had a vague <target>notion</target> <pattern>of</pattern> how the complex chemical reaction worked, but they needed more detailed explanations.","translation":"學生們對於這個複雜的化學反應如何運作只有一個模糊的觀念，但他們需要更詳細的解釋。","explanation":"名詞「觀念」。常用搭配：a notion of something。"},{"sentence":"The traditional <target>notion</target> <pattern>of</pattern> success has changed over time, with more people now valuing happiness over high salaries.","translation":"傳統的成功觀念隨著時間而改變，現在更多的人看重快樂而非高薪。","explanation":"名詞「觀念」。指一種普遍的看法。"},{"sentence":"She suddenly had a <target>notion</target> <pattern>that</pattern> she should start learning a new language to expand her cultural horizons.","translation":"她突然有個想法，認為她應該開始學習一門新語言以擴展她的文化視野。","explanation":"名詞「想法」。常用搭配：have a notion that...。"}],"related_forms":["notional"]}

{"headword":"nowhere","explanation":"副詞或代名詞「沒有任何地方」。常用於否定句或強調句中。常見片語 be nowhere near (遠遠不足/還差得遠)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The missing keys were <target>nowhere</target> <pattern>to be found</pattern>, even after the students searched every corner of the classroom.","translation":"即使學生們搜尋了教室的每個角落，失蹤的鑰匙仍然無處可尋。","explanation":"副詞「沒有任何地方」。常用搭配：nowhere to be found (無處可尋)。"},{"sentence":"The athlete realized that his current training level was <target>nowhere</target> <pattern>near</pattern> enough to win the gold medal in the competition.","translation":"這名運動員意識到他目前的訓練程度遠遠不足以在比賽中贏得金牌。","explanation":"副詞「沒有任何地方」。常用片語 be nowhere near (遠遠不足/還差得遠)。"},{"sentence":"There is <target>nowhere</target> more peaceful than a quiet library on a rainy afternoon, where one can focus entirely on reading.","translation":"在下雨的午後，沒有任何地方比安靜的圖書館更令人心安，在那裡一個人可以完全專注於閱讀。","explanation":"副詞「沒有任何地方」。用於比較級句子中。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"nutrient","explanation":"名詞「營養素」或形容詞「營養的」。名詞指食物中對身體有益的物質，如 vitamins (維生素) 或 minerals (礦物質)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Plants absorb essential <target>nutrients</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the soil through their roots to grow strong and healthy leaves.","translation":"植物透過根部從土壤中吸收必要的營養素，以長出強壯健康的葉子。","explanation":"名詞「營養素」。指食物或土壤中的營養成分。"},{"sentence":"The doctor recommended eating more green vegetables because they are rich in <target>nutrients</target> <pattern>that</pattern> support a healthy immune system.","translation":"醫生建議多吃綠色蔬菜，因為它們富含支持健康免疫系統的營養素。","explanation":"名詞「營養素」。"},{"sentence":"The <target>nutrient</target> <pattern>rich</pattern> soil of the river valley made it an ideal location for ancient civilizations to develop agriculture.","translation":"河谷地帶營養豐富的土壤使其成為古代文明發展農業的理想地點。","explanation":"形容詞「營養的」。常用搭配：nutrient-rich (營養豐富的)。"}],"related_forms":["nutritional","nutrition"]}
comment: Note: The use of 'nutrient-rich' as an adjective in sentence 3 is acceptable as a compound adjective.

response: {"headword":"nutrition","explanation":"名詞「營養」。指攝取營養素的過程或營養狀態。常用搭配 poor nutrition (營養不良) 或 good nutrition (良好營養)。注意與 nutrient (營養素) 的區別：nutrient 是指具體的物質，而 nutrition 是指整體的營養狀態或學問。","entries":[{"sentence":"Proper <target>nutrition</target> is essential for growing teenagers to ensure their brains and bodies develop correctly during puberty.","translation":"良好的營養對成長中的青少年至關重要，以確保他們的大腦和身體在青春期能正確發育。","explanation":"名詞「營養」。指整體的營養狀態。"},{"sentence":"The school nurse gave a presentation on the importance of balanced <target>nutrition</target> to help students avoid unhealthy eating habits.","translation":"學校護理師就平衡營養的重要性做了一場演講，以幫助學生避免不健康的飲食習慣。","explanation":"名詞「營養」。常用搭配：balanced nutrition (平衡營養)。"},{"sentence":"Many children in poor regions suffer from <target>nutrition</target> <pattern>deficiencies</pattern>, which can lead to long-term health problems and stunted growth.","translation":"許多貧困地區的孩子營養不足，這可能導致長期的健康問題和發育遲緩。","explanation":"名詞「營養」。常用搭配：nutrition deficiency (營養缺乏)。"}],"related_forms":["nutritional","nutrient"]}

{"headword": "obligation", "explanation": "名詞「義務、責任」。常用搭配 have an obligation to do sth (有義務做某事) 或 under obligation (有義務/受約束)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "As a citizen, everyone has a legal <target>obligation</target> <pattern>to</pattern> follow the traffic laws to ensure the safety of all road users.", "translation": "作為一名公民，每個人都有法律義務遵守交通法規，以確保所有道路使用者的安全。", "explanation": "名詞「義務」。常用搭配：obligation to do sth。"}, {"sentence": "The parents felt a strong moral <target>obligation</target> <pattern>to</pattern> support their children's education, regardless of the financial cost.", "translation": "父母感到有強烈的道德義務支持孩子的教育，不論財務成本如何。", "explanation": "名詞「義務」。指道德上的責任。"}, {"sentence": "The company is <pattern>under</pattern> <target>obligation</target> to provide a safe working environment for its employees according to the new government regulations.", "translation": "根據政府的新規定，該公司有義務為其員工提供安全的工作環境。", "explanation": "名詞片語 under obligation (有義務)。"}], "related_forms": ["obligatory", "obliged"]}

{"headword":"obscure","explanation":"形容詞「模糊的、晦澀的、無名的」；動詞「遮蔽、使模糊」。形容詞時常用於描述不清楚的文字、概念或不知名的人；動詞時指遮住視線或使某事變得難以理解。","entries":[{"sentence":"The meaning of the poem was so <target>obscure</target> that even the English teacher struggled to explain it to the class.","translation":"這首詩的意思如此晦澀，以至於連英文老師都難以向全班解釋。","explanation":"形容詞「晦澀的」。指意思不清楚。"},{"sentence":"The athlete was once an <target>obscure</target> player from a small town, but he eventually became a global superstar after winning the championship.","translation":"這名運動員曾是一個來自小鎮的無名選手，但他在贏得冠軍後最終成為了全球超級巨星。","explanation":"形容詞「無名的」。指不為人知。"},{"sentence":"The thick clouds <target>obscured</target> the view of the mountain peak, making it impossible for the hikers to take any photos.","translation":"濃厚的雲層遮住了山頂的風景，使登山者無法拍到任何照片。","explanation":"動詞「遮蔽」。指遮住視線。"},{"sentence":"The politician tried to <target>obscure</target> the truth <pattern>about</pattern> the scandal by giving vague answers during the press conference.","translation":"這位政治家試圖透過在記者會上給出模糊的答案來掩蓋關於醜聞的真相。","explanation":"動詞「掩蓋/使模糊」。常用搭配：obscure the truth about sth。"}],"related_forms":["obscurity"]}

{"headword":"observer","explanation":"名詞「觀察者、觀察員」。指觀察事物的人或被委派去監測某事的人。常用搭配 keen observer (敏銳的觀察者)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The science student acted as a careful <target>observer</target> during the experiment, recording every small change in the chemical solution.","translation":"這名科學學生在實驗過程中扮演了仔細的觀察者，記錄了化學溶液中的每一個微小變化。","explanation":"名詞「觀察者」。指在科學實驗中進行觀察的人。"},{"sentence":"International <target>observers</target> were invited to monitor the election process to ensure that the voting was fair and transparent.","translation":"國際觀察員受邀監測選舉過程，以確保投票公平且透明。","explanation":"名詞「觀察員」。指被委派監督正式程序的人。"},{"sentence":"Since he is a <pattern>keen</pattern> <target>observer</target> <pattern>of</pattern> human behavior, he can often predict how people will react in different social situations.","translation":"因為他是人類行為的敏銳觀察者，他通常能預測人們在不同社交情況下會如何反應。","explanation":"名詞「觀察者」。常用搭配：keen observer of sth。"}],"related_forms":["observe","observation"]}

{"headword": "odds", "explanation": "名詞「機率、可能性」或「困難」。常考片語 the odds of... (…的機率) 或 against all odds (排除萬難)。注意 odds 通常以複數形式出現。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Despite the heavy rain and strong wind, the team won the championship <pattern>against</pattern> all <target>odds</target>, surprising everyone in the stadium.", "translation": "儘管下著大雨且強風猛烈，該隊仍排除萬難贏得了冠軍，讓體育場裡的每個人都感到驚訝。", "explanation": "名詞片語 against all odds (排除萬難/在極低機率下成功)。"}, {"sentence": "Doctors believe the <target>odds</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a full recovery are very high if the patient follows the strict medication plan.", "translation": "醫生認為，如果病人遵循嚴格的用藥計劃，就完全康復的機率非常高。", "explanation": "名詞「機率」。常用搭配：the odds of something。"}, {"sentence": "The gamble was risky, but he felt that the <target>odds</target> <pattern>were</pattern> <pattern>in</pattern> <pattern>his favor</pattern>, so he decided to try his luck.", "translation": "這次賭博很冒險，但覺得機率對他有利，所以決定試試運氣。", "explanation": "名詞片語 the odds are in someone's favor (機率對某人有利)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"offering","explanation":"名詞「產品、提供的東西」或「祭品」。在商業語境中，常指公司推出的新產品或服務。在宗教語境中，常指祭品或捐獻。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tech company announced its latest software <target>offering</target>, which includes advanced artificial intelligence tools for student productivity.","translation":"這家科技公司宣布了其最新的軟體產品，其中包括用於提高學生生產力的先進人工智慧工具。","explanation":"名詞「產品/提供的東西」。常用於商業語境。"},{"sentence":"The museum's newest <target>offering</target> is a special interactive exhibition that allows visitors to explore the history of ancient Egypt.","translation":"博物館最新的提供項目是一個特殊的互動展覽，允許遊客探索古埃及的歷史。","explanation":"名詞「提供項目」。"},{"sentence":"In ancient times, people often left food and flowers as an <target>offering</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the gods to pray for a good harvest.","translation":"在古代，人們經常留下食物和花朵作為給神靈的祭品，以祈求豐收。","explanation":"名詞「祭品」。常用搭配：offering to someone/something。"}],"related_forms":["offer"]}

{"headword":"olive","explanation":"名詞指「橄欖」或「橄欖色」；形容詞則描述「橄欖色的」。在 GSAT 考題中，通常出現在關於飲食、自然或顏色描述的文本中。","entries":[{"sentence":"The Italian restaurant serves a wonderful appetizer of marinated <target>olives</target> and warm bread, which is a favorite among many customers.","translation":"這家義大利餐廳提供醃製橄欖和溫熱麵包的絕佳開胃菜，深受許多顧客喜愛。","explanation":"名詞「橄欖」。"},{"sentence":"She chose a dress in a deep <target>olive</target> green color, which complemented her skin tone perfectly for the evening gala.","translation":"她選擇了一件深橄欖綠色的禮服，這顏色與她的膚色完美匹配，非常適合參加晚宴。","explanation":"形容詞「橄欖色的」。"},{"sentence":"Many people enjoy adding sliced <target>olives</target> to their salads to add a salty and rich flavor to the fresh vegetables.","translation":"許多人喜歡在沙拉中加入橄欖片，為新鮮蔬菜增添鹹味和濃郁的風味。","explanation":"名詞「橄欖」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"operational","explanation":"形容詞「可操作的；運作中的」。常用於描述機器、系統或計畫已準備好可以使用或正在運行中。常用搭配 operational cost (營運成本), be operational (開始運作)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After several months of construction and testing, the new city library is finally <target>operational</target>, providing a quiet space for students to study.","translation":"經過數月的建設和測試，新的市立圖書館終於開始運作，為學生提供了一個安靜的學習空間。","explanation":"形容詞「運作中的」。指系統或設施已準備好可以使用。"},{"sentence":"The company is trying to reduce its <target>operational</target> <pattern>costs</pattern> by introducing new technology to automate the packaging process.","translation":"公司正嘗試透過引入新技術來自動化包裝過程，以降低其營運成本。","explanation":"形容詞「營運的」。常用搭配：operational costs (營運成本)。"},{"sentence":"The flight control system became <target>operational</target> after the engineers fixed the software glitch that had caused the delay.","translation":"飛行控制系統在工程師修復導致延遲的軟體錯誤後，恢復了運作。","explanation":"形容詞「運作中的」。"}],"related_forms":["operate","operation","operator"]}

{"headword": "opponent", "explanation": "名詞「對手；反對者」。指在比賽、辯論或政治中競爭的人。注意與 opposite (相反的) 區分，opponent 強調競爭對象。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The tennis player shook hands with his <target>opponent</target> after the match, showing great sportsmanship despite the intense competition.", "translation": "網球選手在比賽結束後與對手握手，儘管競爭激烈，仍展現了極佳的運動精神。", "explanation": "名詞「對手」。指比賽中的競爭者。"}, {"sentence": "In the school debate competition, she had to prepare strong arguments to convince her <target>opponent</target> and the judges.", "translation": "在學校的辯論賽中，她必須準備強而有力的論點來說服對手和評審。", "explanation": "名詞「對手」。指辯論中的對手。"}, {"sentence": "The politician faced strong <target>opponents</target> who disagreed with his new tax policy and argued that it would hurt the poor.", "translation": "這位政治家面臨強大的反對者，他們不同意他的新稅收政策，並認為這會傷害了窮人。", "explanation": "名詞「反對者」。"}], "related_forms": ["oppose", "opposition"]}

{"headword":"opposition","explanation":"名詞「反對；對立」。可指對某事的反對態度，或指政治上的反對黨。常用片語 in opposition to (與...相反/反對), face strong opposition (面臨強烈反對)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The plan to build a new shopping mall faced strong <target>opposition</target> <pattern>from</pattern> local residents who feared it would increase traffic congestion.","translation":"在當地居民擔心會增加交通擁堵的情況下，建設新購物中心的計劃面臨了強烈的反對。","explanation":"名詞「反對」。常用搭配：opposition from someone (來自某人的反對)。"},{"sentence":"The student council's proposal to change the school uniform was met with fierce <target>opposition</target> by the traditional teachers.","translation":"學生會更改校服的提案遭到了傳統老師們的強烈反對。","explanation":"名詞「反對」。"},{"sentence":"Many people live in <target>opposition</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the government's new law, arguing that it limits the freedom of speech for all citizens.","translation":"許多人反對政府的新法律，認為它限制了所有公民的言論自由。","explanation":"名詞「反對」。常用片語 in opposition to (反對.../與...相反)。"}],"related_forms":["oppose","opponent"]}

{"headword":"opt","explanation":"動詞「選擇」。比 choose 更正式，常用搭配 opt for (選擇某物), opt to (選擇做某事)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many students <target>opt</target> <pattern>for</pattern> a gap year after high school to travel and gain life experience before entering university.","translation":"許多學生在高中畢業後選擇休學一年，以便在進入大學之前旅行並獲得生活經驗。","explanation":"動詞「選擇」。常用片語 opt for + N (選擇某物)。"},{"sentence":"Instead of taking the bus, she <target>opted</target> <pattern>to</pattern> walk to school to get some fresh air and exercise every morning.","translation":"她選擇走路去學校，而不是搭公車，以便每天早晨呼吸新鮮空氣並運動。","explanation":"動詞「選擇」。常用片語 opt to + V (選擇做某事)。"},{"sentence":"Since the textbook was too expensive, some students <target>opted</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the electronic version to save money.","translation":"由於教科書太貴，一些學生選擇電子版本以省錢。","explanation":"動詞「選擇」。常用片語 opt for + N。"}],"related_forms":["option","optional"]}

{"headword":"optimism","explanation":"名詞「樂觀主義；樂觀」。指對未來抱有正面期待的態度。與 pessimism (悲觀主義) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite the difficult exam results, her <target>optimism</target> helped her stay motivated and keep studying hard for the next test.","translation":"儘管考試結果不理想，她的樂觀精神幫助她保持動力並繼續努力學習準備下一次考試。","explanation":"名詞「樂觀」。"},{"sentence":"The economic report filled the investors with <target>optimism</target>, as it predicted a strong growth in the global market next year.","translation":"這份經濟報告讓投資者充滿了樂觀，因為它預測明年全球市場將有強勁增長。","explanation":"名詞「樂觀」。"},{"sentence":"A sense of <target>optimism</target> spread through the team after the coach gave an inspiring speech before the big game.","translation":"在教練於大賽前發表了一場激勵人心的演講後，團隊中瀰漫著一種樂觀的情緒。","explanation":"名詞「樂觀」。"}],"related_forms":["optimistic","optimistically"]}

{"headword":"optional","explanation":"形容詞「可選擇的；非強制性的」。指不需要必須做的事。常用搭配 optional course (選修課), optional equipment (選配設備)。","entries":[{"sentence":"In our high school, the afternoon art class is <target>optional</target>, so students can choose whether to attend based on their interests.","translation":"在我們高中，下午的藝術課是選修的，所以學生可以根據自己的興趣選擇是否參加。","explanation":"形容詞「可選擇的」。"},{"sentence":"The teacher told us that the homework assignment was <target>optional</target>, but completing it would help us better understand the lesson.","translation":"老師告訴我們，這次的家庭作業是自願的，但完成它將幫助我們更好地理解課程。","explanation":"形容詞「可選擇的」。"},{"sentence":"When buying a new car, leather seats are often an <target>optional</target> <pattern>feature</pattern> that costs extra money.","translation":"購買新車時，皮質座椅通常是一個需要額外花錢的選配功能。","explanation":"形容詞「可選擇的」。常用搭配：optional feature (選配功能)。"}],"related_forms":["option"]}

{"headword":"orchard","explanation":"名詞「果園」。指專門種植果樹的土地。常見搭配 apple orchard (蘋果園), peach orchard (桃園)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Every autumn, the family visits a local <target>orchard</target> to pick fresh apples for making homemade apple pies.","translation":"每年秋天，這家人都會去當地的果園採摘新鮮蘋果，用來製作自製蘋果派。","explanation":"名詞「果園」。"},{"sentence":"The farmer spent the entire morning pruning the trees in his <target>orchard</target> to ensure a healthy harvest next year.","translation":"農夫花了一整個上午修剪果園裡的樹木，以確保明年的收成健康。","explanation":"名詞「果園」。"},{"sentence":"Walking through the cherry <target>orchard</target> in spring is a wonderful experience because the blossoms are absolutely beautiful.","translation":"春天走在櫻桃果園中是一種美妙的體驗，因為花朵絕對美麗。","explanation":"名詞「果園」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"organism","explanation":"名詞「有機體；生物」。指任何具有生命形式的個體，無論大小。常用於生物學討論。","entries":[{"sentence":"A tiny <target>organism</target> discovered in the deep ocean can survive in extreme temperatures that would kill most other creatures.","translation":"在深海中發現的一種微小生物可以在極端溫度下生存，而這種溫度會杀死大多數其他生物。","explanation":"名詞「生物」。指單個生命個體。"},{"sentence":"Bacteria are single-celled <target>organisms</target> that can be found almost everywhere, from the soil to the human body.","translation":"細菌是單細胞生物，幾乎處處可見，從土壤到人體。","explanation":"名詞「生物」。指生物學上的有機體。"},{"sentence":"The scientist explained how each <target>organism</target> in the ecosystem plays a specific role in maintaining the balance of nature.","translation":"科學家解釋了生態系統中的每個生物在維持自然平衡方面扮演著特定的角色。","explanation":"名詞「生物」。"}],"related_forms":["organic","organization"]}

{"headword":"originality","explanation":"名詞「原創性；新穎性」。指作品或想法不模仿他人而具有獨特性的特質。常用搭配 lack originality (缺乏原創性), show originality (展現原創性)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The judges praised the student's art project for its <target>originality</target>, as she used recycled materials in a very creative way.","translation":"評審們稱讚這名學生的藝術項目因其原創性，因為她以非常創意的方式使用了回收材料。","explanation":"名詞「原創性」。"},{"sentence":"Many pop songs today sound very similar, and some critics argue that they <pattern>lack</pattern> <target>originality</target> in their melodies.","translation":"現在的許多流行歌曲聽起來非常相似，一些評論家認為它們的旋律缺乏原創性。","explanation":"名詞「原創性」。常用搭配：lack originality (缺乏原創性)。"},{"sentence":"To succeed in the competitive world of design, an artist must combine technical skill with a high degree of <target>originality</target>.","translation":"要在競爭激烈的設計世界中取得成功，藝術家必須將技術能力與高度的原創性相結合。","explanation":"名詞『原創性』。"}],"related_forms":["original"]}

{"headword":"outfit","explanation":"名詞指「一套衣服」或「裝備」；動詞則指「為...提供裝備」或「配備」。注意名詞用法中 outfit 通常指一套完整的穿著，而非單件衣服。","entries":[{"sentence":"She spent hours choosing the perfect <target>outfit</target> for the graduation party, wanting to look elegant and confident in front of everyone.","translation":"她花了好幾個小時選擇畢業派對最完美的一套衣服，想要在每個人面前看起來優雅且自信。","explanation":"名詞「一套衣服」。指一套完整的穿著。"},{"sentence":"The explorers were carefully <target>outfitted</target> <pattern>with</pattern> high-tech gear and warm clothing before they began their journey to the North Pole.","translation":"探險家在開始前往北極的旅程之前，被細心地配備了高科技裝備和保暖衣物。","explanation":"動詞「配備」。常用搭配 outfit with sth。"},{"sentence":"The school's science lab is <target>outfitted</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the latest equipment, allowing students to conduct complex experiments safely and accurately.","translation":"學校的科學實驗室配備了最新的設備，讓學生能安全且精確地進行複雜的實驗。","explanation":"動詞「配備」。常用於描述設備的安裝。"}],"related_forms":["outfitting"]}

{"headword":"outlet","explanation":"名詞「出口」或「零售店（特別是折扣店）」。在電器方面，也指「電源插座」。常考用法：power outlet (電源插座), creative outlet (情感/創造力的抒發口)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Because the brand offered huge discounts, the <target>outlet</target> store in the suburbs attracted thousands of shoppers every weekend.","translation":"因為該品牌提供巨大的折扣，郊區的折扣店每週末都吸引了數千名購物者。","explanation":"名詞「折扣店」。指直接從工廠或品牌銷售的廉價零售店。"},{"sentence":"Writing in a personal journal every night provides a great creative <target>outlet</target> <pattern>for</pattern> her to express her feelings and reduce stress.","translation":"每晚在個人日記中寫作為她提供了一個絕佳的創造力抒發口，讓她能表達情感並減輕壓力。","explanation":"名詞「抒發口」。常用搭配 outlet for sth。"},{"sentence":"Please make sure to unplug the charger from the wall <target>outlet</target> after the phone is fully charged to save energy.","translation":"請確保在手機充滿電後將充電器從牆上的電源插座拔掉，以節省能源。","explanation":"名詞「電源插座」。"}],"related_forms":["outlets"]}

{"headword": "output", "explanation": "名詞「產量」或「輸出」；動詞「產出」。在經濟或工業背景下，常用於描述生產量。在電腦科學中，則指輸出結果。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The factory implemented new automated machines to increase its daily <target>output</target> of electronic components and meet the growing market demand.", "translation": "工廠採用了新的自動化機器以增加電子零件的每日產量，以滿足日益增長的市場需求。", "explanation": "名詞「產量」。指生產出的數量。"}, {"sentence": "The computer program takes the user's input and processes it to produce a detailed <target>output</target> in the form of a chart.", "translation": "電腦程式接收使用者的輸入並處理它，以圖表的形式產出詳細的輸出結果。", "explanation": "名詞「輸出」。指輸出結果。"}, {"sentence": "The agricultural department is trying to increase the <target>output</target> of organic vegetables this year by introducing new farming techniques to local farmers.", "translation": "農業部門今年試圖透過向當地農民介紹新的耕作技術來增加有機蔬菜的產出。", "explanation": "名詞「產量」。"}, {"sentence": "The system was designed to <target>output</target> the results automatically after the analysis was completed, saving the researchers a lot of time.", "translation": "該系統被設計成在分析完成後自動產出結果，為研究人員節省了大量時間。", "explanation": "動詞「產出」。指將數據或資訊輸出。"}, {"sentence": "The software developer spent several hours trying to <target>output</target> the error logs to a separate file for easier debugging.", "translation": "軟體開發人員花了幾個小時試圖將錯誤日誌產出到一個獨立的文件中，以便於除錯。", "explanation": "動詞「產出」。"}], "related_forms": ["outputs"]}

{"headword":"outsider","explanation":"名詞「局外人、外來者」。指不屬於某個特定群體、組織或社會階層的人。常考搭配：be an outsider (是個局外人)。","entries":[{"sentence":"As a transfer student from another country, he felt like an <target>outsider</target> during the first few weeks of school until he joined the soccer team.","translation":"作為一名來自另一個國家的轉學生，在入學的前幾週他覺得自己像個局外人，直到他加入了足球隊。","explanation":"名詞「局外人」。指不屬於該群體的人。"},{"sentence":"The company decided to hire an <target>outsider</target> as the new CEO to bring fresh perspectives and innovative ideas to the organization.","translation":"公司決定聘請一名外部人士擔任新任執行長，為組織帶來新鮮的觀點和創新想法。","explanation":"名詞「外來者」。指不屬於該組織內部的人。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"overall","explanation":"形容詞「整體的、全面的」；副詞「總體而言」；名詞「連身工作褲」。注意副詞用法在句首時常後接逗號，用來對前文進行總結。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>overall</target> cost of the renovation project was higher than expected, but the result was worth every penny.","translation":"翻修計畫的總體成本比預期的要高，但結果值得每一分錢。","explanation":"形容詞「整體的」。指全部加在一起的狀態。"},{"sentence":"The student's grades were not perfect, but <target>overall</target>, his performance in the English class improved significantly over the semester.","translation":"這個學生的成績並不完美，但總體而言，他在英文課上的表現整個學期都有顯著提升。","explanation":"副詞「總體而言」。用來總結情況。"},{"sentence":"The mechanic wore a pair of blue <target>overalls</target> to protect his clothes from oil and grease while repairing the old car engine.","translation":"機械師穿著一件藍色連身工作褲，以在修理舊汽車引擎時保護衣服不被油垢弄髒。","explanation":"名詞「連身工作褲」。通常使用複數形式 overalls。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"overhead","explanation":"副詞「在...上方」；形容詞「或名詞指「經常性開支（如房租、水電費）」。在商務英語中， overhead (經常性開支) 是常見考點。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students looked <target>overhead</target> and saw a flock of birds flying south for the winter across the clear blue sky.","translation":"學生們看向頭頂上方，看到一群鳥在晴朗的藍天中向南飛越冬。","explanation":"副詞「在...上方」。指位置在頭頂之上。"},{"sentence":"To reduce the company's <target>overhead</target> costs, the manager decided to rent a smaller office and cut down on unnecessary electricity usage.","translation":"為了降低公司的經常性開支，經理決定租一個較小的辦公室並減少不必要的電力使用。","explanation":"名詞「經常性開支」。指經營企業所需的基本固定成本。"},{"sentence":"The airplane flew low <target>overhead</target>, making a loud noise that woke up many residents in the quiet neighborhood.","translation":"飛機在頭頂低空飛過，發出巨大的噪音，吵醒了寧靜社區裡的許多居民。","explanation":"副詞「在...上方」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"oversee","explanation":"動詞「監督、監管」。指負責管理某人或某事，確保其正確執行。常用搭配：oversee a project (監督計畫)。注意與 overlook (忽略/俯瞰) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The senior architect was hired to <target>oversee</target> the construction of the new museum, ensuring that every detail followed the original design.","translation":"這位資深建築師被聘請來監督新博物館的建設，確保每個細節都符合原始設計。","explanation":"動詞「監督」。指負責管理過程。"},{"sentence":"The principal will <target>oversee</target> the final examinations to make sure that no students are cheating and that the process is fair.","translation":"校長將監督期末考試，以確保沒有學生作弊且過程公平。","explanation":"動詞「監督」。指監控執行過程。"}],"related_forms":["overseer"]}

{"headword":"overtake","explanation":"動詞「超越、追上」或「佔據（主導地位）」。常用於交通工具的超車或在競爭中超越對手。","entries":[{"sentence":"The fast car tried to <target>overtake</target> the slow truck on the highway, but there was not enough space to pass safely.","translation":"這輛快車試圖在高速公路上超越那慢速卡車，但沒有足夠的空間可以安全地通過。","explanation":"動詞「超越」。指在移動中追上並超過。"},{"sentence":"Many experts believe that small, innovative companies will soon <target>overtake</target> larger corporations in the field of artificial intelligence.","translation":"許多專家認為，小型創新公司很快將在人工智慧領域超越大型企業。","explanation":"動詞「超越」。指在能力或地位上超過對手。"}],"related_forms":["overtaken"]}

{"headword":"overturn","explanation":"動詞「推翻、翻轉」；名詞「翻覆」。可用於物理上的翻轉（如車輛翻覆）或抽象的定義（如推翻判決、觀念）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The strong wind caused the small boat to <target>overturn</target> in the middle of the lake, forcing the passengers to swim to shore.","translation":"強風導致小船在湖中心翻覆，迫使乘客游泳回岸邊。","explanation":"動詞「翻轉」。指物理上的翻覆。"},{"sentence":"The higher court decided to <target>overturn</target> the previous judge's decision, stating that the evidence provided was not sufficient for a conviction.","translation":"高等法院決定推翻之前的法官決定，由於提供的證據不足以定罪。","explanation":"動詞「推翻」。指正式地撤銷或改變之前的法律決定。"},{"sentence":"The emergency services arrived quickly after the car <target>overturned</target> on the slippery road, helping the injured passengers get out of the vehicle.","translation":"在汽車於濕滑道路上翻覆後，緊急救援服務迅速到達，幫助受傷的乘客離開車輛。","explanation":"名詞/動詞用法。指車輛翻覆。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"overwhelm","explanation":"動詞「使...感到不知所措、壓倒」。常用於描述情緒（如壓力、悲傷）或數量上的壓倒性優勢。常用被動語態：be overwhelmed by/with sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new students were <target>overwhelmed</target> <pattern>by</pattern> the amount of homework and the high expectations from their parents during the first month of school.","translation":"新學生在入學的第一個月被大量的作業和父母的高期待搞得不知所措。","explanation":"動詞「使不知所措」。常用被動語態 be overwhelmed by...。"},{"sentence":"The small village was <target>overwhelmed</target> <pattern>by</pattern> a massive flood after three days of continuous heavy rain, destroying many old houses.","translation":"在連續三天的暴雨之後，這個小村莊被巨大的洪水淹沒，摧毀了許多舊房子。","explanation":"動詞「壓倒/淹沒」。指物理上的被覆蓋。"},{"sentence":"She felt <target>overwhelmed</target> <pattern>with</pattern> joy when she received the acceptance letter from her dream university, unable to stop crying from happiness.","translation":"當她收到夢想大學的錄取通知書時，她感到欣喜若狂，因快樂而止不住地哭泣。","explanation":"動詞「使不知所措」。常用搭配 be overwhelmed with (emotion)。"}],"related_forms":["overwhelming","overwhelmingly"]}

{"headword": "parallel", "explanation": "形容詞「平行的、相似的」；名詞「平行線；相似之處」；動詞「與...平行；與...相似」。常考搭配：in parallel with (與...平行/同步), draw a parallel between (在...之間建立類比)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The two roads run <target>parallel</target> to each other for several miles before finally splitting at the city entrance.", "translation": "這兩條路平行延伸數英里，最後在城市入口處分開。", "explanation": "形容詞「平行的」。指兩條線或路徑互不相交。"}, {"sentence": "Historians often <pattern>draw</pattern> <target>parallels</target> <pattern>between</pattern> the fall of the Roman Empire and the decline of modern civilizations.", "translation": "歷史學家經常在羅馬帝國的衰落與現代文明的衰落之間建立類比。", "explanation": "名詞「相似之處」。常用片語 draw a parallel between A and B。"}, {"sentence": "The new software was designed to work <pattern>in</pattern> <target>parallel</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the existing system to ensure a smooth transition during the update.", "translation": "這款新軟體被設計成與現有系統同步運行，以確保更新期間的平穩過渡。", "explanation": "形容詞/副詞用法。片語 in parallel with 表示「與...平行/同步」。"}, {"sentence": "The growth of the digital economy <target>parallels</target> the rapid increase in global internet access over the last two decades.", "translation": "數位經濟的成長與過去二十年全球網路普及迄率的快速增加相平行。", "explanation": "動詞「與...相似；與...平行」。指發展趨勢或進程一致。"}], "related_forms": ["paralleled", "paralleling"]}

{"headword":"participant","explanation":"名詞「參與者」。常用於學術研究、競賽或活動中。常考搭配：active participant (積極的參與者), participant in (參與...的人)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Each <target>participant</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the English speaking contest was given a certificate of attendance to recognize their effort.","translation":"英語演講比賽的每位參與者都獲得了一張出席證明書，以表彰他們的努力。","explanation":"名詞「參與者」。常用搭配 participant in sth。"},{"sentence":"The researchers asked every <target>participant</target> to fill out a detailed questionnaire about their sleeping habits and daily diet.","translation":"研究人員要求每位參與者填寫一份關於睡眠習慣和日常飲食的詳細問卷。","explanation":"名詞「參與者」。常用於科學實驗或社會調查。"},{"sentence":"To make the class more engaging, the teacher encouraged every student to be an <pattern>active</pattern> <target>participant</target> in the group discussions.","translation":"為了讓課程更有趣，老師鼓勵每位學生在小組討論中成為積極的參與者。","explanation":"名詞「參與者」。常用搭配 active participant。"}],"related_forms":["participation","participate"]}

{"headword":"particle","explanation":"名詞「微粒；粒子」。常用於科學（物理、化學）描述，指極小的一部分。","entries":[{"sentence":"The air filter is designed to trap tiny <target>particles</target> <pattern>of</pattern> dust and pollen, preventing them from entering the lungs.","translation":"空氣濾淨器旨在捕捉微小的灰塵和花粉微粒，防止它們進入肺部。","explanation":"名詞「微粒」。常用搭配 particles of dust/pollen。"},{"sentence":"In physics class, the teacher explained how subatomic <target>particles</target> behave when they collide at extremely high speeds.","translation":"在物理課上，老師解釋了亞原子粒子在極高速度碰撞時是如何運作的。","explanation":"名詞「粒子」。指科學定義上的基本組成單位。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"partly","explanation":"副詞「部分地、在一定程度上」。常用於解釋原因或描述狀態，注意與 completely (完全地) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The success of the project was <target>partly</target> <pattern>due to</pattern> the team's hard work and <target>partly</target> <pattern>due to</pattern> a bit of luck.","translation":"該計畫的成功部分歸功於團隊的努力，部分歸功於一點運氣。","explanation":"副詞「部分地」。常用搭配 partly due to (部分由於)。"},{"sentence":"The outdoor concert was <target>partly</target> cancelled because of the unexpected heavy rain and the strong wind.","translation":"戶外音樂會部分取消，是因為突如其來的大雨和強風。","explanation":"副詞「部分地」。指部分內容或範圍被取消。"}],"related_forms":["partial","partially"]}

{"headword":"passionate","explanation":"形容詞「熱情的、熱烈的」。指對某事有強烈情感或極大興趣。常考搭配：be passionate about (對...充滿熱情)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Sarah is <target>passionate</target> <pattern>about</pattern> environmental protection and spends her weekends volunteering at the local animal shelter.","translation":"莎拉對環境保護充滿熱情，週末常在當地的動物收容所擔任志工。","explanation":"形容詞「熱情的」。常用片語 be passionate about sth。"},{"sentence":"The speaker delivered a <target>passionate</target> <pattern>speech</pattern> urging the students to take action against climate change and save the planet.","translation":"演講者發表了一場熱情的演講，敦促學生採取行動對抗氣候變遷並拯救地球。","explanation":"形容詞「熱情的」。常用搭配 passionate speech (熱情的演講)。"},{"sentence":"Despite the disagreement, the two artists had a <target>passionate</target> <pattern>debate</pattern> about the meaning of modern art in the gallery.","translation":"儘管有分歧，這兩位藝術家在畫廊裡就現代藝術的意義進行了一場激烈的辯論。","explanation":"形容詞「熱烈的」。在此指情感強烈地進行爭論。"}],"related_forms":["passion","passionately"]}

{"headword":"pastry","explanation":"名詞「糕點、酥皮」。指用麵粉、油脂和水製成的烘焙食品。","entries":[{"sentence":"The smell of fresh <target>pastries</target> coming from the bakery every morning always makes the students feel hungry before class.","translation":"每天早上烘焙店傳來的新鮮糕點香味，總是讓學生在上課前感到飢餓。","explanation":"名詞「糕點」。指各種甜點或鹹點烘焙品。"},{"sentence":"The chef showed the students how to roll the <target>pastry</target> thinly and fold it carefully to make a perfect apple pie.","translation":"主廚向學生展示如何將酥皮擀薄並小心折疊，以製作出完美的蘋果派。","explanation":"名詞「酥皮」。指製作糕點用的麵團。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"patch","explanation":"名詞「小塊（土地）；補丁」；動詞「修補」。常考搭配：a patch of (一小塊...), patch up (修補/和解)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After the heavy rain, a small <target>patch</target> <pattern>of</pattern> ice formed on the sidewalk, causing several pedestrians to slip and fall.","translation":"大雨後，人行道上形成了一小塊冰，導致幾名行人滑倒。","explanation":"名詞「小塊」。常用搭配 a patch of ice/grass/fog。"},{"sentence":"The old farmer spent the afternoon sewing a <target>patch</target> <pattern>on</pattern> his worn-out jeans to make them usable again.","translation":"老農夫花了一個下午在破舊的牛仔褲上縫一塊補丁，使它們能再次使用。","explanation":"名詞「補丁」。指用來修補孔洞的布料。"},{"sentence":"The two friends tried to <target>patch</target> <pattern>up</pattern> their relationship after a big argument about a school project last month.","translation":"這兩個朋友在上個月因學校計畫而發生大爭執後，試圖修復他們的關係。","explanation":"動詞片語 patch up sth 意為「修補/和解」。可用於實體物品或人際關係。"},{"sentence":"The technician had to <target>patch</target> the software to fix a critical bug that caused the computer system to crash frequently.","translation":"技術人員必須對軟體進行修補，以修復導致電腦系統頻繁崩潰的嚴重漏洞。","explanation":"動詞「修補」。指透過更新程式碼來修復錯誤。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"patent","explanation":"名詞「專利」；形容詞「明顯的」；動詞「取得專利」。常考搭配：apply for a patent (申請專利), hold a patent (持有專利)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young inventor decided to <pattern>apply</pattern> <pattern>for</pattern> a <target>patent</target> to protect his new design for a solar-powered water purifier.","translation":"這位年輕的發明家決定申請專利，以保護他設計的新型太陽能淨水器。","explanation":"名詞「專利」。常用片語 apply for a patent。"},{"sentence":"Because the company <target>patents</target> its unique chemical formula, other businesses cannot legally produce the same medicine for several years.","translation":"由於公司對其獨特的化學配方取得了專利，其他企業在幾年內不能合法地生產相同的藥品。","explanation":"動詞「取得專利」。指將發明登記為法律保護的專利。"},{"sentence":"It was <target>patent</target> <pattern>to</pattern> everyone in the room that the student was lying about why he missed the final exam.","translation":"房間裡的每個人都明顯地看出，這名學生關於他為何缺席期末考的解釋是在撒謊。","explanation":"形容詞「明顯的」。較正式用法，同於 obvious。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"pathetic","explanation":"形容詞「可憐的；糟糕的」。可用於表達同情，或表達輕蔑（指能力或品質極差）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The lost puppy looked <target>pathetic</target> sitting alone in the rain, with its fur soaked and shivering from the cold.","translation":"那隻迷路的小狗獨自坐在雨中，毛被淋濕且因寒冷而顫抖，看起來非常可憐。","explanation":"形容詞「可憐的」。引起同情之情。"},{"sentence":"The team's <target>pathetic</target> <pattern>attempt</pattern> to win the game was disappointing, as they had not practiced enough during the season.","translation":"該隊贏球的嘗試非常糟糕，令人失望，因為他們在賽季期間練習不足。","explanation":"形容詞「糟糕的」。在此指能力或努力程度低得令人輕視。"}],"related_forms":["pathetically","patheticness"]}

{"headword":"patrol","explanation":"名詞「巡邏」；動詞「巡邏」。常考搭配：on patrol (在巡邏), police patrol (警察巡邏)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The security guards <target>patrol</target> the school campus every hour to ensure that all the doors are locked and safe.","translation":"保全人員每小時在校園內巡邏一次，以確保所有門都鎖好且安全。","explanation":"動詞「巡邏」。指為了安全而定期巡視。"},{"sentence":"A police <target>patrol</target> was spotted driving slowly through the neighborhood to prevent crimes and keep the residents feeling secure.","translation":"一名警察巡邏隊被發現緩慢地在社區中開車，以防止犯罪並讓居民感到安心。","explanation":"名詞「巡邏隊」。指負責巡邏的人員或小組。"},{"sentence":"The officer explained that he was <pattern>on</pattern> <target>patrol</target> when he witnessed the car accident at the intersection of the two streets.","translation":"該警官解釋說，他在巡邏時目擊了這兩條街交叉口的車禍。","explanation":"名詞「巡邏」。片語 on patrol 表示「在巡邏中」。"}],"related_forms":["patrols","patrolled","patrolling"]}

{"headword":"patron","explanation":"名詞「顧客、贊助人」。在商業語境中，指經常光顧某店的客人；在藝術語境中，指資助藝術家的贊助人。常用搭配 patron of the arts (藝術贊助人)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The bookstore owner thanked her regular <target>patrons</target> for their loyal support, which helped the small shop survive during the economic crisis.","translation":"書店老闆感謝她的常客們對她的忠實支持，這讓這家小店在經濟危機期間得以生存。","explanation":"名詞「顧客」。指經常光顧某個場所的客人。"},{"sentence":"In the past, many great painters relied on wealthy <target>patrons</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the arts to fund their masterpieces and provide them with living expenses.","translation":"在過去，許多偉大的畫家依賴富有的藝術贊助人來資助他們的傑作並提供生活費。","explanation":"名詞「贊助人」。常用搭配 patron of the arts (藝術贊助人)。"}],"related_forms":["patronage","patronize"]}

{"headword":"peasant","explanation":"名詞「農民、鄉下人」。通常指在封建社會中耕種土地的低階農民，或在現代语境中帶有輕視意味地指代缺乏教養的鄉下人。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the Middle Ages, the <target>peasants</target> lived in small villages and worked hard on the land owned by the local lords.","translation":"在中世紀，農民們住在小村莊裡，在當地領主擁有的土地上辛苦耕作。","explanation":"名詞「農民」。指封建時代的低階農業勞動者。"},{"sentence":"The history teacher explained how the <target>peasant</target> uprisings in the eighteenth century were caused by heavy taxes and food shortages.","translation":"歷史老師解釋了十八世紀的農民起義是如何由沉重的稅收和糧食短缺引起的。","explanation":"名詞「農民」。指參與起義的底層社會階級。"}],"related_forms":["peasantry"]}

{"headword":"pedal","explanation":"名詞「踏板」；動詞「踩踏板、騎車」。常用於描述自行車或鋼琴的踏板。注意與 petal (花瓣) 的發音相同但拼寫不同。","entries":[{"sentence":"The cyclist pushed the <target>pedals</target> with all his strength to climb the steep hill before the race ended.","translation":"單車手用盡全力踩踏板，以便在比賽結束前爬上陡峭的山坡。","explanation":"名詞「踏板」。指自行車、縫製機等上的踏板。"},{"sentence":"To create a softer sound on the piano, the musician gently pressed the <target>pedal</target> with her foot while playing the melody.","translation":"為了在鋼琴上創造出更柔和的聲音，音樂家在演奏旋律時用腳輕輕地按住踏板。","explanation":"名詞「踏板」。指鋼琴等樂器的踏板。"},{"sentence":"He decided to <target>pedal</target> his bike slowly through the park, enjoying the fresh air and the beautiful autumn leaves.","translation":"他決定慢慢騎著單車穿過公園，享受新鮮空氣和美麗的秋葉。","explanation":"動詞「踩踏板、騎車」。指使用踏板推進交通工具。"}],"related_forms":["pedaling","pedaled"]}

{"headword":"pedestrian","explanation":"名詞「行人」；形容詞「平淡的、缺乏想像力的」。名詞用法最為常見，指在道路上行走的人。形容詞用法在 GSAT 中較少見，但指描述事物乏味、普通。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city council decided to build a wider <target>pedestrian</target> <pattern>bridge</pattern> to ensure the safety of people walking across the busy highway.","translation":"市議會決定建造一座更寬的行人天橋，以確保行走在繁忙高速公路上的行人安全。","explanation":"名詞「行人」。常用搭配 pedestrian bridge (行人天橋)。"},{"sentence":"Drivers must always <pattern>yield</pattern> <pattern>to</pattern> <target>pedestrians</target> at crosswalks to prevent accidents and keep the streets safe for everyone.","translation":"駕駛員在斑馬線處必須始終禮讓行人，以防止事故並保持街道對每個人都安全。","explanation":"名詞「行人」。常用搭配 yield to pedestrians (禮讓行人)。"},{"sentence":"The critic described the author's latest novel as <target>pedestrian</target>, noting that the plot was too predictable and lacked creativity.","translation":"評論家將這位作者最新的小說描述為平淡的，指出其情節太可預測且缺乏創意。","explanation":"形容詞「平淡的、缺乏想像力的」。指事物乏味且普通。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"penetrate","explanation":"動詞「穿透、滲透」。可用於物理上的穿透，也可指在心靈、市場或複雜問題上「深入理解」或「進入」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The sharp arrow was able to <target>penetrate</target> the thick armor of the soldier, causing a serious injury during the battle.","translation":"那支銳利的箭能夠穿透士兵厚重的盔甲，在戰鬥中造成嚴重傷害。","explanation":"動詞「穿透」。指物體物理性地穿過另一物體。"},{"sentence":"Heavy rain caused the water to <target>penetrate</target> <pattern>through</pattern> the cracks in the old roof, leading to water damage in the living room.","translation":"大雨導致水分滲透進舊屋頂的裂縫中，導致客廳出現水損。","explanation":"動詞「滲透」。常用搭配 penetrate through sth。"},{"sentence":"The company spent millions of dollars on advertising to <target>penetrate</target> the international <pattern>market</pattern>, hoping to increase their global sales.","translation":"公司花了數百萬美元在廣告上，以滲透國際市場，希望增加其全球銷售額。","explanation":"動詞「進入、滲透」。在商業語境中指進入新市場。"}],"related_forms":["penetration","penetrable"]}

{"headword":"pension","explanation":"名詞「退休金」。通常指僱主或政府在員工退休後定期支付的款項。動詞用法較少見，指「給予退休金」。","entries":[{"sentence":"After working as a teacher for thirty years, Mr. Lin finally retired and now lives comfortably on his monthly <target>pension</target>.","translation":"在擔任老師三十年後，林先生終於退休了，現在依靠每月的退休金舒適地生活。","explanation":"名詞「退休金」。指退休後領取的定期款項。"},{"sentence":"The government is considering raising the retirement age to reduce the pressure on the national <target>pension</target> <pattern>system</pattern> due to the aging population.","translation":"政府正考慮提高退休年齡，以減輕人口老化對國家退休金制度的壓力。","explanation":"名詞「退休金」。常用搭配 pension system (退休金制度)。"}],"related_forms":["pensioner","pensionable"]}

{"headword":"perceive","explanation":"動詞「察覺、感知、認為」。指透過感官（視覺、聽覺等）察覺到某事，或在心靈上對某事形成某種看法或認知。","entries":[{"sentence":"Cats are able to <target>perceive</target> sounds that are too high in frequency for humans to hear, making them excellent hunters.","translation":"貓能夠察覺到頻率過高而人類無法聽到的聲音，使牠們成為卓越的獵手。","explanation":"動詞「察覺」。指透過感官感知。"},{"sentence":"Many people <target>perceive</target> the new school rules as too strict, while the principal believes they are necessary for maintaining order.","translation":"許多人認為新校規太嚴格，而校長則認為它們對於維持秩序是必要的。","explanation":"動詞「認為」。指對某事物形成主觀的看法。"},{"sentence":"The detective noticed that the suspect <target>perceived</target> the question as a threat, as his body language became suddenly defensive.","translation":"偵探注意到嫌疑犯將這個問題視為一種威脅，因為他的肢體語言突然變得具有防禦性。","explanation":"動詞「視為」。常用搭配 perceive sth as sth。"}],"related_forms":["perception","perceptive"]}

{"headword":"perception","explanation":"名詞「感知、認知、看法」。perceive 的名詞形式。指對事物的感知能力或對某事物形成的主觀印象。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company's new marketing campaign aimed to change the public's <target>perception</target> <pattern>of</pattern> their brand as being outdated.","translation":"公司新的行銷活動旨在改變大眾對他們品牌過時的認知。","explanation":"名詞「認知、看法」。常用搭配 perception of sth。"},{"sentence":"Because of his visual impairment, his <target>perception</target> <pattern>of</pattern> depth and distance is different from that of most people.","translation":"由於視力受損，他對深度和距離的感知與大多數人不同。","explanation":"名詞「感知」。指透過感官對物理空間的認知。"},{"sentence":"The teacher encouraged students to challenge their own <target>perception</target> <pattern>of</pattern> success, suggesting that happiness is more important than grades.","translation":"老師鼓勵學生挑戰他們對成功的看法，建議快樂比成績更重要。","explanation":"名詞「看法」。指主觀的認知或觀念。"}],"related_forms":["perceive","perceptive"]}

{"headword":"performer","explanation":"名詞「表演者、執行者」。最常用於指在舞台上演出的人，如歌手、演員、舞者；也可指設備或人的表現程度。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young pianist was a brilliant <target>performer</target>, capturing the audience's attention with her emotional and precise playing.","translation":"這位年輕的鋼琴家是一位卓越的表演者，以其情感豐富且精確的演奏吸引了觀眾的注意力。","explanation":"名詞「表演者」。指在舞台上演出的人。"},{"sentence":"The talent show provided a great opportunity for aspiring <target>performers</target> to showcase their skills in front of a large crowd.","translation":"才藝表演賽為有抱負的表演者提供了在眾多觀眾面前展示其技能的絕佳機會。","explanation":"名詞「表演者」。指參與演出的人。"},{"sentence":"Although he is a hard worker, he is not a top <target>performer</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the sales department, as he often struggles with closing deals.","translation":"儘管他工作勤奮，但他並非銷售部門的頂尖表現者，因為他經常在成交方面遇到困難。","explanation":"名詞「表現者」。指在工作或特定領域表現出色的人。"}],"related_forms":["perform","performance"]}

{"headword":"persist","explanation":"動詞「堅持、持續」。指在面對困難或反對時依然堅持做某事，或指某種不愉快的情況持續存在。常用片語 persist in (堅持做...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite the heavy rain and strong wind, the hikers <target>persisted</target> <pattern>in</pattern> their attempt to reach the mountain peak before sunset.","translation":"儘管大雨和強風，登山者們依然堅持嘗試在日落前到達山頂。","explanation":"動詞片語 persist in sth/doing sth (堅持做...)。指在困難中堅持。"},{"sentence":"If the cough <target>persists</target> <pattern>for</pattern> more than a week, the doctor advised the patient to return for a more detailed check-up.","translation":"如果咳嗽持續超過一週，醫生建議病人回來進行更詳細的檢查。","explanation":"動詞「持續」。指不愉快的情況或症狀持續存在。常用搭配 persist for [時間]。"},{"sentence":"The young scientist <target>persisted</target> <pattern>with</pattern> her research for years, eventually discovering a new species of plant in the remote jungle.","translation":"這位年輕的科學家多年來堅持她的研究，最終在遙遠的叢林中發現了一種新的植物物種。","explanation":"動詞片語 persist with sth (堅持執行某事)。"}],"related_forms":["persistence","persistent","persistently"]}

{"headword":"personnel","explanation":"名詞，意為「人事」或「全體員工」。此詞為集合名詞，通常指一個組織內的所有人員。注意與 personal (個人的) 區分，兩者拼法相近但發音與意義完全不同。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company's human resources <target>personnel</target> are responsible for recruiting new employees and managing employee benefits.","translation":"公司的人力資源人事部門負責招募新員工並管理員工福利。","explanation":"名詞「人事部門」。常用搭配：human resources personnel (人力資源人事)。"},{"sentence":"Only authorized <target>personnel</target> <pattern>are</pattern> allowed to enter the secure laboratory to prevent any potential leaks of confidential information.","translation":"只有獲授權的人員被允許進入安全實驗室，以防止機密資訊發生任何可能的洩漏。","explanation":"名詞「全體人員」。注意 personnel 作為集合名詞時常接複數動詞。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"perspective","explanation":"名詞意為「觀點、看法」或「透視法」；形容詞意為「視角的」。在 GSAT 中最常考的是名詞用法，指對事物的看法。常用搭配：from a ... perspective (從...的視角看), put things into perspective (客觀地看待事物)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Traveling to different countries helps students gain a broader <target>perspective</target> <pattern>on</pattern> global issues and cultural diversity.","translation":"前往不同國家旅行能幫助學生對全球議題和文化多樣性獲得更寬廣的觀點。","explanation":"名詞「觀點、看法」。常用搭配：perspective on sth (對...的看法)。"},{"sentence":"From a historical <target>perspective</target>, the invention of the steam engine was a turning point that changed the world forever.","translation":"從歷史的視角來看，蒸汽機的發明是一個永遠改變世界的轉折點。","explanation":"形容詞用法，在此作為定語修飾名詞，意為「視角的」。"},{"sentence":"After talking to her counselor, she was able to put her academic failures <pattern>into</pattern> <target>perspective</target> and focus on her future growth.","translation":"在與諮商師交談後，她能夠客觀地看待她的學業失敗，並專注於她未來的成長。","explanation":"名詞「視角」。片語 put sth into perspective 意為「客觀地看待某事」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"pessimism","explanation":"名詞「悲觀主義」或「悲觀」。指傾向於預期最壞結果的傾向。與 optimism (樂觀主義) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite the economic downturn, the young entrepreneur refused to give in to <target>pessimism</target> and continued to seek new business opportunities.","translation":"儘管經濟低迷，這位年輕的創業家拒絕屈服於悲觀情緒，並繼續尋找新的商業機會。","explanation":"名詞「悲觀」。"},{"sentence":"The doctor's constant <target>pessimism</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the patient's recovery made the family feel discouraged and hopeless.","translation":"醫生對病人康復的持續悲觀態度讓家人感到沮喪且絕望。","explanation":"名詞「悲觀」。常用搭配：pessimism about sth (對...的悲觀)。"}],"related_forms":["pessimist","pessimistic"]}

{"headword":"petition","explanation":"名詞「請願書」或「請願」；動詞「請願」。指正式地向權威機構提出要求或請求。常見搭配：sign a petition (簽署請願書), file a petition (提交請願書)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students started a <target>petition</target> to request the school administration to extend the library's operating hours during the final exam week.","translation":"學生們發起了一項請願，要求學校行政部門在期末考週延長圖書館的開放時間。","explanation":"名詞「請願」。"},{"sentence":"Hundreds of local residents <pattern>signed</pattern> a <target>petition</target> urging the government to protect the ancient forest from being destroyed by urban development.","translation":"數百名當地居民簽署了一份請願書，敦促政府保護古老森林免於被都市開發所摧毀。","explanation":"名詞「請願書」。常用搭配：sign a petition (簽署請願書)。"},{"sentence":"The environmental group decided to <target>petition</target> the city council <pattern>for</pattern> a ban on single-use plastics in all public parks.","translation":"環保團體決定向市議會請願，要求在所有公共公園禁止使用一次性塑料。","explanation":"動詞「請願」。常用搭配：petition someone for sth。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"petty","explanation":"形容詞「瑣碎的、微小的」或「心胸狹窄的」。常用於描述不重要的小事或小額的款項。常見搭配：petty crime (輕微犯罪), petty cash (零用金)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two friends stopped talking to each other over a <target>petty</target> <pattern>argument</pattern> about who should pay for the bubble tea.","translation":"這兩個朋友因為關於誰該付珍珠奶茶錢的瑣碎爭論而停止交談。","explanation":"形容詞「瑣碎的」。常用搭配：petty argument (瑣碎的爭論)。"},{"sentence":"Shoplifting small items is often considered a <target>petty</target> <pattern>crime</pattern>, but it still has legal consequences for the offender.","translation":"偷竊小物品通常被認為是輕微犯罪，但對於違法者來說仍然有法律後果。","explanation":"形容詞「輕微的」。常用搭配：petty crime (輕微犯罪)。"},{"sentence":"The office manager keeps a small amount of <target>petty</target> <pattern>cash</pattern> to pay for office supplies like stamps and envelopes.","translation":"辦公室經理保留了一小筆零用金，用以支付郵票和信封等辦公用品。","explanation":"形容詞「小額的」。常用搭配：petty cash (零用金)。"}],"related_forms":["pettiness"]}

{"headword": "phase", "explanation": "名詞「階段、時期」；動詞「分階段實施」。名詞用法最常見，指一個過程中的某個特定時期。常用搭配：a phase of (...的一個階段), go through a phase (經歷一個階段)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Learning to walk is just one <target>phase</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a child's early development, followed by the development of speech.", "translation": "學習走路只是孩子早期發展的一個階段，隨後是語言能力的發展。", "explanation": "名詞「階段」。常用搭配：a phase of sth。"}, {"sentence": "Many teenagers <pattern>go</pattern> <target>through</target> a <target>phase</target> of rebellion where they challenge their parents' authority to find their own identity.", "translation": "許多青少年會經歷一個叛逆期，他們挑戰父母的權威以尋找自己的身份認同。", "explanation": "名詞「階段」。片語 go through a phase 表示「經歷一個階段」。"}, {"sentence": "The government plans to <target>phase</target> <pattern>out</pattern> the use of coal-fired power plants over the next decade to reduce carbon emissions.", "translation": "政府計劃在未來十年內逐步淘汰煤電廠的使用，以減少碳排放。", "explanation": "動詞片語 phase out 表示「逐步淘汰」或「分階段取消」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"photographic","explanation":"形容詞「攝影的」或「像照片一樣精確的」。常用於描述記憶力極佳的人，例如 photographic memory (照相式記憶)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The museum displayed a collection of <target>photographic</target> <pattern>evidence</pattern> to prove that the ancient city had been submerged by the sea.","translation":"博物館展出了一系列攝影證據，以證明這座古城已被大海淹沒。","explanation":"形容詞「攝影的」。常用搭配：photographic evidence (攝影證據)。"},{"sentence":"She has a <target>photographic</target> <pattern>memory</pattern>, which allows her to remember every single word on a page after reading it only once.","translation":"她擁有照相式記憶，這使她能在僅閱讀一次後就記住頁面上的每一個字。","explanation":"形容詞「像照片一樣的」。常用搭配：photographic memory (照相式記憶)。"}],"related_forms":["photography","photograph"]}

{"headword":"pickup","explanation":"名詞「接送、提高、皮卡車」。在 GSAT 中，常用於指接送某人或經濟/活動的回升。常見搭配：a pickup in (...的回升)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The hotel provides a free <target>pickup</target> <pattern>service</pattern> from the airport, making it very convenient for international tourists.","translation":"酒店提供免費的機場接送服務，對國際遊客來說非常方便。","explanation":"名詞「接送」。常用搭配：pickup service (接送服務)。"},{"sentence":"Economists are hopeful that there will be a <target>pickup</target> <pattern>in</pattern> consumer spending after the holiday season.","translation":"經濟學家希望在假期結束後，消費支出會有所回升。","explanation":"名詞「回升」。常用搭配 a pickup in sth。"},{"sentence":"The farmer loaded the heavy bags of fertilizer <pattern>into</pattern> the back of his <target>pickup</target> truck to transport them to the field.","translation":"農夫將沉重的肥料袋裝入皮卡車後方，以便將它們運送到田野中。","explanation":"名詞「皮卡車」。pickup truck 指「皮卡車」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"pier","explanation":"名詞「碼頭、棧橋」。指從岸邊向海中延伸的結構，可用於停靠船隻或散步。","entries":[{"sentence":"We spent the afternoon walking along the <target>pier</target>, enjoying the fresh sea breeze and watching the fishing boats arrive.","translation":"我們花了一個下午在碼頭上散步，享受新鮮的海風並看著漁船進港。","explanation":"名詞「碼頭」。"},{"sentence":"The cruise ship docked at the <target>pier</target> early in the morning, and the passengers eagerly waited to explore the coastal city.","translation":"郵輪在清晨停靠在碼頭，乘客們急切地等待著去探索這座沿海城市。","explanation":"名詞「碼頭」。常用動詞搭配：dock at the pier。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"pillar","explanation":"名詞「柱子、支柱」。除了指建築物的物理柱子，也常用於比喻指支撐某個體系或社會的核心人物或原則。常用搭配：a pillar of (...的支柱)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The ancient temple was supported by several massive stone <target>pillars</target> that have remained standing for thousands of years.","translation":"這座古寺由幾根巨大的石柱支撐，數千年來依然屹立不倒。","explanation":"名詞「柱子」。指物理上的建築支柱。"},{"sentence":"Honesty and respect are considered the main <target>pillars</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a healthy relationship between teachers and students.","translation":"誠實與尊重被認為是師生之間健康關係的主要支柱。","explanation":"名詞「支柱」。比喻用法，指核心原則。常用搭配：pillars of sth。"},{"sentence":"The retired professor is known as a <target>pillar</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the community, as he has volunteered his time to help the poor for decades.","translation":"這位退休教授被譽為社區的支柱，因為他數十年來一直利用時間擔任志工幫助窮人。","explanation":"名詞「支柱」。比喻用法，指重要人物。常用搭配：a pillar of the community。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"pipeline","explanation":"名詞，指「管道」或「計劃的進展過程」。實體意義上指輸送油氣的管線；比喻意義上指產品或計畫在開發中的狀態（pipeline of projects）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government is planning to build a new oil <target>pipeline</target> to transport fuel more efficiently from the north to the south of the country.","translation":"政府計劃建造一條新的石油管道，以便更有效地將燃料從國家北部輸送到南部。","explanation":"名詞「管道」。指輸送液體或氣體的長管。"},{"sentence":"The software company has several exciting new updates in the <target>pipeline</target>, which will be released to the public early next year.","translation":"這家軟體公司有幾個令人興奮的新更新正在計劃中，將於明年年初向公眾發布。","explanation":"名詞「計劃中的過程」。in the pipeline 是一個常見片語，指某事正在籌備或開發中。"}],"related_forms":["pipelines"]}

{"headword":"pirate","explanation":"名詞指「海盜」或「盜版者」；動詞指「盜版、非法複製」。注意 pirate 與 piracy (盜版/海盜行為) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the old movies, <target>pirates</target> are often shown sailing across the ocean in search of hidden gold and mysterious treasure maps.","translation":"在舊電影中，海盜經常被描繪成在海洋中航行，尋找隱藏的金幣和神秘的藏寶圖。","explanation":"名詞「海盜」。"},{"sentence":"The music industry has struggled for years to stop people from <target>pirating</target> songs and sharing them for free on the internet.","translation":"音樂產業多年來一直努力阻止人們盜版歌曲並在網路上免費分享。","explanation":"動詞「盜版」。指非法複製受版權保護的作品。"},{"sentence":"The author was shocked to find that someone had <target>pirated</target> his latest novel and was selling it without his permission.","translation":"作者驚訝地發現有人盜版了他的最新小說，並在未經他許可的情況下將其出售。","explanation":"動詞「盜版」。"}],"related_forms":["piracy","pirating"]}
comment: Note: 'pirating' in related_forms is just a conjugation, but acceptable.

response: {"headword":"pitcher","explanation":"名詞，有兩種常見意義：一是棒球中的「投手」；二是盛水或飲料的「水罐/水壺」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The baseball team's <target>pitcher</target> threw a fast ball that the batter could not hit, leading to a strikeout and a cheer from the crowd.","translation":"棒球隊的投手投出了一顆快球，擊球手無法擊中，導致三振出局並引起群眾的歡呼。","explanation":"名詞「投手」。指棒球比賽中將球投向擊球手的球員。"},{"sentence":"The waitress brought a <target>pitcher</target> <pattern>of</pattern> ice water to the table so that everyone in the group could refill their glasses.","translation":"服務生在桌上放了一壺冰水，以便組內每個人都能重新裝滿杯子。","explanation":"名詞「水罐/水壺」。指一種較大且有把手的容器。"}],"related_forms":["pitchers"]}

{"headword":"placement","explanation":"名詞，指「安置、放置」或「工作安置/實習安排」。常用搭配 include placement services (提供安置服務) 或 job placement (工作安置)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university provides an excellent <target>placement</target> <pattern>service</pattern> to help graduating students find suitable jobs in their field of study.","translation":"大學提供優秀的工作安置服務，以幫助畢業生在他們的學習領域找到合適的工作。","explanation":"名詞「工作安置」。job placement service 指工作安置服務。"},{"sentence":"The carefully chosen <target>placement</target> of the furniture in the small room made the space feel much larger and more organized.","translation":"小房間裡家具的精心放置，使得空間感覺大得多且更有條理。","explanation":"名詞「放置、安置」。指將物體放在特定位置。"},{"sentence":"As part of the degree program, many students are required to complete a professional <target>placement</target> in a local company for three months.","translation":"作為學位計畫的一部分，許多學生被要求在當地公司完成為期三個月的專業實習安置。","explanation":"名詞「實習安排」。指將學生安置在實際工作環境中學習。"}],"related_forms":["place"]}

{"headword": "plea", "explanation": "名詞，指「懇求」或法律上的「抗辯/答辯」。常用搭配 make a plea (提出懇求) 或 enter a plea (提交答辯)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The hungry refugees made a desperate <target>plea</target> <pattern>for</pattern> food and medicine, hoping the international community would provide urgent help.", "translation": "飢餓的難民發出了絕望的懇求，請求提供食物和藥品，希望國際社會能提供緊急援助。", "explanation": "名詞「懇求」。常用搭配 plea for sth (請求某物)。"}, {"sentence": "After consulting with his lawyer, the defendant decided to <pattern>enter</pattern> a <target>plea</target> of not guilty in the court case.", "translation": "在與律師諮詢後，被告決定在法庭案件中提交不認罪的答辯。", "explanation": "名詞「答辯」。enter a plea 指在法律程序中正式提交答辯。"}], "related_forms": ["plead"]}

{"headword":"plead","explanation":"動詞，指「懇求」或在法律上「答辯」。常用搭配 plead for (懇求) 或 plead guilty/not guilty (認罪/不認罪)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student <target>pleaded</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the teacher to give him one more chance to submit his assignment after the deadline.","translation":"學生懇求老師給他一次機會，在截止日期後提交他的作業。","explanation":"動詞「懇求」。plead with someone to do sth 指懇求某人做某事。"},{"sentence":"During the trial, the accused man <target>pleaded</target> <pattern>not guilty</pattern> to the charges of theft, claiming he was not at the scene.","translation":"在審判期間，被指控的男子認不認罪，聲稱他不在現場。","explanation":"動詞「答辯」。plead not guilty 指在法律上正式聲稱不認罪。"},{"sentence":"The prisoner <target>pleaded</target> <pattern>for</pattern> mercy, hoping the judge would reduce his sentence because of his young age.","translation":"囚犯懇求寬恕，希望法官能因其年齡較小而減輕其刑期。","explanation":"動詞「懇求」。plead for sth 指請求某事。"}],"related_forms":["plea"]}

{"headword":"pledge","explanation":"名詞或動詞，意為「誓言、承諾」。常用搭配 make a pledge (許下誓言) 或 pledge to do sth (承諾做某事)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The politician made a formal <target>pledge</target> <pattern>to</pattern> reduce taxes and improve public transportation for all citizens in the city.","translation":"這位政治家正式承諾將降低稅金並改善全市公民的公共交通。","explanation":"名詞「誓言、承諾」。make a pledge to V 指許下承諾做某事。"},{"sentence":"Many students <target>pledged</target> <pattern>to</pattern> study harder and follow the school rules to ensure a positive learning environment for everyone.","translation":"許多學生承諾將更加努力學習，並遵守學校規定，以確保每個人都有正面的學習環境。","explanation":"動詞「承諾」。pledge to V 表示承諾做某事。"},{"sentence":"The wealthy businessman <pattern>made</pattern> a <target>pledge</target> of ten million dollars to support the new library building project of the university.","translation":"這位富有的商人承諾捐贈一千萬美元以支持大學的新圖書館建築計畫。","explanation":"名詞「承諾」。make a pledge of [amount] 指承諾捐贈特定金額。"}],"related_forms":["pledged"]}

{"headword":"plunge","explanation":"動詞或名詞，指「驟降、猛跌」或「跳入、陷入」。常用搭配 plunge into (跳入/陷入)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The brave swimmer decided to <target>plunge</target> <pattern>into</pattern> the cold water of the lake to save the drowning child.","translation":"勇敢的游泳者決定跳入湖中冰冷的水中，以救那個溺水的孩子。","explanation":"動詞「跳入」。plunge into sth 指迅速地跳入水中。"},{"sentence":"After the sudden economic crisis, the value of the company's shares <target>plunged</target> <pattern>to</pattern> an all-time low in just a few days.","translation":"在突然的經濟危機後，公司股票的價值在短短幾天內驟降至歷史最低點。","explanation":"動詞「驟降」。指價格、數值或溫度迅速下跌。"},{"sentence":"The city was <target>plunged</target> <pattern>into</pattern> darkness when the power grid failed during the heavy storm last night.","translation":"昨晚大暴風雨期間電網故障，使得整座城市陷入了黑暗。","explanation":"動詞片語 plunge into darkness 指「陷入黑暗」。"},{"sentence":"There was a sudden <target>plunge</target> in the temperature last week, which caused many plants in the garden to die.","translation":"上週溫度突然驟降，導致花園裡的許多植物死亡。","explanation":"名詞「驟降」。指數值或狀態的迅速下降。"}],"related_forms":["plunging"]}

{"headword":"plural","explanation":"形容詞或名詞，指「複數的」。在語言學中，指代兩個或兩個以上的人或物。","entries":[{"sentence":"In English grammar, most nouns are changed to their <target>plural</target> form by simply adding an 's' or 'es' to the end of the word.","translation":"在英文文法中，大多數名詞透過在單字末尾簡單地加上 's' 或 'es' 來變更為複數形式。","explanation":"形容詞「複數的」。"},{"sentence":"The teacher reminded the students that the word 'people' is always used as a <target>plural</target> noun, even if it refers to a single group.","translation":"老師提醒學生 'people' 這個字總是作為複數名詞使用，即使它指的是一個單個群體。","explanation":"名詞「複數」。"}],"related_forms":["plurality","plurals"]}

{"headword":"poetic","explanation":"形容詞，指「詩意的、詩歌的」。指與詩歌相關，或具有詩意的美感或韻律。","entries":[{"sentence":"The writer used <target>poetic</target> language to describe the beauty of the sunset over the mountains, creating a romantic atmosphere in the novel.","translation":"作者使用詩意的語言來描述山間日落之美，在小說中營造出浪漫的氛圍。","explanation":"形容詞「詩意的」。指使用優美且富有想像力的語言。"},{"sentence":"During the literature class, we studied several <target>poetic</target> <pattern>devices</pattern>, such as metaphors and rhymes, to understand how poets express their feelings.","translation":"在文學課上，我們學習了幾種詩歌技巧，例如隱喻和押韻，以了解詩人如何表達他們的感受。","explanation":"形容詞「詩歌的」。poetic devices 指「詩歌技巧」。"}],"related_forms":["poetry","poet","poetically"]}

{"headword":"poke","explanation":"動詞「戳、捅」；名詞「戳」。常用片語 poke fun at (嘲笑)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The curious child tried to <target>poke</target> the sleeping cat with a stick, but the cat woke up and hissed at him.","translation":"好奇的孩子試圖用棍子戳戳那隻睡覺的貓，但貓醒來並對他嘶嘶地叫。","explanation":"動詞「戳、捅」。"},{"sentence":"It is unkind to <target>poke</target> <pattern>fun at</pattern> others for their mistakes, as everyone makes them from time to time.","translation":"嘲笑別人的錯誤是不友善的，因為每個人偶爾都會犯錯。","explanation":"動詞片語 poke fun at 意為「嘲笑」。"},{"sentence":"He gave the heavy bag a quick <target>poke</target> with his foot to see if there was anything inside.","translation":"他用腳快速地戳了一下那個重袋子，以看看裡面是否有東西。","explanation":"名詞「戳」。"}],"related_forms":["poked","poking"]}

{"headword":"porch","explanation":"名詞「門廊、陽台」。指建築物入口處的覆蓋空間。","entries":[{"sentence":"The family spent their lazy Sunday afternoon sitting on the front <target>porch</target>, chatting and drinking iced tea in the breeze.","translation":"這家人在懶洋洋的週日下午坐在前門廊上，在微風中聊天並喝著冰茶。","explanation":"名詞「門廊」。"},{"sentence":"The delivery man left the package on the <target>porch</target> and rang the doorbell before leaving quickly.","translation":"快遞員將包裹留在門廊上，並在迅速離開前按了門鈴。","explanation":"名詞「門廊」。"}],"related_forms":["porches"]}

{"headword":"portfolio","explanation":"名詞「作品集、投資組合」。在藝術或就業申請中指作品集；在金融中指投資組合。","entries":[{"sentence":"The aspiring artist spent months carefully selecting her best paintings to create a professional <target>portfolio</target> for her college application.","translation":"這名有抱負的藝術家花了好幾個月仔細挑選她最好的畫作，為她的大學申請創建一個專業的作品集。","explanation":"名詞「作品集」。"},{"sentence":"To reduce risk, the financial advisor suggested that the client diversify his investment <target>portfolio</target> by adding some gold and real estate.","translation":"為了降低風險，財務顧問建議客戶透過增加一些黃金和房地產來使他的投資組合多元化。","explanation":"名詞「投資組合」。"}],"related_forms":["portfolios"]}

{"headword":"practitioner","explanation":"名詞「從業者、執業醫師」。指在特定專業領域（尤其是醫療）中實際工作的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you have a mild cold, it is often best to visit a general <target>practitioner</target> for a basic check-up and medical advice.","translation":"如果你患有輕微感冒，通常最好去看一位全科醫師進行基礎檢查並獲取醫療建議。","explanation":"名詞「執業醫師」。general practitioner (GP) 指全科醫師。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer is not only a legal expert but also a skilled <target>practitioner</target> of traditional meditation techniques in his free time.","translation":"這名律師不僅是一位法律專家，在閒暇時間也是一位熟練的傳統冥想技巧從業者。","explanation":"名詞「從業者」。"}],"related_forms":["practice"]}

{"headword":"precaution","explanation":"名詞「預防措施」。常用搭配 take precautions (採取預防措施)。","entries":[{"sentence":"As a <target>precaution</target>, the school decided to cancel all outdoor activities because the weather forecast predicted heavy rain.","translation":"作為一種預防措施，學校決定取消所有戶外活動，因為天氣預報預測會有大雨。","explanation":"名詞「預防措施」。"},{"sentence":"Drivers should <pattern>take</pattern> necessary <target>precautions</target> when driving in heavy fog to ensure the safety of other road users.","translation":"駕駛者在濃霧中駕駛時應採取必要的預防措施，以確保其他道路使用者的安全。","explanation":"名詞「預防措施」。常用搭配：take precautions (採取預防措施)。"}],"related_forms":["precautionary"]}
