{"headword":"predator","explanation":"名詞「捕食者、掠食者」。指以其他動物為食的動物。","entries":[{"sentence":"The lion is a powerful <target>predator</target> that hunts other animals in the African savanna to survive.","translation":"獅子是在非洲大草原上獵捕其他動物以生存的強大捕食者。","explanation":"名詞「捕食者」。"},{"sentence":"Small fish often swim in large schools to protect themselves from <target>predators</target> that might attack them from below.","translation":"小魚經常成群地游泳，以保護自己免於那些可能從下方攻擊它們的捕食者的侵害。","explanation":"名詞「捕食者」。"}],"related_forms":["predatory"]}

{"headword":"preference","explanation":"名詞「偏好、優先權」。常用搭配 have a preference for (偏好...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"When choosing a university, some students have a strong <target>preference</target> <pattern>for</pattern> cities with a vibrant cultural scene.","translation":"在選擇大學時，有些學生對具有活力文化氛圍的城市的偏好非常強烈。","explanation":"名詞「偏好」。常用搭配：have a preference for (偏好...)。"},{"sentence":"The company gives <target>preference</target> to candidates who are fluent in more than two languages for this international sales position.","translation":"對於這個國際銷售職位，公司優先考慮能流利使用兩種以上語言的應徵者。","explanation":"名詞「優先權」。"}],"related_forms":["prefer"]}

{"headword":"prejudice","explanation":"名詞「偏見」；動詞「使受損、造成偏見」。常考搭配 have a prejudice against (對...有偏見)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher encouraged students to read books from different cultures to overcome their <target>prejudice</target> <pattern>against</pattern> people from other countries.","translation":"老師鼓勵學生閱讀不同文化背景的書籍，以克服他們對來自其他國家的人的偏見。","explanation":"名詞「偏見」。常用搭配：have a prejudice against (對...有偏見)。"},{"sentence":"The judge reminded the jury that they must make a fair decision without any <target>prejudice</target> based on the person's background.","translation":"法官提醒陪審團，他們必須在沒有任何基於個人背景的偏見的情況下做出公正的決定。","explanation":"名詞「偏見」。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer argued that the early news reports had <target>prejudiced</target> the jury, making it impossible for them to be impartial.","translation":"律師主張早期的新聞報導已使陪審團產生偏見，使他們不可能保持公正。","explanation":"動詞「使產生偏見、損害」。"}],"related_forms":["prejudiced"]}

{"headword": "preliminary", "explanation": "形容詞「初步的、預備的」；名詞「預賽、初步調查」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The researchers conducted a <target>preliminary</target> study to gather basic information before starting the more detailed and expensive experiment.", "translation": "研究人員在開始更詳細且昂貴的實驗之前，進行了一項初步研究以收集基礎資訊。", "explanation": "形容詞「初步的」。"}, {"sentence": "After passing the <target>preliminary</target> round of the singing competition, she was finally able to enter the final contest.", "translation": "在通過歌唱比賽的初步輪次後，她終於能夠進入決賽。", "explanation": "名詞「預賽」。"}, {"sentence": "The police conducted a <target>preliminary</target> investigation into the cause of the accident, but the final report was not yet available.", "translation": "警察對事故原因進行了初步調查，但最終報告尚未出爐。", "explanation": "形容詞「初步的」。"}], "related_forms": ["preliminaries"]}

{"headword":"premature","explanation":"形容詞「過早的、早產的」。常用於描述決定、反應或出生。","entries":[{"sentence":"The manager decided that announcing the result was <target>premature</target> because the final data had not yet been fully verified.","translation":"經理決定宣布結果還太早了，因為最終數據尚未被完全驗證。","explanation":"形容詞「過早的」。指決定或結論下得太快。"},{"sentence":"Because the baby was <target>premature</target>, he had to stay in an incubator for several weeks to grow stronger and healthier.","translation":"因為這名嬰兒早產，他必須在育嬰箱中待上幾個星期以長得更強壯健康。","explanation":"形容詞「早產的」。"}],"related_forms":["prematurely"]}

{"headword": "premier", "explanation": "形容詞「首要的、最頂尖的」；名詞「首相、總理」。注意形容詞用法常在 GSAT 出現，指品質或地位最高。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The university is known for its <target>premier</target> research facilities, attracting scholars from all over the world to study advanced science.", "translation": "這所大學以其頂尖的研究設施而聞名，吸引了全世界的學者來研究先進科學。", "explanation": "形容詞「首要的、最頂尖的」。常用搭配：premier research facilities (頂尖的研究設施)。"}, {"sentence": "After the election, the newly appointed <target>premier</target> announced a series of economic reforms to improve the country's financial stability.", "translation": "選舉後，新任首相宣布了一系列經濟改革，以改善國家的財務穩定。", "explanation": "名詞「首相、總理」。指國家行政首腦。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "premise", "explanation": "名詞「前提、假設」。常用於邏輯論證或學術寫作中，指得出結論前所基於的基礎。常用片語 on the premise that (基於...的前提)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The entire argument is based <pattern>on</pattern> the <target>premise</target> <pattern>that</pattern> all humans are created equal and deserve the same fundamental rights.", "translation": "整個論點是基於所有人類天生平等且享有相同基本權利的前提。", "explanation": "名詞「前提、假設」。常用片語 on the premise that... (基於...的前提)。"}, {"sentence": "If the initial <target>premise</target> of the research is flawed, the final conclusions will likely be incorrect regardless of the data collected.", "translation": "如果研究的初始前提有缺陷，無論收集到多少數據，最終結論很可能是不正確的。", "explanation": "名詞「前提、假設」。指論證的基礎。"}], "related_forms": ["premises"]}

{"headword":"premium","explanation":"名詞「保費；額外費用；高品質產品」。在保險語境下指保費，在商業語境下指高品質或奢侈品的溢價。","entries":[{"sentence":"Because of the high demand for organic vegetables, some supermarkets charge a <target>premium</target> <pattern>price for</pattern> them compared to regular produce.","translation":"由於有機蔬菜的需求量大，一些超市對其收取的價格比一般農產品更高。","explanation":"名詞「額外費用/溢價」。常用搭配：charge a premium price for sth (對...收取高價)。"},{"sentence":"The company offers a high <target>premium</target> to employees who are willing to relocate to remote areas for a few years.","translation":"公司為願意在偏遠地區工作幾年的員工提供高額的額外津貼。","explanation":"名詞「額外費用/津貼」。"},{"sentence":"Young adults are often required to pay a higher monthly <target>premium</target> for health insurance if they have a history of chronic illness.","translation":"年輕成年人如果患有慢性病史，通常被要求支付更高的每月保險費。","explanation":"名詞「保費」。指保險合同中的定期支付金額。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"prescribe","explanation":"動詞「開處方箋；規定」。在醫療語境下指醫生開藥，在法律或規則語境下指規定應採取的方式。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctor <target>prescribed</target> a strong course of antibiotics to treat the infection, warning the patient not to skip any doses.","translation":"醫生開了一套強效抗生素來治療感染，並警告病人不要漏掉任何一次劑量。","explanation":"動詞「開處方箋」。常用搭配：prescribe medication/antibiotics。"},{"sentence":"The school handbook <target>prescribes</target> the exact dress code that all students must follow during the official graduation ceremony.","translation":"學校手冊規定了所有學生在正式畢業典禮期間必須遵守的精確著裝要求。","explanation":"動詞「規定」。指按規則或法律要求做某事。"}],"related_forms":["prescription"]}

{"headword":"prescription","explanation":"名詞「處方箋；規定」。指醫生開出的藥單或根據該單據購買的藥物，亦可指對某種情況的建議解決方案。","entries":[{"sentence":"You cannot buy these strong painkillers without a <target>prescription</target> <pattern>from</pattern> a licensed physician, as they can be dangerous if misused.","translation":"沒有持照醫生的處方箋，你不能購買這些強效止痛藥，因為如果誤用可能會很危險。","explanation":"名詞「處方箋」。常用搭配：prescription from a doctor。"},{"sentence":"The government's new economic <target>prescription</target> for solving unemployment aims to encourage small business growth through tax breaks.","translation":"政府解決失業問題的新經濟方案旨在通過減稅來鼓勵小企業增長。","explanation":"名詞「規定/方案」。在此指對問題的建議解決方式。"}],"related_forms":["prescribe"]}

{"headword":"presidency","explanation":"名詞「總統職位；總統任期」。指擔任總統的期間或總統所擁有的權力。","entries":[{"sentence":"During his <target>presidency</target>, the leader focused on improving international relations and reducing the carbon emissions of the nation.","translation":"在他擔任總統期間，這位領導人專注於改善國際關係並降低國家的碳排放量。","explanation":"名詞「總統職位/任期」。"},{"sentence":"The historical archives contain detailed records of every decision made during the <target>presidency</target> of the twentieth century's most famous leader.","translation":"歷史檔案中包含了二十世紀最著名領導人總統任期內所做出的每一項決策的詳細記錄。","explanation":"名詞「總統任期」。"}],"related_forms":["president","presidential"]}

{"headword":"presidential","explanation":"形容詞「總統的」。常用於描述與總統相關的權限、行為或特質。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>presidential</target> <pattern>election</pattern> is held every four years, allowing citizens to choose the next leader of their country.","translation":"總統大選每四年舉行一次，讓公民選擇國家的下一任領導人。","explanation":"形容詞「總統的」。常用搭配：presidential election (總統大選)。"},{"sentence":"The candidate gave a powerful <target>presidential</target> <pattern>speech</pattern> that inspired millions of people to believe in a brighter future for the nation.","translation":"候選人發表了一場強而有力的總統演說，激勵了數百萬人相信國家會有更光明的未來。","explanation":"形容詞「總統的」。常用搭配：presidential speech (總統演說)。"}],"related_forms":["president","presidency"]}

{"headword":"presumably","explanation":"副詞「大概、推測地」。表示根據現有證據或常識進行推論，常用於句子開頭或動詞之前。","entries":[{"sentence":"The lights in the office are still on, so <target>presumably</target> the manager is still working on the final report for the client.","translation":"辦公室的燈還亮著，所以大概經理還在為客戶準備最終報告。","explanation":"副詞「大概」。表示基於事實的推論。"},{"sentence":"Since she has lived in France for ten years, she <target>presumably</target> speaks French fluently and can help us translate the document.","translation":"既然她在法國住了十年，她大概能流利地說法語，並能幫我們翻譯這份文件。","explanation":"副詞「大概」。"}],"related_forms":["presume"]}

{"headword":"presume","explanation":"動詞「假定、 presumed 」。常用片語 presume to do sth (擅自做某事)。注意與 assume 的區別：presume 較多基於證據或常識而推斷，而 assume 則較多在無證據的情況下直接假定。","entries":[{"sentence":"Since the store is closed on Sundays, I <target>presume</target> <pattern>that</pattern> they are not open today, although I did not check the website.","translation":"既然商店週日關門，我假定他們今天不開門，儘管我沒有查看網站。","explanation":"動詞「假定」。基於已知事實進行推論。"},{"sentence":"He did not <target>presume</target> <pattern>to</pattern> interrupt the professor's lecture, as he wanted to show respect to the expert in the field.","translation":"他不敢擅自打斷教授的講座，因為他想對該領域的專家表示尊重。","explanation":"動詞片語 presume to do sth 表「擅自做某事」。"}],"related_forms":["presumably","presumption"]}

{"headword":"prevail","explanation":"動詞「盛行、戰勝」。常用片語 prevail over (戰勝/克服)。常用於描述一種觀念或情況在某個地區或時間盛行。","entries":[{"sentence":"In some traditional cultures, the belief that ancestors protect the living still <target>prevails</target> <pattern>among</pattern> the older generation.","translation":"在某些傳統文化中，祖先保護後人的信念在年長一代中依然盛行。","explanation":"動詞「盛行」。常用搭配：prevail among sth/sb (在...之中盛行)。"},{"sentence":"After a long and difficult struggle, justice finally <target>prevailed</target> <pattern>over</pattern> the forces of corruption and greed in the small town.","translation":"經過漫長而艱辛的鬥爭，正義最終戰勝了小鎮上的腐敗與貪婪勢力。","explanation":"動詞片語 prevail over sth 表「戰勝/克服」。"},{"sentence":"Despite the initial challenges, the team's determination to succeed <target>prevailed</target>, leading them to win the national championship.","translation":"儘管最初面臨挑戰，該團隊獲勝的決心最終佔了上風，使他們贏得了全國冠軍。","explanation":"動詞「佔上風/成功」。"}],"related_forms":["prevalent","prevailing"]}

{"headword":"prey","explanation":"名詞「獵物」；動詞「捕食」。注意與 pray (祈禱) 的發音相同但意義不同。常用片語 prey on (捕食...；利用...的弱點)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The eagle soared high in the sky, searching for its <target>prey</target> among the small animals running in the field below.","translation":"老鷹在高空中盤旋，在下方田野奔跑的小動物中尋找它的獵物。","explanation":"名詞「獵物」。指被捕食的動物。"},{"sentence":"Many species of owls <target>prey</target> <pattern>on</pattern> small rodents, using their sharp claws and silent flight to catch them at night.","translation":"許多品種的貓頭鷹捕食小型齧齒動物，利用牠們銳利的爪子和無聲的飛行在夜間捕捉牠們。","explanation":"動詞片語 prey on 表示「捕食」。"},{"sentence":"Scammers often <target>prey</target> <pattern>on</pattern> elderly people who may not be familiar with modern technology and are more likely to trust strangers.","translation":"詐騙者經常利用不熟悉現代科技且較容易信任陌生人的老年人的弱點來進行詐騙。","explanation":"動詞片語 prey on 在此表示「利用...的弱點」或「欺壓」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"prior","explanation":"形容詞「優先的、先前的」；副詞「先前地」；名詞「院長/優先權」。在 GSAT 中最常見為形容詞，常用於 prior to (在...之前)，相當於 before 但更正式。","entries":[{"sentence":"Students must complete the online registration form <target>prior</target> <pattern>to</pattern> attending the orientation session on Monday morning.","translation":"學生在週一早上的說明會之前必須完成線上登記表。","explanation":"形容詞用法，片語 prior to 表示「在...之前」。"},{"sentence":"The applicant had no <target>prior</target> experience in marketing, but his strong passion for the job impressed the interviewer.","translation":"該申請人之前沒有行銷方面的經驗，但他對這份工作的強烈熱情給面試官留下了深刻印象。","explanation":"形容詞「先前的」。指在目前時間點之前發生的。"},{"sentence":"The meeting was rescheduled to a <target>prior</target> date because several key members were unable to attend the original session.","translation":"由於幾位關鍵成員無法參加原定的會議，會議被重新安排在較早的日期。","explanation":"形容詞「較早的」。"}],"related_forms":["priority"]}

{"headword":"proclaim","explanation":"動詞「宣布、宣告」。通常用於正式、公開的宣告，如政府公告或法律宣告。常用搭配 proclaim something to be... (宣布某事為...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After the long war ended, the government <target>proclaimed</target> a national holiday to celebrate the return of peace to the country.","translation":"長久的戰爭結束後，政府宣布全國放假，以慶祝國家恢復和平。","explanation":"動詞「宣布」。指正式地向大眾公告。"},{"sentence":"The new law was <target>proclaimed</target> by the president, stating that all citizens have the right to free education until high school.","translation":"總統宣布了新法律，規定所有公民都有權在高中之前接受免費教育。","explanation":"動詞「宣告」。常用於法律或政令的發布。"},{"sentence":"The committee <target>proclaimed</target> the winner of the art competition during the school assembly, much to the excitement of the students.","translation":"委員會在學校集會期間宣布了藝術比賽的獲勝者，令學生們非常興奮。","explanation":"動詞「宣布」。指正式公布結果。"}],"related_forms":["proclamation"]}

{"headword":"productivity","explanation":"名詞「生產力」。指在一定時間內產出的數量或效率。常用於經濟、工作環境或學習效率的討論。常用搭配 increase/boost productivity (提高生產力)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company introduced new software to <pattern>boost</pattern> <target>productivity</target>, allowing employees to complete their reports more quickly and accurately.","translation":"公司引入了新軟體以提高生產力，使員工能更快速且準確地完成報告。","explanation":"名詞「生產力」。搭配 boost 表示「提升」。"},{"sentence":"Taking short breaks every hour can actually improve your <target>productivity</target> by preventing mental fatigue during long study sessions.","translation":"每小時休息片刻實際上可以提高你的生產力，因為能防止長時間學習時的精神疲勞。","explanation":"名詞「生產力」。指工作或學習的效率。"},{"sentence":"The farm's <target>productivity</target> increased significantly after the farmers started using organic fertilizers and a more efficient irrigation system.","translation":"在農民開始使用有機肥料和更高效的灌溉系統後，農場的產量顯著增加。","explanation":"名詞「生產力」。在此指農業的產出量。"}],"related_forms":["productive"]}

{"headword":"profile","explanation":"名詞「側臉；簡介；輪廓」；動詞「描寫、介紹」。在數位時代，profile 常指社群媒體的「個人檔案」。常用片語 high-profile (高調的、受關注的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Before applying for the internship, the student updated her professional <target>profile</target> on LinkedIn to attract more potential employers.","translation":"在申請實習之前，這名學生更新了她在 LinkedIn 上的專業個人簡介，以吸引更多潛在的雇主。","explanation":"名詞「個人簡介/檔案」。指總結個人背景的資訊。"},{"sentence":"The magazine decided to <target>profile</target> the young scientist in their next issue, highlighting her contributions to cancer research.","translation":"該雜誌決定在下一期中介紹這位年輕科學家，強調她對癌症研究的貢獻。","explanation":"動詞「詳細介紹」。指撰寫關於某人的專題報導。"},{"sentence":"The celebrity tried to keep a <pattern>low</pattern> <target>profile</target> by avoiding public events and staying away from the media for a few months.","translation":"這位名人試圖保持低調，幾個月來避免參加公開活動並遠離媒體。","explanation":"名詞「關注度」。片語 low profile 表示「低調」，相對的是 high profile (高調)。"},{"sentence":"The detective studied the suspect's side <target>profile</target> in the photograph to see if it matched the witness's description.","translation":"偵探研究照片中嫌疑犯的側臉輪廓，看是否與證人的描述相符。","explanation":"名詞「側臉/輪廓」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"profound","explanation":"形容詞「深奧的、深刻的」。可用於描述影響、感受或知識。常見搭配 profound impact/effect (深遠的影響), profound knowledge (深厚的知識)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher's words had a <target>profound</target> <pattern>impact on</pattern> the student, inspiring him to pursue a career in environmental science.","translation":"老師的話對這名學生產生了深遠的影響，激勵他追求環境科學的職業。","explanation":"形容詞「深遠的」。常用片語 profound impact on sth/sb。"},{"sentence":"After reading the philosophy book, the student felt a <target>profound</target> sense of confusion about the meaning of human existence.","translation":"讀完這本哲學書後，學生對人類存在的意義感到一種深刻的困惑。","explanation":"形容詞「深刻的」。描述強烈的感受。"},{"sentence":"The professor is known for his <target>profound</target> understanding of ancient history, often sharing insights that surprise his colleagues.","translation":"這位教授以其對古代歷史的深厚理解而聞名，經常分享令同事驚訝的見解。","explanation":"形容詞「深厚的」。描述知識或理解的程度。"}],"related_forms":["profoundly"]}

{"headword":"progressive","explanation":"形容詞「進步的、漸進的」；名詞「進步主義者」。在 GSAT 中常指思想開明或循序漸進的過程。注意與 conservative (保守的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school adopted a <target>progressive</target> approach to education, encouraging students to learn through experience rather than just memorizing facts.","translation":"學校採取了一種進步的教育方法，鼓勵學生透過經驗學習，而非僅僅是記憶事實。","explanation":"形容詞「進步的」。指思想開明、採取新方法。"},{"sentence":"The patient showed <target>progressive</target> improvement in her health after following the doctor's exercise plan for three months.","translation":"在遵循醫生的運動計畫三個月後，病人的健康狀況顯示出漸進的改善。","explanation":"形容詞「漸進的」。指隨著時間慢慢增加或改變。"},{"sentence":"As a <target>progressive</target>, he strongly supported new laws that aimed to reduce social inequality and protect the rights of minorities.","translation":"作為一名進步主義者，他強烈支持旨在減少社會不平等和保護少數群體權利的新法律。","explanation":"名詞「進步主義者」。指支持社會改革的人。"}],"related_forms":["progress","progressively"]}

{"headword":"prohibit","explanation":"動詞「禁止」。正式用詞，常用於法律、規則。注意其被動用法 be prohibited from V-ing (被禁止做...) 或 prohibit someone from V-ing (禁止某人做...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school rules strictly <target>prohibit</target> students <pattern>from</pattern> using mobile phones during class to ensure they stay focused on the lesson.","translation":"校規嚴格禁止學生在課堂上使用手機，以確保他們能專注於課程。","explanation":"動詞「禁止」。常用結構 prohibit someone from doing something。"},{"sentence":"Smoking is <target>prohibited</target> <pattern>in</pattern> all public buildings to protect people from the harmful effects of second-hand smoke.","translation":"所有公共建築內均禁止吸菸，以保護人們免受二手菸的有害影響。","explanation":"動詞被動用法。prohibited in... 表示在某處被禁止。"},{"sentence":"The new law <target>prohibits</target> the sale of sugary drinks to children under the age of twelve in order to reduce childhood obesity.","translation":"新法律禁止向十二歲以下兒童銷售含糖飲料，以減少兒童肥胖。","explanation":"動詞「禁止」。指由法律或規定所禁止。"}],"related_forms":["prohibition","prohibitive"]}

{"headword":"projection","explanation":"名詞「預測、推計」或「投影、投射」。在商業或科學語境中，常指根據現有數據對未來的預測。常用搭配 population projection (人口預測), financial projection (財務預測)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Based on current trends, the company's financial <target>projection</target> suggests a significant increase in profits by the end of the next year.","translation":"根據目前的趨勢，公司的財務預測顯示明年年底利潤將大幅增加。","explanation":"名詞「預測」。指對未來數據的推算。"},{"sentence":"The latest population <target>projection</target> indicates that the city will grow by ten percent over the next decade due to urban development.","translation":"最新的人口預測指出，由於都市發展，這座城市在未來十年將成長百分之十。","explanation":"名詞「預測」。常用於人口統計。"},{"sentence":"The teacher used a digital <target>projection</target> to display the complex diagrams on the wall, making it easier for students to visualize the process.","translation":"老師使用數位投影將複雜的圖表顯示在牆上，使學生更容易將過程視覺化。","explanation":"名詞「投影」。指將影像投射到螢幕或牆上的行為。"}],"related_forms":["project"]}

{"headword":"prolong","explanation":"動詞「延長」。指使時間或過程變得更長。常用搭配 prolong the process (延長過程), prolong life (延長壽命)。注意與 extend 的區別：prolong 常用於指「不必要地或令人不快地延長」或「延續某種狀態」，而 extend 則較中性，可用於延長期限 (extend a deadline) 或延伸長度。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government tried to <target>prolong</target> the negotiations to reach a fair agreement, but the two sides could not find common ground.","translation":"政府試圖延長協商時間以達成公平協議，但雙方無法找到共同點。","explanation":"動詞「延長」。指延續某個過程的時間。"},{"sentence":"Medical advancements in the last century have helped to <target>prolong</target> the average human lifespan by improving healthcare and nutrition.","translation":"上個世紀的醫學進步透過改善醫療和營養，幫助延長了人類的平均壽命。","explanation":"動詞「延長」。常用於 prolong life/lifespan。"},{"sentence":"He tried to <target>prolong</target> the conversation by asking more questions because he didn't want the guest to leave so soon.","translation":"他試圖透過詢問更多問題來延長對話，因為他不想讓客人這麼快離開。","explanation":"動詞「延長」。指刻意延後結束時間。"}],"related_forms":["prolonged"]}

{"headword":"prone","explanation":"形容詞「易於...的，傾向於...的」。常用於描述不好的傾向。最常見的搭配是 be prone to (易於...的/傾向於...的)，其中 to 是介係詞，後接名詞或動名詞 (V-ing)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Because of the coastal location and low-lying land, the village is <target>prone</target> <pattern>to</pattern> frequent flooding during the rainy season.","translation":"由於位於沿海且地勢低窪，這個村莊在雨季期間容易發生頻繁的淹水。","explanation":"形容詞「易於...的」。搭配 be prone to + N，描述一種客觀的傾向或易發狀態。"},{"sentence":"Young children are often more <target>prone</target> <pattern>to</pattern> catching colds in winter if they do not wear enough warm clothes.","translation":"如果冬天不穿足夠的保暖衣物，幼童往往更容易感冒。","explanation":"形容詞「易於...的」。搭配 be prone to + V-ing，描述一種生理傾向。"},{"sentence":"The student, who often forgot his homework, was <target>prone</target> <pattern>to</pattern> making careless mistakes during the final examination.","translation":"這名經常忘記功課的學生在期末考時傾向於犯粗心的錯誤。","explanation":"形容詞「傾向於...的」。描述一個人的習慣性傾向。"}],"related_forms":["proneness"]}

{"headword":"propaganda","explanation":"名詞「宣傳」。通常指具有偏見、誤導性或為了政治目的而散布的資訊。注意其含義通常帶有負面色彩，與普通的 advertisement 或 information 不同。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the war, the government used <target>propaganda</target> to convince the citizens that their country was winning the fight against the enemy.","translation":"戰爭期間，政府利用宣傳來讓公民相信他們的國家在與敵人的戰鬥中獲勝。","explanation":"名詞「宣傳」。指為了政治目的而刻意操縱的資訊。"},{"sentence":"Many people are now learning how to analyze news critically to avoid being misled by political <target>propaganda</target> on social media.","translation":"許多人現在學習如何批判性地分析新聞，以避免被社群媒體上的政治宣傳所誤導。","explanation":"名詞「宣傳」。強調其誤導性。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"prophet","explanation":"名詞「先知，預言者」。指能夠預測未來或傳達神聖信息的人。在 GSAT 考題中，除了宗教語境，也可用於比喻那些預測未來趨勢的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"In many ancient stories, the <target>prophet</target> warned the people about a coming disaster, but few of them believed his words.","translation":"在許多古代故事中，先知警告人們即將到來的災難，但很少有人相信他的話。","explanation":"名詞「先知」。指能預測未來的人。"},{"sentence":"Some economists act as <target>prophets</target> of the financial market, predicting that a global economic crisis will happen in the next few years.","translation":"一些經濟學家扮演著金融市場預言者的角色，預測全球經濟危機將在未來幾年內發生。","explanation":"名詞「預言者」。比喻能預測未來趨勢的人。"}],"related_forms":["prophetic","prophecy"]}

{"headword": "proportion", "explanation": "名詞「比例，部分」。指一個部分與整體之間的關係。常用搭配 include a large proportion of (包含大部分的...) 或 in proportion to (與...成比例)。動詞用法較少見，指「使成比例」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "A large <target>proportion</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the city's budget was spent on building new parks and libraries to improve the quality of life.", "translation": "城市預算的大部分被用於建造新的公園和圖書館，以提高生活品質。", "explanation": "名詞「比例，部分」。常用搭配 a proportion of + N。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher noticed that a significant <target>proportion</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the students failed the test because they did not study the correct material.", "translation": "老師注意到很大比例的學生在考試中失敗，因為他們沒有研讀正確的教材。", "explanation": "名詞「比例，部分」。"}, {"sentence": "The design of the building was criticized because the size of the windows was not in <target>proportion</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the overall structure.", "translation": "這棟建築的設計受到批評，因為窗戶的大小與整體結構不成比例。", "explanation": "名詞「比例」。片語 in proportion to 表示「與...成比例」。"}], "related_forms": ["proportional", "proportionate"]}

{"headword":"prosecution","explanation":"名詞「起訴，檢方」。指法律程序中對被告進行起訴的行為，或指負責起訴的檢察官（集體名詞）。注意與 prosecution (起訴) 和 defense (辯方) 的對立。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>prosecution</target> presented strong evidence to the judge to prove that the suspect had committed the crime intentionally.","translation":"檢方向法官提交了強而有力的證據，以證明嫌疑犯是有意地犯罪。","explanation":"名詞「檢方」。指負責起訴的法律團隊。"},{"sentence":"After gathering enough evidence, the district attorney decided to start the <target>prosecution</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the company for violating environmental laws.","translation":"在收集到足夠證據後，地方檢察官決定起訴該公司違反環境法。","explanation":"名詞「起訴」。指法律上的起訴行為。搭配 prosecution of sth/sb。"}],"related_forms":["prosecute"]}

{"headword":"prospect","explanation":"名詞「前景，希望；展望」。常用搭配 include the prospect of (包含...的可能性) 或 bright prospects (光明的前景)。動詞用法指「尋找，勘探」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young graduate felt excited about the <target>prospect</target> <pattern>of</pattern> starting a new career in a foreign country after finishing university.","translation":"這位年輕的畢業生對於在大學畢業後在國外開始新職業的前景感到興奮。","explanation":"名詞「前景，希望」。搭配 the prospect of + N/V-ing。"},{"sentence":"With its innovative technology and strong leadership, the startup company has very <pattern>bright</pattern> <target>prospects</target> for future growth.","translation":"憑藉其創新技術和強大的領導力，這家初創公司未來成長的前景非常光明。","explanation":"名詞「前景」。常用搭配 bright/dim prospects。"},{"sentence":"Miners spent many years <target>prospecting</target> <pattern>for</pattern> gold in the mountains, hoping to find a rich vein of precious metal.","translation":"礦工在山中花了很多年勘探金礦，希望找到富含貴金屬的礦脈。","explanation":"動詞「勘探」。常用搭配 prospect for sth。"}],"related_forms":["prospective"]}

{"headword":"province","explanation":"名詞「省；省分」。指一個國家內部行政區劃的一部分。也可以比喻地指「領域，範圍」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government decided to allocate more resources to the rural <target>provinces</target> to reduce the gap between the city and the countryside.","translation":"政府決定向農村省份分配更多資源，以縮小城市與鄉村之間的差距。","explanation":"名詞「省」。指行政區劃。"},{"sentence":"While I can help you with the basic grammar, detailed legal analysis is outside my <target>province</target> of expertise.","translation":"雖然我可以幫你處理基礎文法，但詳細的法律分析超出了我的專業領域。","explanation":"名詞「領域，範圍」。比喻用法，指某人的知識或權限範圍。"}],"related_forms":["provincial"]}

{"headword":"provision","explanation":"名詞「供應，提供；條款」。指提供所需物品的行為，或法律文件/合約中的具體規定。注意 provision (供應) 與 provisions (糧食/物資) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school ensures the <target>provision</target> <pattern>of</pattern> healthy meals for all students, regardless of their family's financial situation.","translation":"學校確保為所有學生提供健康的餐點，無論其家庭經濟狀況如何。","explanation":"名詞「供應，提供」。常用搭配 the provision of sth。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer carefully read every <target>provision</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the contract to ensure that his client's rights were fully protected.","translation":"律師仔細閱讀了合約中的每一項條款，以確保他的客戶的權利得到充分保護。","explanation":"名詞「條款」。指法律文件中的規定。常用搭配 provision in/of the contract。"},{"sentence":"The explorers carried enough <target>provisions</target> to last for two weeks, including dried food and plenty of clean drinking water.","translation":"探險家攜帶了足夠兩週的物資，包括乾糧和大量乾淨的飲用水。","explanation":"名詞「物資，糧食」。通常用複數形式 provisions。"}],"related_forms":["provide"]}

{"headword":"provoke","explanation":"動詞「挑釁，激怒；引起」。常用搭配 provoke a reaction (引起反應) 或 provoke someone to do sth (激怒某人使其做某事)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The politician's controversial comments <target>provoked</target> a strong <pattern>reaction</pattern> <pattern>from</pattern> the public, leading to several large protests.","translation":"這位政治家的爭議性言論引起了公眾的強烈反應，導致了幾次大型抗議。","explanation":"動詞「引起」。常用搭配 provoke a reaction from sb。"},{"sentence":"It is unwise to <target>provoke</target> a wild animal while hiking in the forest, as it may attack you to protect its territory.","translation":"在森林中徒步旅行時，挑釁野生動物是不明智的，因為它可能會為了保護領地而攻擊你。","explanation":"動詞「挑釁，激怒」。"},{"sentence":"The sudden increase in taxes <target>provoked</target> the citizens <pattern>to</pattern> organize a meeting to discuss their concerns with the mayor.","translation":"稅金的突然增加激怒了公民，使他們組織了一次會議，與市長討論他們的擔憂。","explanation":"動詞「激怒某人使其...」。搭配 provoke sb to do sth。"}],"related_forms":["provocation","provocative"]}

{"headword":"pulse","explanation":"名詞「脈搏；脈動」。動詞「跳動，脈動」。在醫學語境中指心跳，在比喻語境中指某個群體的「主流氛圍」或「趨勢」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The nurse placed two fingers on the patient's wrist to check his <target>pulse</target>, ensuring his heart was beating steadily.","translation":"護理師將兩根手指放在病人的手腕上檢查他的脈搏，確保他的心跳穩定。","explanation":"名詞「脈搏」。指生理上的心跳頻率。"},{"sentence":"The city center is the <target>pulse</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the metropolitan area, where the most active business and cultural events happen.","translation":"市中心是大都會區的脈動，最活躍的商業和文化活動都在此發生。","explanation":"名詞「脈動」。比喻用法，指一個地方的核心活力。"},{"sentence":"The lights in the club <target>pulsed</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the beat of the music, creating an exciting atmosphere for the young dancers.","translation":"俱樂部裡的燈光隨著音樂的節拍而跳動，為年輕的舞者營造了興奮的氛圍。","explanation":"動詞「跳動，脈動」。搭配 pulse to the beat。"}],"related_forms":["pulsate","pulsation"]}

{"headword":"purchase","explanation":"動詞「購買」；名詞「購買；購買之物」。動詞用法較正式，相當於 buy。名詞用法可用於描述交易過程或所買的商品。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school decided to <target>purchase</target> new computers for the library to provide students with better resources for their research projects.","translation":"學校決定為圖書館購買新電腦，以便為學生提供更好的研究計畫資源。","explanation":"動詞「購買」。在正式情境中常用於替代 buy。"},{"sentence":"Many customers prefer to <target>purchase</target> products <pattern>online</pattern> because it is more convenient and often cheaper than shopping at physical stores.","translation":"許多顧客偏好在網上購買產品，因為這比在實體店購物更方便且通常更便宜。","explanation":"動詞「購買」。"},{"sentence":"After browsing through the bookstore for an hour, she finally made a <target>purchase</target> and bought a rare collection of classical poetry.","translation":"在書店瀏覽了一小時後，她終於完成了購買，買了一套罕見的古典詩集。","explanation":"名詞「購買」。片語 make a purchase 表示「進行購買」。"},{"sentence":"Please keep your <target>purchases</target> in the provided bags until you have paid for them at the checkout counter.","translation":"在結帳櫃檯付款之前，請將您購買的物品放在提供的袋子裡。","explanation":"名詞「購買之物」。這裡指買到的商品。"}],"related_forms":["purchaser","purchasable"]}

{"headword":"pyramid","explanation":"名詞「金字塔；錐形物」。常用於描述古埃及建築或結構上的階層分佈。","entries":[{"sentence":"During their history trip to Egypt, the students were amazed by the massive size of the Great <target>Pyramid</target> of Giza.","translation":"在前往埃及的歷史之旅中，學生們對吉薩大金字塔的巨大規模感到驚訝。","explanation":"名詞「金字塔」。指古埃及的建築物。"},{"sentence":"The company's management structure is shaped like a <target>pyramid</target>, with the CEO at the top and many employees at the base.","translation":"該公司的管理結構呈金字塔形，執行長在頂端，許多員工在底端。","explanation":"名詞「錐形物」。比喻階層分佈。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"qualify","explanation":"動詞「使合格；取得資格」或「限制；修正」。常用片語 qualify for (取得...資格)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The athlete trained hard for four years to <target>qualify</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the Olympic Games and represent her country on the global stage.","translation":"這名運動員刻苦訓練四年，以取得參加奧運會並在國際舞台上代表國家的資格。","explanation":"動詞「取得資格」。常用片語 qualify for sth。"},{"sentence":"To <target>qualify</target> <pattern>as</pattern> a licensed teacher, graduates must complete a specific number of teaching hours in a real classroom.","translation":"為了取得教師執照資格，畢業生必須在真實的教室中完成特定時數的教學。","explanation":"動詞「取得資格」。常用搭配 qualify as + 職業。"},{"sentence":"The manager decided to <target>qualify</target> his previous statement to clarify that the success depended on several external factors.","translation":"經理決定修正他之前的陳述，以澄清這次成功取決於幾個外部因素。","explanation":"動詞「限制；修正」。指對原話進行補充或修正，使其更精確。"}],"related_forms":["qualification","qualified"]}

{"headword":"quest","explanation":"名詞「追求；探索」。通常指長期的、艱難的尋找或追求，常用於文學或正式語境。常用片語 in quest of (為了尋找...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The brave knight set out on a dangerous <target>quest</target> to find the legendary sword and save the kingdom from the dark magic.","translation":"勇敢的騎士展開了一場危險的探索，以尋找傳說中的寶劍並將王國從黑暗魔法中拯救出來。","explanation":"名詞「探索；尋找」。指一段艱難的旅程。"},{"sentence":"Many scientists spend their entire lives <pattern>in</pattern> <target>quest</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a cure for cancer to improve human health and longevity.","translation":"許多科學家花費一生追求癌症的治療方法，以改善人類的健康與壽命。","explanation":"名詞「追求」。片語 in quest of sth 表示「為了尋找/追求某物」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "questionnaire", "explanation": "名詞「問卷」。常用動詞搭配 fill out (填寫) 或 distribute (分發)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The sociology students <pattern>distributed</pattern> a <target>questionnaire</target> to a hundred classmates to gather data on their sleeping habits.", "translation": "社會學學生向一百名同學分發了問卷，以收集關於他們睡眠習慣的數據。", "explanation": "名詞「問卷」。常用搭配 distribute a questionnaire。"}, {"sentence": "Please <pattern>fill</pattern> <target>out</target> the <target>questionnaire</target> carefully and return it to the office by the end of the week.", "translation": "請仔細填寫這份問卷，並在週末前將其交回辦公室。", "explanation": "名詞「問卷」。片語 fill out a questionnaire 表示「填寫問卷」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"quiver","explanation":"名詞「箭袋」；動詞「顫抖」。動詞常用於描述因恐懼、興奮或寒冷而產生的輕微抖動。","entries":[{"sentence":"The archer reached back to pull an arrow from his leather <target>quiver</target> before aiming carefully at the target.","translation":"弓箭手在仔細瞄準目標之前，伸手從皮製箭袋中取出了一支箭。","explanation":"名詞「箭袋」。指存放箭的容器。"},{"sentence":"Her voice began to <target>quiver</target> with emotion as she thanked her parents and teachers during the graduation speech.","translation":"在畢業演講中感謝父母和老師時，她的聲音因激動而開始顫抖。","explanation":"動詞「顫抖」。指輕微的抖動。"},{"sentence":"The leaves of the trees started to <target>quiver</target> in the cold autumn wind, signaling that winter was approaching.","translation":"樹葉在寒冷的秋風中開始顫抖，預示著冬天快到了。","explanation":"動詞「顫抖」。"}],"related_forms":["quivering"]}

{"headword":"quota","explanation":"名詞「配額；定額」。指分配給某人或某組織的固定數量或比例。","entries":[{"sentence":"The sales team must meet their monthly <target>quota</target> of new clients to receive a bonus from the company.","translation":"銷售團隊必須達到每月開發新客戶的配額才能從公司獲得獎金。","explanation":"名詞「配額」。指必須達到的最低數量。"},{"sentence":"The government imposed a strict <target>quota</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the import of foreign cars to protect the local automotive industry.","translation":"政府對進口外國汽車實施了嚴格的配額限制，以保護本地汽車工業。","explanation":"名詞「配額」。常用搭配 quota on sth。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"racism","explanation":"名詞「種族主義」。指基於種族而產生的歧視或偏見。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university holds workshops every year to educate students about the dangers of <target>racism</target> and promote equality for all.","translation":"大學每年舉辦工作坊，教育學生關於種族主義的危險，並促進所有人的平等。","explanation":"名詞「種族主義」。"},{"sentence":"Many people believe that systemic <target>racism</target> still exists in the legal system, leading to unfair treatment of minority groups.","translation":"許多人認為法律體系中仍然存在系統性的種族主義，導致少數群體受到不公正的對待。","explanation":"名詞「種族主義」。常用搭配 systemic racism (系統性種族主義)。"}],"related_forms":["racist","racial"]}

{"headword":"rack","explanation":"名詞「架子；支架」；動詞「使受苦；（用力）扭曲」。名詞常用於存放物品的架子，如 clothes rack 或 luggage rack。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students placed their heavy bags on the luggage <target>rack</target> at the back of the bus to make more room.","translation":"學生們將沉重的背包放在巴士後方的行李架上，以騰出更多空間。","explanation":"名詞「架子」。常用搭配 luggage rack (行李架)。"},{"sentence":"Please hang your coats on the clothes <target>rack</target> near the entrance so that the classroom remains tidy and organized.","translation":"請將外套掛在入口處的衣架上，這樣教室才能保持整潔有序。","explanation":"名詞「架子」。常用搭配 clothes rack (衣架)。"},{"sentence":"I had to <target>rack</target> <pattern>my brain</pattern> for an hour to remember the name of the teacher who taught me in primary school.","translation":"我得苦思一小時才能想起小學時教我的那位老師的名字。","explanation":"動詞片語 rack one's brain 表示「苦思；絞盡腦汁」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"radiation","explanation":"名詞「輻射」。常用於描述電磁波或核能釋放的能量，如 UV radiation (紫外線輻射) 或 nuclear radiation (核輻射)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Doctors advise people to wear sunscreen to protect their skin from the harmful effects of UV <target>radiation</target> during the summer.","translation":"醫生建議人們在夏天塗抹防曬霜，以保護皮膚免受紫外線輻射的傷害。","explanation":"名詞「輻射」。常用搭配 UV radiation (紫外線輻射)。"},{"sentence":"After the nuclear accident, scientists used special equipment to measure the level of <target>radiation</target> in the surrounding soil and water.","translation":"核事故發生後，科學家使用特殊設備測量周圍土壤和水中的輻射水平。","explanation":"名詞「輻射」。常用搭配 nuclear radiation (核輻射)。"}],"related_forms":["radiate","radioactive"]}

{"headword":"radical","explanation":"形容詞「激進的」或「根本的」；名詞「激進分子」或「數學中的根號」。在 GSAT 考題中，最常出現的是形容詞用法，區分「根本的 (fundamental)」與「激進的 (extreme)」。例如 radical change (根本的改變) 或 radical political views (激進的政治觀點)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The scientists suggested that a <target>radical</target> change in the city's waste management system was necessary to solve the pollution problem.","translation":"科學家建議，城市廢物管理系統的根本改變對於解決污染問題是必要的。","explanation":"形容詞「根本的」。指從根源上進行徹底的改變。"},{"sentence":"The young activist proposed <target>radical</target> ideas to reform the education system, which were seen as too extreme by the older generation.","translation":"這位年輕的活動家提出了改革教育系統的激進想法，這被年長一代視為過於極端。","explanation":"形容詞「激進的」。指對現狀採取極端或強烈的變革態度。"},{"sentence":"The government's decision to lower taxes was viewed by some as a <target>radical</target> step toward improving the local economy.","translation":"政府降低稅金的決定被一些人視為改善當地經濟的激進舉措。","explanation":"形容詞「激進的」。"},{"sentence":"During the history class, the teacher explained how <target>radical</target> thinkers of the past challenged the traditional beliefs of their society.","translation":"在歷史課上，老師解釋了過去的激進思想家如何挑戰他們社會的傳統信仰。","explanation":"名詞「激進分子/思想家」。"}],"related_forms":["radically"]}

{"headword":"ragged","explanation":"形容詞「破爛的」或「參差不齊的」。常用於描述衣服破舊 (ragged clothes) 或呼吸急促不穩 (ragged breathing)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The homeless man wore <target>ragged</target> clothes that were torn in many places, showing that he had been living on the streets for a long time.","translation":"那個無家可歸的男人穿著破爛的衣服，許多地方都撕裂了，顯示出他長期住在街上。","explanation":"形容詞「破爛的」。描述衣服或布料破損。"},{"sentence":"After running the marathon for three hours, the athlete's breathing became <target>ragged</target> as he struggled to reach the finish line.","translation":"經過三小時的馬拉松後，這位運動員的呼吸變得急促不穩，因為他正努力到達終點線。","explanation":"形容詞「參差不齊的/急促的」。描述呼吸不規律且沉重。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"raid","explanation":"名詞「突擊；搜查」；動詞「突擊；搜查」。常用搭配 raid on (對...的突擊)。注意區分 raid (突擊搜查) 與 attack (攻擊)，raid 通常指短時間、出其不意地進入某地以奪取某物或逮捕某人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police conducted a midnight <target>raid</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the warehouse to seize the illegal drugs and arrest the gang members.","translation":"警方在半夜對該倉庫進行了突擊搜查，以沒收非法藥物並逮捕幫派成員。","explanation":"名詞「突擊搜查」。常用搭配 raid on sth。"},{"sentence":"The hungry students decided to <target>raid</target> the refrigerator in the kitchen for some late-night snacks during their final exam week.","translation":"飢餓的學生決定在期末考週期間突擊搜查廚房的冰箱，找一些深夜零食。","explanation":"動詞「搜查/翻找」。在此指非正式地尋找食物。"},{"sentence":"The military forces launched a sudden <target>raid</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the enemy's base to destroy their communication equipment and capture important documents.","translation":"軍方對敵軍基地發起了突然的突擊，以摧毀其通訊設備並獲取重要文件。","explanation":"名詞「突擊」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"rail","explanation":"名詞「鐵軌；欄杆」。常用搭配 by rail (搭火車), handrail (扶手)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many tourists prefer to travel <pattern>by</pattern> <target>rail</target> through Europe because it is more scenic and convenient than flying between cities.","translation":"許多遊客偏好搭火車遊覽歐洲，因為這比在城市之間飛機旅行更有風景且更方便。","explanation":"名詞「鐵軌/鐵路」。片語 by rail 表示「搭火車」。"},{"sentence":"The elderly woman held onto the <target>rail</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the stairs for support as she slowly walked down to the first floor.","translation":"那位年長的婦女在慢慢走下樓到一樓時，扶著樓梯的欄杆以獲得支撐。","explanation":"名詞「欄杆/扶手」。"}],"related_forms":["railway","railing"]}

{"headword":"rally","explanation":"名詞「集會；恢復」；動詞「聚集；恢復」。在 GSAT 中，rally 常指政治集會或支持某人的集會。動詞用法時，常指恢復體力或精神，或聚集力量。常用搭配 rally around (團結在...周圍)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Thousands of people gathered for a political <target>rally</target> in the city center to demand better working conditions and higher wages.","translation":"數千人聚集在市中心參加政治集會，要求更好的工作條件和更高的薪水。","explanation":"名詞「集會」。指為了某個共同目的而聚集的人群。"},{"sentence":"The tennis player managed to <target>rally</target> her strength in the final set and won the match after being behind for most of the game.","translation":"這位網球選手在最後一盤成功恢復了體力，並在大部分比賽落後的情況下贏得了比賽。","explanation":"動詞「恢復」。指在困難情況下恢復體力或精神。"},{"sentence":"After the shocking news of the team's loss, the students <target>rallied</target> <pattern>around</pattern> their captain to provide emotional support.","translation":"在球隊輸球的震驚消息後，學生們團結在隊長身邊提供情感支持。","explanation":"動詞片語 rally around 表「團結在...周圍」或「支持」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"ranch","explanation":"名詞「大牧場」；動詞「經營牧場」。常用於描述美國西部風格的大規模畜牧場，區分於 farm (農場)，ranch 專指養殖牛羊等的大型牧場。","entries":[{"sentence":"The family owns a large cattle <target>ranch</target> in Texas, where they raise thousands of cows and produce high-quality beef.","translation":"這家人在德州擁有一座大型牛牧場，在那裡他們養了數千頭牛並生產高品質的牛肉。","explanation":"名詞「大牧場」。"},{"sentence":"He spent his summer vacation working on a <target>ranch</target>, learning how to ride horses and manage the livestock in the open fields.","translation":"他在牧場工作度過了暑假，學習如何騎馬以及在開闊的田野中管理牲畜。","explanation":"名詞「大牧場」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"random","explanation":"形容詞「隨機的；任意的」。常用搭配 at random (隨機地)。注意區分 random 與 accidental (意外的)，random 強調的是沒有特定計畫或模式，而 accidental 強調的是非刻意地發生。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher chose a <target>random</target> student to answer the question, ensuring that everyone in the class remained attentive during the lesson.","translation":"老師隨機選擇了一名學生來回答問題，以確保班上的每個人在課堂上都保持專注。","explanation":"形容詞「隨機的」。指沒有特定順序或模式。"},{"sentence":"To ensure a fair test, the computer program selects <target>random</target> samples from the population to represent different age groups.","translation":"為了確保測試的公正，電腦程式從人口中隨機抽取樣本，以代表不同的年齡層。","explanation":"形容詞「隨機的」。"},{"sentence":"The artist painted a series of <target>random</target> dots on the canvas, creating a modern piece of art that looked like a starry night.","translation":"藝術家在畫布上畫了一系列隨機的點，創造出一件看起來像星空的現代藝術品。","explanation":"形容詞「隨機的」。"},{"sentence":"Since he didn't know which book to choose, he simply picked one <pattern>at</pattern> <target>random</target> from the library shelf.","translation":"因為他不確定要選擇哪本書，他簡單地從圖書館書架上隨機挑了一本。","explanation":"形容詞/副詞用法。片語 at random 表示「隨機地」。"}],"related_forms":["randomly","randomness"]}

{"headword":"ratio","explanation":"名詞「比例；比率」。常用搭配 the ratio of A to B (A 與 B 的比例)。在學術文章中極為常見，用於描述數量關係。","entries":[{"sentence":"The ideal <target>ratio</target> <pattern>of</pattern> students <pattern>to</pattern> teachers in the classroom should be low to ensure that each student receives enough attention.","translation":"教室中學生與老師的理想比例應該較低，以確保每位學生都能獲得足夠的關注。","explanation":"名詞「比例」。常用搭配 the ratio of A to B。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are studying the <target>ratio</target> <pattern>of</pattern> oxygen <pattern>to</pattern> nitrogen in the atmosphere to understand how climate change affects the air.","translation":"科學家正在研究大氣中氧氣與氮氣的比例，以了解氣候變遷如何影響空氣。","explanation":"名詞「比例」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"rational","explanation":"形容詞「理性的；合理的」。常用搭配 a rational decision (理性的決定)。注意區分 rational (理性的) 與 rationalization (合理化/辯解)，後者常指為錯誤行為找藉口。","entries":[{"sentence":"In a heated argument, it is difficult to remain <target>rational</target> and listen to the other person's point of view without getting angry.","translation":"在激烈的爭論中，很難保持理性並在不生氣的情況下傾聽對方的觀點。","explanation":"形容詞「理性的」。指基於邏輯和理智而非情緒。"},{"sentence":"The manager asked the employees to provide a <target>rational</target> explanation for the delay in the project, rather than making excuses.","translation":"經理要求員工為專案延遲提供一個合理的解釋，而不是找藉口。","explanation":"形容詞「合理的」。指符合邏輯且能被接受的。"},{"sentence":"After weighing all the options, she finally made a <target>rational</target> decision to save money instead of buying an expensive new phone.","translation":"在衡量所有選項後，她終於做出了一個理性的決定，選擇存錢而不是買一支昂貴的新手機。","explanation":"形容詞「理性的」。"}],"related_forms":["rationally","rationality"]}

{"headword":"rattle","explanation":"動詞「使不安；發出咯咯聲」；名詞「咯咯聲；不安」。常用片語 rattle someone (使某人緊張/不安)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The loud <target>rattle</target> of the old air conditioner kept the students awake all night, making it impossible for them to concentrate on studying.","translation":"舊冷氣機發出的咯咯聲讓學生們整晚沒睡，使他們無法專注於學習。","explanation":"名詞「咯咯聲」。指短促、快速的碰撞聲。"},{"sentence":"The unexpected difficulty of the exam questions <target>rattled</target> the student, who had studied hard but suddenly forgot everything he knew.","translation":"考題的出乎意料的困難讓這名學生感到不安，儘管他努力學習過，但突然間忘記了所有他知道的東西。","explanation":"動詞「使不安」。指因壓力或驚訝而變得緊張。"},{"sentence":"Despite the pressure of the final interview, the candidate remained calm and did not let the difficult questions <target>rattle</target> him.","translation":"儘管面試的壓力很大，面試者仍保持冷靜，沒有讓困難的問題使他感到不安。","explanation":"動詞「使不安」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "realism", "explanation": "名詞「現實主義」或「現實感」。指對事物真實狀態的客觀呈現，而非理想化地想像。常用於藝術、文學或對生活的看法。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The author's use of gritty <target>realism</target> in the novel makes the characters' struggles feel authentic and relatable to the readers.", "translation": "作者在小說中使用殘酷的現實主義，使得角色們的掙扎對讀者而言顯得真實且能引起共鳴。", "explanation": "名詞「現實主義」。指在藝術或文學中真實地描繪生活。"}, {"sentence": "While some prefer fantasy stories, others appreciate the <target>realism</target> of the movie, which accurately depicts the daily lives of ordinary people.", "translation": "雖然有些人喜歡幻想故事，但其他人則欣賞這部電影的現實感，它準確地描繪普通人的日常生活。", "explanation": "名詞「現實感」。指對真實情況的準確呈現。"}, {"sentence": "Despite her dreams of becoming a world-famous singer, she maintained a sense of <target>realism</target> by practicing diligently and accepting constructive criticism.", "translation": "儘管她夢想成為世界著名的歌手，但她透過勤奮練習和接受建設性的批評來保持一種現實感。", "explanation": "名詞「現實感」。指對生活的實際看法。"}, {"sentence": "In international relations, <target>realism</target> suggests that nations act primarily based on their own national interests and power rather than on shared moral values.", "translation": "在國際關係中，現實主義認為國家主要根據自身的國家利益和權力而非共同的道德價值觀來行動。", "explanation": "名詞「現實主義」。指一種政治或哲學上的客觀觀點。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"realm","explanation":"名詞「領域」或「國度」。可以用於具體地指一個王國，或抽象地指知識、活動或興趣的特定範圍。常用搭配：in the realm of (在...領域中)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The discovery of a new planet has opened up new possibilities in the <target>realm</target> <pattern>of</pattern> astronomy and planetary science.","translation":"一顆新行星的發現為天文學和行星科學領域開啟了新的可能性。","explanation":"名詞「領域」。常用片語 in the realm of...。"},{"sentence":"In the <target>realm</target> <pattern>of</pattern> computer science, artificial intelligence is currently the most discussed topic among researchers and students.","translation":"在電腦科學領域，人工智慧目前是研究人員和學生之間討論最熱門的話題。","explanation":"名詞「領域」。"},{"sentence":"The legendary knight swore his loyalty to the king and promised to protect the <target>realm</target> from any foreign invasions.","translation":"傳奇騎士對國王宣誓效忠，並承諾保護這個國度免受任何外國入侵。","explanation":"名詞「國度」。指一個由君主統治的地區。"}],"related_forms":["realms"]}

{"headword": "rear", "explanation": "形容詞「後方的」；名詞「後部」。也可作為動詞指「撫養」。在 GSAT 中，常作為形容詞或名詞出現，描述位置。常用搭配：at the rear of (在...後方)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The passengers were told to exit the bus through the <target>rear</target> door to ensure a smoother flow of people during the evacuation.", "translation": "乘客被告知從巴士的後門下車，以確保疏散過程中人群的流動更加順暢。", "explanation": "形容詞「後方的」。"}, {"sentence": "The garden is located at the <target>rear</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the house, providing a quiet space for the family to relax and grow vegetables.", "translation": "花園位於房子的後方，為家人提供了一個放鬆和種植蔬菜的寧靜空間。", "explanation": "名詞「後部」。常用搭配 at the rear of...。"}, {"sentence": "She spent her childhood in a small village, where she was <target>reared</target> by her grandparents after her parents moved to the city.", "translation": "她在一個小村莊度過童年，在父母搬到城市後由祖父母撫養長大。", "explanation": "動詞「撫養」。指照顧孩子直到長大。"}], "related_forms": ["rearing"]}

{"headword":"reassure","explanation":"動詞「使安心、安慰」。指通過提供信心或正面信息來消除他人的疑慮或恐懼。常用搭配：reassure someone that... (使某人相信...而安心)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher <target>reassured</target> the nervous students <pattern>that</pattern> the exam would be fair and based only on the material covered in class.","translation":"老師安慰緊張的學生們，考試將會公平，且僅根據課堂上涵蓋的內容出題。","explanation":"動詞「使安心」。常用搭配 reassure someone that...。"},{"sentence":"When the child started to cry, the mother gently <target>reassured</target> him <pattern>with</pattern> a warm hug and some soft words.","translation":"當孩子開始哭泣時，母親用溫暖的擁抱和一些溫柔的話語安慰他。","explanation":"動詞「安慰」。常用搭配 reassure someone with sth。"}],"related_forms":["reassurance","reassuringly"]}

{"headword":"rebellion","explanation":"名詞「反叛、造反」。指對權威或政府的武裝反抗或拒絕服從。常用搭配：lead a rebellion (領導反叛), rebellion against (對...的反叛)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The citizens' <target>rebellion</target> <pattern>against</pattern> the unfair taxes led to a major political shift and the establishment of a new government.","translation":"公民對不公平稅收的反叛導致了重大的政治轉變以及新政府的成立。","explanation":"名詞「反叛」。常用搭配 rebellion against...。"},{"sentence":"The young prince led a <target>rebellion</target> to overthrow the cruel tyrant who had ruled the country for over thirty years.","translation":"年輕的王子領導了一場反叛，以推翻統治該國三十多年來的殘暴暴君。","explanation":"名詞「造反」。指組織性的武裝反抗。"}],"related_forms":["rebel","rebellious"]}

{"headword":"recession","explanation":"名詞「經濟衰退」。指經濟活動在一段時間內持續下降的狀態。常用搭配：economic recession (經濟衰退), enter a recession (進入衰退期)。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the global <target>recession</target>, many companies were forced to reduce their workforce to save costs and survive the crisis.","translation":"在全球經濟衰退期間，許多公司被迫削減人力以降低成本並在危機中生存。","explanation":"名詞「經濟衰退」。常用搭配 economic recession。"},{"sentence":"Economists warn that the country might <pattern>enter</pattern> a <target>recession</target> if the government does not implement effective policies to stimulate spending.","translation":"經濟學家警告說，如果政府不採取有效政策來刺激消費，該國可能會進入經濟衰退期。","explanation":"名詞「經濟衰退」。常用搭配 enter a recession。"}],"related_forms":["recessional"]}

{"headword":"recipient","explanation":"名詞「接收者、領受者」；形容詞「接收的」。最常用於指領取獎金、信件、獎項或器官移植的接收者。常用搭配：the recipient of (...的接收者)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The talented student was the <target>recipient</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the prestigious scholarship, which allowed her to study at a top university abroad.","translation":"這位才華橫溢的學生是這項聲望極高的獎學金的領受者，使她能夠在國外頂尖大學學習。","explanation":"名詞「領受者」。常用片語 the recipient of...。"},{"sentence":"Please make sure that the email address of the <target>recipient</target> is correct before you click the send button to avoid any delivery errors.","translation":"在點擊發送按鈕之前，請確保收件人的電子郵件地址正確，以避免任何投遞錯誤。","explanation":"名詞「接收者」。指收到信件或訊息的人。"},{"sentence":"In organ transplantation, the <target>recipient</target> must be a match <pattern>with</pattern> the donor to minimize the risk of rejection by the body.","translation":"在器官移植中，接收者必須與捐贈者匹配，以最大限度地降低身體排斥的風險。","explanation":"名詞「接收者」。醫學術語，指接受移植器官的人。"}],"related_forms":["receive","reception"]}

{"headword":"recite","explanation":"動詞「背誦、朗誦」。指將記憶中的內容大聲讀出。常用搭配：recite a poem (背誦詩歌), recite from memory (憑記憶背誦)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The English teacher asked the students to <target>recite</target> the poem <pattern>from memory</pattern> in front of the class to test their speaking skills.","translation":"英文老師要求學生在全班面前憑記憶朗誦這首詩，以測試他們的口說能力。","explanation":"動詞「背誦」。常用搭配 recite from memory。"},{"sentence":"During the school assembly, a young student <target>recited</target> a famous speech by Martin Luther King Jr., which deeply moved the audience.","translation":"在學校集會期間，一名年輕學生朗誦了馬丁路德金博士的一篇著名演講，深深地打動了聽眾。","explanation":"動詞「朗誦」。"}],"related_forms":["recitation"]}

{"headword":"recommend","explanation":"動詞「推薦、建議」。常用搭配：recommend A to B (向 B 推薦 A), recommend that... (建議...)。注意 recommend that 後面的子句中，動詞使用原形 (should be omitted)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The librarian <target>recommended</target> several interesting history books <pattern>to</pattern> the students, hoping they would enjoy reading about the past.","translation":"圖書管理員向學生推薦了幾本有趣的歷史書，希望他們能喜歡閱讀過去的故事。","explanation":"動詞「推薦」。常用搭配 recommend A to B。"},{"sentence":"My doctor <target>recommended</target> <pattern>that</pattern> I <target>take</target> a short break and get more sleep to recover from the extreme stress of the exams.","translation":"醫生建議我短暫休息並多睡覺，以從考試的極大壓力中恢復過來。","explanation":"動詞「建議」。常用搭配 recommend that... (that 子句中動詞用原形)。"},{"sentence":"If you are looking for a good restaurant nearby, I highly <target>recommend</target> the Italian place on the corner, as their pasta is amazing.","translation":"如果你在附近找好的餐廳，我強烈推薦轉角那家義大利餐廳，因為他們的義大利麵非常好吃。","explanation":"動詞「推薦」。"}],"related_forms":["recommendation"]}

{"headword":"recommendation","explanation":"名詞「推薦、建議」。常用搭配：on the recommendation of (根據...的推薦), make a recommendation (提出建議)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Based <pattern>on</pattern> the <target>recommendation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> my guidance counselor, I decided to apply for the computer science department at the university.","translation":"根據我輔導老師的推薦，我決定申請大學的電腦科學系。","explanation":"名詞「推薦」。常用片語 on the recommendation of...。"},{"sentence":"The committee spent several hours debating the issue before they finally <pattern>made</pattern> a <target>recommendation</target> for the new school policy.","translation":"委員會花了幾個小時討論這個問題，最後才針對新學校政策提出建議。","explanation":"名詞「建議」。常用搭配 make a recommendation。"},{"sentence":"The candidate provided three letters of <target>recommendation</target> from former employers to prove his professional skills and experience.","translation":"這位候選人提供了三封來自前雇主的推薦信，以證明其專業技能和經驗。","explanation":"名詞「推薦」。常用搭配 letters of recommendation。"}],"related_forms":["recommend"]}

{"headword":"recruit","explanation":"動詞「招募、徵召」；名詞「新兵、新進人員」。動詞常搭配 recruit for a position；名詞則指被招募進來的人。注意其動詞用法在職場與軍事背景皆常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"The software company is looking to <target>recruit</target> <pattern>talented programmers</pattern> from top universities to develop their new artificial intelligence app.","translation":"這家軟體公司正尋求從頂尖大學招募有才華的程式設計師，以開發他們新的人工智慧應用程式。","explanation":"動詞「招募」。常用搭配：recruit someone for a job/position。"},{"sentence":"During the training camp, the <target>recruits</target> had to wake up at dawn every day to practice their physical endurance and discipline.","translation":"在訓練營期間，新兵們每天必須在黎明時分起床，以練習他們的體能耐力與紀律。","explanation":"名詞「新兵」。指剛加入軍隊或組織的人員。"},{"sentence":"The sports club is trying to <target>recruit</target> <pattern>more members</pattern> <pattern>by</pattern> offering a free trial period for all new students.","translation":"該體育俱樂部正試圖透過為所有新生提供免費試用期來招募更多會員。","explanation":"動詞「招募」。"}],"related_forms":["recruitment"]}

{"headword":"refuge","explanation":"名詞「避難所、庇護」。指在危險或困難中尋求安全的地方。常用片語 seek refuge in/with (在...尋求庇護/避難)。","entries":[{"sentence":"When the sudden storm hit the mountain, the hikers decided to <pattern>seek</pattern> <target>refuge</target> <pattern>in</pattern> a small cave until the rain stopped.","translation":"當突然的暴風雨襲擊山區時，登山客決定在一個小山洞中尋求避難，直到雨停。","explanation":"名詞「避難所」。常用片語 seek refuge in sth。"},{"sentence":"The international organization provided a safe <target>refuge</target> for thousands of families fleeing from the war-torn region.","translation":"國際組織為數千個逃離戰亂地區的家庭提供了安全的庇護所。","explanation":"名詞「庇護所」。指提供安全保障的場所。"}],"related_forms":["refugee"]}

{"headword":"regardless","explanation":"形容詞「不顧的、不理會的」；副詞「不管怎樣」。最常見用法是 regardless of (不論...，不管...)，這是一個極其重要的 GSAT 考點，用來引導讓步狀語。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school decided to hold the sports meet <target>regardless</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the rainy weather, as the students had prepared for months.","translation":"由於學生們已經準備了數月，學校決定不顧雨天，依然舉行運動會。","explanation":"形容詞用法，常用片語 regardless of... (不管...)。"},{"sentence":"He knew that the task was extremely difficult, but he decided to move forward <target>regardless</target> to achieve his dream.","translation":"他知道這項任務極其困難，但他決定不顧一切地前進，以實現他的夢想。","explanation":"副詞用法，表示「不管怎樣」、「不顧一切地」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"regime","explanation":"名詞「政權、政體；管理制度」。常用於描述政治體制或某種嚴格的控制系統。注意其發音與 regime (政權) 相同但與 regimen (養生法/飲食計畫) 在某些語境下可通用，但在 GSAT 中主要指政權。","entries":[{"sentence":"The citizens protested in the streets, demanding an end to the oppressive <target>regime</target> that had restricted their freedom of speech for decades.","translation":"公民們在街上抗議，要求結束那個限制他們言論自由數十年的壓迫政權。","explanation":"名詞「政權」。通常指由強權掌控的政府。"},{"sentence":"The athletes followed a strict training <target>regime</target> to ensure they were in peak physical condition before the Olympic Games.","translation":"運動員們遵循嚴格的訓練制度，以確保他們在奧運會前處於巔峰體能狀態。","explanation":"名詞「管理制度/計畫」。指一套規律的程序或安排。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"rehearsal","explanation":"名詞「排練、演習」。指在正式表演或活動前的練習過程。常用搭配 hold a rehearsal (舉行排練)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school choir held a final <target>rehearsal</target> in the auditorium to make sure everyone knew their parts before the concert tonight.","translation":"學校合唱團在禮堂舉行了最後一次排練，以確保每個人在今晚的音樂會前都熟悉自己的部分。","explanation":"名詞「排練」。常用搭配 hold a rehearsal。"},{"sentence":"The actors spent hours in <target>rehearsal</target>, focusing on their facial expressions and timing to make the play more emotional.","translation":"演員們花了好幾個小時排練，專注於他們的面部表情和時機，使這齣戲更具情感感染力。","explanation":"名詞「排練」。"}],"related_forms":["rehearse"]}

{"headword":"reinforce","explanation":"動詞「加強、強化」。可用於物理上的加固（如建築），或抽象概念的強化（如觀念、信心、軍隊）。常用搭配 reinforce the idea/belief (強化觀念)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher used real-life examples to <target>reinforce</target> the grammar rules, helping students understand how to apply them in writing.","translation":"老師使用生活實例來強化文法規則，幫助學生理解如何在寫作中應用這些規則。","explanation":"動詞「強化」。指加深對某個概念的理解。"},{"sentence":"To prevent the building from collapsing during an earthquake, engineers decided to <target>reinforce</target> the walls <pattern>with</pattern> steel beams.","translation":"為了防止建築物在地震中倒塌，工程師決定用鋼樑加固牆壁。","explanation":"動詞「加固」。常用搭配 reinforce sth with sth。"},{"sentence":"Positive feedback from the coach helped <target>reinforce</target> the athlete's confidence, encouraging him to train even harder for the next race.","translation":"來自教練的正面回饋有助於強化運動員的信心，鼓勵他為下一場比賽更加努力地訓練。","explanation":"動詞「強化」。"}],"related_forms":["reinforcement"]}

{"headword":"reminder","explanation":"名詞「提醒物、提醒信」。通常指用來提醒某人做某事的事物。常用片語 serve as a reminder (作為提醒)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The sticky note on the refrigerator served as a <target>reminder</target> for her to buy milk and eggs on her way home.","translation":"冰箱上的便利貼提醒她回家路上要買牛奶和雞蛋。","explanation":"名詞「提醒物」。常用片語 serve as a reminder。"},{"sentence":"The teacher sent a friendly <target>reminder</target> to all students via email, reminding them that the final project was due next Friday.","translation":"老師透過電子郵件向所有學生發送了一封友好的提醒信，提醒他們期末專題在下週五截止。","explanation":"名詞「提醒信」。"}],"related_forms":["remind"]}

{"headword":"removal","explanation":"名詞「移除、除去」。指將某物移走或去掉的動作。常用搭配 removal of (移除...)；removal service (搬家公司/清除服務)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>removal</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the old, broken playground equipment was necessary to ensure the safety of the children playing there.","translation":"移除舊的、損壞的遊樂場設備對於確保在那裡玩耍的孩子們的安全是必要的。","explanation":"名詞「移除」。常用搭配 removal of sth。"},{"sentence":"After moving to a new city, the family hired a professional <target>removal</target> <pattern>company</pattern> to help them transport their furniture and belongings.","translation":"搬到新城市後，這家人雇了一家專業的搬家公司來幫助他們運輸家具和財產。","explanation":"名詞「搬遷/移除」。removal company 是英式英語中常見的搬家公司稱呼。"}],"related_forms":["remove"]}

{"headword":"render","explanation":"動詞「使成為、使得」；「提供（幫助/服務）」；「翻譯/表達」。在 GSAT 中最常考的是 render + 受詞 + 形容詞 (使...變得...)。注意 render 與 make 的區別：render 通常用於較正式的語境，且常接負面或狀態的改變。","entries":[{"sentence":"The heavy rain and strong winds <target>rendered</target> the mountain road impassable, forcing the rescue team to use helicopters.","translation":"暴雨和強風使得山路無法通行，迫使救援隊使用直升機。","explanation":"動詞「使成為」。常用結構：render + 受詞 + 形容詞 (impassable)。"},{"sentence":"The government is ready to <target>render</target> <pattern>assistance</pattern> <pattern>to</pattern> the victims of the flood, providing food, water, and temporary shelter.","translation":"政府準備向洪水災民提供援助，提供食物、水和臨時避難所。","explanation":"動詞「提供」。常用搭配 render assistance/aid to someone。"},{"sentence":"The translator worked hard to <target>render</target> the complex poem <pattern>into</pattern> English while keeping its original emotion and meaning.","translation":"翻譯員努力將這首複雜的詩翻譯成英文，同時保留其原始的情感和意義。","explanation":"動詞「翻譯」。常用搭配 render sth into another language。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"rental","explanation":"名詞「租金、租賃」；形容詞「租賃的」。常用搭配 rental car (租賃車)、rental fee (租金)。注意 rental 與 rent 的區別：rent 可作動詞(租)或名詞(租金)，而 rental 則較常用作形容詞或指整個租賃過程/租金。","entries":[{"sentence":"Because they didn't have their own car, the tourists decided to pay a daily <target>rental</target> <pattern>fee</pattern> to explore the countryside.","translation":"因為他們沒有自己的車，遊客決定支付每日租金來探索鄉間。","explanation":"名詞「租金」。常用搭配 rental fee。"},{"sentence":"The students looked for a <target>rental</target> <pattern>apartment</pattern> near the university campus to save time and money on commuting.","translation":"學生們在大學校園附近尋找租賃公寓，以節省通勤的時間和金錢。","explanation":"形容詞「租賃的」。常用搭配 rental apartment/house。"},{"sentence":"The <target>rental</target> <pattern>agreement</pattern> clearly states that the tenant must pay the rent on the first day of every month.","translation":"租賃協議明確規定租客必須在每個月的第一天支付租金。","explanation":"名詞「租賃 (過程/協議)」。常用搭配 rental agreement。"}],"related_forms":["rent"]}

{"headword":"repay","explanation":"動詞「償還；報答」。指將借來的錢還給對方，或以好的行為回報對方的恩情。常用搭配 repay the debt (償還債務), repay someone for something (因某事而報答某人)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After working part-time for a year, the student was finally able to <target>repay</target> the loan he had borrowed from his parents for college tuition.","translation":"在打工一年後，這位學生終於能夠償還他為了大學學費向父母借的貸款。","explanation":"動詞「償還」。指還錢。"},{"sentence":"She promised to <target>repay</target> her friend <pattern>for</pattern> the kindness she had shown during the difficult times of her illness.","translation":"她承諾要報答朋友在她生病困難時期所表現出的善意。","explanation":"動詞「報答」。常用搭配 repay someone for something。"}],"related_forms":["repayment"]}

{"headword":"republican","explanation":"名詞「共和主義者」；形容詞「共和制的」。指支持共和制度（非君主制）的人或與共和制相關的事物。在美國政治語境中，常指共和黨員 (Republican Party)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The historian explained that the <target>republican</target> system of government allows citizens to elect their leaders rather than inheriting power from a king.","translation":"歷史學家解釋說，共和制政府系統允許公民選舉他們的領導者，而不是從國王那裡繼承權力。","explanation":"形容詞「共和制的」。指政府形式。"},{"sentence":"As a committed <target>republican</target>, he believes that the power of the state should be limited to protect individual liberties and rights.","translation":"作為一名堅定的共和主義者，他認為國家權力應受到限制，以保護個人的自由與權利。","explanation":"名詞「共和主義者」。指持有共和主義政治觀點的人。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"resemblance","explanation":"名詞「相似之處」。常用搭配 bear a resemblance to (與...相似)。注意與 similar (adj.) 和 resemble (v.) 的區別：resemblance 是名詞形式，常用於描述外貌或特質的相似度。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many people noticed a striking <target>resemblance</target> <pattern>between</pattern> the two sisters, although they were born in different years.","translation":"許多人注意到這對姐妹之間有著驚人的相似之處，儘管她們出生在不同的年份。","explanation":"名詞「相似之處」。常用搭配 resemblance between A and B。"},{"sentence":"The new model of the smartphone <pattern>bears</pattern> a close <target>resemblance</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the previous version, with only a few minor changes in design.","translation":"這款新型手機與前一個版本非常相似，僅在設計上有少許微小改動。","explanation":"名詞「相似之處」。常用片語 bear a resemblance to (與...相似)。"}],"related_forms":["resemble"]}

{"headword":"reservoir","explanation":"名詞「水庫；儲藏室」。最常用於指人工蓄水池以供應城市用水或發電。在生物學或醫學中，也可指病原體的宿主或儲藏場所。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the severe drought, the water level in the city's main <target>reservoir</target> dropped significantly, leading to water restrictions for all residents.","translation":"在嚴重的乾旱期間，城市主要水庫的水位顯著下降，導致所有居民面臨用水限制。","explanation":"名詞「水庫」。指人工蓄水池。"},{"sentence":"The engineers designed a massive <target>reservoir</target> in the mountains to collect rainwater and provide a steady supply of water to the nearby farms.","translation":"工程師在山區設計了一個巨大的水庫，以收集雨水並為附近的農場提供穩定的水源。","explanation":"名詞「水庫」。"}],"related_forms":["reservoirs"]}

{"headword":"residence","explanation":"名詞「住宅；居住地」。指某人居住的房屋或地點。注意與 resident (n. 居民) 的區別：residence 強調的是建築物或地點本身，而 resident 強調的是住在在那裡的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The governor's official <target>residence</target> is a historic mansion located in the center of the capital city, where he hosts foreign diplomats.","translation":"州長的官方官邸是一座位於首都中心、具有歷史意義的豪宅，他在那裡接待外國外交官。","explanation":"名詞「住宅、官邸」。指居住的建築物。"},{"sentence":"After living abroad for several years, the artist decided to establish her permanent <target>residence</target> in a small village in the south of Taiwan.","translation":"在國外生活了幾年後，這位藝術家決定在台灣南部的一個小村莊建立她的永久居所。","explanation":"名詞「居住地」。指居住的地方。"}],"related_forms":["residential","resident"]}

{"headword":"resident","explanation":"名詞「居民」；形容詞「居住的」。名詞用法指住在某處的人。形容詞用法指固定居住在某處的，或在醫院實習的住院醫師 (resident physician)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The local <target>residents</target> expressed their concerns about the noise pollution caused by the new shopping mall being built in their neighborhood.","translation":"當地居民對在他們社區建造新購物中心所造成的噪音污染表示擔憂。","explanation":"名詞「居民」。指住在該地區的人。"},{"sentence":"After completing her medical degree, she spent three years as a <target>resident</target> in the cardiology department of a large city hospital.","translation":"在完成醫學學位後，她在一家大城市醫院的心臟科擔任住院醫師三年。","explanation":"名詞「住院醫師」。特指醫療體系中的實習醫師。"},{"sentence":"The hotel offers a <target>resident</target> chef who specializes in traditional French cuisine, providing guests with high-quality meals throughout their stay.","translation":"這家飯店提供一名駐店主廚，專精於傳統法國料理，為入住客提供高品質的餐點。","explanation":"形容詞「居住的、駐店的」。指固定在該處的人。"}],"related_forms":["residence","residential"]}

{"headword":"residential","explanation":"形容詞「住宅的；居住區的」。常用於描述地區 (residential area) 或建築物，用以區分於商業區 (commercial area) 或工業區 (industrial area)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city council decided to protect the <target>residential</target> <pattern>area</pattern> by limiting the number of commercial stores that could open in the neighborhood.","translation":"市議會決定透過限制在該社區可開設的商業商店數量來保護住宅區。","explanation":"形容詞「住宅的」。常用搭配：residential area (住宅區)。"},{"sentence":"Because the street is located in a <target>residential</target> district, drivers are encouraged to slow down to ensure the safety of children playing outside.","translation":"由於這條街道位於住宅區，因此鼓勵駕駛者減速，以確保在外面玩耍的孩子們的安全。","explanation":"形容詞「住宅的」。"}],"related_forms":["residence","resident"]}

{"headword":"resort","explanation":"名詞「度假勝地」；動詞「採取 (最後手段)」。名詞用法最常見。動詞用法時，常搭配 to (resort to sth)，表示在其他方法都失敗後，採取某種不理想的手段。","entries":[{"sentence":"The couple decided to spend their honeymoon at a luxury beach <target>resort</target> in the Maldives, where they could relax and enjoy the sun.","translation":"這對夫妻決定在馬爾地夫的一家豪華海濱度假勝地度過蜜月，在那裡他們可以放鬆並享受陽光。","explanation":"名詞「度假勝地」。指提供休閒設施的場所。"},{"sentence":"When the peaceful negotiations failed, the government was forced to <target>resort</target> <pattern>to</pattern> military force to regain control of the region.","translation":"當和平談判失敗後，政府被迫採取武力手段以重新掌控該地區。","explanation":"動詞片語 resort to sth (採取...作為手段)。通常指採取不理想或極端的方法。"},{"sentence":"If you cannot solve the problem through communication, do not <target>resort</target> <pattern>to</pattern> shouting, as it will only make the situation worse.","translation":"如果你無法透過溝通解決問題，不要採取大聲叫喊的手段，因為這只會讓情況變得更糟。","explanation":"動詞片語 resort to sth。指在無奈之下採取某種行為。"}],"related_forms":["resorts"]}

{"headword": "respondent", "explanation": "名詞「受訪者；被告」。在社會調查、研究或問卷中，s指回答問題的人 (respondent)。在法律語境中，指對抗訴或上訴提出回應的人 (被告/被上訴人)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The survey found that the majority <pattern>of</pattern> <target>respondents</target> preferred online shopping to traditional stores because of the convenience and lower prices.", "translation": "調查發現，大多數受訪者比起傳統商店更喜歡就喜歡網購，因為其便利性和較低的價格。", "explanation": "名詞「受訪者」。指回答問問卷的人。"}, {"sentence": "The lawyer carefully reviewed the <target>respondent</target>'s written statement before presenting the arguments to the judge in the court case.", "translation": "律師在將論點提交給法官之前，仔細審閱了被告的書面陳述。", "explanation": "名詞「被告」。法律術語。"}], "related_forms": ["respond", "response"]}

{"headword":"resume","explanation":"動詞「恢復；重新開始」；名詞「履歷」。動詞發音與名詞不同 (rɪˈzjuːm vs ˈrɛzjuːmeɪ)。動詞常用於指活動或會議在暫停後重新開始。名詞指申請工作時提交的文書。","entries":[{"sentence":"After a short break for lunch, the committee will <target>resume</target> the meeting at 2 p.m. to discuss the final details of the project.","translation":"午餐短暫休息後，委員會將於下午兩點恢復會議，以討論計畫的最終細節。","explanation":"動詞「恢復」。指在暫停後重新開始。"},{"sentence":"The athlete was able to <target>resume</target> his training schedule after recovering from a serious knee injury that had kept him out for months.","translation":"這位運動員在從嚴重的膝蓋傷勢中恢復後，能夠恢復他的訓練計畫。","explanation":"動詞「恢復」。"},{"sentence":"The job applicant spent several hours updating his <target>resume</target> to highlight his academic achievements and relevant work experience for the position.","translation":"求職者花了好幾個小時更新他的履歷，以突出他在該職位相關的學術成就和工作經驗。","explanation":"名詞「履歷」。注意發音與動詞不同。"}],"related_forms":["resumption"]}

{"headword":"retail","explanation":"名詞、形容詞或動詞。名詞指「零售業」；形容詞指「零售的」；動詞指「零售」。注意其與 wholesale (批發) 的對比。常見搭配為 retail price (零售價) 或 retail therapy (零售治療/購物紓壓)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many small businesses struggle to compete with online <target>retail</target> giants who can offer lower prices and faster delivery services.","translation":"許多小型企業難以與能夠提供更低價格和更快配送服務的線上零售巨頭競爭。","explanation":"名詞「零售業」。"},{"sentence":"The store offers a significant discount on the <target>retail</target> <pattern>price</pattern> for students who purchase the textbook during the first week of school.","translation":"對於在開學第一週購買教科書的學生，該商店提供零售價的顯著折扣。","explanation":"形容詞「零售的」。常用搭配：retail price (零售價)。"},{"sentence":"Some companies choose to <target>retail</target> their products <pattern>through</pattern> a network of independent boutiques to maintain a high-end brand image.","translation":"有些公司選擇透過獨立精品店網絡來零售其產品，以維持高端品牌形象。","explanation":"動詞「零售」。常用搭配：retail through sth。"},{"sentence":"After a stressful week of exams, Sarah decided to engage in some <target>retail</target> <pattern>therapy</pattern> by buying a new dress and some shoes.","translation":"經過壓力巨大的考試週後，莎拉決定透過購買一件新洋裝和一些鞋子來進行購物紓壓。","explanation":"名詞「零售」。常用搭配：retail therapy (購物紓壓)。"}],"related_forms":["retailer","retailing"]}

{"headword":"revenue","explanation":"名詞，意為「收入」或「稅收」。通常指公司、政府或組織從銷售商品或提供服務中獲得的總額，而非個人薪水 (salary)。常用搭配為 generate revenue (產生收入) 或 tax revenue (稅收)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city government is looking for new ways to increase tax <target>revenue</target> to fund the construction of a new public library and park.","translation":"市政府正在尋找增加稅收的新方法，以為新建的公共圖書館和公園提供資金。","explanation":"名詞「稅收」。常用搭配：tax revenue。"},{"sentence":"The company's annual <target>revenue</target> <pattern>increased</pattern> significantly after they launched a successful marketing campaign targeting young adults.","translation":"在推出針對年輕人的成功行銷活動後，該公司的年度收入顯著增加。","explanation":"名詞「收入」。常用動詞搭配：increase, decrease, generate。"},{"sentence":"Tourism provides a major source of <target>revenue</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the small island nation, supporting thousands of local jobs and businesses.","translation":"觀光業為這個小島國提供了主要的收入來源，支持了數千個當地工作崗位和企業。","explanation":"名詞「收入」。常用搭配：source of revenue (收入來源)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"reverse","explanation":"動詞「反轉、撤回」；形容詞「相反的」；名詞「反面」。動詞常用於 reverse a decision (撤銷決定) 或 reverse a car (倒車)。形容詞常指 opposite (相反的) 或 backward (向後的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The judge decided to <target>reverse</target> the previous <pattern>decision</pattern> after new evidence came to light, allowing the defendant to be released.","translation":"在證據揭露後，法官決定撤銷之前的決定，允許被告獲釋。","explanation":"動詞「撤銷、反轉」。常用搭配 reverse a decision/judgment。"},{"sentence":"The driver carefully <target>reversed</target> the car <pattern>into</pattern> the narrow parking space, making sure not to hit the curb.","translation":"駕駛小心地將車倒進狹窄的停車位，確保沒有撞到路緣。","explanation":"動詞「倒車」。常用搭配 reverse into sth。"},{"sentence":"In a <target>reverse</target> <pattern>order</pattern>, the students were asked to list the events of the story from the end to the beginning.","translation":"學生們被要求以相反的順序，將故事的事件從結尾列到開頭。","explanation":"形容詞「相反的」。常用搭配：reverse order (相反順序)。"},{"sentence":"The <target>reverse</target> <pattern>side</pattern> of the coin shows the national emblem, while the front side features the portrait of the former president.","translation":"硬幣的反面顯示著國家徽章，而正面則是前任總統的肖像。","explanation":"名詞「反面」。常用搭配：reverse side (反面)。"}],"related_forms":["reversal","reversible"]}

{"headword":"rhetoric","explanation":"名詞，意為「修辭學」或「花俏但缺乏實質內容的言論」。在 GSAT 中，常指演講者使用技巧來影響聽眾，有時帶有負面含義，指其言論空洞。","entries":[{"sentence":"The politician's speech was full of powerful <target>rhetoric</target>, but many voters felt it lacked a clear and practical plan for the future.","translation":"這位政治家的演講充滿了強而有力的修辭，但許多選民覺得它缺乏一個清晰且實用的未來計畫。","explanation":"名詞「修辭、花俏的言論」。指使用技巧來吸引聽眾。"},{"sentence":"In the advanced English class, students are learning how to use <target>rhetoric</target> <pattern>to</pattern> persuade their audience more effectively in a debate.","translation":"在高級英語課中，學生們正在學習如何使用修辭來在辯論中更有效地說服聽眾。","explanation":"名詞「修辭學」。指說話或寫作的藝術和技巧。"}],"related_forms":["rhetorical","rhetorician"]}

{"headword":"rib","explanation":"名詞「肋骨」；動詞「開玩笑地揶揄」。名詞用法最為常見，指人體或建築物、飛機機翼的支撐結構。","entries":[{"sentence":"The athlete suffered a broken <target>rib</target> after a heavy collision during the football match, forcing him to miss several games.","translation":"這名運動員在足球比賽中一次劇烈碰撞後肋骨骨折，導致他缺席了數場比賽。","explanation":"名詞「肋骨」。"},{"sentence":"His friends often <target>ribbed</target> him <pattern>about</pattern> his terrible singing voice, but he always took the jokes in good spirits.","translation":"他的朋友們經常拿他糟糕的歌聲開玩笑，但他總是以豁達的心態面對這些玩笑。","explanation":"動詞「揶揄、開玩笑」。常用搭配：rib someone about something。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"ridge","explanation":"名詞「山脊、隆起處」；動詞「使隆起」。最常見於描述地理景觀或某些物體的表面特徵。","entries":[{"sentence":"The hikers climbed slowly up the mountain <target>ridge</target>, enjoying the breathtaking view of the valley stretching below them.","translation":"登山者緩慢地爬上山脊，欣賞著下方延伸的谷底那令人屏息的美景。","explanation":"名詞「山脊」。"},{"sentence":"The geologist pointed out the sharp <target>ridge</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the rock formation, explaining how it was created by glaciers thousands of years ago.","translation":"地質學家指出岩石構造的鋒利山脊，解釋它是數千年前由冰河創造的。","explanation":"名詞「隆起處」。常用搭配：ridge of sth。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"ridiculous","explanation":"形容詞，意為「荒謬的、可笑的」。常用於描述極端不合理或令人發笑的情況。注意與 absurd 的同義。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is absolutely <target>ridiculous</target> <pattern>to</pattern> expect a student to memorize an entire dictionary in one week without any help.","translation":"期望一個學生在沒有任何幫助的情況下，在一週內背誦整本字典，簡直是荒謬至極。","explanation":"形容詞「荒謬的」。常用結構：It is ridiculous to V。"},{"sentence":"The movie's plot was so <target>ridiculous</target> that the audience couldn't stop laughing throughout the whole film.","translation":"這部電影的劇情如此荒謬，以至於觀眾在整場電影中都忍不住大笑。","explanation":"形容詞「可笑的」。"}],"related_forms":["ridicule","ridiculously"]}

{"headword":"rifle","explanation":"名詞「步槍」；動詞「翻找」。名詞指一種長槍，而動詞用法在閱讀理解中常指在某人的東西中快速且雜亂地搜尋東西（通常是為了偷竊）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The soldier was trained to clean and maintain his <target>rifle</target> daily to ensure it functioned perfectly during field exercises.","translation":"士兵接受訓練每天清潔和維護他的步槍，以確保它在野外演習期間能完美運作。","explanation":"名詞「步槍」。"},{"sentence":"The thief <target>rifled</target> <pattern>through</pattern> the woman's handbag, quickly searching for a wallet or any other valuable items.","translation":"小偷在女人的手提包中翻找，快速搜尋錢包或其他任何有價值的物品。","explanation":"動詞「翻找」。常用搭配：rifle through sth。"}],"related_forms":["rifled","rifling"]}

{"headword":"rigid","explanation":"形容詞，意為「僵硬的、嚴格的」。可用於描述物理上的僵硬（不能彎曲）或規則、思考方式的僵硬（不靈活）。常用搭配為 rigid rules (嚴格的規則) 或 rigid schedule (僵硬的行程)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company's <target>rigid</target> <pattern>rules</pattern> regarding attendance make it difficult for employees to handle unexpected family emergencies.","translation":"公司關於出勤的嚴格規則使得員工很難處理意外的家庭緊急狀況。","explanation":"形容詞「嚴格的」。常用搭配：rigid rules/regulations。"},{"sentence":"The old wooden bridge was not <target>rigid</target> enough to support the weight of the heavy trucks passing over it.","translation":"這座舊木橋不夠堅固（僵硬），無法承受經過其上的重型卡車的重量。","explanation":"形容詞「僵硬的」。物理上的不能彎曲或不穩固。"},{"sentence":"Some people have a <target>rigid</target> <pattern>mindset</pattern>, refusing to consider any new ideas or alternative perspectives on a problem.","translation":"有些人擁有僵硬的心態，拒絕考慮任何新想法或問題的替代視角。","explanation":"形容詞「僵硬的」。指思考方式不靈活。"}],"related_forms":["rigidity","rigidly"]}

{"headword":"rim","explanation":"名詞「邊緣」；動詞「裝飾邊緣」。名詞用法最常見，指圓形物體（如杯子、輪胎、眼鏡）的邊緣。","entries":[{"sentence":"The coffee cup had a gold <target>rim</target> <pattern>around</pattern> its edge, making it look elegant and sophisticated.","translation":"咖啡杯的邊緣有一圈金邊，使其看起來優雅且精緻。","explanation":"名詞「邊緣」。"},{"sentence":"The basketball player jumped high and managed to slam the ball <pattern>into</pattern> the <target>rim</target> of the basket.","translation":"這名籃球員跳得很高，並成功將球扣進籃框的邊緣。","explanation":"名詞「籃框邊緣」。"},{"sentence":"The designer decided to <target>rim</target> the mirror <pattern>with</pattern> small, sparkling diamonds to create a luxurious feel.","translation":"設計師決定用小而閃亮的鑽石來裝飾鏡子的邊緣，以創造一種奢華感。","explanation":"動詞「裝飾邊緣」。常用搭配：rim sth with sth。"}],"related_forms":["rims"]}

{"headword":"riot","explanation":"名詞「暴動」，動詞「發起暴動」。指一群人因憤怒或不滿而集體採取暴力行為。注意其名詞用法中也有「極其華麗/色彩繽紛」的引申義 (a riot of color)，但在 GSAT 中以「暴動」為主。","entries":[{"sentence":"The peaceful protest quickly turned into a <target>riot</target> when the crowd began breaking windows and throwing stones at the police.","translation":"這場和平抗議在人群開始打破窗戶並向警察投擲石頭後，迅速演變成一場暴動。","explanation":"名詞「暴動」。指集體性的暴力行為。"},{"sentence":"Angry citizens <target>rioted</target> in the streets for several days to demand better living conditions and fair treatment from the government.","translation":"憤怒的公民在街道上暴動了數天，以要求政府提供更好的生活條件和公平的待遇。","explanation":"動詞「發起暴動」。"},{"sentence":"The police used tear gas to control the <target>riot</target> and prevent the protesters from entering the government buildings.","translation":"警方使用催淚瓦斯來控制暴動，防止抗議者進入政府大樓。","explanation":"名詞「暴動」。常用搭配：control the riot。"}],"related_forms":["rioter","rioting"]}

{"headword":"rip","explanation":"動詞「撕裂、扯破」，名詞「裂縫、撕破處」。常用於描述布料、紙張或皮膚被強行撕開。注意其動詞片語 rip off (敲竹槓/剽竊) 在口語中極為常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"While playing soccer, the boy accidentally <target>ripped</target> his pants when he fell hard on the grass during the game.","translation":"在踢足球時，這個男孩在比賽中重重地摔在草地上，不小心把褲子撕破了。","explanation":"動詞「撕裂」。指布料被扯破。"},{"sentence":"She noticed a small <target>rip</target> in her favorite dress and decided to sew it before wearing it to the party.","translation":"她注意到她最喜歡的洋裝上有一道小裂縫，決定在穿去參加派對之前將其縫好。","explanation":"名詞「裂縫」。指布料上的破損處。"},{"sentence":"The tourist felt that the street vendor <target>ripped</target> him <pattern>off</pattern> by charging twice the normal price for a simple souvenir.","translation":"這名遊客覺得路邊攤販敲他竹槓，將一個簡單的紀念品開價為正常價格的兩倍。","explanation":"動詞片語 rip off 表示「敲竹槓」。"}],"related_forms":["ripped"]}

{"headword":"risky","explanation":"形容詞「冒險的、有風險的」。指某件事可能會導致不良結果。常用於描述投資、決定或行為，與 safe (安全的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"Investing all your savings into a single company is a <target>risky</target> <pattern>move</pattern>, as you could lose everything if the company fails.","translation":"將所有積蓄投資於一家公司是一個冒險的舉動，因為如果公司失敗，你可能會失去一切。","explanation":"形容詞「冒險的」。常用搭配：risky move (冒險的舉動)。"},{"sentence":"The mountain climber decided not to attempt the summit during the storm because the weather conditions were too <target>risky</target>.","translation":"登山者決定在風暴期間不嘗試登頂，因為天氣條件太危險了。","explanation":"形容詞「有風險的」。"},{"sentence":"Some people believe that taking a <target>risky</target> <pattern>bet</pattern> can sometimes lead to great success, though most of the time it leads to failure.","translation":"有些人認為採取冒險的賭注有時會帶來巨大的成功，儘管大多數時候它會導致失敗。","explanation":"形容詞「冒險的」。常用搭配：risky bet (冒險的賭注)。"}],"related_forms":["risk"]}
