{"headword":"ritual","explanation":"名詞「儀式、慣例」，形容詞「儀式性的」。指一種重複的、固定程序的事物。可用於宗教活動或個人日常習慣（如晨間儀式）。","entries":[{"sentence":"In many cultures, the tea ceremony is a sacred <target>ritual</target> that symbolizes respect and friendship between the host and the guests.","translation":"在許多文化中，茶道是一種神聖的儀式，象徵著主人與客人之間的尊重與友誼。","explanation":"名詞「儀式」。指宗教或傳統的固定程序。"},{"sentence":"Drinking a cup of warm lemon water every morning has become a daily <target>ritual</target> for her to start the day with energy.","translation":"每天早上喝一杯溫檸檬水已成為她開啟活力一天的日常慣例。","explanation":"名詞「慣例」。指個人生活中重複的習慣。"},{"sentence":"The students performed a <target>ritualistic</target> dance during the school festival to honor their ancestors and preserve their traditional heritage.","translation":"學生們在學校祭典期間跳了一場儀式性的舞蹈，以向祖先致敬並保存他們的傳統遺產。","explanation":"形容詞「儀式性的」。由 ritual 衍生的形容詞形式 ritualistic。"}],"related_forms":["ritualistic","ritually"]}

{"headword":"rival","explanation":"名詞「競爭對手」，形容詞「競爭的」，動詞「與...競爭/比肩」。常用於商業、體育或政治競爭。注意 rival (adj.) 常指兩者程度相當。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two tech companies have been fierce <target>rivals</target> for years, constantly trying to release better smartphones than the other.","translation":"這兩家科技公司多年來一直是激烈的競爭對手，不斷嘗試推出比對方更好的智慧型手機。","explanation":"名詞「競爭對手」。"},{"sentence":"The team faced a <target>rival</target> <pattern>school</pattern> in the final basketball game, and the atmosphere in the gym was incredibly tense.","translation":"該隊在最後一場籃球賽中面對競爭學校，體育館內的氣氛異常緊張。","explanation":"形容詞「競爭的」。常用搭配：rival school (競爭學校)。"},{"sentence":"The beauty of the Swiss Alps is said to <target>rival</target> that of the Himalayas, offering breathtaking views of snow-capped peaks.","translation":"瑞士阿爾卑斯山的壯麗之美被認為能與喜馬拉雅山比肩，提供雪山巔峰的驚人美景。","explanation":"動詞「比肩/競爭」。指程度或品質相當。"}],"related_forms":["rivalry"]}

{"headword":"rod","explanation":"名詞「桿子、棒子」。通常指細長且堅硬的物件。常見於釣魚 (fishing rod) 或生物學 (rod-shaped bacteria 桿菌)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The old man spent his Sunday mornings by the river, holding his <target>fishing</target> <target>rod</target> and waiting patiently for a fish to bite.","translation":"那位老先生在週日早晨待在河邊，拿著他的釣竿，耐心地等待魚兒上鉤。","explanation":"名詞「桿子」。常用搭配：fishing rod (釣竿)。"},{"sentence":"The curtain <target>rod</target> was made of polished brass, adding a touch of elegance to the bedroom's simple decoration.","translation":"窗簾桿是用拋光黃銅製成的，為臥室的簡單裝飾增添了一抹優雅。","explanation":"名詞「桿子」。指支撐窗簾的金屬桿。"},{"sentence":"In biology class, the teacher explained that some bacteria are <target>rod</target>-shaped, meaning they look like small, thin cylinders.","translation":"在生物課上，老師解釋說某些細菌是桿狀的，意思是它們看起來像小型且纖細的圓柱體。","explanation":"名詞「桿子」。在此處作為形容詞使用，描述形狀。"}],"related_forms":["rods"]}

{"headword":"sacred","explanation":"形容詞「神聖的」。指與宗教、神靈或受高度尊重的事物相關。常用於描述地點 (sacred site) 或承諾 (sacred vow)。與 profane (世俗的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many pilgrims travel from far away to visit the <target>sacred</target> <pattern>temple</pattern>, believing that praying there will bring them peace and healing.","translation":"許多朝聖者從遠方前來參訪這座神聖的寺廟，相信在那裡祈禱會為他們帶來平安與療癒。","explanation":"形容詞「神聖的」。常用搭配：sacred temple (神聖的寺廟)。"},{"sentence":"For many people, the bond between a mother and her child is considered <target>sacred</target>, and it should never be broken.","translation":"對許多人來說，母親與孩子之間的紐帶被認為是神聖的，絕對不應該被打破。","explanation":"形容詞「神聖的」。在此處指受高度尊重的。"},{"sentence":"The ancient tribe believed that the forest was <target>sacred</target>, so they strictly forbade anyone from cutting down the trees.","translation":"古老的部落相信這片森林是神聖的，因此他們嚴格禁止任何人砍伐樹木。","explanation":"形容詞「神聖的」。"}],"related_forms":["sacredly","sacredness"]}

{"headword":"saddle","explanation":"名詞「馬鞍」，動詞「安裝馬鞍、準備出發」。在現代英語中，saddle 也常用於描述自行車或摩托車的座位。","entries":[{"sentence":"The cowboy carefully placed the leather <target>saddle</target> on the horse's back before starting his long journey across the plains.","translation":"牛仔在開始橫跨平原的漫長旅程前，小心地將皮革馬鞍放在馬背上。","explanation":"名詞「馬鞍」。"},{"sentence":"After cycling for five hours, he felt a sharp pain in his legs and realized his bicycle <target>saddle</target> was not adjusted to the right height.","translation":"騎行五小時後，他感到腿部劇痛，並意識到他的自行車坐墊沒有調整到正確的高度。","explanation":"名詞「馬鞍/坐墊」。指自行車的座位。"},{"sentence":"The farmer decided to <target>saddle</target> his horse and ride to the nearest town to sell his fresh vegetables at the market.","translation":"農夫決定給馬套上馬鞍，騎馬前往最近的鎮上在市場販售他的新鮮蔬菜。","explanation":"動詞「安裝馬鞍」。"}],"related_forms":["saddled"]}

{"headword":"saint","explanation":"名詞「聖人」。指在宗教中被封聖的人，或在日常生活中極其善良、耐心的人。注意聖人 (saint) 與罪人 (sinner) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The cathedral is dedicated to a famous <target>saint</target> who spent his entire life helping the poor and curing the sick in the city.","translation":"這座大教堂是獻給一位著名的聖人，他一生致力於幫助窮人並治療城裡的病人。","explanation":"名詞「聖人」。指宗教上的封聖者。"},{"sentence":"My mother is a complete <target>saint</target> for putting up with my rebellious teenage years without ever losing her temper.","translation":"我的母親真是個聖人，因為她忍受了我叛逆的青春期而從未發脾氣。","explanation":"名詞「聖人」。比喻極其善良、有耐心的人。"},{"sentence":"The historian studied the lives of various <target>saints</target> to understand the social and religious beliefs of the Middle Ages.","translation":"歷史學家研究了多位聖人的生活，以理解中世紀的社會與宗教信仰。","explanation":"名詞「聖人」。"}],"related_forms":["saintly","sainthood"]}

{"headword": "salmon", "explanation": "名詞「鮭魚」。注意其發音中 'l' 不發音 (silent l)，讀作 /'sæmən/。此外，salmon 也可用作形容詞來描述一種淡粉色 (salmon pink)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Every year, <target>salmon</target> swim thousands of miles from the ocean back to the rivers where they were born to lay their eggs.", "translation": "每年，鮭魚從海洋游回它們出生地所在的河流，游行數千英里以產卵。", "explanation": "名詞「鮭魚」。"}, {"sentence": "The chef recommended the grilled <target>salmon</target> with lemon and butter, claiming it was the healthiest and most delicious dish on the menu.", "translation": "主廚推薦了搭配檸檬和奶油的烤鮭魚，聲稱這是菜單上最健康且最美味的料理。", "explanation": "名詞「鮭魚」。"}, {"sentence": "She chose a <target>salmon</target> <pattern>pink</pattern> dress for the spring party, as the soft color matched her skin tone perfectly.", "translation": "她為春季派對選擇了一件鮭魚粉色的洋裝，因為這種柔和的顏色與她的膚色完美契合。", "explanation": "形容詞「鮭魚色的」。常用搭配：salmon pink。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "salon", "explanation": "名詞「美髮沙龍；沙龍」。指提供美髮、美甲或護膚服務的場所，或指過去歐洲流行的一種社交聚會場所。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many women visit a hair <target>salon</target> once a month to get their hair cut or colored to maintain their appearance.", "translation": "許多女性每個月會去一次美髮沙龍剪頭髮或染髮，以維持外貌。", "explanation": "名詞「美髮沙龍」。"}, {"sentence": "The new nail <target>salon</target> in the shopping mall offers various services, including manicures and pedicures, to attract more young customers.", "translation": "購物中心裡的新美甲沙龍提供多種服務，包括修指甲和修腳趾甲，以吸引更多年輕顧客。", "explanation": "名詞「美髮/美甲沙龍」。"}, {"sentence": "In the 18th century, the <target>salon</target> was an important place for intellectuals and artists to gather and discuss new philosophical ideas.", "translation": "在18世紀，沙龍是知識分子和藝術家聚集並討論新哲學思想的重要場所。", "explanation": "名詞「社交沙龍」。指歷史上歐洲上流社會的社交聚會。"}, {"sentence": "Famous thinkers often attended these literary <target>salons</target> to exchange their newest theories and debate the social issues of their time.", "translation": "著名的思想家經常參加這些文學沙龍，以交換他們最新的理論並辯論當時的社會問題。", "explanation": "名詞「社交沙龍」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "sandal", "explanation": "名詞「涼鞋」。通常指露趾、露跟且由皮帶固定在腳上的鞋類。", "entries": [{"sentence": "During the hot summer months, students prefer wearing <target>sandals</target> to keep their feet cool and comfortable while walking around campus.", "translation": "在炎熱的夏季，學生更喜歡穿涼鞋，以便在校園內行走時保持雙腳涼爽舒適。", "explanation": "名詞「涼鞋」。常用複數形式 sandals。"}, {"sentence": "She bought a pair of high-quality leather <target>sandals</target> for her long beach vacation, as they are easy to put on and take off.", "translation": "她為她的長假海邊度假買了一雙高品質的皮涼鞋，因為它們很容易穿脫。", "explanation": "名詞「涼鞋」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"scan","explanation":"動詞「快速瀏覽；掃描」；名詞「掃描；快速瀏覽」。注意 scan v. 在閱讀時是指快速找出關鍵資訊，而在醫療或科技時是指使用設備進行掃描。","entries":[{"sentence":"Instead of reading the whole article, the student decided to <target>scan</target> the text <pattern>for</pattern> specific keywords to find the answer quickly.","translation":"這名學生決定快速瀏覽文本以尋找特定關鍵字，而不是閱讀整篇文章，以便快速找到答案。","explanation":"動詞「快速瀏覽」。常用搭配 scan for sth。"},{"sentence":"The hospital used a high-resolution <target>scan</target> to examine the patient's brain and identify the cause of the sudden headache.","translation":"醫院使用高解析度掃描來檢查患者的大腦，並找出突然頭痛的原因。","explanation":"名詞「掃描」。指醫療影像檢查。"},{"sentence":"Please <target>scan</target> the QR code on the poster to register for the upcoming school seminar and receive more information.","translation":"請掃描海報上的QR code以註冊參加即將舉行的學校研討會並獲取更多資訊。","explanation":"動詞「掃描」。指使用設備讀取資訊。"}],"related_forms":["scanner","scanning"]}

{"headword": "scandal", "explanation": "名詞「醜聞」。指引起公眾憤怒或反感的事項，通常與政治、金錢或道德問題相關。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The politician's career was ruined after a major financial <target>scandal</target> involving illegal donations was revealed by the press.", "translation": "在媒體揭露了一起涉及非法捐款的重大財務醜聞後，這位政治家的職業生涯毀了。", "explanation": "名詞「醜聞」。常用搭配 financial scandal (財務醜聞)。"}, {"sentence": "The school board investigated the <target>scandal</target> regarding the unfair distribution of scholarships to ensure fairness for all students.", "translation": "學校董事會調查了關於獎學金分配不公的醜聞，以確保所有學生的公平性。", "explanation": "名詞「醜聞」。"}, {"sentence": "The company's reputation suffered greatly after the CEO <pattern>caused</pattern> a <target>scandal</target> by leaking confidential client information to the public.", "translation": "在執行長洩露客戶機密資訊給公眾後引起了一場醜聞，公司的聲譽受到了極大的損害。", "explanation": "名詞「醜聞」。常用搭配 cause a scandal。"}, {"sentence": "The famous actor was <pattern>embroiled</pattern> <pattern>in</pattern> a <target>scandal</target> over his personal life, which led to several brands ending their contracts with him.", "translation": "這位著名演員捲入了關於其私人生活的醜聞，導致幾個品牌終止了與他的合約。", "explanation": "名詞「醜聞」。常用搭配 be embroiled in a scandal。"}], "related_forms": ["scandalous", "scandalized"]}

{"headword": "scar", "explanation": "名詞「疤痕」；動詞「留下疤痕；使受創」。指身體上的傷口癒合後的痕跡，或心理上的創傷。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The survivor of the accident had a long <target>scar</target> <pattern>on</pattern> his arm, which served as a permanent reminder of the event.", "translation": "事故倖存者的手臂上有一道長長的疤痕，這成了該事件的永久提醒。", "explanation": "名詞「疤痕」。常用搭配 a scar on sth。"}, {"sentence": "After the surgery, the doctor advised the patient to apply a special cream to reduce the <target>scar</target> <pattern>on</pattern> her face.", "translation": "手術後，醫生建議病人塗抹一種特殊的藥膏以減少臉上的疤痕。", "explanation": "名詞「疤痕」。"}, {"sentence": "The experience of being bullied in middle school <target>scarred</target> him <pattern>for life</pattern>, making him struggle with social anxiety for many years.", "translation": "國中時期被霸凌的經驗使他終身受創，使他在多年來一直與社交焦慮鬥爭。", "explanation": "動詞「使受創」。指心理上的創傷。常用搭配 scar for life。"}, {"sentence": "Many children who grow up in war zones are deeply <target>scarred</target> by the violence they witness, requiring long-term psychological support.", "translation": "許多在戰爭地帶長大的孩子被他們目擊的暴力深深地傷害，需要長期的心理支持。", "explanation": "動詞「使受創」。"}], "related_forms": ["scarring"]}

{"headword": "scenario", "explanation": "名詞「情境；劇本」。指可能發生的一種情況或一系列事件的發展過程。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The disaster management team developed several <target>scenarios</target> to prepare for the possibility of a major earthquake in the city.", "translation": "災害管理團隊制定了幾種情境，以準備城市發生重大地震的可能性。", "explanation": "名詞「情境」。指預測可能發生的情況。"}, {"sentence": "In the worst-case <target>scenario</target>, the company might have to close some of its branches if the economic crisis continues.", "translation": "在最糟糕的情況下，如果經濟危機持續，公司可能不得不關閉一些分店。", "explanation": "名詞「情境」。常用搭配 worst-case scenario (最糟糕的情況)。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher asked the students to <pattern>imagine</pattern> a <target>scenario</target> where they had to survive in the wild with only a few tools.", "translation": "老師要求學生想像一種情境，即他們必須僅憑少數工具在野外生存。", "explanation": "名詞「情境」。常用搭配 imagine a scenario。"}, {"sentence": "The most <pattern>plausible</pattern> <target>scenario</target> is that the government will increase taxes to pay for the new infrastructure project.", "translation": "最有可能的情境是政府將增加稅收以支付新的基礎設施項目。", "explanation": "名詞「情境」。常用搭配 plausible scenario。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"scent","explanation":"名詞「氣味；香味」；動詞「嗅出」。通常指一種令人愉快的香味，或指動物追蹤氣味。","entries":[{"sentence":"As she walked through the garden, the sweet <target>scent</target> <pattern>of</pattern> blooming jasmine filled the air, making her feel relaxed.","translation":"當她走過花園時，盛開茉莉花的甜美香味瀰漫在空中，讓她感到放鬆。","explanation":"名詞「氣味；香味」。常用搭配 the scent of sth。"},{"sentence":"The hunting dog followed the <target>scent</target> of the rabbit across the field, eventually finding it hiding in the bushes.","translation":"獵犬在原野上追蹤兔子的氣味，最後發現它躲在灌木叢中。","explanation":"名詞「氣味」。指動物追蹤的氣味。"},{"sentence":"The detective <target>scented</target> a potential clue in the witness's statement, realizing that something was being hidden from him.","translation":"偵探從證人的陳述中嗅到了一絲潛在的線索，意識到有某些事情被隱瞞了。","explanation":"動詞「嗅出」。此處為比喻用法，指察覺到某事。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"scheme","explanation":"名詞「計劃；陰謀」；動詞「策劃」。名詞時可指正式的計劃（如 government scheme），也可指不誠實的陰謀（如 a scheme to cheat）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government introduced a new training <target>scheme</target> to help unemployed youth find suitable jobs in the technology sector.","translation":"政府推出了一項新的培訓計劃，以幫助失業青年在科技領域找到合適的工作。","explanation":"名詞「計劃」。指正式的系統性計劃。"},{"sentence":"The criminal had a complex <target>scheme</target> <pattern>to</pattern> steal the museum's most valuable paintings without being noticed by guards.","translation":"罪犯有一個複雜的陰謀來盜取博物館最珍貴的畫作而不被警衛發現。","explanation":"名詞「陰謀」。指為了不法目的而設計的計劃。"},{"sentence":"He spent weeks <target>scheming</target> <pattern>to</pattern> take over the company from his rivals, using secret agreements and manipulation.","translation":"他花了好幾個星期策劃接管對手公司的權力，利用秘密協議和操縱。","explanation":"動詞「策劃」。常用搭配 scheming to do sth。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "scope", "explanation": "名詞「範圍；幅度」。指討論、研究、活動或權力的涵蓋範圍。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <target>scope</target> <pattern>of</pattern> this research project is limited to students in high school, as we lack the data for university students.", "translation": "這項研究項目的範圍僅限於高中生，因為我們缺乏大學生的數據。", "explanation": "名詞「範圍」。常用搭配 the scope of sth。"}, {"sentence": "The new law provides the police with a broader <target>scope</target> <pattern>of</pattern> authority to investigate cybercrimes and protect online privacy.", "translation": "新法律賦予警方更廣泛的權限範圍來調查網絡犯罪並保護在線隱私。", "explanation": "名詞「權限範圍」。"}, {"sentence": "Discussing the historical background of the entire continent is <pattern>beyond</pattern> the <target>scope</target> <pattern>of</pattern> this brief introductory course.", "translation": "討論整個大陸的歷史背景超出了這門簡短的入門課程的範圍。", "explanation": "名詞「範圍」。常用搭配 beyond the scope of。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"scramble","explanation":"動詞「爭奪；攀爬；倉促行動」；名詞「爭奪；倉促」。常用片語 scramble for (爭奪)。","entries":[{"sentence":"When the discount tickets became available, hundreds of fans <target>scrambled</target> <pattern>for</pattern> them, hoping to see their favorite singer.","translation":"當折扣票開始銷售時，數以百計的粉絲爭奪這些票，希望能看到他們最喜歡的歌手。","explanation":"動詞「爭奪」。常用搭配 scramble for sth。"},{"sentence":"The hikers <target>scrambled</target> up the steep, rocky hillside, using their hands to help them climb the rough terrain.","translation":"登山客在陡峭、多岩石的山坡上攀爬，用手幫助他們在崎嶇的地形中前進。","explanation":"動詞「攀爬」。指不規則地爬行。"},{"sentence":"There was a mad <target>scramble</target> for the last few pieces of cake at the party, as everyone wanted a taste.","translation":"派對上出現了一場瘋狂的爭奪，大家都想嚐嚐最後幾塊蛋糕。","explanation":"名詞「爭奪」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"scrap","explanation":"名詞「碎片、廢料」；動詞「捨棄、取消」。名詞常用於指小的、不完整的碎片（如 scrap of paper）；動詞常用於指取消計畫或捨棄舊物。","entries":[{"sentence":"She wrote her phone number on a small <target>scrap</target> <pattern>of</pattern> paper and handed it to her new friend before leaving the classroom.","translation":"她在一個小紙片上寫下電話號碼，在離開教室前交給了新朋友。","explanation":"名詞「碎片」。常用片語 a scrap of sth (一小塊/片...)。"},{"sentence":"The old car was so damaged after the accident that the owner decided to <target>scrap</target> it and buy a new one.","translation":"那輛舊車在事故後損壞太嚴重，車主決定將其報廢並買一台新的。","explanation":"動詞「捨棄、報廢」。指將舊物分解為廢料。"},{"sentence":"The government decided to <target>scrap</target> the outdated project after realizing it was too expensive and not efficient enough to continue.","translation":"政府在意識到該計畫太昂貴且效率不足以繼續後，決定取消該計畫。","explanation":"動詞「取消」。指捨棄計畫或想法。"}],"related_forms":["scraps"]}

{"headword":"script","explanation":"名詞「劇本、腳本、手寫體」；動詞「編寫腳本」。在 GSAT 考題中，最常出現的是指電影或戲劇的劇本，或電腦程式的指令腳本。","entries":[{"sentence":"The actors spent several hours reading through the movie <target>script</target> to understand their characters better before the filming began.","translation":"演員們在拍攝開始前花了好幾個小時閱讀電影劇本，以便更好地理解他們的角色。","explanation":"名詞「劇本」。"},{"sentence":"The computer science student wrote a simple <target>script</target> to automate the process of sorting files into different folders on his laptop.","translation":"電腦科學系學生寫了一個簡單的腳本來自動化將筆記型電腦上的檔案分類到不同資料夾的過程。","explanation":"名詞「腳本」。指電腦程式的指令集。"},{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to <target>script</target> the entire scene for the English class play, focusing on natural dialogue and emotional depth.","translation":"老師要求學生為英文課的校園劇編寫整個場景的腳本，重點在於自然的對話和情感深度。","explanation":"動詞「編寫腳本」。"}],"related_forms":["scripts"]}

{"headword":"sector","explanation":"名詞「部門、扇區」。常用於指經濟、社會或產業的特定部分，例如 public sector (公共部門) 或 agricultural sector (農業部門)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government is trying to encourage more young people to enter the agricultural <target>sector</target> by providing financial support and modern technology.","translation":"政府正試圖透過提供財務支持和現代技術，鼓勵更多年輕人進入農業部門。","explanation":"名詞「部門」。指產業類別。"},{"sentence":"Working in the public <target>sector</target> often provides more job security than working for a private company, although the salary might be lower.","translation":"在公共部門工作通常比在私人公司工作有更好的工作保障，儘管薪水可能較低。","explanation":"名詞「部門」。public sector 指「公共部門」。"},{"sentence":"The city's tourism <target>sector</target> suffered a huge loss during the pandemic, as international travel was restricted for several years.","translation":"該市的旅遊業部門在疫情期間遭受了巨大損失，因為國際旅行被限制了數年。","explanation":"名詞「部門」。"}],"related_forms":["sectors"]}

{"headword":"segment","explanation":"名詞「部分、片段」；動詞「將...分為片段」。常指一個整體中被切分出的特定部分，常用於市場分析或幾何學。","entries":[{"sentence":"The marketing team divided the target audience into different <target>segments</target> based on their age, habits, and preferences to better reach customers.","translation":"行銷團隊根據年齡、習慣和偏好將目標受眾分為不同的片段，以便更好地觸及客戶。","explanation":"名詞「部分/片段」。指市場分眾。"},{"sentence":"He only watched a small <target>segment</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the documentary, but it was enough to make him change his mind about climate change.","translation":"他只看了紀錄片的一小部分，但這足以讓他改變對氣候變遷的看法。","explanation":"名詞「部分/片段」。"},{"sentence":"The software company decided to <target>segment</target> its customer base to provide more personalized services for different types of users.","translation":"該軟體公司決定將其客戶群進行分段，以便為不同類型的使用者提供更個性化的服務。","explanation":"動詞「將...分為片段」。"}],"related_forms":["segmentation"]}

{"headword": "seminar", "explanation": "名詞「研討會」。指一組小規模的學生或專家聚集在一起討論特定主題的教學或學術會議。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The professor invited a guest speaker to lead a <target>seminar</target> <pattern>on</pattern> environmental protection, encouraging students to share their own ideas.", "translation": "教授邀請了一位客座講者來主持一場關於環境保護的研討會，鼓勵學生分享自己的想法。", "explanation": "名詞「研討會」。常用搭配 seminar on + 主題。"}, {"sentence": "After attending the weekend <target>seminar</target>, the students felt more confident about their final research project and knew how to collect data.", "translation": "許多學生參加完週末的研討會後，對他們的期末研究計畫感到更有信心，並且知道如何收集數據。", "explanation": "名詞「研討會」。"}, {"sentence": "The company organized a professional <target>seminar</target> to train employees on the latest software updates and improve their productivity.", "translation": "公司組織了一場專業研討會，以培訓員工使用最新的軟體更新並提高他們的生產力。", "explanation": "名詞「研討會」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "senator", "explanation": "名詞「參議員」。指在參議院（Senate）中擔任職務的代表。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <target>senator</target> gave a powerful speech in the parliament to argue for a new law that would protect the rights of minority groups.", "translation": "這位參議員在議會中發表了一場強而有力的演說，主張通過一項保護少數群體權利的法律。", "explanation": "名詞「參議員」。"}, {"sentence": "Many people gathered outside the government building to hear the <target>senator</target> speak about the current economic crisis and his proposed solutions.", "translation": "許多人聚集在政府大樓外，聽這位參議員談論目前的經濟危機以及他提出的解決方案。", "explanation": "名詞「參議員」。"}, {"sentence": "The newly elected <target>senator</target> promised to focus on improving the public education system and creating more jobs for young people.", "translation": "新當選的參議員承諾將專注於改善公共教育系統並為年輕人創造更多工作機會。", "explanation": "名詞「參議員」。"}], "related_forms": ["senate"]}

{"headword":"sensation","explanation":"名詞「感覺、快感」或「轟動」。指生理上的感覺或引起大眾強烈關注的人或事。","entries":[{"sentence":"When she stepped onto the stage for the first time, she felt a strange <target>sensation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> tingling in her fingers and toes.","translation":"當她第一次踏上舞台時，她感覺到手指和腳趾有種奇怪的刺痛感。","explanation":"名詞「感覺」。指生理感覺。"},{"sentence":"The new pop star became an overnight <target>sensation</target> after her song went viral on social media, attracting millions of listeners worldwide.","translation":"這位新流行歌手在她的歌曲在社交媒體上瘋傳後，一夜之間成為轟動人物。","explanation":"名詞「轟動/轟動人物」。指引起大眾強烈關注的人或事。"},{"sentence":"The discovery of the ancient city under the ocean created a worldwide <target>sensation</target>, sparking interest in archaeology among teenagers.","translation":"在海底發現古城的事件引起了全球轟動，激發了青少年對考古學的興趣。","explanation":"名詞「轟動」。"}],"related_forms":["sensational"]}

{"headword":"sensitivity","explanation":"名詞「敏感度、敏感」。指對外界刺激的反應程度，或對他人情感的體貼。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new digital thermometer has a high level of <target>sensitivity</target>, allowing it to detect even the smallest changes in temperature.","translation":"這款新型數位溫度計具有很高的敏感度，使其能夠偵測到即使是微小的溫度變化。","explanation":"名詞「敏感度」。指設備的精準度。"},{"sentence":"Teachers should show <target>sensitivity</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the needs of students from different cultural backgrounds to create a supportive learning environment.","translation":"老師應對來自不同文化背景的學生的需求展現敏感度，以創造一個支持性的學習環境。","explanation":"名詞「敏感」。常用搭配 sensitivity to sth。"},{"sentence":"Because of her high emotional <target>sensitivity</target>, she is often able to tell if her friends are upset even before they say a word.","translation":"由於她高度的情感敏感度，她通常能在朋友開口之前就察覺到他們是否不開心。","explanation":"名詞「敏感」。指對情感的洞察力。"}],"related_forms":["sensitive","sensitize"]}

{"headword": "sensor", "explanation": "名詞「感測器」。指能偵測環境變化並將其轉化為訊號的裝置。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The automatic doors at the supermarket open as soon as the <target>sensor</target> detects a person approaching the entrance.", "translation": "超級市場的自動門在感測器偵測到有人靠近入口時會立即開啟。", "explanation": "名詞「感測器」。"}, {"sentence": "Modern cars are equipped with parking <target>sensors</target> that beep when the driver gets too close to an object while reversing.", "translation": "現代汽車配備了停車感測器，當駕駛者在倒車時會發出嗶嗶聲。", "explanation": "名詞「感測器」。"}, {"sentence": "The smart home system uses a motion <target>sensor</target> to automatically turn on the lights when someone enters the room.", "translation": "智慧家庭系統使用動態感測器，在有人進入房間時自動開啟燈光。", "explanation": "名詞「感測器」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"sentiment","explanation":"名詞「情感、看法」。指基於情感而非理性的看法或態度。","entries":[{"sentence":"The public <target>sentiment</target> shifted quickly after the government explained the reasons for the new tax law to the citizens.","translation":"在政府向公民解釋新稅法的原因後，大眾的情感迅速發生了轉變。","explanation":"名詞「情感/看法」。指大眾的普遍態度。"},{"sentence":"Many people share the <target>sentiment</target> <pattern>that</pattern> students should have more free time to explore their interests instead of only studying for exams.","translation":"許多人認同這樣一種看法：學生應該有更多自由時間來探索自己的興趣，而不是僅僅為了考試而學習。","explanation":"名詞「看法」。常用搭配 sentiment that...。"},{"sentence":"The old photograph brought back a <target>sentiment</target> <pattern>of</pattern> nostalgia for the days when he lived in a small village with his grandparents.","translation":"這張舊照片喚起了一種對他曾與祖父母住在小村莊日子的懷舊之情。","explanation":"名詞「情感」。常用搭配 sentiment of nostalgia。"}],"related_forms":["sentimental"]}

{"headword": "sentimental", "explanation": "形容詞「感傷的，情感上的」。指對過去的事物抱有深情或過分感傷。常用於描述對紀念品、舊照片或回憶的依戀。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She kept the old, worn-out teddy bear not for its value, but for <target>sentimental</target> <pattern>reasons</pattern>, as it was a gift from her grandmother.", "translation": "她保留那個破舊的小熊玩具不是因為它的價值，而是出於感傷的原因，因為那是她祖母送的禮物。", "explanation": "形容詞「感傷的」。sentimental reasons 指「感傷的原因」，常用於解釋為何保留沒有實用價值的物品。"}, {"sentence": "The movie's ending was a bit too <target>sentimental</target>, making the audience cry with its overly emotional music and slow-motion scenes.", "translation": "這部電影的結局有點太感傷了，用過於感性的音樂和慢動作場景讓觀眾落淚。", "explanation": "形容詞「感傷的」。指情感表達過於豐富，有時帶有貶義，指過分感傷。"}, {"sentence": "After visiting her childhood home, she felt deeply <target>sentimental</target> about the memories of playing in the garden with her siblings.", "translation": "在參訪她童年的家後，她對與兄弟姐妹在花園玩耍的回憶感到深深的感傷。", "explanation": "形容詞「感傷的」。描述對過去美好回憶的依戀。"}], "related_forms": ["sentiment", "sentimentally"]}

{"headword":"sequence","explanation":"名詞「順序，序列」；動詞「按順序排列」。常用於數學、電影剪輯或邏輯分析。名詞時常用片語 in sequence (依序)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students had to arrange the historical events <pattern>in</pattern> <target>sequence</target> to understand how one event led to another over time.","translation":"學生們必須將歷史事件依序排列，以了解隨著時間推移，一個事件是如何導致另一個事件的。","explanation":"名詞「順序」。in sequence 指「依序」。"},{"sentence":"The detective carefully analyzed the <target>sequence</target> <pattern>of</pattern> clues left at the crime scene to reconstruct what had happened that night.","translation":"偵探仔細分析了犯罪現場留下的線索順序，以重建當晚發生的事情。","explanation":"名詞「序列，順序」。sequence of clues 指「線索的順序」。"},{"sentence":"The editor decided to cut a short <target>sequence</target> from the movie to make the story move faster and keep the audience engaged.","translation":"剪輯師決定從電影中刪除一段短小的片段，使故事推進更快，並讓觀眾保持參與感。","explanation":"名詞「片段」。在電影或音樂中，sequence 指一連串相關的鏡頭或段落。"},{"sentence":"Biologists use advanced software to <target>sequence</target> the DNA of rare plants, helping them identify the species' genetic characteristics.","translation":"生物學家使用先進的軟體來對稀有植物的 DNA 進行定序，幫助他們識別該物種的遺傳特徵。","explanation":"動詞「按順序排列/定序」。在生物學中，sequence DNA 指「對 DNA 進行定序」。"}],"related_forms":["sequential","sequentially"]}

{"headword":"series","explanation":"名詞「系列，一系列」。指一連串相關的事物或事件。注意 series 是單複數同形，可用單數動詞或複數動詞，且常用片語 a series of (一系列的...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government implemented <pattern>a</pattern> <target>series</target> <pattern>of</pattern> new laws to reduce air pollution and protect the environment for future generations.","translation":"政府實施了一系列新法律，以減少空氣污染並保護後代子孫的環境。","explanation":"名詞「一系列」。a series of + N (複數)。"},{"sentence":"After experiencing <pattern>a</pattern> <target>series</target> <pattern>of</pattern> unfortunate events, the family decided to move to a quiet countryside to start over.","translation":"在經歷了一系列不幸的事件後，這家人決定搬到寧靜的鄉下重新開始。","explanation":"名詞「一系列」。a series of + N (複數)。"},{"sentence":"The student's favorite TV <target>series</target> was cancelled after the first season, leaving many fans disappointed by the unfinished story.","translation":"這個學生最喜歡的電視影集被在第一季後取消了，讓許多粉絲對未完成的故事感到失望。","explanation":"名詞「系列/影集」。在此指一連串相關的電視節目。"}],"related_forms":["serial"]}

{"headword":"server","explanation":"名詞「伺服器」或「服務員」。在現代英文中，server 多指電腦伺服器，而服務員在餐廳中常用 server 或 waiter/waitress。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school's website crashed during the online registration period because the <target>server</target> could not handle the huge amount of traffic.","translation":"由於伺服器無法處理巨大的流量，學校網站於線上登記期間崩潰了。","explanation":"名詞「伺服器」。指電腦網路中的主機。"},{"sentence":"The IT department is upgrading the <target>server</target> to ensure that students can access their digital textbooks and assignments more reliably.","translation":"資訊部門正在升級伺服器，以確保學生能更可靠地訪問他們的數位教科書和作業。","explanation":"名詞「伺服器」。"},{"sentence":"The friendly <target>server</target> at the local cafe recommended the special of the day, making the customers feel welcome and comfortable.","translation":"當地咖啡店親切的服務員推薦了今日特餐，讓顧客感到受歡迎且舒適。","explanation":"名詞「服務員」。指在餐廳提供服務的人。"}],"related_forms":["serve"]}

{"headword":"session","explanation":"名詞「會議，時段」。指一段時間內進行的特定活動（如課程、會議、法庭審理）。常用搭配 in a session (在會議中)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher organized a special <target>session</target> after school to help students who were struggling with their final exam preparations.","translation":"老師在放學後組織了一個特別時段，以幫助那些在準備期末考時遇到困難的學生。","explanation":"名詞「時段」。指一段時間內進行的特定活動。"},{"sentence":"After a long <target>session</target> <pattern>of</pattern> intense study, the students took a short break to stretch their bodies and clear their minds.","translation":"經過一段長時間的密集學習時段後，學生們休息了一會兒，以伸展身體並清醒頭腦。","explanation":"名詞「時段」。session of study 指「學習時段」。"},{"sentence":"The court <target>session</target> was postponed until next Monday, giving the lawyers more time to gather evidence and prepare their arguments.","translation":"法庭會議被推遲到下週一，讓律師們有更多時間收集證據並準備他們的論點。","explanation":"名詞「會議」。指法庭審理的正式時段。"}],"related_forms":["sessions"]}

{"headword": "setting", "explanation": "名詞「環境，設定」。指事物發生的地點或背景（如故事的背景）。在科技產品中，指功能的設定選項。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The novel is <pattern>set</pattern> <pattern>in</pattern> a small fishing village in Japan, providing a peaceful and atmospheric <target>setting</target> for the story.", "translation": "這部小說設定在日本的一個小漁村，為故事提供了一個寧靜且有氛圍的環境。", "explanation": "名詞「環境，背景」。指故事發生的地點。"}, {"sentence": "The old castle, with its high walls and lush gardens, provided a romantic <target>setting</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the couple's wedding ceremony.", "translation": "這座古堡及其高牆和茂盛的花園，為這對夫婦的婚禮儀式提供了一個浪漫的環境。", "explanation": "名詞「環境」。setting for sth 指「...的環境/背景」。"}, {"sentence": "If you cannot hear the audio clearly, please check the sound <target>settings</target> <pattern>on</pattern> your computer to make sure the volume is turned up.", "translation": "如果你不能清楚地聽到聲音，請檢查電腦上的聲音設定，確保音量已調高。", "explanation": "名詞「設定」。指電子設備的配置選項。"}], "related_forms": ["set"]}

{"headword":"shareholder","explanation":"名詞「股東」。指持有公司股票的人或機構。常用搭配 shareholder meeting (股東會)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company's CEO presented the annual report at the <target>shareholder</target> meeting, explaining the profits and future goals of the business.","translation":"公司執行長在股東會上提交了年度報告，解釋了企業的利潤和未來目標。","explanation":"名詞「股東」。shareholder meeting 指「股東會」。"},{"sentence":"As a <target>shareholder</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the tech company, he was entitled to receive a portion of the company's profits as dividends.","translation":"作為這家科技公司的股東，他有權獲得公司利潤的一部分作為股利。","explanation":"名詞「股東」。shareholder in a company 指「某公司的股東」。"},{"sentence":"The board of directors must balance the interests of the <target>shareholders</target> with the long-term sustainability of the company.","translation":"董事會必須在股東的利益與公司的長期永續發展之間取得平衡。","explanation":"名詞「股東」。指持有股票的人。"}],"related_forms":["share","shareholding"]}

{"headword":"shatter","explanation":"動詞「粉碎，使破碎」。指物體（尤其是玻璃或陶瓷）破碎成許多小碎片。也可指夢想、希望或沉默的粉碎。","entries":[{"sentence":"The loud noise of the window <target>shattering</target> <pattern>into</pattern> a thousand pieces startled the sleeping dog and woke up the entire neighborhood.","translation":"窗戶粉碎成千片的小聲響驚醒了熟睡的狗，並喚醒了整個鄰里。","explanation":"動詞「粉碎」。shatter into pieces 指「粉碎成碎片」。"},{"sentence":"The sudden news of the company's bankruptcy <target>shattered</target> his dreams of starting his own business and traveling around the world.","translation":"公司破產的突然消息粉碎了他的創業和環遊世界的夢想。","explanation":"動詞「粉碎」。指抽象的夢想或希望被摧毀。"},{"sentence":"The silence of the library was <target>shattered</target> <pattern>by</pattern> a loud phone call, causing many students to look up from their books with annoyance.","translation":"圖書館的寧靜被一通大聲的電話給打破了，導致許多學生不耐煩地從書中抬起頭來。","explanation":"動詞「粉碎/打破」。shatter the silence 指「打破寧靜」。"}],"related_forms":["shattered"]}

{"headword":"shed","explanation":"動詞「脫落，掉落」或「流（淚）」。名詞「棚屋」。動詞用法常考 a shed skin (脫皮) 或 shed tears (流淚)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Snakes <target>shed</target> their skin periodically to allow their bodies to grow and to remove parasites that might be attached to them.","translation":"蛇會定期脫皮，以便讓身體生長並去除可能附著在身上的寄生蟲。","explanation":"動詞「脫落」。指動物脫皮。"},{"sentence":"After hearing the heart-wrenching story of the lost puppy, the young girl could not help but <target>shed</target> a few <pattern>tears</pattern>.","translation":"在聽完關於失去小狗的令人心碎的故事後，小女孩忍不住流了幾滴淚。","explanation":"動詞片語 shed tears 指「流淚」。"},{"sentence":"The gardener stored all his heavy tools, such as shovels and rakes, in a small <target>shed</target> <pattern>at</pattern> the back of the garden.","translation":"園丁將他所有沉重的工具，如鏟子和耙子，儲存在花園後方的一個小棚屋中。","explanation":"名詞「棚屋」。指用於儲存工具的簡單建築。"},{"sentence":"The new evidence provided by the witness <target>shed</target> <pattern>light on</pattern> the mystery, helping the police identify the real criminal.","translation":"證人提供的最新證據為這個謎團揭開了面處，幫助警方辨識出真正的罪犯。","explanation":"動詞片語 shed light on sth 指「闡明/揭露...」。"}],"related_forms":["sheds"]}

{"headword":"sheer","explanation":"形容詞「純粹的，完全的」或「陡峭的」。副詞「完全地」。常用於強調程度，例如 sheer luck (純粹的運氣) 或 sheer determination (純粹的決定心)。","entries":[{"sentence":"It was <pattern>by</pattern> <target>sheer</target> luck that he found his lost wallet on the sidewalk, just as he was about to give up looking.","translation":"他能在人行道上找到遺失的錢包，純粹是靠運氣，就在他準備放棄尋找的時候。","explanation":"形容詞「純粹的」。sheer luck 指「純粹的運氣」。"},{"sentence":"The climber managed to reach the summit of the mountain through <target>sheer</target> determination and hard work, despite the extreme cold.","translation":"儘管天氣極其寒冷，這位登山者仍憑藉著純粹的決心和努力，成功登上了山頂。","explanation":"形容詞「純粹的」。sheer determination 指「純粹的決心」。"},{"sentence":"The hiker was terrified when he looked down from the <target>sheer</target> cliff, as the drop was hundreds of feet deep and completely vertical.","translation":"當登山客從陡峭的的懸崖向下看時，他感到非常恐懼，因為落差數百英尺且完全垂直。","explanation":"形容詞「陡峭的」。指牆壁或懸崖完全垂直地下降。"},{"sentence":"The dress was made of <target>sheer</target> fabric, which was so thin and transparent that the undergarments were clearly visible.","translation":"這件禮服是由透明的布料製成，如此纖薄透明，以至於內衣清晰可見。","explanation":"形容詞「透明的」。指布料纖薄且透明。"}],"related_forms":["sheerly"]}

{"headword":"sheriff","explanation":"名詞「治安官、警長」。在美國某些地區，sheriff 是由選民選出負責該郡 (county) 治安的最高行政長官，與市警局的 police chief 不同。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>sheriff</target> led the investigation into the bank robbery, coordinating with several deputies to track down the suspects across the state.","translation":"治安官領導了銀行搶劫案的調查，與幾名副警長協調，在全州追蹤嫌疑人。","explanation":"名詞「治安官」。指負責特定區域治安的法律執行官。"},{"sentence":"In many Western movies, the <target>sheriff</target> is often depicted as a brave man wearing a star-shaped badge on his chest.","translation":"在許多西部片中，治安官通常被描繪成一名胸前佩戴星形徽章的勇敢男人。","explanation":"名詞「治安官」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"shield","explanation":"名詞「盾牌；屏蔽」；動詞「保護；遮蔽」。常考搭配：shield A from B (保護 A 免於 B)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The ancient warrior held a heavy metal <target>shield</target> to protect himself from the enemy's arrows during the fierce battle.","translation":"古代戰士持有沉重的金屬盾牌，以在激烈戰鬥中保護自己免受敵人的箭矢攻擊。","explanation":"名詞「盾牌」。指用來防禦攻擊的工具。"},{"sentence":"Parents often try to <target>shield</target> their children <pattern>from</pattern> the harsh realities of the world to preserve their innocence for as long as possible.","translation":"父母經常試圖保護孩子免於面對世界的殘酷現實，以盡可能長時間地保留他們的純真。","explanation":"動詞「保護」。常用搭配 shield someone from something。"},{"sentence":"The astronaut's helmet is designed with a special visor to <target>shield</target> his eyes <pattern>from</pattern> the intense radiation of the sun in space.","translation":"太空人的頭盔設計有特殊的面罩，用以保護眼睛免於太空陽光的強烈輻射。","explanation":"動詞「遮蔽」。指物理上的遮蔽或保護。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"shiver","explanation":"動詞「發抖」；名詞「顫抖」。通常指因寒冷、恐懼或興奮而產生的不由自主的身體抖動。常用搭配：shiver with cold/fear (因寒冷/恐懼而發抖)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young boy began to <target>shiver</target> <pattern>with</pattern> cold after he fell into the icy river and waited for help for an hour.","translation":"小男孩在掉進冰冷的河裡並等待救援一小時後，開始因寒冷而發抖。","explanation":"動詞「發抖」。常用搭配 shiver with cold。"},{"sentence":"A sudden <target>shiver</target> ran down her spine when she heard a strange noise coming from the dark basement of the old house.","translation":"當她聽到舊房子黑暗的地下室傳來奇怪的聲音時，她的背脊感到一陣顫抖。","explanation":"名詞「顫抖」。常用搭配 a shiver ran down one's spine (感到毛骨悚然)。"},{"sentence":"The witness started to <target>shiver</target> <pattern>with</pattern> fear as the lawyer asked him difficult questions during the trial in the courtroom.","translation":"當律師在法庭審理期間向他提出困難的問題時，證人開始因恐懼而發抖。","explanation":"動詞「發抖」。常用搭配 shiver with fear。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"shortage","explanation":"名詞「短缺」。指某物數量不足，無法滿足需求。常用搭配：a shortage of (缺乏...)，與 surplus (過剩) 相反。","entries":[{"sentence":"Due to the severe drought, the city is facing a critical <target>shortage</target> <pattern>of</pattern> fresh water, forcing residents to limit their daily use.","translation":"由於嚴重的乾旱，這座城市正面臨嚴重的淡水短缺，迫使居民限制日常用水量。","explanation":"名詞「短缺」。常用搭配 a shortage of sth。"},{"sentence":"Many hospitals are experiencing a severe <target>shortage</target> <pattern>of</pattern> nursing staff, leading to longer waiting times for patients in the emergency room.","translation":"許多醫院正經歷嚴重的護理人員短缺，導致急診室患者的等待時間增加。","explanation":"名詞「短缺」。常用搭配 a shortage of sth。"},{"sentence":"The global chip <target>shortage</target> has caused a significant increase in the price of new cars and electronic devices worldwide.","translation":"全球晶片短缺導致全球新車和電子設備的價格大幅上漲。","explanation":"名詞「短缺」。"}],"related_forms":["short"]}

{"headword":"shove","explanation":"動詞「猛推」；名詞「猛推」。指用力且突然地將某人或某物推開。注意與 push (推) 的區別：shove 通常帶有更強的力道或更粗魯的意味。","entries":[{"sentence":"The angry man tried to <target>shove</target> his way <pattern>through</pattern> the crowded subway station during the morning rush hour to get to his office.","translation":"這名憤怒的男子試圖在早晨通勤尖峰時段，在擁擠的地鐵站中強行擠過，以趕到辦公室。","explanation":"動詞「猛推」。常用片語 shove one's way through 表示「強行擠過」。"},{"sentence":"Please do not <target>shove</target> the books <pattern>into</pattern> your backpack so carelessly, or you might damage the covers of your textbooks.","translation":"請不要如此粗魯地將書本塞進書包，否則你可能會損壞課本的封面。","explanation":"動詞「猛推/塞」。指用力地將物體放入某處。"},{"sentence":"With a strong <target>shove</target>, the security guard pushed the intruder away from the entrance of the gallery to maintain order.","translation":"保全人員用力猛推了一把，將入侵者從美術館入口處推開，以維持秩序。","explanation":"名詞「猛推」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"shrug","explanation":"動詞「聳肩」；名詞「聳肩」。通常表示不確定、不在乎或不知道。常用搭配：shrug one's shoulders (聳肩)。","entries":[{"sentence":"When the teacher asked who had broken the window, the student just <target>shrugged</target> his <pattern>shoulders</pattern> and looked away, pretending not to know.","translation":"當老師詢問是誰打破窗戶時，那名學生只是聳了聳肩，然後看向別處，假裝不知道。","explanation":"動詞「聳肩」。常用搭配 shrug one's shoulders。"},{"sentence":"I asked her where the nearest post office was, but she gave me a <target>shrug</target> and told me she was a tourist too.","translation":"我問她最近的郵局在哪裡，但她只是聳了聳肩，告訴我她也是一名遊客。","explanation":"名詞「聳肩」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"shuttle","explanation":"名詞「接駁車」；動詞「頻繁往返」。指在兩個特定地點之間規律地往返。常用搭配：shuttle bus (接駁車)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The hotel provides a free <target>shuttle</target> <pattern>bus</pattern> that runs every fifteen minutes between the airport and the hotel lobby.","translation":"飯店提供每十五分鐘一班的免費接駁車，往返於機場與飯店大廳之間。","explanation":"名詞「接駁車」。常用搭配 shuttle bus。"},{"sentence":"During the international conference, officials <target>shuttled</target> <pattern>between</pattern> the two cities to negotiate the peace agreement as quickly as possible.","translation":"在國際會議期間，官員們在兩座城市之間頻繁往返，以盡快協商和平協議。","explanation":"動詞「頻繁往返」。常用搭配 shuttle between A and B。"},{"sentence":"The space <target>shuttle</target> was launched into orbit, carrying several astronauts and a large satellite to be installed in space.","translation":"太空梭被發射到軌道上，攜帶著幾名太空人以及一顆將要在太空安裝的大型衛星。","explanation":"名詞「太空梭」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"sibling","explanation":"名詞「兄弟姊妹」。是一個正式的集合名詞，涵蓋了 brother 和 sister。在學術或醫療文件中較為常用。","entries":[{"sentence":"The psychologist asked the participant whether he had any <target>siblings</target> and how his relationship with them affected his childhood development.","translation":"心理學家詢問參與者是否擁有任何兄弟姊妹，以及他與他們的關係如何影響他的童年發展。","explanation":"名詞「兄弟姊妹」。指同父母所生的孩子。"},{"sentence":"Many children who grow up without <target>siblings</target> often develop a stronger bond with their parents but may feel lonely at times.","translation":"許多在沒有兄弟姊妹環境下長大的孩子，通常與父母的關係更緊密，但有時可能會感到孤單。","explanation":"名詞「兄弟姊妹」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"siege","explanation":"名詞「圍城；圍攻」。指軍隊將某個地點完全包圍，切斷其物資供應以迫使對方投降的軍事行動。常用搭配：lay siege to (圍攻)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The army <pattern>laid</pattern> <target>siege</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the ancient city for six months, cutting off all food supplies to force the residents to surrender.","translation":"軍隊圍攻這座古城六個月，切斷所有食物供應以迫使居民投降。","explanation":"名詞「圍城」。片語 lay siege to 表示「圍攻」。"},{"sentence":"During the long <target>siege</target>, the people inside the castle suffered from severe hunger and disease, as no help could reach them.","translation":"在漫長的圍城期間，城堡內的人們遭受嚴重的飢餓和疾病，因為沒有救援能到達他們身邊。","explanation":"名詞「圍攻」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"skeleton","explanation":"名詞「骨架；骨骼」。指生物體內支撐身體的骨頭總稱。也可以指某事物的初步框架或大綱 (a skeleton of a plan)。","entries":[{"sentence":"In biology class, students studied a human <target>skeleton</target> to learn about the different types of bones and how they protect internal organs.","translation":"在生物課上，學生們研究人類骨骼，以了解不同類種的骨骨頭以及它們如何保護內部器官。","explanation":"名詞「骨架」。指身體的骨骼系統。"},{"sentence":"The writer spent a week creating a <target>skeleton</target> <pattern>of</pattern> his new novel, outlining the main plot and key characters before writing the full story.","translation":"作者花了一週時間為他的新小說建立初步大綱，在撰寫完整故事前先勾勒出主線劇情和關鍵角色。","explanation":"名詞「骨架/大綱」。比喻指事物的初步框架。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"skull","explanation":"名詞「頭骨」。指保護大腦的骨骼結構。","entries":[{"sentence":"The archeologist carefully brushed away the dirt to reveal a human <target>skull</target> that had been buried for thousands of years.","translation":"考古學家小心地刷掉泥土，揭露了一個被埋葬數千年的人類頭骨。","explanation":"名詞「頭骨」。"},{"sentence":"Doctors used a high-resolution X-ray to examine the <target>skull</target> for any cracks after the patient suffered a severe head injury.","translation":"在患者遭受嚴重頭部受傷後，醫生使用高解析度 X 光片檢查頭骨是否有任何裂縫。","explanation":"名詞「頭骨」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"slam","explanation":"動詞「用力關上」或「猛擊」；名詞「猛擊」。常用於描述門被用力關上，或在體育運動中猛烈擊球。","entries":[{"sentence":"In a fit of anger, the teenager <target>slammed</target> the bedroom door, making the entire house shake from the loud noise.","translation":"在憤怒之中，這名青少年用力地關上了臥室門，巨大的噪音讓整個房子都震動。","explanation":"動詞「用力關上」。常用於描述門或窗戶。"},{"sentence":"The tennis player <target>slammed</target> the ball <pattern>into</pattern> the court with incredible force, leaving the opponent unable to react in time.","translation":"這名網球選手以驚人的力量將球猛擊入場內，讓對手無法及時做出反應。","explanation":"動詞「猛擊」。常用於描述力量強大的擊打。"},{"sentence":"The critic gave the new movie a <pattern>harsh</pattern> <target>slam</target> in the local newspaper, criticizing its weak plot and poor acting.","translation":"評論家在當地報紙上對這部新電影給予了嚴厲的批評，批評其情節薄弱且演技拙劣。","explanation":"名詞「猛擊/批評」。在此處是指對某事物的強烈批評。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"slap","explanation":"動詞「拍打」；名詞「拍打」；副詞（較少見，通常指拍打的聲音）。常用於描述輕輕拍擊或處罰性的拍打。","entries":[{"sentence":"The mother gently <target>slapped</target> the child <pattern>on</pattern> the hand to warn him not to touch the hot stove in the kitchen.","translation":"母親輕輕拍打孩子的手，警告他不要觸碰廚房裡的熱爐子。","explanation":"動詞「拍打」。常用搭配 slap someone on the hand。"},{"sentence":"She felt a sudden <target>slap</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the face when she realized that her hard work had been completely ignored by her boss.","translation":"當她意識到她的努力完全被老闆無視時，她感到像是被狠狠地扇了一巴掌。","explanation":"名詞「拍打」。此處為比喻用法，指令人失望或受辱的感覺。"},{"sentence":"He quickly <target>slapped</target> <pattern>a sticker</pattern> <pattern>on</pattern> the folder to mark the important documents for the upcoming meeting.","translation":"他迅速地在文件夾上貼上一個貼紙，以標記即將到來的會議中的重要文件。","explanation":"動詞「隨便地貼/拍」。常用於描述快速且不精細的動作。"}],"related_forms":[]}
comment: Sentence 2 translation is slightly awkward: '感到像是被狠狠地扇了一巴掌' is a bit too literal for the metaphorical use of 'slap in the face', though acceptable. However, the card passes overall.

response: {"headword":"slavery","explanation":"名詞「奴隸制度」或「奴役狀態」。指一個人被視為另一個人的財產並被迫工作的情況。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many historians study the impact of <target>slavery</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the economic development of the Americas during the eighteenth century.","translation":"許多歷史學家研究十八世紀奴隸制度對美洲經濟發展的影響。","explanation":"名詞「奴隸制度」。"},{"sentence":"The international community has worked tirelessly to abolish <target>slavery</target> <pattern>in</pattern> all forms, including forced labor and human trafficking.","translation":"國際社會不懈地努力地廢除所有形式的奴隸制度，包括強迫勞動和人口販賣。","explanation":"名詞「奴隸制度」。"},{"sentence":"The brave woman fought against <target>slavery</target> to help thousands of people escape from their cruel masters and find freedom.","translation":"勇敢的女人與奴隸制度對抗，以幫助數千人從殘酷的主人手中逃脫並找到自由。","explanation":"名詞「奴役狀態」。"}],"related_forms":["slave"]}

{"headword":"slot","explanation":"名詞「狹縫、時段」；動詞「放入、安排」。常用於描述物理上的孔洞或時間表上的空檔。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please insert your coin <pattern>into</pattern> the <target>slot</target> of the vending machine to purchase your favorite drink.","translation":"請將硬幣放入自動販賣機的狹縫中，以購買您最喜歡的飲料。","explanation":"名詞「狹縫」。"},{"sentence":"The student tried to find a free time <target>slot</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the school schedule to take an extra English class.","translation":"學生試圖在學校的時間表中找到一個空閒時段，以便修習一門額外的英語課。","explanation":"名詞「時段」。"},{"sentence":"The manager <target>slotted</target> the meeting <pattern>into</pattern> his busy afternoon, ensuring that all team members could attend.","translation":"經理將會議安排在他的繁忙的下午，確保所有團隊成員都能參加。","explanation":"動詞「安排」。指將某事放入時間表中的空檔。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"smash","explanation":"動詞「粉碎、擊碎」；名詞「粉碎、大成功」。常用於描述物體被擊碎或某個作品取得巨大的成功。","entries":[{"sentence":"The clumsy boy accidentally <target>smashed</target> the expensive glass vase, sending pieces of crystal flying across the room.","translation":"那個笨拙的男孩不小心地將昂貴的玻璃花瓶擊碎，使晶體碎片飛散在房間各處。","explanation":"動詞「擊碎」。"},{"sentence":"The angry driver <target>smashed</target> his hand <pattern>against</pattern> the steering wheel in frustration after the car broke down.","translation":"在車子故障後，憤怒的駕駛員將手猛擊在方向盤上以表達沮喪。","explanation":"動詞「猛擊」。"},{"sentence":"The new pop song became a <pattern>global</pattern> <target>smash</target>, topping the music charts in many different countries for several weeks.","translation":"這首新流行歌曲成為了全球大成功，在許多不同國家的音樂排行榜上蟬聯數週。","explanation":"名詞「大成功」。指某個藝術作品或產品取得巨大的成功。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"smog","explanation":"名詞「煙霧」。由 smoke (煙) 和 fog (霧) 組成。指城市中因污染而產生的濃煙霧。","entries":[{"sentence":"Due to the heavy <target>smog</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the city, many people are advised to wear masks to protect their lungs.","translation":"由於城市中濃厚的煙霧，許多人被建議佩戴口罩以保護他們的肺部。","explanation":"名詞「煙霧」。"},{"sentence":"The government implemented new laws to reduce air pollution and clear the <target>smog</target> that often covers the metropolis.","translation":"政府實施了新法律以減少空氣污染，並清除經常覆蓋在大都市中的煙霧。","explanation":"名詞「煙霧」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"snatch","explanation":"動詞「猛抓、搶奪」；名詞「碎片、片段」。常用於描述快速地拿走某物或聽到的一小部分內容。","entries":[{"sentence":"The thief tried to <target>snatch</target> the woman's handbag from her shoulder and run away into the crowded street.","translation":"小偷試圖從女人的肩膀上搶奪她的手提包並逃入擁擠的街道。","explanation":"動詞「搶奪」。"},{"sentence":"The eagle <target>snatched</target> a fish <pattern>from</pattern> the surface of the water with its sharp claws and flew away.","translation":"老鷹用它銳利的爪子從水面猛抓一條魚然後飛走。","explanation":"動詞「猛抓」。"},{"sentence":"As she walked past the library, she caught a <target>snatch</target> <pattern>of</pattern> their conversation, hearing only a few words about the exam.","translation":"當她走過圖書館時，她捕捉到他們對話的一小部分，只聽到了一些關於考試的幾個字。","explanation":"名詞「片段」。指聽到或看到的一小部分。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"sneak","explanation":"動詞「偷偷地走、潛入」；名詞「偷偷地走的人、告密者」。常用於描述為了不被發現而小心翼翼地移動。","entries":[{"sentence":"The boy tried to <target>sneak</target> <pattern>out of</pattern> the house at midnight to meet his friends without his parents' permission.","translation":"男孩試圖在半夜偷偷溜出家門去見他的朋友，而沒有得到父母的許可。","explanation":"動詞「偷偷溜出」。常用片語 sneak out of。"},{"sentence":"She tried to <target>sneak</target> a look <pattern>at</pattern> her classmate's paper during the test, but the teacher caught her immediately.","translation":"她在考試期間試圖偷偷地看一眼同學的卷子，但老師立刻發現了她。","explanation":"動詞「偷偷地做」。指在不被發現的情況下快速地做某事。"},{"sentence":"The cat <target>sneaked</target> <pattern>up to</pattern> the sleeping dog, moving slowly and quietly to avoid making any sound.","translation":"貓偷偷地接近睡眠中的狗，緩慢且安靜地移動以避免發出任何聲音。","explanation":"動詞「潛入」。常用片語 sneak up to。"}],"related_forms":["sneaky"]}

{"headword":"sniff","explanation":"動詞「聞、嗅」；名詞「嗅聞」。常用於描述用鼻子吸氣以感知氣味或表達情緒（如輕蔑或哭泣）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police dog was trained to <target>sniff</target> <pattern>out</pattern> illegal drugs and explosives at the international airport.","translation":"警犬被訓練在國際機場嗅出非法藥品和爆炸物。","explanation":"動詞片語 sniff out 意為「嗅出、查出」。"},{"sentence":"The baby <target>sniffed</target> the fresh flowers in the garden, showing a clear expression of curiosity and delight on his face.","translation":"嬰兒嗅了嗅花園裡的新鮮花朵，表現出好奇與喜悅的表情。","explanation":"動詞「聞」。"},{"sentence":"After crying for a long time, the girl <target>sniffed</target> and wiped her nose with a tissue to stop her from sobbing.","translation":"女孩在哭了一長時間後，抽鼻子地嗅聞，並用面紙擦拭鼻子以防止繼續抽泣。","explanation":"動詞「抽鼻子」。指哭泣後發出的聲音。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"soak","explanation":"動詞「浸泡」或「使濕透」；名詞「浸泡」。常用片語 soak in (滲入/吸收) 或 be soaked in (被...浸透)。注意與 dip (短時間浸) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"To make the beans easier to cook, you should <target>soak</target> them <pattern>in</pattern> water for at least eight hours before boiling.","translation":"為了讓豆子更容易煮熟，你在煮沸前應該將它們在水中浸泡至少八小時。","explanation":"動詞「浸泡」。常用搭配 soak in water。"},{"sentence":"The heavy rain lasted for hours, and by the time he reached home, his clothes were completely <target>soaked</target> <pattern>through</pattern>.","translation":"大雨持續了數小時，當他回到家時，衣服已經完全濕透了。","explanation":"動詞「使濕透」。soaked through 強調完全浸透。"},{"sentence":"After a stressful week at school, she decided to <target>soak</target> <pattern>in</pattern> a warm bath to relax her muscles and clear her mind.","translation":"在學校壓力很大的一週後，她決定泡個熱水澡以放鬆肌肉並清空思緒。","explanation":"動詞「浸泡」。指長時間待在水中。"},{"sentence":"It took a few moments for the news of the victory to <target>soak</target> <pattern>in</pattern>, and then the crowd erupted in cheers.","translation":"勝利的消息花了一會兒才被大家意識到（滲入心中），接著人群爆發出歡呼聲。","explanation":"動詞片語 soak in 意為「逐漸理解或意識到」。"}],"related_forms":["soaking","soaked"]}

{"headword":"soar","explanation":"動詞「猛增」或「高飛」。常用於描述價格、氣溫的劇增或鳥類在高空盤旋。注意與 rise (上升) 相比，soar 強調速度快且幅度大。","entries":[{"sentence":"Due to the sudden increase in demand for electric cars, the stock prices of battery companies began to <target>soar</target> rapidly.","translation":"由於電動車需求的突然增加，電池公司的股價開始迅速猛增。","explanation":"動詞「猛增」。常用於描述價格或數值的劇烈上升。"},{"sentence":"During the hot summer months, temperatures in the desert can <target>soar</target> <pattern>to</pattern> over forty degrees Celsius during the day.","translation":"在炎熱的夏季月份，沙漠白天的氣溫可能會飆升至攝氏四十度以上。","explanation":"動詞「猛增」。搭配 to + 數值表示上升至某程度。"},{"sentence":"We watched the majestic eagle <target>soar</target> high <pattern>above</pattern> the mountains, gliding effortlessly through the clear blue sky.","translation":"我們看著雄鷹在高山之上高飛，在晴朗的藍天中毫不費力地滑行。","explanation":"動詞「高飛」。指鳥類或飛機在高空飛行。"}],"related_forms":["soaring"]}

{"headword":"sob","explanation":"動詞或名詞「抽泣」。指因悲傷而發出的斷斷續續的哭聲。注意與 cry (哭) 相比，sob 更強調抽泣的動作和聲音。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young child began to <target>sob</target> uncontrollably after he lost his favorite toy at the crowded amusement park.","translation":"那個小男孩在擁擠的遊樂園弄丟了他最喜歡的玩具後，開始失控地抽泣。","explanation":"動詞「抽泣」。描述一種劇烈且不連續的哭法。"},{"sentence":"She let out a loud <target>sob</target> when she heard the sad news about her grandmother's health, unable to hold back her tears.","translation":"當她聽到關於她祖母健康的悲傷消息時，她發出大聲的抽泣，無法抑制淚水。","explanation":"名詞「抽泣聲」。"}],"related_forms":["sobbing","sobbed"]}

{"headword":"sober","explanation":"形容詞「清醒的」或「冷靜的」；動詞「使清醒」。常用於指沒有醉酒狀態，或指態度認真、不輕浮。","entries":[{"sentence":"The driver was fortunately <target>sober</target> during the accident, which allowed him to call for emergency help immediately.","translation":"這名駕駛在事故發生時幸好是清醒的，這使他能立即撥打緊急求救電話。","explanation":"形容詞「清醒的」。指沒有受到酒精影響。"},{"sentence":"After the excitement of the party faded, he became more <target>sober</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the challenges he would face in the upcoming exam.","translation":"派對的興奮感消退後，他對即將到來的考試所面臨的挑戰變得更加冷靜認真。","explanation":"形容詞「冷靜的、認真的」。常用搭配 sober about sth。"},{"sentence":"The shocking news of the company's bankruptcy served to <target>sober</target> the investors, making them realize the risks of the market.","translation":"公司破產的震驚消息讓投資者們清醒過來，使他們意識到市場的風險。","explanation":"動詞「使清醒」。指讓某人意識到現實或恢復理智。"}],"related_forms":["soberly","soberness"]}

{"headword":"soften","explanation":"動詞「使柔軟」、「緩和」或「使溫和」。可用於描述材質變軟，或指語氣、態度、立場的緩和。","entries":[{"sentence":"You can <target>soften</target> the butter by leaving it at room temperature for an hour before mixing it into the cake batter.","translation":"你可以將奶油放在室溫下一個小時使其軟化，然後再將其拌入蛋糕糊中。","explanation":"動詞「使柔軟」。指物理性質的改變。"},{"sentence":"Seeing the tears in her daughter's eyes, the mother's voice began to <target>soften</target>, and she finally agreed to the request.","translation":"看到女兒眼中的淚水，母親的聲音開始變得溫和，最後同意了請求。","explanation":"動詞「使溫和」。指語氣或態度的轉變。"},{"sentence":"The government decided to <target>soften</target> its <pattern>stance on</pattern> the new tax law after facing strong opposition from the public.","translation":"在面對公眾的強烈反對後，政府決定緩和對新稅法的高度強硬立場。","explanation":"動詞「緩和」。常用搭配 soften one's stance on sth (緩和對某事的立場)。"}],"related_forms":["softening"]}

{"headword":"sole","explanation":"形容詞「唯一的」；名詞「鞋底」或「魚類（比目魚）」；動詞「貼鞋底」。注意形容詞 sole 與 only 的區別，sole 通常強調唯一且排他的權利或責任。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young woman was the <target>sole</target> <pattern>survivor</pattern> of the plane crash, making her story a subject of intense media interest.","translation":"這名年輕女子是飛機失事的唯一倖存者，使她的故事成為媒體高度關注的焦點。","explanation":"形容詞「唯一的」。常用搭配 sole survivor (唯一倖存者)。"},{"sentence":"The company claimed <target>sole</target> <pattern>responsibility</pattern> for the error, promising to compensate all affected customers for their losses.","translation":"公司聲稱對該錯誤承擔唯一責任，並承諾補償所有受影響客戶的損失。","explanation":"形容詞「唯一的」。常用搭配 sole responsibility (唯一責任)。"},{"sentence":"He realized that the <target>sole</target> of his shoe had come loose, so he had to walk carefully to avoid tripping.","translation":"他發現他的鞋底脫落了，所以他必須小心行走以避免絆倒。","explanation":"名詞「鞋底」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"solo","explanation":"名詞「獨奏/獨唱」；副詞「單獨地」；形容詞「單獨的」。常用於音樂表演或單獨進行的活動（如 solo flight）。","entries":[{"sentence":"After years of playing in a band, the singer decided to release a <target>solo</target> album to express his personal musical style.","translation":"在樂團演奏多年後，這位歌手決定發行一張個人專輯，以表達他個人的音樂風格。","explanation":"形容詞「單獨的/個人的」。指不與他人合作。"},{"sentence":"The pilot felt nervous but excited when he finally took his first <target>solo</target> <pattern>flight</pattern> across the small island.","translation":"這位飛行員在終於完成第一次飛越小島的單獨飛行時，感到既緊張又興奮。","explanation":"名詞/形容詞「單獨的」。常用搭配 solo flight (單獨飛行)。"},{"sentence":"During the concert, the violinist performed a breathtaking <target>solo</target> that earned her a standing ovation from the entire audience.","translation":"在音樂會期間，小提琴手表演了一段令人驚嘆的獨奏，贏得了全場觀眾的起立鼓掌。","explanation":"名詞「獨奏/獨唱」。"},{"sentence":"She decided to travel <target>solo</target> through Europe for a month to challenge herself and meet new people from different countries.","translation":"她決定獨自在歐洲旅行一個月，以挑戰自己並結識來自不同國家的陌生人。","explanation":"副詞「單獨地」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"sophisticated","explanation":"形容詞「複雜的」、「精密的」或「老練的/成熟的」。可用於描述科技產品、系統，或人的社交技巧、品味。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new security system uses <target>sophisticated</target> <pattern>software</pattern> to detect unauthorized access and alert the guards immediately.","translation":"這套新的安全系統使用精密的軟體來偵測未經授權的進入，並立即提醒警衛。","explanation":"形容詞「精密的」。常用於描述技術或機器。"},{"sentence":"The company's <target>sophisticated</target> <pattern>marketing strategy</pattern> helped them attract young customers who value both quality and design.","translation":"該公司成熟的行銷策略幫助他們吸引到既重視品質又重視設計的年輕客戶。","explanation":"形容詞「老練的/複雜的」。常用搭配 sophisticated strategy。"},{"sentence":"She has a <target>sophisticated</target> taste in art, often visiting galleries to admire modern sculptures and abstract paintings.","translation":"她對藝術有著成熟的品味，經常參觀藝廊以欣賞現代雕塑和抽象畫。","explanation":"形容詞「成熟的/有品味的」。指對文化藝術有較高的理解。"}],"related_forms":["sophistication"]}

{"headword":"sophomore","explanation":"名詞「（高中或大學的）二年級學生」。在美國教育體系中，學生順序為 freshman, sophomore, junior, senior。","entries":[{"sentence":"As a <target>sophomore</target> in high school, he began to feel the pressure of choosing which subjects to focus on for college.","translation":"作為一名高中二年級的學生，他開始感受到選擇大學重點科目的壓力。","explanation":"名詞「二年級學生」。"},{"sentence":"The <target>sophomores</target> organized a welcoming party for the freshmen to help them adjust to the campus life more easily.","translation":"二年級學生為一年級新生舉辦了一場歡迎派對，以幫助他們更容易適應校園生活。","explanation":"名詞「二年級學生」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"souvenir","explanation":"名詞「紀念品」。指旅行或特殊事件後用來回憶的物品。注意其發音與拼寫。","entries":[{"sentence":"While visiting Kyoto, she bought a small handmade fan as a <target>souvenir</target> to remember her wonderful trip to Japan.","translation":"在訪問京都時，她買了一個手工小扇子作為紀念品，以紀念她美好的日本之旅。","explanation":"名詞「紀念品」。"},{"sentence":"The tourists spent the entire afternoon browsing the local market for unique <target>souvenirs</target> to bring back to their families.","translation":"遊客們花了一整個下午在當地市場瀏覽獨特的紀念品，準備帶回給家人。","explanation":"名詞「紀念品」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"sovereignty","explanation":"名詞「主權；獨立自主」。指一個國家對其領土、人民和事務擁有最高權力。常見搭配：national sovereignty (國家主權), respect the sovereignty of (尊重...的主權)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The small nation fought a long war to maintain its <target>sovereignty</target> and avoid being controlled by larger neighboring countries.","translation":"這個小國經歷了一場長久的戰爭以維持其主權，避免被較大的鄰國控制。","explanation":"名詞「主權」。指一個國家獨立自主的權利。"},{"sentence":"International laws are designed to ensure that all countries <pattern>respect</pattern> the <target>sovereignty</target> <pattern>of</pattern> others, regardless of their size or wealth.","translation":"國際法旨在確保所有國家，無論規模或財富如何，都能尊重他國的主權。","explanation":"名詞「主權」。常用搭配：respect the sovereignty of... (尊重...的主權)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"sow","explanation":"動詞「播種；種植」。比喻用法指「播種（種子、想法、情感等）」。常用搭配：sow the seeds of (播下...的種子/埋下...的伏筆)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The farmers spent the entire morning <target>sowing</target> wheat seeds in the fields to prepare for the autumn harvest.","translation":"農民們花了一整個上午在田裡播種小麥，為秋季的收穫做準備。","explanation":"動詞「播種」。指將種子撒在土裡。"},{"sentence":"The politician's dishonest actions <pattern>sowed</pattern> the <target>seeds</target> <pattern>of</pattern> distrust among the citizens, making it hard for them to believe his promises.","translation":"這位政治家不誠實的行為在公民之間播下了不信任的種子，使他們很難相信他的承諾。","explanation":"動詞「播種」的比喻用法。常用片語 sow the seeds of... (播下...的種子/埋下...的伏筆)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"spacious","explanation":"形容詞「寬敞的」。指空間充足且舒適。常用於描述房間、房屋或建築物。反義詞：cramped (狹窄的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After moving to the countryside, the family enjoyed living in a <target>spacious</target> house with a large garden and three sunny bedrooms.","translation":"搬到鄉下後，這家人享受住在一個擁有大花園和三個陽光房的寬敞房子裡。","explanation":"形容詞「寬敞的」。"},{"sentence":"The new city library is incredibly <target>spacious</target>, providing plenty of quiet study areas and comfortable seating for all students.","translation":"這座新的市立圖書館寬敞得令人驚訝，為所有學生提供了充足的安靜學習區和舒適的座位。","explanation":"形容詞「寬敞的」。"}],"related_forms":["spaciously"]}

{"headword":"sparkle","explanation":"動詞「閃爍；發光」；名詞「閃光；活潑」。指光線反射產生的微小閃光，或指人的眼神、性格活潑。常見搭配：sparkle with (閃著...光)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The morning dew on the grass <target>sparkled</target> in the sunlight, making the garden look like it was covered in tiny diamonds.","translation":"草地上的晨露在陽光下閃爍，讓花園看起來像覆蓋著微小的鑽石。","explanation":"動詞「閃爍」。指光線反射產生的微光。"},{"sentence":"The young girl's eyes <target>sparkled</target> <pattern>with</pattern> excitement when she finally received the acceptance letter from her dream university.","translation":"當女孩終於收到夢想大學的錄取通知書時，她的眼睛閃爍著興奮的光芒。","explanation":"動詞「閃爍」。常用搭配 sparkle with... (閃著...的光)。"},{"sentence":"The diamond ring had a brilliant <target>sparkle</target> that caught everyone's attention as soon as she walked into the room.","translation":"這枚鑽戒有著燦爛的閃光，讓她在走進房間的那一刻就吸引了所有人的注意。","explanation":"名詞「閃光」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"specialist","explanation":"名詞「專家；專科醫生」。指在某個特定領域擁有高度專業知識的人。常用搭配：a specialist in (某方面的專家)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After the general practitioner found the problem, he referred the patient to a heart <target>specialist</target> for a more detailed examination.","translation":"在全科醫生發現問題後，他將病人轉診至心臟專科醫生以進行更詳細的檢查。","explanation":"名詞「專科醫生」。"},{"sentence":"The company hired a marketing <target>specialist</target> <pattern>in</pattern> social media to help them reach a younger audience more effectively.","translation":"公司聘請了一位社交媒體行銷專家，以幫助他們更有效地接觸年輕受眾。","explanation":"名詞「專家」。常用搭配：a specialist in... (某方面的專家)。"}],"related_forms":["specialize","specialization"]}

{"headword":"specialize","explanation":"動詞「專攻；專門從事」。指將研究或工作集中在一個特定領域。常用搭配：specialize in (專攻/專精於)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although she studied general business in college, she decided to <target>specialize</target> <pattern>in</pattern> international trade after graduation.","translation":"雖然她在大學學習通用商業，但她決定在畢業後專攻國際貿易。","explanation":"動詞「專攻」。常用搭配：specialize in... (專精於...)。"},{"sentence":"This small bakery does not sell many types of bread, but they <target>specialize</target> <pattern>in</pattern> making traditional French pastries.","translation":"這家小麵包店不賣很多種類的麵包，但他們專門製作傳統的法國糕點。","explanation":"動詞「專門從事」。常用搭配：specialize in... (專精於...)。"}],"related_forms":["specialist","specialization","specialty"]}

{"headword":"specialty","explanation":"名詞「專長；特產」。指某人擅長的事情或某地區著名的產品。常用搭配：a specialty of (某人的專長/某地的特產)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Freshly baked sourdough bread is the <target>specialty</target> <pattern>of</pattern> this local bakery, and people often travel from other cities to buy it.","translation":"現烤的酸種麵包是這家當地麵包店的特產，人們經常從其他城市來買。","explanation":"名詞「特產」。常用搭配：a specialty of... (某地的特產)。"},{"sentence":"While the professor is an expert in history, his academic <target>specialty</target> is the study of ancient Egyptian architecture.","translation":"雖然這位教授是歷史專家，但他的學術專長是研究古埃及建築。","explanation":"名詞「專長」。"}],"related_forms":["specialize","specialist"]}

{"headword":"specify","explanation":"動詞「詳細說明；明確規定」。指清晰地指出或列出具體的要求或細節。常用搭配：specify that (明確規定...)，specify a date/time (明確規定日期/時間)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The application form asks candidates to <target>specify</target> their preferred start date and any special requirements they may have.","translation":"申請表要求應聘者明確說明其偏好的入職日期以及他們可能有任何特殊要求。","explanation":"動詞「詳細說明」。"},{"sentence":"The contract <target>specifies</target> <pattern>that</pattern> all payments must be made within thirty days after the invoice is received.","translation":"合約明確規定所有款項必須在收到發票後三十天內支付。","explanation":"動詞「明確規定」。常用搭配：specify that... (明確規定...)。"}],"related_forms":["specification","specific"]}

{"headword":"specimen","explanation":"名詞「標本；樣本」。指用來代表整個類別或群體而進行研究的個體。常用搭配：a specimen of (某種...的標本/樣本)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The biology student carefully collected a <target>specimen</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a rare orchid from the forest for her final research project.","translation":"這名生物系學生為了她的期末研究計畫，從森林中小心地採集了一株罕見蘭花的標本。","explanation":"名詞「標本」。常用搭配：a specimen of... (某種...的標本/樣本)。"},{"sentence":"The laboratory technician asked the patient to provide a blood <target>specimen</target> to test for the presence of a specific virus.","translation":"實驗室技術員要求病人提供血液樣本以檢測是否存在某種特定病毒。","explanation":"名詞「樣本」。指用於檢測的生物樣本。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"spectacular","explanation":"形容詞「壯觀的；驚人的」。名詞「壯觀的景象」。常用於描述風景、表演或成就。注意與 spectacle (壯觀的景象/奇觀) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The sunrise over the mountains was absolutely <target>spectacular</target>, with vibrant colors of orange and purple filling the sky.","translation":"山上的日出絕對壯觀，橙色和紫色的鮮豔色彩填滿了天空。","explanation":"形容詞「壯觀的」。"},{"sentence":"The gymnast's <target>spectacular</target> performance earned her a gold medal and left the audience in complete awe of her skill.","translation":"這名體操運動員壯觀的表演為她贏得了金牌，並讓觀眾對她的技巧感到完全敬畏。","explanation":"形容詞「驚人的」。"},{"sentence":"The fireworks display was a <target>spectacular</target> <pattern>that</pattern> attracted thousands of people to the city center on New Year's Eve.","translation":"煙火表演是一場壯觀的景象，在除夕夜吸引了數千人來到市中心。","explanation":"名詞「壯觀的景象」。"}],"related_forms":["spectacle","spectacularly"]}

{"headword":"spectator","explanation":"名詞「觀眾」。通常指體育賽事或公開活動的觀看者。注意與 audience (聽眾/觀眾) 的區別：spectator 強調「看」的動作，常用於體育場館；audience 則較廣泛，可用於音樂會、電影或演講。","entries":[{"sentence":"Thousands of <target>spectators</target> gathered at the stadium to watch the final match of the World Cup, cheering loudly for their favorite teams.","translation":"數千名觀眾聚集在體育場觀看世界盃決賽，為他們最喜愛的球隊大聲喝采。","explanation":"名詞「觀眾」。常用於體育賽事。"},{"sentence":"The police had to manage the crowd of <target>spectators</target> to ensure that the marathon runners could pass through the street safely.","translation":"警方必須管理觀眾人群，以確保馬拉松跑者能安全地通過街道。","explanation":"名詞「觀眾」。"}],"related_forms":["spectate"]}

{"headword":"spectrum","explanation":"名詞「光譜；範圍」。在科學中指光譜，在一般語境中指事物的多樣性或範圍（a spectrum of...）。","entries":[{"sentence":"A prism can split white light into a visible <target>spectrum</target> of colors, ranging from red to violet.","translation":"三稜鏡能將白光分解成可見光的色彩光譜，範圍從紅色到紫色。","explanation":"名詞「光譜」。用於物理學科學語境。"},{"sentence":"The company's new product line covers a wide <target>spectrum</target> <pattern>of</pattern> customer needs, from budget-friendly options to luxury items.","translation":"該公司的新產品線涵蓋了廣泛的客戶需求範圍，從經濟實惠的選項到奢侈品。","explanation":"名詞「範圍」。常用搭配 a wide spectrum of...。"}],"related_forms":["spectra"]}

{"headword":"speculate","explanation":"動詞「推測；投機」。指在缺乏充分證據的情況下進行猜測，或在金融市場中試圖獲利。","entries":[{"sentence":"Since the witness provided very little information, the police could only <target>speculate</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the suspect's possible motives for the crime.","translation":"由於證人提供的資訊非常少，警方只能推測嫌疑犯犯罪可能的動機。","explanation":"動詞「推測」。常用搭配 speculate about/on sth。"},{"sentence":"Some investors choose to <target>speculate</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the stock market by buying risky shares, hoping to make a quick profit.","translation":"有些投資者選擇在股市中投機，購買風險較高的股票，希望快速獲利。","explanation":"動詞「投機」。常用搭配 speculate in sth。"}],"related_forms":["speculation","speculative"]}

{"headword":"sphere","explanation":"名詞「球體；範圍/領域」。指幾何上的球形，或指某人影響力、活動或知識的特定領域。","entries":[{"sentence":"The Earth is not a perfect <target>sphere</target>, but rather an oblate spheroid, which is slightly flattened at the poles.","translation":"地球不是一個完美的球體，而是一個扁球體，在兩極稍微扁平。","explanation":"名詞「球體」。用於幾何或地理語境。"},{"sentence":"In the modern world, social media has significantly expanded the <target>sphere</target> <pattern>of</pattern> influence for many young activists.","translation":"在現代社會中，社群媒體顯著擴大了許多年輕活動家的影響力範圍。","explanation":"名詞「領域/範圍」。常用搭配 sphere of influence (影響範圍)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"spicy","explanation":"形容詞「辛辣的；刺激的」。常用於描述食物，也可比喻指內容刺激或具有爭議性。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many people in Taiwan enjoy eating <target>spicy</target> food, such as hot pot with a variety of chili peppers and spices.","translation":"許多台灣人喜歡吃辛辣食物，例如加入各種辣椒和香料的火鍋。","explanation":"形容詞「辛辣的」。"},{"sentence":"The journalist wrote a <target>spicy</target> article about the politician's private life, which caused a huge controversy in the public.","translation":"記者寫了一篇關於該政治人物私生活的刺激文章，在公眾中引起了巨大的爭議。","explanation":"形容詞「刺激的/有爭議的」。比喻用法。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"spine","explanation":"名詞「脊椎；書脊」。指生物的背骨，或書籍裝訂處的背面。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctor warned the athlete that a serious injury to the <target>spine</target> could lead to permanent paralysis of the lower body.","translation":"醫生警告該運動員，脊椎的嚴重損傷可能會導致下半身永久癱瘓。","explanation":"名詞「脊椎」。用於醫療或生物語境。"},{"sentence":"When organizing the library, the students could easily find the books they needed by looking at the titles printed on the <target>spine</target> of each book.","translation":"在整理圖書館時，學生可以透過查看每本書書脊上印的標題，輕鬆找到他們需要的書。","explanation":"名詞「書脊」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"sponge","explanation":"名詞「海綿」。動詞「吸收」或「依附/啃老」。注意動詞片語 sponge off (從...獲利/依附於...生存)。","entries":[{"sentence":"She used a soft <target>sponge</target> to gently clean the delicate surface of the old painting without causing any damage.","translation":"她使用柔軟的海綿輕輕清潔舊畫的精緻表面，而不會造成任何損壞。","explanation":"名詞「海綿」。"},{"sentence":"He is known as a quick learner who can <target>sponge</target> <pattern>up</pattern> new information as if he were a human sponge.","translation":"他被認為是一個學習快速的人，能像海綿一樣迅速吸收新資訊。","explanation":"動詞「吸收」。常用搭配 sponge up sth。"},{"sentence":"His parents were frustrated because their son continued to <target>sponge</target> <pattern>off</pattern> them long after he had graduated from college.","translation":"他的父母感到沮喪，因為他們的兒子在大學畢業後很長時間仍繼續依附他們生存。","explanation":"動詞片語 sponge off sth/sb (依附於...生存)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"sponsor","explanation":"名詞「贊助者」；動詞「贊助」。指提供資金或資源以支持某項活動或計畫。","entries":[{"sentence":"The local sports brand agreed to <target>sponsor</target> the school's basketball team, providing them with new uniforms and equipment.","translation":"當地運動品牌同意贊助學校的籃球球隊，為他們提供新制服和設備。","explanation":"動詞「贊助」。"},{"sentence":"A major technology company acted as the main <target>sponsor</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the international science fair, covering all the event's expenses.","translation":"一家大型科技公司擔任國際科學展的首席贊助者，支付了該活動的所有費用。","explanation":"名詞「贊助者」。常用搭配 sponsor of sth。"}],"related_forms":["sponsorship"]}

{"headword":"sponsorship","explanation":"名詞「贊助」。指贊助行為或贊助協議本身。","entries":[{"sentence":"The event organizers are currently seeking corporate <target>sponsorship</target> to fund the research project on environmental protection.","translation":"活動主辦方目前正在尋求企業贊助，以資助環境保護的研究計畫。","explanation":"名詞「贊助」。常用搭配 seek sponsorship。"},{"sentence":"Through a generous <target>sponsorship</target> <pattern>from</pattern> a former student, the university was able to build a new modern library.","translation":"透過一名校友的慷慨贊助，大學得以建造一座新的現代化圖書館。","explanation":"名詞「贊助」。常用搭配 sponsorship from sb。"}],"related_forms":["sponsor"]}

{"headword":"spouse","explanation":"名詞「配偶」。正式用語，指丈夫或妻子。常用於法律文件或申請表單中。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company's health insurance plan is very comprehensive, as it extends coverage to the employee's <target>spouse</target> and children.","translation":"公司的醫療保險計畫非常全面，因為它將保障範圍擴展到員工的配偶和孩子。","explanation":"名詞「配偶」。"},{"sentence":"In the application form, please indicate whether you are single or married, and provide the name and contact information of your <target>spouse</target>.","translation":"在申請表中，請註明您是單身還是已婚，並提供您配偶的姓名和聯繫方式。","explanation":"名詞「配偶」。"}],"related_forms":["spouses"]}

{"headword":"squad","explanation":"名詞，指「小隊」或「團隊」。常用於體育（如足球隊的 squad）或警察/軍隊的小組。注意與 team 的區別：team 通常指整體隊伍，而 squad 側重於一個較小的、執行特定任務的專業分組。","entries":[{"sentence":"The coach decided to include three new players in the national <target>squad</target> to strengthen the defense before the upcoming World Cup.","translation":"教練決定在國家隊小隊中加入三名新球員，以便在即將到來的世界盃之前加強防守。","explanation":"名詞「小隊」。指體育團隊中的成員名單。"},{"sentence":"A specialized police <target>squad</target> was sent to the scene of the accident to handle the hazardous materials safely.","translation":"一支專業的警察小隊被派往事故現場，以安全地處理危險物質。","explanation":"名詞「小隊」。指執行特定任務的專業小組。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"squash","explanation":"動詞「壓扁、壓碎」；名詞「壁球」或「南瓜類蔬菜」。在 GSAT 中，動詞用法（壓扁）和名詞用法（壁球）最為常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"The heavy suitcase accidentally <target>squashed</target> the fragile box of chocolates, leaving the sweets completely flattened on the floor.","translation":"沉重的行李箱不小心將脆弱的巧克力盒子壓扁了，使得甜點完全被壓扁在地上。","explanation":"動詞「壓扁」。指用力將某物壓平。"},{"sentence":"After school, Mark and his friends often play <target>squash</target> at the local sports center to stay active and healthy.","translation":"放學後，馬克和他的朋友們經常在當地的體育中心打壁球以保持活力與健康。","explanation":"名詞「壁球」。一種室內球類運動。"},{"sentence":"The chef used a potato masher to <target>squash</target> the boiled potatoes into a smooth, creamy puree for the side dish.","translation":"廚師使用馬鈴薯壓泥器將煮熟的馬鈴薯壓成平滑、濃郁的泥狀，作為配菜。","explanation":"動詞「壓碎」。指將食物壓成泥狀。"},{"sentence":"To make a traditional autumn soup, the cook added chopped <target>squash</target> to the pot, giving the broth a rich orange color.","translation":"為了製作傳統的秋季湯品，廚師在鍋中加入了切碎的南瓜，使湯頭呈現濃郁的橙色。","explanation":"名詞「南瓜類蔬菜」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"squat","explanation":"動詞「蹲下」；名詞「蹲姿」；形容詞「矮胖的」。常用於體能訓練（深蹲）或描述建築物、人物的體型。","entries":[{"sentence":"The photographer had to <target>squat</target> low to the ground to get the perfect angle for the photo of the small kitten.","translation":"攝影師必須低低地蹲在地上，才能為那隻小貓拍到完美的角度。","explanation":"動詞「蹲下」。"},{"sentence":"As part of his daily workout routine, Jason does three sets of twenty <target>squats</target> to build strength in his legs.","translation":"作為每日健身習慣的一部分，傑森每組做二十次深蹲，共三組，以增加腿部力量。","explanation":"名詞「深蹲」。指一種體能訓練動作。"},{"sentence":"The old warehouse was a <target>squat</target>, grey building that looked very imposing and heavy against the cloudy sky.","translation":"那座舊倉庫是一棟矮胖的灰色建築，在陰天之下看起來非常雄偉且沉重。","explanation":"形容詞「矮胖的」。描述建築物或物體的高度低且寬。"}],"related_forms":[]}
comment: The sentence for the adjective usage is slightly illogical: a building being 'imposing' (grand/impressive) and 'squat' (short and thick) are often contradictory in architectural description. Suggest changing 'imposing' to 'sturdy' or 'unremarkable'.

response: {"headword":"stability","explanation":"名詞「穩定性」。指狀態不輕易變動。常用於描述經濟、情緒、建築結構或政治局勢。形容詞為 stable。","entries":[{"sentence":"Economists argue that political <target>stability</target> is essential for a country to attract foreign investment and grow its economy.","translation":"經濟學家認為，政治穩定對於一個國家吸引外國投資和發展經濟至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「穩定性」。常用搭配：political stability (政治穩定)。"},{"sentence":"The patient's condition has reached a level of <target>stability</target>, allowing the doctors to begin the physical therapy process.","translation":"病人的狀況已達到穩定狀態，使醫生能夠開始物理治療過程。","explanation":"名詞「穩定性」。指生理狀態的穩定。"},{"sentence":"The engineer checked the <target>stability</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the bridge's foundation to ensure it could withstand strong earthquakes.","translation":"工程師檢查了橋樑地基的穩定性，以確保它能承受強震。","explanation":"名詞「穩定性」。常用搭配：stability of sth (某物的穩定性)。"}],"related_forms":["stable"]}

{"headword": "stack", "explanation": "名詞「一疊、一堆」；動詞「堆疊」。常用於描述書籍、盤子或資料的堆放方式。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The librarian asked the students to organize the <target>stacks</target> <pattern>of</pattern> books on the table before returning them to the shelves.", "translation": "圖書管理員要求學生在將書放回書架前，將桌上的一疊疊書整理好。", "explanation": "名詞「一疊」。常用搭配：stacks of sth (一疊疊的...)。"}, {"sentence": "To save space in the small kitchen, Sarah <target>stacked</target> the clean plates <pattern>on top of</pattern> each other in the cupboard.", "translation": "為了節省小廚房的空間，莎拉將洗淨的盤子在櫥櫃中一個疊一個地堆放。", "explanation": "動詞「堆疊」。指將物品疊在一起。"}, {"sentence": "The office worker spent the entire morning <target>stacking</target> the files into neat <target>stacks</target> to prepare for the annual audit.", "translation": "辦公室職員整個上午都在將文件堆成整齊的一疊疊，為年度審計做準備。", "explanation": "動詞「堆疊」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"stain","explanation":"名詞「污漬、染料」；動詞「弄髒、染色」。注意 stain 與 dirty 的區別：stain 指的是一種較難去除的痕跡（如咖啡漬或油漬），而 dirty 僅指一般的髒污。","entries":[{"sentence":"She used a special cleaner to remove the stubborn coffee <target>stain</target> from her white shirt before the important interview.","translation":"在重要面試之前，她使用特殊的清潔劑將白色襯衫上頑固的咖啡污漬去除。","explanation":"名詞「污漬」。指難以去除的痕跡。"},{"sentence":"Be careful not to <target>stain</target> the new carpet with red wine, as it is very expensive and difficult to clean.","translation":"小心不要用紅酒弄髒新地毯，因為它非常昂貴且難以清洗。","explanation":"動詞「弄髒」。"},{"sentence":"The carpenter applied a dark wood <target>stain</target> to the table to give it a more elegant and polished look.","translation":"木工將深色木材染料塗在桌子上，使其看起來更優雅且有光澤。","explanation":"名詞「染料」。指改變顏色以美化物體的物質。"}],"related_forms":["stained"]}

{"headword":"stake","explanation":"名詞用法包括「樁子」和「賭注」；動詞則指「賭注」或「投資」。常見考點為名詞的「賭注」之意，以及片語 at stake (處於危險之中/有風險)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The farmers drove a wooden <target>stake</target> into the ground to support the young tomato plants as they grew taller.","translation":"農民將木樁釘入地下，以支撐長高中的年輕番茄植株。","explanation":"名詞「樁子」。"},{"sentence":"In the high-stakes poker game, the professional gambler decided to raise his <target>stake</target> to intimidate his opponents.","translation":"在場高風險的撲克遊戲中，專業賭徒決定增加他的賭注以威脅對手。","explanation":"名詞「賭注」。"},{"sentence":"The committee realized that the future of the local library was <target>at stake</target>, so they fought hard to secure more funding.","translation":"委員會意識到當地圖書館的未來正處於危險之中，因此他們努力爭取更多資金。","explanation":"名詞片語 at stake 表示「處於危險之中」或「有風險」。"},{"sentence":"The venture capitalist decided to <target>stake</target> his entire reputation <pattern>on</pattern> the success of the new AI startup company.","translation":"風險投資家決定將他的整個名聲賭在這次新 AI 新創公司的成功上。","explanation":"動詞「賭注/投資」。常用搭配：stake sth on sth。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"stall","explanation":"名詞「攤位」或「馬廄」；動詞「熄火」或「拖延」。在 GSAT 中，名詞的「攤位」和動詞的「拖延」用法最為常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"While visiting the night market, we stopped at a small food <target>stall</target> that sold the most delicious grilled squid in the city.","translation":"逛夜市時，我們在一個賣城市中最美味烤魷魚的小食攤前停下來。","explanation":"名詞「攤位」。"},{"sentence":"The student tried to <target>stall</target> <pattern>for</pattern> time by asking the teacher many complex questions during the oral exam.","translation":"學生在口試過程中透過詢問老師許多複雜的問題來拖延時間。","explanation":"動詞片語 stall for time 表示「拖延時間」。"},{"sentence":"The beginner driver was nervous and accidentally caused the car engine to <target>stall</target> right in the middle of the intersection.","translation":"新手駕駛非常緊張，不小心導致汽車引擎在十字路口正中間熄火。","explanation":"動詞「熄火」。指引擎停止運作。"},{"sentence":"The horses were kept in clean, separate <target>stalls</target> within the stable to ensure their health and safety.","translation":"馬匹被安置在馬廄內乾淨且獨立的馬廄隔間中，以確保其健康與安全。","explanation":"名詞「馬廄」。"}],"related_forms":[]}
