{"headword": "stance", "explanation": "名詞，指「立場」或「姿勢」。常用於描述對某個議題的看法（立場）或身體的站立姿勢。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The government has taken a firm <target>stance</target> <pattern>against</pattern> air pollution, introducing new laws to reduce factory emissions.", "translation": "政府採取了堅定的立場反對空氣污染，並引入新法律以減少工廠排放。", "explanation": "名詞「立場」。常用搭配：take a stance against/on sth。"}, {"sentence": "The tennis player adjusted his <target>stance</target> to better prepare for the opponent's powerful serve, keeping his feet wide apart.", "translation": "網球球員調整了他的站姿，以更好地準備迎接對手的強力發球，雙腳分開。", "explanation": "名詞「姿勢」。指身體的站立方式。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"startle","explanation":"動詞「使驚嚇」。指突然的驚訝或恐懼，通常伴隨著身體的跳起或顫抖。注意與 surprise 的區別：surprise 側重於意想不到的事，而 startle 側重於突然且令人驚跳的反應。","entries":[{"sentence":"The sudden loud noise from the construction site <target>startled</target> the sleeping baby, who began to cry immediately.","translation":"建築工地傳來的突然大聲噪音驚嚇到了熟睡的嬰兒，他立即開始哭泣。","explanation":"動詞「使驚嚇」。指突然的外部刺激導致的驚跳。"},{"sentence":"I was <target>startled</target> <pattern>by</pattern> the sudden appearance of a spider on my shoulder, making me jump back in fear.","translation":"我被肩上突然出現的一隻蜘蛛驚嚇到了，讓我恐懼地向後跳起。","explanation":"動詞「被驚嚇」。常用搭配：be startled by sth。"},{"sentence":"When the teacher walked into the classroom unexpectedly, she <target>startled</target> several students who were secretly talking to each other.","translation":"當老師意外地走進教室時，她驚嚇到了幾個正在秘密交談的學生。","explanation":"動詞「使驚嚇」。"}],"related_forms":["startlingly","startling"]}

{"headword":"statistical","explanation":"形容詞「統計的」。常用於描述與數據分析、概率或數學統計相關的事物。常見搭配 statistical data (統計數據)、statistical analysis (統計分析) 或 statistical evidence (統計證據)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The researchers used <target>statistical</target> <pattern>analysis</pattern> to determine if the difference between the two groups was significant or just a result of chance.","translation":"研究人員使用了統計分析來確定兩組之間的差異是顯著的，還是僅僅是偶然的結果。","explanation":"形容詞「統計的」。常用搭配 statistical analysis (統計分析)。"},{"sentence":"According to the latest <target>statistical</target> <pattern>data</pattern>, the birth rate in this city has decreased steadily over the past decade.","translation":"根據最新的統計數據，這個城市的出生率在過去十年中穩步下降。","explanation":"形容詞「統計的」。常用搭配 statistical data (統計數據)。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer argued that there was no <target>statistical</target> <pattern>evidence</pattern> to support the claim that the new drug caused the side effects.","translation":"律師辯稱，沒有統計證據支持該新藥導致副作用的說法。","explanation":"形容詞「統計的」。常用搭配 statistical evidence (統計證據)。"}],"related_forms":["statistics","statistically"]}

{"headword":"steer","explanation":"動詞「駕駛、引導」；名詞「小牛」。動詞常用片語 steer A toward B (引導 A 走向 B) 或 steer clear of (避開)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The experienced captain used the wheel to <target>steer</target> the ship <pattern>through</pattern> the narrow channel to avoid hitting the hidden rocks.","translation":"經驗豐富的船長使用舵輪將船導航通過狹窄的通道，以避免撞到隱藏的岩石。","explanation":"動詞「駕駛、操控」。指操控車輛、船隻等方向。"},{"sentence":"During the career counseling session, the teacher tried to <target>steer</target> the students <pattern>toward</pattern> majors that matched their strengths.","translation":"在職涯諮詢會議中，老師試圖引導學生選擇與其強項相符的主修科目。","explanation":"動詞「引導」。指引導某人走向特定方向或決定。"},{"sentence":"To avoid unnecessary arguments with his boss, he decided to <target>steer</target> <pattern>clear of</pattern> the topic of politics during the lunch break.","translation":"為了避免與老闆發生不必要的爭執，他決定在午休時間避開政治話題。","explanation":"動詞片語 steer clear of 表示「避開」。"},{"sentence":"The farmer led the young <target>steer</target> to the pasture, ensuring the animal was healthy and well-fed before the market day.","translation":"農夫將小牛領到牧場，確保動物在市場日之前健康且餵養良好。","explanation":"名詞「小牛」。指未閹割的年輕公牛。"}],"related_forms":["steering"]}

{"headword": "stereotype", "explanation": "名詞「刻板印象」；動詞「將...形成刻板印象」。名詞常用搭配 break the stereotype (打破刻板印象) 或 fight the stereotype (對抗刻板印象)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The movie was praised for breaking the <target>stereotype</target> that all scientists are socially awkward and spend all their time in laboratories.", "translation": "這部電影因打破了所有科學家都社交笨拙且整天待在實驗室的刻板印象而受到稱讚。", "explanation": "名詞「刻板印象」。指對特定群體的一般化看法。"}, {"sentence": "Many people still <target>stereotype</target> elderly people as being slow and unable to use modern technology, which is often not true.", "translation": "許多人仍然將老年人刻板地認為是緩慢且無法使用現代科技的，而這通常並非事實。", "explanation": "動詞「將...形成刻板印象」。"}, {"sentence": "Society often <target>stereotypes</target> students who wear glasses as being studious and quiet, regardless of their actual personalities.", "translation": "社會經常將戴眼鏡的學生刻板地認為是勤奮且安靜的，而不管他們的實際性格如何。", "explanation": "動詞「將...形成刻板印象」。"}], "related_forms": ["stereotypical", "stereotypically"]}

{"headword":"stew","explanation":"名詞「燉菜」；動詞「燉」。此外，stew 也可以作為比喻，指「焦慮地等待」或「處於不安狀態」。","entries":[{"sentence":"On cold winter evenings, my grandmother always prepares a hearty beef <target>stew</target> with potatoes and carrots to warm us up.","translation":"在寒冷的冬夜，我的祖母總是準備一份豐盛的牛肉燉菜，加入馬鈴薯和紅蘿蔔來讓我們暖身。","explanation":"名詞「燉菜」。"},{"sentence":"The chef showed the students how to <target>stew</target> the meat <pattern>on</pattern> low heat for several hours to make it tender and juicy.","translation":"主廚向學生展示如何用低溫將肉燉煮數小時，使其變得鮮嫩多汁。","explanation":"動詞「燉」。指用少量液體長時間慢煮。"},{"sentence":"He was left to <target>stew</target> <pattern>in</pattern> his own juice after the manager refused to give him an answer immediately.","translation":"在經理拒絕立即給他答案後，他被留在原地焦慮地等待。","explanation":"動詞片語 stew in one's own juice 指「在不安或焦慮中煎熬」。"}],"related_forms":["stewed"]}

{"headword":"stimulate","explanation":"動詞「刺激、激發」。常用於描述生理刺激或激發興趣、經濟或思考。常用搭配 stimulate interest (激發興趣) 或 stimulate the economy (刺激經濟)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher used colorful pictures and interactive games to <target>stimulate</target> the students' <pattern>interest in</pattern> history and archaeology.","translation":"老師使用彩色圖片和互動遊戲來激發學生對歷史和考古學的興趣。","explanation":"動詞「刺激、激發」。常用搭配 stimulate interest in sth。"},{"sentence":"The government decided to lower interest rates to <target>stimulate</target> <pattern>economic growth</pattern> after the severe financial crisis.","translation":"政府決定降低利率，以在嚴重的金融危機後刺激經濟成長。","explanation":"動詞「刺激經濟」。常用搭配 stimulate economic growth。"},{"sentence":"Drinking a cup of coffee in the morning often helps to <target>stimulate</target> the brain and improve focus during early lectures.","translation":"早晨喝一杯咖啡通常有助於刺激大腦並提高早課期間的注意力。","explanation":"動詞「刺激」。指生理上的刺激。"}],"related_forms":["stimulation","stimulant","stimulus"]}

{"headword":"stimulus","explanation":"名詞「刺激、刺激物」。指引起某種反應或活動的外部因素。常用複數形式為 stimuli。常用搭配 provide a stimulus for (為...提供刺激)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new tax cuts served as a powerful <target>stimulus</target> <pattern>for</pattern> local businesses to expand and hire more employees.","translation":"新的減稅措施為當地企業擴張並雇用更多員工提供了強大的刺激。","explanation":"名詞「刺激」。指促使某事發生的誘因。"},{"sentence":"Psychologists study how the human brain reacts to different <target>stimuli</target>, such as loud noises or bright flashing lights.","translation":"心理學家研究人類大腦如何對不同的刺激物做出反應，例如巨大的噪音或閃爍的亮光。","explanation":"名詞「刺激物」。此處為複數形式 stimuli。"},{"sentence":"The promising reward offered by the school was a great <target>stimulus</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the students to study harder for the final exams.","translation":"學校提供的誘人獎勵對學生在期末考前更加努力學習是一個巨大的刺激。","explanation":"名詞「刺激」。指激發行動的誘因。"}],"related_forms":["stimulate","stimulation"]}

{"headword": "stink", "explanation": "動詞「發臭」；名詞「臭味」。此外，stink 也可以比喻指「表現極差」或「引起醜聞」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "If you do not take out the garbage regularly, the kitchen will quickly <target>stink</target> <pattern>of</pattern> rotten eggs and old food.", "translation": "如果你不定期地倒垃圾，廚房很快就會散發出臭雞蛋和舊食物的臭味。", "explanation": "動詞「發臭」。常用搭配 stink of sth (散發出...的臭味)。"}, {"sentence": "The locker room <target>stank</target> after the basketball team finished their practice, as the smell of sweat was overwhelming.", "translation": "籃球隊練習結束後，更衣室裡充滿了臭味，因為汗水的味道太強烈了。", "explanation": "動詞「發臭」。"}, {"sentence": "The athlete's performance <target>stank</target> during the first half of the game, but he managed to recover and score in the last minute.", "translation": "這名運動員在比賽前半場的表現極差，但他在最後一分鐘成功恢復並得分。", "explanation": "動詞「表現極差」。此處為過去式 stank。"}, {"sentence": "The corruption scandal caused a huge <target>stink</target> in the local government, leading to the resignation of several high-ranking officials.", "translation": "這起腐敗醜聞在當地政府引起了巨大的爭議，導致幾位高官辭職。", "explanation": "名詞「醜聞、爭議」。指引起不滿或憤怒的事件。"}], "related_forms": ["stinky"]}

{"headword":"stock","explanation":"名詞「庫存、股票、股份」。指儲存的物品或對公司的所有權。常用片語 in stock (有貨) 或 out of stock (缺貨)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The bookstore informed me that the latest novel by the famous author was <pattern>out of</pattern> <target>stock</target>, but they could order it for me.","translation":"書店告知我，那位著名作者的最新小說目前缺貨，但他們可以為我訂購。","explanation":"名詞「庫存」。常用片語 out of stock (缺貨)。"},{"sentence":"Many young professionals invest their savings <pattern>in</pattern> <target>stocks</target> to build wealth over a long period of time.","translation":"許多年輕專業人士將儲蓄投資於股票，以在長期間內累積財富。","explanation":"名詞「股票」。"},{"sentence":"The company decided to increase its <target>stock</target> <pattern>of</pattern> raw materials to avoid any production delays during the holiday season.","translation":"公司決定增加原材料的庫存，以避免在假期期間出現任何生產延遲。","explanation":"名詞「庫存」。常用搭配 stock of sth。"},{"sentence":"He has a vast <target>stock</target> <pattern>of</pattern> jokes and funny stories that always make the classmates laugh during the break.","translation":"他擁有大量的笑話和有趣的故事，總能讓同學們在休息時間大笑。","explanation":"名詞「儲備」。比喻指儲存的知識或故事。"}],"related_forms":["stockpile","stockholder"]}

{"headword":"storage","explanation":"名詞「儲存、儲藏空間」。常用於描述電腦硬碟空間或實體倉庫空間。常用搭配 storage space (儲存空間) 或 in storage (儲藏中)。","entries":[{"sentence":"I need to buy a new laptop with more <target>storage</target> <pattern>space</pattern> to store all my high-resolution photos and video projects.","translation":"我需要買一台有更多儲存空間的筆記型電腦，用來儲存我所有的高解析度照片和影片專案。","explanation":"名詞「儲存空間」。常用搭配 storage space。"},{"sentence":"The family put their old furniture <pattern>in</pattern> <target>storage</target> before moving to a smaller apartment in the city center.","translation":"這家人在搬到市中心較小的公寓之前，將他們的舊家具儲藏起來。","explanation":"名詞「儲存」。常用片語 in storage (儲藏中)。"},{"sentence":"Proper <target>storage</target> <pattern>conditions</pattern> are essential for keeping food fresh and preventing the growth of harmful bacteria.","translation":"適當的儲存條件對於保持食物新鮮並防止有害細菌生長至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「儲存」。常用搭配 storage conditions (儲存條件)。"}],"related_forms":["store"]}

{"headword":"straighten","explanation":"動詞「弄直、整理」。常用於描述使某物不再彎曲，或整理房間、衣服等使其整潔。常用搭配 straighten up (整理)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The dentist suggested that the student wear braces for two years to <target>straighten</target> <pattern>his teeth</pattern> and improve his smile.","translation":"牙醫建議這名學生戴兩年牙套，以將他的牙齒弄直並改善他的笑容。","explanation":"動詞「弄直」。"},{"sentence":"Please <target>straighten</target> <pattern>up</pattern> your room before the guests arrive, as it looks like a storm has hit it.","translation":"請在客人到達之前整理好你的房間，因為它現在看起來像被暴風雨襲擊過一樣。","explanation":"動詞片語 straighten up 表示「整理」。"},{"sentence":"She paused for a moment to <target>straighten</target> <pattern>her dress</pattern> before walking onto the stage to give her final presentation.","translation":"她在走上舞台進行最終簡報之前，停頓了一下以整理她的衣服。","explanation":"動詞「整理」。指將衣服弄整齊。"}],"related_forms":["straight","straightener"]}

{"headword": "straightforward", "explanation": "形容詞「簡單直接的」或「坦率的」。常用於描述任務容易完成，或人的性格誠實、不隱瞞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The teacher gave <target>straightforward</target> instructions for the science project, so every student knew exactly what to do.", "translation": "老師為科學計畫提供了簡單直接的指示，所以每個學生都清楚知道該做什麼。", "explanation": "形容詞「簡單直接的」。描述指示或過程不複雜。"}, {"sentence": "I appreciate his <target>straightforward</target> approach to solving the problem, as he tells the truth without trying to hide anything.", "translation": "我很欣賞他解決問題的坦率方式，因為他實話實說，沒有試圖隱瞞任何事情。", "explanation": "形容詞「坦率的」。描述人的性格或溝通方式誠實。"}, {"sentence": "Although the manual was long, the installation process was <target>straightforward</target> and took only fifteen minutes to complete.", "translation": "雖然說明書很長，但安裝過程很簡單直接，僅用了十五分鐘就完成。", "explanation": "形容詞「簡單直接的」。指過程不複雜。"}, {"sentence": "The lawyer provided a <target>straightforward</target> answer to the judge's question, leaving no room for confusion or ambiguity.", "translation": "律師對法官的問題提供了坦率且直接的回答，沒有留下任何混淆或模稜兩可之處。", "explanation": "形容詞「坦率的」。指溝通直接且誠實。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"strain","explanation":"動詞「拉緊」、「使疲憊」或「過度使用」；名詞「壓力」或「菌株/品系」。常用搭配：strain your muscles (拉傷肌肉), put a strain on (給...帶來壓力), under strain (在壓力下)。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you lift heavy boxes without bending your knees, you might <target>strain</target> a muscle in your back.","translation":"如果你在搬重箱子時沒有彎曲膝蓋，你可能會拉傷背部肌肉。","explanation":"動詞「拉傷/過度使用」。指肌肉因過度用力而受傷。"},{"sentence":"Working two part-time jobs while studying for final exams put a great <target>strain</target> <pattern>on</pattern> his physical and mental health.","translation":"在準備期末考的同時打兩份兼職工作，給他的身心健康帶來了巨大的壓力。","explanation":"名詞「壓力」。片語 put a strain on 表示「對...造成壓力」。"},{"sentence":"The bridge was <target>strained</target> to its limit during the storm when thousands of cars tried to cross it at once.","translation":"在風暴期間，當數千輛汽車試圖同時通過時，這座橋樑承受了極限的壓力。","explanation":"動詞「拉緊/承受壓力」。此處為被動態，描述結構承受壓力。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are studying a new <target>strain</target> of the virus to develop a more effective vaccine for the public.","translation":"科學家正在研究一種新的病毒菌株，以便為大眾研發更有效的疫苗。","explanation":"名詞「菌株/品系」。生物學術語。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "strand", "explanation": "動詞「使擱淺」或「使陷入困境」；名詞「一股/一條（線、髮絲）」。注意動詞用法常為被動態 be stranded (受困於...)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The sudden cancellation of all flights <target>stranded</target> hundreds of travelers at the airport for two whole days.", "translation": "所有航班的突然取消使數百名旅客在機場受困整整兩天。", "explanation": "動詞「使陷入困境」。指因外部因素而無法離開某地。"}, {"sentence": "After the heavy storm, several whales were <target>stranded</target> on the sandy beach, and locals tried to push them back into the ocean.", "translation": "大風暴後，幾頭鯨魚在沙灘上擱淺，當地人試圖將牠們推回大海。", "explanation": "動詞「使擱淺」。指海洋生物被沖到岸上。"}, {"sentence": "She gently tucked a loose <target>strand</target> of hair behind her ear while she was focusing on the difficult math problem.", "translation": "當她專注於那道困難的數學題時，她輕輕地將一縷散落的頭髮別在耳後。", "explanation": "名詞「一股/一條」。指頭髮或線的一根。"}, {"sentence": "Thousands of tourists were <target>stranded</target> in the mountain resort after a massive landslide blocked the only road out of the valley.", "translation": "由於大規模的山崩阻塞了山谷中唯一的出路，數千名遊客在山區度假村受困。", "explanation": "動詞「使陷入困境」。指受困於某地。"}], "related_forms": ["stranded"]}

{"headword":"strap","explanation":"名詞「帶子/皮帶」；動詞「用帶子繫緊」。常用搭配：shoulder strap (肩帶), strap in (繫好安全帶)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student realized that the <target>strap</target> of her backpack was broken, so she had to carry it by hand.","translation":"學生意識到她背包的肩帶斷了，所以她不得不把它用手提著。","explanation":"名詞「帶子」。指用來固定或承重的小皮帶或布帶。"},{"sentence":"Please <target>strap</target> yourself <pattern>in</pattern> securely before the roller coaster starts moving for your own safety.","translation":"為了您自己的安全，在雲霄飛車開始移動之前，請將自己安全地繫好。","explanation":"動詞片語 strap in 表示「繫好安全帶/固定住」。"},{"sentence":"He used a strong leather <target>strap</target> to tie the luggage firmly to the roof of the car before the trip.","translation":"在旅行之前，他使用一條強韌的皮帶將行李牢牢地繫在汽車頂上。","explanation":"名詞「帶子」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"strategic","explanation":"形容詞「策略性的」或「戰略上的」。指為了達成長期目標而精心計劃的。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company made a <target>strategic</target> decision to expand its business into the Asian market to increase its global sales.","translation":"該公司做出了一個策略性的決定，將業務擴展到亞洲市場以增加全球銷售額。","explanation":"形容詞「策略性的」。指經過深思熟慮的計畫。"},{"sentence":"In the basketball game, the coach changed the team's <target>strategic</target> formation to stop the opponent's star player from scoring.","translation":"在籃球賽中，教練改變了球隊的策略陣型，以阻止對手的明星球員得分。","explanation":"形容詞「策略性的」。指在競爭中使用的技巧或計畫。"}],"related_forms":["strategically","strategy"]}

{"headword":"striking","explanation":"形容詞「顯著的」、「引人注目的」或「驚人的」。常用於描述外貌出色或差異極其明顯。","entries":[{"sentence":"There is a <target>striking</target> difference between the two paintings, as one uses bright colors while the other is completely gray.","translation":"這兩幅畫之間有顯著的差異，因為一幅使用了鮮豔的色彩，而另一幅則是完全灰色的。","explanation":"形容詞「顯著的」。描述兩者之間明顯的對比。"},{"sentence":"The model had <target>striking</target> blue eyes that immediately caught the attention of everyone in the room.","translation":"那位模特兒擁有一雙引人注目的藍色眼睛，立刻吸引了房間裡所有人的注意。","explanation":"形容詞「引人注目的」。描述外貌非常出眾。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"structural","explanation":"形容詞「結構的」或「結構上的」。指某物組成方式或其基礎框架的。","entries":[{"sentence":"After the earthquake, engineers had to inspect the building for any <target>structural</target> damage to ensure it was still safe.","translation":"地震後，工程師必須檢查建築物是否有結構性損壞，以確保其依然安全。","explanation":"形容詞「結構的」。指建築物基礎框架的損壞。"},{"sentence":"The professor explained that the <target>structural</target> differences between the two languages make it difficult for students to learn both.","translation":"教授解釋說，這兩種語言在結構上的差異使得學生很難同時學習這兩種語言。","explanation":"形容詞「結構的」。指語言的組成方式或語法框架。"}],"related_forms":["structure","structurally"]}

{"headword":"stumble","explanation":"動詞「絆倒」或「偶然發現」；名詞「絆倒」。常用片語：stumble upon (偶然發現)。","entries":[{"sentence":"While walking through the dark forest, the hiker <target>stumbled</target> over a hidden tree root and fell forward.","translation":"在穿過黑暗的森林時，徒步旅行者被隱藏的樹根絆倒並向前摔倒。","explanation":"動詞「絆倒」。指腳被東西擋住而失去平衡。"},{"sentence":"While searching for old photos in the attic, I <target>stumbled</target> <pattern>upon</pattern> a dusty diary written by my great-grandfather.","translation":"在閣樓找舊照片時，我偶然發現了一本由我曾祖父寫的佈滿灰塵的日記。","explanation":"動詞片語 stumble upon 表示「偶然發現」。"},{"sentence":"The nervous speaker made a few <target>stumbles</target> during his presentation, but he quickly recovered and finished his speech.","translation":"這位緊張的演講者在簡報過程中發生了幾次結巴（絆倒），但他很快恢復並完成了演講。","explanation":"名詞「絆倒」。此處比喻說話不流暢或出錯。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"sturdy","explanation":"形容詞「堅固的」或「強壯的」。常用於描述家具、建築或人的體格。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you plan to go hiking in the mountains, you should wear <target>sturdy</target> boots to protect your ankles.","translation":"如果你計畫去山裡健行，你應該穿堅固的靴子來保護你的腳踝。","explanation":"形容詞「堅固的」。描述鞋子耐用且有支撐力。"},{"sentence":"The farmers built a <target>sturdy</target> fence around the garden to keep the wild animals from eating the vegetables.","translation":"農民在花園周圍築起一道堅固的圍欄，以防止野生動物吃掉蔬菜。","explanation":"形容詞「堅固的」。描述構造牢固。"}],"related_forms":["sturdily","sturdiness"]}

{"headword":"submit","explanation":"動詞「提交」或「屈服」。提交常用於作業、申請書；屈服常用於 submit to (屈服於/服從)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher reminded the students to <target>submit</target> their final essays <pattern>by</pattern> Friday afternoon to avoid any point deductions.","translation":"老師提醒學生在週五下午前提交最終論文，以避免被扣分。","explanation":"動詞「提交」。常用搭配 submit something by [time]。"},{"sentence":"After hours of intense negotiation, the smaller company finally decided to <target>submit</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the terms of the merger.","translation":"經過數小時的激烈協商，這家較小的公司最終決定接受（屈服於）合併條款。","explanation":"動詞片語 submit to 表示「屈服於」或「服從」。"},{"sentence":"You can <target>submit</target> your application for the scholarship online, but you must upload a digital copy of your transcript.","translation":"你可以透過網路提交獎學金申請，但你必須上傳成績單的數位副本。","explanation":"動詞「提交」。"}],"related_forms":["submission"]}

{"headword":"subsequent","explanation":"形容詞「隨後的，後來的」。指在時間或順序上接在某事之後。常用搭配 subsequent to (在...之後)，但在 GSAT 中更常作為形容詞修飾名詞，如 subsequent events (後續事件)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The first meeting was unsuccessful, but <target>subsequent</target> <pattern>discussions</pattern> led to a mutually beneficial agreement between the two companies.","translation":"第一次會議沒有成功，但隨後的討論促成了兩家公司之間互利的協議。","explanation":"形容詞「隨後的」。修飾 discussions，表示在第一次會議之後發生的討論。"},{"sentence":"The initial report was inaccurate, and <target>subsequent</target> <pattern>investigations</pattern> revealed a much more complex story behind the accident.","translation":"初步報告不準確，而後續的調查揭露了事故背後更複雜的故事。","explanation":"形容詞「後來的」。修飾 investigations，表示在初步報告之後進行的調查。"}],"related_forms":["subsequently"]}

{"headword":"subsidy","explanation":"名詞「補貼，津貼」。指政府或機構為了維持價格或促進產業發展而提供的財政援助。常用搭配 government subsidy (政府補貼)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government provides a generous <target>subsidy</target> <pattern>for</pattern> electric vehicles to encourage more citizens to switch from gasoline cars to cleaner energy.","translation":"政府為電動車提供優渥的補貼，以鼓勵更多公民從汽油車轉換為更乾淨的能源。","explanation":"名詞「補貼」。常用搭配 subsidy for sth (對...的補貼)。"},{"sentence":"Agricultural <target>subsidies</target> are designed to help farmers maintain stable prices and ensure the country's food security during economic downturns.","translation":"農業補貼旨在幫助農民維持穩定價格，並在經濟低迷期間確保國家的糧食安全。","explanation":"名詞「補貼」。指政府對特定產業的財政支持。"}],"related_forms":["subsidize","subsidized"]}

{"headword":"substantial","explanation":"形容詞「大量的，實質的」。可用於描述數量、金額、重要性或程度很大。注意與 substance (物質) 的關聯，substantial 指的是「有分量的」。","entries":[{"sentence":"After months of hard work, the company saw a <target>substantial</target> <pattern>increase in</pattern> profits, allowing them to expand their operations globally.","translation":"經過數月的努力，公司看到利潤大幅增加，使他們能夠將業務擴展到全球。","explanation":"形容詞「大量的」。常用搭配 substantial increase in sth (在...方面大幅增加)。"},{"sentence":"The new law will have a <target>substantial</target> <pattern>impact on</pattern> the local environment, forcing factories to reduce their carbon emissions significantly.","translation":"這項新法律將對當地環境產生實質的影響，迫使工廠顯著地減少碳排放。","explanation":"形容詞「實質的」。常用搭配 substantial impact on sth (對...有實質影響)。"},{"sentence":"The researchers found <target>substantial</target> <pattern>evidence</pattern> to support their theory that climate change is accelerating the melting of polar ice caps.","translation":"研究人員發現了充足的證據來支持他們的理論，即氣候變遷正在加速極地冰蓋的融化。","explanation":"形容詞「充足的，大量的」。修飾 evidence。"}],"related_forms":["substantially","substance"]}

{"headword": "substitute", "explanation": "名詞指「替代品、代用品」；動詞指「替代、代替」。常用搭配 substitute A for B (用 A 替代 B) 或 substitute B with A (用 A 替代 B)。注意 A 和 B 的位置，避免混淆。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Since the original ingredient was unavailable, the chef decided to <target>substitute</target> honey <pattern>for</pattern> sugar in the cake recipe.", "translation": "由於原食材沒貨，廚師決定在蛋糕食譜中用蜂蜜代替糖。", "explanation": "動詞「替代」。常用搭配 substitute A for B (用 A 代替 B)。"}, {"sentence": "In the championship game, the coach decided to <target>substitute</target> a fresh player <pattern>for</pattern> the exhausted captain to maintain the team's energy.", "translation": "在冠軍賽中，教練決定用一名體力充沛的球員替換掉疲憊的隊長，以維持球隊的能量。", "explanation": "動詞「替代」。常用搭配 substitute A for B (用 A 代替 B)。"}, {"sentence": "Due to the sudden illness of the lead actor, the theater company had to find a <target>substitute</target> to perform the role tonight.", "translation": "由於主演突然生病，劇團必須找到一名替代者在今晚演出這個角色。", "explanation": "名詞「替代者」。指代替某人執行任務的人。"}, {"sentence": "Many people are now <pattern>using</pattern> soy milk as a <target>substitute</target> <pattern>for</pattern> cow's milk for health reasons or dietary restrictions.", "translation": "出於健康原因或飲食限制，許多人現在使用豆奶作為牛奶的替代品。", "explanation": "名詞「替代品」。常用搭配 substitute for sth (作為...的替代品)。"}], "related_forms": ["substitution", "substitutable"]}

{"headword":"subtle","explanation":"形容詞「微妙的，不易察覺的」。指細微的差異或精巧的處理方式。注意 b 不發音。常用搭配 subtle difference (微妙的差異), subtle hint (微妙的暗示)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two paintings look almost identical at first glance, but there are <target>subtle</target> <pattern>differences in</pattern> the way the light is used.","translation":"這兩幅畫乍看之下幾乎一模一樣，但在光線的使用方式上存在微妙的差異。","explanation":"形容詞「微妙的」。常用搭配 subtle differences in sth (在...方面有微妙的差異)。"},{"sentence":"She gave him a <target>subtle</target> <pattern>hint</pattern> that she was unhappy with the decision, but he completely failed to notice it.","translation":"她給了他一個微妙的暗示，表示她對這個決定不滿，但他完全沒有注意到。","explanation":"形容詞「不易察覺的」。常用搭配 subtle hint (微妙的暗示)。"},{"sentence":"The chef added a <target>subtle</target> <pattern>flavor of</pattern> lemon to the dessert to make it more refreshing without being too strong.","translation":"廚師在甜點中加入了微量的檸檬風味，使其更清爽而不會過於強烈。","explanation":"形容詞「微量的，微妙的」。修飾 flavor。"}],"related_forms":["subtly"]}

{"headword":"suburban","explanation":"形容詞「郊區的」。指位於城市邊緣的地區。注意與 urban (城市的) 和 rural (鄉村的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many families prefer to live in <target>suburban</target> <pattern>areas</pattern> because they offer more space and a quieter environment than the city center.","translation":"許多家庭喜歡住在郊區，因為與市中心相比，他們能提供更多空間和更安靜的環境。","explanation":"形容詞「郊區的」。常用搭配 suburban areas (郊區)。"},{"sentence":"The growth of <target>suburban</target> <pattern>sprawl</pattern> has led to an increase in the number of people commuting long distances to work every day.","translation":"郊區擴張的增長導致每天長距離通勤上班的人數增加。","explanation":"形容詞「郊區的」。常用搭配 suburban sprawl (郊區擴張/蔓延)。"}],"related_forms":["suburb","suburbia"]}

{"headword":"successor","explanation":"名詞「繼任者」。指接替某人職位或職責的人。注意與 predecessor (前任者) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The newly appointed CEO is expected to be a more innovative <target>successor</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the previous leader, who was known for being conservative.","translation":"新任命的執行長被期待成為前任領導者（以保守著稱）的一個更具創新力的繼任者。","explanation":"名詞「繼任者」。常用搭配 successor to sth/sb (某人的繼任者)。"},{"sentence":"After the king died, his eldest son became his legal <target>successor</target>, taking over the throne and all the royal responsibilities.","translation":"國王去世後，他的長子成為其合法繼任者，接管了王位和所有皇家職責。","explanation":"名詞「繼任者」。"}],"related_forms":["succeed","succession"]}

{"headword":"suite","explanation":"名詞「套房」。指飯店中由多個房間組成的住宿單位，或是指一套配套的軟體或家具。注意發音為 /swiːt/，與 sweet 同音。","entries":[{"sentence":"To celebrate their wedding anniversary, the couple decided to book a luxury <target>suite</target> <pattern>at</pattern> the hotel, which included a separate living room.","translation":"為了慶祝他們的結婚紀念日，這對夫婦決定在飯店預訂一間豪華套房，其中包含一個獨立的客廳。","explanation":"名詞「套房」。指飯店中的連接房。"},{"sentence":"The company provided every new employee with a complete <target>suite</target> <pattern>of</pattern> office software to help them manage their tasks efficiently.","translation":"公司為每位新員工提供了一套完整的辦公軟體，以幫助他們高效地管理任務。","explanation":"名詞「一套」。指一組配套的工具或軟體。常用搭配 suite of software (一套軟體)。"}],"related_forms":["suites"]}

{"headword":"superb","explanation":"形容詞「極好的，卓越的」。指品質、表現或外觀非常出色。常用於描述表演、天氣或技能。","entries":[{"sentence":"The pianist gave a <target>superb</target> <pattern>performance</pattern> at the concert, earning a standing ovation from the audience for her technical skill.","translation":"鋼琴家在音樂會上給予了卓越的表演，因其技術技巧而贏得了觀眾的起立鼓掌。","explanation":"形容詞「極好的」。常用搭配 superb performance (卓越的表演)。"},{"sentence":"We spent the entire weekend hiking in the mountains under <target>superb</target> <pattern>weather conditions</pattern>, with clear skies and mild temperatures.","translation":"我們在極佳的天氣條件下，整個週末都在山中徒步旅行，天空晴朗，氣溫溫和。","explanation":"形容詞「極佳的」。常用搭配 superb weather (絕佳的天氣)。"}],"related_forms":["superbly"]}

{"headword":"superstition","explanation":"名詞「迷信」。指基於恐懼或無知而相信的事物，通常缺乏科學依據。常用搭配 superstition about sth (關於...的迷信)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many cultures have a deep-rooted <target>superstition</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the number thirteen, believing that it brings bad luck to anyone who encounters it.","translation":"許多文化對數字 13 有著深根蒂固的迷信，認為它會給任何遇到它的人帶來厄運。","explanation":"名詞「迷信」。常用搭配 superstition about sth (關於...的迷信)。"},{"sentence":"Although he is a scientist, he still holds a small <target>superstition</target> <pattern>that</pattern> wearing his lucky socks will help him pass the exam.","translation":"雖然他是一名科學家，但他仍然抱有一種小迷信，認為穿上他的幸運襪會幫助他通過考試。","explanation":"名詞「迷信」。常用搭配 hold a superstition that... (持有...的迷信)。"}],"related_forms":["superstitious","superstitiously"]}

{"headword":"supervise","explanation":"動詞「監督、管理」。指對人員或工作的進度進行監控，以確保任務正確完成。常用搭配：supervise the process, supervise students。","entries":[{"sentence":"The senior teacher was asked to <target>supervise</target> the students <pattern>during</pattern> their field trip to the museum to ensure their safety.","translation":"資深教師被要求在學生參觀博物館的校外教學期間監督他們，以確保其安全。","explanation":"動詞「監督」。常用搭配：supervise someone during an activity。"},{"sentence":"It is essential for the manager to <target>supervise</target> the production line closely to avoid any errors in the final products.","translation":"經理密切監督生產線至關重要，以避免最終產品出現任何錯誤。","explanation":"動詞「監督」。指對工作流程的監控。"}],"related_forms":["supervised","supervising","supervision","supervisor"]}

{"headword":"supervision","explanation":"名詞「監督、管理」。指監督的行為或狀態。常用搭配：under the supervision of (在...的監督下)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young chemistry students performed the dangerous experiment <pattern>under the</pattern> <target>supervision</target> <pattern>of</pattern> their professor to prevent accidents.","translation":"年輕的化學學生在教授的監督下進行了危險的實驗，以防止事故發生。","explanation":"名詞「監督」。常用搭配：under the supervision of someone。"},{"sentence":"Children should not be left alone on the internet without proper adult <target>supervision</target> because of the potential risks of online scams.","translation":"由於網路詐騙的潛在風險，孩子們在沒有成年人適當監督的情況下不應單獨使用網路。","explanation":"名詞「監督」。指對行為的監管。"}],"related_forms":["supervise","supervisor"]}

{"headword":"supervisor","explanation":"名詞「監督者、主管」。指負責管理他人的人。在學術背景下，常指指導教授。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you have any questions about your thesis, you should schedule a meeting with your <target>supervisor</target> to discuss your research goals.","translation":"如果你對論文有任何疑問，你應該安排一次與指導教授的會面，以討論你的研究目標。","explanation":"名詞「指導教授/主管」。在大學中，supervisor 常指指導論文的教授。"},{"sentence":"The warehouse <target>supervisor</target> is responsible for checking the inventory and ensuring that all shipments are delivered on time.","translation":"倉庫主管負責檢查庫存並確保所有貨件準時送達。","explanation":"名詞「主管」。指在職場中負責監督工作的管理人員。"}],"related_forms":["supervise","supervision"]}

{"headword":"supposedly","explanation":"副詞「據說、大概」。用於表示根據他人之說或普遍看法，但說話者不一定完全相信或確定。注意與 probably (可能) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new smartphone is <target>supposedly</target> the most advanced model on the market, but some users report that the battery life is shorter than expected.","translation":"這款新手機據說市場上最先進的型號，但有些使用者回報電池續航力比預期短。","explanation":"副詞「據說」。表達一種不確定的傳聞。"},{"sentence":"He <target>supposedly</target> finished the project last night, but the team leader noticed that several important sections were still missing from the report.","translation":"他據說昨晚完成了計畫，但團隊領導注意到報告中仍缺少幾個重要部分。","explanation":"副詞「據說」。常用於對某事表示懷疑。"}],"related_forms":["suppose","supposed"]}

{"headword":"supreme","explanation":"形容詞「至高無上的、最高級的」。指地位、權力或程度達到最高點。常用搭配：supreme court (最高法院), supreme confidence (極大信心)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The case was eventually taken to the <target>supreme</target> court, where the final decision would be made regarding the constitutionality of the law.","translation":"此案最終被提交至最高法院，法院將就該法律的合憲性做出最終決定。","explanation":"形容詞「最高」。指法律體系中的最高權威。"},{"sentence":"Despite the challenging nature of the competition, the athlete competed with <target>supreme</target> confidence, believing that his hard work would pay off.","translation":"儘管競爭激烈，這名運動員仍以極大的信心參賽，相信他的努力將會有所回報。","explanation":"形容詞「最高/極大」。指程度上的最高點。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"surplus","explanation":"名詞「過剩、剩餘」；形容詞「過剩的」。指數量超過需求量。常用搭配：trade surplus (貿易順差/盈餘), budget surplus (預算盈餘)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The farmers had a <target>surplus</target> <pattern>of</pattern> corn this year due to the perfect weather, so they decided to export the extra grain to other countries.","translation":"由於天氣完美，農民今年玉米過剩，因此他們決定將多餘的穀物出口到其他國家。","explanation":"名詞「過剩」。常用搭配：a surplus of sth。"},{"sentence":"The government reported a budget <target>surplus</target> this year, allowing them to invest more money in improving the city's public transportation system.","translation":"政府報告今年有預算盈餘，使他們能夠投入更多資金改善城市的公共交通系統。","explanation":"名詞「盈餘」。指財務上的剩餘。"},{"sentence":"Because there were <target>surplus</target> supplies in the warehouse, the company offered them at a discount to clear space for new inventory.","translation":"由於倉庫中有過剩的物資，公司以折扣價出售，以便為新庫存騰出空間。","explanation":"形容詞「過剩的」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"surveillance","explanation":"名詞「監視、監控」。指為了安全或調查而持續觀察某人或某事。常用搭配：under surveillance (被監視), surveillance camera (監視器)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The bank installed high-definition <target>surveillance</target> <pattern>cameras</pattern> to prevent theft and ensure the safety of the customers' money.","translation":"銀行安裝了高解析度的監視器，以防止盜竊並確保客戶資金的安全。","explanation":"名詞「監視」。常用搭配：surveillance cameras。"},{"sentence":"The suspect was kept <pattern>under</pattern> <target>surveillance</target> for several weeks by the police before they finally had enough evidence to make an arrest.","translation":"嫌疑犯在被警方監視數週後，警方終於有了足夠的證據將其逮捕。","explanation":"名詞「監視」。常用片語 under surveillance 表示「被監視」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"suspend","explanation":"動詞「暫停、中止；吊銷、停職」。指暫時停止某事或將某人暫時移出某個職位或學校。常用搭配：suspend from school (停學), suspend a service (暫停服務)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school decided to <target>suspend</target> the student <pattern>from</pattern> class for three days because he repeatedly broke the school's rules regarding academic honesty.","translation":"學校決定讓該學生停學三天，因為他多次違反學校關於學術誠信的規定。","explanation":"動詞「停學」。常用搭配：suspend someone from school。"},{"sentence":"Due to the heavy snowstorm, the airline had to <target>suspend</target> all flights <pattern>for</pattern> twenty-four hours to ensure the safety of the passengers.","translation":"由於強烈雪暴，航空公司不得不暫停所有航班二十四小時，以確保乘客的安全。","explanation":"動詞「暫停」。指暫時停止某項服務或活動。"},{"sentence":"The judge decided to <target>suspend</target> the sentence, allowing the first-time offender to return home provided that he stayed out of trouble.","translation":"法官決定對其緩刑，允許這名初犯者回家，前提是他不再犯錯。","explanation":"動詞「緩刑」。法律術語，指暫時不執行判決。"}],"related_forms":["suspended","suspension"]}

{"headword":"sustain","explanation":"動詞「維持、持續；承受」。指保持某種狀態或承受某種損害。常用搭配：sustain an injury (受傷), sustain growth (維持成長)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Without enough water and nutrients, it is impossible for the plants to <target>sustain</target> their growth <pattern>over</pattern> a long period of time.","translation":"如果沒有足夠的水分和養分，植物不可能在很長時間內維持其成長。","explanation":"動詞「維持」。指保持某種生理或物理狀態。"},{"sentence":"The athlete <target>sustained</target> a serious knee <pattern>injury</pattern> during the final race, which unfortunately forced him to retire from the competition.","translation":"這名運動員在最後一場比賽中遭受了嚴重的膝蓋傷勢，不幸地迫使他退出比賽。","explanation":"動詞「承受/遭受」。常用搭配：sustain an injury。"},{"sentence":"The company struggled to <target>sustain</target> <pattern>a level of</pattern> high quality in its products while trying to expand its market globally.","translation":"公司在試圖全球擴展市場的同時，努力維持其產品的高品質水準。","explanation":"動詞「維持」。指保持某個水準或程度。"}],"related_forms":["sustainable","sustainability"]}

{"headword":"sustainable","explanation":"形容詞「永續的、可持續的」。指能夠在長期內維持而不會損害環境或資源。常用搭配：sustainable development (永續發展), sustainable energy (永續能源)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many countries are now investing in <target>sustainable</target> <pattern>energy sources</pattern>, such as wind and solar power, to reduce their reliance on fossil fuels.","translation":"許多國家現在正投資於永續能源，如風能和太陽能，以減少對化石燃料的依賴。","explanation":"形容詞「永續的」。常用搭配：sustainable energy sources。"},{"sentence":"The government is promoting <target>sustainable</target> <pattern>development</pattern> to ensure that future generations can still enjoy the natural beauty of the planet.","translation":"政府正在推廣永續發展，以確保後代能繼續享受地球的自然之美。","explanation":"形容詞「永續的」。常用搭配：sustainable development。"}],"related_forms":["sustain","sustainability"]}

{"headword": "swap", "explanation": "swap 可作為動詞「交換」或名詞「交換」。動詞用法中常見搭配 swap A for B (用 A 交換 B)，在口語中非常常見。", "entries": [{"sentence": "During the break, the two students decided to <target>swap</target> their seats so they could sit next to their best friends.", "translation": "在休息時間，兩名學生決定交換座位，這樣他們就可以坐在好朋友旁邊。", "explanation": "動詞「交換」。指將自己的東西給對方，同時從對方那裡得到東西。"}, {"sentence": "I forgot my pen at home, so I asked my classmate if she could <target>swap</target> <pattern>her</pattern> blue ink pen <pattern>for</pattern> my pencil.", "translation": "我把筆忘在家裡，所以問同學是否可以用她的藍色原子筆來交換我的鉛筆。", "explanation": "動詞「交換」。常用搭配：swap A for B。"}, {"sentence": "The players made a quick <target>swap</target> during the game, changing positions to better defend their goal against the opposing team.", "translation": "球員們在比賽中迅速進行了交換，更換位置以更好地防守對手球門。", "explanation": "名詞「交換」。指交換位置或物品的行為。"}], "related_forms": ["swapped", "swapping"]}

{"headword":"symbolic","explanation":"形容詞「象徵的、象徵性的」。指某物代表某個抽象概念或想法。常用於描述藝術、儀式或特定行為。","entries":[{"sentence":"The dove is widely recognized as a <target>symbolic</target> <pattern>representation</pattern> of peace and hope, appearing in many artworks and poems.","translation":"鴿子被廣泛認可為和平與希望的象徵性代表，出現在許多藝術作品和詩歌中。","explanation":"形容詞「象徵的」。常用搭配：symbolic representation (象徵性代表)。"},{"sentence":"Giving a ring during the wedding ceremony is a <target>symbolic</target> <pattern>gesture</pattern> that represents a lifelong commitment between two people.","translation":"在婚禮儀式上送戒指是一個象徵性的舉動，代表著兩人之間終身相伴的承諾。","explanation":"形容詞「象徵的」。常用搭配：symbolic gesture (象徵性舉動)。"}],"related_forms":["symbol","symbolically","symbolism"]}

{"headword":"symptom","explanation":"名詞「症狀」。指疾病或問題的徵兆。除了醫療用法，也可用於描述社會問題或系統故障的徵兆。","entries":[{"sentence":"A high fever and a persistent cough are common <target>symptoms</target> of the flu, requiring patients to rest and drink plenty of fluids.","translation":"高燒和持續咳嗽是流感的常見症狀，需要病人休息並飲用大量液體。","explanation":"名詞「症狀」。指生理上的不適感。"},{"sentence":"The sudden drop in student engagement was seen as a <target>symptom</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a deeper problem within the school's teaching methods.","translation":"學生參與度的突然下降被視為學校教學方法中更深層問題的一個症狀。","explanation":"名詞「症狀」。此處指某種不良情況的徵兆。"},{"sentence":"If you experience any unusual <target>symptoms</target> after taking the medication, you should contact your doctor immediately for a professional check-up.","translation":"如果在服用藥物後出現任何異常症狀，你應該立即聯繫你的醫生進行專業檢查。","explanation":"名詞「症狀」。"}],"related_forms":["symptomatic"]}

{"headword":"syndrome","explanation":"名詞「症候群」。指一組共同出現的症狀或特徵。常用於醫療或心理學描述，如 Down syndrome (唐氏症候群)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctor explained that the patient was suffering from a rare <target>syndrome</target> that affects both the muscular and nervous systems.","translation":"醫生解釋說，病人患有一種罕見的症候群，會影響肌肉和神經系統。","explanation":"名詞「症候群」。指一組相關症狀的集合。"},{"sentence":"Many young professionals experience burnout <target>syndrome</target>, which is characterized by extreme exhaustion and a lack of motivation in their careers.","translation":"許多年輕專業人士經歷倦怠症候群，其特徵是職業生涯中極度疲憊且缺乏動力。","explanation":"名詞「症候群」。指一種特定的心理或生理狀態。"}],"related_forms":["syndromes"]}

{"headword":"tackle","explanation":"動詞「處理、解決」或「對付」。常指面對困難的問題或挑戰。在運動中（如美式足球）則指「擒抱」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city council met last week to discuss how to <target>tackle</target> the growing problem of air pollution in the downtown area.","translation":"市議會上週開會討論如何解決市中心日益嚴重的空氣污染問題。","explanation":"動詞「處理、解決」。常用搭配：tackle a problem/issue。"},{"sentence":"To <target>tackle</target> the difficult math problem, the student decided to break it down into smaller, more manageable steps.","translation":"為了處理這個困難的數學題，學生決定將其分解為較小、更易於處理的步驟。","explanation":"動詞「處理、解決」。"},{"sentence":"The defender used a powerful <target>tackle</target> to stop the opposing player from reaching the goal line during the final minutes of the match.","translation":"防守球員在比賽最後幾分鐘使用強而有力的擒抱，阻止對手球員到達球門線。","explanation":"名詞用法。在運動中指將對手壓倒在地。"}],"related_forms":["tackled","tackling"]}

{"headword":"tactic","explanation":"名詞「策略、戰術」。指為了達到特定目的而採取的具體行動或方法。通常為複數形式 tactics。","entries":[{"sentence":"The marketing team developed a new <target>tactic</target> to attract younger customers by using social media influencers for their advertisements.","translation":"行銷團隊開發了一種新策略，透過在廣告中使用社群媒體影響者來吸引年輕顧客。","explanation":"名詞「策略」。指達到目的的具體手段。"},{"sentence":"The coach changed his <target>tactics</target> during the second half of the game to surprise the opposing team and score more points.","translation":"教練在比賽下半場改變了戰術，以出其不意地擊敗對手並得分更多。","explanation":"名詞「戰術」。通常以複數形式出現，指整體的行動方案。"},{"sentence":"Some people use psychological <target>tactics</target> to persuade others to agree with their opinions during a heated debate.","translation":"有些人使用心理戰術來說服他人同意他們的觀點，在激烈的辯論中。","explanation":"名詞「戰術」。"}],"related_forms":["tactical","tactically"]}

{"headword":"tangle","explanation":"tangle 可作為名詞「糾結、混亂」或動詞「糾結、纏繞」。動詞常用片語 tangle with (與...糾纏/衝突)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After playing in the sand all day, the little girl's hair became a huge <target>tangle</target> that was very difficult to brush out.","translation":"在沙灘上玩了一整天後，小女孩的頭髮變得非常糾結，很難梳開。","explanation":"名詞「糾結」。指線類或頭髮等糾結在一起的狀態。"},{"sentence":"The fishing lines <target>tangled</target> <pattern>together</pattern>, making it impossible for the fishermen to catch any fish for several hours.","translation":"釣魚線糾結在一起，導致漁民幾個小時都釣不到魚。","explanation":"動詞「糾結」。指線類等物體互相纏繞。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer warned his client not to <target>tangle</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the opposing party's legal team, as it might lead to unnecessary complications.","translation":"律師警告他的客戶不要與對方的法律團隊糾纏，因為這可能會導致不必要的複雜情況。","explanation":"動詞片語 tangle with 意為「與...糾纏」或「與...發生衝突」。"}],"related_forms":["tangled","tangling"]}

{"headword":"tempt","explanation":"動詞「誘惑、吸引」。指某物使人想做某些（通常是不正確或不被允許的）事情。常用搭配 tempt someone to do something。","entries":[{"sentence":"The smell of freshly baked cookies <target>tempted</target> the student <pattern>to</pattern> sneak into the kitchen and take one before dinner.","translation":"剛出爐的餅乾香味誘惑學生在晚餐前偷偷溜進廚房拿一塊。","explanation":"動詞「誘惑」。常用搭配：tempt someone to do something。"},{"sentence":"Although he was on a strict diet, the delicious chocolate cake <target>tempted</target> him greatly during the birthday party.","translation":"儘管他在嚴格節食，但生日派對上美味的巧克力蛋糕極大地誘惑了他。","explanation":"動詞「誘惑」。指被某物吸引而想去做。"}],"related_forms":["temptation","tempting","temptingly"]}

{"headword":"temptation","explanation":"名詞「誘惑」。指使人想做不正確事情的衝動或吸引力。常用搭配 give in to temptation (屈服於誘惑)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student felt a strong <target>temptation</target> <pattern>to</pattern> cheat on the exam, but his honesty and integrity kept him from doing so.","translation":"學生感到強烈的誘惑想要在考試中作弊，但他的誠實和正直使他沒有這麼做。","explanation":"名詞「誘惑」。指內心的衝動。"},{"sentence":"Many people <pattern>give</pattern> <pattern>in</pattern> <pattern>to</pattern> the <target>temptation</target> of eating junk food when they are stressed, which can lead to health problems.","translation":"許多人在壓力大時會屈服於吃垃圾食物的誘惑，這可能導致健康問題。","explanation":"名詞「誘惑」。常用片語 give in to temptation (屈服於誘惑)。"}],"related_forms":["tempt","tempting"]}

{"headword":"terminal","explanation":"terminal 可作為名詞「終點站/航廈」或形容詞「末期的/終點的」。形容詞用法中 terminal illness (末期疾病) 是常見考點。","entries":[{"sentence":"The passengers waited in the international <target>terminal</target> of the airport, checking their flights and preparing for their long journey.","translation":"乘客在機場的國際航廈等待，檢查航班並準備長途旅行。","explanation":"名詞「航廈」。指機場或車站的大型建築。"},{"sentence":"The train reached the <target>terminal</target> station at midnight, and all the remaining passengers were asked to leave the train.","translation":"火車在午夜到達終點站，所有剩餘的乘客都被要求離開火車。","explanation":"名詞「終點站」。指路線的最後一個車站。"},{"sentence":"The doctor gently told the family that the patient was suffering from a <target>terminal</target> <pattern>illness</pattern> and that treatment was no longer possible.","translation":"醫生溫柔地告訴家屬，病人患有末期疾病，且治療已不再可能。","explanation":"形容詞「末期的」。常用搭配：terminal illness (末期疾病)。"}],"related_forms":["terminals"]}

{"headword":"terrify","explanation":"動詞「使恐懼、使驚恐」。常用於描述極度的恐懼。注意與 fear (恐懼) 的區別：terrify 是使人進入恐懼的狀態 (使動詞)，而 fear 則是主體感受到恐懼 (狀態動詞)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The sudden loud noise from the old building <target>terrified</target> the young children, who immediately ran to their parents for safety.","translation":"舊建築中突然傳出的巨大噪音嚇壞了年幼的孩子們，他們立即跑向父母尋求安全。","explanation":"動詞「使恐懼」。指造成極大的恐懼感。"},{"sentence":"The thought of speaking in front of a large audience <target>terrifies</target> many students, making them feel nervous and anxious before the presentation.","translation":"在眾多觀眾面前演講的想法讓許多學生感到恐懼，使他們在簡報前感到緊張和焦慮。","explanation":"動詞「使恐懼」。描述一種持續性的心理狀態。"}],"related_forms":["terrified","terrifying","terror"]}

{"headword":"testify","explanation":"動詞「作證」。主要用於法律語境，指在法庭上或正式場合下，根據自己的見聞提供證據。常用搭配：testify to sth (證實某事), testify against sb (對某人作不利之證)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The witness was called to <target>testify</target> <pattern>in</pattern> court about what he had seen during the accident on the highway.","translation":"證人被傳喚到法庭上，就他在高速公路上目擊的事故作證。","explanation":"動詞「作證」。指在法律程序中提供陳述。"},{"sentence":"Her success in the competition <target>testifies</target> <pattern>to</pattern> her hard work and dedication over the past three years of training.","translation":"她在競賽中的成功證實了她在過去三年的訓練中付出的努力與專注。","explanation":"動詞「證實」。testify to sth 用於描述某事作為證據證明某種特質或事實。"},{"sentence":"The former employee decided to <target>testify</target> <pattern>against</pattern> the company manager, exposing the illegal business practices they had used.","translation":"前員工決定對公司經理作證，揭露他們所使用的非法經營方式。","explanation":"動詞片語 testify against sb 表「對某人作不利之證」。"}],"related_forms":["testimony","testifying"]}

{"headword":"texture","explanation":"名詞「質地、構造」。指物體表面的觸感或組成方式。動詞用法較少見，指「編織、構成」。常用於描述食物、布料或皮膚。","entries":[{"sentence":"The artist chose a rough <target>texture</target> for the painting to create a feeling of strength and raw energy on the canvas.","translation":"藝術家為這幅畫選擇了粗糙的質地，以在畫布上創造出一種力量感和原始的能量。","explanation":"名詞「質地」。指表面的觸感。"},{"sentence":"The chef explained that the secret to the perfect cake is maintaining a light and fluffy <target>texture</target> in the sponge.","translation":"主廚解釋說，完美蛋糕的秘密在於保持海綿蛋糕輕盈且鬆軟的質地。","explanation":"名詞「質地」。常用於描述食物的口感。"},{"sentence":"The designer used different fabrics to <target>texture</target> the garment, adding visual interest and depth to the modern outfit.","translation":"設計師使用不同的布料來構成這件衣服，為這套現代裝扮增添了視覺趣味和深度。","explanation":"動詞「構成、編織」。指透過不同材質增加視覺或觸覺的層次。"}],"related_forms":["textural"]}

{"headword":"theft","explanation":"名詞「偷竊、盜竊罪」。指偷走某物的行為或該罪行。注意與 steal (動詞) 和 thief (偷竊者) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police are investigating a series of <target>thefts</target> <pattern>of</pattern> expensive bicycles from the university campus during the winter break.","translation":"警方正在調查冬季假期期間大學校園內一系列昂貴自行車的盜竊案。","explanation":"名詞「盜竊」。常用搭配 theft of sth。"},{"sentence":"The museum installed high-tech security cameras to prevent the <target>theft</target> <pattern>of</pattern> valuable ancient artifacts from the gallery.","translation":"博物館安裝了高科技安全攝影機，以防止美術館內珍貴古代文物的盜竊。","explanation":"名詞「盜竊」。指偷竊的行為。"}],"related_forms":["thief","steal"]}

{"headword":"theology","explanation":"名詞「神學」。指對神、宗教教義或信仰系統的系統性研究。常用於學術討論或宗教歷史語境。","entries":[{"sentence":"After finishing his degree in history, the student decided to study <target>theology</target> to better understand the beliefs of ancient civilizations.","translation":"在完成歷史學位後，這名學生決定學習神學，以便更好地理解古代文明的信仰。","explanation":"名詞「神學」。指對宗教教義的研究。"},{"sentence":"The professor's lecture on <target>theology</target> focused on the similarities between different religions and how they shape human morality.","translation":"教授關於神學的講座聚焦於不同宗教之間的相似之處，以及它們如何塑造人類的道德觀。","explanation":"名詞「神學」。"}],"related_forms":["theologian","theological"]}

{"headword":"theoretical","explanation":"形容詞「理論上的、假設性的」。指基於理論而非實際經驗或實踐的。常用於科學研究、數學或學術討論。注意與 practical (實際的) 相反。","entries":[{"sentence":"While the plan sounds great in a <target>theoretical</target> sense, the team needs to consider the practical challenges of implementing it.","translation":"雖然這個計畫在理論上聽起來很棒，但團隊需要考慮實行時的實際挑戰。","explanation":"形容詞「理論上的」。常用搭配：in a theoretical sense (在理論上的意義上)。"},{"sentence":"The scientists presented a <target>theoretical</target> model to explain how the universe began, although they lack direct evidence to prove it.","translation":"科學家提出了一個理論模型來解釋宇宙是如何開始的，儘管他們缺乏直接證據來證明它。","explanation":"形容詞「理論上的」。指基於假設和推論。"}],"related_forms":["theory","theoretically"]}

{"headword":"therapist","explanation":"名詞「治療師」。指經過專業訓練的人員，提供心理或身體治療。常用於心理治療 (psychotherapist) 或物理治療 (physical therapist)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After the car accident, the young man visited a physical <target>therapist</target> twice a week to regain his ability to walk.","translation":"車禍後，這名年輕人每週兩次拜訪物理治療師，以恢復行走能力。","explanation":"名詞「治療師」。指提供物理治療的專業人員。"},{"sentence":"The school counselor is a licensed <target>therapist</target> who helps students deal with stress and anxiety during the exam season.","translation":"學校輔導員是一位領有執照的治療師，幫助學生在考試季節處理壓力與焦慮。","explanation":"名詞「治療師」。指提供心理治療的專業人員。"}],"related_forms":["therapy"]}

{"headword":"therapy","explanation":"名詞「治療、療法」。指為了改善健康或心理狀態而採取的治療方式。常用搭配：undergo therapy (接受治療), physical therapy (物理治療), speech therapy (語言治療)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctor recommended that the patient <pattern>undergo</pattern> <target>therapy</target> to help him recover from the emotional trauma of the war.","translation":"醫生建議病人接受治療，以幫助他從戰爭的情感創傷中恢復。","explanation":"名詞「治療」。片語 undergo therapy 表示「接受治療」。"},{"sentence":"Music <target>therapy</target> has become a popular way to reduce stress and help elderly people with dementia remember their past memories.","translation":"音樂治療已成為一種降低壓力並幫助失智老人回憶起過去記憶的流行方式。","explanation":"名詞「療法」。指一種特定的治療方法。"},{"sentence":"After the surgery, she spent three months in <target>therapy</target> to strengthen her muscles and improve her balance while walking.","translation":"手術後，她花三個月時間進行治療，以強化肌肉並改善走路時的平衡感。","explanation":"名詞「治療」。指持續性的恢復過程。"}],"related_forms":["therapeutic","therapist"]}

{"headword": "thereby", "explanation": "副詞「因此、藉此」。用於連接兩個分句，指前一個動作導致了後一個結果。常用於正式文書或學術寫作中，常接分詞構句 (thereby + V-ing)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The company decided to automate its production line, <target>thereby</target> reducing the cost of labor and increasing its total profit.", "translation": "公司決定將生產線自動化，藉此降低人力成本並增加總利潤。", "explanation": "副詞「藉此」。常用於分詞構句，表示結果。"}, {"sentence": "He studied hard every day and improved his vocabulary, <target>thereby</target> making it easier for him to pass the GSAT English exam.", "translation": "他每天努力學習並擴展詞彙量，因此使他更容易通過學測英語考試。", "explanation": "副詞「因此」。表示前述動作導致的結果。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"thesis","explanation":"名詞「論文、論點」。在學術語境中，指畢業論文或一個研究計畫的核心論點。注意複數形為 theses。","entries":[{"sentence":"The graduate student spent an entire year researching and writing her <target>thesis</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the effects of global warming on coral reefs.","translation":"這名研究生花了一整年研究並撰寫關於全球暖化對珊瑚礁影響的論文。","explanation":"名詞「論文」。常用搭配 thesis on sth。"},{"sentence":"The professor asked the student to clearly state his main <target>thesis</target> in the introduction of his essay to avoid confusing the reader.","translation":"教授要求學生在文章的導入段落中清楚地陳述他的主論點，以避免讓讀者感到困惑。","explanation":"名詞「論點」。指文章的核心主張。"}],"related_forms":["theses"]}

{"headword":"thigh","explanation":"名詞「大腿」。指從臀部到膝蓋的部分。在描述身體部位或食材（如雞腿）時常用。","entries":[{"sentence":"The athlete felt a sharp pain in his <target>thigh</target> during the final sprint, forcing him to stop and seek medical help immediately.","translation":"這名運動員在最後衝刺時感到大腿劇痛，迫使他立即停止並尋求醫療幫助。","explanation":"名詞「大腿」。指人體的大腿部位。"},{"sentence":"For the dinner party, the chef prepared roasted chicken <target>thighs</target> with a lemon and garlic sauce, which were tender and juicy.","translation":"為了晚餐派對，廚師準備了烤雞腿配檸檬蒜醬，口感鮮嫩多汁。","explanation":"名詞「大腿」。此處指雞腿。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "threshold", "explanation": "名詞「門檻；臨界點」。原指門口的地板，後引申為進入某種狀態或達到某個程度的界限。常用片語 cross the threshold (跨過門檻/進入某種狀態)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "As soon as she crossed <pattern>the threshold of</pattern> the old house, she felt a strange sense of peace and nostalgia.", "translation": "當她跨進這棟舊房子的門檻時，她感到一種奇怪的平靜與懷舊感。", "explanation": "名詞「門檻」。指實體的門口。"}, {"sentence": "Every person has a different pain <target>threshold</target>, meaning some can endure more discomfort than others during a medical procedure.", "translation": "每個人的痛覺臨界點不同，這意味著有些人比其他人能在醫療過程中忍受更多不適。", "explanation": "名詞「臨界點」。指能忍受或感知某事的最高/最低限度。"}, {"sentence": "The company is on the <target>threshold</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a major breakthrough in cancer research, which could save thousands of lives in the future.", "translation": "這家公司正處於癌症研究重大突破的臨界點，未來可能會拯救數千人的生命。", "explanation": "名詞「臨界點」。常用片語 on the threshold of sth (處於...的臨界點)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"thrill","explanation":"名詞「興奮；顫慄」或動詞「使興奮」。常用於描述強烈的快感或驚險的體驗。常用搭配 a thrill to (對...感到興奮)。","entries":[{"sentence":"It was a <target>thrill</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the young student to visit the NASA space center and see the actual rockets for the first time.","translation":"對於這名年輕學生來說，能參觀 NASA 太空中心並第一次親眼看到真正的火箭是一件令人興奮的事。","explanation":"名詞「興奮」。指強烈的快感。"},{"sentence":"Many people enjoy the <target>thrill</target> <pattern>of</pattern> extreme sports, such as skydiving or bungee jumping, because they love the feeling of adrenaline.","translation":"許多人享受極端運動的快感，例如高空跳傘或蹦極，因為他們喜歡腎上腺素分泌的感覺。","explanation":"名詞「興奮」。常用搭配 a thrill of sth。"},{"sentence":"The young musician was <target>thrilled</target> <pattern>to</pattern> receive a full scholarship to study at the prestigious music academy in Vienna.","translation":"這名年輕的音樂家很高興收到前往維也納著名音樂學院學習的全額獎學金。","explanation":"動詞（被動語態）「使興奮」。指感到極其興奮。"},{"sentence":"She was <target>thrilled</target> <pattern>by</pattern> the news that her favorite author was coming to town for a book signing event.","translation":"她聽到她最喜歡的作者要來鎮上參加簽書會的消息而感到非常興奮。","explanation":"動詞（被動語態）「使興奮」。"}],"related_forms":["thrilled","thrillingly"]}

{"headword":"thriller","explanation":"名詞「驚悚片；驚悚小說」。指情節緊湊、令人緊張且充滿懸念的作品。","entries":[{"sentence":"The movie was a psychological <target>thriller</target> that kept the audience on the edge of their seats until the very end.","translation":"這部電影是一部心理驚悚片，讓觀眾直到最後一刻都緊張得坐立不安。","explanation":"名詞「驚悚片」。指令人緊張的電影。"},{"sentence":"He spent the entire weekend reading a gripping <target>thriller</target> about a spy who discovers a secret plot to overthrow the government.","translation":"他整個週末都在讀一本關於一名間諜發現推翻政府秘密陰謀的吸引人的驚悚小說。","explanation":"名詞「驚悚小說」。指情節緊湊的小說。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"thrive","explanation":"動詞「繁榮；茁壯成長」。可用於描述植物、動物、企業或人。常用搭配 thrive on (靠...而繁榮/在...中茁壯)。","entries":[{"sentence":"These tropical plants <target>thrive</target> <pattern>in</pattern> warm, humid environments and will die if they are kept in cold weather.","translation":"這些熱帶植物在溫暖潮濕的環境中茁壯成長，如果在寒冷的天氣中會枯死。","explanation":"動詞「茁壯成長」。指植物生長良好。"},{"sentence":"The small local business began to <target>thrive</target> after the city government built a new shopping mall near the town center.","translation":"在市政府在市中心附近建造一座新購物中心後，這家小型當地企業開始繁榮起來。","explanation":"動詞「繁榮」。指企業經營成功。"},{"sentence":"Some people <target>thrive</target> <pattern>on</pattern> pressure, using the stress of deadlines to motivate themselves to work more efficiently.","translation":"有些人靠壓力而繁榮，利用截止日期的壓力來激勵自己更高效地工作。","explanation":"動詞片語 thrive on sth 意為「在...中茁壯/喜歡...」。"}],"related_forms":["thriving"]}

{"headword":"throne","explanation":"名詞「王座；王位」。指君主坐的椅子，也引申為君主地位或權力。","entries":[{"sentence":"The king sat upon his golden <target>throne</target>, looking down at the people of his kingdom with a mixture of pride and concern.","translation":"國王坐在他的金色王座上，帶著一種自豪與擔憂交織的情緒俯視著他王國的子民。","explanation":"名詞「王座」。指實體的椅子。"},{"sentence":"After the old emperor died, there was a fierce struggle for the <target>throne</target> among his three sons, leading to a civil war.","translation":"在老皇帝去世後，他的三個兒子之間展開了激烈的王位爭奪戰，導致了一場內戰。","explanation":"名詞「王位」。指君主的地位或權力。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "thrust", "explanation": "動詞「猛推；刺」。名詞「猛推；主旨」。注意動詞用法：thrust A into B (將 A 猛推入 B)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "In a moment of panic, the guard <target>thrust</target> the prisoner <pattern>into</pattern> the dark cell and locked the heavy iron door quickly.", "translation": "在恐慌的一瞬間，守衛將囚犯猛推入黑暗的監獄，並迅速鎖上沉重的鐵門。", "explanation": "動詞「猛推」。指用力且快速地推。"}, {"sentence": "The fencer <target>thrust</target> his sword forward with great speed, aiming for the opponent's shoulder to win the final match.", "translation": "擊劍手將劍快步向前刺，瞄準對手的肩膀以贏得最終比賽。", "explanation": "動詞「刺」。指用力向前推或刺。"}, {"sentence": "I didn't understand the <target>thrust</target> <pattern>of</pattern> his argument, so I asked him to explain his main points more clearly.", "translation": "我不理解他論點的主旨，所以我請他更清楚地解釋他的主要觀點。", "explanation": "名詞「主旨」。指論點或說話的核心意義。"}, {"sentence": "The sudden <target>thrust</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the car's acceleration caused the passengers to be pushed back into their seats.", "translation": "汽車突然加速的推力使乘客被推回座位上。", "explanation": "名詞，指一種猛力的推力。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"tick","explanation":"名詞「滴答聲；勾選標記」。動詞「滴答作聲；勾選」。注意常用片語 tick off (勾掉/完成)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The only sound in the quiet room was the constant <target>tick</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the clock on the wall, which made her nervous.","translation":"安靜房間裡唯一的聲音就是牆上時鐘不斷的滴答聲，這讓她感到緊張。","explanation":"名詞「滴答聲」。指時鐘的聲音。"},{"sentence":"Please <target>tick</target> the box next to the answer you think is correct on the multiple-choice test paper.","translation":"請在選擇題考卷上，在你認為正確的答案選項旁的方格中勾選。","explanation":"動詞「勾選」。指在方格中打勾。"},{"sentence":"She used a highlighter to <target>tick</target> <pattern>off</pattern> the items on her to-do list as she finished each task throughout the day.","translation":"她在一天中完成每項任務後，用螢光筆將待辦清單上的項目勾掉。","explanation":"動詞片語 tick off (勾掉)。指完成某事後將其標記。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "tile", "explanation": "名詞「瓷磚；瓦片」。動詞「鋪瓷磚」。常用於描述浴室、廚房或房頂的材質。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The bathroom walls are covered with white <target>tiles</target>, making the small space feel cleaner and brighter than before.", "translation": "浴室牆壁鋪滿了白色瓷磚，使這個小空間感覺比以前更乾淨、更明亮。", "explanation": "名詞「瓷磚」。指用於牆壁或地板的方形片狀物。"}, {"sentence": "The workers spent three days <target>tiling</target> the kitchen floor to ensure that every piece was perfectly aligned and level.", "translation": "工人花了三天時間在廚房地板鋪瓷磚，以確保每一片都完美對齊且平整。", "explanation": "動詞「鋪瓷磚」。指安裝瓷磚的過程。"}, {"sentence": "The old roof was made of red clay <target>tiles</target>, which is a common style in many Mediterranean countries.", "translation": "這座舊房子的屋頂是由紅土瓦片製成的，這是許多地中海國家的常見風格。", "explanation": "名詞「瓦片」。指用於房頂的遮雨瓦。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"tin","explanation":"名詞「錫；錫罐」。動詞「用錫鍍；將...裝罐」。注意 tin can (錫罐) 與 can (罐頭) 的區別，tin 常用於英式英語中。","entries":[{"sentence":"The museum displayed several ancient coins made <pattern>of</pattern> <target>tin</target>, showing the metalworking skills of people in the past.","translation":"博物館展出了幾枚由錫製成的古代錢幣，顯示了過去人們的金屬加工技術。","explanation":"名詞「錫」。指一種金屬元素。"},{"sentence":"She opened a <target>tin</target> <pattern>of</pattern> soup for a quick lunch, as she didn't have enough time to cook a fresh meal.","translation":"她開了一罐湯作為快速午餐，因為她沒有足夠的時間準備一份新鮮的餐點。","explanation":"名詞「錫罐」。指裝食物的金屬罐頭。"},{"sentence":"Many traditional foods are <target>tinned</target> to extend their shelf life, allowing them to be stored for long periods without refrigeration.","translation":"許多傳統食物被裝罐，以延長其保質期，使它們在不需要冷藏的情況下能儲存很長時間。","explanation":"動詞「將...裝罐」。指將食物密封在金屬罐中保存。"}],"related_forms":["tinned"]}

{"headword":"toll","explanation":"名詞可指「通行費」或「傷亡人數」。動詞則指「緩慢地敲鐘」或「造成損失」。常考搭配：take a toll on (對...造成負面影響/損害)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city government decided to <pattern>charge</pattern> a <target>toll</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the new bridge to raise funds for the maintenance of local roads.","translation":"市政府決定對新橋徵收通行費，以籌集當地道路維護的資金。","explanation":"名詞「通行費」。常用搭配 charge a toll on sth。"},{"sentence":"The devastating earthquake caused a high death <target>toll</target>, leaving thousands of families in grief and many homes destroyed.","translation":"這場毀滅性的地震造成了高額的死亡人數，讓數千個家庭陷入悲痛，許多房屋被摧毀。","explanation":"名詞「傷亡人數」。常用搭配 death toll。"},{"sentence":"Working overtime for several months <pattern>took</pattern> a heavy <target>toll</target> <pattern>on</pattern> his physical and mental health, leading to a sudden collapse.","translation":"連續幾個月加班對他的身心健康造成了沉重打擊。","explanation":"動詞片語 take a toll on sth 意為「對...造成損失或負面影響」。"},{"sentence":"The church bell <target>tolled</target> slowly throughout the village to announce the passing of the respected local leader.","translation":"教堂的鐘聲在整個村莊緩緩敲響，以宣布這位受尊敬的當地領導人的去世。","explanation":"動詞「緩慢敲鐘」。通常用於葬禮或悲劇性時刻。"}],"related_forms":["tolls","tolled","tolling"]}

{"headword":"torch","explanation":"名詞指「火把」或（英式英語）「手電筒」。動詞指「縱火燒毀」。注意美式英語中使用 flashlight 而非 torch。","entries":[{"sentence":"The explorers used <target>torches</target> to light their way through the dark cave, carefully avoiding the sharp rocks on the ground.","translation":"探險家們使用火把照亮他們通過黑暗洞穴的道路，小心地避開地面上的尖銳岩石。","explanation":"名詞「火把」。"},{"sentence":"When the power went out during the storm, he grabbed a <target>torch</target> to find the flashlight and check the circuit breaker.","translation":"暴風雨導致停電時，他拿著手電筒去找手電筒並檢查電路斷路器。","explanation":"名詞「手電筒」。在英式英語中 torch 等同於美式英語的 flashlight。"},{"sentence":"The angry mob decided to <target>torch</target> the old warehouse after the company refused to pay the workers their fair wages.","translation":"憤怒的暴民在公司拒絕支付工人公平工資後，決定縱火燒毀這座舊倉庫。","explanation":"動詞「縱火燒毀」。指刻意地將某物點燃燒毀。"}],"related_forms":["torches","torched","torching"]}

{"headword":"torment","explanation":"名詞指「痛苦」或「折磨的人/物」。動詞指「折磨」或「使受苦」。常考用法：torment someone with sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young boy was <target>tormented</target> <pattern>by</pattern> guilt after he accidentally broke his mother's favorite vase and lied about it.","translation":"這個小男孩在不小心打破母親最心愛的花瓶並撒謊後，被愧疚感所折磨。","explanation":"動詞「折磨」。常用被動語態 be tormented by sth。"},{"sentence":"For years, the athlete suffered the <target>torment</target> <pattern>of</pattern> chronic knee pain, which prevented him from competing in professional matches.","translation":"多年來，這位運動員承受著慢性膝蓋疼痛的折磨，這使他無法參加職業比賽。","explanation":"名詞「痛苦」。常用搭配 torment of sth。"},{"sentence":"The older students used to <target>torment</target> the shy newcomer <pattern>with</pattern> mean jokes, making him feel unwelcome in the classroom.","translation":"年長的學生以前常以刻薄的玩笑來折磨那個害羞的新來者，讓他覺得在教室裡不受歡迎。","explanation":"動詞「折磨」。常用搭配 torment someone with sth。"}],"related_forms":["torments","tormented","tormenting"]}

{"headword":"tournament","explanation":"名詞「錦標賽、競賽」。指一系列的比賽，最終決定一名贏家。常用搭配：hold a tournament, enter a tournament。","entries":[{"sentence":"Our school's basketball team practiced hard for months to <pattern>enter</pattern> the national <target>tournament</target> and win the gold medal.","translation":"我們學校的籃球隊辛苦練習了數月，以便參加全國錦標賽並贏得金牌。","explanation":"名詞「錦標賽」。enter a tournament 指「參加錦標賽」。"},{"sentence":"The city <pattern>held</pattern> a tennis <target>tournament</target> every summer to attract tourists and promote the sport among local youth.","translation":"這座城市每年夏天舉辦一場網球錦標賽，以吸引遊客並在當地青少年中推廣這項運動。","explanation":"名詞「錦標賽」。hold a tournament 指「舉辦錦標賽」。"}],"related_forms":["tournaments"]}

{"headword":"toxic","explanation":"形容詞「有毒的」。可用於描述化學物質或比喻作「有害的、有毒的」環境（如 toxic relationship）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The factory was fined for releasing <target>toxic</target> <pattern>waste</pattern> into the river, which killed thousands of fish and contaminated the water.","translation":"這家工廠因將有毒廢料排放到河流中而受到罰款，這導致數千條魚死亡並污染了水源。","explanation":"形容詞「有毒的」。常用搭配 toxic waste (有毒廢料)。"},{"sentence":"Many people believe that spending too much time on social media can create a <target>toxic</target> <pattern>environment</pattern> for teenagers' self-esteem.","translation":"許多人認為，在社交媒體上花太多時間會為青少年的自尊心營造一個有害的環境。","explanation":"形容詞「有害的」。這裡用來比喻精神上的負面影響。"},{"sentence":"The expert warned that the <target>toxic</target> <pattern>fumes</pattern> from the old car's exhaust could cause serious respiratory problems if inhaled for too long.","translation":"專家警告說，舊車排氣管排出的有毒煙霧如果吸入太久，可能會導致嚴重的呼吸系統問題。","explanation":"形容詞「有毒的」。常用搭配 toxic fumes (有毒煙霧)。"}],"related_forms":["toxicity","toxically"]}

{"headword":"trait","explanation":"名詞「特徵、特質」。指一個人或動物天生的或習得的特徵。常用搭配：personality trait, genetic trait。","entries":[{"sentence":"Patience is a key <target>trait</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a good teacher, as they must deal with students of different learning speeds.","translation":"耐心是一位好老師的關鍵特質，因為他們必須面對學習速度不同的學生。","explanation":"名詞「特徵」。常用搭配 trait of someone。"},{"sentence":"The researcher studied the genetic <target>traits</target> that are <pattern>passed down</pattern> from parents to children, such as eye color and height.","translation":"研究人員研究了從父母傳給孩子的遺傳特徵，例如眼睛顏色和身高。","explanation":"名詞「特徵」。genetic trait 指「遺傳特徵」。"},{"sentence":"Honesty is often considered the most admirable <target>trait</target> in a leader, as it builds trust between the leader and the followers.","translation":"誠實通常被認為是領導者最令人欽佩的特質，因為它能在領導者和追隨者之間建立信任。","explanation":"名詞「特質」。"}],"related_forms":["traits"]}

{"headword":"traitor","explanation":"名詞「叛徒、背叛者」。指背叛自己的國家、朋友或組織的人。常用搭配：be a traitor to sth/someone。","entries":[{"sentence":"The soldier was accused of being a <target>traitor</target> <pattern>to</pattern> his country after he secretly sold military secrets to a foreign government.","translation":"這名士兵在秘密將軍事機密賣給外國政府後，被指控為國家的叛徒。","explanation":"名詞「叛徒」。常用搭配 be a traitor to someone/something。"},{"sentence":"She felt as if her best friend had become a <target>traitor</target> when he told the teacher about her secret crush on a classmate.","translation":"當她的好朋友把她暗戀同學的秘密告訴老師時，她覺得他變成了叛徒。","explanation":"名詞「叛徒」。用於描述背叛信任的人。"}],"related_forms":["treason","betray"]}

{"headword":"transaction","explanation":"名詞「交易、往來」。指買賣商品或金錢的交換過程。常用搭配：financial transaction, conduct a transaction。","entries":[{"sentence":"You can use a mobile app to complete the <target>transaction</target> quickly, making it more convenient than carrying cash in your wallet.","translation":"你可以使用手機應用程式快速完成交易，這比在錢包中攜帶現金更方便。","explanation":"名詞「交易」。指金錢或商品的交換過程。"},{"sentence":"The bank monitors every financial <target>transaction</target> <pattern>to</pattern> detect any unusual activity that might indicate credit card fraud.","translation":"銀行監控每一筆財務交易，以偵測任何可能表明信用卡詐騙的異常活動。","explanation":"名詞「交易」。常用搭配 financial transaction (財務交易)。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer reviewed the record of all business <target>transactions</target> <pattern>between</pattern> the two companies to ensure everything was legal and transparent.","translation":"律師審查了兩家公司之間所有商業交易的記錄，以確保一切合法且透明。","explanation":"名詞「交易」。常用搭配 transactions between A and B。"}],"related_forms":["transact","transactional"]}

{"headword":"transformation","explanation":"名詞「轉變、變形」。指形式、性質或外觀的重大改變。常用搭配：undergo a transformation, complete a transformation。","entries":[{"sentence":"The small village <pattern>underwent</pattern> a complete <target>transformation</target> after the new highway was built, turning into a busy tourist town.","translation":"在修建新高速公路後，這個小村莊經歷了徹底的轉變，變成了一個繁忙的旅遊小鎮。","explanation":"名詞「轉變」。常用搭配 undergo a transformation (經歷轉變)。"},{"sentence":"The digital <target>transformation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the education system allows students to access learning materials from anywhere in the world.","translation":"教育系統的數位轉型讓學生能夠從世界任何地方獲取學習材料。","explanation":"名詞「轉型」。digital transformation 指「數位轉型」。"},{"sentence":"The caterpillar's <target>transformation</target> <pattern>into</pattern> a butterfly is one of the most amazing processes in the natural world.","translation":"毛毛蟲轉變為蝴蝶是自然界中最令人驚訝的過程之一。","explanation":"名詞「變形」。常用搭配 transformation into sth (轉變為...)。"}],"related_forms":["transform","transformative"]}

{"headword": "transit", "explanation": "名詞指「運輸、過境」；動詞指「通過、運送」。常用片語：in transit (在運輸過程中)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The package is currently <pattern>in</pattern> <target>transit</target> and should arrive at your house within three business days.", "translation": "包裹目前正在運送中，應該會在三個工作日內送到你家。", "explanation": "名詞「運輸過程」。片語 in transit 意為「在運送途中」。"}, {"sentence": "Singapore is known as a major <target>transit</target> <pattern>hub</pattern> because many travelers stop there before flying to other countries.", "translation": "新加坡被認為是一個主要的轉運中心，因為許多旅客在飛往其他國家之前會在那裡停留。", "explanation": "名詞「過境、轉運」。常用搭配 transit hub (轉運中心)。"}, {"sentence": "The city is investing in <target>transit</target> <pattern>systems</pattern> like subways and buses to reduce traffic congestion during rush hour.", "translation": "這座城市正在投資地鐵和巴士等運輸系統，以減少尖峰時段的交通擁堵。", "explanation": "名詞「運輸」。mass transit 指「大眾運輸」。"}, {"sentence": "The satellite will <target>transit</target> the area behind the moon, providing scientists with a rare opportunity to study the lunar surface.", "translation": "衛星將通過月球後方的區域，提供科學家一個研究月球表面的罕見機會。", "explanation": "動詞「通過」。指物體在空間中從一個位置移動到另一個位置。"}], "related_forms": ["transited", "transiting"]}

{"headword":"transition","explanation":"名詞，意為「過渡」或「轉變」。常用於描述從一種狀態、階段或環境轉移到另一種的過程。常考搭配：make a transition (進行過渡), transition from A to B (從 A 過渡到 B)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Moving to a new country often requires a difficult <target>transition</target> <pattern>from</pattern> one culture <pattern>to</pattern> another, which can be stressful for many students.","translation":"搬到一個新國家通常需要從一種文化過渡到另一種文化，這對許多學生來說可能是壓力很大的。","explanation":"名詞「過渡」。指從一種狀態轉變到另一種狀態的過程。"},{"sentence":"The school provided a support program to help graduating students make a smooth <target>transition</target> into college life and academic requirements.","translation":"學校提供了一個支持計畫，以幫助畢業生順利過渡到大學生活和學術要求。","explanation":"名詞「轉變」。常用搭配：make a transition (進行過渡)。"}],"related_forms":["transitional"]}

{"headword":"transmission","explanation":"名詞，具有多種含義。最常見的是「傳播」或「傳送」（如疾病的傳播、訊號的傳送）以及「變速箱」（汽車零件）。在 GSAT 中，重點在於疾病的 transmission 和資訊的傳送。","entries":[{"sentence":"Doctors are working hard to find new ways to prevent the <target>transmission</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the virus between people in crowded public areas.","translation":"醫生們正努力尋找新方法，以防止病毒在擁擠的公共區域的人與人之間傳播。","explanation":"名詞「傳播」。常用於疾病的傳播。"},{"sentence":"The high-speed internet allows for the rapid <target>transmission</target> <pattern>of</pattern> data, enabling students to access online resources from anywhere in the world.","translation":"高速網路允許數據的快速傳送，使學生能從世界任何地方獲取在線資源。","explanation":"名詞「傳送」。指資訊或電子訊號的傳遞。"},{"sentence":"The mechanic told the driver that the car's <target>transmission</target> was broken and needed to be replaced to ensure a safe journey.","translation":"機械師告訴駕駛員，汽車的變速箱壞了，需要更換以確保旅程安全。","explanation":"名詞「變速箱」。指汽車的動力傳輸系統。"}],"related_forms":["transmit","transmitter"]}

{"headword":"transparent","explanation":"形容詞「透明的」或「顯而易見的」。物理上的透明指光線可穿過；比喻意義上的透明則指過程或意圖清晰、公開且不隱瞞。","entries":[{"sentence":"The scientist used a <target>transparent</target> glass container to observe how the chemical reaction changed colors over time during the experiment.","translation":"科學家使用透明的玻璃容器來觀察化學反應在實驗過程中如何隨時間改變顏色。","explanation":"形容詞「透明的」。指物理上的透明度。"},{"sentence":"To build trust with the public, the government promised to make the decision-making process more <target>transparent</target> and open to scrutiny.","translation":"為了與公眾建立信任，政府承諾將決策過程變得更加透明且公開接受審查。","explanation":"形容詞「透明的」。比喻意指過程清晰、不隱瞞。"}],"related_forms":["transparency","transparently"]}

{"headword":"trauma","explanation":"名詞，意為「創傷」。可指生理上的嚴重受傷，但 GSAT 中更常指心理上的巨大衝擊或精神創傷。常用搭配：emotional trauma (情感創傷), suffer from trauma (遭受創傷)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After surviving the terrible car accident, the young man suffered from severe psychological <target>trauma</target> and needed professional counseling for months.","translation":"在倖存於那場可怕的車禍後，這個年輕人遭受了嚴重的心理創傷，並在數月內需要專業的諮詢。","explanation":"名詞「心理創傷」。指精神上的巨大衝擊。"},{"sentence":"The doctor explained that physical <target>trauma</target> to the brain can lead to long-term memory loss or other serious health problems.","translation":"醫生解釋說，大腦的生理創傷可能導致長期記憶喪失或其他嚴重的健康問題。","explanation":"名詞「生理創傷」。指身體上的嚴重受傷。"}],"related_forms":["traumatic","traumatize"]}

{"headword": "treaty", "explanation": "名詞「條約」或「協定」。指國家之間正式的書面協議。常用搭配：sign a treaty (簽署條約), violate a treaty (違反條約)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The two countries finally signed a peace <target>treaty</target> to end the long war and establish a lasting friendship between their people.", "translation": "這兩個國家最終簽署了一項和平條約，以結束長久的戰爭並在兩國人民之間建立持久的友誼。", "explanation": "名詞「條約」。指正式的國際協議。"}, {"sentence": "The international community criticized the nation for violating the <target>treaty</target> <pattern>on</pattern> nuclear weapons, which threatened global security.", "translation": "國際社會譴責該國違反了關於核武器的條約，這威脅到了全球安全。", "explanation": "名詞「條約」。常用搭配：violate a treaty (違反條約)。"}], "related_forms": ["treaties"]}

{"headword":"tribute","explanation":"名詞，意為「貢獻」、「稱讚」或「悼念」。最常見的用法是 pay tribute to (向...致敬/稱讚)。注意其在古代歷史背景下也可指「貢品」。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the funeral, many people gathered to <pattern>pay</pattern> <target>tribute</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the late president for his lifelong dedication to human rights.","translation":"在葬禮上，許多人聚集在一起向已故的總統致敬，感謝他一生對人權的貢獻。","explanation":"名詞「致敬、稱讚」。常用搭配：pay tribute to (向...致敬)。"},{"sentence":"The beautiful statue in the center of the city is a <target>tribute</target> to the brave soldiers who fought in the war.","translation":"市中心的這座美麗雕像是在向那些在戰爭中戰鬥的勇敢士兵致敬。","explanation":"名詞「致敬之物」。指用以表達敬意的事物。"},{"sentence":"In ancient times, smaller kingdoms were often forced to pay <target>tribute</target> to the powerful empire to avoid being attacked.","translation":"在古代，較小的王國經常被迫向強大的帝國繳納貢品，以避免受到攻擊。","explanation":"名詞「貢品」。指古代強迫繳納的錢財或物品。"}],"related_forms":["tributary"]}

{"headword": "trigger", "explanation": "名詞「扳機」；動詞「觸發」或「引起」。動詞用法最為常見，指某件事物導致另一件事（通常是不好的事）發生。常用搭配：trigger a reaction (觸發反應), trigger an alarm (觸發警報)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The loud noise from the construction site <target>triggered</target> a strong <pattern>reaction</pattern> from the neighbors, who complained about the noise pollution.", "translation": "建築工地傳來的巨大噪音觸發了鄰居們的強烈反應，他們抱怨噪音污染。", "explanation": "動詞「觸發」。指導致某個反應或事件的發生。"}, {"sentence": "The smoke from the kitchen fire <target>triggered</target> the smoke alarm in the building, forcing everyone to leave the premises immediately.", "translation": "廚房火災產生的煙霧觸發了建築物內的煙霧警報器，迫使每個人立即離開場所。", "explanation": "動詞「觸發」。常用搭配：trigger an alarm (觸發警報)。"}, {"sentence": "The police officer warned the suspect not to touch the <target>trigger</target> of the gun, as it could lead to an accidental shooting.", "translation": "警察警告嫌疑人不要觸碰槍的扳機，以免導致意外射擊。", "explanation": "名詞「扳機」。指槍支的觸發裝置。"}], "related_forms": ["triggered"]}

{"headword":"trim","explanation":"動詞「修剪」；名詞「修剪」；形容詞「整潔的」或「苗條的」。動詞用法最常用，指修剪多餘的部分使其整齊。常考搭配：trim the hedges (修剪樹籬)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Every weekend, the gardener carefully <target>trims</target> the hedges and the grass to keep the school garden looking neat and tidy.","translation":"每個週末，，花園管理員都會仔細修剪樹籬和草坪，以保持學校花園看起來整潔。","explanation":"動詞「修剪」。指除去多餘的部分使之整齊。"},{"sentence":"She decided to <target>trim</target> the edges of the photograph to make it fit perfectly into the small wooden frame.","translation":"她決定修剪照片的邊緣，使其能完美地放入那個小木框中。","explanation":"動詞「修剪」。指將某物修剪掉一部分。"},{"sentence":"The athlete maintained a <target>trim</target> figure through a strict diet and daily exercise, which helped him perform better in the competition.","translation":"這位運動員透過嚴格的飲食和每日運動保持著苗條的身形，這有助於他在比賽中表現得更好。","explanation":"形容詞「苗條的、整潔的」。指身體形態纖細且健康。"}],"related_forms":["trimmed","trimming"]}

{"headword":"triple","explanation":"形容詞「三倍的」；動詞「增加到三倍」；名詞「三倍量」。注意與 double (兩倍) 的區別。常用搭配：triple the size (三倍大小)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Due to the sudden increase in tourists, the city's hotel prices have <target>tripled</target> over the last few months, making it expensive for travelers.","translation":"由於遊客的突然增加，該市的酒店價格在過去幾個月內翻了三倍，使得旅行者感到昂貴。","explanation":"動詞「增加到三倍」。指數量或價格增加到原來的三倍。"},{"sentence":"The new library is <target>triple</target> the size of the old one, providing students with more space to study and read books.","translation":"新圖書館的大小是舊圖書館的三倍，為學生提供了更多學習和閱讀書籍的空間。","explanation":"形容詞「三倍的」。常用搭配：triple the size (三倍大小)。"},{"sentence":"The coach decided to <target>triple</target> the amount of training hours for the team, aiming to improve their performance before the big game.","translation":"教練決定將團隊的訓練時數增加到三倍，旨在在重大比賽前提高他們的表現。","explanation":"動詞「增加到三倍」。"}],"related_forms":["tripled","tripling"]}

{"headword":"trivial","explanation":"形容詞「瑣碎的」或「微不足道的」。常用於描述不重要的事情或問題。常考搭配：trivial matter (瑣碎的事), trivial detail (微不足道的細節)。注意與 significant (顯著的/重要的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"They spent hours arguing over <target>trivial</target> <pattern>matters</pattern>, such as who should wash the dishes, instead of focusing on the real problem.","translation":"他們花了好幾個小時爭論瑣碎的事情，比如誰應該洗碗，而不是專注於真正的問題。","explanation":"形容詞「瑣碎的」。指不重要、微不足道的事物。"},{"sentence":"Although the mistake in the essay was <target>trivial</target>, the strict teacher still asked the student to rewrite the entire paragraph.","translation":"儘管作文中的錯誤是微不足道的，但嚴格的老師仍然要求學生重新寫整個段落。","explanation":"形容詞「微不足道的」。指程度輕微或不重要。"},{"sentence":"The scientist argued that the difference in temperature was too <target>trivial</target> to affect the result of the chemistry experiment.","translation":"科學家認為溫度的差異太微不足道，以至於不會影響化學實驗的結果。","explanation":"形容詞「微不足道的」。"}],"related_forms":["triviality","trivially"]}

{"headword":"trophy","explanation":"名詞「獎盃；獎品」。指在比賽或競賽中獲得的象徵勝利的物品。常用搭配：win a trophy (贏得獎盃), a trophy for (為了...的獎盃)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The captain of the basketball team held the gold <target>trophy</target> high in the air, celebrating their victory in the national championship.","translation":"籃球隊隊長將金色的獎盃高高舉起，慶祝他們在全國錦標賽中獲得的勝利。","explanation":"名詞「獎盃」。指在競賽中獲得的獎勵。"},{"sentence":"After years of hard work and training, the young athlete finally won a <target>trophy</target> <pattern>for</pattern> her outstanding performance in the swimming competition.","translation":"經過多年的努力與訓練，這位年輕運動員終於因為在游泳比賽中的出色表現而贏得了一座獎盃。","explanation":"名詞「獎盃」。常用搭配 trophy for something。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"tuition","explanation":"名詞「學費」或「教學」。在 GSAT 中最常用於指代支付給學校或老師的教育費用。常用搭配：pay tuition (支付學費), tuition fees (學費)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many students apply for scholarships to help their parents <pattern>pay</pattern> <target>tuition</target> and other educational expenses at prestigious universities.","translation":"許多學生申請獎學金以幫助父母支付名校的學費及其他教育費用。","explanation":"名詞「學費」。常用動詞搭配 pay tuition。"},{"sentence":"The government has decided to reduce <target>tuition</target> <pattern>fees</pattern> for low-income families to ensure that every child has an equal opportunity to learn.","translation":"政府已決定降低低收入家庭的學費，以確保每個孩子都有平等的學習機會。","explanation":"名詞「學費」。常用搭配 tuition fees。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"tumor","explanation":"名詞「腫瘤」。指身體組織中異常的細胞生長。在學術或醫療相關的閱讀文章中常見。常用搭配：benign tumor (良性腫瘤), malignant tumor (惡性腫瘤)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After several medical tests, the doctors discovered a small <target>tumor</target> in the patient's brain that required immediate surgical removal.","translation":"經過幾次醫療檢查，醫生在病人的大腦中發現了一個小腫瘤，需要立即進行手術切除。","explanation":"名詞「腫瘤」。指身體內異常的增生組織。"},{"sentence":"The specialist explained that the growth was a <pattern>benign</pattern> <target>tumor</target>, meaning it was not cancerous and would not spread to other organs.","translation":"專家解釋說，這個增生物是一個良性腫瘤，意味著它不是癌症且不會擴散到其他器官。","explanation":"名詞「腫瘤」。常用搭配 benign tumor (良性腫瘤)。"}],"related_forms":[]}
