{"headword":"tuna","explanation":"名詞「鮪魚」。指一種常用於商業捕撈的大型海洋魚類。常出現在關於環境保護、海洋生態或食物的文章中。","entries":[{"sentence":"The chef recommended the fresh <target>tuna</target> sashimi, which was imported from Japan and known for its high quality and rich flavor.","translation":"主廚推薦新鮮的鮪魚生魚片，這是從日本進口的，以高品質和豐富的風味著稱。","explanation":"名詞「鮪魚」。"},{"sentence":"Environmentalists are concerned that overfishing of <target>tuna</target> in the Pacific Ocean could lead to a serious decline in the marine population.","translation":"環保人士擔心太平洋中的鮪魚過度捕撈可能會導致海洋生物數量嚴重下降。","explanation":"名詞「鮪魚」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"ultimate","explanation":"形容詞「最終的；極限的」；名詞「終極目標」。形容詞用法最常見，指在一系列事件之後發生的最後結果，或最高等級的狀態。常用搭配：the ultimate goal (最終目標), the ultimate decision (最終決定)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although the team faced many challenges during the project, their <target>ultimate</target> <pattern>goal</pattern> was to create a sustainable energy source for the city.","translation":"儘管團隊在計畫期間面臨許多挑戰，但他們的最終目標是為城市創造一個永續的能源來源。","explanation":"形容詞「最終的」。常用搭配 the ultimate goal。"},{"sentence":"After considering all the available options and consulting with experts, the committee made the <target>ultimate</target> <pattern>decision</pattern> to cancel the event.","translation":"在考慮所有可用選項並諮詢專家後，委員會做出了取消活動的最終決定。","explanation":"形容詞「最終的」。常用搭配 the ultimate decision。"},{"sentence":"For many professional climbers, reaching the summit of Mount Everest is the <target>ultimate</target> <pattern>challenge</pattern> of their entire career.","translation":"對於許多專業登山者來說，登上聖母峰頂是他們整個職業生涯中終極的挑戰。","explanation":"形容詞「極限的/最高等級的」。"}],"related_forms":["ultimately"]}

{"headword":"uncover","explanation":"動詞「揭露；發現」。指揭開覆蓋物或揭開秘密、真相。常用搭配：uncover the truth (揭露真相), uncover a secret (發現秘密)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The journalist spent months researching the case to <target>uncover</target> <pattern>the truth</pattern> <pattern>about</pattern> the company's illegal financial activities.","translation":"這名記者花了好幾個月研究這個案件，以揭露關於公司非法財務活動的真相。","explanation":"動詞「揭露」。指揭開被隱藏的真相或秘密。"},{"sentence":"Archaeologists working at the site managed to <target>uncover</target> an ancient temple that had been buried under the sand for centuries.","translation":"在該遺址工作的考古學家成功發現了一座被埋在沙下數世紀的古廟。","explanation":"動詞「發現」。指將被覆蓋的物品揭開並發現。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"undergo","explanation":"動詞「經歷；遭受」。常用於描述經歷痛苦、困難、改變或醫療手術。常用搭配：undergo surgery (接受手術), undergo training (接受訓練), undergo changes (經歷改變)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The patient had to <target>undergo</target> <pattern>surgery</pattern> to remove the tumor, but the doctors are confident that the operation will be successful.","translation":"病人必須接受手術以切除腫瘤，但醫生對手術會成功很有信心。","explanation":"動詞「接受/經歷」。常用搭配 undergo surgery。"},{"sentence":"To become a licensed pilot, candidates must <target>undergo</target> <pattern>rigorous training</pattern> for several months to ensure they can handle emergencies.","translation":"為了成為一名持照飛行員，應試者必須接受數個月的嚴格訓練，以確保他們能處理緊急狀況。","explanation":"動詞「經歷」。常用搭配 undergo training。"},{"sentence":"Over the last decade, the city's transportation system has <target>undergone</target> <pattern>significant changes</pattern> to reduce traffic congestion and pollution.","translation":"在過去十年中，該市的交通系統經歷了顯著的改變，以減少交通擁堵和污染。","explanation":"動詞「經歷」。常用搭配 undergo changes。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"undergraduate","explanation":"名詞「大學本科生」。指尚未獲得學位（如學士學位）的大學生。注意與 graduate (畢業生) 和 postgraduate (研究生) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"As an <target>undergraduate</target>, she spent most of her time in the library researching for her final thesis on environmental science.","translation":"作為一名大學本科生，她大部分時間都在圖書館為她的環境科學畢業論文做研究。","explanation":"名詞「大學本科生」。指正在就讀大學且尚未畢業的人。"},{"sentence":"The university offers various scholarships for <target>undergraduates</target> who demonstrate outstanding academic performance in their first two years.","translation":"大學為前兩年表現出卓越學術表現的本科生提供各種獎學金。","explanation":"名詞「大學本科生」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"underline","explanation":"動詞「強調；在...下方劃線」；名詞「底線」。在 GSAT 中，動詞用法較常考，指比喻喻義的「強調」。常用搭配：underline the importance of (強調...的重要性)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The recent increase in crime rates serves to <target>underline</target> <pattern>the importance of</pattern> a stronger community policing system.","translation":"最近犯罪率的上升凸顯了建立更強的社區警政系統的重要性。","explanation":"動詞「強調」。指比喻義的強調。常用搭配 underline the importance of。"},{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to <target>underline</target> the main keywords <pattern>in</pattern> the reading passage to help them find the answers more quickly.","translation":"老師要求學生在閱讀文章中劃出關鍵字，以幫助他們更快地找到答案。","explanation":"動詞「在...下方劃線」。指字面義的劃線。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"undermine","explanation":"動詞「削弱；暗中破壞」。原意是指在建築物下方挖掘，引申為逐漸地損害某人的權威、信心或計畫。常用搭配：undermine confidence (削弱信心), undermine authority (削弱權威)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The constant criticism from his manager began to <target>undermine</target> <pattern>his confidence</pattern> <pattern>in</pattern> his own ability to lead the team.","translation":"經理不斷的批評開始削弱他對自己領導團隊能力的信心。","explanation":"動詞「削弱」。指逐漸地損害信心或權威。"},{"sentence":"Spreading false information about the candidate's past can <target>undermine</target> <pattern>the public's trust</pattern> <pattern>in</pattern> the democratic process.","translation":"散布關於候選人過去的假資訊可能會削弱大眾對民主程序的信任。","explanation":"動詞「削弱」。常用搭配 undermine trust in sth。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"undertake","explanation":"動詞「承擔，承接，著手進行」。常用於正式場合，指承諾要做某事或開始一項艱巨的任務。常用搭配：undertake a task/responsibility/project。","entries":[{"sentence":"The research team decided to <target>undertake</target> a comprehensive study on climate change to find sustainable solutions for the environment.","translation":"研究團隊決定著手進行一項關於氣候變遷的全面研究，以尋找環境的永續解決方案。","explanation":"動詞「著手進行」。常用搭配 undertake a study/research。"},{"sentence":"After graduating from college, many students <target>undertake</target> an internship to gain practical experience in their chosen field of study.","translation":"大學畢業後，許多學生會承接實習工作，以便在所選的學習領域中獲得實作經驗。","explanation":"動詞「承接」。"},{"sentence":"The local government promised to <target>undertake</target> the <pattern>responsibility</pattern> <pattern>for</pattern> repairing the damaged roads after the severe earthquake.","translation":"地方政府承諾將承擔維修強震後受損道路的責任。","explanation":"動詞「承擔」。常用搭配 undertake the responsibility for...。"}],"related_forms":["undertaken","undertaking"]}

{"headword":"undo","explanation":"動詞「撤銷，取消，解開」。指將先前所做的事情恢復到原狀。常用於電腦操作（撤銷）或描述行為後果的撤銷。常用搭配：undo the damage, undo a button。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you make a mistake while typing your essay, you can simply press the <target>undo</target> button to reverse the last action.","translation":"如果你在寫論文時打錯字，只需按下撤銷按鈕即可恢復上一個動作。","explanation":"動詞「撤銷」。常用於電腦操作。"},{"sentence":"The sudden economic crisis threatened to <target>undo</target> years of hard work and progress made by the small community.","translation":"突如其來的經濟危機威脅到要將這個小社區多年來努力工作所取得的進展全部抵消。","explanation":"動詞「撤銷/抵消」。指將先前取得的成果毀掉。"},{"sentence":"The young girl slowly <target>undid</target> the ribbons on her gift box, excited to see what surprise was waiting inside.","translation":"小女孩緩慢地解開禮物盒上的絲帶，興奮地想看看裡面等待著什麼驚喜。","explanation":"動詞「解開」。"}],"related_forms":["undone"]}

{"headword":"undoubtedly","explanation":"副詞「毫無疑問地」。用於強調某件事是事實且不可否認。同義詞為 certainly, definitely。常用搭配：It is undoubtedly... (毫無疑問地...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The professor's lecture on quantum physics was <target>undoubtedly</target> one of the most challenging topics the students had ever encountered.","translation":"教授關於量子物理的講座毫無疑問地是學生們曾經遇到過最困難的主題之一。","explanation":"副詞「毫無疑問地」。"},{"sentence":"With her extensive knowledge and passion for music, she is <target>undoubtedly</target> the most talented violinist in the school orchestra.","translation":"憑藉其豐富的知識和對音樂的熱情，她毫無疑問地是學校管弦樂團中最有才華的小提琴手。","explanation":"副詞「毫無疑問地」。"}],"related_forms":["undoubted"]}

{"headword":"unemployment","explanation":"名詞「失業」。指人們想工作但找不到工作的情況。常用搭配：unemployment rate (失業率), tackle unemployment (解決失業問題)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government is implementing new training programs to reduce the <target>unemployment</target> <pattern>rate</pattern> and help people find stable jobs.","translation":"政府正在實施新的培訓計畫以降低失業率，並幫助人們找到穩定的工作。","explanation":"名詞「失業」。常用搭配 unemployment rate。"},{"sentence":"Many young graduates face the challenge of <target>unemployment</target> due to the lack of practical experience required by many companies.","translation":"許多年輕畢業生由於缺乏許多公司要求的實作經驗，而面臨失業的挑戰。","explanation":"名詞「失業」。"}],"related_forms":["unemployed"]}

{"headword":"unfold","explanation":"動詞「展開，揭開，呈現」。可用於物理上的展開（如地圖、信件）或抽象地描述事件的發展過程。常用搭配：unfold before one's eyes (在某人眼前展開)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The traveler carefully <target>unfolded</target> the old map to plan his route through the mountains, hoping to find a hidden waterfall.","translation":"旅行者小心地展開舊地圖，計畫穿越山區的路線，希望能找到一座隱藏的瀑布。","explanation":"動詞「展開」。指物理上的展開。"},{"sentence":"The students watched in silence as the dramatic events of the history play <target>unfolded</target> <pattern>before</pattern> their eyes on stage.","translation":"學生們靜靜地看著歷史劇中戲劇性的事件在舞台上在他們眼前展開。","explanation":"動詞「展開/呈現」。常用片語 unfold before one's eyes。"},{"sentence":"As the story <target>unfolds</target>, we learn more about the character's hidden motives and the secrets of his mysterious past.","translation":"隨著故事的展開，我們對角色的隱藏動機及其神祕過去的秘密了解得更多。","explanation":"動詞「展開」。指事情的發展過程。"}],"related_forms":["unfolding"]}

{"headword":"unlock","explanation":"動詞「解鎖，開啟，釋放」。可用於物理上的開鎖，或比喻義指釋放潛能、揭開秘密。常用搭配：unlock the potential (釋放潛能), unlock the secret (揭開秘密)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The janitor used a master key to <target>unlock</target> all the classroom doors before the students arrived for the first day of school.","translation":"管理員在學生到校第一天之前，用一把萬能鑰匙解鎖了所有教室的門。","explanation":"動詞「解鎖」。指物理上的開鎖。"},{"sentence":"The new educational program aims to <target>unlock</target> the <pattern>potential</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> every student, regardless of their academic background.","translation":"這個新的教育計畫旨在釋放每個學生的潛能，不論其學業背景如何。","explanation":"動詞「釋放」。常用搭配 unlock the potential of...。"},{"sentence":"Archaeologists hope that the new discovery will <target>unlock</target> the <pattern>secrets</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> the ancient civilization that existed thousands of years ago.","translation":"考古學家希望這項新發現能揭開數千年前存在過的古代文明的秘密。","explanation":"動詞「揭開」。常用搭配 unlock the secrets of...。"}],"related_forms":["unlocked"]}

{"headword":"unprecedented","explanation":"形容詞「前所未有的，史無前例的」。指之前從未發生過或從未存在過的事情。常用於描述規模、程度或速度。常用搭配：unprecedented growth, unprecedented scale。","entries":[{"sentence":"The global pandemic caused an <target>unprecedented</target> <pattern>increase</pattern> <pattern>in</pattern> the number of people working from home using digital tools.","translation":"全球流行病導致在家使用數位工具工作的人數前所未有地增加。","explanation":"形容詞「前所未有的」。常用搭配 unprecedented increase in...。"},{"sentence":"The city's new museum features an <target>unprecedented</target> <pattern>collection</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> ancient artifacts, attracting visitors from all over the world.","translation":"這座城市的新博物館擁有前所未有的古代文物收藏，吸引了來自世界各地的遊客。","explanation":"形容詞「前所未有的」。常用搭配 unprecedented collection of...。"},{"sentence":"Due to the <target>unprecedented</target> <pattern>amount of</pattern> snowfall this winter, the school decided to cancel classes for three consecutive days.","translation":"由於今年冬天前所未有的降雪量，學校決定連續三天停課。","explanation":"形容詞「前所未有的」。常用搭配 unprecedented amount of...。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"update","explanation":"動詞「更新」；名詞「最新消息，更新」。動詞用法指將資訊或軟體更新到最新版本。名詞用法指最新的資訊或進展。常用搭配：update sth to the latest version, give an update on sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"You should regularly <target>update</target> your computer's operating system to protect your personal data from potential security threats.","translation":"你應該定期更新電腦的作業系統，以保護你的個人資料免於潛在的安全威脅。","explanation":"動詞「更新」。常用搭配 update the operating system。"},{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to <target>update</target> their research papers with the most recent data from the official government website.","translation":"老師要求學生用政府官方網站上的最新數據來更新他們的研究論文。","explanation":"動詞「更新」。"},{"sentence":"The project manager gave a brief <target>update</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the progress of the construction, explaining that the building would be finished by next month.","translation":"專案經理簡短地報告了建築工程的進展最新消息，解釋說建築將在下個月完工。","explanation":"名詞「最新消息」。常用搭配 give an update on...。"}],"related_forms":["updated"]}

{"headword":"upgrade","explanation":"動詞「升級」；名詞「升級」。指將某物提升到更高、更好的等級或品質。常用於科技產品、職位或設施。常用搭配：upgrade to a better model, get an upgrade。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school decided to <target>upgrade</target> the old computer lab with new high-speed internet and modern laptops for every student.","translation":"學校決定升級舊的電腦實驗室，為每位學生提供新的高速網路和現代化的筆記型電腦。","explanation":"動詞「升級」。"},{"sentence":"Because of a technical error during booking, the airline <pattern>gave</pattern> him a free <target>upgrade</target> <pattern>to</pattern> business class for his flight to Tokyo.","translation":"由於預訂時出現技術錯誤，航空公司為他前往東京的航班免費升級到商務艙。","explanation":"名詞「升級」。常用搭配 give an upgrade to...。"},{"sentence":"To improve efficiency, the company decided to <target>upgrade</target> its software system to a more powerful and reliable version.","translation":"為了提高效率，公司決定將其軟體系統升級到更強大且可靠的版本。","explanation":"動詞「升級」。"}],"related_forms":["upgraded"]}

{"headword":"utility","explanation":"名詞「效用，用途」；「公用事業 (如水、電、瓦斯)」。在學術情境中，指某物對達成目標的 helpfulness；在生活情境中，指基礎設施。常用搭配：public utility, utility bill。","entries":[{"sentence":"The professor explained that the <target>utility</target> <pattern>of</pattern> this mathematical formula is limited to specific types of physics problems.","translation":"教授解釋說，這個數學公式的效用僅限於特定類型的物理問題。","explanation":"名詞「效用」。常用搭配 utility of sth。"},{"sentence":"During the summer, the family's <target>utility</target> <pattern>bills</pattern> often increase significantly because they use the air conditioner all day.","translation":"在夏天，這家人的公用事業費用通常會顯著增加，因為他們整天使用冷氣。","explanation":"名詞「公用事業」。常用搭配 utility bills (水電瓦斯費)。"},{"sentence":"The new multi-purpose tool was praised for its <target>utility</target> in the wilderness, making it essential for experienced hikers.","translation":"這款新型多功能工具因其在野外生存的實用性而受到稱讚，使其成為經驗豐富的登山客的必備品。","explanation":"名詞「效用/實用性」。"}],"related_forms":["utilitarian","utilize"]}

{"headword": "utilize", "explanation": "動詞「利用」。指有效地使用某物以達成特定目的，比 use 更正式。常用搭配：utilize resources (利用資源), utilize technology (利用技術)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The school decided to <target>utilize</target> new digital tools <pattern>in</pattern> the classroom to make learning more interactive and engaging for students.", "translation": "學校決定在教室裡利用新的數位工具，讓學習對學生來說更具互動性和溫度。", "explanation": "動詞「利用」。指有效地使用資源或工具以達成目標。"}, {"sentence": "To save energy, the city planned to <target>utilize</target> solar power <pattern>for</pattern> street lighting in all the residential neighborhoods.", "translation": "為了節能，該市計劃利用太陽能為所有住宅區的街道照明提供電力。", "explanation": "動詞「利用」。常用搭配 utilize ... for ...。"}, {"sentence": "Experienced managers often <target>utilize</target> their communication skills to resolve conflicts between employees and maintain a positive work environment.", "translation": "經驗豐富的經理經常利用他們的溝通技巧來解決員工之間的衝突並維持正面的工作環境。", "explanation": "動詞「利用」。指利用一種能力或技巧。"}, {"sentence": "The startup company aimed to <target>utilize</target> a gap in the market by offering an affordable alternative to expensive luxury brands.", "translation": "這家新創公司旨在利用市場上的空隙，提供一個可替代昂貴奢侈品牌的實惠選擇。", "explanation": "動詞「利用」。指利用一個機會或市場空隙。"}], "related_forms": ["utilization", "utility"]}

{"headword": "vacuum", "explanation": "名詞「真空」或「吸塵器」；動詞「用吸塵器清理」。注意在名詞中，真空 (a vacuum) 與吸塵器 (a vacuum cleaner) 是不同概念，但口語中常將 vacuum cleaner 簡稱為 vacuum。", "entries": [{"sentence": "In a science experiment, students learned how to create a <target>vacuum</target> in a glass jar to see if sound could travel through it.", "translation": "在一項科學實驗中，學生學習如何玻璃罐中製造真空，以觀察聲音是否能透過真空傳播。", "explanation": "名詞「真空」。指完全沒有物質的空間。"}, {"sentence": "Since the carpet was covered in dust, the student <target>vacuum</target>ed the living room before his parents came home.", "translation": "因為地毯上滿是灰塵，這名學生在父母回家前必須用吸塵器清理客廳。", "explanation": "動詞「用吸塵器清理」。"}, {"sentence": "The mother asked her son to use the <target>vacuum</target> to clean the crumbs under the sofa, as the broom was not effective enough.", "translation": "母親要求兒子使用吸塵器清理沙發下的碎屑，因為掃帚不夠有效。", "explanation": "名詞「吸塵器」。口語中 vacuum 常指 vacuum cleaner。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"vague","explanation":"形容詞「模糊的、含糊的」。指意思不清晰或記憶不鮮明。常用搭配：a vague idea (模糊的概念), a vague memory (模糊的記憶), be vague about (對...含糊其辭)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher's instructions were too <target>vague</target>, leaving many students confused about how to start their final research project.","translation":"老師的指示太模糊了，讓許多學生對如何開始他們的期末研究計畫感到困惑。","explanation":"形容詞「模糊的」。指說明或指示不清晰。"},{"sentence":"He had only a <target>vague</target> <pattern>memory of</pattern> the old house where he lived as a child, as it had been many years.","translation":"他對童年居住的舊房子只有模糊的記憶，因為已經過了許多年。","explanation":"形容詞「模糊的」。常用搭配 a vague memory of...。"},{"sentence":"When asked about his future plans, the student was <target>vague</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the details, suggesting he had not decided yet.","translation":"當被問到未來計畫時，該學生對細節含糊其辭，顯示他還沒決定。","explanation":"形容詞「含糊的」。片語 be vague about sth。"}],"related_forms":["vaguely","vagueness"]}

{"headword":"valid","explanation":"形容詞「有效的、正當的」。可用於法律、票券或論點。常用搭配：a valid passport (有效護照), a valid reason (正當理由), valid evidence (有效證據)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please make sure your passport is still <target>valid</target> <pattern>for</pattern> at least six months if you plan to travel abroad this summer.","translation":"如果你計劃今年夏天出國旅遊，請確保你的護照在至少六個月內仍然有效。","explanation":"形容詞「有效的」。指文件或證件在法律上仍然有效。"},{"sentence":"The professor argued that the student's conclusion was not <target>valid</target> because it was based on a small and biased sample size.","translation":"教授認為該學生的結論是不成立的，因為它是基於一個較小且有偏見的樣本量。","explanation":"形容詞「正當的、成立的」。指論點或邏輯在理論上是正確的。"},{"sentence":"The employee provided a <target>valid</target> <pattern>reason for</pattern> his absence from the meeting, so the manager did not penalize him.","translation":"該員工為其缺席會議提供了正當理由，因此經理沒有處罰他。","explanation":"形容詞「正當的」。常用搭配 a valid reason for...。"}],"related_forms":["validate","validation","validity"]}

{"headword":"variable","explanation":"形容詞「可變的、易變的」；名詞「變數」。在科學或數學中，variable 指影響結果的因素。常用搭配：variable weather (多變的天氣), a controlled variable (控制變數)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The weather in spring is highly <target>variable</target>, so students are advised to bring an umbrella regardless of the sunny morning.","translation":"春天的天氣非常多變，因此建議學生無論早晨是否晴朗，都應攜帶雨傘。","explanation":"形容詞「可變的、易變的」。"},{"sentence":"In the chemistry experiment, the amount of water was kept as a constant <target>variable</target> to ensure the results were accurate.","translation":"在化學實驗中，水的量被保持為一個常數變數，以確保結果準確。","explanation":"名詞「變數」。指實驗中可改變或保持不變的因素。"},{"sentence":"Success in learning a language depends on many <target>variables</target>, such as the student's motivation and the environment they are in.","translation":"學習語言的成功取決於許多變數，例如學生的學習動機和他們所處的環境。","explanation":"名詞「變數」。指影響結果的因素。"}],"related_forms":["variability","variably"]}

{"headword":"variation","explanation":"名詞「變化、差異」。指在同一類事物中存在的微小差異。常用搭配：a variation in (在...方面的變化), a slight variation (微小的差異)。","entries":[{"sentence":"There is a significant <target>variation</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the temperature between day and night in the desert, which can be dangerous for travelers.","translation":"沙漠中晝夜的溫度差異顯著，這對旅行者來說可能很危險。","explanation":"名詞「變化、差異」。常用搭配 a variation in sth。"},{"sentence":"The chef explained that this dish is a <target>variation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a traditional Italian recipe, with a few local ingredients added.","translation":"主廚解釋說這道菜是傳統義大利食譜的一個變體，加入了一些當地食材。","explanation":"名詞「變體、差異」。常用搭配 a variation of sth。"},{"sentence":"Scientists noticed a slight <target>variation</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the bird's song, which helped them distinguish between different subspecies of the same bird.","translation":"科學家注意到鳥鳴聲有微小差異，這幫助他們區分同一種鳥的不同亞種。","explanation":"名詞「差異」。"}],"related_forms":["vary","variable"]}

{"headword": "vein", "explanation": "名詞「靜脈」或「風格/特質」。指血液從身體流向心臟的血管。在比喻意義上， vein 可指一種特定的風格或情緒。常用搭配：in a similar vein (以類似的方式/風格)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The nurse carefully found the patient's <target>vein</target> to draw blood for a medical test, ensuring the process was as painless as possible.", "translation": "護士仔細地尋找病人的靜脈以抽取血液進行醫療測試，確保過程盡量無痛。", "explanation": "名詞「靜脈」。指血液流回心臟的血管。"}, {"sentence": "The surgeon performed a delicate operation to repair a damaged <target>vein</target> in the patient's leg to prevent further complications.", "translation": "外科醫生進行了一次精細的手術來修復病人腿部受損的靜脈，以防止進一步的併發症。", "explanation": "名詞「靜脈」。指生物學上的血管。"}, {"sentence": "The author wrote another novel <pattern>in a similar</pattern> <target>vein</target> to her first book, focusing on themes of loneliness and memory.", "translation": "作者寫了另一本小說，風格與她的第一本書類似，專注於孤獨和記憶點上。", "explanation": "名詞「風格/特質」。片語 in a similar vein 表示「以類似的方式或風格」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"vendor","explanation":"名詞「供應商、小販」。指銷售商品或服務的人或公司。常用搭配：street vendor (路邊小販), software vendor (軟體供應商)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The hungry student bought a hot dog from a street <target>vendor</target> on his way to school, as he had skipped breakfast.","translation":"飢餓的學生在去學校的路上從路邊小販那裡買了個熱狗，因為他沒吃早餐。","explanation":"名詞「小販」。指在街上銷售商品的人。"},{"sentence":"The university's IT department is looking for a reliable software <target>vendor</target> to provide new security systems for the campus network.","translation":"大學的 IT 部門正在尋找一家可靠的軟體供應商來提供校園網路的新安全系統。","explanation":"名詞「供應商」。指銷售特定商品或服務的公司。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"venture","explanation":"名詞「冒險事業」或動詞「冒險」。名詞時指一個具有風險的風險投資或事業。動詞時指在風險情況下敢於行動或說話。常用搭配：joint venture (合資企業), venture into (涉足/冒險進入)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two tech companies decided to start a joint <target>venture</target> to develop a new type of artificial intelligence that could assist doctors.","translation":"這兩家科技公司決定成立一家合資企業，開發一種可以用於輔助醫生的新型人工智慧。","explanation":"名詞「合資企業/冒險事業」。片語 joint venture 指合資企業。"},{"sentence":"Despite the heavy rain, the hikers <target>ventured</target> <pattern>into</pattern> the deep forest, hoping to find the hidden waterfall mentioned in the guidebook.","translation":"儘管雨下得很大，登山客仍冒險進入深林，希望找到指南書中提到的隱藏瀑布。","explanation":"動詞「冒險進入」。片語 venture into sth。"},{"sentence":"The shy student finally <target>ventured</target> <pattern>to</pattern> ask a question during the lecture, even though he was afraid of sounding silly.","translation":"這名害羞的學生終於敢於在講座中提出一個問題，儘管他擔心會顯起來很傻。","explanation":"動詞「冒險做某事」。片語 venture to V。"}],"related_forms":["venturous","venturer"]}

{"headword":"venue","explanation":"名詞「場地、地點」。常用於正式活動如會議、婚禮或演唱會的場地。常用搭配：the perfect venue (完美的場地), a wedding venue (婚禮場地)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city's central park was chosen as the <target>venue</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the annual music festival, attracting thousands of visitors from across the country.","translation":"市中心公園被選為年度音樂節的場地，吸引了來自全國各地的數千名遊客。","explanation":"名詞「場地」。常用搭配 venue for sth。"},{"sentence":"After searching for several months, the couple finally found the perfect <target>venue</target> <pattern>for</pattern> their wedding, a small chapel by the sea.","translation":"經過數月的搜尋，這對夫妻終於找到了完美的婚禮場地，一座位於海邊的小教堂。","explanation":"名詞「場地」。"}],"related_forms":["venues"]}

{"headword":"verbal","explanation":"形容詞指「口頭的」或「語言的」，名詞則指「動詞類型的詞」。在 GSAT 中，最常考的是形容詞用法，尤其是 verbal communication (口頭溝通) 或 verbal agreement (口頭協議)。注意與 non-verbal (非語言的/肢體語言) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"Since they had only a <target>verbal</target> <pattern>agreement</pattern>, the lawyer suggested they put the contract in writing to avoid future disputes.","translation":"由於他們只有口頭協議，律師建議他們將合約以書面形式記錄，以避免未來的爭議。","explanation":"形容詞「口頭的」。常用搭配：verbal agreement (口頭協議)。"},{"sentence":"Experts suggest that <target>verbal</target> <pattern>communication</pattern> is only one part of interaction, as body language also plays a significant role.","translation":"專家建議口頭溝通只是互動的一部分，因為肢體語言也扮演著重要角色。","explanation":"形容詞「語言的、口頭的」。常用搭配：verbal communication (口頭溝通)。"},{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to provide a <target>verbal</target> <pattern>response</pattern> instead of writing their answers on the paper.","translation":"老師要求學生以口頭回答而非將答案寫在紙上。","explanation":"形容詞「口頭的」。常用搭配：verbal response (口頭回答)。"}],"related_forms":["verbally"]}

{"headword":"verdict","explanation":"名詞「裁決，判決」。通常指陪審團或法官在法庭上的最終決定。常用搭配 reach a verdict (達成裁決), deliver a verdict (宣布判決)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After hours of intense deliberation, the jury finally <pattern>reached</pattern> a <target>verdict</target> of not guilty, releasing the defendant from all charges.","translation":"經過數小時的激烈討論，陪審團最終達成了無罪的裁決，使被告免於所有指控。","explanation":"名詞「裁決」。常用搭配：reach a verdict (達成裁決)。"},{"sentence":"The judge is expected to <pattern>deliver</pattern> his <target>verdict</target> tomorrow morning, which will decide the fate of the accused man.","translation":"法官預計將在明天早上宣布他的判決，這將決定被告男子的命運。","explanation":"名詞「判決」。常用搭配：deliver a verdict (宣布判決)。"}],"related_forms":["verdicts"]}

{"headword":"version","explanation":"名詞「版本，譯本」。指同一件事物但形式或細節略有不同的形式。常用於軟體更新、語言翻譯或對某事件的不同敘述。","entries":[{"sentence":"The software company released a newer <target>version</target> of the app to fix bugs and improve the overall user experience.","translation":"軟體公司發布了該應用程式的新版本，以修復漏洞並提升整體使用者體驗。","explanation":"名詞「版本」。指軟體或文件的更新版本。"},{"sentence":"The witness gave a different <target>version</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the accident, which made the police suspicious about the truth of the story.","translation":"證人對事故提供了不同的敘述，這讓警察對故事的真實性產生懷疑。","explanation":"名詞「版本/敘述」。常用搭配：version of sth (對...的敘述/版本)。"},{"sentence":"I prefer the English <target>version</target> of the book because the translation is more accurate and easier to understand than the Chinese one.","translation":"我更喜歡這本書的英文版，因為翻譯比中文版更準確且更容易理解。","explanation":"名詞「譯本」。"}],"related_forms":["versions"]}

{"headword":"versus","explanation":"介系詞「對抗，相對」。常用縮寫為 vs.。用於描述兩者之間的競爭、對比或法律訴訟。","entries":[{"sentence":"The final match of the basketball tournament will be the home team <target>versus</target> the visiting team from the city.","translation":"籃球賽的決賽將由主場球隊對陣來自城市的客場球隊。","explanation":"介系詞「對抗」。用於體育比賽。"},{"sentence":"The debate focused on the advantages of living in the city <target>versus</target> the benefits of living in the countryside.","translation":"辯論集中在住在城市與住在鄉下的優點對比。","explanation":"介系詞「相對/對比」。用於兩者之間的比較。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"vertical","explanation":"形容詞「垂直的」，名詞指「垂直線」。與 horizontal (水平的) 相對。常用於描述方向、圖表或建築物。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to draw a <target>vertical</target> line on the graph to represent the change in temperature over time.","translation":"老師要求學生在圖表上畫一條垂直線，以代表溫度隨時間的變化。","explanation":"形容詞「垂直的」。"},{"sentence":"To ensure the shelf was stable, the carpenter used a tool to check if the support beam was perfectly <target>vertical</target>.","translation":"為了確保層架穩定，木工使用工具檢查支撐樑是否完全垂直。","explanation":"形容詞「垂直的」。"},{"sentence":"The climber struggled to scale the <target>vertical</target> cliff face, which was nearly impossible to climb without special equipment.","translation":"登山者努力攀登垂直的峭壁，如果沒有特殊設備，幾乎不可能攀登。","explanation":"形容詞「垂直的」。"}],"related_forms":["vertically"]}

{"headword":"veteran","explanation":"名詞指「退伍軍人」或「經驗豐富的人」。在 GSAT 中，注意區分其指代對象：可以是軍事背景或任何專業領域的資深人士。","entries":[{"sentence":"The local community center provides special healthcare services <pattern>for</pattern> <target>veterans</target> who served in the army many years ago.","translation":"當地社區中心為多年前服役的退伍軍人提供特殊的醫療服務。","explanation":"名詞「退伍軍人」。"},{"sentence":"As a <target>veteran</target> journalist, she has covered many international conflicts and knows exactly how to handle difficult interviews.","translation":"作為一名資深記者，她報導過許多國際衝突，並且非常清楚如何處理困難的採訪。","explanation":"名詞「經驗豐富的人/資深人士」。"}],"related_forms":["veterans"]}

{"headword":"via","explanation":"介系詞「經由，通過」。可用於描述路徑、媒介或手段。例如 via email (透過電子郵件), via the highway (經由高速公路)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students submitted their final assignments <target>via</target> the online portal to ensure they were received by the teacher on time.","translation":"學生們透過線上入口網站提交最終作業，以確保老師能準時收到。","explanation":"介系詞「透過」。指使用某種媒介或手段。"},{"sentence":"If you want to travel from Taipei to Kaohsiung, the fastest way is <target>via</target> the high-speed rail system.","translation":"如果你想從台北旅行到高雄，最快的方式是經由高鐵系統。","explanation":"介系詞「經由」。指經過某個地點或路徑。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"viable","explanation":"形容詞「可行的，能生存的」。常用於描述計畫、方案或生物個體。常用搭配 a viable alternative (一個可行的替代方案)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The committee spent weeks discussing the proposal, but they eventually decided it was not a <target>viable</target> <pattern>option</pattern> due to lack of funds.","translation":"委員會花了好幾週討論這項提案，但他們最終決定由於缺乏資金，這不是一個可行的選擇。","explanation":"形容詞「可行的」。常用搭配：viable option/alternative (可行的選擇/替代方案)。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are searching for a <target>viable</target> <pattern>solution</pattern> to reduce plastic pollution in the ocean without affecting the local economy.","translation":"科學家正在尋找一個可行的解決方案，以在不影響當地經濟的情況下減少海洋中的塑膠污染。","explanation":"形容詞「可行的」。常用搭配：viable solution (可行的解決方案)。"}],"related_forms":["viability"]}

{"headword":"vicious","explanation":"形容詞「兇殘的，惡劣的」。常用於描述動物、人或某種負面循環。注意常用片語 vicious circle (惡性循環)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The neighborhood was warned about a <target>vicious</target> dog that often barked and tried to attack people walking by.","translation":"社區接到了關於一隻經常吠叫並試圖攻擊路人的兇殘狗的警告。","explanation":"形容詞「兇殘的」。"},{"sentence":"Many people fall into a <target>vicious</target> <pattern>circle</pattern> of debt, where they borrow more money to pay off their previous loans.","translation":"許多人陷入了債務的惡性循環，他們借更多錢來償還之前的貸款。","explanation":"形容詞「惡劣的」。常用搭配：vicious circle (惡性循環)。"},{"sentence":"The politician was criticized for making <target>vicious</target> <pattern>attacks</pattern> on his opponent's personal life during the election campaign.","translation":"這位政治家因在競選期間對對手的私生活進行惡劣的攻擊而受到批評。","explanation":"形容詞「惡劣的/兇殘的」。"}],"related_forms":["viciously","viciousness"]}

{"headword":"viewer","explanation":"名詞「觀眾」。專指看電視、影片或展覽的人。與 audience (觀眾) 的區別在於 viewer 側重於透過螢幕觀看，而 audience 則可指聽眾或在場的所有觀眾。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new reality show attracted millions of <target>viewers</target> <pattern>across</pattern> the country, making it the most popular program of the year.","translation":"這部新的實境秀吸引了全國數百萬名觀眾，使其成為今年最受欢迎的節目。","explanation":"名詞「觀眾」。"},{"sentence":"The news channel encouraged <target>viewers</target> to send in their opinions <pattern>via</pattern> email to participate in the discussion about climate change.","translation":"新聞頻道鼓勵觀眾透過電子郵件發送他們的意見，以參與關於氣候變遷的討論。","explanation":"名詞「觀眾」。"}],"related_forms":["view","viewing"]}

{"headword":"viewpoint","explanation":"名詞「觀點、看法」。常與 from 的介系詞連用，表示「從...的觀點來看」。","entries":[{"sentence":"From a financial <target>viewpoint</target>, investing in renewable energy is a smart decision for the long-term growth of the company.","translation":"從財務觀點來看，投資可再生能源是公司長期增長的明智決定。","explanation":"名詞「觀點」。常用片語 from a ... viewpoint。"},{"sentence":"The students were encouraged to share their different <target>viewpoints</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the environmental issues during the class discussion.","translation":"在課堂討論中，鼓勵學生們分享他們對環境問題的不同看法。","explanation":"名詞「觀點」。常搭配介系詞 on 表示對某事的看法。"}],"related_forms":["viewpoints"]}

{"headword":"vinegar","explanation":"名詞「醋」。通常指用於烹飪或清潔的酸性液體。","entries":[{"sentence":"To make the salad taste fresher, the chef added a small amount of <target>vinegar</target> and olive oil to the vegetables.","translation":"為了讓沙拉味道更清新，廚師在蔬菜中加入少量醋和橄欖油。","explanation":"名詞「醋」。"},{"sentence":"My grandmother often uses <target>vinegar</target> to clean the glass windows because it can remove stains more effectively than plain water.","translation":"我的祖母經常使用醋來清潔玻璃窗，因為它比清水能更有效地去除污漬。","explanation":"名詞「醋」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"virtual","explanation":"形容詞「虛擬的」或「幾乎、事實上的」。在現代科技語境中，常用於指透過電腦網路實現的虛擬環境（如 virtual reality）。","entries":[{"sentence":"Due to the heavy snowstorm, the university decided to hold a <target>virtual</target> meeting <pattern>via</pattern> Zoom to ensure everyone's safety.","translation":"由於強烈的暴風雪，大學決定透過 Zoom 舉行虛擬會議，以確保每個人的安全。","explanation":"形容詞「虛擬的」。指透過電腦網路進行的。"},{"sentence":"The new software allows users to explore a <target>virtual</target> museum, where they can see ancient artifacts from their own homes.","translation":"這款新軟體允許使用者探索虛擬博物館，他們可以在家中看到古代文物。","explanation":"形容詞「虛擬的」。"},{"sentence":"After losing almost all of his savings, the businessman faced a <target>virtual</target> impossibility <pattern>of</pattern> recovering his lost wealth.","translation":"在失去了幾乎所有的積蓄後，這位商人面臨著幾乎不可能恢復其失財的困境。","explanation":"形容詞「幾乎、事實上的」。此處表示極高程度的可能性，接近於事實。"}],"related_forms":["virtually"]}

{"headword":"visa","explanation":"名詞「簽證」。指允許外國人進入某國的正式許可證。常用搭配：apply for a visa (申請簽證), grant a visa (核發簽證)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Before traveling to the United States for the summer camp, the student had to <pattern>apply</pattern> <pattern>for</pattern> a tourist <target>visa</target> at the embassy.","translation":"在前往美國參加夏令營之前，該學生必須在大使館申請觀光簽證。","explanation":"名詞「簽證」。片語 apply for a visa 表示申請簽證。"},{"sentence":"The traveler was worried that the embassy might not <pattern>grant</pattern> him a <target>visa</target> because his passport had expired last month.","translation":"旅客擔心大使館可能不會核發簽證給他，因為他的護照上個月就過期了。","explanation":"名詞「簽證」。片語 grant a visa 表示核發簽證。"}],"related_forms":["visas"]}

{"headword":"vocal","explanation":"形容詞「聲音的、口頭的」或「大聲表達意見的」；名詞「嗓音」。注意 vocal chords (聲帶) 和 be vocal about sth (大聲地對某事表達意見)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The choir members practiced their <target>vocal</target> exercises every morning to ensure their voices were clear and strong for the concert.","translation":"合唱團成員每天早上練習發聲練習，以確保在音樂會上聲音清晰且強而有力。","explanation":"形容詞「聲音的」。指與嗓音相關的。"},{"sentence":"Many students became very <target>vocal</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the new school rules, arguing that they were too strict and unfair.","translation":"許多學生對新的學校規定表現得非常大聲地表達意見，認為這些規定太過嚴格且不公平。","explanation":"形容詞「大聲表達意見的」。片語 be vocal about sth。"},{"sentence":"The opera singer's incredible <target>vocal</target> range allowed her to sing both very low and very high notes with ease.","translation":"歌劇歌手驚人的嗓音範圍讓她能輕鬆地唱出極低和極高的音符。","explanation":"名詞「嗓音」。"}],"related_forms":["vocally"]}

{"headword": "volcano", "explanation": "名詞「火山」。常用搭配：volcanic eruption (火山爆發)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The scientists monitored the <target>volcano</target> closely, as they noticed a sudden increase in seismic activity beneath the mountain.", "translation": "科學家密切監測這座火山，因為他們注意到山下地震活動突然增加。", "explanation": "名詞「火山」。"}, {"sentence": "The sudden eruption was caused by the <target>volcano</target> waking up after centuries of dormancy.", "translation": "這次突然的火山爆發是由於這座火山在沉睡數世紀後再次甦醒所造成的。", "explanation": "名詞「火山」。"}], "related_forms": ["volcanoes", "volcanic"]}

{"headword":"vomit","explanation":"動詞「嘔吐」；名詞「嘔吐物」。常用於醫療或健康描述。","entries":[{"sentence":"After eating some spoiled seafood at the market, the tourist began to <target>vomit</target> and felt extremely dizzy.","translation":"在市場吃了一些變質的海鮮後，遊客開始嘔吐並感到極其暈眩。","explanation":"動詞「嘔吐」。"},{"sentence":"The nurse quickly cleaned up the <target>vomit</target> on the floor to keep the environment clean and prevent other students from feeling sick.","translation":"護理師迅速清理了地板上的嘔吐物，以保持環境清潔並防止其他學生感到不適。","explanation":"名詞「嘔吐物」。"}],"related_forms":["vomiting"]}

{"headword":"voucher","explanation":"名詞「代金券、兌換券」。常用搭配：redeem a voucher (兌換代金券)。","entries":[{"sentence":"As a reward for winning the competition, the student received a gift <target>voucher</target> that could be used at any bookstore in the city.","translation":"作為贏得比賽的獎勵，該學生收到了一張禮品代金券，可用於市內任何一家書店。","explanation":"名詞「代金券」。"},{"sentence":"She decided to <pattern>redeem</pattern> her <target>voucher</target> <pattern>for</pattern> a new pair of running shoes after the sports store offered a big discount.","translation":"在運動店提供大折扣後，她決定用她的代金券兌換一雙新跑鞋。","explanation":"名詞「代金券」。片語 redeem a voucher for sth。"}],"related_forms":["vouchers"]}

{"headword":"vow","explanation":"動詞「發誓」；名詞「誓言」。常用搭配：make a vow (發誓), take a vow (發誓)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After the car accident, the young man <target>vowed</target> <pattern>to</pattern> never drink and drive again to avoid causing more pain to others.","translation":"在車禍之後，這個年輕人發誓再也不會酒駕，以避免給他人帶來更多痛苦。","explanation":"動詞「發誓」。常用搭配 vow to V。"},{"sentence":"During the wedding ceremony, the couple <pattern>exchanged</pattern> their <target>vows</target> in front of the family and friends, promising to love each other forever.","translation":"在婚禮儀式上，這對夫妻在家人和朋友面前交換誓言，承諾永遠愛彼此。","explanation":"名詞「誓言」。片語 exchange vows。"},{"sentence":"The athlete <pattern>made</pattern> a solemn <target>vow</target> to train harder than ever before to win a gold medal in the next Olympics.","translation":"這名運動員做出了一個莊重的誓言，要比以前更努力地訓練，以在下一次奧運會贏得金牌。","explanation":"名詞「誓言」。片語 make a vow。"}],"related_forms":["vows","vowed"]}

{"headword": "vulnerable", "explanation": "形容詞「脆弱的、易受攻擊的」。常用搭配：be vulnerable to sth (容易受...影響/攻擊)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Young children and elderly people are often more <target>vulnerable</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the flu, so they should get vaccinated every year.", "translation": "幼童和年長者通常更容易受流感影響，因此他們每年都應該接種疫苗。", "explanation": "形容詞「脆弱的」。片語 be vulnerable to sth。"}, {"sentence": "The coastal city is highly <target>vulnerable</target> <pattern>to</pattern> floods because it is located at a very low altitude near the sea.", "translation": "這座沿海城市非常容易受水災影響，因為它位於海邊非常低的海拔高度。", "explanation": "形容詞「易受攻擊的」。片語 be vulnerable to sth。"}, {"sentence": "Sharing too much personal information online can make you more <target>vulnerable</target> <pattern>to</pattern> identity theft and other cyber crimes.", "translation": "在網路上分享太多個人資訊可能會讓你更容易遭受身份盜用和其他網路犯罪。", "explanation": "形容詞「vulnerable」。片語 be vulnerable to sth。"}], "related_forms": ["vulnerability"]}

{"headword":"warehouse","explanation":"名詞「倉庫」；動詞「將...存放於倉庫」。常用於物流、商業或工業場景。注意其作為動詞時通常指長期存放。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company decided to rent a larger <target>warehouse</target> near the port to store their imported goods before distributing them to shops.","translation":"公司決定在港口附近租一個更大的倉庫，以便在將進口商品分發到商店之前進行存放。","explanation":"名詞「倉庫」。"},{"sentence":"To reduce storage costs, the firm began to <target>warehouse</target> its excess inventory in a cheaper rural area instead of the city center.","translation":"為了降低儲存成本，該公司開始將其過剩的庫存存放於較便宜的鄉村地區，而非市中心。","explanation":"動詞「將...存放於倉庫」。"}],"related_forms":["warehouses","warehousing"]}

{"headword":"warrior","explanation":"名詞「戰士」。指勇敢地戰鬥的人，可用於描述古代士兵或現代在困難面前表現出勇氣的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The museum displayed a collection of ancient <target>warriors</target>' armor and weapons, showing the fighting styles of the early civilization.","translation":"博物館展出了古代戰士的盔甲和武器收藏，展示了早期文明的戰鬥風格。","explanation":"名詞「戰士」。"},{"sentence":"Despite facing numerous failures and illnesses, the athlete fought like a true <target>warrior</target> to win the gold medal in the Olympics.","translation":"儘管面對多次失敗和疾病，這位運動員像個真正的戰士一樣奮鬥，最終在奧運會中贏得金牌。","explanation":"名詞「戰士」。此處為比喻用法，指勇氣與毅力。"}],"related_forms":["warriors"]}

{"headword":"wary","explanation":"形容詞「謹慎的、警覺的」。指因擔心危險或問題而小心行事。常用搭配 be wary of (對...保持警覺)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The experienced traveler was <target>wary</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the strangers who offered him cheap tours, fearing they might be scams.","translation":"這位經驗豐富的旅行者對那些提供廉價行程的陌生人保持警覺，擔心他們可能是詐騙。","explanation":"形容詞「謹慎的」。常用搭配 be wary of sth/sb (對...保持警覺)。"},{"sentence":"After the previous failure, the investors were <target>wary</target> <pattern>of</pattern> putting more money into the new project without a detailed plan.","translation":"在之前的失敗之後，投資者對在沒有詳細計畫的情況下將更多資金投入新計畫保持警覺。","explanation":"形容詞「警覺的」。"}],"related_forms":["warily","wariness"]}

{"headword":"weird","explanation":"形容詞「怪異的、古怪的」。指與平常不同且令人感到不適或好奇。口語中極為常見，在學術寫作中可用 unusual 或 peculiar 代替。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students noticed a <target>weird</target> smell coming from the chemistry lab, which turned out to be a result of an unexpected reaction.","translation":"學生們注意到化學實驗室傳來一種怪異的味道，結果證明是意外反應導致的。","explanation":"形容詞「怪異的」。"},{"sentence":"It was quite <target>weird</target> that the phone rang exactly at midnight, although no one was expected to call at that hour.","translation":"在午夜時分電話突然響起相當怪異，儘管當時沒有人預計會打來。","explanation":"形容詞「古怪的」。"}],"related_forms":["weirdly","weirdness"]}

{"headword":"whatsoever","explanation":"形容詞/代名詞「無論什麼、一點也（不）」。通常用於否定句的末尾以加強語氣，等同於 at all。常用結構: no + 名詞 + whatsoever。","entries":[{"sentence":"The witness claimed that he had no knowledge <target>whatsoever</target> of the incident, insisting that he was at home during that time.","translation":"證人聲稱他對該事件完全不知情，堅持當時他人在家中。","explanation":"用於否定句末尾加強語氣，表示「一點也不」。"},{"sentence":"There is no reason <target>whatsoever</target> for the student to lie about his homework, as he is known for his honesty in class.","translation":"這名學生沒有任何理由對他的家庭作業撒謊，因為他在班上以誠實著稱。","explanation":"用於加強否定語氣，no reason whatsoever 意為「完全沒有理由」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"wheelchair","explanation":"名詞「輪椅」。常用搭配 use a wheelchair (使用輪椅), confined to a wheelchair (受困於輪椅/長期使用輪椅)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new library was designed with ramps and wide doors to ensure that people in <target>wheelchairs</target> could access all the floors easily.","translation":"新圖書館的設計包含坡道和寬門，以確保使用輪椅的人可以輕鬆進入所有樓層。","explanation":"名詞「輪椅」。"},{"sentence":"After the serious car accident, the athlete was <pattern>confined</pattern> <pattern>to</pattern> a <target>wheelchair</target> for several months during his recovery process.","translation":"在嚴重車禍後，這位運動員在康復過程中好幾個月必須使用輪椅。","explanation":"常用片語 be confined to a wheelchair，指長期或被迫使用輪椅。"}],"related_forms":["wheelchairs"]}

{"headword": "whereabouts", "explanation": "名詞「行蹤、所在地」；副詞「在何處」。名詞用法時，其動詞通常用單數或複數皆可。常用搭配 know someone's whereabouts (知道某人的行蹤) 或 the whereabouts of someone (某人的所在地)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The police are still searching for the missing child, but they have no information regarding his current <target>whereabouts</target>.", "translation": "警方仍在搜尋失蹤的孩子，但他們目前沒有關於他行蹤的任何資訊。", "explanation": "名詞「行蹤」。常用搭配 know/find someone's whereabouts。"}, {"sentence": "The detective tried to determine the <target>whereabouts</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the thief before the police arrived at the scene.", "translation": "偵探試圖確定小偷在警方抵達現場之前的所在地。", "explanation": "名詞「所在地」。常用搭配 the whereabouts of someone。"}, {"sentence": "<target>Whereabouts</target> do you live in the city, or are you staying in one of the suburbs outside the main downtown area?", "translation": "你住在城市的哪個地方，或者你是住在主市區外的郊區？", "explanation": "副詞用法，用於詢問具體位置。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "whereas", "explanation": "連接詞「然而、儘管」。用於對比兩個截然不同的事實或情況。常與 while 同義，但 whereas 更加正式。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The first group of students preferred to study in the library, <target>whereas</target> the second group found it easier to concentrate in a quiet cafe.", "translation": "第一組學生偏好在圖書館學習，而第二組則覺得在安靜的咖啡店更容易集中注意力。", "explanation": "連接詞「然而」。用於對比兩組人的偏好。"}, {"sentence": "The north of the city is known for its modern skyscrapers, <target>whereas</target> the old town is famous for its traditional architecture.", "translation": "城市的北部以現代摩天大樓著稱，而舊城區則以傳統建築聞名。", "explanation": "連接詞「然而」。用於對比城市兩個區域的特徵。"}, {"sentence": "Some people believe that technology simplifies our lives, <target>whereas</target> others argue that it creates more stress and complexity.", "translation": "有些人認為科技簡化了我們的生活，而有些人則認為它創造了更多壓力與複雜性。", "explanation": "連接詞「然而」。用於對比兩種不同的觀點。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword":"whine","explanation":"動詞「抱怨、哀鳴」；名詞「抱怨聲、哀鳴聲」。指以一種令人不悅的高頻率聲音發出的抱怨。注意與 complain 的區別：whine 更強調聲音上的煩人或像小孩一樣的抱怨。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher asked the student to stop <target>whining</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the amount of homework and start focusing on completing the tasks.","translation":"老師要求學生停止抱怨家庭作業的量，並開始專注於完成任務。","explanation":"動詞「抱怨」。常用搭配 whine about sth (對...抱怨)。"},{"sentence":"The dog began to <target>whine</target> <pattern>at</pattern> the door, hoping that its owner would return home and take it for a walk.","translation":"這隻狗開始在門口哀鳴，希望主人會回家並帶它去散步。","explanation":"動詞「哀鳴」。指動物發出的低沉或高頻的哭聲。"},{"sentence":"The constant <target>whine</target> of the old air conditioner made it difficult for the students to concentrate on their final exam.","translation":"舊冷氣機持續發出的尖銳噪音讓學生很難專注於期末考試。","explanation":"名詞「抱怨聲/尖銳噪音」。此處指機械發出的單調且令人不悅的聲音。"}],"related_forms":["whines","whining"]}

{"headword":"widespread","explanation":"形容詞「普遍的、廣泛的」。常用於描述信念、疾病、現象或問題在很大範圍內被接受或已知。常用搭配 widespread belief/fear/use (普遍的信念/恐懼/使用)。","entries":[{"sentence":"There is a <target>widespread</target> <pattern>belief</pattern> that learning a second language at a young age can significantly improve cognitive abilities.","translation":"有一種普遍的信念，認為在年幼時學習第二語言可以顯著提高認知能力。","explanation":"形容詞「普遍的」。常用搭配 widespread belief (普遍的信念)。"},{"sentence":"Due to the <target>widespread</target> <pattern>use of</pattern> digital devices, many students now prefer e-books over printed textbooks for their studies.","translation":"由於數位裝置的廣泛使用，許多學生現在學習時比起印刷教科書更偏好電子書。","explanation":"形容詞「廣泛的」。常用搭配 widespread use of sth (某物的廣泛使用)。"},{"sentence":"The storm caused <target>widespread</target> <pattern>damage</pattern> to houses and power lines across the entire coastal region, leaving thousands without electricity.","translation":"這場風暴對整個沿海地區的房屋和電線造成了普遍的損毀，導致數千人失去電力。","explanation":"形容詞「普遍的」。常用搭配 widespread damage (廣泛的損毀)。"}],"related_forms":["widespreadly"]}

{"headword":"wig","explanation":"名詞「假髮」。常用於描述外觀或特定職業（如法官）的裝扮。","entries":[{"sentence":"The actor wore a curly blonde <target>wig</target> to transform himself into a different character for the stage play.","translation":"這位演員戴著一頂金色的捲髮假髮，為了在舞台劇中將自己轉化為不同的角色。","explanation":"名詞「假髮」。"},{"sentence":"In some traditional British courts, judges are still required to wear a <target>wig</target> as part of their official dress code.","translation":"在一些英國傳統法院中，法官仍被要求戴假髮，作為其官方服裝規定的一部分。","explanation":"名詞「假髮」。"},{"sentence":"After losing her hair due to chemotherapy, she bought a high-quality <target>wig</target> to feel more confident in public.","translation":"在因化療而掉髮後，她買了一頂高品質的假髮，以便在公開場合感到更自信。","explanation":"名詞「假髮」。"}],"related_forms":["wigs"]}

{"headword":"wilderness","explanation":"名詞「荒野」。指未經開發、沒有人居住的自然區域。常考搭配：in the wilderness (在荒野中)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The explorers spent three weeks surviving <pattern>in</pattern> the <target>wilderness</target>, relying only on their basic camping gear and limited food supplies.","translation":"探險家們在荒野中生存了三週，僅依靠他們基本的露營裝備和有限的食物供應。","explanation":"名詞「荒野」。常用片語 in the wilderness。"},{"sentence":"Conservationists are working hard to protect the remaining <target>wilderness</target> areas from being destroyed by urban development and deforestation.","translation":"保育主義者正努力保護剩餘的荒野區域，以免被城市開發和砍伐森林所毀壞。","explanation":"名詞「荒野」。指未開發的自然區域。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"wildlife","explanation":"名詞「野生動物」。集合名詞，通常不可數。常考搭配：protect wildlife (保護野生動物), wildlife conservation (野生動物保育)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The national park is famous for its diverse <target>wildlife</target>, including rare birds and mammals that cannot be found anywhere else.","translation":"這座國家公園以其多樣的野生動物而聞名，包括在其他任何地方都找不到的稀有鳥類和哺乳動物。","explanation":"名詞「野生動物」。"},{"sentence":"The government has implemented new laws to <pattern>protect</pattern> <target>wildlife</target> and prevent illegal poaching in the protected forest reserves.","translation":"政府已實施新法律以保護野生動物，並防止在受保護的森林保護區內進行非法偷獵。","explanation":"名詞「野生動物」。常用搭配 protect wildlife。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"windshield","explanation":"名詞「擋風玻璃」。指車輛前方的玻璃窗。常考搭配：windshield wipers (雨刷)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The driver quickly turned on the <target>windshield</target> <pattern>wipers</pattern> when the heavy rain started to blur his vision of the road.","translation":"當大雨開始模糊他的道路視線時，駕駛迅速開啟了雨刷。","explanation":"名詞「擋風玻璃」。常用搭配 windshield wipers (雨刷)。"},{"sentence":"A small rock hit the <target>windshield</target> during the highway trip, leaving a tiny crack that needed to be repaired immediately.","translation":"在高速公路旅程中，一顆小石頭擊中了擋風玻璃，留下了一個需要立即修理的小裂縫。","explanation":"名詞「擋風玻璃」。"}],"related_forms":["windshields"]}

{"headword":"wither","explanation":"動詞「枯萎；凋零」。常用於描述植物因缺乏水分或養分而枯萎，也可比喻指希望、感情或權力的衰落。","entries":[{"sentence":"Without enough water and sunlight, the delicate flowers in the pot began to <target>wither</target> and turn brown within a few days.","translation":"由於缺乏足夠的水分和陽光，盆中脆弱的花朵在幾天內開始枯萎並變褐。","explanation":"動詞「枯萎」。描述植物生理狀態。"},{"sentence":"As the years passed, the old man's hope of returning to his hometown began to <target>wither</target> due to the endless war.","translation":"隨著年歲增長，這位老人回到故鄉的希望由於不斷的戰爭而開始凋零。","explanation":"動詞「枯萎/凋零」。比喻用法，指希望或情感的衰退。"}],"related_forms":["withered","withering"]}

{"headword":"witty","explanation":"形容詞「機智的、幽默的」。指能快速且巧妙地表達幽默感。注意與 funny 的區別：witty 強調智慧與機巧，而 funny 僅指讓人發笑。","entries":[{"sentence":"The talk show host is known for her <target>witty</target> <pattern>remarks</pattern>, which often make the guests laugh and feel more relaxed during the interview.","translation":"這位脫口秀主持人以其機智的評論而聞名，這經常讓賓客在訪談中發笑並感到更放鬆。","explanation":"形容詞「機智的」。常用搭配 witty remarks (機智的評論)。"},{"sentence":"He wrote a <target>witty</target> response to the criticism, using clever wordplay to turn the negative comments into a joke.","translation":"他對批評寫了一個機智的回應，利用巧妙的文字遊戲將負面評論轉化為一個笑話。","explanation":"形容詞「機智的」。"}],"related_forms":["wit"]}

{"headword":"workshop","explanation":"名詞「工作坊；研習會；工作車間」。在現代教育語境中，常指透過實作練習來學習技能的短期課程或研習會。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university organized a <target>workshop</target> <pattern>on</pattern> creative writing to help students improve their storytelling skills and receive feedback from experts.","translation":"大學組織了一個關於創意寫作的工作坊，以幫助學生提高敘事技巧並獲得專家的回饋。","explanation":"名詞「工作坊」。常用搭配 workshop on sth (關於...的工作坊)。"},{"sentence":"The artist spends most of his time in his <target>workshop</target>, where he creates intricate sculptures from recycled metal and wood.","translation":"這位藝術家大部分時間都在他的工作車間裡，在那裡他用回收的金屬和木材創作複雜的雕塑。","explanation":"名詞「工作車間」。指實作的物理空間。"}],"related_forms":["workshops"]}

{"headword":"worship","explanation":"名詞「崇拜；祭拜」；動詞「崇拜；祭拜」。常用於宗教語境，或比喻指對某人極度崇拜。常考搭配：worship at (在...祭拜)。","entries":[{"sentence":"People from different cultures have different ways to <target>worship</target> their gods <pattern>at</pattern> temples, churches, or mosques.","translation":"來自不同文化的人們在寺廟、教堂或清真寺祭拜他們的神靈的方式不同。","explanation":"動詞「祭拜」。常用搭配 worship at (在...祭拜)。"},{"sentence":"The ancient civilization used to <target>worship</target> the sun as the source of all life and strength on earth.","translation":"這個古代文明過去將太陽崇拜為地球上所有生命和力量的來源。","explanation":"動詞「崇拜」。"},{"sentence":"The young fan's <target>worship</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the famous pop star was so intense that she collected every single piece of merchandise.","translation":"這位年輕粉絲對那位知名流行歌手的崇拜如此強烈，以至於她收集了每一件周邊商品。","explanation":"名詞「崇拜」。常用搭配 worship of sth/sb。"},{"sentence":"Every Sunday, the community gathers for a <target>worship</target> <pattern>service</pattern>, praying together for peace and prosperity in the city.","translation":"每個星期日，社區居民聚集在一起參加崇拜儀式，共同祈禱城市的和平與繁榮。","explanation":"名詞「崇拜」。常用搭配 worship service (崇拜儀式)。"}],"related_forms":["worshipper"]}

{"headword":"worthwhile","explanation":"形容詞「值得的」。指某事雖然需要付出努力或時間，但結果是值得的。常考用法：it is worthwhile to V / it is worthwhile doing sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although the hike to the mountain top was exhausting, the breathtaking view from the summit made the effort <target>worthwhile</target>.","translation":"雖然徒步登上山頂非常累，但山頂上令人屏息的美景讓這份努力變得值得。","explanation":"形容詞「值得的」。"},{"sentence":"Many students believe that volunteering at the local animal shelter is a <target>worthwhile</target> <pattern>experience</pattern> that teaches them compassion and responsibility.","translation":"許多學生認為在當地動物收容所擔任志工是一次值得的經驗，能教會他們同情心和責任感。","explanation":"形容詞「值得的」。常用搭配 worthwhile experience (值得的經驗)。"},{"sentence":"The teacher suggested that it is <target>worthwhile</target> <pattern>to</pattern> review the old notes before taking the final exam to ensure a better grade.","translation":"老師建議在參加期末考前複習舊筆記是值得的，以確保更好的成績。","explanation":"形容詞「值得的」。常用搭配 it is worthwhile to V。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword": "worthy", "explanation": "形容詞「值得的；有價值的」。常用於指某人足以獲得某種待遇或某事足以被關注。常考搭配：be worthy of sth / be worthy of being V-ed。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The brave firefighter was considered <target>worthy</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a national award for his courage in saving people from the burning building.", "translation": "這位勇敢的消防員因其在燃燒建築中營救人們的勇氣而被認為值得獲得國家獎項。", "explanation": "形容詞「值得的」。常用搭配 be worthy of sth。"}, {"sentence": "The historic site is <target>worthy</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a visit, as it provides a deep insight into how people lived in the ancient times.", "translation": "這個歷史遺址值得參觀，因為它提供了對古代人們如何生活的深刻見解。", "explanation": "形容詞「值得的」。常用搭配 be worthy of sth。"}, {"sentence": "She felt that her hard work and dedication were <target>worthy</target> <pattern>of</pattern> being recognized by the school administration.", "translation": "她覺得她的努力和奉獻值得被學校行政部門認可。", "explanation": "形容詞「值得的」。常用搭配 be worthy of being V-ed。"}], "related_forms": ["worthiness", "worthily"]}

{"headword": "yacht", "explanation": "名詞指「遊艇」，通常指大型、豪華且用於休閒或競賽的船隻。在 GSAT 考題中，主要以名詞形式出現，描述奢侈生活方式或度假場景。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The billionaire spent his summer vacation on a luxury <target>yacht</target>, sailing across the Mediterranean Sea to visit various islands.", "translation": "這位億萬富翁在豪華遊艇上度過了他的暑假，在地中海航行以參觀不同的島嶼。", "explanation": "名詞「遊艇」。指用於休閒或豪華旅行的大型船隻。"}, {"sentence": "The local harbor is filled with expensive <target>yachts</target> and small fishing boats, reflecting the diverse economic status of the visitors.", "translation": "當地港口停滿了昂貴的遊艇和小漁船，反映出遊客的不同經濟地位。", "explanation": "名詞「遊艇」。複數形式 yachts。"}], "related_forms": ["yachts", "yachting"]}

{"headword": "yield", "explanation": "多義詞。動詞用法包括：1. 「產出、生產」（常用於農業收成、科學研究產出）；2. 「屈服、讓步」（常搭配 yield to）；3. 「讓路」（交通規則用語）。名詞用法指「產量」或投資的「收益、回報率」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The new farming technique is expected to <target>yield</target> a high crop this year, helping the farmers increase their total income.", "translation": "新的耕作技術預計今年會產出高產量，幫助農民增加他們的總收入。", "explanation": "動詞「產出、生產」。指農業上的收成或產量產出。"}, {"sentence": "After hours of intense negotiation, the company finally <target>yielded</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the demands of the workers and agreed to increase their wages.", "translation": "經過數小時激烈的談判後，公司最終屈服於工人的要求，並同意增加他們的工資。", "explanation": "動詞片語 yield to，表示屈服於壓力、要求或權威。"}, {"sentence": "Drivers must <target>yield</target> <pattern>to</pattern> pedestrians who are crossing the street at the crosswalk to ensure everyone's safety.", "translation": "駕駛員必須讓路給在斑馬線過馬路的人，以確保每個人的安全。", "explanation": "動詞片語 yield to，在交通語境中表示「讓路給...」。"}, {"sentence": "The investor decided to buy government bonds because they provide a stable <target>yield</target> of four percent per year.", "translation": "投資者決定購買政府債券，因為它們每年提供百分之四的穩定收益。", "explanation": "名詞「收益、回報」。經常用於金融和投資投資語境。"}, {"sentence": "Scientists hope that the long-term experiments will eventually <target>yield</target> useful data for climate change research.", "translation": "翻譯：科學家們希望這項長期實驗最終能為氣候變遷研究產出有用的數據。", "explanation": "動詞「產出、產生」。用於科學或抽象研究，指得出結果或數據。"}], "related_forms": ["yields"]}
